title: Epic RPG: Lost Teleport
description: A balanced and fair teleportation, powered by Redstone and linked by a special item. A new way to manage how people move around the world.
body:
Fed up with overpowered teleport spam? Restore balance with the teleport node system.

LostTeleport was built to help players return home from distant places—without breaking game balance. The system includes cooldowns to prevent abuse and uses uncommon materials, giving value to items often overlooked by other mods. It’s not instant or free: it demands effort, preparation, and intention. It was also designed to blend naturally with the vanilla environment, respecting its logic and aesthetic.



--------------------------------------------------------------
• Teleport Node 
   - Activates only via redstone blocks, redstone torches, or powered redstone dust
   - Ignores levers, buttons, pressure plates, and other manual triggers
   - Can be linked to another node using the Linker
   - Emits visual feedback when active or in cooldown

![node](https://i.ibb.co/QvFXFfPr/lost-teleport-node-off.png)

--------------------------------------------------------------
• Linker
   - Right-click a node to store its position, then right-click another to complete the link
   - The linked node’s position is saved and displayed directly in the item’s tooltip
   - Reusable
   - One-way linking: the second node becomes the teleport destination

![linker](https://i.ibb.co/dJwHdKhp/teleport-link.png)

--------------------------------------------------------------
• Teleport Crystal
   - Consumable item used to initiate teleportation
   - Must be channeled while standing on an active node
   - Teleport succeeds only if both nodes are powered and linked
   - Crystal is consumed on success

![crystal](https://i.ibb.co/ynD1r3sq/teleport-focus-crystal.png)

title: SuperMoneyTokens
description: Give out redeemable money, integrating with almost all economy plugins automatically.
body:
# SuperMoneyTokens SuperMoneyTokens is a plugin that allows you to give out redeemable money, integrating with almost all economy plugins automatically. ### Money is given out in three ways: 1. A simple token: right click to redeem
2. A Player-generated bank note with /withdraw
3. A Coin Vault which contains a random amount of money and plays an animation
# Commands and Permissions ### Players: - **/withdraw** - moneytokens.withdraw
Players can withdraw a bank note from their balance. ### Admins: - **/moneytoken** (/mt) give - moneytokens.admin.give
Give a player a redeemable money token.

- **/coinvault** (/cv) give - moneytokens.admin.give
Give a player a coin vault containing random amounts of money # Configuration The plugin can be configured using the `config.yml` file that will be located in your plugins/SuperMoneyTokens folder. This file allows you to customize various aspects of the money tokens and coin vaults, such as names, lore, and tier and level-specific settings.
Example config.yml ```yaml coinvault-name: "&a&nCoin Vault&7 (Tier %tier%)" coinvault-levels: 1: # All of these settings are optional except for 'min' and 'max' coinvault-name: "&a&nCoin Vault&7 (Tier %tier%)" min: 25_000 max: 100_000 max-commands: 1 # You can add as many commands as you like, # or remove the section entirely to ignore them. commands: 1: command: give %player% diamond 1 chance: 50 2: min: 100_000 max: 500_000 3: min: 500_000 max: 2_500_000 4: min: 2_500_000 max: 10_000_000 5: min: 10_000_000 max: 50_000_000 money-token: # %amount% is a placeholder for the value of the token; (1,000) name: "&a$%amount%" lore: ["&7Right-Click to redeem &a$%amount%"] ```
# Bugs and Suggestions If you require support or would like to make a suggestion for the plugin, please join the [Discord](https://discord.gg/cAtj5Ue2mC) where support will be provided.

title: CustomWings
description: Create custom particle wings for your players!
body:
<center>

# **Custom Wings**
 
 ![](https://i.imgur.com/xJaAwv3.png)

CustomWings allows players to equip beautiful particle wings ingame, to show off to their friends.

CustomWings comes with preset wings, but you are free to create many more. You can even make the wings animated!
Wings can be created through the config. CustomWings features an ingame Editor GUI allowing you to edit wing settings on the fly.</center>


<details>
<summary>Screenshots</summary>

![](https://i.imgur.com/KiXmuOG.png)
![](https://i.imgur.com/n97vP7B.png)
 ![](https://i.imgur.com/HmYozc7.png)
  
![https://i.imgur.com/qyzuw5D.gif](https://i.imgur.com/qyzuw5D.gif)
![https://i.imgur.com/7UIsmdz.gif](https://i.imgur.com/7UIsmdz.gif)


</details>


<details>
<summary>Commands & permissions</summary>


```
/customwings (wings, cw, w) - Main command, opens the wing selection GUI
    permission: customwings.command
    permission for each wing: customwings.wing.WINGID

Subcommands:
setwing {playername} {wing ID} - sets a wing for the specified player
    permission: customwings.setwing

editor (edit, e) - open the wing editor GUI
    permission: customwings.editor

preview (p) - unattached the currently equipped wing from the player, making it float in the air
    permission: customwings.preview

reload (r) -  reload CustomWings
    permission: customwings.reload

takeawaywing {playername} {wing ID} - Take away a wing from a player if they have bought it before
    permission: customwings.takeawaywings


```


</details>


<details>
<summary>Creating wings</summary>


Below you will find an example of how a wing is setup in the config.
The CustomWings standard config includes more examples.

```yaml


#-------------------------------------------------#
#                 CustomWings                     #
#             Example config file                 #
#-------------------------------------------------#


# This is a commented example config file for a wing.
# All wing configs that you want to use have to be in the 'wings' folder.
# The config's file name is the wing's ID. Used in the permission or the setwing command.
# You can recreate this file and the default wings by deleting the wings folder and reloading the plugin.

# When making changes in the main config or a wing config, you can use the customwings reload command.
# Addiontally you can use the ingame editor menu to change the settings.
# When deleting wings or change the config file names, you will have to restart your server.


# If true the wing will be shown then the player is moving, otherwise it will stop spawning the wing particles when the player starts to move.
showWhenMoving: true

# The worlds where wing can be equipped. Use "all" for all worlds.
whitelistedWorlds:
  - "all"
#   - "world" Default overworld
#   - "world_nether" Default nether
#   - "world_the_end" Default end

# Requires vault. Allows players to buy the wings though the menu.
# Will automatically be disabled if vault is not found.
economy:
#   Type of price to pay.
#   "economy" - Default vault economy.
#   "token" - TokenManager.
  priceType: "economy"

#   Price to pay to unlock the wings.
#   -1 = cannot buy; 0 = free.
  price: 10

# The item that will show up in menu's.
menuItem:

  #If true the wing will not show up in the wing select menu. (Can still be equiped with the /wings setwing command)
  hideInMenu: false

#   name: "&5Example Wing" Also used in other places where the wing name is used.

  material: DIRT
  slot: 0
#   page: 1 Has to be smaller or equal to the pages in the main config.

  loreWhenEquipped:
    - "&6You have the &5Example Wing &6equipped"
  loreWhenUnequipped:
    - "&3You do not have the &5Example Wing &3equipped"
  loreWhenNoPermission:
    - "&cYou do not own the &5Example Wing"
  loreWhenCanBuy:
    - "&eYou can buy this for ${PRICE}"


# The settings for the actual wing.
wing:

#   The starting height of the wing, starting from the players feet. Can be negative
  startVertical: -0.1

#   Offset the wing to the left or right. Negative numbers are to the right
  startHorizontalOffset: 0

#   The starting distance from the player. Accepts negative numbers.
  startDistanceToPlayer: 0.3

#   The distance between each particle in the horizonal and vertical direction.
  distanceBetweenParticles: 0.1

#   The amount of game ticks between the spawing of the wing's particles.
  timer: 2

#   If true the wing will have a flapping animation.
  flapAnimation: true

#   The speed at which the wing should flap. (This is the degrees it moves everytime the wing's particles are spawned).
  flapSpeed: 4

#   The starting position of the wings in degrees. 0 = next to the player. 90 = behind the player.
  startOffset: 30

#   The stopping position of the wings in degrees. Only used when wingAnimation is enabled. 90 = behind the player. 0 = next to the player.
  stopOffset: 70

#   If true only the right side of the wing will be spawed. Usefully for text or pixelart that can't be mirrored. It won't be able to have a flapping animiation.
  onlyOneSide: false

#   The grid layout of the wing. Use an '-' to not spawn a particle. Any other character must have a maching on under 'particles'.
#   You only need to make the right side of the wing, it will be duplicated to the other side
  particleLayout:
    1:  "-,-,-,-,x,x,x,-,-,-"
    2:  "-,-,-,x,x,x,x,x,-,-"
    3:  "-,-,x,x,x,x,x,x,x,-"
    4:  "-,x,x,x,x,x,x,x,x,-"
    5:  "x,x,x,x,x,x,x,x,x,x"
    6:  "x,x,x,x,x,x,x,x,x,x"
    7:  "x,x,x,x,x,x,x,x,x,x"
    8:  "x,x,x,x,x,x,x,x,x,x"
    9:  "-,-,x,x,x,x,x,x,x,x"
    10: "-,-,-,x,x,x,x,x,x,x"
    11: "-,-,-,x,x,x,x,x,x,x"
    12: "-,-,-,-,x,x,x,x,x,x"
    13: "-,-,-,-,x,x,x,x,x,x"
    14: "-,-,-,-,-,x,x,x,x,-"
    15: "-,-,-,-,-,x,x,x,x,-"
    16: "-,-,-,-,-,-,x,x,x,-"
    17: "-,-,-,-,-,-,x,x,x,-"
    18: "-,-,-,-,-,-,-,x,x,-"
    19: "-,-,-,-,-,-,-,-,x,-"

#   The different particles that can be used in the particleLayout.
  particles:
#     The ID of the particle used as a character in the particleLayout.
      x:
#         The name of the particle that you want to use. All minecraft particles can be found here: https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/spigot/org/bukkit/Particle.html.
#         Note that not all particles might be available in your minecraft version. If an invalid particle is given, a Barrier particle will be used instead.
        particle: "CRIT_MAGIC"

#         Some particles, like FIREWORKS_SPARK or FLAME, can have directional moving settings.
#         "distance" is the horizontal distance the particle will move from it's original location in the direction of the angle
#         "height" is the vertical distance the particle will move from it's original location
#         "angle" is the angle at with the particle will fly towards. 0 is parallel to the wing, -90 is to the back of the wing.
#         "speed" is the velocity the particle will have
#         Note that each type of particle will only stay 'alive' for a certain amount of time. This cannot be changed.
#         So you will have to balance distance, height and speed to get the particle to end up where you want it to.
        distance: 0
        height: 0
        angle: 0
        speed: 0

#         Redstone, Spell_mob and Spell_mob_ambient can have a color value. This is given in HEX format writting as 0xRRGGBB e.a 0xFF00FF. Or as an RGB int.
        color: 0xFFFFFF

#         A note particle can also have a color. But it works a bit differently. Minecraft has 24 values for a note's color.
#         So you can enter a value from 1-24 here.
        noteColor: 6

#         ITEM_CRACK, BLOCK_CRACK, BLOCK_DUST and FALLING_DUST require a material to work correctly.
        blockType: DIRT



```


NoahOrtega made a program to convert an image to pixels which can be used to create wings for CustomWings. CustomWings is not associated with this program. The user selects their png pixel art and the program converts it into text which is formatted to the specifications of the customwings .yml wing files.
  
The program can be found here: [https://github.com/NoahOrtega/PixToText](https://github.com/NoahOrtega/PixToText)




</details>

## **Contact**

[https://discord.gg/G8nG65S](https://discord.gg/G8nG65S)

</center>

title: Customizable 3D Doll Item
description: Just a cute doll holding an item for you
body:
Heavily modified from [千虑智者's version](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1Zw411S7DS/?spm_id_from=333.1387.homepage.video_card.click&vd_source=19d7270f8ca54520dc485bb7aaed9421).

**You can customize any item into a sitting doll holding an item. This requires some basic Minecraft resource pack skills. Should work for most of the Minecraft versions.**
## Highlights
- Both the item and the doll is 3D (also for the 2nd layer of the skin).
- Fully customizable as long as you know how to make resource packs. You can even use this model on a block item. You can also use Blockbench to change the doll's pos or add some decorations.

_Item textures should be **16x or lower (best 16x)**. Skins should be **64x or lower (best 64x)**._
## Steps to customize:
1. Open the resource pack .zip file (or decompress it if you can't directly modify files in a .zip).
2. Go to _"assets\minecraft\textures\item\doll\"_ and put a skin file in .png here (assume it's named as **newton.png**).
3. (_If you don't want to change the item's texture (so it stays vanilla or from another resource pack you enabled), skip this step._)\
Go to _"assets\minecraft\textures\item\"_ and put the desired item texture in .png here (assume it's named as **apple.png**).
4. Go to _"assets\minecraft\models\item\"_. If the skin you just put is classic (arm with 4 pixels), copy **classic.json** and paste it here. If the skin is slim (arm with 3 pixels), copy **slim.json**. Rename the pasted file to the item whose model you want to change. For example, you want to change "minecraft:apple", then you rename the file to **apple.json**.
5. Open the .json file, look for the following (_"doll_slim": "item/doll/slim"_ if your skin is slim):
```json
"textures": {
  "doll_wide": "item/doll/classic",
  "particle": "item/whatever",
  "item": "item/whatever"
}
```
> For **"doll_wide"** or **"doll_slim"**: Change _"item/doll/classic"_ into the file path of your skin (without ".png").
>
> For **"particle"**: This controls such as the particle when you eat this item. You can change _"item/whatever"_ into the texture file path of this item (without ".png").
>
> For **"item"**: This is the item texture the doll holds. Change _"item/whatever"_ into the texture file path of this item (without ".png").

![image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dac5779725e03abc2d2af51de7af756cf03d8afb.png)

**You can repeat steps 2~5 to modify the models of several items. You can then put the resource pack into the resource pack folder and enable it.**

title: LoadPlayerByName
description: Makes switching between online mode and offline mode much easier!
body:
# Load Player By Name

Minecraft stores the player data by their UUIDs, but the UUIDs in online mode servers  (provided by Mojang's official API) are different with the one generated offline.

This cause issues when you want to change online/offline mode while not affecting your players' data

## How This Plugin Works

<details>
<summary>I guess you don't care about this</summary>

1. It stores an name to UUID association table
2. When a player joins:
    - We receive an UUID of the player (new ID)
    - Look the player name in the table and get the old ID
    - If not present, try getting the Mojang official UUID as old ID
    - If even the official ID isn't present
        - It's a new offline player, ignore
    - Try to move the player data from old ID to new ID
        - If succeeded, it will kick the player once, and prompt them to rejoin immediately
3. When a player quits:
    - Update the association table
</details>

## Cases

- Server was online mode, plugin not installed
  > You can switch to offline mode with this plugin installed now

- Plugin installed
  > You can switch between modes with ease, without player data lossing

## Notes

- I don't know what will happen if you switch between modes and a player change their username at the same time
- I sometimes spell the plugin `LoadByPlayerName`, well, doesn't matter I guess

title: AniSkin
description: Animated skins of any resolution
body:
This mod allows you to use animated skins stored locally on your PC, or remotely on your server or any image hosting.

First case is for singleplayer, and second is good if you want to share your skin with your friends. Just add URL with all skins to mod configs. It can be either file:/// or http(s)://. Also, if you are using some free image hosting for your skins and it has no direct filename in their URLs you can use name aliases in config matching your name to filecode.

#### This mod requires [ASJCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/asjcore) to run.

Examples:

Animated skin – [lava man](https://legacy.curseforge.com/linkout?remoteUrl=https%253a%252f%252fbitbucket.org%252fAlexSocol%252falfheim%252fraw%252f04ac3d6de1e8274475d5a48cdf905fdcccfa0962%252fsrc%252fmain%252fresources%252fassets%252falfmod%252ftextures%252fmodel%252fentity%252fMuspellsun.png).

Host configs:

Local: make folder **C:\Minecraft\skins\\** and place all your skins there. Names must match username, like *AlexSocol.png* will be for my skin. Then specify the path to this folder, starting with local storage marker **file:**\\\\\ then path to folder made previously and then a nickname placeholder - this will be replaced with your nick. End with .png (because this is the only supported file extension). Result: **file:\\\\\C:\Minecraft\skins\\%s.png**

Remote: same as local, but instead of **file:**\\\\\ use **http:**\\\\ or **https:**\\\\, then add the rest of the URL, placeholder and file extension. Something like: **https:\\\my.skinhost.org\\skins\\%s.png**

And if you are using some public host like googledrive or something else without filenames in the URL, you can specify aliases to match nicks with codes from URL: AlexSocol:AbCdEfGhIjKlMnOp... The host config will be like this: https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/%s.

Remember that images must be .png to work properly. The size is unlimited (well almost unlimited, depends on your GPU), but you need to make sure that width of each frame is twice as big as it's height. Default are 64x32. Number of frames can be unlimited (same as above).

title: PriorChat
description: Minecraft plugin that sends server chat history to players on join.
body:
# PriorChat Plugin
[![GitHub Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/certainly1182/PriorChat?include_prereleases)](https://github.com/certainly1182/PriorChat/releases)
[![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/JMSHw1n4)](https://modrinth.com/plugin/priorchat)

Simple plugin for [Paper](https://papermc.io) servers that stores and displays a history of chat messages for players when they join the server.

## Features
- Stores a configurable number of past chat messages in a queue.
- Displays past chat messages to players when they join the server.
- Stores join, chat, quit, death, broadcast, advancement and kick messages.
## Installation
To install PriorChat, follow these steps:
1. Download the plugin JAR file from [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/plugin/priorchat) or the [Releases](https://github.com/certainly1182/PriorChat/releases) page.
2. Place the JAR file in the plugins folder of your Paper (or Paper fork) server.
3. Start the server and verify that the plugin loaded successfully.
## Configuration
The plugin can be configured via the `config.yml` file located in `plugins/PriorChat`.

The following configuration options are available:
- `debug_mode` (default: false) - Debug mode toggle.
- `number_of_messages_to_store` (default: 50) - The maximum number of chat messages to store in the queue.
- `enabled_message_types` (default: all types) - List of message types to store. Valid values are `CHAT`, `JOIN`, `QUIT`, `DEATH`, `BROADCAST`, `ADVANCEMENT` and `KICK`.
### Default Config
```yml
debug_mode: false
number_of_messages_to_store: 50
enabled_message_types:
  - CHAT
  - JOIN
  - QUIT
  - DEATH
  - BROADCAST
  - ADVANCEMENT
  - KICK
  ```
## Usage
The PriorChat plugin does not *yet* have any commands or permissions. Simply install the plugin on your server to start using it.

When a player joins the server, the plugin will display a configurable number of past chat messages to the player.

title: OptiPlus-Crystal
description: Removes the round-trip wait between clicking obsidian and seeing an end crystal appear.
body:
# 💎 OptiPlus Crystal

> **Zero-wait end crystal placement — now on Minecraft 1.20 through 26.2**

---

## What it does

OptiPlus Crystal removes the round-trip wait between clicking a block and seeing your end crystal appear. The instant you click a valid spot, a client-side "ghost" crystal is placed right away, so placement feels single-player-snappy no matter your ping. The real server crystal silently takes its place once it arrives.

No more waiting on the server to acknowledge your click, and no stuttery placement loops during crystal PvP.

## Features

- Instant, ping-independent end crystal placement

- Client-side only — works on any server, nothing needed server-side

- One jar for every version — it auto-detects your Minecraft version and just works

- Lightweight, Fabric

## Supported versions

A single jar now runs on **Minecraft 1.20 → 26.2**: 1.20, 1.20.1–1.20.6, 1.21–1.21.11, 26.1 and 26.2 (Fabric, client-side). Just drop it into your mods folder.

## Server opt-out

Server admins can disable OptiPlus per-player by sending a plugin-message on one of these channels when a player joins:

- optiplus:disable — disable everything

- optiplus-crystal:disable — disable only the crystal optimization

The flag resets on disconnect.

title: Modern industrialization FE compat
description:
NeoForge addon for Modern Industrialization.
Make MI electric network compatible with FE network.
body:
## MI-FE-Compat

Bridges **Modern Industrialization** (EU) and **NeoForge Forge Energy** (FE) — allowing FE generators to power MI cables and FE cables to connect to MI machines.

---

### What it does

MI machines only speak the MI energy API (`EnergyApi.SIDED`). Mods speak NeoForge FE (`IEnergyStorage`). Without this mod, the two systems are invisible to each other. MI-FE-Compat registers two transparent bridges so energy flows freely in both directions.

---

### Two bridge directions

| Direction | Use case |
|-----------|----------|
| **FE → MI** | FE generators (Mekanism, Thermal, etc.) supply power to MI cables |
| **MI → FE** | FE cables (Mekanism Universal Cable, PowerGrid) connect to MI machines |

Both bridges are registered via NeoForge's `RegisterCapabilitiesEvent` and cached by `BlockCapabilityCache` — they are created once per block position on cache miss, not every tick. A shared recursion guard (`ThreadLocal`) prevents infinite loops when the two bridges would otherwise trigger each other.

---

### Configuration

No separate config file. The EU ↔ FE conversion ratio is read directly from **Modern Industrialization's own config** (`forgeEnergyPerEu`, default: **1 EU = 10 FE**). Changing the ratio in MI's config automatically applies to this mod.

---

### Commands

All commands require permission level 0 (any player).

**`/mifecompat status`**  
Shows how many bridges have been created for each direction. Use this to verify the mod is working after placing cables.

**`/mifecompat check`**  
Inspects the 6 blocks adjacent to your position and reports which energy APIs each one exposes: `[FE]` (NeoForge), `[GP]` (GrandPower), `[MI]` (Modern Industrialization).

**`/mifecompat scan`**  
Scans a 5-block radius around you and lists all energy-capable block types found. Useful for diagnosing why a connection is not forming.

---

### Compatibility

Tested with Modern Industrialization 1.7+, Mekanism, and PowerGrid on NeoForge 21.1 (Minecraft 1.21.1). Any mod that uses standard NeoForge `IEnergyStorage` should work automatically.

**Does not conflict** with GrandPower-based bridges already built into MI — this mod only activates for blocks that MI does not natively handle.

# 🔍 The Ultimate Resource Pack Designed for Enhanced Visibility
This resource pack is designed to maximize visibility during combat, exploration, and building.  
It highlights key information while preserving the vanilla atmosphere.

---

## ✨ Features

### 🔥 Low Fire and Low Shield
Keeps the screen clear when on fire.

### ⛰️ Fine-Tuning Terrain Colors
We’ve improved enemy visibility by darkening the brightness and saturation of certain blocks used in the terrain.

### 💡 Full Bright
It illuminates even dark areas without hesitation.

### 🎞️ Shader Optimization
We’ve optimized the processing of certain shaders.

### 🌧️ Improved Visibility on Rainy and Snowy Days
Reduces visual clutter caused by weather conditions.

### 🪄 Reduced Totem Activation Effects
Totem animations no longer cover the entire screen.

### 💧 Improved Water Transparency
We’ve improved visibility from above the water’s surface into the water. We also took care not to make the transparency too low, so we’ve made a “just right” adjustment that doesn’t ruin the vanilla atmosphere.

### 💥 Removal of Unnecessary Particles
Items removed:  
- Falling leaf particles  
- Heart particles when taking damage  
- Water splash particles  

### 🎃 Improved Visibility for Pumpkins and Powder Snow
This significantly reduces visual obstruction when wearing a pumpkin or standing on powder snow.

### ✨ Improved Distinguishability of Enchanted Items
Enchanted items are now visually easier to distinguish.

### 🪨 Ore Outlines
- Added outlines to all ores based on their respective ore colors  
- **Ancient Shards now glow with a rainbow-colored light**

### 🧊 Distinguishing Powder Snow from Regular Snow
Added a border to Powder Snow.

### 🧱 Reduced Terracotta and Concrete Textures
We’ve reduced the texture size to 1px to improve performance. While the vanilla texture is a 16px × 16px (256px) image, we’ve replaced it with a 1px × 1px image, reducing the size to 1/256th. Additionally, there is virtually no perceptible difference in color even when viewed up close.

### 🌐 Multilingual Support
Works with all vanilla-supported languages.

### 🔢 Numerical Effects & Enchantment Levels
Effects and enchantment levels are displayed using Arabic numerals.

---

## 🎯 Recommended for
- Players who regularly play PvP, RTA, SMP, or Survival
- Players who want to improve visibility without compromising the vanilla atmosphere
- Those looking for a lightweight and practical resource pack

---

Please read the license carefully before using this resource pack.

description: Fixes broken armor textures and rendering issues when using Tinkers' Construct armor with Epic Fight's combat mode
body: # **Epic Fight - Tinkers' Armor Fix** ![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.20.1-green?style=flat-square) ![Forge](https://img.shields.io/badge/Forge-47.x-red?style=flat-square) ![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Version-20.0.0-orange?style=flat-square) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-GPL--3-blue?style=flat-square) *** # **What does this mod do?** * Fix the bug where Tinkers armor was rendered as diamond armor when Epic Fight's battle mode was enabled. | | | *** # **How it works?** * Tinkers' Construct armor doesn't use a single fixed texture; it dynamically layers multiple textures onto the player's body in real-time. * Epic Fight, however, requires a static texture to apply to its custom combat models. When it fails to find one for Tinkers' armor, it defaults to the vanilla diamond armor texture. * This mod solves the issue by "baking" all the individual Tinkers' layers into a single, complete texture on-the-fly, then caching it and providing it to Epic Fight whenever the armor is worn. *** # **Installation Required** [1\. Tinkers' Consturct](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/tinkers-construct/files/7449219) [2\. Mantle](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mantle/files/7563777) [3\. # M'n'S: More Class

Expand your *Mine and Slash* experience with additional ascension classes, each bringing unique playstyles and abilities to your adventures.

## Overview

**M'n'S: More Class** adds fully-integrated spell schools, unique buffs/debuffs, custom perks, and balanced progression nodes that feel native to the Mine and Slash ecosystem. Each class brings a distinct playstyle to enhance party dynamics and solo gameplay.

**Spell Lineup:**
- **Barkskin** – Grant nearby allies damage reduction with protective bark armor
- **Purification** – Cleanse harmful debuffs from yourself and allies in a wide radius
- **Weakness Aura** – Project a debilitating aura that reduces enemy armor in front of you
- **Entangling Thorns** – Anchor a stationary thornfield that immobilizes and damages enemies over time
- **Sakura Bloom** – Summon a healing sakura grove that restores health and grants attack speed to nearby allies

#### Ninja – Agile Shadow Striker
A high-mobility melee specialist wielding shurikens, scythes, and shadow techniques.

**Spell Lineup:**
- **Shadow Walk** – Dash forward through shadows with enhanced movement
- **Shuriken** – Hurl throwing stars at enemies from range
- **Shunjin** – Lightning-fast strike that boosts attack speed
- **Toxic Edge** – Poison-infused blade attack that applies damage over time
- **Ryuusei Ranbu** – Devastating meteor rush combo attack
- **Swing Scythe** – Wide sweeping scythe attack for AoE damage
- **Shadow Secret** – Ultimate shadow technique for burst damage

### Complete Integration

Each class includes:
- Dedicated spell school trees with unlockable nodes
- Custom exile effects (buffs/debuffs) unique to each spell
- Balanced perks that synergize with Mine and Slash's progression systems
- Full localization support (English and Japanese)

- **Minecraft:** 1.20.1
- **Mod Loader:** Forge
- **Dependencies:** Mine and Slash (by RobertX22)

1. Download the latest release from CurseForge or Modrinth

title: WeaponCraft
description: Craft the Weapon of your dreams, block by block.
body:
![WeaponCraft-Title](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_44bd985c-da0f-4cc3-9bf2-88e477263ac9.png)

Welcome to WeaponCraft.

Minecraft... the game where a dirt house gives you +50 efficiency and a stone brick house +25 nostalgia.
Yet, crafting a sword takes no more than a few hand gestures and 0.5 seconds of your life. But for what?
WeaponCraft aims to fill that gap.

Currently in testing. Core logic is implemented.
I need your feedback. Go and craft your weapon!



Already implemented:

  • Draw your perfect weapon on a blueprint with the voxel-based system
  • Design with up to 3 blueprint layers for a single weapon
  • Set the thickness of each layer separately
  • Each voxel defines the final result (e.g. weight increases Damage but decreases Speed)
  • 6 stats to influence: Damage/Speed, Knockback/Crit, Reach/Durability
  • Each weapon is 100% unique: voxels will vary slightly in texture darkness
  • Preview system: see the 3D preview model before creating it

Planned (Test phase 2):

Blacksmithing profession: gain experience as you craft to allow for larger blueprints with an impactful crafting process where you will smelt your ores, pour them into your mold, hammer away and reforge.
Higher level blacksmiths also have a chance to craft a "greater" or "perfect" weapon, further increasing its stats.

Ideas for later

Gemcrafting: craft gems (lapis, amethyst, etc) and socket them into your weapon post-forging for even more unique stat boosts and abilities.

### Quick start Guide Forge your first weapon in a few steps: | Action | Description | |:--|:--| | **Press `B`** | Opens the **Blueprint GUI** — your creative forge. | | **Select a Material** | Choose your base material for each layer. | | **LMB (Draw)** | Paint voxels onto the blueprint to **add material**. | | **RMB (Erase)** | Remove unwanted voxels to refine your design. | | **Scroll Wheel** | **Zoom in/out** to adjust your view of the grid. | | **LMB Drag (Preview Window)** | **Rotate** the 3D weapon render for better angles. | | **RMB Drag (Preview Window)** | **Move/Pan** the 3D weapon render. | | **Click `Forge`** | Finalize and create your weapon.
(Minting is not yet active — materials are not consumed in this Alpha build.) |

# Ray's Added Spears - Datapack

Enhance your Minecraft gameplay with the new spears (from Minecraft Snapshot 24w41a) that’s more versatile and powerful than ever. This datapack adds new enchantment options, crafting recipes, and combat mechanics for an engaging experience, for players who do not play on the snapshot versions, or just want it early in their gameplay!

## Features

- **Expanded Enchantments:** 
Compatible with **Mending** and **all levels of Lunging** for better speeds and or durability.  
- **Crafting Recipes:** 
Easy-to-follow recipes to integrate the spear into your survival or creative worlds.  
- **Unique Combat Mechanics:** 
Faster attacks, balanced knockback, and a more rewarding weapon for both PvE and PvP.  
- **Optional OP Tweaks:** 
For players who want an overpowered experience, the spear can be customized to have Mending and Lunging at the same time! 
- **Seamless Integration:** 
Works smoothly with vanilla Minecraft gameplay without breaking progression.

![Spear in the sunlight](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b0577b624f124276b25e2c68f0277919d2e558b2.png)

## Why Use This Pack?

Whether you’re farming, exploring, or battling mobs, this spear gives you flexibility, power, and fun mechanics while keeping the game balanced. Perfect for players who want **more control and excitement** in their adventures.

title: Zapped
description: A Data-pack that turns lightning rods from a useless block to a way to transport zaps to machines and productivity armor.
body:
**zapped has been achived because I am not happy with its current quality.
zapped will get a full rework when the time is right**

![title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/68b4ccb1ffab2edbde6c3a1161d2f417178ee541.png)

Zapped is a Data-pack that turns lightning rods from a useless block to a way to transport zaps so you can power machines and productivity armour.




<details>
<summary> 1.2 update released </summary>


-music disc (creator disc combined with a zap)

-config (/function zapped:config/config)

-armour texture (enable in config)


</details>




**Requires a Resource-pack to see tools (copper tools appear gold) or to see the armour texture**

**( armour texture disabled by default in config)**

<details>
<summary> Copper Lines </summary>
  
![L](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ad122d4609814e721ded0bf294755035988e907e.png)
![U](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2fe24ea91416f6ce9f7ee447cb00c271cf2d7a3a.png)
![+](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e996812c44ebecacafa5a1a15f20f6ddca5c1fba.png)
batteries store up to 32. though rusted batteries turn 32 into 16
![battery](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b95f7623cd6f790558266bcbd7e5328cc1eb8fbd.png)
![Gateway](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/773c5bc714afd96f51c74130529bedbe7a3c8040.png)

Don't use copper blocks like that. Also, there is a chance it stays within the blocks and expires.
![cursed](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/94ce495037a49c1c947096759ef44ca2cbf424cb.png)
</details>




The most common thing to power is the productivity armour/tools or copper armour/tools.
The armour and tools are weak and easily destroyed. The armour gives less protection than iron and tools are slightly better than stone.


<details>
<summary>armor recipe</summary>
  
Because of copper's malleability, it requires a structure.
The copper armour must be conductive, making golden armour a perfect cadet because it is also conductive.

![armour recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6db39a4b67e312a9c5f1324cc4be82e9116d8a6b.png)

</details>


![copper armour with resoursepack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/79b3688cb49f2d5df71e4cf5e37a85934eabde6b.png)

<details>
<summary> without resoursepack </summary>


![copper armour](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4255c303e45c03929d49e3a33d466a25f9996513.png)


</details>


But don't let the tools fool you these are powerful assets.
With the power of zaps, you can charge the armour to be better than they once were.

Armour at max charge now gives as much protection as a diamond. They also give you a faster and extended grip (R.I.P-Crab). The boots also decrease fall damage.


![charged armour with resourcepack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0c6c0cdd220536804052df257284cc7e993cbcc8.png)

<details>
<summary> without resoursepack </summary>


![charged armour](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0fd719b5226c8fa15850285fb71aee90b6e885f5.png)


</details>


The charged tools rivel netherite making them faster and sharper.
The sword is slower to swing but has a better sweeping edge and damage.

The axe is fast

The pickaxe is fast

The shovel.. is also fast.

And the hoe doesn't exist :(  ...
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>
  YET
</details>

![charged tools and armour](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/001fd36956432db39aef8a4512157b34aa625e55.png)


You can also charge copper bulbs to have a better range.

![powed bulb](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/SWbMXgCm/images/9ee4f47553a8d982a0ef0efc97217076feefa707_350.webp)
![unpowered](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/SWbMXgCm/images/2b63894fdae68f5eea6e8bbe13bac665c8133c13_350.webp)

Tired of charging your armour?
With the use of the heavy core, you can change your armour wirelessly!
However due to the zaps exposure to the air it requires 40 zaps for one charge.

![core](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/65ca1ce404a83467b83c0b3b64929a2dcfb3e846.png)


<details>
<summary>Heavy core distance</summary>

![core distance](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/af615cc3d2fae6fa15771a9b974f5d0ec351bcda.png)

</details>




Now for the good part, how do you generate zaps?
There are a few ways to do it with the easiest being furnaces.
The furnaces must be constantly lit.

![furnace](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7c6c5ac63b1bb2c3dfd483dfb5b65039453588d0.png)

Then there are daylight sensors that generate power over time slowly but surely. 
If combined with copper blocks to minimise space.

![daylight sensors](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1a0dcbf7dc51371ee1e2336afa6a6c8e44acfdd4.png)

Or you can go the old-fashioned way and use lightning rods for their intended purpose.
Produces high power when struck necessary for all buildings.

![LIGHTNING](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f68b8ca85ac7c9bb205bd17824cd4538a9689d7a_0.webp)

With more infrastructure, you can turn a mob farm into an energy source.
Which is made possible with the catalyst


<details>
<summary>Recipe</summary>

![bone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9aa66997ba0da7bef256783647ca36aa7e724e5e.png)
![catalist](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/02a88541dd85fa3c8783071aade55196f2febfab.png)

</details>




![mob farm](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2c52269f0ce6fdbc15c96c56ec0ae932d4c17d35_0.webp)

Going into the late game there is the gateway.
To make a gateway you need to align 2 lodestones together at the same cords in both the end and overworld. It also doubles up as a chunk loader.

![exp gateway](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/519f9e13ba606f3af9e01b7345f673c951fe553d_0.webp)

If you want to avoid touching grass for a few days, you can make a netherite block and magnetize it.

title: Gorp's World
description: Wake up kiddo, it's time for Gorp! You're in his world now...
body:
_**This mod will be on hiatus while I work on Update 10 (it's real big)**_
# **Welcome to Gorp's World!**

![Gorp](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1dd0647d720852e45674e7e08a07467348574ef0.png)

In this mod you will find **Gorp**, a green, lovable, bean-shaped creature.
Despite his handsome looks, Gorp is not food.
Instead, he is a multi-purpose consumable made of biological matter.
This means Gorp is alive!

![Gorp Sprout](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ed8605023f8f9c8af121ecf820b35cd83d04be2f_0.webp)

**Gorp Sprouts** generate in the overworld and are your ticket into the world of Gorp.
When a Gorp Sprout is destroyed, it will drop Gorp Seeds.

![Gorp Seed](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5114ca848c6edb60574afee1ba704ebb7c1f431f_0.webp)

**Gorp Seeds** can be planted on farmland to grow into Gorp Plants. 

![Gorp Plant](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/329ad2a3196ddf0977c44239b5d220c1e1d5cf2a.png)

**Gorp Plants** when harvested will drop an assortment of Gorps and Gorp Seeds.
He's chilling in a hammock btw.

![Bitten Gorp](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c7d14dafeb446c1c87586884c8e62ab0d0b0bd6d.png)

You need permission from a Gorp to create a **Bitten Gorp**.
They are commonly used in Gorp crafting.
Bitten Gorps can also be eaten and give more hunger points than a regular Gorp.

![Gorp Altar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/36bf8c2fd3b31a5ef6dc1305b738be31024ab46c.png)

The **Gorp Altar** allows you to communicate with Gorp if you place one on the mantle.
It's very ancient technology.

![Gorp Hammer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/953c17072d1be5922b91b9935ef025e22873398b.png)

Gorp Hammer
When you hit a mob with the **Gorp Hammer**, you and your target will be afflicted with Jorping which makes you jorp.

![Jorping](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e03b25518924200004adc1c8a2b1b60bae562a39_0.webp)

It makes you jorp.
**Jorping** can be useful for getting to tall, hard to reach areas.
It can be also used to negate fall damage in certain cases.

![Jorp Juice](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/59ba44f58191552ade74ffba25b6b8a0f8835d37_0.webp)

Smelting a Bitten Gorp produces **Jorp Juice**. Upon consumption the player will jorp.
Designed as a replacement for water bucket MLGing with a similar learning curve.

![Gorp Spear](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e7b88b30fd2f590826c2ab7b0d988c00434e619c.png)

Hold right-click to charge your **Gorp Spear** and it will launch you in the direction you are looking.
Can be used while flying with elytra to increase your velocity.
Please be mindful of fall damage. Use Jorp Juice if you must.

![Plurge](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7ebc252158364aa808dfeb47becb0c69765751f6.png)

A new enchantment, **Plurge**, is added.
It can be applied to swords and the Gorp Hammer.

When an entity is killed with Plurge the player is given an Iron-H Damage effect.

Plurge is the power of the Aggrussel race, the natural born enemy of Gorp.
They are angry and aggressive beasts who wish to harm any Gorp they come across.

![Gorp Staff](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3d3317018c6607d7c15a336d93c1dc9c17bf2940.png)

**Gorp Staff**
Gives you the power to push mobs away from you with a single right-click!
Phantoms are intrinsically afraid of Gorp's teeth.


---


While this is all Gorp's World has to offer for now, new features will be added in the future!
Remember to love and cherish Gorp!

![March of the Gorp painting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1be2766daa260e3a91116c12c2684cbb8278918e.png)

Gorp Mod Dev <3

title: CraftPit: Origins
description: A new modpack project inspired by the OG CraftPit server.
body:
A fun tech/exploration based modpack with a focus on optimisation, terrain generation and technology based mods. The goal of this pack is to enhance the gameplay without breaking the spririt of core Minecraft gameplay.

_This pack is meant for use on the private CraftPit: Origins server, but can freely be played solo or on your own private server._

Leveraging mods like [Terralith](https://modrinth.com/mod/terralith), and [YUNG's](https://modrinth.com/user/YUNGNICKYOUNG/mods) suite of Better structures the world generation has been a big focus of the pack, creating vast mountain ranges, and long stretches of rivers that carve their way through mountains and out into the ocean. Animals are enhanced with the help of [Naturalist](https://modrinth.com/mod/naturalist) and unfriendly mobs get a boost with the help of [Creeper](https://modrinth.com/mod/creeper-overhaul) and [Enderman Overhaul](https://modrinth.com/mod/enderman-overhaul), along with the aid of [Spawn Animations](https://modrinth.com/datapack/spawn-animations) and [Nyf's Spiders](https://modrinth.com/mod/nyfs-spiders) to really bring them to life.

The pack's primary tech mod is [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-fabric) allowing for the creation of huge automated factories, railways, or Airships with the aid of [Valkyrian Skies](https://modrinth.com/mod/valkyrien-skies).
However if you want to take your technological advancements a step further, [Ad Astra](https://modrinth.com/mod/ad-astra) allows you to take your adventures beyond the stars!

title: Mob Equipment

body:
# Mob Equipment This is a datapack which make mobs gained better equipment. Each player have their own difficulty value, the difficulty increases as the number mobs killed by player. The default difficulty limit is 5000. The increase in difficulty will make mobs stronger. ## Features: ### Equipment(Armor & Mainhand Weapon) Affected mobs: Zombie, Zombie Villager, Husk,Drowned, Skeleton, Stray, Wither Skeleton. These mobs gained better armor and weapon. The increase in difficulty will increase the probability of iron and diamond equipment Wither Skeletons may gained netherite equipment. Wither Skeletons may use bow to shoot wither arrow to player. ### Offhand Weapon Affected mobs: Zombie, Zombie Villager, Husk,Drowned, Skeleton, Stray, Wither Skeleton, Pillager. These mobs may carry special offhand weapons: (Splash Potion, Ender Pearl, Lava Bucket, Shield, Silverfish Egg, Cobweb, TNT).
These weapons are all disposable: Splash Potion: Throw various negative potions to player.

Silverfish Egg: Throw silverfish spawn egg to player and summon silverfish.

Ender Pearl: Throw ender pearl to player and teleport.

Lava Bucket: Place a short-lived lava on player.

Cobweb: Place a short-lived cobweb on player.

TNT: Place a TNT block below them. The TNT block will explode in 4 seconds if player did not break it.
These weapons can be used continuously: Shield: Give mobs slowness and resistance effects when they are attacked, and make them to rebound arrows ahead.

Tipped Arrow(only skeletons): Make skeletons shoot tipped arrow.
### Health Boost Affected mobs: Zombie, Zombie Villager, Husk,Drowned, Skeleton, Stray, Wither Skeleton, Spider, Enderman. As the difficulty increases, these mobs HP boosts. Default maximum health boost by 10 (5❤). Skeletons and Strays initially only have 16 HP (8❤). Wither Skeletons initially have 16 HP (8❤). ### Other Features In high difficulty, Creepers become faster and probably charged. Spiders' damage and health increased. ## Commands: You can access a chat based configuration menu by running the command /function mobequipment:config You can use it to turn off some features or modify difficulty. ## Lower version of Minecraft: https://modrinth.com/datapack/specmobs

title: Sign Logger
description: A mod to track instances of sign text editions in the Minecraft server.
body:
# Sign Logger
This server side mod allows for the tracking of sign editions in the world. It can log these events to the server's console, as well as store them to a database. The mod features an inspection mode to quickly see the sign=edit logs associated with a specific coordinate.

## Features

### Inspection mode

If you have OP permissions in the server, you are able to toggle inspection mode via `/sign-logger inspect true` and `/sign-logger inspect false`, respectively. Once in inspection mode, you will not be able to break or place any blocks. Left click any currently placed block to see the sign-edit logs of the coordinates of the clicked block. You can also right click a block to to see the sign-edit logs of the coordinate adjacent to the face of the block you right clicked.

Inspection mode will be automatically disabled upon dying or leaving the server.

### Sign-edit logging

There are currently four types of sign edit events that get stored, all of which include information about the author, the position, the world, and the time at which this event happened. These are:
- **Changed Text event**: Corresponds to when a player changes the text of a sign to another. Includes information about the old and new text of the sign, as well as the side of the sign where the text edition happened. Hover your cursor over the sign side section of the log to see the before and after the of the edited text.
- **Waxed Sign event**: Corresponds to when a player waxes a sign, preventing it from being edited further.
- **Dyed Sign event**: Corresponds to when a player changes the color of the text of a sign by applying a dye. Includes information about the old and new color of the text, and the side of the sign where the color change happened. Hover your cursor over the sign side section of the log to see the before and after of the color of the text.
- **Glowed Sign event**: Corresponds to when a player applies or removes the glow effect from the text of a sign, by using a glow ink sac or an ink sac, respectively. Includes information about the side of the sign where this action was performed.

You can also toggle the logging of sign-edits in the console via `/sign-logger settings do_console_logs true|false`.

### Database

The sign-edit logs get stored in a simple database. You can configure the time in days that will be used to purge logs older than the time specified via `/sign-logger database purge`. You can specify the amount of days with `/sign-logger database purge_older_than_x_days <whole number value>`.
The database will also be automatically purged upon server shutdown, using the `purge_logs_older_than_x_amount` value specified in the configuration file.

## Configuration  File

When the server is started, the mod will look for an existing `sign-logger.toml` file for the config folder of your game. If it exists, it will read the values from there. If not, it will create a new config file in `/config/sign-logger.toml`. You can then edit this file to configure the mod, and restart the server to apply the changes, or use the `/sign-logger reload_config` in-game command. 

The following is the default configuration file generated upon first mod initialization or whenever the mod fails to find the config file during server or world shutdown.

```toml
#Settings related to the behavior of the database.
[database]
	#(Default = 30) Configure the time in days that will be used to purge log entries older than the time specified.
	#Cannot be set to a value lower than 1 or a decimal value.
	purge_logs_older_than_x_amount = 1
#Toggleable settings to customize the behavior of the mod.
[settings]
	#(Default = true) Toggle the logging of sign edit instances in the console.
	do_console_logging = true
```

## Support

If you would like to report a bug, or make a suggestion, you can do so via the mod's [issue tracker](https://github.com/ArkoSammy12/sign-logger/issues) or join my [Discord server](https://discord.gg/UKr8n3b3ze).

- Download VPacketLogger from [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/plugin/vpacketlogger)
- Drag and drop on your plugins folder
- Start the server

title: Fabroxy
description: The Fabric mod for forwarding to Minecraft server proxy like Velocity, BungeeCord and Waterfall
body:
# Fabroxy The Fabric mod for forwarding to Minecraft server proxy like Velocity ## Requirements * [Minecraft](https://www.minecraft.net) * [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net) * [Fabric API](/mod/fabric-api) A version that fits each requirement is written together in the Changelog. ## Supports * [Velocity](https://papermc.io/software/velocity) * ~~BungeeCord~~ *(not supported yet)* * ~~Waterfall~~ *(not supported yet)* ## Setting up ### Setting up with Velocity The common usage is almost the same as setting up a proxy on [Paper](https://docs.papermc.io/paper/reference/global-configuration#velocity). #### Velocity Server 1. Open `velocity.toml`. 1. Change the value of `player-info-forwarding-mode` to `"modern"` and save it. 1. Open `forwarding.secret` and remember its value. #### Fabric Server 1. Start your server to create a new Fabroxy config. 1. Open `server.properties` in your server directory. 1. Change the value of `online-mode` to `false` and save it. 1. Open `config/fabroxy.json`. 1. Change the value `enabled` to `true` and `secret` to the value `forwarding.secret` you just rememered. 1. Save it and enter `proxy reload` in your Fabric server console. ## Configuration | Name | Type | Default
Value | Description | |---|---|---|---| | enabled | boolean | `false` | Enable Fabroxy's Velocity proxy features. | | secret | string | `""` | A HMacSHA256 encryption key to communicate with the Velocity proxy. It should be match the contents of the file `forwarding.secret` on the Velocity proxy server. | | direct_connection | boolean | `false` | Allow clients to connect to the Fabric server without connecting the Velocity server. | ## Notes The mod file name indicates the mod name, loader and version: \ Fabroxy-`mod loader`-`MC version`-`mod version`.jar For example: \ Fabroxy-fabric-1.19.3-1.0.0.jar

title: Smithee
description: Combine all the parts
body:
Smithee

HEADS UP

This mod is still in development, which could potentially lead to unwanted results.

Smithee is a mod all about different tool-part combinations. Its goal is not to be a clone of Tinker's Construct, but rather a "spiritual successor" with high customizability.

You can add new custom tool materials and change their stats all via configs.

The 3 different tool stations:

- Disassembly Table - Breaks apart the tools back to their original components

- Assembly Table - Combines tool parts into tools. Also used for embossing

- Chiseling Table - Chisel materials into tool parts (requires a chisel)

The items in the inventory are embossments used for giving additional stats to tools. You can only add 1 embossment per tool level, which is acquired by shift-right-clicking with the tool, which exchanges your XP for tool XP.

Currently supports materials from the following mods:

- Astromine Foundations

- Mythic Metals

- BiomesYouGo

- Diamold

- Better Nether

- Better End

Join the Development Discord if you want to help out or follow progress.

Any help is appreciated (be it code, stat-balancing, ideas/suggestions, etc.)

title: Fabric Utility
description: Fabric Utility is a mod with chunk and subchunk tagging, protected area support, player nicknames, configurable entity petting, and a Ban Hammer item NBT feature.
body:
--- Fabric Utility is a Minecraft 1.20.1 Fabric server utility mod focused on administration, communication, protection, and quality-of-life features. It combines chunk-based protection, advanced nicknames, proximity chat, item customization, configurable entity interactions, and server management tools into a single package. ## Highlights - Chunk & Subchunk Tagging - Protected Areas - Advanced Nicknames - MiniMessage Chat Formatting - Proximity Chat - Chat Areas - Item Inscriber - Configurable Entity Petting - Ban Hammer Moderation - In-Game Configuration Management - Mod Menu Integration - Public API
Chunk & Subchunk Tagging Store persistent tags directly on chunks or individual 16-block-tall subchunks using `/tagchunk`. The built-in `invulnerability` tag can protect areas from: - Block interaction by unauthorized players - Explosions and TNT - Falling block damage Tags support custom values and player bypass lists, allowing protected regions while still granting access to trusted players. Custom tags can also be utilized by other mods through the Fabric Utility API.
Nicknames & MiniMessage Fabric Utility includes a complete nickname system with history tracking, administrative controls, and full MiniMessage support. Features include: - Colors and gradients - Hover text - Click events - Formatting decorations - Nickname history - Administrative nickname management Nicknames automatically appear in: - Chat - Join and leave messages - Nameplates - Tab list names - Jade tooltips - Proxy chat channels
Proximity Chat & Chat Areas Built-in proxy chat provides multiple communication channels without requiring additional mods. Available chat modes: - Local Chat - World Chat - Area Chat Additional features include: - Chat pinning - Do Not Disturb mode - Configurable chat ranges - Named chat areas Chat areas integrate directly with the chunk tagging system for simple management and persistence.
Inscriber Item Editor The Inscriber allows players and administrators to customize item names and descriptions directly in-game. Using MiniMessage formatting, items can receive: - Custom names - Multi-line descriptions - Colors and gradients - Advanced formatting Perfect for roleplay servers, custom rewards, shop items, events, and administrative tools.
Entity Petting Shift-right-click living entities with an empty hand to pet them. The petting system includes: - Custom sounds - Heart particles - Entity blacklists - Tag-based sound overrides - Gamerule support - Mod Menu integration Everything can be customized through configuration files, commands, or Mod Menu.
Administration Tools Fabric Utility provides several tools designed for server moderation and administration. Features include: - Ban Hammer NBT support - Protected area management - Nickname moderation - Administrative command logging - In-game configuration editing Most settings can be managed without restarting the server.
Configuration & Mod Menu Integration Server settings can be viewed, edited, synchronized, and reloaded directly in-game. When Mod Menu is installed: - Client settings can be edited visually - Server operators can modify server settings through a GUI - Changes are validated before being applied - Settings automatically synchronize to connected clients Legacy configuration files are migrated automatically.
Developer API Fabric Utility includes a public API that allows other mods to integrate with its systems. Available integrations include: - Chunk tag access - Chunk tag modification - Custom tag behavior registration - Nickname lookups - Nickname updates - Nickname change events This makes it easy for developers to build upon existing Fabric Utility functionality.
--- For the most complete and up-to-date information, configuration details, commands, and ongoing updates, refer to the [Github](https://github.com/SuperHeroPuppy/fabric_utility) repository. ---

title: Adventure Mod

body:
# **ADVENTURE MOD**
**FOR VERSION 1.20.1**

‟”_Patience, and awareness, greats didn't notice cielings raise_””

**ADVENTURE MOD** begins you at **three hearts**, offering you to pick a class that affects your playthrough´s playstyle, earning more hearts is in relation to either your XP level and your armor pieces, greatly increasing the importance of farming, fishing, mining & killing mobs.

This is suppose to be difficult and challenging to the regular vanilla player, slow you down, slightly unforgiving so play how you want to… the game´s core mechanics still matter though at the centre and are paramount to progression: building a homestead with a chimney, a barn for breeding animals, spelunking caves to mine minerals in aid to exploring and fighting through dungeons or interdimensional portals to take on the unique bosses… at the very least you will have to explore and gather the eyes, enter Hell, enter Heaven, and then the End presents itself…

Reward is in journey, and somehow, after years of not playing this game, this variation and difficulty had brought me back.

### **INFORMATION**

**VERSIONS**

**Please** pay attention to which version you download considering your pc specs, it is recommended to allocate **5-8GB** of memory... preloading using [Chunky](https://modrinth.com/plugin/chunky) helps performance, here is an example command: _/chunky start minecraft:overworld circle 0 0 400 400_

- **LITE** is around 120 mods, achieves a consistent tick rate below 10
- **MAIN** is around 140 mods, achieves a tick rate around 14 to 28
- **PLUS** is everything baby, tick rate is f**ked, beast pcs only

**CONTROLS**
```
[TAB] Hotswap
[L ALT] Dodge — armor weight affects this, there is a potion for that issue…
[X] Crawl
[Z] Zoom — craft a spyglass to enable zooming
[B] Backpack
[M] Map — craft a map atlas, enables a mini-map with coordinates 
[I] Death History
[F4] JEI
```

_**WHAT DO I EVEN DO?**_
```
PROPOSED PROGRESSION
- [1] chop trees, watch the leaves gracefully fall, build a homestead, mine, survive the first few nights
- [2] explore the dozens of unique above ground structures, aid villages, rebuild and grow them into cities
- [3] craft new weaponry: a long sword, twin blade, rapier, katana, sai, spear, glaive, warglaive, chakram, cutlass, claymore, great hammer, great axe, halberd, scythe… there are new enchantments. shields & bows and tons of new arrow types, armors, gloves, etc… coming across unique variants and clothing requires exploration & mob drops…
- [4] craft waystones to set up a teleportation network at the cost of xp…
- [5] mine away, craft a hammer or new rails and build a mineshaft, a railroad, tunnel systems, underground villages or cities or outposts… 
- [6] craft chimneys, furniture like sofas, lamps, curtains, tables, chairs, door variants or tall doors, windows
- [7] cook unique recipes over a stove, cooking pot, pan, or cutting board
- [8] build farms (sugarcane, wheat, potato, carrot, pumpkin, melon, beetroot, flax, rice, cabbage, onions, tomatoes, cotton, peppers)
- [9] build animal farms (cow, pig, sheep, horse, chicken, rabbit, bee)
- [10] horses can drag carts and mobs around…
- [11] build a zoo, aquarium or mob showcase (pandas!)
- [12] build mob farms (iron golem, piglin, slime, skeleton, creepers)
- [13] grow trees, collect multiple types of flowers and ferns, build a botanical garden, hedges
- [14] traverse biomes and gather material for building palettes and architecture purposes
- [15] use a brush, sift bones in the desert, badlands or jungles to uncover extinct species, ruins and digsites
- [16] explore six unique cave systems and all the dungeons at every depth
- [17] play with magic scrolls using an inscription table, scroll forge, arcane anvil, alchemist cauldron
- [18] collect magical and powerful artifacts & weaponry, the heads of all the mobs, discs, paintings, and by using pedestals, build a museum
- [19] enter Hell, fight it´s dungeons and build unique civilizations connected to the Overworld or… build on the ominous roof…
- [20] venture upward into the heavenly Aether to travel across floating islands and face against ancient beings
- [21] venture downward into the magical and swampy Twilight Forest… attempt to lift the curse (player has to manually download Twilight Forest </3)
- [22] having explored and collected ten to twelve unique ender eyes, face and defeat the Ender Dragon, roam the once guarded stark regions surrounded in a voided abyss
- [23] defeat all bosses in every dimension: the overworld, hell, heaven, the twilight zone & the end
- [24] nothing to play with?… there´s cameras, ziplines and hooks, quarries, holograms, rayguns, shotguns, demons, dinosaurs, springling forklift, wicked mask morphing, nukes, submarines, cultists, gingerbread warfare.. geomancers and powerful sorcerers, knights, yetis, golems... that´s not even all of it!!!
```

title: ElytraFlow
description: ElytraFlow is a client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.1.2 that automatically swaps your elytra back to your best chestplate when you land.
body:
# ElytraFlow 🪂

**Stop interrupting your flight to swap armor.**

ElytraFlow automatically re-equips your best chestplate the moment you land, so you can focus on exploring, not your inventory.

## You know this situation

You're flying across the map with your elytra. You land, you're exposed, and you start digging through your hotbar to put your chestplate back on.

Whether you're:
- 🏔️ Gliding between mountain peaks and landing mid-combat
- 🌍 Exploring for hours and touching down frequently for resources
- 🏹 Playing on a PvP server where every second counts
- 🌙 Landing at night and immediately getting attacked

...ElytraFlow handles the swap for you, instantly and automatically.

## How it works

The moment your feet touch the ground while wearing an elytra, ElytraFlow scans your inventory and equips the best chestplate it finds. No clicks, no fumbling, no delay.

- Searches your entire inventory (hotbar, main, offhand)
- Always picks the highest-tier armor available
- Skips items with **Curse of Binding** so you never get stuck
- Does nothing if you don't have a chestplate to swap to

## Toggle keybind

You can turn the mod on or off at any time with a keybind under **Options > Controls > ElytraFlow** (unbound by default). A quick on-screen message confirms the state.

## Installation

Drop the `.jar` into your `mods` folder. That's it.

Works with **Fabric** and **NeoForge**, client-side only, compatible with any server.

## Notes

- 🔒 No data collected, no network requests
- ⚙️ No config needed, it just works
- 🌐 Works on any server

title: T.error
description: T.error adds a terrifying entity that stalks you, sends creepy messages, and corrupts your world, turning Minecraft into a true horror experience.
body:
**T.error – Horror Like You’ve Never Experienced in Minecraft**

**Version:** 1.21.4 | **Mod Version:** 1.6.2 | **Status:** Private | **Loader:** NeoForge | **Development Stage:** Indev

Team: Hero of Time 64 (Texture Artist/Dev), Samuelchr (Dev), Yoru (Tester), 𐌌𐌙𐌔𐌕𐌉𐌂 (3d modeler/animator)

Dive into your first truly unsettling Minecraft experience with **T.error**, a mod that will haunt your world in ways you’ve never imagined. This is my first ever Minecraft mod, created for a YouTube video, with plans for more terrifying horror mods in the future.

**What T.error Does:**

* Introduces a sinister entity that stalks you relentlessly.
* Sends eerie, creepy messages that make every moment in-game tense.
* Interacts with players in unpredictable ways, keeping you constantly on edge.
* Corrupts your game and world, causing bugs, glitches, and unexpected breakages that blur the line between game and nightmare.

**Inspirations:**
Broken Script, From the Fog, The Backrooms, In Your World, mod_file

Prepare for a chilling experience that turns Minecraft into a psychological horror playground. **T.error** isn’t just a mod—it’s a test of your courage. 

### **📌 Versioning System Explained**

This mod uses a **three-number version format (X.Y.Z)** designed to clearly show what type of experience you’re running and how updated it is.

* **X — Build Edition**
  This number represents which *build* of the mod you’re using.
  Examples include:
  **• Immersive Build** – A highly atmospheric, story-driven version
  **• Comedy Build** – A lighthearted, humorous take on the mod
  **• Hard Difficulty Build** – A challenging, intense gameplay experience

  *(Note: In the current release, **Build 1 represents the Standard Build**, which is the default experience.)*

* **Y — Feature Update**
  Increases when new content, mechanics, or major improvements are added to the mod.

* **Z — Bug Fix Update**
  Used for small patches, fixes, optimizations, and stability improvements.

**Example:**
**1.4.0**

* **1** = Standard Build (default build)
* **4** = Fourth major feature update
* **0** = No bug-fix patches yet

This system keeps everything clean, easy to understand, and lets players instantly know which build, feature set, and patch level they’re using.

title: Monchlets!
description: A mod adding a few small fantasy creatures
body:
Monchlets is a mod that adds a variety of hybrids and speculative evolution style animals, starring the infamous monchi's!

Monchis are Hadrosaur-salamander hybrids found naturally in savannhas and badlands. Their patterns and colors are highly dependant on what they eat...

Alongside the Monchi are multiple friends, like the Pufferwyrm and Tusked Skink. Tusked skinks are territorial, nocturnal predators that hunt monchis and players! Tame a baby skinling with Monchi eggs to get a true beast of a companion.

and of course there is the Pufferwyrm, a small, flying snake that can be found anywhere and comes in a variety of biome-dependant skinks. 

Quick FAQ

Q: "What happened to my pets when I updated?"

A: The 1.1.0 and 2.0.0 versions of the mod are technically completely different mods, as I had to remake it from scratch, so your world may corrupt or your pets may disappear.

Q: "How do I obtain Puffdragon larvae???"

A: Breed puffdragons using sugarberries!

Q: "I thought this mod was cancelled?

A: I came back to it after I was motivated by seeing some fan designs of the monchi
Hope you enjoy this mod!

title: Dynamic Trims Mod
description: Armor trims emit dynamic light based on their material, with fully configurable brightness via Mod Menu.
body:
# Dynamic Trims

Armor trims emit dynamic light based on their material, with fully configurable brightness via Mod Menu.

## 📖 What's this mod?

Ever wanted your glowing amethyst trim to actually **glow**? Now it does.

Dynamic Trims adds per-material dynamic lighting to armor trims, powered by LambDynamicLights. Each trim material emits its own level of light amethyst shines bright, netherite gives off a subtle glow, and everything in between is fully adjustable to your taste.

## ✅ Features

* Armor trims emit dynamic light based on their material.
* Works on players and armor stands.
* Fully configurable brightness per material (0-15) via in-game config screen.
* Lightweight, no unnecessary overhead.

## 🎨 Trim Light Levels (recommended)

| Material  | Default brightness |
|-----------|--------------------|
| Amethyst  | 12                 |
| Diamond   | 11                 |
| Quartz    | 11                 |
| Redstone  | 10                 |
| Emerald   | 8                  |
| Iron      | 9                  |
| Gold      | 7                  |
| Lapis     | 7                  |
| Copper    | 6                  |
| Netherite | 6                  |

> **Tip:** Want maximum brightness? You can push any material up to 15 in the config screen.

## ❓ Usage

Install in your mods folder along with [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api), [LambDynamicLights](https://modrinth.com/mod/lambdynamiclights), [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) and [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu).

Open the config screen via Mod Menu to adjust brightness per material.

## 🔥 Requirements

* [LambDynamicLights](https://modrinth.com/mod/lambdynamiclights)
* [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)
* [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
* [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) *(optional, for config screen)*

title: Improved Rotten Flesh
description: This mod adds in some basic additional uses for Rotten Flesh in Minecraft.
body:
Welcome to the Improved Rotten Flesh mod, this mod aims to give some extra uses to rotten flesh as currently in Minecraft it doesn't have many purposes, this mod will change that and make rotten flesh a useful resource inside of your world. Some changes are the Rotten Golem, which drops the Rotten Sword when slain, or the ability to turn rotten flesh into leather using a furnace.

Full list of features:

Rotten flesh to leather; When using this mod you can convert rotten flesh to leather by putting rotten flesh into a furnace.

Rotten flesh to cured meat; Rotten flesh can now become cured meat by putting the rotten flesh inside of a smoker.

Cured Meat; Cured meat is made from rotten flesh, and when eaten it gives you some hunger bars back, as well as speed, however cured meat also gives you poison.

Potion of Undying; The potion of undying will give you regeneration and strength at the cost of slowness and bad luck, the potion of undying is made from putting rotten flesh, and a bone into a brewing stand and leaving it to brew.

Rotten Flesh Blocks; The rotten flesh blocks are made out of nine rotten flesh that are put inside of a crafting table, and are used to summon the Rotten Golem.

Rotten Golem' The Rotten Golem is spawned when a rotten flesh block is placed on top of another rotten flesh block, and a pumpkin is placed on top of the rotten flesh block, when the Rotten Golem is spawned it will summon five zombies to aid it in battle, and when the Rotten Golem is hurt it will give itself the regeneration and strength effects making the battle against it even harder. Upon the Rotten Golem's defeat the Rotten Golem will drop the Rotten Sword.

Rotten Sword; The Rotten Sword when held in your hand will give you regeneration, strength, unluck, and slowness, as well as does 4 damage, and has a durability of 18, and when a mob is attacked they are inflicted with poison, slowness, weakness, and wither, however when the Rotten Sword is combined with a Nether Star it becomes the Enchanted Rotten Sword, which when held in your hand gives you regeneration four, speed four, strength four, and luck four, as well as doing 15 attack damage, having 256 durability, and inflicting enemy mobs with wither five, poison five, slowness five, and weakness five when hit with the blade.
