* 🎮 **In-game Quality Profiles:** Easily toggle between **Potato, Medium, High, and Cinematic** presets in the shader options.

---

## 🛠️ Installation
1. Make sure you have **Iris Shader Mod** (recommended) or **OptiFine** installed.
2. Download the **WVP Shader** zip file.
3. Drop the zip file into your `.minecraft/shaderpacks` folder.
4. Enable it in-game via **Video Settings -> Shader Packs**.

title: SCP-294, The Coffee Machine
description: A mysterious coffee machine that can dispense any liquid imaginable for a small price.
body:
The Coffee Machine adds a new item. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-294, also known as the Coffee Machine.


SCP-294 looks like a regular coffee machine but can produce almost any drink when interacted with. Players can right-click it to open a menu, choose a drink, and receive a filled cup. Each use costs 1 XP level, without XP, no drink will be made. Every drink has a unique effect! Some heal or buff the player, while others cause nausea, fire, or even explosions. Whether you want a refreshing coffee or something far more dangerous, SCP-294 can make it, if you dare to try.

title: Divergence
description: An alternate-path Minecraft overhaul inspired by the lonely, raw feeling of older versions.
body:
Divergence is a reimagining of Minecraft built around the idea of what the game might have become if it had held onto that lonely, isolated, raw feeling of its older versions and well, evolved along a different path. It reworks terrain generation, structures, survival systems, progression, and exploration into a more deliberate, mysterious, and atmospheric experience.

I wanted to recreate the feeling of Minecraft when its world felt strange and otherworldly, yet still full of possibility, a world shaped entirely by your imagination.

This project was initially made for my own enjoyment, but I decided to share it so other people who like older versions of Minecraft could experience it too.

<iframe width="500" height="355" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/xe8Gxwz1mbs" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

### Features:

_(Note: Divergence is meant to be a standalone experience, it's not a general purpose mod. Also it's mainly survival oriented and these features are ment to alter/add to/restrict the gameplay to fit my vision)_

_(Also this mod stays pretty close to vanilla, and I tried to add features that feel like they could've been added to the game if it had gone in this direction.)_ 

_(**This mod is still in development**. In the future, I plan to add more Custom features, overhauls, tweaks, Structures, mobs, etc. while still keeping the original premise of the mod)_

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/75769218aa1cf9327ab548a6e0229ad0352bbdfe.png)

The terrain generation is heavily inspired by _Beta 1.7.3_, but it is not a direct copy ,it takes that old base and reshapes it with its own twists. Grass and foliage colors behave just like they did in the old world generation, using humidity and temperature values to create a similar palette, though it is less bright and saturated to fit Divergence's atmosphere. So, only the biomes from Beta 1.7.3 can be found in this mod.

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4e649101679683fcdc4df455442dd8aa0d1ea6d9.png)

At the moment, the mod includes four custom structures, with more planned for future updates. The Stronghold is the only structure left unchanged from vanilla. All other structures were created specifically for the mod.

### Abandoned Villages:

Inspired by Notch’s old prototype villages, there are abandoned villages with no NPCs at all. Since vanilla villagers do not exist in the mod, these settlements feel empty, and long forgotten.

### Abandoned Mineshafts:

Similar to vanilla mineshafts, but redesigned.

### Dungeons:

Also loosely inspired by Notch’s old prototype dungeons, each dungeon is generated differently, with different kinds of rooms to explore. But if you decide to descend into one, you had better bring a sword and some armor. (there are a lot of mobs).

### Underground Ancient Cities:

Huge abandoned cities can be found deep underground. Who built them, and where are they now? No one knows. But beware of the statues that guard these ancient remains.

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bdf2340d79cee06aa9351293436e28f84be34d81.png)

The sleeping experience is completely overhauled. Beds no longer require wool to craft, but Phantom Membranes instead. Phantoms will not appear until around the fifth night, after which they begin to return more frequently, though not forever. Beds themselves are no longer permanent either: each one can only be used a limited number of times before it wears down and breaks. In Divergence, sleep is a luxury rather than a common convenience, forcing you to decide whether it is worth spending one of your valuable nights of rest, or just survive the night. Nights are also far darker, and darkness settings can no longer be changed.

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dc0a686978938af20fe9ec544f31de73d60f6bd3_0.webp)

A new block that lets you set your respawn point. It is expensive to craft, requiring Obsidian, Diamonds, and Ender Pearls. It will only bring you back once after death, after that, it breaks. So be careful.

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/275747e6b90405c4295d023190fbf64abf973e2c_0.webp)

### Darkness:

As mentioned earlier, nights are far darker than before, and the minimum brightness has been lowered even further. This helps bring back that old, slightly unsettling feeling of caves and nighttime. Brightness settings are deliberately locked.

### Fog:

The mod brings back the fog from Beta Minecraft, thicker, heavier. The G hotkey has also been added, functioning as a render distance toggle that cycles through the same settings used in Beta: Tiny, Short, Normal, and Far.

### Dynamic Fog:

There is dynamic variation to the fog. Some nights and mornings become much foggier before slowly clearing up again. It also adds cave fog below a certain Y level, which can be turned on or off in the settings.

### Lighting Tweaks:
The world’s lighting has been adjusted to feel flatter and closer to the look of older versions, but it still keeps dynamic lighting.

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/673259d5555534871a68cf06f16e8f0dfb185b89.png)

The hunger system has been reworked so that basic movement no longer drains hunger, including walking, jumping, and breaking blocks. Reaching 0 hunger will no longer kill you, though your movement speed is greatly reduced. Sprinting, sprint-jumping, and fighting still drain hunger quickly, and sprint movement itself has also been reduced _(sprint jumping will drain your hunger much quicker than just sprinting, and sprint jumping in this mod is not much faster than just regular sprinting)_. These changes are meant to encourage a slower, more deliberate pace of play, closer to older versions of Minecraft but you can still move fast when you truly need to.

Food item stack sizes have also been reduced. Each food item now has a different stack size.

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9b47a66a91ae519517069d8150673be838b2da3_0.webp)

Elytras can no longer be boosted and can only be used for gliding. Horses do not exist in the world, and neither does packed ice nor blue ice. These changes are meant to keep movement and travel more balanced.

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fe2448477fa0ed23e01a4ed61c0ed60f078528aa_0.webp)

There's also a new custom painting system. How to paint: you will need canvases, dye, and an easel. The system uses the default 16 vanilla colors, each with adjustable opacity levels, allowing colors to be blended together. Dye is required to paint, and each dye provides 16 pixels of color.

First place a canvas into the easel to begin, then open the painting interface to paint (in real time!). Finished canvases can be removed as items, placed back onto the easel, or put into frames. Frames come in multiple sizes, and larger ones let you combine several canvases into a single bigger painting.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/Xcnlkbwrvjo" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dc367d36931fd03db7d97c097cfa56e0493ae2f6_0.webp)

Currently, two new mobs have been added:
Trader: Works similarly to a Wandering Trader.
Stone Golem: Ancient guardian golems that protect the underground ancient cities.

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ee63f059a844eca42581969527dd997dbc91fd1a.png)

These systems have been heavily reworked, especially the anvil. Since Mending has been removed from the mod and can no longer be obtained in any form, repair and progression had to be redesigned around it. The anvil no longer treats enchanting and repairing as the same XP cost.
Every tool and armor piece now has a condition tier: Pristine, Worn, Damaged, Fragile, and Ruined. As items are repaired, their condition worsens, which gradually lowers their maximum durability over time. This is meant to prevent items from lasting forever, while still being more forgiving than vanilla repair mechanics.
Enchanting and repairing have also been made cheaper in terms of XP, since mob farming has been greatly reduced. This mod does not encourage large-scale automatic farming. Elytras can still only be repaired with Phantom Membranes, but now a single membrane fully repairs them.

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b215ab4138cd1029c9343ae9dbcd7287f5b0d888_0.webp)

As mentioned earlier, this mod does not encourage large-scale automatic farming. Because of this, Hoppers and Observers have been made unobtainable.

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a493bd68fdd7a04269f27803ec1f927330f2828d.png)

Several vanilla mobs have been adjusted. Zombies and Spiders are now stronger, Zombie Pigmen have updated AI, and Fish now have a panic mechanic.Shulker boxes no longer keep their items when broken. The vanilla difficulty system has also been changed: when creating a world, you now choose between Monsters On and Peaceful. If you choose Monsters On, you can switch between Easy, Normal, and Hard during gameplay. If you choose Peaceful, the world remains permanently locked to Peaceful mode. Also, all non-Blaze spawners are destroyed after a set amount of time once activated by a player, and spawners work in all light conditions.

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dc70031d4adc51a8696727936bbfc9bdb23c75a7.png)

Many blocks from 1.15.2 have been made unobtainable and removed from the creative menu. The goal is to simplify block choices, and encourage more creative building. A full list of removed blocks and items can be seen in the screenshots.

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3ff3366a01445a46079421ac608c2afa20d8dba1_0.webp)

The mod also comes with a separate resource pack, which can be downloaded on its own. It brings back selected textures and sounds from older versions of Minecraft. You can find it here:

[https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/divergenceresourcepack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/divergenceresourcepack)

Also, if you like the **old water**, I made a separate resource pack that brings back that, and only that. It was tailored for this mod. You can use it with the mod’s resource pack too.:

[https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/old-water-for-divergence-resourcepack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/old-water-for-divergence-resourcepack)

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3458a3987bdd70cafc9a4d93093b298b94d84498_0.webp)

The “Allow Cheats” option has been removed from the Open to LAN menu, making it harder to enable cheats on the fly. Yes, I am looking at you. _(you can still enable cheats when creating a new world)_

# Discord: 
We also have a Discord server for anyone who wants to talk about the mod, and be part of the community:
[https://discord.com/invite/WHTZzbtnEh](https://discord.com/invite/WHTZzbtnEh)

# Patreon:
Divergence is free and will stay free. If you enjoy the project and want to support its development, you can do so on Patreon:
[https://www.patreon.com/divergencemod](https://www.patreon.com/divergencemod)

## FAQ:

Why 1.15.2? Will you update to newer versions?

I built this mod on 1.15.2 because it’s stable and it was the easiest version to shape around my vision. A lot of 1.15.2 features have also been removed or heavily reworked in this mod.

I don’t plan to update to newer versions, because this project is meant to explore an alternate development path for Minecraft, with its own progression and features. If I moved to newer versions, I’d end up having to remove or undo even more vanilla additions anyway.

So think of 1.15.2 as a foundation, a base I can build on to create something different.


### Compatibility:

_Optifine is not compatible with this mod._

title: TFC Heat Treatment
description: This mod enables quenching and tempering for TFC tools.
body:
本模组是把《群峦传说：野望》整合包内的淬火系统单独做成了模组，实现了给群峦工具的淬火回火。兼容《群峦超级锤》和《TFC Hammer Time》模组。支持数据包自定义。

只有品质为完美的、且没有附魔的铁和钢（类）工具才能淬火，先淬火后回火，然后获得相应的附魔属性。

淬火：把预热的工具投入装水的炼药锅中。回火：把淬火后的工具缓慢加热到250℃。

根据淬火的温度控制获得相应的附魔加成。

- 800℃会导致工具报废 - 只能熔化回收
- 760-800℃完美淬火 - 回火后得到效率5锋利5耐久3
- 730-759℃精工淬火 - 回火后得到效率3锋利3耐久2
- 700-729℃成功淬火 - 回火后得到效率1锋利1耐久1

This mod extracts the quenching system from the Terra Firma Far Horizons modpack and makes it into a standalone mod, enabling quenching and tempering for TFC tools. Compatible with the TFC Super Hammer and TFC Hammer Time mods. Custom datapacks are also supported.

Only tools made of iron and steel (or color steel) that are of perfect quality and have no enchantments can be quenched. First quench, then temper, and the tool will gain corresponding enchantments.

Quenching: Throw the preheated tool into a cauldron filled with water.
Tempering: Slowly heat the quenched tool to 250°C.

The enchantment bonuses gained depend on the temperature during quenching:

- 800°C: The tool is destroyed — can only be melted down for recycling.
- 760–800°C: Perfect Quench — after tempering grants Efficiency V, Sharpness V, Unbreaking III.
- 730–759°C: Fine Quench — after tempering grants Efficiency III, Sharpness III, Unbreaking II.
- 700–729°C: Successful Quench — after tempering grants Efficiency I, Sharpness I, Unbreaking I.

title: KTF Heroes & Horizons
description: This modpack combines RPG classes, progression, and exploration with a living economy, unique structures, and immersive villages. Featuring Cobblemon, farming & nature expansions, and Create automation, it offers endless adventures in a dynamic world.
body:
# 🌍 KTF Heroes & Horizons  

**KTF Heroes & Horizons** is a fantasy-RPG Minecraft modpack built around **class progression, exploration, and immersive worldbuilding**. Whether you’re chasing treasure, battling monsters, training Cobblemon, or mastering advanced engineering, this pack creates a dynamic sandbox for every adventurer.  

---

## ✨ Key Features  

### 🗡️ RPG Classes & Progression  
- **Level Z & Expansions** – Unlock skills and level up with specialized classes like Wizards, Archers, Paladins, Rogues, and more.  
- **Artifacts & Radiant Gear** – Discover unique loot, accessories, and RPG-style enhancements.  
- **Origins** – Choose from distinct player origins, each with unique abilities and drawbacks.  

### 🐾 Cobblemon & Creatures  
- **Cobblemon** and its addons bring Pokémon-inspired creatures into Minecraft.  
- Catch, battle, and train your team, explore gyms, and fill your Cobblepedia.  
- Side-mods expand trainers, Pokécenters, and Cobblemon-related quests.  

### 🌾 Animals, Farming & Nature  
- **Farmer’s Delight** expands cooking and farming with new meals and crops.  
- **Respawning Animals & Feeding Troughs** keep your farms alive and thriving.  
- **Horse Overhaul Mods** add depth with traits, equipment, and summoning tools.  
- **Serene Seasons** (visuals only) makes the world feel alive without restricting crop growth.

### 🏘 Villagers & Economy

description: Add motion support for your map!
body:
# **WHAT DID IT DO**
It adds support for motion NBT to the world, which makes your mini-game maps easier to make.

# **HOW TO USE IT**
Add tag to what entity that you want to move.

here are all the available tags:

-"mot" : Throws entities in the direction of your gaze

-"random_mot","random_mot_mid","random_mot_big" :Throws entities in the direction of your gaze, but adds randomness

-"one_random_mot" : Add randomly but it doesn't work when applied to multiple entities

-"random_exp" : throws entities to a random direction, if you do this to multiple entities at once, then it will look like an explosion!

-"trace": Throw entities to the nearest player

-"away": Throw entities away from the nearest player

/summon snowball ~ ~ ~ {Tags:["random_mot"]}

title: MineAuth
description: A simple Authentication mod with auto Login SUPPORT 1.21.11 /简体中文
body:
# MineAuth - Server Authentication 
![same](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1a49ba9b9b8933bbfc2ddc6c64f85e756c32ecfe.png)
- **English**
- [简体中文](https://github.com/Queso-su/BackupAlwaysRight/blob/master/README.zh_CN.md)

A simple and easy-to-use Minecraft server authentication mod with IP verification, multi-language support, login protection, session management, and permanent login for special users.

Only supports Minecraft [1.21.11]() Java Edition for **Fabric**.

> #### Attention!!!!! If yours _Minecraft Version < 1.21.11_, Please Use Another Mods for Auth, this Minecraft version changed old API

## Features

- Complete registration/login system with password change support, configurable login attempt limits
- Configurable session expiration time, supports auto-login
- Admins can grant permanent login permission to players using `/pass` command
- Admins can reset player account status using `/refresh` command
- Supports Fake Player Auth
- Supports IP verification to prevent login from different locations, option for single account per IP

## Installation

0. **You need Install [Fabric-Language-Kotlin](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin) too.**
1. Place the mod file in server's `mods` folder
2. Start server to generate config file
3. Modify `config/mineauth/mineauth.conf` as needed
4. Reload config need restart server.

## Player Commands

| Command | Description | Permission Level |
|---------|-------------|------------------|
| `/register <password> <confirm>` | Register new account | 0 |
| `/reg <password> <confirm>` | Register new account (short) | 0 |
| `/login <password>` | Login to account | 0 |
| `/logout` | Logout from account | 0 |
| `/changepassword <old> <new>` | Change password | 0 |
| `/cpwd <old> <new>` | Change password (short) | 0 |

## Admin Commands

| Command | Description | Permission Level |
|---------|-------------|------------------|
| `/pass <playername>` | Grant permanent login permission to player | 3 |
| | • Player will never need to login again | |
| | • Player sessions never expire | |
| | • Only works for unregistered players | |
| `/refresh <playername>` | Reset specified player's login status | 3 |
| | • Clear login cooldown | |
| | • Reset registration status (requires re-register) | |
| | • Useful when players forget passwords | |
> You can use /pass on the Fake Player .
## Configuration

Edit `config/mineauth/mineauth.conf`:

```properties
    # ================================================

    #  MineAuth 1.0.0 Configuration File
    #                               Author: QuesoX
    #  注意: 修改配置后需要重启服务器生效
    #  Note: Server restart required after modifying configuration
    # ================================================

    
    # [语言设置 / Language Setting]
    # auto: 自动根据系统语言选择 | auto: Auto-detect based on system language
    # zh_cn: 简体中文 | en_us: English
    
    language=auto
    
    
    
    # [IP验证 / IP Verification]
    # 启用后，不同IP登录同一账号时会要求重新输入密码
    # When enabled, logging in from a different IP will require re-entering the password
    
    ipVerify=false
    
    
    
    # [同一IP单账号 / One Account per IP]
    # 必须开启ipVerify才能生效
    # 开启后，同一IP注册多个账号会被禁止，并通知管理员
    # 可使用/refresh命令重置账号状态
    # When enabled, registering multiple accounts from the same IP will be blocked and admins will be notified
    # Requires ipVerify to be enabled
    # Use /refresh command to reset account status
    
    sameIPSameAccount=false
    
    
    
    # [会话过期时间 / Session Expiration Time]
    # 支持格式: 10m (分钟), 2h (小时), 30d (天)
    # Supported formats: 10m (minutes), 2h (hours), 30d (days)
    
    sessionTime=1d
    
    
    
    # [登录尝试限制 / Login Attempt Limit]
    # 如果禁用，则无限尝试次数，不会踢出玩家
    # If disabled, unlimited attempts and no player kick
    
    enableLoginLimit=true
    
    
    
    # [冷却时间 / CoolDown Time]
    # 达到最大尝试次数后的等待时间
    # 支持格式: 10m (分钟), 1h (小时), 2d (天)
    # /refresh 命令可以重置冷却时间
    # Waiting time after reaching maximum attempts
    # Supported formats: 10m (minutes), 1h (hours), 2d (days)
    # /refresh command can reset cooldown
    
    coolDownTime=5m
    
    
    
    # [最大登录尝试次数 / Maximum Login Attempts]
    # 仅在 enableLoginLimit=true 时生效
    # Only effective when enableLoginLimit=true
    
    maxLoginAttempts=10
    
    
    
    # [Pass命令 / Pass Command]
    # 开启后，OP可以使用/pass命令让玩家永久登录，无需注册
    # 使用后该玩家将永久登录，不受会话时间限制
    # When enabled, OP can use /pass command to let players login permanently without registration
    # After using, the player will be permanently logged in, not affected by session time
    
    enablePassCommand=false

body:
# **💠 Risers Gemstone – Power Beyond the Ordinary**

Step into the world of RISERS with the legendary **Risers Gemstone** – a mystical Spigot plugin that channels elemental strength, unique abilities, and server-wide influence through 10 distinct gemstones.

![Risers Gemstones](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bac8d8e820ebea4605d4ef301b0c3d94b2b4f2ac.jpeg)

---

## ⚡ **10 Elemental Gemstones, 10 Unique Powers**

| Gem | Element | Core Abilities |
|:---:|:---:|:---|
| 💧 **Water Gem** | Depths & Currents | Riptide III trident • Empowered effects in water/rain • Reduced damage in Nether |
| ⚡ **Shock Gem** | Storms & Lightning | Loyalty III trident • Summon lightning strikes • Combat buff on activation |
| 🌬️ **Air Gem** | Wind & Freedom | Unlimited Wind Charges • Wind Burst III enchanting • Complete fall immunity |
| 🔥 **Fire Gem** | Flame & Fury | Fire/lava immunity • Combat buffs when ablaze • 1.5x Nether damage boost |
| 💪 **Strength Gem** | Titan's Will | Permanent Strength effect • Sharpness V enchanting |
| 💨 **Speed Gem** | Velocity & Agility | 10-block teleportation (Blink) • Speed effect • Charge-based cooldown system |
| 👻 **Spirit Gem** | Soul & Ethereal | Capture mob spirits on kill • Summon spirit army (up to 5 spirits) |
| 🍀 **Luck Gem** | Fortune & Fate | Looting V / Fortune V enchanting • Permanent Luck effect |
| 💀 **Curse Gem** | Malevolence | Apply Wither & Blindness to foes • 1.5x Nether damage • Overworld penalty |
| 💗 **Healing Gem** | Life Force | +4 extra hearts • Regeneration & Resistance • AoE healing aura |

---

## ✨ **Key Features**

- 🎮 **Intuitive Activation** – Press `Shift + 5 rapid right-clicks` to awaken your gem's power
- 🛡️ **Soulbound Protection** – Gems can't be dropped, lost on death, or stored in containers (configurable)
- 🌍 **Multi-World Support** – Enable/disable gem mechanics per world
- 🎨 **Custom Model Ready** – Designed with CustomModelData for resource pack textures
- 🔄 **Auto-Update Checker** – Stay current with the latest version
- 🗃️ **SQLite Database** – Persistent gem ownership tracking

---

## 📦 **Commands & Permissions**

| Command | Description |
|:---|:---|
| `/gemstone give <player> <gem>` | Give a gemstone to a player |
| `/gemstone take <player> <gem>` | Remove a gemstone from a player |
| `/gemstone reload` | Reload the configuration |

**Permission:** `gemstone.admin` (default: OP)

---

## ⚙️ **Configuration**

```yaml
# Worlds where gemstone mechanics are active
enabled-worlds:
  - world
  - world_nether
  - world_the_end

# Gem protection settings
gem-settings:
  return-on-drop: true      # Prevents dropping gems
  return-on-death: true     # Returns gems on respawn
  return-on-container: true # Blocks storing in chests/hoppers
```

---

## 🔧 **Resource Pack**

For custom gem models and textures, use the official resource pack:
- **[Risers Gemstone Texturepack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/risers-gemstone-texture-pack)**

---

## 📋 **Requirements**

- **Minecraft:** 1.21+  
- **Server:** Spigot/Paper  
- **Java:** 21  

---

## 🌟 **Perfect For**

- ⚔️ **RPG Servers** – Unique class-based abilities
- 🏰 **Survival Multiplayer** – Rare rewards for achievements
- 🎁 **Reward Systems** – Integration with crate plugins or events
- 🛒 **Economy Servers** – Tradeable prestige items

---

> *"These aren't just gems... they're fragments of legacy."*  
> — **Dark_Yoddha** | Heir of the Risers Realm

**Will you rise to claim your gem?** 💎

body:
# OptiCore - Advanced Server Optimization Suite

## OptiCore is a comprehensive, high-performance optimization plugin for Minecraft servers that intelligently manages resources and prevents lag through automated systems and real-time monitoring. Built specifically for Spigot/Paper servers, it combines powerful optimization tools with detailed analytics to maintain optimal server performance even under extreme conditions.

# Core Features:

## 🔧 Smart Entity Management

• Dynamic entity limits per chunk with type-specific thresholds

• Intelligent item cleanup prioritizing valuable items and named/tamed entities

• Experience orb merging and mob spawn control

• Configurable entity tracking ranges and cleanup intervals


## 🗑️ Advanced Item Cleanup

• Performance-based cleanup system with configurable thresholds

• Value-based item protection system

• Fast-cleanup items list for quick optimization

• Age-based removal with server load consideration


## 🌍 Intelligent Chunk Management

• World-specific chunk loading settings

• Protected worlds and spawn areas

• Aggressive optimization mode for specific worlds

• Smart chunk unloading algorithms


## ⚡ Redstone Optimization

• Component-specific limits per chunk

• Hopper optimization during low TPS

• Redstone update delay system

• Advanced component tracking


## 📊 Real-Time Performance Monitoring

• Live TPS tracking with historical data

• Memory usage monitoring and alerts

• Entity and chunk count statistics

• Performance score calculation

• Trend analysis and recommendations


## 🚨 Emergency Response System

• Force garbage collection

• Cache clearing

• World unloading

• Spawn control

• Automatic recovery procedures


# Admin Tools:

## 📱 User Interface

• Beautiful, color-coded status messages

• Action bar notifications

• Title messages for important alerts

• Formatted console output


## ⚙️ Configuration

• Extensive config.yml options

• World-specific settings

• Customizable thresholds and limits

• Module toggles


## 📈 Analytics Dashboard

• Performance overview

• Trend insights

• Resource usage statistics

• Optimization history


# Commands:

• /opticore dashboard - Real-time performance overview

• /opticore optimize - Manual cleanup and optimization

• /opticore analytics - Detailed performance insights

• /opticore reload - Reload configuration


# Perfect For:

• High-performance servers requiring constant optimization

• Networks with multiple worlds and complex setups

• Servers experiencing entity or redstone-related lag

• Administrators seeking proactive performance management

• Communities needing automated resource optimization


# Technical Requirements:

• Java 17 or higher

• Paper/Spigot 1.18.2+

• 2GB+ RAM recommended


# OptiCore combines powerful optimization tools with detailed analytics to create a comprehensive solution for server performance management. Whether you're running a small community server or a large network, OptiCore provides the tools needed to maintain optimal performance and prevent lag spikes.

# Remap Menu Key

A mod that (in a hacky, taped together type of way) fixes a [years old](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-252336) bug because mojang doesn't care about us `caps:swapescape` users :(

Adds a keybinding in the settings that lets said key be used as an alternative escape key.
Because the escape key is otherwise impossible to set as a keybinding, the default is the escape key so it can always to reset to the default.

title: CommandTokens
description: Configurable 'token' items that run commands when held and right clicked. Useful for servers.
body:
NOTE: If you are looking for a server-side alternative to this mod (that clients dont also have to install to connect to your server) - CommandTokens has been included in my server-side essentials mod:
 
## Henny Essentials
### Overview
CommandTokens gives the user the ability to create custom items that execute commands when a player uses them.

This mod is aimed toward server owners, modpack creators and map makers but has a wide range of uses in many scenarios.

### Commands

You can use the command /commandtokens give <playername> <tokenalias> to give a token to a player.

Alternatively, you can use the Minecraft give command to give a player a token as follows:

/give <playername> commandtokens:token[custom_data={"commandtoken":"tokenAlias"}]



### How to create a Token

To create a token, place this mod in your mods folder and load up a world in creative mode. If you navigate to the CommandTokens creative tab you will see 3 tokens that are created by default.

Now save and quit your world and navigate to the config directory, you will see a file called: CommandTokens.json

This is the file where you can create your custom tokens. Below is a breakdown of a "token" object:
![Config token](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9b1f67e710bcb6b689681a3e88b247972233a582.png)

**NOTE: as of V1.0.4 you can add a permission: "some.permission.node" option to tokens and it will use LuckPerms to check if player has permission to use the token. If LuckPerms is not installed, or the permission string is blank, the token will not check permissions.**

Create as many of those objects as you want and place them within the "tokens": [] array in the config and the next time you load your world you will have access to these tokens.

For example, the config token defined above will create this token in game:
![Example of token in game](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/65808bd56f27feafe9d5fd2825a5eee6decec9c6.png)

title: Heal Command
description: Adds /heal command to Minecraft, optionally, targets and heal amount can be specified in any order. Supports single-player, integrated/LAN servers, and dedicated servers.
body:
# Minecraft Heal Command Mod

This is a simple Fabric mod that adds a `/heal` command to Minecraft, allowing players to heal themselves or others. This mod supports **single-player**, **integrated/LAN servers**, and **dedicated servers**.

## Command Usage  
```  
/heal [<targets>] [<amount>]  
/heal [<amount>] [<targets>]  
```

### Parameters:  
- `<targets>` (optional) – The player(s) to heal. Defaults to the command executor.  
- `<amount>` (optional) – The amount of health to restore. Defaults to full health.

## Permissions  
- Requires **operator permissions (level 2)** or higher to use.

## Notes  
- Defaults to **self-heal** if no target is specified.  
- Defaults to **full heal** if no amount is specified.  
- Works with modified maximum health values.  
- Not required on clients for dedicated and integrated/LAN servers.  
- Similar to the `/damage` command, the `<amount>` parameter must be greater than 0.  
- Unlike the `/damage` command, multiple players can be affected at once.  
- Players can be healed regardless of their gamemode, given that they are alive.

## Last Note
If you liked the mod and are a mod maker or simply have a github account, I'd appreciate it a lot if you gave the project a star at https://github.com/SametHope/mc-heal-command-mod.

A mod that adds various sleep events to the game, including nightmares, vicious ambushes and the ability to set a sleep percentage/player amount to skip the night even if not all players are sleeping!


This mod adds:
- The ability to set the percentage or amount of players that need to sleep to skip the night on servers. Now including wake up messages!

- A chance for the player to have a nightmare when sleeping. Nightmares give the player temporary debuffs.

- A chance for the player to get ambushed when trying to sleep. Dont sleep in the open!

- A new crafting material, Lunar Fragments. These are dropped by hostile mobs at night with a low chance. The drop chance scales with the moon phase, the chance is highest during a full moon!

- A Moon Lamp that the player can craft with these fragments and place near their bed to prevent nightmares and get a buff instead


**A lot of this mod is controlled in the config file! Please take a look in the config file of the mod when trying it out, as a lot of chances, effects and mobs are arbitrarily chosen as an example!**

FlexiPause allows you to easily change the pausing behavior of any GUI.

![How To Use](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/FlexiPause/BH_SF_HowToUse.webp)

# Creepers Improve Over Time
Creepers get stronger the longer you play. Difficulty is calculated for each player separately. The improvements are gradual, taking place every 20 minutes.

## NOTICE: This datapack is discontinued, instead use the Hostile Mobs Improve Over Time datapack: https://modrinth.com/datapack/hostile-mobs-improve-over-time 

### Stat Increase
Stats that change include:
 - Health
 - Movement speed
 - Follow range
 - Armor
 - Decreased fuse time
 - Chance of being charged
 - Explosion radius
 - On day 100 creepers are silent

Creeper's fuse time starts out lower than default, gets to normal on day 50, and decreases up to day 100.
### Timers
Timer for difficulty is per player, and increases every minecraft day (20 minutes). sleeping does NOT forward this timer. Max difficulty is day 100+ and difficulty does not increase after that.
### Commands
To test out how hard the creepers are, use functions cree:day25, cree:day50, cree:day75, cree:day100 or use command: /scoreboard players set <player> Creedif <number>. To reset your score use cree:reset, to reset all of players difficulty, use cree:resetall. 
### Installing
Like your ordinary datapack, put zip file in datapacks folder of your world.
### Unistalling
Run function skel:uninstall and remove the datapack from datapacks folder
### Other
I tried to make the changes to creepers not as drastic because they are one of the most frustrating mobs in the game. I am planning on making a version of this datapack for each common mob, then making a datapack consisting of all of them (This is the fourth mob improvement datapack I made).

Creepers can be destructive, and with this datapack even more, keep this in mind, as they could destroy your builds/terrain.

title: Ori's Client Pronouns
description: A client-side mod to exchange pronouns with other players.
body:
What is this mod?

This is a client-side Fabric mod that allows players to select their pronouns, as well as see the pronouns of other players using the mod.

Client-side?

That's right, this mod is purely client-side. The motivation for this was primarily so that it can be used on any server, regardless of what mods are installed. As long as you install the mod locally, you can use it anywhere(*).

How does it work?

Upon joining a server, your client will automatically send a registration message in global chat. For example, if your pronouns are they/them, the following will be sent:

<ori_sky> #pronouns they/them

Registration messages will be hidden from those using the mod, in order to streamline your experience with the mod. For someone who is not using the mod, they will see this message, but it's designed to be human-readable so that they know your pronouns.

Upon receiving a registration message, another player using the pronouns mod will automatically respond with a private registration message to the joining player. For example, if that player's pronouns are she/her, the following will be sent to the joining player:

<c00Lkid1337> /tell ori_sky #pronouns she/her

Similarly, private registration messages will be hidden from those using the mod.

(*) Note: This mod may not function properly on servers that modify the normal operation of chat, e.g. very large servers with instanced chat channels.

Where do I see someone's pronouns?

As of version 0.1.0, pronouns are visible in two places.

  • Viewing the player list (holding Tab by default) will display pronouns alongside usernames.
  • Hovering over a username in chat events. This should work across many common chat events but the list is not exhaustive.

Where are my pronouns?

Unfortunately, the list of pronouns can never be exhaustive. I've included the most common set of pronouns for you to choose from, but you can set custom ones by editing the config file manually. In a future update I'll provide a way for this to be done entirely from the pronouns options screen. If you're still unsatisfied and feel your pronouns should be included in the default list, please don't hesitate to get in touch!

I don't want my pronouns to be displayed

When using this mod, you can select (none) as your pronouns. Registration will still occur as normal, but no pronouns will be displayed with your name, both on your own client and other players' clients.

Why do I need to see pronouns??

You don't. However, it can help to avoid misunderstandings and mistakes. Sometimes, you misjudge someone's gender -- we all do it: "thanks man", "nah he just joined the server", etc -- and visible pronouns can help prevent this.

Visible pronouns can also alleviate the concerns of some people who may find it difficult to remember everyone's pronouns. For those people, this gives them a way of instantly seeing someone's pronouns without needing to recall them, and hovering over someone's name in chat is a very small price to pay, in return for making someone feel happy and respected.

I still don't want this >:(

Well, don't use it then. You don't have to. This is entirely client-side, so it's your choice. This mod exists for those who do want to use it, so it's probably not designed for you.

title: G1axFixer
description: G1axFixer is a client-side Fabric mod that fixes resource pack crashes and optimizes network, rendering, and ticking for maximum FPS and smooth combat.
body:
# 🎮 G1axFixer

**The ultimate performance and stability mod for Minecraft 1.21.11**

G1axFixer eliminates lag spikes, freezes, and crashes caused by resource packs while providing powerful optimizations for smooth gameplay and combat.

[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/XPYnrMd39C?color=7289da&label=Discord&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/XPYnrMd39C)
[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-AkaTriggered-181717?logo=github)](https://github.com/AkaTriggered)

---

## ✨ Features

### 🛡️ Resource Pack Protection
- **Corrupt ZIP Guard** - Prevents crashes from broken resource pack archives
- **Atlas Overflow Fix** - Handles oversized textures that exceed GPU limits
- **Missing Sprite Handler** - Replaces missing textures with fallback instead of crashing
- **Sound Event Fixer** - Silently skips missing or corrupt sound files
- **Model Load Protection** - Substitutes broken models with fallback cube
- **Language File Sanitizer** - Skips malformed translation files
- **Metadata Auto-Repair** - Fixes or generates missing pack.mcmeta files

### ⚡ Performance Optimizations
- **Network Packet Batching** - Reduces network overhead for smoother multiplayer
- **Particle Culling** - Removes distant particles to boost FPS
- **Entity Render Optimization** - Optimizes entity rendering at distance
- **Smart Entity Ticking** - Reduces tick rate for distant entities
- **Block Entity Optimization** - Improves performance with many tile entities

### 🔧 Advanced Features
- **Compatibility Checker** - Detects incompatible mods before launch
- **Error Handler** - Catches and logs errors without crashing
- **Configurable** - Toggle any fix or optimization via config file
- **Debug Logging** - Detailed logs for troubleshooting

---

## 📦 Installation

1. **Install Fabric Loader** (0.19.2 or newer)
2. **Install Fabric API** (required dependency)
3. **Download G1axFixer** from [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com) or [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/AkaTriggered)
4. Place the `.jar` file in your `.minecraft/mods` folder
5. Launch the game!

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

Config file: `.minecraft/config/g1axfixer.json`

### Resource Pack Fixes
```json
{
  "fixCorruptZip": true,
  "fixAtlasStitch": true,
  "fixMissingSprite": true,
  "fixMissingSound": true,
  "fixBrokenModel": true,
  "fixLanguageJson": true,
  "fixPackMetadata": true,
  "fixReloadHang": true
}
```

### Performance Optimizations
```json
{
  "optimizeNetwork": true,
  "batchNetworkPackets": true,
  "packetBatchSize": 10,
  "compressLargePackets": true,
  "compressionThreshold": 256,
  
  "optimizeRendering": true,
  "cullDistantParticles": true,
  "particleCullDistance": 64,
  "optimizeEntityRender": true,
  "reduceParticleCount": true,
  
  "optimizeTicking": true,
  "optimizeEntityTick": true,
  "optimizeBlockEntityTick": true,
  "entityTickRange": 128
}
```

### Logging
```json
{
  "logFixedIssues": true,
  "logDebug": false
}
```

---

## 🎯 Use Cases

### For Players
- ✅ Use multiple resource packs without crashes
- ✅ Eliminate lag spikes during resource pack loading
- ✅ Smoother gameplay with 100+ mods
- ✅ Better FPS in crowded multiplayer servers
- ✅ Stable combat without freezes

### For Modpack Creators
- ✅ Prevent user crashes from bad resource packs
- ✅ Improve overall pack stability
- ✅ Reduce support tickets
- ✅ Compatible with performance mods (Sodium, Iris)

### For Server Owners
- ✅ Reduce client-side crashes
- ✅ Better network performance
- ✅ Smoother player experience

---

## 🔄 Compatibility

### ✅ Compatible With
- Fabric API
- Sodium
- Iris Shaders
- Lithium
- Phosphor
- Most Fabric mods

### ❌ Incompatible With
- OptiFabric
- OptiFine (use Sodium + Iris instead)

---

## 📊 Performance Impact

**Before G1axFixer:**

title: Tartarus Punishments - Simple Ban / Mute / Prison System
description: A simple ban manager with predefined reasons and timeframes
body:
TartarusPunishements

Ban with Simplicity.

**Tartarus Punishments is a lightweight, permission-based moderation plugin for Minecraft servers (Bukkit/Paper/Purpur/Spigot).** Easily manage bans & temporary punishments with predefined or custom reasons — perfect for small to medium-sized servers needing a clean, configurable punishment system. --- ## ✅ Key Features - **Punish & Forgive** — Apply or remove punishment options (ban, mute, prison, screenshare) - **Temporary & Permanent Punishments** — Flexible duration support (permanent, timed) - **Prison System** — Freeze and teleport players to a designated prison location - **Screenshare Workflow** — Freeze players for screenshare checks with automatic unfreezing - **Predefined Reasons + Custom Reasons** — Use built-in reason templates or define your own - **Permission-based Controls** — Fine-grained permission nodes for each punishment type - **Customizable Messages & Layouts** — Color or legacy codes, configurable message templates per reason - **Automatic Default Messages** — Smart fallback messages if none provided (avoids server crashes or misconfig) - **IP Banning** — Automatic IP bans with UUID-based bans - **Inventory Clearing** — Optional inventory clearing on ban (configurable per reason) - **Async Database Operations** — Non-blocking punishment checks for optimal server performance - **Fully Configurable** — All settings exposed in config file; easy to tailor for your server style - **Easy Setup & Lightweight** — Drop JAR into plugins folder on Bukkit/Spigot/Paper/Purpur; ready to go - **Active Development & Changelog** — Frequent updates, bug-fixes, and improvements ## 🎯 Performance Features (v0.2.2+) Tartarus Punishments is designed for optimal server performance: - **Async Player Lookups**: Player searches run off the main thread - **Async Database Checks**: Punishment verification doesn't block the server - **Async Join Processing**: Player login data loads asynchronously - **Optimized Tab Completion**: Only searches online players for instant results Your server will remain responsive even during heavy moderation activity! --- ## ⚙️ Supported Platforms & Versions - **Loaders:** Bukkit, Spigot, Paper, Purpur - **Minecraft Versions:** 1.21.x - Java 21+ Compatible on any Bukkit-based server — from small SMPs to mid-sized communities. --- ### Permissions - `tartarus.punishments.punish` – Punish a player - `tartarus.punishments.forgive` – Remove a punishment - `tartarus.punishments.banlist` – View the ban list - `tartarus.punishments.prison` – Imprison (freeze) players - `tartarus.punishments.setprison` – Set the prison location - `tartarus.punishments.screenshare` – Freeze players for screenshares - `tartarus.punishments.*` – All punishment permissions ### Commands - `/punish ` (aliases: `/ban`, `/banplayer`) - `/forgive ` (aliases: `/unban`, `/pardon`) - `/banlist` (aliases: `/bans`) - `/prison ` - `/setprison` - `/screenshare ` --- ## 💡 Why Use Tartarus Punishments? | ✔️ Benefit | Details | |-----------|---------| | **Simple yet powerful** | Provides comprehensive moderation without bloat or complexity | | **Customizable & flexible** | Customize reasons, durations, messages — fits any server style | | **Permission-driven** | Control who can punish who, integrate with permission plugins | | **Performance optimized** | Async operations prevent server lag during punishment checks | | **Lightweight & easy** | SQLite database, minimal dependencies, no complex setup | | **Active & maintained** | Regular updates and bug fixes ensure reliability | For servers that don't need heavy all-in-one moderation suites, but want a clean, dependable punishment system — Tartarus Punishments hits the sweet spot. --- ## 🔄 Recent Changelog (since 0.2.0) ### v0.2.2 (Latest) - **Performance Optimization**: Moved all database operations to async threads for zero main-thread blocking - **Code Refactoring**: Introduced `TartarusCommand` base class for better code reusability - **Player Lookup Optimization**: Created `PlayerFinder` utility for efficient async player searches - **Join Listener Optimization**: Async punishment data loading prevents login freezes - **Tab Completion Fix**: Commands now properly support tab completion via `TabExecutor` - **Code Cleanup**: Removed ~53 lines of unnecessary verbose comments for better maintainability - Added configurable ban message layouts supporting named colours or legacy codes - Custom ban message lines now support smart defaulting if colours are omitted - Auto-populate missing `ban-message` config fields on update to avoid breaking configurations - Metadata and compatibility update for 1.21.x Full changelog available in “Versions” tab. --- ## 🔧 Installation 1. Download the latest `TartarusPunishments-*.jar` from Releases on Modrinth 2. Place it in your server’s `plugins` folder (Bukkit/Paper/Spigot/Purpur) 3. (Re)start the server 4. Configure `config.yml` as needed — or use defaults 5. Use permissions and commands to manage punishments --- *Licensed ARR — see project page for details.*

A Minecraft mod that adds recipes and models for cute stuffed animals.

# 📖 What is this mod?

Have you ever felt like your dwellings were cold, utilitarian places?
Nothing makes a home feel cozier than soft pillows and cute stuffed animals!

Socky is a lightweight mod that adds stuffed animals to the game.
For now, these are purely decorative items intended to make you feel better every time you go back to your base.

- **[Smol Scarf](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/VKML5JZk/images/107a6136d359272cad1f96de3e88b7969e771eb3.png)** - Adds a dash of style, essential for bringing out a stuffy's personality.

## Blocks
- **[Socky](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/VKML5JZk/images/ae1be320e68da7591de9e2526cd45c1d868ad1e4.png)** - Adorable, all-purpose stuffy ready for any adventure.
- **[Blocky](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/VKML5JZk/images/b3f14be55f92b2de9399cc4394a6c4bf3dd8d8cf.png)** - An efficient way to bundle up several Sockies for storage, or when you need to increase the density of cuteness.

Socky is simple and lightweight, to ensure as many people as possible can benefit from a little extra cuteness.

Install it in your mods folder along with [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api).

A flexible, optimized plugin for creating, brewing, and distributing unique potions with full config control and placeholder support.

  - Configure mob drops, structure loot, and acquisition odds

title: JMC-Codespace
description: Utilities for coding on JustMC Creative+
body:
## Этот мод помогает кодить на JustMC Creative+:
- Позволяет очищать код
- Позволяет сохранять код в файл
- Позволяет получить ссылку на загрузку кода
- Позволяет загрузить файл с кодом в мир
- Добавляет навигацию по коду при помощи Shift + ЛКМ
- Позволяет искать блоки в коде
- Позволяет получить код шаблона
- Позволяет установить код шаблона

## Использование
- `/csp clear` - очистить код
- `/csp config` - открыть папку с конфигом
- `/csp config reload` - перезагрузить конфиг
- `/csp config reset` - сбросить конфиг
- `/csp config savingPeriod` - узнать текущий период сохранения шаблонов (тики)
- `/csp config savingPeriod <число>` - установить период сохранения шаблонов (тики)
- `/csp save stop` - остановить сохранение кода
- `/csp save file` - сохранить код в файл
- `/csp save file <имя>` - сохранить код в файл с указанным именем
- `/csp save upload` - получить ссылку на загрузку кода
- `/csp modules delete <файл>` - удалить сохранённый код в указанном файле
- `/csp modules clear` - удалить все сохранённые коды
- `/csp modules optimize <файл>` - оптимизировать код модуля
- `/csp modules load <файл>` - загрузить код из файла в мир
- `/csp modules load force <файл>` - загрузить код из файла в мир с заменой текущего кода
- `/csp modules mapping` - открыть файл с маппингами
- `/csp modules mapping add <маппинг> <ссылка на модуль>` - добавить маппинг
- `/csp modules mapping remove <маппинг>` - удалить маппинг
- `/csp search <ввод>` - найти в коде блоки по имени
- `/csp search-page <страница>` - показать определённую страницу результатов поиска
- `/csp template from-raw <код>` - создать шаблон из кода в сжатом виде
- `/csp template from-json <код>` - создать шаблон из кода в виде JSON
- `/csp template get-raw` - получить код шаблона в сжатом виде
- `/csp template get-json` - получить код шаблона в виде JSON
- `/csp template optimize` - оптимизировать код шаблона

# Usage explanation:

<details>
<summary>(All information is also described in the books that are given out during the game)</summary>

## Magic Materia
In the world, **Magic Materia** is generated once every 2-5 hours in a radius of the center of the world of 10-150 blocks. The maximum number of Materia in the world at a time is 5. Materia disappears 1-3 hours after its appearance, but if a player is near it, it will not disappear. Materia looks like a cluster of purple particles. Materia can only be seen if you put on **Spectral Glasses**.
## Amethyst Workbench ![Amethyst Workbench](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/712a7c21ba1b57d5c6e913feb33a4757ca880213.png)
Workbench is crafted from 3 amethyst shards, 3 wood planks and 2 stripped logs. If you drop an item on the Workbench, it will stay there. If you collect enough items for crafting, you can right-click on the table, then the item will be crafted. If you press Shift and right-click, then all the items will fall out. If you left-click on the table, then the table will break.
## Amethyst Lens ![Amethyst Lens](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/69feb632d85470e1a065e8afa667843f51a32d2a.png)
The Amethyst Lens is crafted from an Amethyst Shard and a Glass Pane. The lens is an ingredient for the **Spectral Glasses**.
## Spectral Glasses ![Spectral Glasses](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/27f48bb810b0c8f1cf48c24b839dd605ebb99553.png)
Spectral glasses are crafted from 2 amethyst lenses, iron, a stick and a string. If you put on the glasses, the amethyst lenses will make your vision a little purple, after which the vision spectrum will allow you to see **Magic Materia**.
## Amethyst Extractor ![Amethyst Extractor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4ffefe39e8a7164f36612d65721f7bce94a017e6.png)
The Extractor is crafted from glass, an amethyst shard, and a piston. Thanks to its tip, the extractor can touch the Materia. If you right-click the extractor on the **Materia**, you will collect it in the **Extractor**. The Materia can be injected into you, after which it will live in your body.
## Amethyst Apple ![Amethyst Apple](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/55b30feeb60b0f7c6184734119668f2ee788c4ab.png)
Crafted on crafting table from 8 amethyst blocks and golden apple. Works like a regular golden apple, but also restores 50 used mana.
## Amethyst Armor ![Amethyst Chestplate](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e4bf184df525a21e2a31ddbf9d17bb9bf77fd025.png)
Amethyst armor is crafted like regular armor, but from amethyst shards. In terms of durability and protection, it is between chainmail and gold, but each piece of armor also reduces **Mana Cost** by 2%.
## Amethyst Sandpaper ![Amethyst Sandpaper](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1ad1fbb31dda8696a3c4f8c55c94e65b25918445.png)
Amethyst sandpaper is crafted from paper, sand and amethyst dust. With the charged tablet in your left hand, use sandpaper to remove the spell from the tablet.
## Dust for Circles ![Circle Dust](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/afdc9c290b796143823108c00bba4a11c02b4a94.png)
To make Dust for Circle, you will need 6-64 redstone and 10-64 amethyst dust (also on the Workbench). To get Amethyst Dust, you need to put Amethyst or an Amethyst block in a stonecutter.
## Magic Circles
When using Dust for a Circle, a **Magic Circle** will appear, the radius of which will be equal to the amount of Amethyst Dust divided by 10, and the duration of the circle will be equal to the amount of redstone in Flixes new time measure.
## Drawing on Magic Circles
There is a grid with dots in the circle, by right-clicking the starting point will appear, by right-clicking on any point you make it the leading one, by clicking on the next one you draw a line between them. You can draw several lines from one point, but you cannot close it. After finishing your figure, hold down Shift and hit the starting point, then the figure will be accepted and an amethyst crystal will appear. An unaccepted figure can be erased by hitting the starting point. If you right-click on the crystal, all figures will be erased. And if you hit it, the spell will begin. The crystal can be activated at any time, the main thing is to draw all the figures successfully. The top for the figures is on the side where the circle begins to be drawn.
## Mana System
After injecting **Magic Materia**, you are given 200-250 mana volume and 25-35 seconds of mana regeneration. Mana volume and spent mana are completely different values. Mana volume is your safe maximum amount of spent mana , and spent mana is the amount of your spent mana, respectively. When there is a lack of mana, all spells begin to deal damage and impose negative effects, the more mana is spent, the more damage and longer the effects. If the spell fails to activate, an explosion occurs, causing damage.
## Figures for Drawing
You can draw the **Figures** on the circle in any order, the main thing is not to make a mistake, otherwise an explosion will occur. **Not all figures are available from the very beginning!** To open some figures, you will need to practice with these figures, one day you will succeed.
## Starfall
Starts at night with a chance of ~2.85%, during rain ~3.33%, during a thunderstorm 25%. Every 15-25 seconds a star falls within a radius of 150 blocks from a random player.
## Fallen Star ![Fallen Star](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cdc317cebb7dc5f9b592b574431194bff5f27041.png)
Fallen stars that are **not picked up** disappear during the day. They are useless by themselves, they are only needed for crafting.
## Amethyst Mana Star ![Amethyst Mana Star](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/25cfe754fcab1ccb155c9bc877833a089a47c3bd.png)
Amethyst mana star is crafted 5 fallen stars and 3 amethyst dust. Instantly consumes, has a 0.25 second cooldown, increases mana by 5.

title: Time Enchants

body:
# ⏳ **World Time: Time Enchants**

A **Minecraft 1.21.1 (NeoForge)** mod created by the **World Time Team**, designed to enhance your gameplay with **over 23 powerful custom enchantments**, magical utilities, and even **infinite-level upgrades** for vanilla enchantments.

---

## ⚡ **Main Features**

### ✨ **Custom Enchantments**

1. **No Fall** *(Lv. 1–3)*
   • Reduces or completely removes fall damage.
   • Applies to boots.
   • Level 3 fully negates fall damage.

2. **Auto Repair** *(Lv. 1–6)*
   • Automatically repairs items over time.
   • Higher levels increase repair speed or chance.
   • Applies to any repairable item.

3. **Fly** *(Lv. 1–3)*
   • Allows creative-style flight.
   • Applies to chestplates.
   • Higher levels grant faster flight speed.

4. **Click TP** *(Lv. 1–3)*
   • Teleports the player to where they click.
   • Applies to sticks (including the “Special Teleport Stick”).
   • Higher levels increase range.

5. **Lifesteal** *(Lv. 1–5)*
   • Heals the player for a portion of dealt damage.
   • Applies to melee weapons.

6. **Auto Smelt** *(Lv. 1–3)*
   • Instantly smelts mined ores.
   • Applies to mining tools.

7. **Magnet** *(Lv. 1–4)*
   • Pulls nearby items toward the player.
   • Applies to chestplates.

8. **Night Vision** *(Lv. 1)*
   • Grants permanent night vision while wearing a helmet.

9. **Speed** *(Lv. 1–3)*
   • Increases movement speed while wearing enchanted boots.

10. **Soulbound** *(Lv. 1)*
    • Keeps the item in your inventory after death.

11. **XP Boost** *(Lv. 1–3)*
    • Increases experience gained from killing mobs.

12. **Beheading** *(Lv. 1–3)*
    • Increases the chance of mobs dropping their heads.

13. **Fire Immunity** *(Lv. 1)*
    • Grants fire resistance and extinguishes flames.
    • Applies to chestplates.

14. **Water Mastery** *(Lv. 1–3)*
    • Grants water breathing and Dolphin’s Grace.
    • Applies to boots.

15. **Anti Knockback** *(Lv. 1–3)*
    • Reduces or negates knockback depending on the level.
    • Applies to chestplates.

16. **Mining AOE** *(Lv. 1–3)*
    • Breaks multiple blocks around the targeted one.
    • Applies to mining tools.

17. **Vein Miner** *(Lv. 1–3)*
    • Mines entire connected ore veins.
    • Applies to mining tools.

18. **Reflect Damage** *(Lv. 1–3)*
    • Reflects part of the damage received back to the attacker.
    • Applies to chestplates.

19. **Auto Feed** *(Lv. 1–3)*
    • Gradually restores hunger while equipped.
    • Applies to chestplates.

20. **Prosperity** *(Lv. 1–5)*
    • Adds bonus drops from ores and resources.
    • Applies to mining tools.

21. **Super Loot**
    • Increases loot drops from mobs.
    • Applies to weapons.

22. **OP Haste**
    • Drastically increases mining speed.
    • Applies to mining tools.

23. **XP Magnet**
    • Pulls XP orbs toward the player.
    • Applies to chestplates.

---

## ⚙️ **Installation**

1. Make sure you have **Minecraft 1.21.1** and **NeoForge 21.1.0+** installed.
2. Download the `.jar` file from **Modrinth**.
3. Place it inside your `mods` folder.
4. Launch Minecraft and enjoy the new enchantments!

---

## 📘 **How to Obtain Enchantments**

Custom enchantments can be obtained through:

* **Enchanting tables** (with unique rarity chances).
* **Loot chests** and structure rewards.
* **Trading** with librarian villagers.
* **Combining** items in anvils.

---

## 🎲 **Spawn Chances**

| Enchantment | Chance           |
| ----------- | ---------------- |
| No Fall     | 15%              |
| Auto Repair | 8%               |
| Fly         | 3% *(very rare)* |
| Click TP    | 2% *(very rare)* |

---

## 🧩 **Compatibility**

* **Version:** Minecraft 1.21.1
* **Loader:** NeoForge 21.1.0 or higher
* Fully compatible with most other mods.

---

**MIT License**
You are free to modify, use, and redistribute this mod, as long as proper credit is given to the original authors.

---

## 🌐 **Part of the World Time Project**

**Time Enchants** is part of the **World Time** network of projects — a collection of mods, tools, and utilities designed to enhance your gameplay experience, made by and for the community.

💬 **Discord:** [https://discord.gg/AkGsvJhnJF](https://discord.gg/AkGsvJhnJF)

title: Hunter Vs Mice
description:
The two teams compete against the game mod, and the identities of the hunter and the mouse will be swapped from time to time
两队对抗游戏模组，猎人与鼠鼠的身份会不定期互换
body:
# Hunter vs Mice Mod
## Overview
**Hunter vs Mice Mod** is a multiplayer modification designed for Minecraft players, delivering a unique hunting experience. In this game, players can choose to become either "Hunters" or "Mice," engaging in interactive competition through distinct roles. The mod introduces new commands, HUD interfaces, configuration options, and various interactive mechanics, significantly enhancing gameplay depth and enjoyment.

## Installation Requirements
- "fabricloader": ">=0.16.14",
- "minecraft": "~1.20.1",
- "java": ">=17",
- "fabric-api": "*",
- "cloth-config": "*"
## Core Features
### Role Switching
Admins can change player roles using `/teamchange <player> <role>`, where `<role>` is either `hunter` or `mouse`.

## Game Controls
- *Stop Game*: Execute `/hvmstop` to terminate gameplay.
- *Team Data Request*: Press `H` to view current team information (client-side).
- *Configuration Menu*: Press `C` to access settings (admin-only).
### Command Examples
- `/hvmstop`: Ends the game.
- `/teamchange Alice hunter`: Assigns Alice as a Hunter.
- `/teamchange Bob mouse`: Assigns Bob as a Mouse.
### HUD Display
- *Coordinate Display*: Shows player coordinates and nearby Mice positions.
- *Countdown Timer*: Indicates remaining time for preparation or next role-swap.
### Team Management
- *UI Interface*: Admins use `TeamUIScreen` to assign roles and confirm game readiness.
- *Auto-Reassignment*: Players are randomly assigned new roles post-game to rejoin battles.
## Configuration Options
Use `/hvmconfig` to view settings and `/hvmreload` to apply changes. Key configurations include:

- **Swap Interval**: Time between role rotations.
- **Broadcast Interval**: Frequency of Mice position updates.
- **Danger Alerts**: Notifies players when enemies approach.
- **Respawn Radius**: Hunter revival area radius after death.
- **HUD Settings**: Customizes sidebar content and appearance.
## Known Issues & Solutions
- **Unrecognized Player Roles**: Ensure all player data is correctly saved and uncorrupted.
- **Sync Issues from Network Latency**: Reduce broadcast_interval to minimize network traffic.
- **Client Update Failures**: Verify identical mod versions on server and client. 
- **C key invalid**: The C key is shared with the save shortcut bar. Modify the key binding.
- **Others**: Please leave a message.

# Hunter vs Mice Mod

## 概述

**Hunter vs Mice Mod** 是一款专为Minecraft玩家设计的多人游戏模组，旨在提供一种独特的狩猎体验。在这个游戏中，玩家可以选择成为“猎人”或“老鼠”，通过不同的角色扮演来进行互动和竞争。这个模组引入了新的命令、HUD界面、配置选项以及各种交互机制，使得游戏更加丰富有趣。


## 安装需要
- "fabricloader": ">=0.16.14",
- "minecraft": "~1.20.1",
- "java": ">=17",
- "fabric-api": "*",
- "cloth-config": "*"

## 主要功能

### 角色切换

玩家可以通过 `/teamchange <player> <role>` 命令来改变其他玩家的角色（需要管理员权限）。其中 `<role>` 可以为 `hunter` 或 `mouse`。


## 游戏控制

- *停止游戏* : 使用 `/hvmstop` 来中断游戏。

- *请求团队数据* : 在客户端按下 `H` 键查看当前队伍信息。

- *配置界面* : 按下 `C` 键打开配置菜单，调整游戏设置（仅限管理员）。


### 示例命令

- `/hvmstop`: 结束游戏。

- `/teamchange Alice hunter`: 将玩家Alice设为猎人。

- `/teamchange Bob mouse`: 将玩家Bob设为老鼠。


### HUD 显示

- *坐标显示* : 展示玩家当前位置及附近老鼠的位置。

- *倒计时* : 显示准备阶段剩余时间或下次换队时间。



### 团队管理

- *UI界面*: 管理员可以使用 `TeamUIScreen` 更改玩家角色并确认游戏准备状态。

- *自动分配*: 游戏结束后，玩家会随机分配到新角色，重新加入战斗。



## 配置选项

通过 `/hvmconfig` 查看可用的配置项，并使用 `/hvmreload` 加载最新的配置更改。主要配置包括：

- **交换间隔**: 设置每两次角色互换之间的时间间隔。

- **广播间隔**: 控制鼠标位置更新的频率。

- **危险警报**: 开启后会在接近敌方时发送警告信息。

- **复活半径**: 定义猎人在死亡后重生的最大范围。

- **HUD 设置**: 自定义侧边栏显示的内容及其外观样式。


## 已知问题与解决方案

- **无法识别玩家角色**: 确保所有玩家的数据正确保存且没有损坏。

- **网络延迟导致同步问题**: 尝试降低 `broadcast_interval` 参数以减少不必要的网络流量。

- **客户端无法接收更新**: 确认服务器和客户端均运行相同版本的模组。
  
- **C键无效**：与保存快捷栏共用了C键，修改按键绑定。

- **其他**：请留言。

title: MatterBukkit
description: A Bukkit plugin which sends chat messages from/to MatterBridge.
body:
# MatterBukkit

A Minecraft Bukkit plugin which sends chat messages from/to [MatterBridge](https://github.com/42wim/matterbridge).

[![actions status](https://github.com/Programie/MatterBukkit/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Programie/MatterBukkit/actions/workflows/build.yml)
[![download from GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/download-Releases-blue?logo=github)](https://github.com/Programie/MatterBukkit/releases/latest)
[![download from Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/badge/download-Modrinth-blue?logo=modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/mod/matterbukkit)
[![download from CurseForge](https://img.shields.io/badge/download-CurseForge-blue?logo=curseforge)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/bukkit-plugins/matterbukkit)

## Setup

First, install the plugin onto your Bukkit/Spigot/Paper server, and start it to generate [`config.yml`](src/main/resources/config.yml). Then, configure it:

- Set [`url`](src/main/resources/config.yml#L3) to the URL where you're running MatterBridge, with port 4242 or whatever you'd like to use (if you're running it on the same server, you can use `http://localhost:4242`).
- Set [`gateway`](src/main/resources/config.yml#L6) to the name of your MatterBridge gateway.
- Set a [`token`](src/main/resources/config.yml#L9) to secure the API. This is optional, but heavily recommended.
- Configure all other settings to your liking.

Add an API protocol and gateway to `matterbridge.toml`. Here is an example:

```toml
[api]
[api.minecraft]
Token="pasteTokenHere"
# Set BindAddress to "0.0.0.0:port" if your Minecraft server is running on a different server, and you're not using a reverse proxy
BindAddress="127.0.0.1:4242"
Buffer=1000
RemoteNickFormat="[{PROTOCOL}] {NICK}"

[[gateway.inout]]
account="api.minecraft"
channel="api"
```

Add any other protocols and gateways you would like to use, following [MatterBridge's documentation](https://github.com/42wim/matterbridge/wiki/How-to-create-your-config).

If necessary, open your desired port in your firewall, then start MatterBridge and restart your Minecraft server.

## Build

You can build the project in the following 2 steps:

 * Check out the repository
 * Build the jar file using maven: *mvn clean package*

**Note:** JDK 1.8 and Maven is required to build the project!

### Testing

You can start a local test server including a MatterBridge instance using Docker and Docker Compose. For that, use the [docker-compose.yml](docker-dev/docker-compose.yml) from the [docker-dev](docker-dev) folder.

Copy the target/MatterBukkit.jar to docker-dev/data/plugins and restart the Minecraft container.

## My other plugins

You can find them on [my website](https://selfcoders.com/projects/minecraft-plugins).

title: Kai Fixes Diorite
description: Makes diorite more usable as building blocks.
body:
As the name suggests, Kai Fixes Diorite improves the texture of diorite and polished diorite in Minecraft to make them more usable as building blocks. 
________________________________________________________________________________________________

This resource pack is a small part of a much larger resource pack being worked on called Kai Fixes Minecraft.

The concept behind what Kai Fixes Minecraft is bringing to the table is:
- Significantly reduce redundancies within the block textures

- Greatly increase the building opportunities from blocks that often get overlooked

- Reduce the unintentional texture repetition effect without heavy reliance on noise or random block variants by focusing on patterns that seamlessly splice together and proper shading

- Identify colors missing from the game and the best texture to go with that color while maintaining balance with what feels appropriate for the block in accordance with its fit in the game

- Maintain the highest quality of block textures in the Minecraft ecosystem

________________________________________________________________________________________________

Terms of Use

- Captain Kai is the creator and owner of this resource pack

title: blakebab
description:
modpack for blakebab sever.

Offers compatability of sodium, create & hephaestus.
body:
modpack for blakebab official server.
MIT license.

Normal methods of playing with create and tinker's construct tend to frustratingly lead to playing on older versions like 1.18.2, and offer lower framerates. Blakebab aims to maintain compatibility between these two mods primarily, along with sodium, for better stability. A large variety of patches and libraries are needed to maintain compatibility between create and hephaestus (port of tinker's construct), and blakebab aims to remove the burden of installing these patches, which are often hard to find and require scrounging discord support servers, by providing it in one easy to use modpack.

-Contains stability mods, worldgen mods such as terralith, nullscape, incendium, along with content mods Hephaestus and create

title: Adventurous!
description: optimizations, worldgen, and more, all in one!
body:
Adventurous! is a modpack primarily featuring, alongside the standard suite of optimization mods (because who wants to have to edit a modpack right out of the box?), lots of worldgen mods. 
Vanilla biomes and structures have been tweaked or completely overhauled, and lots of modded new biomes and structures have been added. The Nether and End have gotten a complete overhaul, and several new dimensions have been added on top of that. One of them is designed to be kind of a "secret surprise", so I'd recommend just creating a new world and trying it out, without looking through the mod list. Or don't, I can't stop you.  
I have also included lots of quality-of-life tweaks as I saw fit, and a few mods that I just honestly found funny (who doesn't want to be able to put your pants in the head slot?). 
Overall, this pack is designed to be a plug-and-play system for anyone who wants to get into modded minecraft that still mostly feels "vanilla." This pack is perfect for someone who has previously played mostly vanilla, or has transferred over from the Optifine community in search of better fps and feature customization.  
The one thing I haven't added much of is the Create-style technical progression. To be completely honest, it kind of scares me. I've added plenty of vanilla progression options to balance this out. 

There are a few issues and unwanted behavior that I've experienced, but for the most part it's small things that can be resolved with a bit of ironing out. I don't have any expectations that people will play this pack, but if you do, community feedback is the most valuable reward I get. If there's a feature or mod you're dying to see in this pack, feel free to request it. I'll do my best. 

Beta 1.1 does not support multiplayer, but the most recent version should. 

Screenshots are forthcoming! 

Due to the permissions set forth by some of the mod authors, please do not rehost this pack outside of Modrinth


All mods in this pack are available on Modrinth except for Liroth and More Villagers, which are available on Curseforge, linked below, and the Mobhead datapacks, which are from VanillaTweaks  
Please note that there are over 300, going on 400 mods in this pack. Once the libraries are fully expanded the number is more like 500. Optimization mods can only do so much, so it will take a bit longer to launch your game. Not much I can do about it unfortunately.

title: Serene Cyclopes Mod
description: This vanilla+ mod includes even MORE Cyclops variants, but this time, they are PEACEFUL!!! Although they are passive and do not fight back, they were designed specifically to have their own place in the Minecraft ecosystem. - MOD HAS BEEN MERGED
body:
This mod is intended to be used in addition to my [Savage Cyclopes Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/savage-cyclopes-mod), and is kept as a separate file because it has a slightly easier/simpler experience. However, this mod WILL work on its own, so feel free to use it with its companion, in a modpack, or as a standalone mod.  If you want a little more of a challenge, I recommend trying my [Savage Cyclopes Mod - Nether & End edition](https://modrinth.com/mod/savage-cyclopes-mod-nether-end-edition).

This mod adds several new features to the Savage Cyclopes Experience.

The **Mushroom Cyclops** is a new entity that spawns on the Mushroom Island.  You can shear it to get its Large Mushroom (elaborated on in the items section), and can bonemeal it to expedite   the mushroom's regrowth.  You can strike it with lightning to turn it into a Brown Mushroom Cyclops.

The **Cyclops Merchant** is similar to the wandering trader.  However, this creature's trades are **NOT COMPLETE RIP-OFF GARBAGE** which is actually the primary difference between this entity and the wanderiong trader (also this mob is EXTREMELY rare).

**Large Mushrooms** are a new Item that can be obtained by Shearing a Mushroom Cyclops (technically they are also obtainable by killing them, but the cyclopes are rare, and shearing them is renewable source).  They come in two variants, red and brown.  Large Red Mushrooms are obtainable by shearing Red Mushroom Cyclopes, and Large Brown Mushrooms are obtainable by breaking diamond ore with your fist. Just kidding.  They are obtained by shearing Brown Mushroom Cyclopes. Depending on the type, they have a small chance to give you Strength or Speed for a short duration.

**Gold-Infused Mushrooms** are crafted by surrounding a Large Mushroom in Gold Ingots (similar to a golden apple).  Depending on what mushroom they are crafted with, they can give Strength and Haste, or Resistance and Speed.

**Enchanted Golden Mushrooms** are crafted by combining a Gold-Infused red Mushroom and a Gold-Infused Brown Mushroom.  They give Strength, Speed, Haste, and Resistance.  They are similar to Enchanted Golden Apples, but are geared more towards offensive combat than defensive combat, as instead of Absorption and Regeneration, they give Strength and Speed.

**MORE FEATURES COMING SOON**

**THANK YOU**

I hope that you enjoy this mod, whether you play it alone ar with others, and whether you play it by itself or with other mods in a modpack.

Also: A lot of people have called me out on spelling "Cyclopes" wrong. I want to clarify that "Cyclops" with no "e" is a singular noun, and "Cyclopes" with an "e" is a plural noun.  **GOOGLE IT.**

# XehTascing
Some hexlink stuffs unrelated to spirits, now in a cool stand-alone mod! Waw!
Upgraded Spellbook, Special staff, mixed pigments, nbt patterns, snake staff, ...

/!\ There is duplicate content with 2.3.3 Hexlink and below. Use only Hexlink if you want both mods./!\

## Upgraded Book  ![upgraded_book_empty](https://github.com/Jempasam/Hexlink/assets/65395998/a00eaf0c-4561-480b-9fa1-9317acf1019a)
A better version of the spellbook:  

- He cast spell using the caster stack so you can add iotas on your stack as an input and he can can leave iotas on the stack as an output.
- You can cast a spell by right clicking with it
- He is colorable with color spirits.

## Special Staff
![spirits](https://github.com/Jempasam/Hexlink/blob/master/imgs/special_wand.gif?raw=true)
A programmable and colorable staff. Write a spell in it, then when you draw a pattern using it, the spell treat it and return your new stack. You can make a staff that cast the pattern and add it to a list at the bottom of the stack , a staff that don't call the pattern but instead draw it in the world using block, or a staff for writing a pattern to a scroll on wall you are looking just by drawing it per example.

## Mixed Pigment

body:
## Important note

Biome colors is a DataPack for version 1.21. There is no need to download forge or fabric. Just putting the Biome colors folder in your datapack folder should work for you.

## What's this mod?

“Biome Colors” is a data pack that is still in development and currently features five colors: Red, Blue, Green, Black, and White.

## What is the command I should use?

/fillbiome <from> <to> <biome>

## Example:

/fillbiome X0 Y200 Z0 X100 Y0 Z100 default:red

## How can I deactivate the block limit

To modify the limit you can use the following command:

/gamerule commandModificationBlockLimit <number>

title: Stack Furnace
description: The furnace mod that stack!
body:
Hello player, I'm glad you're interested in my mod. This is a creation I made because I really wanted an overpowered furnace mod, so here it is!

This mod, as incredible as it may not seem, goes beyond just a furnace. I have a path I want to follow but without spoilers.

**In case of bugs or suggestions, please feel free to let me know.**

# Features
- Furnace
- Stacked Amethyst Tank
- Stackstone
- Stackstone Tools
- Stack Transporter


# Explanations

### Furnace
It has 3 stages of upgrades, which are: Time, Multiplier, Fuel.Out of the 3, only the multiplier increases.

For maximum time reduction, you need 65 furnaces.
For maximum multiplier increase, you need 6,464 furnaces.
For maximum fuel usage reduction, you need 12,800,000 furnaces.

The furnace comes with a visualization of its information, so don't worry about that.

To stack the furnaces, simply click to place one next to another (Yes, it will disappear!), a message will appear in your toolbar, indicating that the upgrade has been made. Also, if you have more than one furnace in your hand and hold shift to place them, it will insert all at once.

**Auto Input Fuel (AIF)** It's a mode that uses any item that can be used as fuel, as fuel. This can be useful if you only want to put any item into a hopper in the furnace.

If you don't want to use the AIF, I recommend using lava.


### Stacked Amethyst Tank
This is still a very new feature; I still have future plans for it.

It's a lava tank, made with stacked amethyst. When activated with redstone, it allows you to send lava to the block in front of it, if the block accepts it.


### Stackstone
I still have a future use for it; just one use in this case.

A ugly stone, made from pieces of Stack Furnace. You can use this stone to make tools and the stack transporter.


### Stackstone Tools
Standard Minecraft tools (Pickaxe, Axe, etc.), even though they are made of stone (Stackstone), still have the properties of iron tools.


### Stack Transporter
An item that allows you to carry your furnace (And Stackstone block) wherever you want, including a way to place two furnaces side by side without stacking them.
