title: Forbidden Library
description: A datapack adding a collection of custom enchantments.
body:
# The library of forbidden enchantments...
![head_image_presentation_v2](https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/85f44kt0nnbn9mpxw2g19/forbidden_library_title.png?rlkey=9764ss4mfz25ayjyq5ddswxi2&st=orvea8ik&dl=1)
Forbidden Library is a datapack/mod that adds a curated collection of original custom enchantments designed to expand gameplay, without sticking to a single theme.

Enchantments may affect weapons, tools, shields, projectiles, or TNT, and are all available directly from the enchanting table.

This datapack/mod is designed for both singleplayer and multiplayer worlds and aims to feel balanced within a survival environment.

In datapack version there is a value file in function root you can change some value if you want to.

### ⚠ WARNING ⚠
- For Fabric version [FabricAPI](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) is needed.
- For the datapack version a resource pack is needed.
- Some enchantments for flint and steel or shields must be obtained through enchanted books and 
cannot be applied directly to the item in enchanting table.
- Datapack and mod are only translated in english and french.

<details>
<summary>List of enchantments</summary>

### Desert Marauder
- Max level : 1
- Support : Boots
- Description : Increases movement speed and reduces fall damage while in hot biomes such as deserts and badlands. Mutually exclusive with Icy Breeze.


### Icy Breeze
- Max level : 1
- Support : Boots
- Description : Increases movement speed, reduces fall damage, and improves movement efficiency in cold and icy biomes. Cannot be combined with Desert Marauder.


### Tuff Enough
- Max level : 5
- Support : Armor pieces
- Description : Increases the player’s maximum health by half a heart per enchantment level.


### Marathon
- Max level : 4
- Support : Leggings and boots
- Description : Increases the player’s movement speed.


### Lightness
- Max level : 3
- Support : Bows, Crossbows and Trident
- Description : After firing, projectiles briefly remaining silent and suspended in the air before returning to normal behavior.


### Quick Fuse
- Max level : 3
- Support : Flint and steel
- Description : Reduces the explosion delay of TNT. Cannot be combined with Visco Fuse.


### Visco Fuse
- Max level : 3
- Support : Flint and steel
- Description : Increases the explosion delay of TNT. Cannot be combined with Quick Fuse.


### Detonation
- Max level : 5
- Support : Flint and steel
- Description : Causes TNT to split into multiple explosions when it detonates, depending on the enchantment level.


### Vaccinator
- Max level : 1
- Support : Shields
- Description : Holding a shield removes negative status effects at the cost of increased shield durability loss. Durability penalty is reduced when the shield has Unbreaking.


### Tactical Reload
- Max level : 3
- Support : Crossbows
- Description : When firing a crossbow, grants a chance to instantly reload it with an arrow. Higher enchantment levels increase the chance.


### Gossamer
- Max level : 1
- Support : Bows
- Description : Arrows create web-based traps by connecting to the nearest entity on impact, ensnaring the target in cobwebs. Applies an additional bow durability cost, reduced by Unbreaking.


### Silken Step
- Max level : 3
- Support : Swords
- Description : Entities trapped in cobwebs take bonus true damage that ignores armor when struck. This effect limits the weapon’s base attack damage to a single point. Cannot be applied with sharpness and other damage-boosting enchantments.


### Grounded
- Max level : 1
- Support : Tridents
- Description : Useless without Loyalty. Forces the trident to return even while still in mid-air. If the trident falls too low in the world, it is forcefully recalled. Does not activate if the player throws the trident while sneaking.


### Grand Finale
- Max level : 3
- Support : Flint and Steel
- Description : Increases the explosion power of TNT.


### Refuge
- Max level : 3
- Support : Shields
- Description : When the holder’s health drops below 2 hearts, grants an Absorption effect based on the enchantment level. Does not activate if the player already has Absorption. Damages the shield; durability loss is reduced by Unbreaking.


### Shockproof
- Max level : 4
- Support : Armor pieces
- Description : Increases knockback resistance and reduces lightning damage.


### Poise
- Max level : 4
- Support : Swords and Trident
- Description : Slightly increases attack reach. Jumping doubles the reach bonus and reduces the attack cooldown between sword strikes.


### Tidal Wave
- Max level : 4
- Support : Trident
- Description : While airborne, hitting an entity propels the player based on movement direction. Sneak-hitting applies additional knockback to the target. Throwing the trident in water and hitting a target launches the player strongly forward.


</details>

title: Custom Team Manager
description: Create and manage your teams as an admin
body:
# English

## Menu
With the command ```/trigger ctm_menu``` you can open the menu

### Join
All teams are listed. Just click on the team you want to join

### Leave
Uh yeah you leave the team

### AFK
You join in the AFK team. When you change your rotation, you either join your team you was before or just the AFK team.

## Menu for admins
### Add
Click on a color for suggesting you the command in the chat.
Fill the other 3 arguments.
```
/function ctm:manage/add/add_team {id:"", name:"", color:"color", trigger:""}
```

### Remove
Select one team, you will get suggested a command for deleting it

### Edit
You can edit following arguments:
- name (and the color)
- suffix (and the color)
- player color
- trigger

You cannot edit the id. For that you have to delete and recreate it.



<details>
<summary>Version 1.0.0</summary>

## Menu
The command opens the menu.
You can execute it by clicking on the respective text.


```
/trigger customteammanager_menu
```
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4e613b4cc18da4ddcefbfaddd0f763f74762902d_0.webp)

## Join
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1a8c63f0ca2801b30d49ef7f82453e4ce0abe041_0.webp)

The teams that have been created are listed, and you can join the respective team by clicking on it again.

## Leave
You can only leave your current team by clicking on “Leave current team.”

## Add team
Only admins can create a team.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/673011d1e87c5618ffd7ff45346aa1f3d3c68b30_0.webp)

You can click on the template and the /function will be suggested, where you only need to insert the information in the curly brackets.

**It is important not to use the same trigger value, as this could lead to confusion in the “code”.**

A suffix is created for this purpose -> [<name>] This is displayed after the name.

## Remove team
Click on the template and then enter the ID of the team you want to delete.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1c842d00bc3c92c6d4c025062f6816b17b70894a_0.webp)

<details>
<summary>In the future</summary>

I still plan to add a feature that allows users to edit teams so that they don't have to delete them just because they made a mistake.

I also plan to add a feature that allows users to edit the suffix.

</details>

</details>

title: Lattice
description: The Minecraft side of Lattice — local couch co-op where each player uses their own keyboard and mouse in their own instance. Requires Lattice Weaver.
body:
# Lattice **Local couch co-op for Minecraft Java.** Run multiple Minecraft instances on one Windows PC and give each local player their own keyboard, mouse, cursor, HUD, and settings profile. Lattice is the **Minecraft adapter** for **Lattice Weaver**, the Windows companion app that handles guided device setup and player-slot routing.

Download Weaver  |  Latest Release  |  Buy License  |  Support

---

## What It Does Lattice lets several people share one Windows PC and play Minecraft at the same time, each in their own instance with their **own keyboard and mouse**. - **Separate controls per player** - P1+ keyboards and mice are routed to their assigned Minecraft instances. - **P0 stays native** - the main player keeps normal Windows control for launchers, setup, and desktop use. - **Slot-aware HUD and cursors** - see each player's connection/routing state in-game. - **P0 master settings** - Player 0 can manage routed players' audio, video, resource packs, profiles, and selected mod config values. - **Lockable settings** - force settings on routed-player instances where supported. - **Profile-aware setup** - per-instance options and controls can be saved and restored. - **Multi-instance friendly** - designed for launchers such as MultiMC/Prism-style instance folders.

## Setup Summary 1. Install **Fabric Loader** for the Minecraft version you want to run. 2. Install **Fabric API**. Install **Mod Menu** if you want the in-game config entry. 3. Put the matching Lattice jar in each instance's `mods` folder. 4. Download and run **Lattice Weaver** from [files.bide.cx](https://files.bide.cx/). 5. Use Weaver's guided setup to choose P0 native devices and P1+ routed devices. 6. Assign each Minecraft instance a player slot through Weaver's launcher setup tools or JVM args. 7. Start Weaver, then launch the Minecraft instances. Example JVM args if setting slots manually: ```text -Dlattice.player=0 # Player 1 / P0 -Dlattice.player=1 # Player 2 / P1 -Dlattice.player=2 # Player 3 / P2 ``` ## Supported Minecraft Versions Lattice currently supports Fabric-based Minecraft versions from **1.20 through 26.1.2**. Use the file whose name matches your target compatibility range: | Minecraft version | Lattice file range | | --- | --- | | `1.20` | `1.20` | | `1.20.1` - `1.20.6` | `1.20.1-1.20.6` | | `1.21` - `1.21.4` | `1.21-1.21.4` | | `1.21.5` | `1.21.5` | | `1.21.6` - `1.21.8` | `1.21.6-1.21.8` | | `1.21.9` - `1.21.11` | `1.21.9-1.21.11` | | `26.1` - `26.1.2` | `26.1-26.1.2` | ## Master Controls

From the P0 configuration screen, Lattice can stage and push supported settings to routed-player instances. Current control areas include: - Lattice HUD and cursor options. - Vanilla audio settings. - Vanilla video settings. - Resource-pack copy, enable, disable, and lock controls. - Per-slot profile selection. - Selected mod config files where compatible. Some settings vary by Minecraft version or by the target mod's config format, so the control surface may differ slightly between instances. ## Lattice Weaver Companion

This mod requires **Lattice Weaver**. title: DurabilityInfo
description: See your item's durability in the tooltip — numbers, percentage, and a color-coded bar.
body:
Welcome to DurabilityInfo — the mod that shows your item durability exactly where you need it.

Simply put your cursor over any tool, weapon, or piece of armor and you will instantly see exactly how much life it has left. In numbers, percentage, or a color-coded bar — you decide which parts to see.

---

## Features

### 📊 Tooltip Display
Every damageable item gets extra information added directly to its tooltip:

• **Durability Numbers** — shows the exact remaining durability (e.g. `Durability: 235 / 500`)
• **Percentage** — displays a clean percentage (e.g. `Durability: 47%`)
• **Color Bar** — a visual bar that changes from green → yellow → red as durability decreases

Each of these three elements can be turned on or off independently. You can show just the numbers, just the percentage, just the bar, or any combination.

![In-Game Screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Cukkoo12/durabilityinfo/master/screenshots/ingame.png)

### 🖥️ Heads-Up Display (HUD)
An always-visible durability display on your screen that tracks everything you are wearing and holding:

| Position | Item | What It Shows |
|----------|------|---------------|
| 1 | Helmet | Durability bar + icon |
| 2 | Chestplate | Durability bar + icon |
| 3 | Leggings | Durability bar + icon |
| 4 | Boots | Durability bar + icon |
| 5 | Main Hand | Durability bar + icon |
| 6 | Offhand | Durability bar + icon |

Each item is shown as a small icon with a colored bar underneath. The bar shrinks as durability drops and changes color — green when healthy, yellow when worn, red when almost broken.

**Customize the HUD:**
• Move it to any corner (Top-Left, Top-Right, Bottom-Left, Bottom-Right)
• Adjust its position with X and Y pixel offsets
• Switch between Bar mode or Percentage text mode
• A semi-transparent background keeps it readable on any terrain

### ⚠️ Low Durability Warning
No more sudden breakage. When any equipped item falls below your chosen durability threshold:

• The bar starts **flashing bright red** to catch your attention immediately
• A **warning sound** plays (the item break sound) so you hear it even while fighting or mining
• The sound has a 2-second cooldown — it warns you without becoming annoying
• The threshold is fully adjustable — set it to 5% for a late warning, 20% for early notice, or whatever feels right to you

### 🔧 Damage-Dealt Mode
Prefer to see how much you have used an item instead of how much is left? Toggle *showDamageDealt* on, and the HUD will display the amount of damage your item has taken. This is especially useful for players who think in terms of "this pickaxe has 500 uses left" versus "this pickaxe has been used 150 times."

![Configuration Options](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Cukkoo12/durabilityinfo/master/screenshots/config.png)

---

## Configuration

### In-Game (Recommended)
If you have **Mod Menu** and **Cloth Config** installed, just open the Mods menu, find DurabilityInfo, and click the gear icon. All settings can be changed from there.

### Config File
Located at `.minecraft/config/durabilityinfo.json`. You can edit it manually.

**Tooltip Settings:**
| Setting | Default | Description |
|---------|---------|-------------|
| showDurabilityNumbers | true | Shows remaining durability as a fraction |
| showPercentage | true | Shows durability as a percentage |
| showBar | true | Shows a colored bar |
| showOnUnbreakable | false | Also show info on unbreakable items |

**HUD Settings:**
| Setting | Default | Description |
|---------|---------|-------------|
| warningThreshold | 10 | Percentage at which the warning activates |
| hudAnchor | BOTTOM_RIGHT | Screen corner for the HUD |
| hudOffsetX | 4 | Horizontal offset from the edge |
| hudOffsetY | 4 | Vertical offset from the edge |
| hudDisplayMode | BAR | Switch between BAR and PERCENTAGE view |
| showDamageDealt | false | Show damage taken instead of remaining |

---

## Requirements

- **Minecraft 26.1.x** (any sub-version)
- **Fabric Loader** 0.18.5 or newer
- **Fabric API** (any recent version)

## Optional (Recommended)

- **Mod Menu** — browse and configure your mods
- **Cloth Config** — provides the configuration screen

Both are free and available on Modrinth and CurseForge.

---

title: Beautiful Day Counter
description: Never lose track of time again! A vanilla-friendly HUD with a clock, day counter, and a beautiful dynamic 24h bossbar.
body:
# 🌅 Beautiful Day Counter

---

## 📝 About
Ever lose track of time while mining deep underground or building your next mega-base? **Beautiful Day Counter** is a lightweight, client-side mod that adds a sleek, vanilla-friendly HUD to the top of your screen. 

Keep yourself perfectly synced with the Minecraft world without ever needing to craft a clock again. With **Beautiful Day Counter**, you'll always know exactly when to head back to safety.

---

## ✨ Main Features

* **🕒 Beautiful Day Counter Clock:** Displays the precise in-game time in **HH:MM** format.
* **📅 Beautiful Day Counter Day Tracker:** Automatically tracks and displays how many days you have survived in your world.
* **🟦 Beautiful Day Counter 24h Bossbar:** An elegant progress bar that fills as the day passes. Midnight is 0%, noon is 50%, and sunset warns you to get to bed!
* **🌈 Beautiful Day Counter Smooth Transitions (v1.1):** Experience fluid, per-second color fading. The **Beautiful Day Counter** bar shifts beautifully between:
    * 🟡 **Dawn (Yellow)**
    * 🔵 **Day (Blue)**
    * 🌸 **Sunset (Pink)**
    * 🟣 **Night (Purple)**
* **⚔️ Beautiful Day Counter Dynamic Icons:** The HUD icon automatically updates based on your gamemode:
    * *Survival Heart | Hardcore Heart | Creative Grass Block | Adventure Sword | Spectator Eye.*
* **🧩 Beautiful Day Counter Smart UI:** Designed for seamless vanilla integration. **Beautiful Day Counter** automatically pushes down to make room for bossbars (like the Ender Dragon or Wither), preventing any UI overlapping.
* **📸 Beautiful Day Counter Stealth Mode:** Fully respects **F1** (Hide HUD) and **F3** (Debug) modes for clean, professional screenshots.

---

## ⚙️ Technical Details

| Feature | Info |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Mod Loader** | **Fabric** |
| **Game Versions** | **1.21.x** (Optimized for 1.21.2 and newer) |
| **Side** | **Client-Side Only** (Works on any vanilla server!) |

---

## ❗️ Requirements
To run **Beautiful Day Counter**, you must have the following installed:
* **Fabric Loader**
* **Fabric API**

---

## 👾 Bugs & Feedback
Please report any issues or bugs through:
* **GitHub Issues** page
* **Modrinth / CurseForge** comments section

Your feedback is essential to keeping **Beautiful Day Counter** the best time-tracking mod for Minecraft!

#

GainExpDisplay

## A lightweight Minecraft plugin that shows useful feedback in the action bar whenever you gain experience or when items are repaired by **Mending**. ## ✨ Features - Displays XP gained directly in the action bar - Shows Mending repair amount and durability progress - Fully customizable messages using MiniMessage - 7 languages supported - Lightweight and performance-friendly
📸 Showcase - **XP Gained** ![Gaining XP](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e1980b2fd3375d78be801b417ac189cf309616db.png) - **Mending Repair** ![Mending Repair](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4d0413ecf810d9a9bedac8b0fc6b99a30e8c19c9.png)
## ⚙️ Configuration - Permission requirement and messages toggle are fully configurable in ```config.yml```. - All messages are fully customizable in **translation files** using [MiniMessage](https://docs.papermc.io/adventure/minimessage/format/#standard-tags) format. ```yaml # Configuration version, DO NOT MODIFY THIS VALUE! config-version: 3.0.0 ###################################################### # Language # ###################################################### # Language setting (available: en_US, es_ES, de_DE, fr_FR, zh_CN, ja_JP, th_TH) # If the specified language file is missing, it will fall back to en_US. lang: en_US # Adding custom language # 1. Create a new file in the translations directory # 2. Use en_US.yml as a template # 3. Modify the file as needed # 4. Set language to your custom language file name ###################################################### # Permissions # ###################################################### # When set to true, players require permissions to see any message. # This setting applies globally to all message types. # See below for a list of permissions. require-permission: false # Permissions for displaying messages: # # gainexpdisplay.gainexp - Display text when gaining experience # gainexpdisplay.mending - Display text when repairing items with Mending ###################################################### # Settings # ###################################################### # When set to true, players will see text when gaining exp. gain-xp: enabled: true # When set to true, players will see text when repairing items with Mending. mending-repair: enabled: true ``` ## 📚 Command & Permissions - Command | Command | Permission | Description | | ----------------- | --------------------------- | ------------------- | | ```/ged reload``` | ```gainexpdisplay.reload``` | Reload config file. | - Permissions | Permission | Description | Default | | ---------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- | ---------- | | ```gainexpdisplay.gainxp``` | Display text when gaining experience. | ```true``` | | ```gainexpdisplay.mending``` | Display text when repairing items with Mending. | ```true``` |

title: SCP-153-D | The Impaler's Thumb
description: A finger of an ancient ruler that makes its owner animalistic and territorial.
body:
![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_b1d82adc-62e4-415c-8dcd-fcafb8f86530.png) *** **The Impaler's Thumb** mod adds __five new items__ _(SCP, documentation, label and more...),_ __one structure__, __seven new blocks__ and __50+ events__ to the game. The mod is heavily inspired by **SCP-153-D** from the **SCP Foundation Universe**. **SCP-153-D** is an old finger, lost among rubbish, said to have belonged to an ancient ruler. Anyone who handles it will become animalistic and territorial. **●** **Mod** __made by__ : TheCaptainFoxy (me) ● __Mod created with__ MCreator ● Join __my discord__ for __support/question/suggestions/sneak-peaks__ and more! _TCF Discord_ **●** Mod inspired by zcoper's mods         __FAQ__ 
Spoiler

 ► Where can I find the mod content?

SCP-153-D, its documentation, its label and all the new blocks can only be found inside the SCP-153-D containment chamber structure.

The foundation's landfill center

 

► Where does the structure spawn?

The structure spawns in every overworld biome at surface level, with approximately one structure every 3,000 blocks.

 

You can find it using /locate command

 

► How can I place the document?

Right-click to read the document.  
Shift + right-click to place it.

  *** ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_7e07df3d-9bf2-48f6-b185-3a9a9fdff401.png) *** ![SCP-153-D](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/807cf951b4adc5a2345070545350f1a713f13d8b.png)

SCP-153-D | The Impaler's Thumb

*** **SCP-153-D** is an old finger, lost among rubbish, said to have belonged to an ancient ruler. **Anyone who handles it will become animalistic and territorial.** Anyone coming into physical contact with **SCP-153-D** will become **extremely territorial** and **aggressive** towards anyone from outside its territory. The owner of **SCP-153-D** will recognize their __spawn point__ or __sleeping location__ as their "**territory**". Any entity whose **own spawn point** or **sleeping location** is more than **200 blocks away** from the __owner’s territory__ will be **attacked on sight** and automatically by the owner, as long as they are holding **The Impaler’s Thumb**.  

_There is also a chance that the owner of **SCP-153-D** will express __angry thoughts__ or phrases __in chat__ or in the action bar._

  Any entity that comes into contact with **SCP-153-D** will enter a territorial state, becoming highly defensive and __periodically expressing patriotic or possessive sentiments__. Any player who has **SCP-153-D** in their inventory will become __extremely possessive and attached to it__. As a result, they will be **unable to drop the item**.  

_The player may also express their refusal or dissatisfaction through messages._

  If someone wants to __take__ **SCP-153-D** from __another player__, they must wait until the owner is __holding it in their hand__. While the item is being held, another player can **right-click the owner with an empty hand** to steal it. **SCP-153-D** can be placed by **right-clicking** on a block. It can be picked up again by **right-clicking** on the placed finger.   _**The Impaler's Thumb** is compatible with **every** mod._ ***   __Show all content__  
Spoiler

 

 

 

SCP-153-D Wrapped in Flax Cloth

SCP-153-D is first found wrapped in flax.

While wrapped in flax, SCP-153-D has no effects on the player holding it or carrying it in their inventory, allowing it to be moved safely.

Placing the flax-wrapped SCP-153-D on a block and right-clicking it will remove the flax.

 

Antique Flax Cloth

The Antique Flax Cloth is given to the player when the flax is removed from a SCP-153-D In Flax.

Shift + Right-clicking a placed SCP-153-D on the ground with the Antique Flax Cloth will rewrap it in flax.

The Antique Flax Cloth can also be found in Garbage Treasure.

Garbage & Garbage Treasure

In the structure, players may encounter Garbage and Garbage Treasure blocks.

At first glance, they look identical. Right-clicking allows you to inspect these piles of trash.

Garbage will never yield any items.

Garbage Treasure can be searched up to three times, with a chance to find various items, ranging from less useful items like dyes or bones to more valuable items like golden apples. After the third search, the Garbage Treasure block is destroyed.

   

Pitch Black Ash & Other Versions

Various types of Pitch Black Ash are another block that can be found in the structure.

The Pitch Black Ash is the result of incinerations and hydraulic presses, and they may contain important remnants.

As noted in the Trash Document, Dr. Kondraki threw SCP-153-D into the garbage, where it eventually ended up in a pile of ash.

Breaking the different Pitch Black Ash blocks will yield essential SCP items.

At first glance, all versions look identical, but:

Pitch Black Ash (Base) will drop nothing.

Pitch Black Ash with Label will drop the SCP-153-D label.

Pitch Black Ash with Document will drop the SCP-153-D descriptive document.

Pitch Black Ash with SCP-153-D will drop SCP-153-D wrapped in flax.

   

SCP-153-D Containment Chamber

SCP-153-D can only be found inside the SCP-153-D Containment Chamber/Cell.

 Landfill Center of the Foundation

The structure spawns in any Overworld biome at surface level and is rare. 

  

SCP-153-D Documents & SCP-153-D Label

The SCP-153-D documentation can be found inside the SCP-153-D Containment Chamber together with the pitch black ash block versions and the two garbages blocks.


The documents are readable, while the label provides information about the SCP’s classification and risk level.

The Trash Document describes how SCP-153-D was lost in the garbage.

As mentioned earlier, the label and document must be found among the Pitch Black Ash blocks.

title: Vanilla Journeys +
description: This Modpack is a spiritual successor to my Vanilla Adventures +, However with this one I intend to keep the core mechanics as Vanilla as possible.
body:
## What is the goal of this modpack?  
**The goal is to keep the classic Vanilla Minecraft feel while introducing meaningful improvements that enhance immersion and gameplay. The core mechanics remain unchanged, but with better world generation, enhanced sounds, and subtle tweaks, the world feels more alive.**

## How does this improve upon the Vanilla Minecraft feel?  

**This modpack primarily improves upon Vanilla Minecraft through improving world generation and introducing new structures that blend seamlessly into the game. Through these changes minecraft is given richer feel:**
- [**Incendium**](https://modrinth.com/datapack/incendium) - _Enhances Nether biomes and structures_
- [**Enderscape**](https://modrinth.com/mod/enderscape) - _Complete End Overhaul_ **(1.2.0+)**
- [**Nullscape**](https://modrinth.com/datapack/nullscape) - _End World Gen rework_ **(1.0.01-)**
- [**Structory**](https://modrinth.com/datapack/structory) - _Adds new villages_
- [**Tectonic**](https://modrinth.com/datapack/tectonic) - _Overhauls terrain generation_
- [**Terralith**](https://modrinth.com/mod/terralith) - _Adds new biomes and structures_
- [**Tidal Towns**](https://modrinth.com/datapack/tidal-towns) - _Introduces coastal villages_  
##
**Beyond terrain, the world has better immersion from new sound design, improved visual effects. and more. These details help make exploration dynamic and engaging:**
- [**AmbientSounds**](https://modrinth.com/mod/ambientsounds) - _Adds nature sounds_
- [**Cave Dust**](https://modrinth.com/mod/cave-dust) - _Introduces dust in caves_
- [**Cool Rain**](https://modrinth.com/mod/coolrain) - _Improves rain audio_

- [**More Mobs**](https://modrinth.com/datapack/more-mobs) - _Introduces new mob variants_

- [**Spawn Animations**](https://modrinth.com/datapack/spawn-animations) - _Creates mob spawn effects_
- [**Visuality**](https://modrinth.com/mod/visuality) - _Adds subtle particle effects_
##
**This modpack also introduces new items and mechanics into the game that allow more personalization to your gear:**
- [**Enchancement**](https://modrinth.com/mod/enchancement) - _Revamps and adds to enchanting system_
- [**Lootr**](https://modrinth.com/mod/lootr) - _Instanced loot for players_
- [**Soul Fire'd**](https://modrinth.com/mod/soul-fire-d) - _Expands soul fire mechanics_
- [**Soul Link**](https://modrinth.com/datapack/soul-link) - _Prevents gear loss_
- [**Tool Trims +**](https://modrinth.com/datapack/tool-trims) [**Elytra Trims**](https://modrinth.com/mod/elytra-trims) - _Enhances item customization_
- [**Waystones**](https://modrinth.com/mod/waystones) - _Enables fast travel_
##
**A few small tweaks make managing inventory and gameplay more intuitive, reducing frustration and making everything flow smoother:**
- [**Detail Armor Bar**](https://modrinth.com/mod/detail-armor-bar) - _Displays armor durability_
- [**InvMove**](https://modrinth.com/mod/invmove) - _Allows movement in inventory_
- [**Mouse Tweaks**](https://modrinth.com/mod/mouse-tweaks) - _Improves inventory controls_
##
**Some additional mods that enhance the experience in subtle and intuitive ways:**
- [**Advancement Plaques**](https://modrinth.com/mod/advancement-plaques) - _Visual effects for advancements_
- [**Explorer’s Compass**](https://modrinth.com/mod/explorers-compass) - _Helps locate biomes and structures_
- [**Shulker Box Tooltip**](https://modrinth.com/mod/shulkerboxtooltip) - _Displays contents of Shulker Boxes_

- [**Trade Cycling**](https://modrinth.com/mod/trade-cycling) - _Allows cycling through villager trades_
##
**With all of this there is also a few Resource Packs introduced as well that you may know:**

Have you ever thought: What if Mojang added dragons to the game?

This mod adds dragons to Minecraft without making them feel out of place

⚔️ What is Weapon of God?
Weapon of God is a supernatural sword that doesn’t just deal heavy damage — it unleashes an epic visual ban effect, complete with lightning strikes, particle rings, explosions that destroy blocks, and a powerful sound effect to complete the experience.

✨ Features--->
1. 🗡️ Deals 12 damage – stronger than Netherite!

2. ⛓️ "Binding" effect triggers just before a final blow

3. ⚡ Summons lightning on the target when finishing them

4. 💥 Explosion that destroys blocks (real explosion, not just visual)

5. 🌀 Particle rings (CHAIN particles) represent divine power

6. 🔊 Unique sound effect when the final hit lands

7. 🚫 Visual ban for players – not a real disconnect, but a full visual sequence

8. 🐄 Also works on any entity – useful for testing the effects

9. ✅ Compatible with Essential Mod – works perfectly in multiplayer

10. 🌈 Purple item name – styled like a Nether Star
-----------------------
🧪 How it works --->
Hold the Judgement Blade in your hand.

Hit a player or entity.

When your target is about to die:

They're frozen in place (binding effect)

A lightning strike hits them

A destructive explosion goes off

Sound and particles trigger around them

A visual "ban" effect plays
-----------------------
📦 Installation
Install Fabric Loader 1.20.1

Install the Fabric API

(Optional) Install the Essential Mod for multiplayer compatibility

Drop the mod .jar file into your mods folder

Launch Minecraft and enjoy divine power
-----------------------
🎯 Who is it for?
This mod is perfect for:

Creative players

Server admins who want an epic admin weapon

Modpack creators looking to add divine tools

Anyone who loves cool particles and effects



 

How to get it ingame:
/give (Player) weaponofgod:judgement_blade

title: Quick Builder Pack
description: The Quick Builder Pack helps you create Minecraft maps faster while maintaining the vanilla experience, with tools and mods for all skill levels
body:
## Intro : This modpack was created to meet a personal need: a clean, fast, and optimized Minecraft environment. Specifically designed for a seamless gameplay experience, it does not add any blocks or items that could disrupt existing worlds or corrupt created structures. The goal was to maintain a pack that integrates perfectly with Vanilla gameplay while offering useful features to improve performance, entity management, and visual comfort. ### What Sets It Apart? All the mods included in this collection are centered around enhancing the Vanilla experience without altering the core of the game. The idea was to create a modular, stable, and fast environment by focusing on elements that truly add something valuable to the game, such as entity management, texture improvements, and performance optimizations. Each mod in this pack was chosen specifically for its ability to enrich the gameplay experience without radically changing Minecraft’s structure. There are subtle yet powerful improvements: better memory management, visual optimizations, and additions that make building and exploring more enjoyable. The goal is to provide a smooth and optimized experience for players, with mods like Sodium for performance, Clumps for XP management, or Better Villages to bring more life to villages, all while preserving Minecraft’s essence. This modpack was designed for those who want an efficient gaming experience, where performance meets simplicity, and every mod has a place. This is, in my opinion, what Minecraft Java Edition should be by default. ## Partners : This project is proudly supported by BisectHosting. Check out their services to easily host your projects with quality and reliability.

## Call to Action : Have questions? Need help? Join us on Discord or visit our GitHub to get involved with the community and contribute!

title: Life Potato
description: This datapack makes Poisonous Potatoes useful for the Player. When eaten, it grants an extra heart, up to a maximum of 20 hearts.
body: # Life Potato Poisonous Potatoes are no longer useless! With this datapack, eating a Poisonous Potato will permanently increase your max health by 1 heart (2 HP), allowing you to reach a maximum of 20 hearts. ## Installation ### Datapack 1. Download the Datapack. 2. Copy the .zip file into the datapacks folder which is located under `%APPDATA%\.minecraft\saves\\datapacks` (under Windows). Replace correspondingly. 3. Reload the World or run the `/reload` command. ### Mod 1. Download the Mod. 2. Copy the downloaded `.jar` file into the mods folder which is located under `%APPDATA%\.minecraft\mods` (under Windows). 3. Reload the World or run the `/reload` command.

title: Discord integration Luckperms
description: Combining Discord roles and Luckperms groups
body:
This modification is a fork of [DiscordLoom](https://modrinth.com/mod/discordloom) created by [Dreaming Codes](https://modrinth.com/user/Dreaming-Codes)

This version was created only for 1.20.1 no updates and new versions are planned.
You can contact **luciferrium** in Discord to create the version you need.


![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f2a6ea266b6c8e39ca5b48d16ac1124d797cfb3c.png)

The mod allows you to fully synchronise Discord and Minecraft server based on the Luckperms permissions modification.

What a mod can do:
1. Synchronisation of Discord roles with Luckperms groups
2. change Discord username to the name specified in Minecraft
3. By enabling the function: mandatoryVCChannels = [] specifying in it the id of the voice chat of your server, for example mandatoryVCChannels = [‘435457687658665856856’], then players will be able to log in to the server and play on it while they are online in this voice chat.

The mod is fully tested on the following modpacks:
1. Forge - Craft to Exile 2
2. Fabric - Prominence II

Work with other mods and modpacks may not be stable.

Instructions for proper installation:


<details>
<summary>1. Bot creation</summary>

You need to go to [https://discord.com/developers/applications/](https://discord.com/developers/applications/)
Click on the New application button
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/71cb8e36fb0b4d9beefba43749f52439f412e617.png)
Come up with a name for the bot
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/877ac5a9f44ce9c119e7d1f92e47cada8b53ef87.png)
The bot configuration menu will open, you need to go to the OAuth2 section
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3c3d3d87c90cf68282d1799ae49615ae221bae68.png)
Get Client Id and Client Secret
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/808e06ade5ce7abc2eb3f3cfd6c5e2d9578dea90.png)
The following link should be added to the Redirects line: **http://localhost:8000/callback**
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/726bfc5820c317548dbcaad7c4c9487efddfbac8.png)
Generate a link to the bot invitation by setting the Bot and Administrator parameters
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4bc369af4b1a4791e814c5a908de88d8642674e4.png)
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3ca19a6ba0890c261263e8e38c25b212b12591b5.png)
Then go to the Bot tab and set the parameters as shown on the image
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/94afe2adb9639c3844df466f96ea8b340f4cc683.png)
Congratulations! You have successfully created and added a bot to your Discord server. Now let's move on to the next step.

</details>




<details>
<summary>2. Installing the mod on the server, setting the configuration, configuring Luckperms</summary>


After you download the mod, add it to your server and try to run it, you will get an error. This means that the configuration has been created and it needs to be configured.

Go to the path config/discordloom-common.toml

Open this file with any text editor and start filling it in.
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1ccfd1c3f521038be0fab981b54d9b5e15fd3c21.png)

The checkForGuildsOnJoin parameter is the id of your Discord community, to get it you must be an administrator of the community, click the community icon and click Copy Server ID.
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f8e894756323eb617ad5047e140c97a46a3e9520.png)

Don't forget to set the role created by the bot to the first role in the list of server roles.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6cd60fa0679cb27c89d7aee7c516bbcfd83ebaec.png)

After filling out the configuration file, if you have entered all the parameters correctly, the mod will allow you to start the server. After the first login to the server, you will be prompted to link your Discord account and Minecraft account.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/69f42b82e5c9da4626b358d0e1f5e63c5373aaa1.png)

You will see a window where you need to allow the bot to manage your usernames on the server and synchronise your accounts

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dfa40e30f6b3cec2bbcea39c8c92f17d5d096f1e_0.webp)

Now your Discord name will become the same as in Minecraft, and Luckperms will give all groups matching Discord.

Now I will briefly tell you how to create a Luckperms group that will match Discord.

To do this in the server console type lp editor and open the graphical editor on the link given to you.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6ad29507ca273438fa189e4193e9319702828d50.png)

Click the + next to the Group button.

In the window that appears, you need to type discordloom:idrolediscord in the group name.

To get idrolediscord you need to click on the role you created and click Copy role id. 
Your group name in Luckperms should look like this: discordloom:3948293850239502395023509.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0c98e06e870966a09e91f6af66f4899418b7270f.png)

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/38347f92f563abc973b0e0bc9fb436a42efd6103.png)

That's it, you have successfully integrated your Discord with your Minecraft server. If you still have any questions or need help, join my Discord community: [https://minecraft.press/](https://minecraft.press/)

</details>

title: Better Server Packs
description: Replaces the regular server resource pack logic. No pesky restarts needed!
body:
**This project has been discontinued until further notice in favour of [Better Server Packs (Fabric)](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-server-packs-fabric).**

**You can (probably) still use this version for 1.20.2+**

# Better Server Packs (BSP)
Better Server Packs is a project that aims to replace the oftentimes annoying 
vanilla implementation of Server Resourcepacks. It does this by calculating the
resourcepack's sha1-hash itself, saving it in a file for caching.


## What is wrong with Server Resourcepacks?
The issue Server Resourcepacks face currently is that all config about them
(including the hash) is stored in the server.properties file. Although hashes are
technically optional for servers, not using one will cause all sorts of
weirdness when updating the resourcepack resulting in packs not updating on the
client. 

Using a hash on the other hand, requires a server restart for every update of 
the resourcepack and hashes are also a pain to compute. 
(Often tools will generate incorrect hashes for a file.)


## How does BSP solve this problem?
BSP removes the need for server restarts by implementing its own logic
essentially replacing the vanilla system. BSP also calculates the hash on its
own solving the issue of finding a functional hash generator and increasing
ease of use.

BSP provides a simple and responsive command interface for operators through 
a new `/pack` command through which all on-demand functionalities of the plugin
can be modified and used.

BSP also allows caching of the resource pack hash to increase boot times.


## Commands
BSP adds one new command `/pack` to your server with the following command tree:
+ `/pack`
  + [`set [<url>]`](#set)
  + [`reload [push]`](#reload)

These subcommands serve the following functions.

### `set`
`/pack set [<url>]`

This command sets the url of the server resourcepack. Simply pass the URL of the
pack as an argument. Passing no argument will set no resourcepack, effectively
disabling the plugin.

*Note that this follows the same restrictions as a regular server resourcepack.
The link must be "direct", meaning it cannot lead to a webpage, but must lead to
the file itself.*

### `reload`
`/pack reload [push]`

Recalculates the resourcepack hash. This should be called after updating the
resourcepack to ensure new players can receive the pack correctly. This is not
necessary after restarting the server. Passing "push" as an argument will update the resourcepack for all active 
players.

Reloading the resourcepack is done asynchronously, doing will, disregarding edge
cases, not impact server performance. 


## Permissions
BSP implements four total permissions to regulate usage of the commands. These
can be modified through permission plugins like LuckPerms without issue.
The following permissions are implemented:
+ `betterserverpack`:
  + Controls usage of all commands. Disabling this permission will disable 
    access to all commands moderated by this plugin.
  + Default: Operator Only
+ `betterserverpack.set`:
  + Controls access to the [`set`](#set) subcommand.
  + Default: Operator Only
+ `betterserverpack.reload`
  + Controls access to the [`reload`](#reload) subcommand.
  + Default: Operator Only

Dispensers can now plant crops and saplings.
Wrench for rotating blocks.
Throw-able dynamite sticks (dispensers can throw them too!). Crafted from TNT or found in mineshafts.
Chain links for crafting chain-mail armor.
And more!

Discord: https://discord.gg/3kAN8vC

## Q & A:


**Q: If I find a bug or get a crash report, where should I post it?**
*A: Please post it on the issue tracker where it is easier for me to keep track of bug reports; any issues posted in the comments section will most likely be ignored.*
 

**Q: Can you port this to Forge/Rift/other mod-loaders?**
*A: No, I really don't want to maintain ports of this for multiple mod-loaders. It's just too much of a hassle/time-sink to be worth it.*
 
**Q: Will earlier versions of Minecraft continue to be supported.**
*A: No.*

**Q: When is the next version coming out?**
*A: I don't give out ETAs as I would most likely miss it.*

**Q: Can you please add X Y Z?**
*A: If it fits in with the mod and I feel like adding it.*

**Q: Is there somewhere where I can look at a complete list of features, recipes, etc.?**
*A: There is currently a wiki in-progress which you can go to by clicking the link at the top of this project page. Be warned that it is far from complete at the moment.*

Q: Can I add this to my mod pack?
A: Yes, but please link back to this page.

title: Monolithic Modernity
description: Bringing monoliths from alpha back into modern Minecraft!
body:
# Monolithic Modernity
![Image of a monolith top with a poppy in focus, with "Monolithic Modernity" written over it. ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6690e53557cc84aaae71ffdbe4bcdf427b578519.png)
Did you know that in 1.19 monoliths were techinically possible again? Well, this datapack aims to add them back in the game! (although more commonly than in alpha)
# Description
This pack uses a bug from 1.19 in which, if you multiply the terrain density function by a negative number, it shoots the terrain up into the the sky. Then, with a range choice, I made that terrain much rarer.

Tldr: I made a bug a feature.
# Compatibility
This should be incompatible with any other that touches the sloped_cheese file, but it's fairly easy to make it compatible. For now there's a separate file compatible with [Cascades](https://modrinth.com/datapack/hybrid-beta).
# Credits 
- Special thanks to [Hazel](https://modrinth.com/user/HazelsInferno) for giving me the pack idea while developing her pack, [Seecret Sunday](https://modrinth.com/modpack/seecret-sunday) (Go play it!)
- Thanks also to [29Naybla](https://modrinth.com/user/29Naybla) for helping me test it in the a pack with Cascades. We're also making a modpack called [Box of Snails](https://modrinth.com/modpack/box-of-snails), in which these will be featured. Check it when it's out and come hang out in our [Discord](https://discord.gg/k8Av5tsXQy)!
- And finally, a huge thanks to [DB3K's](https://legacy.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/db3k) discord server. Not only it hugely inspired us, it also allowed a space to develop our projects.

This unknown entity slowly infects the world, corrupting creatures, blocks, structures, and even reality itself. title: Black Bombardment
description: Call in airstrikes, ride a bomber plane, and unleash tactical destruction — from light explosives to nuclear obliteration. All from a single briefcase.
body:
# 💣 Black Bombardment

**Open the briefcase. Pick your target. Watch the world burn.**

Black Bombardment adds a full tactical airstrike system to Minecraft — 
complete with a command console, a rideable bomber plane, an armored limo, 
and five escalating bomb types that range from surgical strikes to total annihilation.

---

## ✈️ Features

### 🧳 Bomb Briefcase Console
Place the **Bomb Briefcase** block, open its map interface, and click any 
coordinate to lock on a target. Choose your bomb type, set your explosion 
radius, and hit **Bombard** — then watch the sky do the rest.

### 💥 5 Bomb Types
| Type | Description |
|------|-------------|
| **Light** | Quick, precise strike — minimal collateral damage |
| **Mortar** | Mid-range blast with solid area coverage |
| **Heavy** | Massive explosion for serious destruction |
| **Obliterator** | Leaves nothing standing |
| **☢️ Nuclear** | The last word in firepower |

### 🛩️ Pyramid Bomber Plane
Spawn and ride the **Pyramid Bomber** — a fully modeled aircraft entity. 
Use keybinds to **drop bombs** and **cycle bomb types** mid-flight for 
precise aerial bombardment.

### 🚗 Armored Limo
Roll up in style with the **Armored Limo** — a drivable vehicle with its 
own storage trunk. Built for warzone logistics (and looking good doing it).

### 🪖 Pilot Bomber
The **Pilot Bomber** entity accompanies your aircraft operations. 
A proper crew for a proper air assault.

---

## 📦 Items & Blocks
- 🧳 **Bomb Briefcase** — Deployable airstrike console
- ✈️ **Armored Limo** — Drivable vehicle with storage
- 🪖 **Pilot Bomber** — Crew entity item
- ⚾ **Baseball** — Throwable projectile
- 🍬 **Gum** — Craftable from smelted dirt

---

## ⚙️ Requirements
- **Minecraft:** 1.20.1
- **Mod Loader:** Forge 47+
- No additional dependencies required

---

*Black Bombardment is a standalone mod — no bloated dependency chains, 
just pure explosive gameplay.*

title: P_Economia
description: Plugin Economia! Feito para seu servidor ter a melhor economia! com varias Moedas!, Economy Plugin! Made for your server to have the best economy! with multiple Currencies!
body:
# 💰 P_Economia  
Plugin de Economia para **Minecraft**

**P_Economia** é um plugin robusto para servidores Minecraft que implementa um sistema de economia **com múltiplas moedas, rankings dinâmicos, menus interativos, integração com Vault e PlaceholderAPI, cheques e displays de holograma**.  
Foi desenvolvido com foco em **performance, personalização e escalabilidade**, ideal para servidores que buscam uma economia avançada.  

---

## 🚀 Funcionalidades

✅ **Múltiplas Moedas** – totalmente configuráveis (nome, símbolo, saldo inicial, tags de magnata).  
📊 **Rankings Dinâmicos** – atualização automática, com hologramas e armor stands.  
🔗 **Integração com Vault** – compatibilidade com outros plugins de economia.  
🔧 **Integração com PlaceholderAPI** – placeholders personalizáveis para chats, scoreboards e mais.  
🖥️ **Menus Interativos** – GUI para saldo, preferências, histórico e configurações.  
📄 **Sistema de Cheques** – crie e resgate cheques físicos com valores em moedas.  
💬 **Mensagens Personalizáveis** – suporte a chat, action bar e títulos (ativáveis/desativáveis por jogador).  
👤 **Skins Personalizadas** – compatível com SkinsRestorer para exibir skins nos rankings.  
🗄️ **Banco de Dados** – armazenamento persistente de saldos, transações e configs.  

---

## 📦 Requisitos

- ⚡ **Vault** *(opcional, mas recomendado)*  
- 📜 **PlaceholderAPI** *(para placeholders personalizados)*  
- 🎭 **SkinsRestorer** *(para skins em displays de ranking)*  

---

## ⚙️ Configuração

Arquivos gerados automaticamente em:  
`/plugins/P_Economy/`

- `config.yml` → Configurações gerais.  
- `currencies.yml` → Definição das moedas.  
- `commands.yml` → Configuração de comandos.  
- `menus.yml` → Configuração dos menus interativos.  
- `Idiomas/pt_br.yml` e `Idiomas/en_us.yml` → Traduções e mensagens.  

---

## ⌨️ Comandos Principais

| Comando | Descrição | Permissão |
|---------|------------|-----------|
| `/economia saldo [moeda]` | Exibe o saldo do jogador. | `peconomy.use` |
| `/economia top [moeda]` | Mostra o top 10 jogadores. | `peconomy.use` |
| `/economia toggle [moeda]` | Ativa/desativa recebimento. | `peconomy.use` |
| `/economia transacoes [moeda]` | Histórico de transações. | `peconomy.use` |
| `/economia message_prefs` | Menu de preferências de mensagens. | `peconomy.use` |
| `/economia cheque <valor> <moeda>` | Cria um cheque. | `peconomy.cheque` |
| `/economia reload` | Recarrega configs. | `peconomy.admin` |
| `/economia add/remove/set` | Gerencia saldo de jogadores. | `peconomy.admin` |

---

## 🔑 Permissões

- `peconomy.use` → Comandos básicos.  
- `peconomy.admin` → Comandos administrativos.  
- `peconomy.cheque` → Criar/resgatar cheques.  
- `peconomy.customcommands` → Executar comandos personalizados nos menus.  

---

## 🪄 Placeholders (PlaceholderAPI)

```txt
%peconomy_balance_<moeda>%       → "$100.00"
%peconomy_magnata_<moeda>%       → "[Magnata]"
%peconomy_toggle_<moeda>%        → "Enabled/Disabled"
%peconomy_actionbar%             → "Enabled/Disabled"
%peconomy_title%                 → "Enabled/Disabled"
%peconomy_lasttransaction_<moeda>% → "ADD $50 Mr_Haruki"
%peconomy_top_<moeda>_<posição>_<tipo>%

```
# 💰 P_Economia  
Economy Plugin for **Minecraft**

**P_Economia** is a robust plugin for Minecraft servers that implements an economy system **with multiple currencies, dynamic leaderboards, interactive menus, Vault and PlaceholderAPI integration, checks, and hologram displays**.  
It was developed with a focus on **performance, customization, and scalability**, making it ideal for servers looking for an advanced economy system.  

---

## 🚀 Features

✅ **Multiple Currencies** – fully configurable (name, symbol, starting balance, magnate tags).  
📊 **Dynamic Leaderboards** – automatic updates, with holograms and armor stands.  
🔗 **Vault Integration** – compatibility with other economy plugins.  
🔧 **PlaceholderAPI Integration** – customizable placeholders for chats, scoreboards, and more.  
🖥️ **Interactive Menus** – GUI for balance, preferences, history, and settings.  
📄 **Check System** – create and redeem physical checks with currency values.  
💬 **Customizable Messages** – support for chat, action bar, and titles (enable/disable per player).  
👤 **Custom Skins** – compatible with SkinsRestorer to display skins on leaderboards.  
🗄️ **Database** – persistent storage of balances, transactions, and configs.  

---

## 📦 Requirements

- ⚡ **Vault** *(optional, but recommended)*  
- 📜 **PlaceholderAPI** *(for custom placeholders)*  
- 🎭 **SkinsRestorer** *(for leaderboard display skins)*  

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

Files are automatically generated in:  
`/plugins/P_Economy/`

- `config.yml` → General settings.  
- `currencies.yml` → Currency definitions.  
- `commands.yml` → Command configuration.  
- `menus.yml` → Interactive menu configuration.  
- `Languages/pt_br.yml` and `Languages/en_us.yml` → Translations and messages.  

---

## ⌨️ Main Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/economy balance [currency]` | Displays the player’s balance. | `peconomy.use` |
| `/economy top [currency]` | Shows the top 10 players. | `peconomy.use` |
| `/economy toggle [currency]` | Enables/disables receiving. | `peconomy.use` |
| `/economy transactions [currency]` | Transaction history. | `peconomy.use` |
| `/economy message_prefs` | Message preferences menu. | `peconomy.use` |
| `/economy check <amount> <currency>` | Creates a check. | `peconomy.cheque` |
| `/economy reload` | Reloads configs. | `peconomy.admin` |
| `/economy add/remove/set` | Manage player balances. | `peconomy.admin` |

---

## 🔑 Permissions

- `peconomy.use` → Basic commands.  
- `peconomy.admin` → Administrative commands.  
- `peconomy.cheque` → Create/redeem checks.  
- `peconomy.customcommands` → Execute custom commands in menus.  

---

## 🪄 Placeholders (PlaceholderAPI)

```txt
%peconomy_balance_<currency>%        → "$100.00"
%peconomy_magnate_<currency>%        → "[Magnate]"
%peconomy_toggle_<currency>%         → "Enabled/Disabled"
%peconomy_actionbar%                 → "Enabled/Disabled"
%peconomy_title%                     → "Enabled/Disabled"
%peconomy_lasttransaction_<currency>% → "ADD $50 Steve"
%peconomy_top_<currency>_<position>_<type>%

title: Nickname — The Most Complete Cross-Platform Nickname System
description: Best cross-platform nickname system for Minecraft — built for Fabric and Paper-family servers, with nickname-aware join/leave, death and advancement messages, configurable nametags, and powerful admin controls in one lightweight package
body:
**The best nickname solution for modern Minecraft servers.
One project, one command style, and one consistent player identity experience across both Fabric and Bukkit-family servers.

Unlike typical nickname plugins that only rename chat or tab, Nickname is built as a full identity layer: join/leave, death, advancements, nametag behavior, persistence rules, and admin controls in one place.

DISCLAIMER:
This Mod has not been tested with other mods if you find  Bugs please report them on
business.ayaan.iquires.gmail.com

# Why Nickname stands out
Cross-platform by design
Built for both Fabric and plugin ecosystems, so network owners can keep one nickname workflow across different server stacks.

# Identity consistency, not just cosmetic rename
Nicknames are applied across multiple gameplay surfaces (join/leave, death, advancements, display contexts) instead of only one UI element.

# Operationally flexible
Fine-grained toggles let you decide exactly how identity behaves: persistent or session-only, public former-name context, message-level controls, and more.

# Made for real servers
Permission-based control, simple JSON storage, reload support, and no required client installation.

# Core Features
- /nick and /nickname command suite
- Self nickname management and staff assignment tools
- Nickname-aware join and leave messaging
- Optional format: Nickname (formerly known as Username)
- Nickname-aware death and advancement announcements
- Optional recipe advancement spam filtering
- Configurable overhead nametag behavior
- Persistent nickname storage with runtime reload support
# Commands
- /nick set me <nickname>
- /nick set <player> <nickname>
- /nick clear
- /nick clear <player>
- /nick reload
- /nick list
- /nick query <player>
# Permissions
- nickname.set.self (default: true)
- nickname.clear.self (default: true)
- nickname.query (default: true)
- - nickname.set.other (default: op)
- nickname.clear.other (default: op)
- nickname.list (default: op)
- nickname.reload (default: op)
# Compatibility
## Confirmed tested
- Fabric
- Paper
- Purpur
- Bukkit/Spigot
## Intended compatibility
- Most Paper forks
- Spigot/Bukkit-compatible environments
- Fabric server environments
- No client-side mod/plugin required for standard functionality.**

title: Chat Overhaul !
description: Chat Overhaul adds custom chat formatting, 100+ emojis, @mentions, and more to Minecraft's chat system.
body:
![Veack's Chat Overhaul logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/29527e1e23dfe8798c2109f4c867b46758e27e02.png)

> Chat Overhaul modernizes Minecraft's chat system with configurable chat formatting and color, 100+ vanilla looking emojis, a mention system, user-defined aliases, and a tab system to quickly swap between general, team, and whisper chats, completly client-side !

## Features

### Chat Tabs

Using whispers or teammsg commands will automatically send you to the corresponding tab.

![The player typing "/w Miriuc" in the chat, being sent in the whisper tab](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/715c8df9606ccbccfeaf7935c78907ab80263c6d.gif)

![The player swapping between tabs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9c73a88144e3d86ea069edb7ab31911496b54f6.gif)

### Configurable message formats

You can customize chat messages format to your hearts content ! Using [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) on Fabric, or NeoForge default mod menu, you can configure message formats and colors per channel, with timestamps and more !

![![Example of custom aliases in the config menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/823c2e73bf628b39416ead3bbc1e0c0f8f871ba6_0.webp)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/03cb1ec97dd6b1aa9840c1eb37a62cf4da394773_0.webp)

### Mentions
**@mentions** are colored in chat, and play a sound if someone is mentionning you. 
(Tip : by clicking on mentions, you can quickly whisper to someone !)

![Mentions and pings example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bdcce8a6ed0886b32e900e76781fac159df2e8d2_0.webp)

### Emojis !
`:name:` codes are substituted with emojis. For now, the mod is adding around 100 emojis, with plans for more in the future !

You can also add text remplacements in the mod config.

Feel free to add this mod to your modpack !
Please credit me and don't distribute this mod as yours.

title: NightVision: Warm

body:
### **Be Sure To Follow On Instagram to get future updates and to resolve quires:** **[@nv.labs.official](https://www.instagram.com/nv.labs.official/)**

### 💡 About this pack
This pack is a warm variant of the original [NightVision: Standard](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/nv_1.21.x) project, keeping the same lightmap-based visibility boost while adding a subtle orange tint that makes nighttime skys feel cozier without washing out contrast or depth. It works in survival, creative, and on servers that allow client-side resource packs, and stays lightweight since it only edits Minecraft’s core lightmap instead of relying on external shader loaders.

_**[Note: This pack doesn't change the way caves look at night]**_

### **🎮 Use cases**

- Mining and caving without placing torches everywhere.
- Building at night while still clearly seeing block shapes and colors.
- Exploring, raid prep, and general gameplay when you want better visibility but not flat                    fullbright.

### **⚙️ Compatibility**
Made for Minecraft 1.21.x (also works with 26.1). Works with vanilla and most vanilla-style packs if this pack is above them in the resource pack list. May conflict with packs or shaders that modify the same lightmap.fsh (fullbright, night-vision fixes, etc.). Also works with [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) when [PolyTone](https://modrinth.com/mod/polytone) is installed.

### **Be sure to check out our other project:** [DarkGUI](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/dark_gui), [SmartComms](https://modrinth.com/mod/smartcomms),  [NightVision: Standard](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/nv_1.21.x)

title: Snake Game Clientside
description: Adds a clientside snake game which you can play if you get bored or are waiting for something.
body:
Adds the classic snake game to Minecraft, which you can play using the /clientsnake command. It is purely clientside and so nice if you are waiting for something or bored. ![The game underway](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7282b8fca2a8b5b09cf8b76abb4f64be037196d3_0.webp) Has a few persistent settings: - Speed: The number of milliseconds between snake updates - Show Pointers: Wether to show the direction of each snake element using the < ^ > and V characters - Show In Chat: Whether to inform you of your score when you die - Show Stats: Whether to display your current & highest scores as you play - Digest: Whether to show the eating animation To open the game, type the command /clientsnake To move use the 4 arrow keys For help type /clientsnake help To set the speed type /clientsnake speed
The speed is the rate at which the snake game updates, in milliseconds, meaning a speed of 1000 is one update per second, whereas 50 is 20 updates per second. It defaults to 120. To toggle the other settings use the command /clientsnake , the options will show as suggestions. title: Keep my tools!
description: A simple mod that makes your tools and armour stay with you through death.
body:
A simple and configurable mod which causes the player to retain their tools and armour upon death, while still dropping other items like normal and optionally damaging the tools you kept. A list of every item you lost will be sent to the chat, as well.

![A gif showing the mod in-use. A player dies and drops their items, but not their tools.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/v90xGFAM/images/1fcead6234936c467f11d43e8fdac38a79ac7dd3.gif)

This mod works by simply turning 'keepinventory' to true, and dropping selected items when the player dies. This means the mod will most likely _not_ work with most gravestone, corpse, etc mods. If you really want I can add optional grave functionality. :-)

The list of items kept on death can be easily modified through a datapack. To do this you can simply change the item tag "keepmytools:retained_on_death", which is a list of what not to drop when the player dies. 

The mod will force the gamerule 'keepinventory' to true. This is necessary for the mods functionality, and so cannot be changed.

Feel free to use this in modpacks!

No generative ai was used in the development of this mod.
