title: UltimateGraves
description: The Ultimate Grave plugin with various gamemodes vault integrations and many more features....
body:
** 🪦 UltimateGraves - Complete Plugin Overview

---

 📖 Description

**UltimateGraves** is a premium, feature-rich grave management system for Minecraft 1.21.1+ servers running on Paper. When players die, instead of losing their items, a grave is created at their death location, storing all inventory contents, armor, and experience points safely.

Built with modern Java 21 and the latest Paper API, UltimateGraves offers unparalleled performance, flexibility, and customization. Whether you run a survival server, RPG realm, or hardcore PvP arena, UltimateGraves adapts to your needs with its intelligent protection system, smart location detection, and extensive configuration options.

**No more rage-quits from lost items. No more unfair deaths in lava or void. Just peace of mind.**

---

 🎯 Core Concept

When a player dies:
1. **🔍 Smart Location Detection** - Finds a safe spot (handles void, lava, walls)
2. **📦 Items Secured** - All inventory, armor, and offhand items stored
3. **⚰️ Grave Spawned** - Visual marker placed (player head, hologram, particles)
4. **🔒 Protected** - Configurable protection modes (private, public, timed, PvP, token-based)
5. **🧭 Navigation** - Player receives compass pointing to grave
6. **⏰ Expiration** - Configurable timer before grave becomes public/expires
7. **💰 Economy** - Optional costs for teleportation and retrieval (Vault integration)

---

 ✨ Key Features Summary

| Category | Features |
|----------|----------|
| **🛡️ Protection** | 5 Protection Modes, Timed Access, PvP Detection, Token System, Guardian Mobs |
| **🎨 Visuals** | Player Head Graves, Native Holograms, Particle Effects, Beacon Beams, Glow Effects |
| **🗄️ Storage** | SQLite & MySQL Support, Async Operations, HikariCP Pooling, NBT Preservation |
| **🧠 Intelligence** | Safe Location Finder, Void/Lava Handling, Soulbound Items, Overflow Management |
| **💎 Economy** | Vault Integration, Teleport Costs, Retrieval Fees, Item Refunds |
| **🎮 Interaction** | Interactive GUI, Quick Loot, Smart Equip, Compass Tracking, Multi-Click Actions |
| **⚙️ Configuration** | 580+ Config Lines, Every Feature Toggleable, Hot Reload, Per-World Settings |
| **🔌 Integration** | PlaceholderAPI, WorldGuard, Vault, Developer API, Custom Events |

---

 🌟 Detailed Feature Breakdown

 🛡️ **Protection System (Strategy Pattern)**

 **5 Protection Modes:**

1. **PRIVATE Mode** 🔒
   - Only the grave owner can access
   - Admins with bypass permission can open
   - Perfect for PvE servers

2. **PUBLIC Mode** 🌍
   - Anyone can loot the grave
   - First come, first serve
   - Ideal for hardcore/anarchy servers

3. **TIMED Mode** ⏰
   - Private for X seconds (configurable)
   - Becomes public after timer expires
   - Balances fairness and risk

4. **PVP_PVE Mode** ⚔️
   - Smart detection:
     - Killed by player → Public grave (PvP loot)
     - Killed by mob/environment → Private grave
   - Perfect for factions/war servers

5. **TOKEN Mode** 🔑
   - Requires a custom item (Grave Key) to open
   - Keys can be sold, rewarded, or crafted
   - Creates unique economy opportunities

---

 🎨 **Visual System (Native 1.21 API)**

 **Grave Block:**
- **Player Head** with owner's skin (default)
- OR configurable materials (Netherite Block, Chest, Ender Chest, etc.)
- **Glowing effect** with customizable color
- **Explosion-proof** and **piston-proof**

 **Holograms** (TextDisplay Entities - NO PLUGINS NEEDED):
```
⚰ GRAVE ⚰
Owner: Steve
Time: 14m 32s
Cause: Fell into Lava
Items: 47
```
- **Live countdown timer**
- **Fully customizable lines**
- **MiniMessage color support** (gradients, RGB, hex)
- **Auto-updates** every second

 **Particle Effects:**
- Rising soul flames (configurable type)
- Customizable count, speed, spread
- 20+ particle types supported
- Adjustable spawn interval

 **Beacon Beam:**
- Visible only to grave owner
- Points to grave from distance
- Configurable color (RGB)
- Adjustable visibility range (64 blocks default)

---

 🧠 **Smart Location Algorithm**

 **The Problem:**
Players die in lava, void, inside walls → Graves can't spawn normally

 **The Solution:**
```java
if (death in VOID) {
    → Scan 10-block radius for solid ground
    → If none found: Create glass platform at Y=5
}

if (death in LAVA) {
    → Replace lava with Netherite Block
    → Clear surrounding lava (configurable radius)
}

if (death in WALL) {
    → Raycast for nearest air pocket
    → Spawn grave at safe location
}
```

 **Configurable Options:**
- Search radius (horizontal & vertical)
- Void platform height
- Lava replacement block
- Unsafe block list
- Platform creation toggle

---

 💎 **Unique "Premium" Features**

 1. **Grave Guardian System** 👻
- **Random spawn chance** (default 15%)
- Zombie/Skeleton equipped with **player's armor & weapon**
- Grave **locked until guardian is killed**
- Customizable:
  - Mob type (Zombie, Skeleton, Wither Skeleton, Piglin Brute)
  - Health multiplier (default 2x)
  - Damage multiplier (default 1.5x)
  - Speed boost
  - Custom name with player placeholder
  - Glowing effect

**Example:**
```
Player dies → 15% chance to spawn "Ghost of Steve"
Guardian wears Steve's Diamond Armor + Netherite Sword
Steve must kill the Guardian to access his grave
```

 2. **Soulbound Item System** 💍
- Mark items with lore/NBT tags
- These items **stay in inventory on death**
- Configurable identifiers:
  ```yaml
  - "<gold><bold>SOULBOUND</bold></gold>"
  - "§6§lSOULBOUND"
  - NBT tag: "soulbound:true"
  ```
- Perfect for quest items, rank rewards, etc.

 3. **Overflow Management** 📦
- Player inventory full when looting grave?
- **Options:**
  - **LEAVE_IN_GRAVE** - Items stay for next visit
  - **DROP_AT_FEET** - Items drop as entities
  - **PREVENT_LOOT** - Block opening until space available

 4. **Smart Equip** 🎽
- Automatically equips armor when looting grave
- Only fills empty armor slots
- Prioritizes best gear
- Can be toggled per-player

 5. **XP Preservation** ⭐
- Configurable percentage saved (default 75%)
- Players with permission keep 100%
- Stored separately from items
- Returned on grave loot

---

 🗄️ **Database & Performance**

 **Dual Database Support:**
- **SQLite** - Zero-config local storage (default)
- **MySQL** - Remote database for networks

 **HikariCP Connection Pooling:**
- Industry-standard connection management
- Configurable pool size (default 10 connections)
- Automatic connection recycling
- Optimized for high player counts

 **Async Operations:**
- Grave spawning (prevents death event lag)
- Database saves/loads
- Location calculations
- All async operations use CompletableFuture

 **Data Preservation:**
- **Base64 serialization** for items
- **NBT/Component data** preserved (modded items, custom model data)
- **Enchantments** and **lore** retained
- **Potion effects** and **attributes** saved

 **Caching System:**
- In-memory cache for active graves
- Reduces database queries by 80%
- Configurable max cache size (default 500)
- Auto-sync every 5 minutes

---

 🎮 **Player Interaction**

 **Multiple Interaction Types:**

| Action | Result |
|--------|--------|
| **Left Click** | Show grave info in chat |
| **Right Click** | Open grave GUI |
| **Shift + Right Click** | Quick loot (instant retrieval) |

 **GUI System:**

**1. Graves List GUI** (`/graves`)
```
╔════════════════════════════════════╗
║        YOUR GRAVES                 ║
╠════════════════════════════════════╣
║ [💀] Grave 1                     ║
║ World: world (100, 64, -200)       ║
║ Died: 5 minutes ago                ║
║ Cause: Fell from high place        ║
║ Items: 32                          ║
║                                    ║
║ Left-Click: Teleport ($100)        ║
║ Right-Click: Preview Items         ║
╚════════════════════════════════════╝
```

**2. Grave Loot GUI**
- Shows exact grave contents
- Preview before retrieval
- Click items to loot individually
- Or "Take All" button

 **Compass Navigation** 🧭
- Given on respawn (toggleable)
- Points to nearest grave
- Updates when grave changes
- Custom name + lore with coordinates
- Removed automatically when grave looted

---

 💰 **Economy Integration (Vault)**

 **Configurable Costs:**
- **Teleport to grave** - Default $100
- **Open grave** - Default $0 (disabled)
- **Retrieve items** - Default $0 (disabled)

 **Special Features:**
- **Refund system** - Convert expired grave items to money
- **Bypass permissions** - `ultimategraves.teleport.free`, `ultimategraves.nocost`
- **Balance checks** - Won't charge if insufficient funds
- **Detailed messages** - Shows exact costs and balances

 **Use Cases:**
- Charge for convenience (teleportation)
- "Ransom" mode (pay to get items back)
- Refund as insurance (50% item value back)
- Create "Grave Key" economy (TOKEN mode)

---

 🔌 **Integrations**

 **PlaceholderAPI Expansion:**
```
%ultimategraves_count% - Number of active graves
%ultimategraves_latest_coords% - Last grave location
%ultimategraves_latest_world% - Last grave world
%ultimategraves_latest_time% - Time since last death
%ultimategraves_total_items% - Items in all graves
```

 **WorldGuard Integration:**
- Custom region flag: `graves-spawn`
- Block grave spawning in protected areas
- Configurable fallback behavior
- Soft dependency (optional)

 **Vault Integration:**
- Economy API for costs
- Permission checks
- Balance management

---

 🎯 Use Cases & Server Types

 **Survival Servers** 🌲
- **Problem:** Players lose items to accidental deaths
- **Solution:** Private graves with 15-minute timer
- **Config:** `PRIVATE` or `TIMED` mode, soulbound for special items

 **PvP/Factions Servers** ⚔️
- **Problem:** Need lootable graves for kills, but not for accidents
- **Solution:** PVP_PVE mode
- **Config:** Instant public graves for PvP, protected for PvE deaths

 **RPG Servers** 🗡️
- **Problem:** Custom items need special protection
- **Solution:** Soulbound + Guardian system
- **Config:** Mark quest items as soulbound, 50% guardian spawn chance

 **Hardcore Servers** 💀
- **Problem:** Too easy if items always protected
- **Solution:** Short timer + guardian mobs
- **Config:** `TIMED` 2 minutes, 30% guardian chance, no teleport

 **Anarchy Servers** 🔥
- **Problem:** No rules, full loot
- **Solution:** Public graves, short expiration
- **Config:** `PUBLIC` mode, 5-minute expiration, void protection only

 **SMP Servers** 🏘️
- **Problem:** Mix of casual and hardcore players
- **Solution:** Permission-based modes
- **Config:** Different modes per rank, optional teleport costs

---

 📊 Comparison with Other Plugins

| Feature | UltimateGraves | Graves (Basic) | AngelsChest | GriefPrevention Graves |
|---------|----------------|----------------|-------------|------------------------|
| **Modern API (1.21)** | ✅ Yes | ❌ No | ❌ No | ❌ No |
| **Native Holograms** | ✅ TextDisplay | ❌ Armor Stands | ❌ External | ❌ None |
| **Database Support** | ✅ SQLite + MySQL | ❌ File-based | ✅ SQLite | ❌ None |
| **Async Operations** | ✅ Full | ❌ Partial | ❌ No | ❌ No |
| **Protection Modes** | ✅ 5 Modes | ❌ 2 Modes | ❌ 1 Mode | ❌ 1 Mode |
| **Smart Location** | ✅ Yes | ❌ No | ❌ No | ❌ No |
| **Guardian System** | ✅ Yes | ❌ No | ❌ No | ❌ No |
| **Soulbound Items** | ✅ Yes | ❌ No | ❌ No | ❌ No |
| **Economy Integration** | ✅ Full | ❌ Partial | ❌ No | ❌ No |
| **Developer API** | ✅ Yes | ❌ Limited | ❌ No | ❌ No |
| **GUI System** | ✅ Advanced | ❌ Basic | ❌ None | ❌ None |
| **Configuration** | ✅ 580+ lines | ❌ 100 lines | ❌ 150 lines | ❌ 50 lines |

---

 🚀 Installation & Setup

 **Requirements:**
- **Minecraft Version:** 1.21.1 - 1.21.x
- **Server Software:** Paper (or Forks: Purpur, Pufferfish)
- **Java Version:** Java 21
- **Optional Dependencies:**
  - Vault + Economy Plugin (for costs)
  - PlaceholderAPI (for placeholders)
  - WorldGuard 7.0+ (for region protection)

 **Installation:**
1. Download `UltimateGraves.jar`
2. Place in `plugins/` folder
3. Restart server (NOT reload)
4. Configure `plugins/UltimateGraves/config.yml`
5. Edit `plugins/UltimateGraves/messages.yml` (optional)
6. Use `/graveadmin reload` to apply changes

 **First-Time Setup:**
```yaml
 config.yml - Recommended starter settings

 Storage (use SQLite for single servers)
storage:
  type: "SQLITE"

 Basic grave settings
graves:
  max-graves-per-player: 5
  expiration-time: 900  15 minutes
  default-protection-mode: "TIMED"
  timed-mode-duration: 300  5 minutes

 Enable visuals
visuals:
  block-material: "PLAYER_HEAD"
  glowing: true
  hologram:
    enabled: true
  particles:
    enabled: true

 Enable economy (requires Vault)
economy:
  enabled: true
  teleport-cost: 100.0

 Enable guardian (15% chance)
guardian:
  enabled: true
  spawn-chance: 0.15
```

---

 📝 Commands Reference

 **Player Commands:**

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/graves` | Open graves GUI | `ultimategraves.use` |
| `/graves list` | List all your graves | `ultimategraves.use` |
| `/graves tp <>` | Teleport to grave | `ultimategraves.teleport` |
| `/graves info <>` | View grave details | `ultimategraves.use` |
| `/graves help` | Show help | `ultimategraves.use` |

 **Admin Commands:**

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/graveadmin reload` | Reload config | `ultimategraves.admin` |
| `/graveadmin cleanup` | Remove expired graves | `ultimategraves.admin` |
| `/graveadmin purge` | Delete ALL graves | `ultimategraves.admin` |
| `/graveadmin list [player]` | List player's graves | `ultimategraves.admin` |
| `/graveadmin tp <player> <>` | Teleport to any grave | `ultimategraves.admin` |
| `/graveadmin remove <player> <>` | Remove a grave | `ultimategraves.admin` |

---

 🔐 Permissions Reference

 **Basic Permissions:**
```yaml
ultimategraves.use               Basic grave usage (default: true)
ultimategraves.admin             Admin commands (default: op)
ultimategraves.bypass            Access any grave (default: op)
ultimategraves.unlimited         No grave limit (default: false)
ultimategraves.teleport          Teleport to graves (default: true)
ultimategraves.teleport.free     Free teleports (default: op)
ultimategraves.compass           Receive compass (default: true)
ultimategraves.nocost            Bypass all costs (default: op)
```

 **Mode Permissions:**
```yaml
ultimategraves.mode.private      Use PRIVATE mode
ultimategraves.mode.public       Use PUBLIC mode
ultimategraves.mode.timed        Use TIMED mode
ultimategraves.mode.pvppve       Use PVP_PVE mode
ultimategraves.mode.token        Use TOKEN mode
```

 **Special Permissions:**
```yaml
ultimategraves.keepxp            Keep 100% XP
ultimategraves.soulbound.bypass  All items act as soulbound
```

---

 ⚙️ Configuration Highlights

 **580+ Configuration Options** including:

- ✅ **Database settings** (type, MySQL credentials, pool size)
- ✅ **Grave limits** (max per player, expiration time)
- ✅ **Protection modes** (5 types with sub-options)
- ✅ **Visual customization** (block type, glow, particles, holograms)
- ✅ **Safe location algorithm** (void/lava handling, search radius)
- ✅ **Inventory handling** (XP percentage, soulbound, overflow)
- ✅ **Economy costs** (teleport, retrieval, refunds)
- ✅ **Guardian system** (spawn chance, mob type, stats)
- ✅ **Interaction modes** (left/right/shift click behaviors)
- ✅ **Respawn settings** (compass, titles, messages)
- ✅ **Cleanup automation** (expired graves, database purging)
- ✅ **GUI customization** (titles, items, lore)
- ✅ **Integration toggles** (WorldGuard, Vault, PlaceholderAPI)
- ✅ **Per-world settings** (blacklist, behavior overrides)
- ✅ **Debug options** (logging, performance monitoring)

 **Every Feature is Configurable:**
```yaml
 Example: Disable a feature completely
guardian:
  enabled: false

 Example: Change behavior
inventory:
  overflow:
    mode: "DROP_AT_FEET"  Instead of leaving in grave

 Example: Customize visuals
visuals:
  block-material: "ENDER_CHEST"
  particles:
    type: "FLAME"
    count: 10
```

---

 💬 Message Customization

 **350+ Message Lines** including:

- ✅ All player-facing text
- ✅ **MiniMessage format** (gradients, RGB, hex colors)
- ✅ **Placeholders** (`%player%`, `%x%`, `%cost%`, etc.)
- ✅ Chat, title, actionbar, and hologram messages
- ✅ GUI item names and lore
- ✅ Error messages
- ✅ Debug messages

 **Example Customization:**
```yaml
 Default:
grave-spawned:
  chat: "%prefix%<yellow>Your grave has been created..."

 Custom (with gradient):
grave-spawned:
  chat: "%prefix%<gradient:red:gold>💀 RIP! Your items are safe at %x%, %y%, %z%</gradient>"
```

---

 🏆 Why Choose UltimateGraves?

 **For Server Owners:**
✅ **Player retention** - No rage-quits from item loss  
✅ **Flexible** - Adapts to any server type  
✅ **Professional** - Enterprise-grade code quality  
✅ **Performant** - Async operations, optimized database  
✅ **Modern** - Uses latest Minecraft features  
✅ **Supported** - Regular updates for new MC versions  

 **For Players:**
✅ **Fair** - Items protected from unfair deaths  
✅ **Intuitive** - Easy-to-use GUI and compass  
✅ **Visual** - Clear markers and holograms  
✅ **Convenient** - Teleport to graves (optional)  
✅ **Transparent** - Know exactly when graves expire 
---

 📈 Performance Metrics

- **Death Event Lag:** < 1ms (async processing)
- **Database Query Time:** < 10ms (HikariCP pooling)
- **Memory Usage:** ~15MB for 500 cached graves
- **Hologram Update Cost:** < 0.1ms per grave per second
- **Particle Spawn Cost:** < 0.05ms per grave per tick

---

 🛠️ Technical Architecture

 **Design Patterns Used:**
- **Strategy Pattern** - Protection modes
- **Repository Pattern** - Database abstraction
- **Factory Pattern** - Grave creation
- **Observer Pattern** - Event system
- **Singleton Pattern** - Manager classes

 **Code Quality:**
- ✅ SOLID principles
- ✅ DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself)
- ✅ Null-safety with annotations
- ✅ Exception handling
- ✅ Thread-safe operations
- ✅ JavaDoc documentation

---

 📚 Documentation & Support

- **💬 Discord:** geturplugins

---

 🎉 Summary

**UltimateGraves** is the **most comprehensive, customizable, and modern** grave plugin available for Minecraft 1.21.1+. With **51 classes**, **580+ config options**, **350+ messages**, and **5 protection modes**, it's built for servers that demand quality.

Whether you need basic item protection or a complex economy-driven grave system with guardian mobs and token access, UltimateGraves delivers.

**No bloat. No dependencies. Just pure, optimized grave management.**

---

  📥 Get Started

1. Download the latest release
2. Drop in `plugins/` folder
3. Configure to your liking
4. Enjoy premium grave protection!

body:
Recipe downloads have been split into their own projects for better Modrinth App compatibility.\
Links to all recipes in description

This project adds craftable cobweb, making it renewable.


#### Installation:
- Put the datapack in your "/AppData/Roaming/.minecraft/saves/[Your World Here]/datapack" folder.
- ***DO NOT put the datapack in your "/AppData/Roaming/.minecraft/resourcepacks" folder.***
- If you changed where Minecraft loads from, find that location and use that "saves" folder.
- For servers, put it in your world folder that matches where your server.properties file says.

#### For advanced users:
- IF you want to store it in your ".minecraft" folder, CREATE a folder called "datapack" and put it there.
- From there, when you create a world and go to add datapacks, you can simply go to this folder and grab what you need.
- For identical recipes in multiple data packs, load desired recipes AFTER their duplicates


#### Datapack version reference (as of 1.21.10):
|Datapack |MC Format|MC Version      |
|:--------|:--------|:---------------|
|1.0.x    |4        |1.13.x          |
|1.1.x    |4        |1.14.x          |

The different release versions of "More Recipes by Selah":
- More Recipes: A balance of Quality of Life recipes while still feeling Vanilla
- Mini-Collections: Every recipe in "More Recipes" sub-divided into seven (7) categories
  - Additional, Change, Color, New, Smelting, Stonecutting, Undo
- Alpha: Every recipe divided into sub-categories based on the Mini-Collection categories
  - This is effectively the test version of all recipes
  - This is where recipes not in the Mini-Collection or comprehensive releases are
  - Feedback encouraged to bring as many recipes into the comprehensive release as possible

Datapacks were not a thing before 1.13. There is no way to make these compatible older than 1.13.

There are special cases where breaking changes that are not backwards compatible don't have the "A" value incremented:
- Item names are changed
  - ex: 1.1.x changes "rose_red" to "red_dye"
- A non-breaking functionality is added
  - ex: 2.6.x in 1.19.3 adds categories while anything before ignores them
- A change is made that doesn't stop the previous method from working
  - ex: "crafting_shapeless" works in all versions, "minecraft:crafting_shapeless" starting in 1.1.x
- Changes to the way "pack.mcmeta" is read
  - ex: see changes in 25w31a

Major breaking changes to each version:
 - 2.0.0 MC 1.17: Advancement Format change - custom recipe "condition" ("items")
 - 3.0.0 MC 1.20.5: Recipe Format change - recipe "result"
 - 4.0.0 MC 1.21: Folder Name change
 - 5.0.0 MC 1.21.2: Recipe Format change - shaped "key" and shapeless "ingredients"

title: ConicDuels
description: The Next-Gen Ultra-Light Practice Core plugin.
body:
# ⚡ **ConicDuels – UPDATE 1.5.0**

**The Next-Gen Ultra-Light Practice Core for 1.21+**

__This is a developer build, please report bugs if you find any.__
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## 📝 Overview
**ConicDuels** is an ultra-optimized Practice Core plugin for **Paper 1.21–1.21.8** that combines **Kits, Parties, Duels, Arenas, Stats, and AutoGG** into one performance-focused package — perfect for competitive PvP environments.

> **ConicDuels 1.5.0-DEV build is buggy & not perfectly tested, please reach out github or discord to report bugs.**

Read [**Documents Here**](https://github.com/SwarajDev5/ConicCore/)

---

## 🚀 What's New in 1.5.0
✔ **Completely Reworked Party System** (Merged from ConicDuels)
✔ **Dedicated 1v1 Duels System** (Merged from ConicDuels)
✔ **Auto Arena Reset System** integration for Duels (Requires a dependency)
✔ **Hex Color Code Support** for all messages and configuration.
✔ Full compatibility with the new command and permission structure.

---

## ✨ Features
✅ Ultra-lightweight & performance-optimized
✅ Fully in-game kit creation & editing
✅ **Advanced Party System** (chat, fights, invites, kicks, admin tools)
✅ **Dedicated Duel System** with kit selection, rounds, and new commands
✅ **Auto Arena Reset** (Requires ConicArena + FastAsyncWorldEdit/WorldEdit)
✅ Arena creation & teleportation commands
✅ AutoGG toggle system
✅ Works perfectly on Practice & PvP servers
✅ Built for Paper 1.21.x
✅ PlaceholderAPI integration
✅ **Hex Color Code Support**

---

## ⚙ Dependencies
**Hard Dependency:**
* ConicArena

**Soft Dependencies (Required for Arena Management/Reset):**
* FastAsyncWorldEdit **or** WorldEdit

---

## ⌨ Commands
| Command | Description | Usage Examples |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`/conic`** | Main plugin command. | `/conic setspawn`, `/conic reload` |
| **`/spawn`** | Teleport to spawn. | `/spawn`, `/spawn <player>` |
| **`/kit`** | Kit management. | `/kit create <name>`, `/kit list` |
| **`/kiteditor`** | Edit kits in-game. | `/kiteditor edit <kit>`, `/kiteditor save` |
| **`/giveeditedkit`**| Give an edited kit to a player. | `/giveeditedkit <kit> <player>` |
| **`/arenas`** | Arena management. | `/arenas create <name>`, `/arenas reset <name>` |
| **`/party`** | Party system commands. | `/party create`, `/party invite <player>`, `/party fight` |
| **`/duel`** | Duel a player. | `/duel <player>`, `/duel accept` |
| **`/partyaccept`** | Accept a party invite. | `/partyaccept` |
| **`/partyfight`** | Accept a party fight request. | `/partyfight` |
| **`/stats`** | View player stats. | `/stats [player]` |
| **`/autoggtoggle`**| Toggle the AutoGG feature. | `/autoggtoggle` |

---

## 🔐 Permissions
| Permission | Description | Default |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `conicduels.*` | All ConicCore/Duels commands. | `op` |
| `conicduels.admin` | Access to admin commands. | `op` |
| `conicduels.spawn` | Use `/spawn`. | `true` |
| `conicduels.spawn.others`| Teleport others with `/spawn`. | `op` |
| `conicduels.kit` | Access to kit commands. | `true` |
| `conicduels.kiteditor`| Access to kit editor. | `true` |
| `conicduels.givekit` | Give kits to others. | `op` |
| `conicduels.arenas.admin`| Manage arenas. | `op` |
| `conicduels.party` | Access to party commands. | `true` |
| `conicduels.duel` | Access to duel commands. | `true` |
| `conicduels.reload` | Reload the plugin. | `op` |
| `conicduels.spectate` | Spectate duels. | `true` |
| `conicduels.bypass.cooldown` | Bypass all cooldowns. | `op` |
| `conicduels.bypass.build` | Bypass build restrictions. | `op` |
| `conicduels.bypass.break` | Bypass break restrictions. | `op` |

---

## 📥 Installation
1.  Download the latest **ConicDuels.jar** **and** **ConicArena.jar**.
2.  Place them in your `/plugins` folder.
3.  Ensure you also have **FastAsyncWorldEdit** or **WorldEdit** installed if you plan on using arenas with auto-reset.
4.  Start your server.
5.  Configure zones using `/conic setspawn` & `/conic setediting`.
6.  Enjoy a full-featured Practice Core system!

💬 Support & Issues
Github: [Click Here](https://github.com/SwarajDev5/ConicCore/issues/)

title: Between Horizons
description: An expanded world of Minecraft to explore and build in
body:
## Overview
Between Horizons is a mod-pack that aims to create a incredible world to explore, mine in, and or build in. Featuring an array of biome and world generation mods, and so much more. An adventure awaits you, find your way between the horizons!

## What's included?
🌎- Vast Immersive World: Explore a breath taking world created by putting Tectonic, Terralith, BOP, Geophilic, and OTBYG along with a series of structure mods and Immerive Weathering all together. A vast world unfolds before you  with hundreds of unique biomes and incredible continents to explore. 

🛠️- Tools & Weapons: Good ol' Tinkers offers the tried and tested way of creating epic tools and weapons, while Tetra offers a different take on crafting and upgrading yours tools while requiring you to delve into the depths beneath mountains to find ancient ruins. Choose your prefered style of tool craft and pave your way!

🌦️- Seasons: Serene Seaons will transform the world around you as you go through the four seasons, bringing different weather patterns and affecting how your crops grow and the fauna around you!

🏗️✨- Building & Decoration: Thousands of blocks from Dustrial Decor, Chipped, Chisled, Stoneworks, and many more mods give you a wide variety of blocks and decorations to create impressive builds! Go crazy!

⚙️- Optimizations: Mods like Embeddium, AI Improvements, Bad Optimizations, Entity Culling and several more do their best to help keep the modpack running as smooth as possible. Be sure though that you have a decent computer!



<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- It is strongly recommend that you give this pack **AT LEAST 8GB's of RAM**. Lower clock speeds may encounter issues running at the min RAM.
- Using higher resolution texture packs and or shaders with this pack may impact performance. Performance issues if high res texture packs or shaders are out of our control and may entirely depend on your hardware and resource allocations

</details>




<details>
<summary>Known Issues</summary>
While the pack is stable at this time, there could be issues that have not been yet found. As any new issues are found that can-not be solved or are awaiting fixes from mod devs, they will be posted here. Please check back here if you encounter an issue to see if it has been posted.
</details>

description: Redirect <world name>/serverconfig to config folder
body: This mod redirects the /serverconfig directory to the legacy config directory. This allows settings configured there to **automatically synchronize across worlds** upon modification, eliminating the need to manually manage defaultconfigs. Note: This redirection only affects mods utilizing the Forge Config API. Mods that write files _directly_ into the world-specific directory (e.g., voicechat) remain unaffected. Note: In my own modpack containing over 200 mods, all files that were not redirected by this mod were not actual configuration files. Their contents typically resembled notices like # This config has been moved to config/voicechat/voicechat-server.properties.

title: I AM HERE
description: A simple mod that helps players share their coordinates and location visually with others. Just type /iamhere to broadcast your position and briefly glow to be seen easily. Perfect for multiplayer exploration.
body:
# I Am Here Mod

## Overview

**"I Am Here"** is a lightweight coordinate sharing mod for Minecraft.  
It allows players to quickly let others know where they are by using a simple command.

Ideal for multiplayer adventures, this mod enhances communication and visibility without needing voice chat or map mods.

## Features

- 🔹 Use the `/iamhere` command to share your current coordinates in the chat.
- ✨ Your player glows for 5 seconds when you run the command.
- 🌍 The message includes dimension info (Overworld, Nether, End).

## How to Use

1. Open the in-game chat (default: `T` key).
2. Type `/iamhere` and press Enter.
3. Your coordinates will be broadcasted to all players, and you’ll glow briefly.

## Installation

1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/).
2. Download and place [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) in your `mods` folder.
3. Download and place this mod's `.jar` file in your `mods` folder.
4. Launch Minecraft.

## Compatibility

- Minecraft: `1.21.5`
- Fabric Loader: `0.16.12+`
- Requires: `Fabric API`
- Java: `21+`

## Author

**IzmYuta**

## Source Code

[https://github.com/IzmYuta/iamhere](https://github.com/IzmYuta/iamhere)

---

🧭 This mod was made to help players locate each other more easily in multiplayer games.  
It’s simple, effective, and made to improve coordination without adding complexity.

title: Simple Scheduled Messages
description: Configure messages to be sent by the server at regular intervals
body:
# Simple Scheduled Messages
A basic plugin that allows you to configure messages that will cycle in order with the specified delay time.

These messages use [MiniMessage Formatting](https://webui.advntr.dev/) and can be very basic or very complex.

Also allows admins to send server broadcasts with `/broadcastmsg <message>` that also use minimessage formatting. 
It is recommended to only give this permission to trusted users, as minimessage can be used to run commands and open urls

| Command               | Permission         | Description                                           |
|-----------------------|--------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|
| `/smreload`           | messages.reload    | Allows the user to reload the configs                 |
| `/automessage toggle` | messages.toggle    | Allows the user to pause/resume auto-messages         |
| `/broadcastmsg`       | messages.broadcast | Allows the user to send a message to the whole server |

| **Permissions**      | Description                            |
|----------------------|----------------------------------------|
| `messages`           | Allows plugin functionality            |
| `messages.reload`    | Allows reloading the plugin            |
| `messages.toggle`    | Allows toggling auto-messages on/off   |
| `messages.broadcast` | Allows sending a message to the server |

## Default Config:
```yml
# delay between messages in seconds
delay-time: 10
messages-to-display:
  - "test"
  - "test 2"
  - "<red>Test in color</red>"
  - "<gradient:red:dark_blue>other test in color</gradient>"
```

title: Terracraft
description: Minecraft how you have never experienced before. A minimalistic modpack focused on visual enhancements, performance and Create support.
body:
# Experience a New Era of Minecraft

Discover a groundbreaking Fabric-based modpack that blends stunning visuals, advanced mechanics, and smooth performance to redefine your Minecraft adventure. This modpack focuses on bringing together the most stunning mods for visual enhancements and Create.

![Iris + Create + Distant Horizons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/88492120f2a439e3fd7a18d2a8131f999fc48023.png)

Elevate your Minecraft experience with a modpack that fuses stunning graphics, innovative automation, and uncompromising performance. Dive into a world where every block, mechanic, and landscape detail is designed to create an adventure unlike any other.

---

## Graphics & Visuals

- **Enhanced Render Distance:**  
  Enjoy vastly increased render distances with **Distant Horizons** that transform your exploration experience.

- **Shader Variety:**  
  Choose from multiple pre-configured shader packs:  
  - **Bliss:** For ultra-photorealistic visuals.  
  - **Complementary Reimagined:** Offers a beautifully refined vanilla aesthetic.  
  - **Rethinking Voxels:** Focuses on path tracing and realistic shadows.

- **PBR Texture Packs:**  
  Experience blocks rendered with lifelike detail that perfectly complement the shader options.


## Full Create Mod Support

- **Dynamic Mechanics:**  
  Immerse yourself in new automation and mechanics courtesy of the **Create** mod, making complex constructions and processes intuitive.

- **Enhanced Transportation:**  
  Navigate your world with:
  - **Airships (Immersive Aircrafts):** Seamlessly integrated with Create mechanics for a unique crafting experience.
  - **Ships (Small Ships):** Maintain a classic feel while expanding your transportation options.


## Realism & Quality-of-Life Improvements

- **Immersive Realism:**  
  Enjoy a more authentic survival experience with added systems like **Thirst** and **Temperature**, bringing an extra layer of challenge and immersion.

- **User-Friendly Tools:**  
  Quality-of-life mods such as **NEI**, **Journey Map**, and **Inventory Tweaks** streamline gameplay without overwhelming the classic Minecraft charm.

- **Reworked Terrain:**  
  With **Lithosphere**, explore landscapes featuring higher mountain ranges, deeper valleys, and more realistic terrain generation.


## Optimized Performance

Every mod is meticulously selected and tweaked to ensure:
- **Seamless Integration:** A vanilla-like look and feel that respects Minecraft’s original design.
- **Smooth Gameplay:** Robust optimization mods that keep your game running effortlessly even as you push the visual boundaries.

---

## Multiplayer Support
This modpack was build with multiplayer in mind. Each release includes a pre-configured server release file that includes all required server side mods and additional optimizations and tools (e.g. chunky). To run the server, extract the server file to your Minecraft Server directory. The release file also includes a bash script that automatically downloads and runs the latest fabric server executable.

---

## Known Issues

- Using the Bliss shader can sometimes lead to smearing / dublication in the skybox. To fix this disable and enable Distant Horizon in the settings or restart the game.

## Important Notes

- It is highly recommended to run the server on a seperat device due to performance reason. A high frequency CPU with at least 8 cores and at least 24GB of memory is recommended.
- When running the server, use chunky to pregenerate chunks and Distant Horizon LoDs, so players can take full advantage of Distant Horizon even in mutiplayer sessions.
- When using other shaders make sure to increate the cloud height to at least 300, since mountains ranges will have a height of up to y=500.
- If running on lower end hardware, it is recommended to use the pre-configured version of Complementary shaders or disable shaders all togehter. In addition try and avoid playing at higher resolutions as this will drastically affect your FPS.

---

## Credits
The following mods have been included from external sources:

- [Create Immersive Aircrafts](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/create-immersive-aircrafts-resource-pack): nicky__21
- [Create Immersive Aircraft - Warship](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/create-immersive-aircraft-warship): crazyfl_
- [Bliss Shader Development Version](https://github.com/X0nk/Bliss-Shader): X0nk

title: Aelven Expansion
description:
A mod about magical creatures, places, and resources.
This mod adds a bunch of blocks, mostly for decoration because it is in early development. Enjoy!
body:
![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/75H9zNF3/images/35a3987084df3472a4f7f364605f313678617440.png)

Our mod adds a bunch of blocks, mostly for decoration because it is in early development. Enjoy!


## 📖 Contents:

Our mod is mostly focused on a new dimension called Aelfheim. Currently, there is no way to get into Aelfheim in survival mode, you have to use a command `/execute in aelven_expansion:aelfheim run tp ~ ~ ~`. At the moment our mod only has many blocks, some features and structures, and one unfinished mob. But we plan on adding more magical creatures, places, and items, and making it accessible in survival. Some features are somewhat half-baked for now and is still being worked on.


### Some of the main features of Aelfheim are its Biomes:
- Chalk Peaks, with a thick layer of chalk dust on the surface, and chitta underneath.
- Silverblood Rise, a forest of slanted trees and flowers matching the trees.
- Moon Fir Wilds, a darker variant of Silverblood Rise.
- Drystone Plains, a desolate land made of drystone and chipstone gravel, with spires of chipstone jutting out of the ground, slashes of chipstone through the ground, and scattered spots of petrified trees and plants.
- Peachgrove Swamp, a swamp of trees with thick trunks and round leaves and flowers that match, the ground covered in a mix of mud and mulch, and mudstone underneath.
- Hydosatin Forest, a fungus forest submerged in water, the fungus tree made of a thick trunk and large round cap, the ground made of jadegrass nylium with hydrojade underneath, and the ground sparsely covered with jadegrass, hydrosatin sprouts, and luminescent kelp.

If you are a builder, you may appreciate knowing about our beam and stripped beam blocks that have variations for each vanilla wood and fungus type along with each one added in this mod, and our shingles blocks with 16 color variants and stair, slab, and wall blocks as well.

More info can soon be found on [the wiki](https://github.com/AnonymousVoid/AelvenExpansion/wiki/Aelven-Expansion-Mod-Wiki), which is currently under development.


## 📥 Installation:

Make sure you have forge downloaded for the correct version of Minecraft you wish to run the mod on, from 1.19.2+.  Simply drop the mod into your mods folder, and no other mods or downloads are required.


## ✅ Compatibility:

Aelven Expansion has optional compatibility with Just Enough Items (JEI).

More compatibility options are possible in the future.


## 🐞 Reporting Issues:

Please use the [issue tracker](https://github.com/AnonymousVoid/AelvenExpansion/issues) linked in our external resources to submit issues and bugs found whilst using the mod.



## ❓ Frequently Asked Questions:

We will have a wiki with some of the most frequently asked questions addressed here.

We hope you enjoy our mod!

# WELCOME TO MY FIRST MODPACK!

## version20 UPDATE!
- I updated the entire modlist! Please check it out when you have the chance!
- **PLEASE DO NOT USE THE v20 PACK ON A WORLD YOU USED v10 WITH, THIS WILL BREAK YOUR GAME.**

Some mods/datapacks you may be familiar with include [Sounds](https://modrinth.com/mod/sound), [Serene Seasons](https://modrinth.com/mod/serene-seasons), [Cliff Tree](https://modrinth.com/datapack/clifftree), [Chipped](https://modrinth.com/mod/chipped), [Handcrafted](https://modrinth.com/mod/handcrafted), [Tom's Simple Storage](https://modrinth.com/mod/toms-storage), and some of [purejosh's](https://modrinth.com/user/purejosh) tools/weapons! 

## version10 & ALL FUTURE VERSIONS!
My modpack aims to only add a handful of mods that add new features to the game, while simultaneously keeping it simple and feel as if Mojang added the features themselves.

It adds new structures for players to explore in the overworld and nether with the use of [Dungeons and Taverns](https://modrinth.com/datapack/dungeons-and-taverns), while also adding new rare caves to the overworld as well with the use of [Alex's Caves](https://modrinth.com/mod/alexs-caves)!

Play with your friends easily by opening up a server with the use of [Essential](https://modrinth.com/mod/essential), a mod that aims at providing a very beginner friendly experience to opening up a simple server, right from the game!

You'll find new beautifully designed mobs roaming your entire minecraft world with [Alex's Mobs](https://modrinth.com/mod/alexs-mobs), which adds 89 new creatures to the game!

Make windmills, trains, or even elevators with the use of [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create), where you can defy the rules of Vanilla minecraft while also keeping it within the confines of what Vanilla+ really stands for.

Finally, make fulfilling foods that can add 2 new buffs to the player with the use of [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight), which adds new crops, new cooking mechanics, and new foodstuffs that the player can use to aid themselves around their world!

I only covered a couple of the big mods that are included in this little modpack, but there's even more for you to discover!

This modpack also includes lots of optimization mods that will make your game run smoothly, so expect your PC to not EXPLODE when running this pack. This is thanks to the other famous modpack [Simply Optimized](https://modrinth.com/modpack/sop) of course, so all thanks goes to that modpack creator.

title: RPChat
description: Server mod that adds local chatting for roleplay servers
body:
# RPChat

RPChat is a fairly simple mod that adds in a handful of commands useful for roleplay servers:

- /localchat : Send a message in local chat. Only players within 30 blocks of you can see this message.
- /globalchat : Sends a normal chat message.
- /shout : Sends a message in shout chat. Players within 80 blocks of you can see this message. Message appears bolded.
- /whisper : Sends a message in whisper chat. Only players within 5 blocks of you can see this message. Message appears gray and italicized.
- /ooc : Sends a message in out of character chat. Message appears gold.
- /chatmode : Allows you to change what chat you type in by default. Options are global, local, shout, whisper, and ooc.


## Configuration

Commands can be enabled / disabled in the config. Text formatting for each mode can additionally be enabled / disabled, and all ranges are configurable. Additionally, /chatmode can be toggled to be only for ops.

## Installation

Requires [Fabric Api](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api). Only needs to be installed on the server.

## Compatibility

This breaks chat reporting! Mods like [No Chat Reports](https://modrinth.com/mod/no-chat-reports) should still function, but if no such mods exist most messages will not be reportable.

May or may not break discord chat mods, AdvancedChat should work fine (both untested)

### FAQ

- Forge? Maybe later, don't ask.
- Backport? No.
- Update? Maybe.

title: Comet
description:
Expanding the vanilla game with carefully approached design!
In this update: New content for The End!
body:
![imagen](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/75187144/214413931-eb104440-8357-4170-8c5d-40b5f6084eb4.png) # Comet 1.0.0 Comet is a mod that aims to give more life to those parts of the game that feel undeveloped, in a vanilla-friendly way, following logical design choices and trying to respect Vanilla Minecraft's design tendencies. In this first release, Comet introduces new content to The End, in a way that tries to give a definitive answer to the little controversy regarding this dimension's identity, and how to approach it when adding content.
Important notice This first release contains a lot of concepts that can, and will, be developed upon in future versions. This mod is being released as an ALPHA, and while some features are almost completely fleshed out, it is likely for some others to not work as intended.

Do not put any valuable world at risk with this mod, since some features are likely to be tweaked, specially The End's world generation. While in most cases the worst thing that could happen is losing this mod's items, The End dimension is influenced by a world generation datapack and some world generation custom code that will 100% worked upon a lot more in the future, and it's unpredictable if newer versions will adapt well enough to older world generation, which can lead to splitted terrain generation at the borders of old chunks. If any issues, or compatibility problems arise during the gameplay with this mod, please, let me know through any of the communication channels I will provide you with below.
# TLDR; What does this mod do? 1. If you haven't already, it'd be best for you to read the previous notice, thank you! 2. Added new blocks to The End's terrain generation with interesting new mechanics! (When you think you've already found everything try using night vision) 3. Crystallization: transport mobs in a more convenient and vanilla-like way or turn them into decorative statues! You can also make crystallization potions to temporarily stun mobs, and even crystallize yourself! 4. Added a new mineral to The End, a tube-like formation of organic origin with its own unique way to look for! Not simply diggin' at low level altitudes! Make with it an armor set or the portal shield! 5. Much more content that you can check in the details below! ## The mod in-depth I've made a video showcasing the mod's design philosohpy and some of its main features, if you have some time to spare, you can check it out by clicking the image below!
Before you watch this video Be warned that this video has more of a 'Minecraft Lore Theories' format, if you just want to get to the point and see what the mod adds, click the link I provide to you below the embedded video, or visit the 'Gallery' section of this page for a even quicker overview.
[![LINK TO THE VIDEO](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/75187144/215266035-b62f1465-8470-4e7f-af0e-b19a615a5961.png)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6egN9DBdxKE) If you don't want to watch a video, you can check all this mod adds in its wiki with the link below: [-→ LINK TO THE WIKI ←-](https://github.com/Soulphur0/Comet/wiki) ## FAQ ### Can I modify or redistribute the mod? You can work upon the mod's source and/or redistribute it, as long as you give credit to the original author and use the same license. I recommend reading the license below for more information. ### Will a port for Forge ever be made? I do have plans to personally port this mod to Forge, but notice that these plans are in the very long run. So please, bear in mind it won't happen anytime soon and refer to this notice when asking for a port. Also,I might change my mind in the future and not port it myself, it's unlikely but not impossible. ### Can I port the mod to Forge? License allows you to do it, and so do I. But notice that everyone has the right to port it to Forge, and even if ports were made by third parties I may eventually publish a port under the name of "Official Forge Port". ## Licensing This project is licensed under the Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported license. A copy of the license can be found at https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/3.0/legalcode ## Attributions All sound effects in this project are modifications of already existing sounds in vanilla Minecraft or a mix of the sounds of the following sources, which also were modified in some cases. None of the sounds used belong to me, and credit should be given to their corresponding authors.

title: SilentBan
description: Silently bans people with a custom reason
body:
# SilentBan

## A discreet moderation solution for Minecraft servers

SilentBan provides server administrators with a powerful tool to handle problematic players without creating drama or drawing attention to moderation actions. When a player is silently banned, they receive a customizable connection error message instead of the standard ban notification, preventing them from knowing they've been banned while effectively removing them from your server.

### Key Features

* **Stealth Moderation**: Ban players without them knowing they've been banned
* **Customizable Error Messages**: Set your own connection error text to display to banned players
* **Simple Commands**: Easy-to-use commands for banning, unbanning, and viewing banned players
* **UUID Support**: Tracks players by UUID to prevent ban evasion through name changes
* **Ban Reasons**: Store and view reasons for each ban to keep track of moderation history
* **Permissions-Based**: Fine-grained permission system for server staff
* **Lightweight**: Minimal performance impact on your server
* **Developer API**: Easy integration with other plugins

### How It Works

When a banned player attempts to join your server, they'll see what appears to be a connection error rather than a ban message. This prevents them from immediately creating alternate accounts, as they might assume the issue is temporary or related to their own connection. The plugin maintains a separate list from Minecraft's built-in ban system, allowing for complete discretion in your moderation actions.

### Commands

* `/silentban <player> [reason]` - Silently ban a player with an optional reason
* `/silentunban <player>` - Remove a player from the silent ban list
* `/silentbanlist` - View all silently banned players and their ban reasons

### Permissions

* `silentban.ban` - Permission to use the silentban command
* `silentban.unban` - Permission to use the silentunban command
* `silentban.list` - Permission to view the list of silently banned players

### Configuration

The plugin is highly configurable, allowing you to:

* Customize the "error" message shown to banned players
* Enable or disable console logging of silent bans
* Set automatic save intervals for the banned players database
* Toggle anonymous usage metrics

### Why Choose This Plugin?

Server moderation often creates community drama when players discover they've been banned. This plugin solves that problem by making bans appear as technical issues. It's perfect for:

* Handling trolls and griefers without giving them the satisfaction of knowing they've been banned
* Quietly removing problematic players during active investigations
* Managing temporary bans without public announcement
* Reducing ban-related drama and retaliation on community platforms

SilentBan has been designed with both small community servers and large networks in mind, providing a valuable addition to any administrator's toolkit.

### Installation

1. Download the plugin JAR file
2. Place it in your server's plugins folder
3. Restart your server
4. Configure the plugin via the generated config.yml file
5. Start using the commands to manage problematic players discreetly

For support, feature requests, or to report bugs, please visit the project's issue tracker.

title: daxecraft
description: Tiny client and server pack for daxe's community.
body:
# daxecraft
The client and server pack for daxe's community Minecraft server.

It has been designed to work with vanilla clients, only modifying server-side behavior. The client side of the pack is optional, including pre-configured tweaks and connected mods such as [Customizable Player Models](https://modrinth.com/plugin/custom-player-models) and [Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat).

On the server's side, not much has been changed from Vanilla behavior. Simple Voice Chat, [Pl3xMap](https://modrinth.com/plugin/pl3xmap), and [AutoWhitelist](https://modrinth.com/mod/autowhitelist) have been pre-configured according to the allocations provided by Modrinth Hosting. Many administration mods are included to keep players protected without restricting player experience. Quality of life mods may be added over time!

Overall, the current goal is to keep the server simple. It may pivot to a fully modded experience in the future, however, the server will always have its roots in vanilla Minecraft.

### Server Pack
Other than the server's world, the server is designed to be stateless. Everything that defines the server is contained within this pack as well! Thanks to Modrinth Hosting, who provided the server, for implementing an easy way to install and update server mod packs.

### Credits
No third-party projects are packaged within the mod pack file, but there will be. The credits for these projects will be found [in the `credits.md` file](credits.md). This file will be included in the pack's export as well!

title: Tellurium
description: QOL features for casual players and PvPers
body:
## Tellurium

**Tellurium** is a lightweight, highly customizable quality-of-life mod designed to improve clarity, awareness, and control without cluttering your screen. Whether you're playing competitively or just want a cleaner experience, Tellurium gives you the tools to stay informed and in control.

---

### Features

#### Smart Indicators

Stay aware of important situations with clean, minimal indicators:

* **Low Health** alert
* **Low Armor** durability warning
* **Burning** indicator
* **Elytra equipped** indicator
* **Shield stun** warning
* **Repot reminder** (when strength/speed are about to expire)
* **Totem warning** when not in offhand
* **Mace slow-fall** indicator

All indicators support **custom size and screen offset** for perfect positioning.

---

#### Combat & Feedback

* **3-block hit sound** for accurate reach feedback
* **Remove death animations** for clearer visuals
* **Flexible enchantment level display**

  * Vanilla
  * Decimal
  * Roman
  * Both

---

#### Hitbox Customization

Modify how hitboxes are rendered:

* Conditional hitboxes (speed-based, crawling/swimming, elytra use)
* Custom colors and toggles for:

  * Passive mobs
  * Neutral mobs
  * Hostile mobs
  * Players
  * Items
 
* Option to hide:

  * Eye boxes
  * Look vectors
 
* F3+B state stored between game sessions
* Custom thickness

---

#### Controls & Movement

* **Inverted sprinting** option
* **GUI sneaking** (stay sneaking while opening menus)

---

#### UI & Quality of Life

* Adjustable **chat textbox opacity**
* **Store chat messages** when closing chat

---

#### Full Customization

* Full **RGBA color control** (including opacity)
* Adjustable indicator **size and position**
* Dedicated configuration menus for hitboxes and indicators

---

### Configuration

Access everything through the in-game **Tellurium Configuration** screen (requires [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) + [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) or [Ukulib](https://modrinth.com/mod/ukulib) on versions older than 2.0.0)

title: Create: Alchemy
description: This mod uses my new Modern Elements mod to add chemical processing to the Create mod
body:
This mod adds new machines to process items into chemicals and to use those chemicals to make other resources. 

Currently, there is just one new machine called the Dissolver. There will be more in the future of course. 

The Dissolver breaks items into chemicals (Solids, Liquids, and Gases), the solids are able to be pulled out from the sides of the Dissolver while the Liquids and Gases are pushed from the Dissolver Tanks placed above the machine.

There are recipes right now to melt the chemical dusts into fluids and to turn the dusts into the nuggets. 

Dusts can be gotten from the Dissolver for various recipes

![banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5c4b07eeb75d62b713be6b7ce96b60ece62e3a48_0.webp) # ⭐ xVoidSpawn – Advanced Anti-Void & Spawn Management
xVoidSpawn is a lightweight, optimized, and fully configurable Anti-Void plugin designed for modern Minecraft servers. It automatically rescues players when they fall into the void and safely teleports them to a configured spawn location — preventing unnecessary deaths and keeping your lobby or minigame experience smooth and professional. Perfect for hubs, SkyBlock, void maps, minigames, and large server networks.
--- ## 🚀 Key Features ### 🛡 Intelligent Anti-Void System Automatically teleports players to a safe spawn when they fall below a configurable Y-level. ### ✈ Spawn on Join Optionally teleport players to the main spawn every time they join the server. title: Immersive TFC (Frozen)
description: Modpack which includes and integrates TFC, Immersive Engineering, Immersive Aircrafts and etc.
body:
Modpack is frozen(for now). Check my new modpack Create: Space Travel on Discord:https://discord.gg/xnhpuBaB
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

![Immersive TFC](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9e72366671084332e9700d51eb51203bb018c309.png)

From the Stone Age to the Steel Skies — Forge your path in an expanded, cohesive, and challenging world.

**Overview:**
Immersive TFC is a meticulously crafted survival and progression-focused modpack that seamlessly blends the brutal realism of TerraFirmaCraft (TFC) with the deep industrial engineering of Immersive Engineering and the rewarding exploration enabled by Immersive Aircrafts. This is not a simple kitchen-sink pack; it's an integrated experience where technology evolves naturally from the ground up, and every advancement feels earned.

**The Core Vision:**
The pack completely overhauls the early and mid-game Minecraft experience. You start with TFC's realistic geology, metallurgy, and survival mechanics — knapping your first tools, building a bloomery for wrought iron, and mastering agriculture. This foundational struggle makes the eventual transition into industrial power profoundly satisfying.

**Key Integrated Mods & Features:**

**TerraFirmaCraft:** The unchallenged king of the early game. Defines your start with its detailed world generation, layered rock system, realistic metalworking (smelting, alloying, blacksmithing), and a thirst and nutrition system that matters.
**Immersive Engineering:** The logical and aesthetic successor to TFC's metallurgy. Once you master steel, you graduate to IE's dieselpunk machinery. Build multiblock crushers, fermenters, and arc furnaces. Automate with conveyors and powerful wired electricity. Its industrial aesthetic perfectly complements the hand-crafted feel of TFC.
**Immersive Aircrafts:** Your reward for reaching the industrial age. Exploration is now redefined. Build custom biplanes, helicopters, and airships from IE's steel and components to conquer vast TFC landscapes and discover rare resources. Travel becomes strategic and thrilling.
Supporting Cast for a Cohesive World:

**Create:** Just additional mod with cuted features. Adds unparalleled kinetic automation and detailed craftsmanship, fitting perfectly between TFC's mechanics and IE's industry.
**Farmer's Delight:** Expands TFC's food system with more crops, cooking pots, and meals, making the nutrition system diverse and engaging.
**Supplementaries:** For detailed and functional decoration that matches the pack's aesthetic.
Performance & Atmosphere: Sodium / Iris ensure the world is beautiful, immersive, and runs smoothly.
**What Makes This Pack Unique?**

**Seamless Progression:** Recipes are customized (via Datapack(for now, later will be moved to KubeJS)) to create a unified tech tree. IE machines require TFC-style anvil work; aircraft frames need specific treated woods and steel plates. Nothing feels out of place.

**Exploration-Driven:** TFC's world generation creates vast, unique landscapes. Immersive Aircrafts doesn't just add travel—it makes it essential to find different ores, biomes, and hidden structures scattered across continents.

**Balance & Challenge:** The pack is carefully tuned to avoid skipping stages. You can't magic away ores; you must process them. Power generation requires thought and infrastructure. The journey from a pit kiln to a flying machine is long, challenging, and incredibly rewarding.

**For Players Who Want:**

A long-term, goal-oriented survival world.
The satisfaction of realistic progression and meaningful automation.
A world that demands and rewards exploration.
A cohesive "feel" where all mods serve a unified vision, not just a collection of features.
Begin your journey. Master the earth, harness industry, and take to the skies.
**Also, join our Discord server to track procces of development:** https://discord.gg/xnhpuBaB


</details>

title: Project Time Master: Reforged
description: Control the flow of time! Accelerate your base, items and machines with this addon.
body:
**Master time, accelerate your machines, and control the day-night cycle in Minecraft!**

### 📖 About

**Project Time Master: Reforged** is a dedicated addon for **ProjectE**, bringing back the powerful Tiers Time Watches mechanics to modern Minecraft.

This project is a **modern rewrite and unofficial port** based on the original [_Project Time_ (1.20.1)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/project-time-master). We analyzed the original logic and rewrote/adapted the code to function natively and efficiently on **NeoForge**, ensuring stability and performance for your modpacks.

### ✨ Features

*   **Time Control:** Fully control the Day/Night cycle. Fast-forward through the night or speed up the day.
    
*   **Tile Entity Acceleration:** Speed up your machines, furnaces, and modded blocks! The Watch accelerates the tick rate of blocks in its range.
    
*   **8 Power Tiers:** From the basic MK1 to the god-tier MK8.
    
    *   **Pedestal Support:** Place the watch on a Dark Matter Pedestal to create an area-of-effect acceleration zone for your base.
        
    *   **Configurable:** Ranges, EMC costs, and bonus ticks are balanced for progression but can be configured.
        
*   **EMC Integration:** Fully integrated with ProjectE's EMC system.
    

### 🛠️ How to Use

1.  **Craft** a Time Watch (requires ProjectE materials).
    
2.  **Hold Right-Click (Shift)** to toggle the watch mode (Charge/ON/OFF).
    
3.  **Right-Click** on a block to accelerate just that block.
    
4.  **Place on a Dark Matter Pedestal** and activate it to speed up all machines in a radius (radius increases with Watch Tier).
    

### 📦 Dependencies

*   **Minecraft** 1.21+
    
*   **NeoForge**
    
*   **ProjectE** (Required)
    

### ⚖️ Credits & License

*   **Original Concept:** Based on the _Project Time Master_ mod and created for complement Project E. All credits for the original idea go to the original authors of these mods
    
*   **Reforged Version:** Developed by **EXPLO**.
    
*   **Assets:** Uses textures inspired by ProjectE and Project Time to maintain visual consistency.

description: A Fabric mod that adds Bedrock Edition (Geyser/Floodgate) compatibility to Universal Graves.
body:
**What does it do?**
Universal Graves uses Polymer to render virtual blocks and display entity based graves. Java players see a nice custom grave. Bedrock players joining through Geyser often see nothing at all or just interact with an invisible block.

This server side addon translates Universal Graves into something Bedrock understands. It only affects Bedrock players. Java players still see the original grave.

For Bedrock players near a grave, the mod
1. Renders a skeleton skull block at the grave position
1. Spawns an invisible armor stand to show grave text
1. Spawns an invisible fox holding the first grave item as a visual hint
1. When a Bedrock player opens the grave user interface, the mod swaps Polymer player head buttons for simple vanilla icons so the menu makes sense.

**Requirements**
- Minecraft Java 1.21.10 (Tested)
- Fabric Loader plus Fabric API
- Universal Graves
- Geyser
- Floodgate recommended for detection

Drop the jar in your server mods folder, restart, and Bedrock players should finally see where they died.

title: [CXPT]Create:XPTool
description: A lightweight and practical utility mod for Create that adds a tool to convert your player experience into tangible Experience Nuggets.
body:
# XP Tools - Experience Storage & Risky Conversion

## ✨ Features

### New: Hammer of Experience
This update introduces the volatile **Hammer of Experience**! Available in four variants: Iron, Copper, Gold, and Diamond.

*   **Charging Mechanic:**
    *   Hold the hammer and **Right-click** to consume **1 experience level** per use to charge it.
    *   Charging significantly **increases the hammer's attack damage**.

*   **Risk Mechanic - Overload Explosion!**
    *   Each hammer has an experience limit. **Exceeding this limit causes the hammer to explode!**
    *   The **explosion** is slightly weaker than TNT, **destroys terrain**, and damages all nearby entities (but not the player who caused it).
    *   The hammer is **destroyed** in the explosion. Charge with caution!

*   **Visual Feedback:**
    *   The hammer has **3 distinct textures** that change based on its charge level, providing a clear visual indicator of the current risk.

*   **Crafting:**
    *   Crafted with a new recipe:
        ```
        a = Create Experience Nugget
        b = Metal Block (Iron/Copper/Gold/Diamond)
        c = Stick

        Pattern:
        a b a
        a c a
        a c a
        ```

### Original: XP Tool
The original XP Tool remains, offering a stable and safe way to convert experience.

*   **Primary Function (Right-click):** Consumes 3 experience levels to generate one Create **Experience Nugget**.
*   **Special Attack:** When used as a weapon, **each hit** causes the target to drop 3 Experience Nuggets.
*   **Durability & Enchanting:** Has 32 durability and can be enchanted with Unbreaking, Mending, and Curse of Vanishing.

## 🧾 Crafting Recipes

*   **XP Tool:**
    ```
    [ Brass Ingot ]
    [  Piston     ]
    [ Iron Sheet  ]
    ```

*   **Hammer of Experience:**
    ```
    [Nugget] [Metal Block] [Nugget]
    [Nugget] [   Stick   ] [Nugget]
    [Nugget] [   Stick   ] [Nugget]
    ```

## ⚙️ Technical Info

*   **Minecraft Version:** 1.20.1
*   **Mod Loader:** Forge (Minimum: 43.4.0)
*   **Required Dependency:** [**Create**](https://www.modrinth.com/mod/create)
*   **Client/Server:** Required on both sides.

## 🙏 Credits & Dependencies

This mod relies on and thanks the following projects:
*   **[Create](https://www.modrinth.com/mod/create)**: This mod is an addon and uses the `experience_nugget` item. Created by **simibubi** and the **Create team**, it is also open-source under the MIT License. A huge thank you for such an amazing foundation.

## ❓ FAQ

**Q: Will the Hammer of Experience's explosion kill me?**
**A: No!** The explosion is designed to only damage other entities and destroy the terrain. However, the hammer itself will be lost.

**Q: Can I use this mod in my modpack?**
**A:** Absolutely! Feel free to use it under the terms of the MIT license.

## 📜 Development Note & Disclaimer

**Important:** This mod was a learning project. As I do not know Java, development was done entirely with the assistance of **DeepSeek AI**.

**This means:**
1.  The code may not be optimal.
2.  **Long-term maintenance and updates are a significant challenge.**
3.  I may be unable to fix compatibility issues with other mods promptly.
4.  Therefore, **this mod may not receive frequent updates or be ported to future versions.**

I share it hoping someone finds it useful. Developers are welcome to use it as a base for improvements!

## 📄 License

This project is licensed under the **MIT License**.

title: Hyrinity (Legacy)
description: An overall content mod adding progression, bosses, dimensions and more!
body:
# Hyrinity
### v1.1.

## [!] Important [!]

_If you wish to use Hyrinity in a mod pack, if the damage and hp system collides with another mod you can simply disable hyrinity's system by doing_ **/gamerule hyrCompatibilityMode true**
### Note: you may have to clear off resistance from entities if compatibility wasn't already on before.


- The default key to open the menu is [home]
- Highly recommend you use Just Enough Items or a recipe mod alongside this mod if you do not have a modpack.


The mod is an overall content mod, adding multiple things such as:

- Unique and diverse lore.
- Custom and themed dimensions.
- Minibosses and full on boss fights.
- Several biomes within the custom dimensions.
- Custom mechanics, such as a fully decked out damage and health system, weapon and armor classes (Melee, Mage, Ranger) and more!
- Many new items, armor, tools, weapons, blocks and other decorative things.

# Combat
- When you strike a mob, after a second or so you will hear a little click sound indicating you can strike and deal full damage again. This is the cooldown system.
- When wielding a Hyrinity bow, it will not properly fire if you are holding a shield in your off hand.


### Health
- The mod uses a completely customized system as opposed to Minecraft's.
- Your base HP will always be 50 unless modified via gamerule.
- You can upgrade your HP by consuming Nature, Lava and Moon Hearts.

### Mana
- Mana gets consumed when using a magic item or weapon.
- To regenerate mana, you need the **Mana Regeneration Stone** which can be upgraded to make faster regen possible.
- Similarly to Health, Mana has **Crystal Stars**, again allowing for a default of 15 possible consumptions.

### Defense
- This is the mod's version of armor points, the more you have the less damage you will take from most things that care about defense.

### Level
- The leveling system consists of your Player Level, and the skill levels.
Your player's level affects several components of gameplay. Such as Combat, Crafting, Mining and even Exploration.
- Skill levels are always limited to HALF of your max Player Level.
Example: you are player level 10, your max level for skills is 5.
- Player Level is solely leveled up via EXP. Skill levels are a combination of less XP but with their respective Tokens. Example: Melee Token, Ranged Token, ect.

**Melee Level**
- Overall increase to your melee/sword damage output. Will unlock special sword abilities as well.

**Magic Level**
- Levels up your weapons and items, allowing them to be more capable at the cost of less mana.

**Ranged Level**
- Makes ranger items and weapons stronger, making certain accessories aid more in movement and accuracy.

**Mining Level**
- Directly affects your block breaking speed, the higher you level up the faster you will mine.
- Custom dimensions have very strong blocks and exploration in them will be greatly affected by how fast you can mine.
 
**Crafting Level**
- Especially relevant for the **Disk of Enchanting** as well as custom crafting stations that are to come.
- Leveling up your crafting will gain you access to higher power/tier crafting recipes and will allow you to use more altars.

**Movement Level**
- Affects your movement speed and swim speed.
- Changes how effective the boosters are as well as flight time lasting longer the higher you level up.

### Flight
- Flight is simply a number that notifies you on how much you can fly. It does not go down by seconds. Flight can be obtained by crafting items such as **Wings** or any accessory that may allow for flying.


#  Reworked Vanilla Bosses
In Hyrinity, the Warden, Wither and Ender Dragon have all been reworked.

- The Warden has been made into a feasable fight.
- The Wither has been completely overhauled with a few new attacks.
- The Dragon has a huge change, with 5 new attack patterns in store for you.

Reccomendations before going in:
- Make sure you level up your player, as well as your skills.
- Craft the best HP Potions you can
- You do not need max prot gear, although protection is recommended.
- Tier 2 armor is ideal with the Wither and onwards. They can be crafted via the **Obsidian Altar** // **Shadow Bookshelf** // **Earth Smither.**

title: Butch - Mob Drops Reimagined
description: Butch overhauls the mob drops of various mobs to be more involved but more lucrative and adds more uses to some lesser used mobs.
body:
With Butch installed, whenever one of the following mobs is killed, instead of its drops, it will drop its carcass. The carcass can then be put into a Butcher Block with a Butcher's Blade in the blade slot in order to Butch it. Once a carcass is butched, it will reveal up to 4 drops in the slots on the right. The amount is semi-random, but most of the time you'll get at least one item, and sometimes up to 6 for others. The new items can be used in some useful way. For example, with tallow from cows, you can make candles or torches. 

Cow
Horse
Sheep
Squid/Glowsquid
Pig
Rabbit
Goat
Chicken
Llama
Turtle

Butch also adds various extra items to compliment some of the new mob drops, as shown below. There are 4 stages of portable inventories from pouches to backpacks. There's a new bowl made from turtle scute and glue to hold your new turtle stew, new decorative balloons that can be placed midair, and a slingshot you can use to finally give llamas a taste of their own medicine. 


Have ideas for some of the other mobs in the game, or something I should change with the ones already added? Let me know, I'm always open to feedback. Also, you might note that the art is not good. That is because I made it. If you have the desire to contribute better art, I'm also open to that. I will say that I'm sticking to 16x though.

Adds an alternative to Elytra rockets for the create mod by adding obsidian rockets that can be made 100% automatically with no user inputs(with some work). Right now there is no crafting recipe built into the mod as I wanted people to use their imagination to create a craft that works best for them. Crafting can be added using a datapack. As of right now all this mod adds is the item, the crafting recipe you have to decide. There are resources online to help with normal crafting and looking at Create mod data files can help with Create crafting.

Note: Also adds a "useless" incomplete version of the item to allow more room for creativity. I recommend deploying, pressing, filling, or a sequenced assembly of all 3..

Example: Fill brass sheet with lava to make the base, deploy propeller on to finish item.

However, because Create is not a dependency for this mod, you could also add a vanilla or alternative mod crafting recipe. 

To look at mod crafting recipes:
Download the mod
Extract the jar to a folder(on windows change the ending to .zip before doing so)))
go to the folders: (data>modname>recipes)
The jsons will have examples that you can use in a data pack

title: Next Level Twitch Integration
description: A mod for streamers to use, Allows chat to cause chaos
body:
# Welcome To Next Level Twitch Integration We are excited to announce that we have removed all previous versions as we have rebuilt the entire project from the ground up with an emphasis on ease of use. From this point onwards we will be keeping to standard semantic versioning starting again at version 1.0.0 ## Current Version: 1.0.0 ### How to setup the mod In order to use this mod you will need to link your twitch account to the mod, all you need to do is run **/NLTI Link** the mod will then display a clickable URL that you will click onto, this will take you over to the twitch authorisation page where it will tell you that NLTI is requesting access for specific priviledges. You only need to accept this and the mod will handle the rest. You will notice your browser redirect a couple of times, once the mod replies in game with the following **
Connected Twitch Account
Please Reboot Server**
Once you see this you are setup and just need to relaunch the server(if you are using one) or relaunch your game ### General Configuration You will notice 2 configuration files appear.
nlti-config.toml
nlti-token.toml ***Note: DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE***
You only need to work with nlti-config.toml This config will contain only a couple of things;
**base-cooldown**
**blacklisted-mobs**
The base-cooldown is the time in seconds between uses of the same command. blacklisted-mobs is a list of mobs that viewers cannot spawn using the **!mc-mob** command #### Player Commands This is a list of all commands that you will use to run this mod.
- /NLTI Link, This command starts the Linking Process. - /NLTI Unlink, This command resets the authorisation for when the token expires. - /NLTI Start, Enables the viewer commands - /NLTI Stop, Disables the viewer commands - /NLTI Reset, Resets the cooldown on all commands. #### Viewer Commands This is the important part for the viewers so you may want to create a command or overlay showing what the commands are. Note: all commands are case-insensitive
- !MC-Mob (name), This command will spawn the mob next to all players. - !MC-Effect (name), This command gives all players the named effect for 10 seconds - !MC-Time (Day, Noon, Night, Midnight), This command sets the time of day in the overworld. - !MC-Weather (Clear, Cloudy, Raining, Thunder), This command sets the weather in the overworld.
