title: Musify!
description: Music! is a versatile client-side mod designed to improve the immersion and auditory experience of Minecraft for both modpack developers and regular players.
body:
# **_Musify!_**

### _Musify!_ is a versatile client-side mod designed to improve the immersion and auditory experience of Minecraft for both modpack developers and regular players. This mod allows for dynamic music customization based on in-game events like PvE Combat, Biome Exploration, Caving, and more, giving you complete control over Minecraft's soundtrack. Whether you’re crafting an immersive modpack or just want to personalize your solo adventures, _Musify!_ provides a way to bring your world to life with the perfect soundtrack.

## **MUSIFY! 1.2.4 is OUT NOW!**

 

## **Features:**

This mod has a bunch of different features revolving around Minecraft's soundtrack:

*   **Customizable Biome Music!** This Mod allows you to customize and set up music for specific biomes, or for certain biome types. Great for that immersive feel when exploring!
*   **Recurrent Complex, Roguelike Dungeons, and Doomlike Dungeons Support!** Set up custom music for the dungeons and structures added by these three mods!
*   **Combat Music!** Enhance your battle experience by setting up custom combat music!
*   **Cavern Music!** Want to feel like a true Dwarf when mining underground? Customize your worlds underground music for a new experience when mining!
*   **Boss Music!** Customize music for boss mobs for a truely unique experience!
*   **Main Menu Music!** Set up some custom music for Minecraft's main menu to personalize your modpack or client!
*   **Ambient Mode!** Want to use sound effects or ambient tracks instead of music? Enable ambient mode to add to vanilla music instead of replacing it!

This mod can use and play any .ogg or .mp3 sound file! Customization of music is limited to your imagination.

***

## **Installation:**

1\. Install any Forge client for a compatible version.   
2\. Put the Jar file in the Mods folder in your instance.  
3\. (OPTIONAL) Pre-make a music folder containing the .ogg or .mp3 sound files.

## **How to use:**

### _Musify!_ can be difficult to set up, for a tutorial on how to initialize and set up the mod, please refer to [the GitHub page](https://github.com/KwemberDev/BiomeMusic).

   

***

## Disclaimers:

*   **This mod can be installed client-side only, but the structure music for the three mods mentioned above will not work. For that, this mod also needs to be installed on the server side!**
*   While the mod does work with _most_ Modded entities and biomes, some might not work. The mod was tested with mods like DefiledLands and Lycanites, But some mobs from other mods with which the mod was not tested might not be compatible. Similarly for some custom biomes from other mods, they might not be recognized. However, Even if the mod does not recognize a biome, as long as they either have a parent biome or biome tags, the music set using biome tags will still work.

### If you do find any bugs in or crashes coming from the mod, please make an issue of github. (or to request a feature i guess.)

title: Create: Better Material
description: It is much easier to get to Copper-, Iron-, Zinc- and Gold Nuggets!
body:
There were many problems with Create if you wanted to automate Copper-, Iron-, Gold- and Zinc Nuggets. Because the player had to farm Tuff by hand and the outcome when you crushed the tuff isn't really that much.

For that reason, I created three new recipes and one new item.

 

The Steps to automate Copper, Gold etc. :

1.Step

Mix 5 Flint, 1 Cobblestone and 250mb Lava to get Tuff

2. Step

Crush the tuff to get the new item "Material Scrap" (Which is a Flint with fragments of the four materials) and you can get Copper Gold Zinc and Iron Nuggets with a specific chance

3. Step

Crush the Material Scrap to optain one flint and Copper Gold Zinc and Iron Nuggets with a specific chance

title: Save State
description: Rewind time when you die
body:
Adds a classic game-style save state. When you set your spawn (at a bed or respawn anchor), a save is created, and when you die, instead of respawning it reloads that save as if time rewound.

⚠️ **Warning: The mod deletes and manipulates files. I do not recommend using this on a world you care about, in case something goes wrong and your world is deleted or corrupted.**

## Support

Only works in singleplayer because I couldn't think of a good way to handle save states for multiple players. If you want a savepoint-style mod that works in multiplayer, see [Save Point](https://modrinth.com/mod/save-point) (of course, the functionality is not the same)

It should work with mods that add other ways to set your spawn, however it may only work the first time depending on how the mod is written, whereas vanilla beds and respawn anchors can be used multiple times.

---

Inspired by Undertale (I know there are plenty of games with a save system, but I think Undertale's is particularly notable)

title: Minecraft Custom Day/Night Mod
description: A server-side only Fabric mod for Minecraft that allows you to configure the length of day and night.
body:
# ☀️ Custom Day/Night Mod 🌙

> **Take full control of Minecraft's day/night cycle — no client mod needed.**

A lightweight, **server-side only** Fabric mod for Minecraft **1.21.11** that lets you customize exactly how long day and night last in the Overworld. Whether you want marathon building sessions under the sun or short, intense nights — this mod makes it effortless.

[![Fabric](https://img.shields.io/badge/mod%20loader-Fabric-blue)](https://fabricmc.net/)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](LICENSE)
[![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/badge/Modrinth-download-brightgreen)](https://modrinth.com/mod/minecraft-custom-daynight-mod)

---

## ✨ Features

- **Two ways to customize** — use speed multipliers *or* set exact tick-based durations
- **Interactive chat menu** — click buttons in chat to adjust settings live, no client mod required
- **Live duration preview** — the menu shows the resulting day, night, and full cycle lengths in human-readable time
- **Hot-reload config** — change settings on the fly without restarting the server
- **Save & restore defaults** — persist changes to disk or reset everything with one click
- **Safety limits** — values are clamped to safe ranges to prevent server crashes
- **In-game commands** — check status, reload config, set values, and toggle logging from the chat
- **Version-stamped logging** — all console and chat messages include the mod name and version
- **Vanilla-client friendly** — players don't need to install anything
- **Zero world data changes** — safe to add or remove at any time

---

## 🚀 Getting Started

1. Drop the mod `.jar` into your server's `mods/` folder (requires [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/) ≥ 0.18.4 and [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) ≥ 0.141.2).
2. Start the server — a default config file will be created automatically.
3. Run `/customdaynight` in-game to open the **interactive settings menu**, or edit `config/customdaynightmod.properties` directly (see below).
4. Use the menu buttons to tweak values, then click **[Save]** to persist changes to disk.

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

**File:** `config/customdaynightmod.properties`

```properties
# Speed multipliers (1.0 = normal speed, 0.5 = half speed / twice as long)
day_multiplier=1.0
night_multiplier=1.0

# Absolute lengths in ticks (overrides multipliers when > 0)
absolute_day_length=0
absolute_night_length=0

# Log day/night transitions to the server console
log_phase_changes=true
```

> **Quick reference:** 1 Minecraft tick = 50 ms · 20 ticks = 1 second · 12,000 ticks = 10 real-time minutes (the default length of both day and night).

### How it works

| Setting | What it does |
|---|---|
| `day_multiplier` / `night_multiplier` | Scales the *speed* of time progression. A value of `0.5` makes that phase last **twice as long**; `2.0` makes it **twice as fast**. |
| `absolute_day_length` / `absolute_night_length` | Sets the phase duration to an **exact number of ticks**. When set to a value greater than `0`, this takes priority over the multiplier. |
| `log_phase_changes` | When `true`, prints a message to the server console each time the world transitions between day and night. |

### ⚠️ Safety Limits

To prevent server instability, all values are automatically clamped to safe ranges:

| Setting | Min | Max | Notes |
|---------|-----|-----|-------|
| `day_multiplier` / `night_multiplier` | 0.01 | 100.0 | Prevents time freeze or extreme speed |
| `absolute_day_length` / `absolute_night_length` | 20 ticks (1 s) | 2,400,000 ticks (~2 h) | Set to `0` to disable (use multiplier instead) |

If a value outside the allowed range is entered via command or config file, it is silently clamped and a warning is shown in chat.

---

### 📖 Examples

#### Example 1: Extended day for builders (50 min day / 10 min night)

```properties
absolute_day_length=60000
absolute_night_length=12000
```

☀️ Day lasts **50 minutes** (60,000 ticks) — plenty of time to build.  
🌙 Night lasts **10 minutes** (12,000 ticks) — standard length.

#### Example 2: Slow down daytime only (20 min day / 10 min night)

```properties
day_multiplier=0.5
night_multiplier=1.0
```

| Phase | Default | With this config |
|-------|---------|-----------------|
| ☀️ Day | 10 min | **20 min** (half speed → twice as long) |
| 🌙 Night | 10 min | **10 min** (unchanged) |

> **Tip:** You can mix and match — for example, use `absolute_day_length` for a precise daytime duration while using `night_multiplier` to scale the night.

---

## 🔧 Commands

All commands require **operator permission level 4** (full ops).

### Interactive Menu

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/customdaynight` | Open the interactive settings menu (same as `/customdaynight menu`) |
| `/customdaynight menu` | Open the interactive settings menu |

The menu displays all current settings with clickable **[−]** / **[+]** buttons to adjust values in steps, a **[✎]** button to type a custom value, and action buttons to **[Save]**, **[Reload]**, or **[Defaults]**. Clicking a button pre-fills the command in your chat bar — just press **Enter** to confirm.

A **duration summary** at the bottom shows the effective day, night, and full cycle lengths (e.g. *☀ Day: 10m 0s · ☽ Night: 10m 0s · ⏱ Full Cycle: 20m 0s*).

> **Tip:** After running the command, press **T** to reopen chat, click a button, then press **Enter**.

### Configuration Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/customdaynight set dayMultiplier <value>` | Set the day speed multiplier |
| `/customdaynight set nightMultiplier <value>` | Set the night speed multiplier |
| `/customdaynight set absoluteDayLength <value>` | Set the absolute day length in ticks (0 to disable) |
| `/customdaynight set absoluteNightLength <value>` | Set the absolute night length in ticks (0 to disable) |

### Utility Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/customdaynight reload` | Reload the config file from disk (discards unsaved changes) |
| `/customdaynight save` | Save the current in-memory settings to the config file |
| `/customdaynight defaults` | Reset all settings to default values (does not save to disk) |
| `/customdaynight status` | Display the current settings menu |
| `/customdaynight togglePhaseLogging` | Toggle day/night transition messages on or off |

---

## 🔗 Links

- [Modrinth Page](https://modrinth.com/mod/minecraft-custom-daynight-mod)
- [Source Code](https://github.com/mozartsghost1212/mg-custom-day-night-mod)
- [Report Issues](https://github.com/mozartsghost1212/mg-custom-day-night-mod/issues)

title: ae2-personal-me-system
description: provides a wearable personal terminal that replaces your inventory key
body:
# AE2 Personal ME System

An AE2 addon that provides a wearable personal terminal to replace inventory and configurable virtual autocrafting recipes through a new communication_relay block.

## Reason
Replacing the vanilla player inventory with an ME system in modpacks traditionally requires extensive configuration and workarounds. This mod streamlines the entire process: equip players with a Personal Terminal in their Curios slot (pre-linked or user-bindable), and they gain direct access to the ME system.

Created for the modpack [Prepare to Dye 2](https://github.com/game-design-driven/create-prepare-to-dye-2).
## Features

### Personal Wireless Terminal
- Wearable wireless terminal (Curios slot or inventory)
- Press inventory key to open ME terminal instead of vanilla inventory
- Bind directly from Wireless Access Point GUI
- Infinite range when bound

### Communication Relay
- Block that provides virtual crafting recipes to ME networks
- Recipes execute instantly without Crafting CPUs
- Configurable via NBT - perfect for modpack makers
- Supports item tags, NBT matching, and multi-input/output recipes
- Right-click to view configured recipes

## Usage

### Personal Terminal
1. Obtain a Personal Wireless Terminal
2. Equip in a Curios slot (or keep in inventory)
3. Open a Wireless Access Point and click the bind button
4. Press E - ME terminal opens instead of vanilla inventory

### Communication Relay
Place the block and connect to an ME network. Recipes stored in the block's NBT will appear as craftable patterns.

#### KubeJS Example
```js
ServerEvents.commandRegistry(event => {
    event.register(
        event.commands.literal('giverelay')
            .requires(src => src.hasPermission(2))
            .executes(ctx => {
                ctx.source.player.give(Item.of('personalmesystem:communication_relay', {
                    BlockEntityTag: {
                        CustomName: '{"text":"Trading Post"}',
                        Description: ['{"text":"Exchange materials"}'],
                        virtual_recipes: [
                            {
                                inputs: [{ item: 'minecraft:cobblestone', count: 64 }],
                                outputs: [{ item: 'minecraft:diamond', count: 1 }]
                            },
                            {
                                inputs: [{ tag: 'forge:ingots/iron', count: 9 }],
                                outputs: [{ item: 'minecraft:iron_block', count: 1 }]
                            }
                        ]
                    }
                }))
                return 1
            })
    )
})
```

#### Recipe Format
```json
{
  "inputs": [
    { "item": "minecraft:diamond", "count": 1 },
    { "tag": "forge:ingots/gold", "count": 4 }
  ],
  "outputs": [
    { "item": "minecraft:netherite_ingot", "count": 1 }
  ]
}
```

## Configuration

### Server Config (`personalmesystem-server.toml`)
- `powerUsage` - AE power consumed per virtual craft (default: 0)

### Client Config (`personalmesystem-client.toml`)
- `showRecipeTooltips` - Show recipes in item tooltips (default: true)
- `maxTooltipRecipes` - Max recipes shown in tooltips (default: 3)

## Dependencies

- Minecraft 1.20.1
- Forge 47.x
- Applied Energistics 2 (15.0.0+)
- Curios API (5.2.0+)
- FancyMenu (optional) - enables AE2 screen customization

## License

MIT

title: Pretty Much Vanilla
description: A curated collection of Vanilla Plus mods and packs to enhance the Minecraft experience while staying true to the game's original feel!
body:
# **Pretty Much Vanilla**
Pretty Much Vanilla is a carefully curated modpack designed to enhance Minecraft’s visuals, mechanics, and quality-of-life features while staying true to the original game. 

## **What is Inside**

### ✨ Visual & Aesthetic Enhancements
- Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore & ModernFix – Optimize performance and boost FPS.
Continuity & Iris – Seamless glass textures and shader support for a stunning world.
- NotEnoughAnimations and Fresh Animations – Improved animations for a more lifelike experience.
- Falling Leaves & SnowyLeavesPlus – Immersive environmental details like drifting leaves.
- Legendary Tooltips & Detail Armor Bar – Improved UI elements with better item and armor displays.
- Presence Footsteps & Sound Physics Remastered – Enhanced sound design for deeper immersion.
- Mob Varients - Gives Mob varrients to the Illigers and Enderman as well as adds the new mob varents for the Cow, Pig, and Chicken
- Visual Tweaks - Visual Inhancments to certain minecraft entities without straying away for the vanilla style 
- Shaders - A massive visual enhancement for those who want it but is disabled by default
### 🔧 Gameplay & Mechanics Tweaks
- Right Click Harvest & Crops Love Rain – More intuitive farming mechanics.
- Better Mount HUD & Superb Steeds – Enhanced horse riding and mount UI.
- Potion Cauldron & EffectTimerPlus – More control over potion brewing and effect tracking.
- Friends & Foes + Beekeeper Hut – Expanded mob variety that fits seamlessly into vanilla.
- Dungeons and Taverns & YUNG’s Better Structures – More exciting world generation with improved dungeons, temples, and mineshafts.
### 🛠️ Quality-of-Life & Utility Mods
- Mod Menu & Cloth Config – Easy mod customization and management.
- Better Recipe Book & Chest Tracker – More intuitive crafting and inventory organization.
- Mouse Tweaks & Inventory Tweaks Renewed – Faster, smoother item handling.
- Cycle Paintings & Toggleable Item Frames – More flexibility in decorating.
- Easy Elytra Takeoff, Do a Barrel Roll, and Jump Over Fences – Improved movement without breaking balance.
### 🌍 The Perfect Balance for EVERYONE
- For Builders 🏗️ – Subtle aesthetic improvements with Bridging Mod, DisplayCase, and Better Carpets.
- For Explorers 🗺️ – More exciting structures and dungeons with YUNG’s Better Structures and Dungeons and Taverns.
- For Survivalists 🏹 – Refined mechanics like Better Enchanting Table, Void Totem
, and Trade Cycling.
- For Performance Seekers ⚡ – Lag-free gameplay with Sodium, Lithium, Krypton, ImmediatelyFast, and BadOptimizations.

Whether you’re a casual player or a seasoned adventurer, Pretty Much Vanilla Plus ensures a polished, optimized, and immersive Minecraft experience that feels just like home.

body:
![Welcome image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7d52806f697a007af627ea5a6dc23dcedfce1dab.png)
**Reign of Nether - KareAkern Edition** is a Modpack designed around the mod Reign of Nether RTS


Reign of Nether turns Minecraft into a Real Time Strategy game, or "RTS" for short.

The goal of this pack is to add extra optimization to the mod, give unique world generation, and add quality of life changes without compromising gameplay expereience and authenticity.

This pack was created for the use of the KareAkern minecraft server for an upcoming Reign of the nether event, but anybody is free is use it!
---

<details>
<summary>Using Embeddium</summary>

There is an alternate version of this modpack with Embeddium installed for lower-end PCs, sacrificing a few features for better performance. To install, go to the "Versions" tab and install the modpack labelled "RON + Embeddium". 

Be aware: some visuals of Reign of Nether such as transparent leaves and Fog of War will be broken, though gameplay should work as normal. Animated Chunks is also disabled.

It's recommended to enable the Invisileafs resource pack with Embeddium enabled.
</details>

---
**Features of the pack include**
* Physics Mod - Makes the destruction of buildings and death of units way more chaotic and exciting! 💥
* Ambient Sounds - Enhances the atmosphere of the game with environmental audio which makes dull moments less silent ⛈️
* Terralith - Makes Reign of Nether terrain more diverse and unique ⛰️
* E4MC - Play with your friends and battle eachother in RTS mode! ⚔️
* Many shader packs to choose from! 🪄
<details>
<summary>Note</summary>

Yeah IK the list is small, this is supposed to be for people with potato hardware T~T
</details>


<details>
<summary>Guide for Lag</summary>

If you experience low framerates or lag, try the following in order:
* Turn off shaders
* Remove Physics Mod
* Lower render distance to 12 and disable Animated Chunks
* In game press the 'M' key and go to the option "Set leaves to:" and switch it to 'ALL'
* If you are running the default pack, switch to the Embeddium version
</details>

title: Noisy No More
description: A mod that adds additional volume settings
body:
# Noisy No More

**Noisy No More** is a client-side Minecraft mod that adds extra sliders to control the volume of specific, often loud sound sources — like pistons, dispensers, villagers, and enderman. It also introduces an optional volume model that automatically lowers the combined volume when multiple identical sounds play at once.

## Features
- **Volume sliders** for noisy blocks and entities like pistons, dispensers, villagers, enderman, and more.
- **Alternative volume model** with two modes:
  - **Off** — uses the default Minecraft sound system.
  - **Only mobs** — reduces volume only for mobs.
- **Client-side only** — works in singleplayer or on any server without needing server installation.
- **Future backports** — planned support for older Minecraft versions (coming later).

## How to configure
To access the settings, go to:  
**Options → Music & Sounds → Additional Sound Options**

## Dependencies
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)

## Installation
1. Install [Fabric](https://fabricmc.net/use/) and [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api).
2. Download **Noisy No More** from Modrinth or [GitHub](https://github.com/Kurasava/noisy-no-more).
3. Put the `.jar` file into your Minecraft `mods` folder.
4. Launch the game using the Fabric profile.

---

🎧 Make Minecraft sound exactly the way you want — no more noisy surprises!

**The hyJax Modpack**  
Embark on a thrilling Minecraft adventure with a carefully curated modpack designed for discovery and collaboration. Originally a personal project, this immersive experience now invites players to explore changing seasons, delve into mysterious structures, and embrace a touch of horror for a spine-tingling adventure.

**Community-Crafted Exploration:**  
Crafted with a passion for exploration, this modpack seamlessly blends additional structures and seasonal changes to create a dynamic Minecraft world. Join a growing community of adventurers who appreciate the unique combination of mods tailored for cooperative play and excitement.

**Realistic Seasons and Agriculture:**  
Experience the enchanting realism of changing seasons, where winter blankets the landscape with snow, affecting crop growth. Integration with "Farmer's Delight" adds authenticity, requiring players to adapt their farming strategies to the challenges posed by each season.

**Physics Mod for Enhanced Realism:**  
Immerse yourself further in the Minecraft universe with the "Physics Mod." Watch as gravity influences block placement, adding an extra layer of realism to builds and interactions. Every action feels authentic, enhancing the overall sense of presence within the world.

**A Hint of Horror and Dimensional Overhaul:**  
Venture into the depths with a subtle horror aspect brought by infamous mods like "In The Fog" and "Cave Dweller." Exploration takes on a thrilling dimension as you delve into the darkest corners, making every discovery a spine-tingling experience.

**Reworked Nether and End:**  
The adventure extends beyond the Overworld with reimagined Nether and End dimensions. Encounter new challenges and marvel at the intricacies of seamlessly integrated "Create" structures in these realms. The modpack offers a unique twist on familiar environments, ensuring the unknown awaits those who dare to explore.

**Crafting Community and Creativity:**  
Designed with multiplayer in mind, this modpack fosters a sense of community and creativity. Collaborate with others to build, explore, and conquer the mysteries hidden within the world. title: Grisha [Minecraft Mod]
description: This mod brings the magic system of the Shadow and Bone Netflix series, and the books it is inspired by, into Minecraft.
body:
This mod brings the magic system of the Shadow and Bone Netflix series, and the books it is inspired by, into Minecraft. Small Science is a magic system that is implemented to be connected to special armor sets, called Kefta, the traditional attire of Grisha in the fantasy nation of Ravka. Don one of three sets and experience the enhanced capabilities of the Grisha. And never surrender to the temptation of taking Jurda Parem.

## Content

**Jurda**

The common plant Jurda is a plant with orange flowers, growing in any open field of temperate climate. It grows similar to common wheats and is being used as a stimulant in many cultures.

Consuming it, does not sate much hunger, but grants a quick nurst of Haste and Speed effects. these bursts are of short duration though, which leads to many experiencing soft addictions to Jurda, to keep themselves awake.

There are rumors that the plant can be refined and enhanced to create a drug imensly potent for Grisha. And highly addictive.

![Wild Jurda, generated in a Minecraft World.](https://i.imgur.com/Lm45Jlq.png "Wild Jurda")

**__Structures__**

**Campsites**

Throughout the world are Grisha encampents to find. Including 2-3 tents, the campsites are minorly protected by its inhabitants, but lack any fortification to not trigger too much attention.

Drüskelle search those camps to catch the grisha inside and put them on trial for their crime against nature. Existing.

![Campsite, generated in a Minecraft World](https://i.imgur.com/XL8zJzA.png "Campsite")

**Little Palace**

The heartpiece of Ravka's Grisha culture, the Little Palace, is a highly frequented location with countless rooms for guests to stay the night and a large throneroom and dancefloor for celebrations. The image of wealth is tried to be uphold by the display of a lot of gold and core cloth.

![Little Palace, generated in a Minecraft World](https://i.imgur.com/Wxj2x1P.png "Little Palace")

**__Core cloth__**

[Corecloth](https://thegrishaverse.fandom.com/wiki/Corecloth "Corecloth, Grishaverse wiki") is an exceptionally strong and flexible fabric that can withstand bullets. It is created by experienced Materialki and is used to craft the Kefta, the official clothing of Grisha.
Additionally it is possible to craft bags from it, light and durable to carry.

**Kefta**

The color of a Grisha's [kefta](https://thegrishaverse.fandom.com/wiki/Kefta "Kefta, Grishaverse wiki") is determined by their Grisha order. Materialki wear puprple, Etherealki blue and Corporalki don a red set of cloths.
Equipping a matching outfit yourself grants you abilities from the specific order.
Usually you need your Main Hand free to enact Small Science (Small Science is the name of a grisha's powers). Exceptions to this are the Materialki who are able to accelerate any item they hold in their hand to a dangerous speed and certain Etherealki who are able to produce explosives if they just hold a flint of steel in their hand to provide the spark.

> To use all Grisha Abilities, besides the corporalki improved melee, it is necessary to have the Small science Cast Keybind bound to a key. [Initial Binding is on **R**]

![Display of different keftas on Armor Stands.](https://i.imgur.com/KCLyo9H.png "Kefta")

title: hardcore-pvz
description: Hardcore PVZ Survival: Thirst, First Aid for Site Injuries, Cultivate Plants to Fight High Difficulty Monsters
body:
**_This is a relatively hardcore Plants vs. Zombies mod package._** _Do you think the difficulty of the current Plants vs. Zombies mod is too easy? Are zombies too weak?_ This integrated package allows you to experience the perfect fusion of the original Minecraft hardcore survival and [Plants V.S. Zombies](https://modrinth.com/mod/plants-and-zombies). You can cultivate your own plant army to resist these terrifying and dangerous zombies
- **Hardcore survival mechanism (bidding farewell to the original version of survival without brain regeneration)**!
Your health value is no longer simply deducted, but treated according to different injured areas, such as arms, body, and head. You must use bandages or other injured areas to restore blood to that area.![Real injury system](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c2bf44cea02974f3cc36bc758680adc405f780fa_0.webp)
- **Real thirst system**: You have to make your own water storage container, collect water sources by making glass bottles, and burn them in a furnace to create pure water sources.![thirsty](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d76f7af2474c6d6ae2ce3c5c7d787cba9f1b2714.png)With the material foundation in the later stage, you can make durable leather water bags，**_I'll tell you in secret, carrion can be burned in a furnace to make leather_**
- **Monster Comprehensive Enhancement**: 
  In addition to enhancing the original monster's AI mechanism, many terrifying creatures have also been added. And zombie equipment will be enhanced along with your equipment. For example, you have already made iron equipment. So at this point, the zombies will also generate these equipment. And every once in a while, blood nights appear. Although the number of zombies generated during a blood night is very small (I know you may not be able to resist the increase in zombies), each zombie has terrifying combat power.
- **Cultivation of Plant Legion**:
So you need to use these plants to resist zombies
Therefore, your survival difficulty is still high without plants. You must find a way to survive and find various plants in various groups. Sunshine is very important and determines the size of your plant army, which is a great thing.
- **The new rendering engine**: _**Vulkan**_. Those familiar with it know that Minecraft now uses the ancient primitive rendering engine **_OpenGL_**, which prevents your device from fully utilizing its capabilities. Adding [vulkan mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/vulkanmod) may solve this problem, but [vulkan mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/vulkanmod) is still being tested and the official version of Vulkan seems to be available in version 26.2. Therefore, if your device encounters rendering problems while playing, please be sure to check if **_Vulkan_** is the cause of the problem
- **Suitable audience for playing**:
Players who are tired of playing regular original survival, want to play challenging but creative solutions, and enjoy PVZ memes
If you are a player who doesn't want to play easy farming and hates death penalty. So I believe this integration package may not be suitable for you.
**_- Suggest playing multiplayer games_**
- I suggest that this mod pack is best played as a multiplayer game because it includes a first aid mod. When you die, you will not immediately die, but will become knocked down (of course, if you are playing as a single player or want to die directly, you can press and hold the G key to give up), and then you need someone else's rescue by using bandages for machine rescue.

title: CrystalCores
description: A mod to help newbies learn crystal!
body:
A mod to help newbies learn crystal! its a kind of utility mod based around Crystal and Anchor PVP. Helps with totem-ing, Helps with crystal-ing, helps with anchor-ing, and more!   This mod has tritotem/totem gaze (One of the first autototems to actually OPEN YOUR INVENTORY, move your cursor towards a totem, then equips it. Speed and other factors can be modified in the config as well.)
Crystal Flick Assist (if you hit a player with a full knockback attack while you have obsidian and end crystals in your hotbar, a nearby available placeable block will be found and your aim will be slightly shifted towards that block to facilitate placement of a quick obsidian + end crystal.)
Anchor Flick Assist (If you charge a respawn anchor past minimum capacity, your viewpoint will be flicked downwards (to facilitate the placement of a block between you and the anchor so you take no damage), and back up again to destroy the anchor. Speed is configurable)
Crystal Breaker (If you're holding the right click button, you'll automatically destroy end crystals as soon as they are within your crosshair as fast as possible, UNLESS you are above the crystal or at feet level to it.)
DragR (When holding right click while holding some specific blocks (such as glowstone or obsidian), it will simulate a packet-accurate drag click (places blocks as fast as possible), pairing great with crystal flick assist and anchor flick assist.)

title: BattleForge AI
description:
PvP Bot Mod is a competitive PvP practice and showcase mod focused on realistic combat behavior.
Each match uses a fair start system with countdown, kit setup, and result tracking, so fights feel structured and replayable.
body:
BattleForge AI



PvP Bot Mod brings high-skill PvP training bots to Minecraft Forge with match flow, team battles, bot-vs-bot mode, adaptive AI, and cinematic combat presentation.

Train against bots from Easy to Godlike, run 1v1/2v2/3v3 team fights, or spectate full bot tournaments with kill feed, countdowns, and post-match stats.

Supports:

Minecraft 1.19.2, 1.20.1, 1.20.4
Forge 43.x, 47.x, 49.x
Java 17+
Short Description 

Advanced PvP training bots with 8 difficulty tiers, team battles, bot-vs-bot arenas, adaptive combat AI, and match stats for Forge 1.19.2/1.20.1/1.20.4.

Full Description

PvP Bot Mod is a competitive PvP practice and showcase mod focused on realistic combat behavior.
Each match uses a fair start system with countdown, kit setup, and result tracking, so fights feel structured and replayable.

Core highlights:

8-tier difficulty system (0-7) from beginner-friendly to Godlike.
Pro mechanics: combos, strafing, crit timing, shield pressure, ranged prediction.
Team mode: allies and enemies with coordinated AI behavior.
Bot vs Bot mode for content creation and AI comparison.
Match UX: countdowns, boss bars, kill feed, victory summaries.
Multi-version build support with separate jars per Minecraft version.
New Features 
Added full team battle system with ally/enemy roles.
Added quick team presets: /1v1, /1v2, /2v2, /3v3.
Added Bot vs Bot arena command with mixed-difficulty teams.
Added cinematic match flow: countdown, start callout, end summary.
Added improved AI behavior across tiers, including advanced tactical logic at high levels.
Added ally utility commands for controlling friendly bots.
Added strict anti-friendly-fire behavior for team logic (teammates should not damage teammates).
Added multi-version output jars for 1.19.2, 1.20.1, and 1.20.4.


Commands

/spawnpvpbot [count] [difficulty]
Spawn PvP bots and start match flow.

/pvpstats
Show your match statistics.

/stats
Alias for /pvpstats.

/forfeit
Forfeit current match.

/quit
Alias for /forfeit.

/surrender
Alias for /forfeit.

/team <allies> <allyDiff> vs <enemies> <enemyDiff>
Start a custom team battle.

/1v1 [difficulty]
Quick solo match.

/1v2 [difficulty]
Player + ally vs 2 enemies.

/2v2 [difficulty]
Player + ally vs 2 enemies.

/3v3 [difficulty]
Player + 2 allies vs 3 enemies.

/dismissbots
Remove nearby allied bots.

/regroupbots
Teleport allied bots to you.

/botpvp <team1 difficulties> vs <team2 difficulties>
Run bot-vs-bot team battles.

Difficulty Tiers

0 Easy, 1 Medium, 2 Hard, 3 Pro, 4 Expert, 5 Master, 6 Legend/Elite, 7 Godlike

Higher tiers unlock faster reactions, higher accuracy, better combat decision-making, and advanced tactical behavior.

title: NPC Mannequins in Survival
description: A Paper plugin allowing for vanilla mannequin mobs to be used in survival
body:
![Logo for NPC Mannequins in Survival](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a3ad3ede74de3ddb6ce16cd5b1308be78d403073.png)

NPC Mannequins in Survival (NMIS for short) is my debut Paper plugin that allows for you to use the new mannequin mobs introduced in Java 1.21.9 in survival mode as decoration (similar to armor stands):

![Image of mannequins spawned with this plugin. Some have gear such as armor and tools, some are wearing blocks on their head](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0a72ed4214df612ff2d628a5b2dcd424ae6118c0.png)

# Basics

Mannequins are spawned in via a craftable item called a Mannequin Soul. To make a basic Soul, all that needs to be done is put a piece of paper named "Mannequin Starter" (or simply "ms") in the crafting grid:

![Image illustrating that you make a basic mannequin soul by placing a piece of paper named "Mannequin Starter" in a crafting grid](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/232fd1f8c6898732e0e7ff5e36216706f6beb073.png)

To spawn this mannequin, place the crafted soul on the ground. Crouching whilst placing the mannequin soul will copy the pitch that you are looking in.

# Extras

## Ingredient Modifiers
You may also add extra ingredients to the crafted Mannequin Soul:
![Image showcasing a mannequin soul crafted with extra ingredients](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c7dc20e87363ce6776e9436c649ea5fbf3308c54.png)

The current ingredients that you can add are as follows:
- Name tag: Applies the skin of a Minecraft Java Edition username based what the name tag was renamed to. The skin on the mannequin will stay the same even if the person with the Minecraft account changes the skin.
- Netherite scrap:  Sets the maximum HP of the mannequin to 50 hearts
- Anvil: Prevents the mannequin from moving and falling. Can be applied post-mannequin-creation to anchor mannequins after the fact.

## Equipment
Mannequins may be equiped with armor and hold items. Right click to open the mannequin inventory:

![Image demonstrating what type of equipment goes in each slot of the mannequin inventory. Helmet goes in the first slot. Chestplate/elytra goes in the second slot. Leggings go in the third slot. Boots go in the fourth slot. The mannequin will hold the fifth slot in its main hand. The mannequin will hold the sixth slot in its off hand.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b6ebc2252a1c5c7e03665dc082c5a4b97d2ff84f.png)

## Rename Your Mannequin
You can use a name tag on a mannequin like a normal mob:
![Image showing a renamed mannequin](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/580a1b24ec480d41c15bac458bd1e8f5d42d9393.png)


## Poses
Right click with a feather in your hand to "tickle" the mannequin into a new pose:

### Fall Flying
![Image showing the fall flying pose](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/423d074f8438bcadc3453844bdcb8f9c89358b5a.png)

### Sleeping
![Image showing the sleeping pose](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/67ca28c06bccfc01c706f38c6a362340be2142a6.png)

### Sneaking
![Image showing the sneaking pose](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9353f660af1e9d3738e40550a2964aab6201131b.png)

### Swimming (similar to fall flying)
![Image showing the swimming pose](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/349193669689f6b5eb601d5a4793074fb3fb1c4c.png)

### Standing
![Image showing the standing pose](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a1f66adb3b705007f3d8110d1c7590fdbe9f3e82.png)

# More About this Plugin

## Config Options
By default, the "NPC" tag displays under mannequins to avoid confusing players. You can disable this in the `config.yml` that is generated.

## Get Support, Give Feedback, Say Hello
Join the Discord server for the things that I make: [Ferroh's Things](https://discord.gg/tabwAayqun)! I will do my best to be as responsive as possible.

## Support Me
If you find this plugin useful [you may click here to donate.](https://www.paypal.com/paypalme/PharaohFerroh)

title: sMusic
description: Playing music in Minecraft with Texture Pack has never been easier
body:
# 🎵 sMusic  

Add and play **custom songs** inside Minecraft easily using `.ogg` files and **automatic resource pack generation**.  

**sMusic** automatically creates a **custom resource pack** with all your `.ogg` tracks and lets you play them for players through commands.  

---

## How to use

- Music files must be **`.ogg` format**, placed in `plugins/sMusic/music/`.

- Each file becomes a playable sound that can be accessed using commands.  

- The resource pack automatically updates whenever new songs are added or configurations are changed.  

---

## 📝 Commands  

- `/music play <song> [player/@a/@p]` → Plays a song for a specific player or all online players.  
  *Example:* `/music play lobby_theme @a`  

- `/music stop [player/@a/@p]` → Stops all currently playing music for the specified players.  
  *Example:* `/music stop`  

---

# Important *every change to the song files after reloading you must update the texture pack for it to work correctly*

---

title: JoinCommandPlugin
description: Easily run configurable commands when a player joins your server. Supports player name placeholders and reloadable config.
body:
JoinCommandPlugin allows server owners to execute customizable commands whenever a player joins the server. All commands can be defined in the config.yml file, and you can use {player_name} as a placeholder that automatically gets replaced with the joining player's real username.

The plugin also supports a convenient /joincommand or /jc command with a reload subcommand, letting you reload the configuration without restarting the server. Perfect for welcome messages, giving items, or running any other console commands upon player join.

Features:

Run any console command when a player joins.

Supports {player_name} placeholder.

Reload the configuration using /jc reload.

Tab completion for commands.

Easy to configure in config.yml.

Installation:

Place the JoinCommandPlugin .jar file into your server’s plugins folder.

Start the server once to generate the default config.yml.

Edit config.yml to add your commands.

Reload with /jc reload or restart the server.

Use Cases:

Send welcome messages to new or returning players.

Give starter items or bonuses automatically.

Trigger any other console command when a player joins.

title: HCTCG Datapack
description: A datapack to play the HermitCraft TCG in your world like the hermits!!
body:
# HermitCraft TCG made by VintageBeef provided to you in Datapack form by DrMine (me)

## What is this?
This is a Trading Card Game originally made by VintageBeef and designed around the hermits from HermitCraft

## Features:
- ALL **199** cards from the Hermitcraft TCG game we all love and play (+tokens!)
Currently you can get cards by running "/function cards:" (admin powers required)
- A starter deck is given to all players upon their first join (make sure "the datapack has loaded" messege is sent in chat, if not do /reload (or reload the server/world))
- Trigger commands:
> /trigger tokens add [to add the amount of tokens you have and it is displayed in the tab menu next to your name, replacing tokens as physical items ingame although you can still obtain them using "/function cards:ultra_rare_hermits"]

> /trigger booster_pack [to buy booster packs for 6 tokens each]

> /trigger item_pack [to buy item packs for 2 tokens each]

> /trigger hermit_pack [to buy hermit packs for 2 tokens each]
 
> /trigger effect_pack [to buy item packs for 8 tokens each]

## How to play?
1. Setup a 5x5 board with item frames (to place the cards on)
2. put your deck in a shuffler (hoppers and dropper for example)
3. Your goal is to knock out your opponent's hermits
4. play the game and have fun!

## INSTRUCTIONS
### DECK COMPOSITION
Each player has a deck of exactly 42 cards, consisting of Hermit cards, item cards, and effect cards,
Apart from item cards, you con't have more than three cards in your deck with the same name. This means
that you can not have more than 3 "Common Hypno" cards but can have 3 "Common Hypno" cards and an 3 "Rare Hypno' cards (as they are treated as different cards).

### STARTING A GAME
- At the beginning of a game, one of the two players flips a coin to see who plays first. The players then shuffle their decks and draw 7 cards, The next 3 cards are also drawn kept face down and set off to the side os prize cards.
- If either players does not draw a Hermit card as part of their initial seven card draw. they must shuffle and draw again, This is repeated as many times as needed
- The player that loses the coin toss places a Hermit on the board as their active Hermit first. - The winner of the coin toss then places their Hermit on the board as their active Hermit. The winner of the coin toss can perform all of the usual steps during their frst turn except for the attacking step (or any sort of attacking).
- A plaver can have a total of five Hermits in play at once, although only one (the active Hermit) can perform attacks during each turn (unless otherwise stated). The rest remain AFK. lf your active Hermit is defeated, you must replace it with an AFK Hermit of your choice. If you do not have an AFK Hermit, you lose

### HOW TO PLAY
**ON YOUR TURN**
During each turn, you can do any and all of the folowing in this order
1. Move any number of Hermits from your hand to the play field as AFK Hermits.
2. Attach one (and only one) item card to a Hermit from your hand. This can be aither an active Hiermit or AFK Hermit.
3. Atach any number of effect cards to active or AFK Hermits (you can not attach 'single use ' effect cards to Hermits).
4. Replace an active Hermit with an AFK Hermit. This ends your turn and you can not attack. Go directly to step6
5. Attack and/or play one single use effect card
6. Draw a card and end your turn; if you run out of cords to draw. you lose.

### HOW TO PLAY
**ATTACKING**
- Attacking can only be done by your active Hermit. The Hermit can perform one attack listed on its card as long as the correct amount and type of item cards are attached to the card (item cards aren't discarded when using the attack unless stated otherwise)
- You can also attack using "single use" effect cards. These cards are played in conjunction with a Hermit attack. For example, if your Hermit's attack does 40 damage and effect card does 20 damage, the total damage done is 60 in one single attack. Using both a Hermit attack and an attacking effect card does not count as 2 separate attacks (although you may choose to attack with an effect card *only*).
- Damage is assigned to the opponent's active Hermit (unless specified). Once it receives as much damage as it has hit points it is defeated. A defeated Hermit is discarded along with any attached item and effect cards and the player who knocked it out claims a prize card (drawn from opponent's deck) to add to their hand. If they claim their third and final prize cord. they win.
- The player who's Hermit was knocked out must replace that Hermit with an AFK Hermit at the beginning of their next turn, lf there are no AFK Hermits to replace it, the player loses.
- Once you've attacked and assigned any damage and /or status effects. your turn ends and it's your opponent's go. The game repeats like this until one player wins!

### STRENGTHS & WEAKNESSES
- Each Hermit type. except for "Balanced type" has, strengths and weaknesses (see strength/weakness chart). IE:
- Attacking Hermit's type is strong against the defending Hermit's type, an additional 20hp in damage is added to damage done, For example, if a buider type Bdubs uses ' Gradient' (60hp damage) plus an iron sword effect card (20hp damage) and the defending Hermit is a terraform type (weak to builder" which means an additional 20hp damage), then the resulting damage would be 60 + 20 + 20 = 100hp damage

### STATUS EFFEGTS
- There are 2 diferent types of (damaging) status effects in Hermitcroft TCG: Burn and Poison.
If your opponent is burned they take an additiona 20hp damage every turn until they are knocked out.
- Armour protects against burn damage and it can also be removed or prevented by effect cards
- If your opponent is poisoned , they take an additional 20hp damage every turn until they are down to 10hp. lf your opponent's poisoned Hermit recovers HP, poison is once again activated until that Hermit reaches 10hp Poison does not wnock out a Hermit but does ignore armour, Poison can also be removed or prevented by effect cards
- Neither burn no poison can be removed by going AFK

### WIN CONDITIONS
Hermitcraft TCG can be won in three different ways:
1. The most common path to victory is to knock out three of your opponent's Hermits and collect
three prize cards. Every time you defeat a Hermit, you draw one of the three prize cards drawn from your opponent's deck. When you draw your third and final prize card. you win!
2. lf you defeat an opponent's active Hermit and they have no availlable AFK Hermits to replace it you can also claim victory.
3. If your opponent runs out of cards in their deck, and therefore can't draw a card at the end of their turn, you win. This is what's known as 'decking your opponent.

title: New World
description: New World: A Totally rethought Minecraft Sandbox, not just Vanilla+. New Progression, New Generation, New Experiences.
body:
# Welcome to a New World...
New World is a modpack that seeks to break free from the "what-does-that-even-mean" that is "Vanilla Plus". It rethinks Minecraft's progression, focusing on the Sandbox in Minecraft's Survival-Sandbox genre, while also not trivializing the proccess of becoming powerful.
New World overhauls and changes a _lot_ of what you would find in Vanilla Minecraft, so the rest of this description will serve to walk you through some of the more influential changes, sequentially from top-to-bottom for how much they affect the game!

## Goodbye Villages! Goodbye Outposts!
![Barrier Block over a Village House and Pillager Outpost](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a709e8960f18652647cc7b09ba0e4a6e124a68f9.png)

Ever making a new Minecraft world, settling along a lovely river, but wait, what's that on the mountain there? An Ugly village with Cubes of dirt everywhere!
You find a beautiful and flat plains... 5 Villages are already there claiming all the good real estate for themselves.
Removing Villages isn't about removing villagers... You can still cure one of them from a zombie! Villages in vanilla Minecraft contribute to a specific problem... ***The world already feels inhabited!***
Pillager outposts have the same issues. With the amount of structures in vanilla, Minecraft feels like a world that is already inhabited, already claimed. For RPG games and modpacks, this is amazing. Massive structures, plentiful villagers to give you quests galore-- but for a sandbox game? It's like trying to set up a beautiful farming village of your *own* and having to tear down *another village* because it's already in the perfect spot in the center of the area.
With them gone, open areas are open again, and Minecraft as a canvas is open and blank for the hands of the player to shape.

## Goodbye Durability! Enchanting Rebalance!
![Barrier Block over a Nearly Broken Netherite Pickaxe, Enchanting Table Setup, Goodbye Durability Hello Enchanting!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/09af0251822a0a2064a0296bd28dca5ea171395b.png)

Those darn iron tools stopping you from making your starter bases because they break too easily? You don't want to enchant them, not even with a tier 1 enchantment, for the same reason? Worry no longer! Without durability, the game's progression no longer has any real *rush* to it. You can make wonders and marvels with iron tools, with no worry of them breaking on you! Diamond tools can be used as soon as you get said diamonds, without needing to consider if you can get mending before they've snapped in two. Durability is an annoying and outdated mechanic, and managing it in vanilla is mundane and one-note. Removing it all together is a bit of a "landlord plaster special" fix, but it opens the game up to a more sandbox-friendly nature.
Enchanting as well was a similar system. Getting the highest level of everything is a major pain, especially with sharpness five and protection four. All those hours spent getting protection three and sharpness three in enchanting tables is now... the highest level!
**Every enchantment** ***(except for Efficiency & Piercing)*** **has a new max level of 3.** This is more of a power-scale related balance, as high level "stat increase" enchantments like protection and sharpness aren't really even neccesary when you have full netherite armor. Decreasing the max level of them makes it easier to enchant your gear to said maximum, makes things like PvP at said maximum more interesting, and most importantly *leaves room for Artifacts to make up the difference!*
Artifacts are *fun*, and they take the place of the much-less-fun option of maxed out gear with crazy modded enchantments.

# **The Ultimate Minecraft Experience**

Stanpack is a carefully curated modpack designed to elevate your Minecraft world! This pack combines performance improvements, visual upgrades, and useful tools to make your gameplay smoother, more beautiful, and more immersive. Whether you love building, exploring, or PvP, Stanpack has everything you need for an optimized Minecraft experience.

**Visual Enhancements and Realism**

With a combination of shaders like BSL, Complementary Shaders - Unbound, and Solas Shader, along with visual tweaks like Clear Glass Pack and 3D Skin Layers, Stanpack delivers an unmatched sense of realism. 3D Ladders and Continuity add depth to small details, making your builds look better than ever.

**Improved Performance**

Stanpack includes performance-boosting mods like Sodium and Lithium, allowing Minecraft to run smoothly even in high-demand environments. Paired with Fabric API and Indium, it ensures a stable, seamless experience with minimal lag and maximum FPS.

**Handy Tools and User-Friendly Interface**

With mods like Just Enough Items (JEI) and Jade, you get easy access to crafting recipes and block information. FancyMenu and Shrimp’s Immersive Interfaces give your interface a sleek look and make it easy to use, while Mouse Tweaks enhances standard mouse controls. Ok Zoomer provides flexible zoom, perfect for getting a closer look at details.

**Enhanced Building Capabilities**

For the creative builders, Litematica and MaLiLib are included, ideal for making blueprints and complex structures. These mods are designed to make building projects more efficient, giving you better control and precision.

**Multiplayer and Social Features**

Communicate effortlessly with others through Simple Voice Chat and Replay Voice Chat. ReplayMod lets you relive and record epic moments, so you can share your adventures with others. For explorers, Xaero’s Minimap and Xaero’s World Map are available, making world navigation simpler so you’ll never get lost again.


**With Stanpack, experience Minecraft like never before, in both singleplayer and multiplayer. Enhance your gameplay, explore new areas, build like a pro, and play smoothly without lag. Try Stanpack today and discover a world of possibilities!**

title: Create: Animal Kingdom
description: Fabric based Create oriented modpack where Foxes and Polar Bears fight for control over the world. Will you help the Foxes and slay the Polar Bears, or dominate both for total control?
body:
In this world, the original villagers have long gone extinct and replaced by many different animal species. From this, two rival factions of intelligent animals emerged: The Foxes and the Polar Bears. They have adapted to all climates, and filled the world with their structures. Will you trade with the foxes and complete their bounties by crafting and placing bounty boards in villages, and maybe even automate their requests using Create? Will you fight the hostile Polar Bears and take over their lands, loot their chests and steal their weapons? Or will you make your own way in the world, explore the far away lands and build grand factories?

This modpack runs on Fabric, and contains all the common performance boost mods like Sodium to ensure compatibility with as many systems as possible. It overhauls the world, using a large combination of Mods, Data Packs and Resource packs to create a large and immersive world to explore. Contains a fabric port of Sophisticated Backpacks & Storage for your items, all the Create mods and addons you want and many different structure generation mods to make the world worth to explore. Heavily based on my two favorite resource packs, [We Don't Bite](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/wedontbite) and [Goat Villagers](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/goat-villagers), so huge shoutout to them.

title: RiscJ Computer Mod
description: This mod is designed to provide a hands-on understanding of computer architecture. It allows you to construct a virtual computer within the Minecraft universe using specific blocks that represent different components of a computer system. These components
body:
This mod is designed to provide a hands-on understanding of computer architecture. It allows you to construct a virtual computer within the Minecraft universe using specific blocks that represent different components of a computer system. These components include registers, a control unit, an arithmetic logic unit (ALU), and memory.
By placing these blocks onto the same bus, you can create a fully functional computer simulation. This setup mirrors a simplified structure of a real-world computer, where different components communicate and interact through a shared bus system.

Programming and Execution

 Once your computer is built, you can bring it to life using a program assembled in the programming block. This feature introduces the concept of assembly language and how instructions are executed in a computer system. You can write programs, load them into your computer, and watch as your instructions are carried out in the Minecraft world. This interactive experience provides a tangible understanding of how software and hardware interact in a computer system.

Learning and Fun

Whether you’re a computer science student looking for a fun way to supplement your studies, a teacher seeking an engaging educational tool, or a Minecraft enthusiast interested in computers, this mod offers a unique blend of learning and gameplay.

We hope this mod will spark your curiosity and deepen your understanding of computer systems. Enjoy building, programming, and exploring the world of computer architecture in Minecraft!

Please refer to the in game manual for detailed instructions on how to use each component and assemble your computer. Happy crafting!

Issues:

title: Vanilla Exploded
description: If Vanilla MC had a bigger, cooler brother with a cool bike and a switchblade comb, this would be it. 😎
body:
## [Discord](https://discord.gg/SBdHKunF3m) is now live!
#### *Come on over and explain exactly how you could've built this modpack in 2 less redstone...*


# Ok, so hear me out...
I got bored and doomscrolled through Modrinth's (*at time of creation*) 132 pages of 1.20.1 compatible mods. I picked out a few (146...) mods with the idea of making a "Vanilla on steroids"-like experience with this pack.

**Please Note:**
**I have not fully tested all the mod's compatibility with each other, I honestly just clicked Launch and waited for a mod to crash upon load, when the mod threw an error, I tossed it and tried again. That's it, nothing more has been done...YET!**

##### *So with that said, I do apologize in advanced if anything goes wonky.*
____

### What VE specifically does/adds
VE is meant to be Vanilla MC-esque, with curated QoL changes, tweaks, and additions to give a nice, refreshing take on the basics, plus a few additional challenges just in case you want a little bit of adventuring.

### Why should you download VE?
In case of boredom, download VE!

Why not? You've probably been like me and doomscrolled modpacks everywhere, looking for the next interesting pack to conquer. After some time passed, I wanted to go back to basics, but it just wasn't cutting it.

Enter Vanilla Exploded!

- You like building, of course, but what about detailed building? We got some of that!
- You like grizzly bears? Ducks? Snuffles? Freaking squeaky sheeps?! Got those too! (and plushies...)
- Overheard your BFF talking about some sort of Ghast Cow? You can find it here!
- Want to play sims, but with villagers? Get married and have kids? Go take an arrow to the knee and find out!
- Wish you could replace that boring hoe with a cool scythe? Nah, me neither...but you can!
- Love Bioshock? Same, so come get your grappling hook and become spooder-man!
- Wanna leave the world behind and see a massive vacuum with other worlds in it? Ad Astra has you covered!
- Already made a wither farm? Figured you would, so Ultris: Boss Expansion has a few things to make you cry...

It's not like you're doing anything else, just give a try and see for yourself!

____

### Baked-In Tools

Look, I'm no streamer, but I still like to be able to communicate with my friends and sometimes show them sweet new caves from time to time. So I added a few popular mods to help. You are more than welcome to disable them if you have no use for them:

- Simple Voice Chat (Note: *A few other mods need this for a dependency*)
- Replay Mod

Also...

- WorldEdit
- Litematica

*For the big builders*

____

### One Last Thing...
Well, three things...

1. **OptiFine** currently does not work for this modpack due to some issues with Fabric not playing well with it (at least for me, your results may vary). I have attempted to use **OptiFabric**, but that mod (at the time of this writing) does not have a 1.20+ version released. Once OptiFabric updates to 1.20 I will be testing it and inform you when it's stable to run alongside VE.

2. The **Immersive Portals** Mod likes to sometimes cause issues when you make portals larger than 8x8, so either take care of your portal sizes, or just disable it. That might help with any miscellaneous issue you may be having.

3. The **Physics Mod** is included but disabled by default due to it breaking a few key MC physics that I consider preferred when playing MC. You are more than welcome to enable the mod when you wanna see some very funny rag doll animals and aren't mining blocks as much.
____
### Bottom Text
If you made it this far, thank you! I tried really hard to make this with very little effort, and I hope you enjoy any or all of it! This is a small passion project of mine, so updates and changes might take some time.

BUT...

If people like the idea and want to improve on it, Go for it! Have fun! Enjoy yourself! Play with Friends! Or just wait till I eventually update the pack and be lazy (Like me!)

Thank you and have fun!

title: Lode Claims
description: Create WorldGuard Regions simply by placing Lodestones
body:
# Lode Claims
A Spigot plugin that allows you and your players to claim regions, simply by placing a lodestone block

### Requirements
- Java 16 or newer
- Spigot (or Paper/Purpur/...) for Minecraft 1.17 or newer
- WorldGuard 7.0.7 or newer

### Usage
Simply install and configure the Plugin. That's it. No Database or complicated setup required.
The Owner of a region can right click the lodestone and then rightclick a player in order to add them to the region.
To unclaim an area, the owner has to mine the lodestone, and then mine it again, to confirm the unclaim.

### Issues and Feedback
Hop on over to [GitHub](https://github.com/Aaron2550/LCP) to suggest things or get a bug fixed

### Current Issues
- Only 1 Region per player
- The distance calculation to other regions is a bit wonky as it does not consider that the region is a square
- The owner can mine any lodestone to unclaim the region, not just the one they used to create the region

### Limitations
Keep in mind that WorldGuard cannot override vanilla's spawn protection. This means only server operators can interact with blocks that overlap with the spawn area. You can change `spawn-protection` in your server.properties to remove the vanilla protection and then protect your server's spawn using WorldGuard

title: Enemy Echelons
description: A mod that assigns levels and attribute modifications to mobs based on the world height range that they spawn at.
body:
Enemy Echelons is a mod that assigns levels and attribute modifications to mobs based on the world height range that they spawn at. This is a Vanilla+ mob progression mod in the same vein as Champions and Sliding Health.


The goal was to create a mod in which the mobs progressively get more difficult the farther you travel down in the Overworld. It can be customized to be more difficult the farther you travel up as well, or both. I believe it works best in dimensions where there is a clear progression/change in the terrain, but it can be customized to any dimension. 

 

Echelons

An echelon is made of all the mob attribute modifiers for a custom defined set of dimensions and mobs. Each echelon defintion has a list of stratum defined by a min and max y-value. Each strata has a list of level-weight entries (histogram). These define the likelyhood of a level being assigned to a mob upon spawn. 
For more info and examples, see the Echelons wiki page.

 

Levels

A level is assigned to a mob at spawn and this level determines that amount of modification to its attributes (health, damage, speed, etc).

 

Configuration

Enemy Echelons is very configurable, allowing you to add as few or as many levels as you wish and to setup their respective attribute modifiers.Enemy Echelons is very configurable, allowing you to add as few or as many levels as you wish and to setup their respective attribute modifiers.
See the Configurations wiki page.

title: Shields
description: Enhance your combat with six unique new shield tiers
body:
# Shields Mod

Shields is a fully configurable, lightweight Minecraft mod built for the Fabric loader that expands vanilla combat by introducing six new custom shield tiers, immersive unique blocking sounds, and robust dynamic customization.

Whether you want early-game variety, late-game high-durability protection, or server-wide custom stat balancing, this mod provides a comprehensive system that can be completely reconfigured without ever needing to touch code.

---

### 🛡️ Core Features

*   **Six New Shield Tiers**: Adds beautiful new shields designed to bridge the gaps in vanilla progression:
    *   **Wooden Shield**: An early-game lightweight alternative.
    *   **Round Iron Shield**: A quick, agile medium-tier shield.
    *   **Emerald Shield**: A high-enchantability, durable mid-game defense.
    *   **Diamond Shield**: Solid, long-lasting obsidian-grade utility.
    *   **Obsidian Shield**: High-durability shield with increased defense and fire resistance.
    *   **Round Netherite Shield**: The ultimate late-game shield with supreme durability and maximum knockback resistance.
*   **Immersive Custom Audio**: Every custom shield tier features its own unique blocking sound effects to provide sensory depth during combat.
*   **100% Configurable System**: A dynamic `shields.json` configuration file is automatically generated in your game's `config/` directory on first launch. Every single value is customizable.

---

### ⚙️ Customizable Properties

Through the generated `config/shields.json` configuration file, you or server administrators can dynamically adjust:
*   **Settings**: Toggle shield attributes on and off, or enable/disable shield enchantments applying effects on block events.
*   **Global Attributes**: Define custom armor ratings and knockback resistance values for shields.
*   **Individual Shield Stats**:
    *   Durability (exact durability rating per tier).
    *   Damage Reduction Percentage (the percent of damage completely blocked).
    *   Damage Reduction Factor (how incoming damage is calculated).
    *   Deflection Cooldown (how fast the shield recovers after blocking).
    *   Custom Sound Events (assign custom block and break sounds from vanilla or other mods).
    *   Custom Audio Volume (volume level for blocking sound effects).

---

### 📦 Dependencies & Installation

To run this mod smoothly, ensure you have the following installed in your Fabric environment:
*   **Minecraft**: version `1.21.10`
*   **Fabric Loader**: version `0.19.2` or newer
*   **Fabric API**: (technically optional, but highly recommended for complete integration)

Simply drop the `.jar` file into your Minecraft client or server's `mods` folder, and you are ready to go!

title: Perfect Presentation
description: The perfect borderless window mod for Windows
body:
# Perfect Presentation

**THIS IS A WINDOWS-ONLY MOD**

This mod replaces the traditional exclusive fullscreen mode with a borderless windowed mode that:

* Maintains the same frame latency as exclusive fullscreen
* Maintains support for variable refresh rate technologies such as (fullscreen) G-Sync
* Allows seamless Alt-Tabbing
* Works correctly with overlays

Even when running in windowed mode, this mod can improve frame latency and frame pacing.

## Demo

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/Y71aJU2_6Gw" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Technical Details

This mod replaces Minecraft’s default OpenGL swap chain with a modern DXGI flip-model swap chain.

To accomplish this, the mod moves Minecraft’s OpenGL rendering context into a separate, hidden window. Using DirectX–OpenGL interoperability extensions, the final copy from the internal framebuffer to the back buffer is performed via DirectX11 instead of OpenGL, which allows the use of a DXGI swap chain.

## Requirements

* A graphics card that supports:
    * DirectX 11
    * OpenGL
    * The `NV_DX_interop2` extension
* Java >= 23

## Known Issues
- V-Sync doesn't seem to reliably work in windowed mode
  -  Whether it works or not seems to depend on whether the java executable is called `javaw.exe` specifically
  - It's likely that there is some kind of compatibility patch from either Windows or the NVIDIA driver involved
  - I'm not sure if screen tearing is even possible in windowed mode with the DXGI flip-model

title: Mobbility [Addon: Spell Engine]
description: Gives mobs player spell-casting abilities for Spell Engine - cast spells with animations and cooldowns just like players.
body:
![Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Es8xro21/images/1a30601fe94fe70523d1a10b644df036b7512bd9.gif)

## Features

- **Player-Like Spell Casting**: Mobs cast spells with animations and cooldowns, just like players
- **Automatic Ability Detection**: Mobs with spell items automatically gain casting abilities on spawn
- **Tag-Based AI**: Item tags determine wizard vs basic combat AI
- **Class Presets**: Pre-configured loadouts spawn automatically (Archer, Assassin, Deadeye, War Archer, Warrior, Rogue, Fire Wizard, Arcane Wizard, Tundra Hunter, Wildling, Frozen Champion, Plaguebringer)

## How It Works

When a mob spawns with Spell Engine items:

1. **Detection**: System checks for items with Spell Engine spells
2. **Tag Check**: Checks if item has wizard tags (staff/spellbook tags)
3. **AI Selection**:
   - Has wizard tags → Wizard AI (maintains distance, strafes)
   - No wizard tags → Basic AI (standard attack behavior)
4. **Behavior**: Mob uses appropriate AI based on item tags

## Wizard Tags

Configure which items get wizard AI via tags in `config/mobbility/spell_engine.toml`:

<details>
<summary>Default Tags</summary>

```toml
[wizardAI]
staffTags = ["wizards:wands", "irons_spellbooks:staff", "wizards:staves", "paladins:staves"]
spellbookTags = ["curios:spellbook"]
```
</details>

Add custom tags to support items from other mods.

## Configuration

Fully customizable via `config/mobbility/spell_engine.toml`:

<details>
<summary>Combat Class Settings</summary>

```toml
[combatClass]
speedModifier = 1.0
attackIntervalMin = 60
attackIntervalMax = 120
useCooldowns = true
preventFriendlyFire = true
spellBlacklist = []
```
</details>

<details>
<summary>Wizard Tags</summary>

```toml
[wizardAI]
staffTags = ["wizards:wands", "irons_spellbooks:staff", "wizards:staves", "paladins:staves"]
spellbookTags = ["curios:spellbook"]
```
</details>

<details>
<summary>Class Presets</summary>

```toml
[classPresets]
enabled = true
# Presets for Skeleton, Zombie, Husk, Stray, Drowned, Wither Skeleton (Archer, Assassin, Warrior, Rogue, Fire Wizard, Arcane Wizard, etc.)
```
</details>

## Requirements

- **Minecraft**: 1.20.1
- **Fabric Loader**: 0.15.11+
- **Mobbility [Core]**: Required core mod (Fabric version)
- **Spell Engine**: The spell mod this addon integrates with
- **Fzzy Config**: For configuration

description: An addon for Tensura: Reincarnated that adds in a few features such as a global EP leaderboard and gacha race selections!
body:
# Tensura: Server Utils

Tensura: Server Utils is an add-on for Tensura: Reincarnated that adds in a few features geared to adding more fun and features to servers or modpacks using the main mod.

For support, suggestions, or bugs, join my [Discord](https://discord.gg/t6qeEzZZSd)

## Features
## **Game Rules**

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- forceRandomRace - Removes the default race selection screen, and automatically chooses a random race of the available options. Only affects the first time login. (default: false)

- gachaMode - Replaces the default race selection screen with the gacha machine. Only works if the forceRandomRace game rule is true. (default: false) 

</details>





## **Gacha Mode**

Gacha Mode is a fun way to randomize player's starting races, while still providing a limited choice. Upon clicking the lever in the new Race Selection screen, a roll animation will play. Then, player's have the option of 3 completely random starting races to choose from. All races configured in the /defaultconfig/ directory are included in the roll.

![Screenshot of the Gacha Race Roller](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3ed95a48a107cd69d1df6bebdfc5518da8e56696.png)

 ## **Global Leaderboard**

Using the 
```
/leaderboard
```
 command, all players are able to view the EP leaderboard. Every player, both online and offline, will be listed on this leaderboard. The leaderboard refreshes every 30 seconds. Players are ordered by EP, and it also lists their race and number of unique skills. To add "fake" players to the leaderboard, use the command 
```
/leaderboard test add <name> <ep>
```
 To remove "fake" players from the leaderboard, use 
```
/leaderboard test remove <name>
```




## **Skill Disable via Config**

An excellent feature for server owners and modpack developers. Allows for the prevention of any skill from being learned by a player. Especially useful for addons that may introduce broken or buggy skills.

To prevent a player from learning any skill, simply open the /config/trutils-common.toml file. Then, add the id of the skill that you want to prevent to the array of values.

For Example, the following will prevent Predator from base Tensura, and the Plunderer skill from Mysticism:

```
blockedSkills = ["tensura:predator", "trmysticism:plunderer"]
```


This will work with all skill types: Intrinsic, Common, Extra, Unique, and Ultimate.

Hopefully you enjoy!

title: ZynAutoEat
description: Auto Eat that actually helps: off-hand first, smooth until full, respects your inputs, safe around fishing rods, and fully configurable via a clean, searchable blacklist UI (toggle-all/reset). Client-side only.
body:
![Download Now!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b4ab64ba62705ab6e8438b68e92167d48be1d88c.png)

# ZynAutoEat — Hands Free Auto Eat for Fabric & Forge

ZynAutoEat keeps your hunger full without stealing control from you. It automatically eats from your **off-hand first**, then main hand, then hotbar, and smoothly chains bites **until full**. It **pauses** the moment you right-click or open any GUI and **resumes automatically** afterward. Built as a lightweight **client-side** QoL mod, it works on servers that don’t have the mod installed.

> **Loaders:** Fabric **and** Forge  
> This page hosts both builds. If a Forge build isn’t listed yet for your version, it’s in the pipeline.

### Features
- **Off-hand priority** with hotbar fallback  
- **Smooth chain-eating** until full (keeps the vanilla eating animation)  
- **Respects your inputs** pauses on right-click and while any GUI is open; resumes when you’re done  
- **Fishing-rod safe** avoids accidental cast/reel between bites  
- **In-game blacklist** with **Search**, **Toggle-All**, and **Reset**  
- Action-bar toggle message: `[ZynAutoEat] Enabled/Disabled`  
- **Client-side only**; server-friendly

### How it works
- Triggers eating only in **Survival** mode  
- Chooses food in this order: **Off-hand → Main hand → Hotbar**  
- Skips any item you’ve **blacklisted** in Settings  
- Chains bites until your hunger is full, then stops  
- Pauses instantly when you right-click or open a screen (chat/inventory/etc.), then resumes automatically

### Settings (in-game)
Open **ZynAutoEat Settings** to configure per-item blacklist:
- Categories: **Danger Foods**, **Super Foods**, **Normal Foods**  
- Search bar, Toggle-All, and Reset to defaults  
- Settings are stored locally

### Controls (default)
- **H** — Toggle ZynAutoEat  
- **J** — Open ZynAutoEat Settings

### Compatibility
- **Client-side only** (QoL): works on any server; no server component required  
- Designed for **Fabric & Forge** (this project lists both)

### Requirements
- **Fabric:** Fabric Loader + Fabric API  
- **Forge:** Forge (no Fabric API required)

### Installation
**Fabric**
1. Install Fabric Loader and Fabric API for your Minecraft version  
2. Put the ZynAutoEat `.jar` into your `mods/` folder  
3. Launch the game, press **H** to enable, **J** to configure

**Forge**
1. Install the Forge Loader for your Minecraft version  
2. Put the ZynAutoEat Forge `.jar` into your `mods/` folder  
3. Launch the game, press **H** to enable, **J** to configure

### FAQ
- **Will it eat “bad” foods (e.g., Rotten Flesh)?**  
  Not if you blacklist them. The Settings screen ships with sensible defaults you can tweak anytime.
- **Does it work with custom modded foods?**  
  Yes — if an item has a standard `FoodComponent`, it can be used (unless blacklisted).
- **Will it fight my right-click (RMB)?**  
  No. The mod pauses immediately while you’re holding right-click and resumes after you release.

### Credits
Author: **Zynwro** • Contact: **https://www.linktr.ee/zynwro**

Explore forgotten kingdoms, rebuild lost legacies, and forge your own path in a realm shaped by mystery, magic, and ruin.
