![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5b0c07058336f5926836e8b6bd66a1d460a654c2_0.webp)

🗺️ 🜂 Chronicles of the Lost Lands

The Earth has been forgotten. Burning portals crumble to ashes, and beneath the ruins of the world lies something that remembers ancient times. Your task is not just to survive. Your task is to uncover the truth.

✨ Story description of the modpack:

Welcome to the Chronicles of the Lost Lands — a modpack that takes you on a journey through transformed Minecraft worlds, full of abandoned fortresses, living ruins, pulsating portals, and echoes of forgotten civilizations.

As a traveler, you awaken among overgrown paths and forgotten campfires. With every step, you discover more — not only about the world around you but also about yourself. Your skills grow. You remember the arts of combat, crafting, and survival that once came naturally.

But you are not alone. The world lives — literally. Every sound, every path, every ruin hides a story waiting to be told.

⚔️ What awaits you?

🧭 Exploration
Discover beautifully generated worlds filled with dungeons & taverns, fiery biomes (Incendium), and ancient structures (Yggdrasil, Hopo Better Ruins).

🛡️ Character development and RPG
Choose your path of growth with Skills Odyssey and built-in skill trees. Complete quests that guide you through a narrative journey (Quests: Journey).

🌿 Survival with soul
Organize your inventory (Inventory Tabs, Chest Tracker), survive dark nights with Dynamic Lights and Clumps, explore caves with realistic sounds (Presence Footsteps, Sound Physics).

🎨 Immersion and atmosphere
Immerse yourself in a world that looks and sounds so good it will be hard to go back to vanilla: Better Animations, Visuality, 3D Crops, Enhanced Audio, Falling Leaves.

🧰 Creator and explorer tools
With WorldEdit, Jade, Xaero’s Minimap, and Zoomify, you create and traverse the world with full control.

🧙‍♂️ Gameplay style:

    Immersive RPG

    Open world with mysteries

    Solo or multiplayer

    No tech overload — a world, not a machine

**Polish**
    
🗺️ 🜂 Kroniki Zaginionych Krain

    Ziemia została zapomniana. Płonące portale rozsypują się w popiół, a pod ruinami świata drzemie coś, co pamięta o dawnych czasach. Twoim zadaniem nie jest tylko przetrwanie. Twoim zadaniem jest odkryć prawdę.

✨ Opis fabularny modpacka:

Witaj w Kronikach Zaginionych Krain — modpacku, który zabiera cię w podróż przez odmienione światy Minecrafta, pełne opuszczonych twierdz, żywych ruin, pulsujących portali i echa zapomnianych cywilizacji.

Jako podróżnik, budzisz się pośród zarośniętych dróg i zapomnianych ognisk. Z każdym krokiem odkrywasz więcej — nie tylko o otaczającym cię świecie, ale i o sobie. Twoje umiejętności rosną. Przypominasz sobie sztuki walki, rzemiosła i przetrwania, które kiedyś były oczywiste.

Ale nie jesteś sam. Świat żyje — dosłownie. Każdy dźwięk, każda ścieżka, każda ruina skrywa historię, która chce zostać opowiedziana.
⚔️ Co czeka na ciebie?

🧭 Eksploracja
Odkrywaj przepięknie wygenerowane światy pełne lochów (Dungeons & Taverns), ognistych biomów (Incendium) i pradawnych struktur (Yggdrasil, Hopo Better Ruins).

🛡️ Rozwój postaci i RPG
Wybierz swoją ścieżkę rozwoju dzięki Skills Odyssey i wbudowanym drzewkom umiejętności. Wypełniaj zadania, które prowadzą cię przez fabularną podróż (Quests: Journey).

🌿 Survival z duszą
Uporządkuj swój ekwipunek (Inventory Tabs, Chest Tracker), przetrwaj mroczne noce z Dynamic Lights i Clumps, eksploruj jaskinie z realistycznymi dźwiękami (Presence Footsteps, Sound Physics).

🎨 Imersja i klimat
Zanurz się w świecie, który wygląda i brzmi tak dobrze, że trudno będzie wrócić do vanilla: Better Animations, Visuality, 3D Crops, Enhanced Audio, Falling Leaves.

🧰 Narzędzia twórcy i eksploratora
Z WorldEdit, Jade, Xaero’s Minimap i Zoomify tworzysz i przemierzasz świat z pełną kontrolą.
🧙‍♂️ Styl rozgrywki:

    Immersyjne RPG

    Otwarty świat z tajemnicami

    Solo lub multiplayer

    Bez przesady z technologią – świat, nie maszyna

title: Simple Double Jump
description: Adds a fully customizable double‑jump mechanic to your game.
body:
# Simple Double Jump

Adds a fully customizable double-jump mechanic to your game.

## Features

- **Customizable Jump Mechanics**
  - Horizontal & Vertical force multipliers
  - Hunger Drain
  - Cooldown
- **Audio & Visual Effects**
  - Play any vanilla sound on jump.
  - Spawn configurable particles on jump.
- **Preserve Fall Damage**
  - Toggle whether players keep fall damage after a double jump.
- **Fly Conflict Prevention**
  - Automatically disables double jump whilst /fly is enabled to avoid conflicts.

## Commands

| Command       | Description                 | Permission  | Default |
|---------------|-----------------------------|-------------|---------|
| `/sdj reload` | Reload plugin configuration | `sdj.admin` | `op`    |

## Permissions

| Permission   | Description                  | Default |
|--------------|------------------------------|---------|
| `sdj.admin`  | Reload the plugin’s config   | `op`    |
| `sdj.use`    | Allow players to double jump | `op`    |



## Configuration

<details>
  <summary>config.yml</summary>

  ```yml
  # Whether players keep fall damage after performing a double jump.
  preserveFallDamage: true
  
  # Prevents conflicts with flying abilities.
  avoidFlyConflicts: true
  
  # Use server-side ground detection instead of trusting client packets.
  # Prevents exploits but may cause slight delays on high-latency connections.
  hardenedGroundCheck: false
  
  # When double jumping should be allowed:
  #   ALL        - Available to everyone.
  #   PERMISSION - Players need a specific permission.
  activationMethod: "PERMISSION"
  
  # Technical double jump configuration.
  jump-settings:
    # Delay between consecutive double jumps (in server ticks; 20 ticks = 1 second).
    # To disable double jump cooldowns, set this value to 0 or less.
    cooldown-ticks: 0
  
    # The amount of hunger points that should be deducted per double jump.
    # 1 point = half a drumstick; set to 0 to disable hunger drain.
    hunger-drain: 1
  
    # Factor applied to the normalised look vector to compute horizontal velocity.
    # In simpler terms, increasing this value makes you travel farther horizontally.
    horizontal-force-multiplier: 0.5
  
    # The upward velocity applied when performing a double jumping.
    # Measured in blocks per tick; increase for a stronger vertical boost.
    vertical-velocity: 0.42
  
    # Double jump effects configuration.
    effects:
      sound:
        # Whether sound effects should be played whenever you double jump.
        enabled: true
  
        # The vanilla Minecraft sound to play whenever double jumping.
        source: "entity.ender_dragon.flap"
  
        # The volume level for the sound effect (0.0 to 1.0).
        volume: 0.5
  
        # The pitch modifier for the sound effect (0.0 to 2.0).
        pitch: 1.32
  
      particles:
        # Whether particle effects should be displayed whenever you double jump.
        enabled: true
  
        # The vanilla Minecraft particle to spawn whenever double jumping.
        type: "CLOUD"
  
        # The number of particles to spawn per double jump.
        count: 30
  
        # How far particles can spread from the players position.
        spread: 0.25
  ```

</details>

<details>
  <summary>language.yml</summary>

  ```yml
  reload: "&aConfiguration successfully reloaded!"
  no-permission: "&cYou don't have permission to run this command."
  players-only: "&cYou cannot run this command via the console."
  cooldown: "&cYou must wait &e<cooldown>&c seconds before double jumping again!"

  exempt-toggle:
    on: "&aDouble jumping enabled."
    off: "&cDouble jumping disabled."
  ```

</details>

## Support & License

⭐ If you find this project useful, consider giving it a star on GitHub!

📜 This project is under the [MIT License](https://github.com/RareHyperIonYT/Simple-Double-Jump/blob/main/LICENSE).

title: Remove "Creator" Music Discs
description: This simple datapack removes the drop of the "Creator" music disc from Ominous Vaults and the "Creator (Music Box)" disc from pots in Trial Chambers.
body:
This simple datapack removes the drop of the "Creator" music disc from Ominous Vaults and the "Creator (Music Box)" disc from pots in Trial Chambers.

**What it does:**  
- Prevents Ominous Vaults from dropping the "Creator" music disc when opened.  
- Removes the "Creator (Music Box)" disc from loot pools of pots in Trial Chambers.  
- All other loot from these sources remains unchanged.  

**Installation:**  
1. Download the datapack `.zip` file.  
2. Place it in the `datapacks` folder of your world save.  
3. Type `/reload` in-game.

title: Cozymon
description: A cobblemon pack that aims to encourage exploration as well as cool battles!
body:
![Pencil Fox Studios and Cozy Fox Den present... Cozymon! Featuring BeanCraft and the Supporters of Shackhorn Galaxy](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6a3a10fc5c4293df342cee1678c24fbf7c21adc9.png)
# Summary
A cobblemon modpack for my buddies and I, and perhaps for a public discord server, now on Modrinth! Encourages exploration, forging, and battling.
# Goals
The main purpose of Cozymon is to provide a way for friend groups who enjoy the idea of Cobblemon to come together and battle each other amidst basic survival needs!

While the modpack is mostly centered around Cobblemon, there are other quality-of-life features and technology-based mods that should make life as a Cobblemon trainer more interesting. For example...

## Create+
Starting off strong with Create and many Create addition mods, you can automate, build, and conveyor to heart's content! There are also railways to get around for all my fellow train enthusiasts out there. 👀

## Yung's Suite of Mods
Thanks to the Yung suite of mods, exploration is very interesting! Find dungeons, mineshafts, nether fortresses, and dessert temples that are sure to have nice loot.

## Ad Astra
Get ready to go to space with this mod! Be sure to leave your Cobblemon at home, though. Sorry. There wasn't a budget for cute lil' space suits that fit each one.

### and much, much more... how much more? Well...

# Mods
You can access a list of mods by going [here](https://modrinth.com/modpack/cozy-mon/version/latest) and scrolling down to see what's under **Dependencies**!

Have fun!

title: Armament
description: Adds the ability to create configurable custom armors using resource packs.
body:
# 🧥 **Armament** Adds the ability to create configurable custom armors using resource packs. --- ## 🎧 **Key Features** | Feature | Description | | --- | --- | | **🛡️ Custom Armor Sets** | Easily add your own armor sets to Minecraft. | | **⚡ Performance Optimization** | Built to ensure smooth server performance. | | **💡 User-Friendly** | Simple commands for reloading configuration and giving armor to players. | | **⚙ Configurable** | Manage your custom armors via a straightforward `armors.yml` file. | | **🎨 Resource Pack Generation** | Automatically generate a resource pack from your configuration. | | **🔃 Cross-Version Compatibility** | Supports Minecraft versions from `1.20` to the latest. | | **🖼️ GUI Interface** | Browse and select custom armor sets through an intuitive GUI. | --- ## 💻 **Available Commands** | Command | Description | | --- | --- | | **`/armament reload`** | Reload the plugin's configuration without a server restart. | | **`/armament give [player]`** | Grant a custom armor piece to a player. | | **`/armament giveset [player]`** | Grant a full custom armor set to a player. | | **`/armament gui`** | Open the GUI to browse and select custom armor sets. | --- ## 🔒 **Permissions** | Permission | Description | | --- | --- | | **`armament.admin`** | Grants access to all admin commands. | --- ## 📩 **Installation Steps** 1. **Download Armament:** - Get the latest version from [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/plugin/armament). 2. **Install:** - Place the `.jar` file into your server's `plugins` directory. - Example: `/plugins/Armament-x.x.x.jar` 3. **Activate:** - Restart your server to load the plugin. 4. **Customize:** - Edit the `armors.yml` file located in `plugins/Armament/armors.yml` to add your custom armor sets. - Example configuration: ```yaml armors: epic: custom_model_data: 1 helmet: name: "&6Epic Chestplate" lore: - "&7Custom Epic Lore!" chestplate: name: "&6Epic Chestplate" lore: - "&7Custom Epic Lore!" leggings: name: "&6Epic Leggings" lore: - "&7Custom Epic Lore!" boots: name: "&6Epic Boots" lore: - "&7Custom Epic Lore!" ``` 5. **Add Resources:** - Place your custom armor textures in the `source_files` directory: - Armor layers: `source_files/layer_files/` - Armor display items: `source_files/item_files/` 6. **Load Resource Pack:** - Upload the generated resource pack to [mc-packs.net](https://mc-packs.net). - Update the `server.properties` file: | Property | Value | | --- | --- | | `resource-pack` | *URL to resource pack* | | `resource-pack-sha1` | *SHA1 hash of the resource pack* | | `require-resource-pack` | `true` | - **Note:** If you're using an existing resource pack, merge it with the Armament resource pack. --- ## 🎨 **Creating Custom Armor Textures** To create custom armor textures for Armament: 1. **Open the Template:** - Locate the `armor_model.bbmodel` file in [src/main/resources](https://github.com/Furq07/Armament/tree/main/src/main/resources). - Open this file in BlockBench to get an understanding of the armor structure. 2. **Customize the Model:** - Ensure your model adheres to Minecraft's armor structure. 3. **Export Textures:** - Export your custom armor textures. 4. **Prepare Texture Files:** The plugin requires specific naming conventions for the texture files: a) **Layer Files** (Required): In `source_files/layer_files/`: - `armorName_layer_1.png`: For helmet, chestplate, and boots - `armorName_layer_2.png`: For leggings b) **Item Files** (Optional, based on armors.yml): In `source_files/item_files/`: - `armorName_helmet.png` - `armorName_chestplate.png` - `armorName_leggings.png` - `armorName_boots.png` Replace `armorName` with the name of your custom armor set as defined in `armors.yml`. 5. **Place Textures:** - Put the armor layer textures (`*_layer_1.png` and `*_layer_2.png`) in `source_files/layer_files/`. - Put the display item textures (e.g., `*_helmet.png`) in `source_files/item_files/`. 6. **Update Configuration:** - In `armors.yml`, reference your new textures using the appropriate armor name. - Ensure the armor name in the configuration matches the prefix used in your texture file names. **Note:** The item files (helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots) are optional and depend on your `armors.yml` configuration. If you define a specific armor piece in the config, make sure to provide the corresponding item texture. --- ## 📞 **Support** For assistance, visit the [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/furq07/armament/issues) or join our [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/7ugrBEKza4). --- ## 📜 **License** Armament is released under the [Apache License 2.0](https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0). --- ## 🤝 **Partner**

title: Project Mars
description: A spiritual successor of the very popular Modpack "Race To The Moon"
body:
![Project Mars Banner](https://i.imgur.com/GGC9tF8.png) ##
A Spiritual Successor to Race To The Moon
Project Mars takes the spirit of exploration and innovation from the beloved "Race To The Moon" modpack and blasts it to a whole new level! This Fabric-based adventure sends you not just to the moon, but accross the whole galaxy! Brace yourself for a brand new frontier filled with familiar gameplay enhanced by exciting world generation, tech-driven progression, and immersive features ### Embrace On A New Frontier - World Generation: Explore a vast new world, with breathtaking biomes. Discover hidden secrets in transformed structures like mineshafts, dungeons, and temples - Tech to Thrive: Industrial Revolution, Modern Dynamics, and Applied Energistics 2 fuel your quest for Martian mastery. Craft intricate machines, automate processes, and build a self-sustaining colony powered by steam and electricity - Adventure Awaits: Unravel the mysteries of new worlds with When Dungeons Arise and delve into challenging dungeons for valuable loot. Explore the seven seas with Small Ships and create your own Locomotive using create - Reimagine: Updating the original modpack's mod list, with newer up to date mods, and added some that can spice up the pack with new features and goals. This time, it isn't about reaching the Moon but exploring the cosmos the way you want to explore ### Project Mars is more than just a modpack: - Craft your own galactic adventure with diverse gameplay styles, from tech-focused automation to exploration and discovery - Immerse yourself in a vibrant world brought to life by stunning visuals, captivating soundscapes, and engaging challenges - Forge your own legacy as a pioneer, leaving your mark on the Martian landscape and pushing the boundaries of space exploration! Are you ready to embark on your new odyssey? Download Project Mars today and set your course for a new era of interstellar adventure! ### Story Background - The Astral Trans-Gov's colossal failure of Mission To The Moon hangs heavy in the air, The Astral Trans-Gov starts a new plan called Project Mars. A project with the task on exploring the Red Giant Planet called Mars. What most of the scientist didn't know, was the Astral Trans-Gov's true goals in this project. - A group of scientist was tasked to find a valid specimen to handle this project. You, the player, was chosen. You are the anomaly, the creature pulled from the fringes of society, chosen for reasons not entirely clear. Are you a genetically-engineered marvel, a relic of forgotten bio-experiments, or perhaps a survivor from a long-lost colony. - After you were picked, the scientist wiped your memory away, than dropped you in a remote location away from anyone. You're goals are the following, battle the elements, tame the hostile environment, and unravel the mysteries of the universe. title: Crystalline Ender Eye
description: Adds a new item used to teleport immediately.
body:
# 🪄Introduction
This mod only adds a new item: Crystalline Eye of Ender.
Using Crystalline Eye of Ender, you can achieve two types of teleportation: fixed-point teleportation and random teleportation.

### Fixed-point Teleportation
Right click while sneaking to write your current position in the eye, then left or right click to teleport other mob or yourself back here.

### Random Teleportion

title: Passenger Perspective
description: Camera improvements for theme park servers.
body:
# Passenger Perspective

Passenger Perspective (or PaPers for short) is a Fabric mod that improves the camera for theme park servers.

### Demo video (click to watch)
[![demo video](https://img.youtube.com/vi/TC_92oMWGjE/0.jpg)](https://youtu.be/TC_92oMWGjE)

# How to use

- If the server you're playing on has a setting for forced ride perspective, disable it.
- Enter the ride as normal.
- Run the command `/papers focus`. Your ride vehicle should start glowing.
- Your camera will be controlled by the mod while you're riding a vehicle and have a focused vehicle (they do not have 
to be the same).
- You can disable the mod by running `/papers clear`.

# Compatibility
PaPers is designed to work with as many servers as possible. Most servers use the same technique to make rides using 
armour stands, but no two servers are the same, so sometimes things break!
The mod's known to work on the following servers:
- [Imagine Fun](https://imaginefun.net)
- <small>Found another server that the mod works on? Please [make an issue](https://github.com/lucyydotp/passenger-perspective/issues/new) and I'll add it to this list!</small>

With this ***beautiful***™ pack, I made it so that each trim of armor in the upcoming 1.20 update is capable of having a custom ability given to it when you apply a trim. All Trim Bonuses

Coast

- Gives the player regeneration in the rain. Regen I with one piece, II with two or three pieces, and regen III for all four pieces ![Coast Trim Preview](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/514848853678096384/1067951273531428974/image.png)

- Gives the player knockback resistance equivalent to the netherite counterpart. For a tip, this means that you can take nearly no knockback with full netherite sentry armor ![Sentry Trim Preview](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/514848853678096384/1067953205343957093/image.png)

body:
# Overall Introduction
Added some new uses to emerald.
These might contribute to your improvement and make you stronger.
# Refined Emerald Tools
The Refined Emerald class is divided into three tiers: Type Ⅰ![Refined Emerald](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6488588aff72e5b69a7ea086b3abdddf73064a86_0.webp), Type Ⅱ![Refined Emerald Ⅱ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1df07584f7acd5077b541cde10d3572048cda00a_0.webp), and Type Ⅲ![Refined Emerald Ⅲ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/972869fd68dfb27ab8d4d636714ab78e5d5d3b2e_0.webp). 
Type Ⅰ can be crafted at a crafting table, while Type Ⅱ and Type Ⅲ require using the previous tier's Refined Emerald by right-clicking on the corresponding tier's Refined Emerald block (for example, to obtain Refined Emerald Ⅱ, you need to hold Refined Emerald Ⅰ and right-click on Refined Emerald block Ⅰ).

The Type Ⅰ and Type Ⅱ Refined Emerald tools only have some auxiliary functions, but Type Ⅲ Refined Emerald tools far surpass the capabilities of the standard Netherite tools, making them incredibly useful for various operations! Additionally, Type Ⅲ Refined Emerald tools possess special skills.

Of course, as expected, Refined Emerald tools Ⅲ also come with certain risks.

# Void Emerald Tools (The version 1.1.0 (inclusive) and later)
The Refined Emerald Ⅱ can also choose not to be upgraded to Refined Emerald Ⅲ and instead pursue an alternative path: the Void Emerald class.
![Void Emerald](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/69b0192d340df100374225fee6f025e73576b1f4_0.webp)

Void Emerald tools possess unique special skills that differ from those of Refined Emerald Ⅲ tools, but they require the corresponding diamond tools to be crafted at a forge table.

Each Void Emerald tool has a built-in enchantment "Void Emerald Attach",whitch can increase damage by percentage.

# Lava Emerald Tools (The version 1.1.7 (inclusive) and later)
The Refined Emerald can also choose not to be upgraded to Refined Emerald Ⅱ and instead pursue an alternative path: the Lava Emerald class.
![Lava Emerald](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d0709ec2d0f4e30ab1b1977c3125e0f7e1757112_0.webp)

Each Lava Emerald tool has built-in enchantment "Heavy",whitch can increase damage by falling from a height and "Lighting",whitch can either stick a torch in place or boost damage based on the brightness level.

title: PSYCHOSYS
description: Sanity Mod is a psychological horror mod that adds a sanity system and frightening visual and sound effects.
body:
# PSYCHOSYS

**Author: Stormy_editor**

Sanity Mod is a psychological horror mod that adds a sanity system and frightening visual and sound effects.

## Main Features

* **Sanity system (0–100)** — default 100
* Sanity decreases:

* at night, in the dark
* underground and in caves
* after prolonged inactivity
* Restores:

* during the day, in bright light
* near torches, campfires, or a bed
* sleeping in a bed: **+20 sanity**

## Effects by Sanity Level

**50–70 (Medium)**

* slight screen dimming
* whispers, fake footsteps

**10–50 (Low)**

* camera shaking
* HUD glitches
* black screen flashes
* fake mob sounds
* red alert messages

**0–10 (Critical)**

* strong camera shaking and rotation
* mini-teleports
* visual "Fake" damage
* VHS effects, red filter
* Rare fake crash (restores sanity to 30)

## HUD

Sanity indicator in the upper left corner:

* 🟢 70–100 — safe
* 🟡 30–70 — alarming
* 🟠 10–30 — dangerous
* 🔴 0–10 — critical

## Other

* Client/server synchronization
* Sanity persists after death
* Optimized, lag-free

⚠ **Warning:** Mod contains intense horror effects. Play at your own risk.

# Vanilla Challenges ![Challenge Brodcast](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/12562dbdc920fcf738a4e98e28edca5bab3c9ac7.png) It's a plugin that allows you to manage daily challenges to promote competition within the server! Designed for a Vanilla but usable in all modalities (Prison, Factions, Vanilla, Survival, Towny...), it is also configurable in many ways such as the points to give, the boost if you want more competitive and the give points at every minutes online for improve the loyalty of online players. # ⚡️Features⚡️ - Possibility to create and set infinity Challenges with a creation of a File in the correct Folder; - Possibility to create and set a Event Challenge; - Possibility to reset points at every challenge or accumulate points; - Possibility to give points if player is online; - Possibility to set Brodcast Message; - Possibility to view top in times or yesterday; - Possibility to use PlaceholderAPI; - Possibility to select Db you want use; - Possibility to configure all messages; - No Dependency; - RGB Support for messages; - Possibility to generate random Challenges order; - Possibility to set boost global with points; - Possibility to set boost for single player with points; - Possibility to set start hour and time duration for all Challenges; - Possibility to configure an interface of all Challenges; - Possibility to configure an infinite positions for the top; - Possibility to configure a reward for each position in the top; - Possibility to configure a series of rewards for each position in the top; - Possibility to randomize the challenges; - Possibility to disable the schedule in any moment with just a command;
Compatibility - CubeGenerator - Lands - WorldGuard - GriefPrevention - Tombs - SuperiorSkyblock2
# ⚡️Challenges Type⚡️ - Absorber - AFK - BlockBreaker - BlockPlacer - BoatMove - Breeder - Chatter - Consumer - Cooker - Crafter - Damager - Dier - Dropper - Dyer - EggThrower - Enchanter - EntityCatcher - ExpCollector - Feeder - FireCatcher - Fisher - Harvester - Healer - InventoryControl - ItemBreaker - ItemCollector - Jumper - JumperHorse - Killer - Leasher - Mover - Primer - Raider - SensorActuator - Shooter - Sleeper - Sneaker - Sprinter - WoolCutter ![List Command](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/db35ef65e7065b4a813172cc60f6f34aa219b8f1.png) # ⚡️Commands⚡️ - vc for add points at player - vc for see the current daily challenge - vc for clear all Challenges and Points - vc for stop Event Challenge - vc [time] for start Event Challenge with file configuration - vc [time] for start a random Event Challenge with file configuration - vc for see the list of Challenges (Player Only) - vc [skip] for go to the next challenge and if you want skip the peaceful time - vc for see your points (Player Only) - vc for see points of another player - vc for reload plugin configurations - vc for see the list of backup files (Console Only) - vc for restore a backup file with H2Database (Console Only) - vc for remove points at player - vc for receive reward of win - vc [time] for add a challenge in the schedule - vc [time] for add a random challenge in the schedule - vc for remove a challenge from the schedule - vc for disable the schedule - vc [time] for add time from current scheduled challenge - vc [time] for set time from current scheduled challenge - vc [time] for remove time from current scheduled challenge - vc for see the time remaining of the current challenge - vc [yesterday] for see the top daily/yesterday ![Help Command](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8e53a3d123c4ceda813ad4aa539fe0ebd3a589e8.png) # ⚡️Permissions⚡️ - vc.reload.command - vc.next.command - vc.top.command - vc.top.yesterday.command - vc.points.command - vc.points.player.command - vc.clear.command - vc.challenge.command - vc.reward.command - vc.list.command - vc.event.start.command - vc.event.stop.command - vc.schedule.add.command - vc.schedule.remove.command - vc.schedule.disable.command - vc.add.command - vc.remove.command - vc.time.add.command - vc.time.remove.command - vc.time.set.command - vc.time.remaining.command # ⚡️Placeholder⚡️ - %vanillachallenges_points% - %vanillachallenges_dailychallenge_name% - %vanillachallenges_dailychallenge_displayName% - %vanillachallenges_dailychallenge_time_complete% - %vanillachallenges_dailychallenge_time_without_zeros% - %vanillachallenges_dailychallenge_time_seconds% - %vanillachallenges_dailychallenge_time_minutes% - %vanillachallenges_dailychallenge_time_hours% - %vanillachallenges_dailychallenge_active% - %vanillachallenges_dailychallenge_top_name_#% # = number - %vanillachallenges_dailychallenge_top_points_#% # = number - %vanillachallenges_dailychallenge_boost_multiplier% - %vanillachallenges_dailychallenge_boost_points_remain% - %vanillachallenges_dailychallenge_boost_multiplier_single_player% - %vanillachallenges_dailychallenge_boost_points_remain_single_player% - %vanillachallenges_top_victories_name_#% # = number - %vanillachallenges_top_victories_points_#% # = number - %vanillachallenges_top_first_place_name_#% # = number - %vanillachallenges_top_first_place_points_#% # = number - %vanillachallenges_top_second_place_name_#% # = number - %vanillachallenges_top_second_place_points_#% # = number - %vanillachallenges_top_third_place_name_#% # = number - %vanillachallenges_top_third_place_points_#% # = number # ⚡️bStats⚡️ ![bStats](https://bstats.org/signatures/bukkit/VanillaChallenges.svg) # ⚡️Configs⚡️

title: El Gato Ender Pearl
description: This resource packs makes your ender pearls have a cute el gato image instead of normal texture.
body: This pack swaps the boring ender pearl texture for a cute El Gato image. Works on Minecraft 1.20.2 to 1.21.11. Great for cat lovers who like pvping and want to change up their pearl look. Enjoy!

title: Quexo's Colored Maces
description: Different Colored Maces Depending On Their Enchants!
body:
📒 Change Your Mace's Color Depending On Enchants!

- 🖤 Netherite Mace - No Enchants
- ❤️ Redstone Mace - Density
- 💙 Blue Mace - Breach
- 🧡 Copper Mace - Any Enchants [Besides Breach/Density]
- 🌈 Rainbow Mace - Breach + Density [Only Obtainable Via Commands]


💛 Quexo's Golden Mace - Every Mace Enchants On One Mace

title: BuildsModpacks
description: Performance, QOL and visual quality focused modpacks, which keep it vanilla.
body:
BuildsModpacks are modpacks made for Kermitcraft (private server), focused on optimization and QoL with high customizability. It also adds some server-specific things, such as the F1 boat models and Simple Voice Chat. Finally, some visual and audio mods are also included, such as HUD QoL additions, sound physics and particle weather.

Version first includes the Minecraft version, then the modpack version.

title: ArenaLite
description: Best FFA plugin out here for free and open source
body:
# ArenaLite

A configurable kit-based Free-For-All (FFA) plugin for Paper 1.21+ servers. ArenaLite focuses on a smooth admin workflow, reliable kit handling, and battle-ready defaults that you can tailor through configuration.

## Wiki page [Click Here](https://arenalite-wiki.pages.dev/)

## Highlights

- **Arena Workflow** – Create, list, delete, and configure arenas in-game (`/ffasetup create/delete/setspawn/build/setregen/list`).
- **Kit Management** – Save slot-accurate kits from your inventory, link them to arenas, and preview them safely.
- **Build Toggles** – Per-arena build flags with high-priority listeners ensure your FFA rules override other plugins when players join.
- **Safety Options** – Join protection and anti-cleanup buffs are fully configurable (or disable them entirely).
- **Storage Choices** – Player stats persist to YAML by default with optional MySQL support.
- **Optional Hooks** – Integrates with FastAsyncWorldEdit (FAWE), PlaceholderAPI, and Vault when present.
- **Safe Regen** – During arena regeneration, players inside the arena are teleported to that arena's set spawn and have movement locked until regen finishes.
- **Placeholders & Leaderboards** – PlaceholderAPI support for player stats and per-kit leaderboards (see Wiki for full list).

## Commands

### Player Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/ffa join <kit>` | Join with the specified kit. |
| `/ffa leave` | Leave the arena and return to the lobby spawn. |
| `/ffa kit preview <kit>` | View a read-only preview (if enabled). |
| `/ffa kit create <kit>` | Create a kit from your inventory (requires `arenalite.admin`). |
| `/ffa setspawn` | Set the global FFA lobby spawn (requires `arenalite.admin`). |
| `/ffa regen <arena>` | Manually trigger a regen (requires `arenalite.admin`). |
| `/ffa reload` | Reload configuration and data (requires `arenalite.admin`). |

### Setup Commands (`arenalite.admin`)

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/ffasetup wand` | Receive the region selection wand. |
| `/ffasetup create <arena>` | Create an arena using your current world. |
| `/ffasetup delete <arena>` | Remove an arena (kits linked to it are unlinked). |
| `/ffasetup setspawn <arena>` | Set the arena spawn point. |
| `/ffasetup setregen <arena> <true|false>` | Toggle regeneration for the arena. |
| `/ffasetup build <arena> <true|false>` | Enable or disable player building for the arena. |
| `/ffasetup list` | Display arena summary (spawn/regen/build state). |
| `/ffasetup kit create <kit>` | Save your current inventory as a kit. |
| `/ffasetup kit delete <kit>` | Delete an existing kit. |
| `/ffasetup kitlink <kit> <arena>` | Link a kit to an arena. |

## Configuration Overview

`config.yml` ships with sensible defaults and is fully documented inline. Key sections:

```yaml
join-protection:
  enabled: true
  duration: 10            # seconds
  clear-effects: true     # remove potion effects/fire when joining/leaving

anti-cleanup:
  enabled: true
  regen:
    enabled: true
    duration: 3           # seconds
  resistance:
    enabled: true
    duration: 5           # seconds
    level: 2

arenas:
  default-build-enabled: true
  default-regen-enabled: false
  default-regen-interval: 300

settings:
  hotbar-enabled: false
  scoreboard-enabled: true
  kit-previews:
    enabled: true
    readonly: true
  instant-respawn-delay: 1   # ticks

ffa:
  spawn: ""                 # set via /ffa setspawn

storage:
  type: YAML                 # YAML or MYSQL
  mysql:
    host: localhost
    port: 3306
    database: arenalite
    username: root
    password: password
    use-ssl: false
    table-prefix: arenalite_
```

Additional configuration lives in:

- `messages.yml` – Fully translatable messages.
- `arenas.yml` / `kits.yml` – Generated data stores (editing is optional).

## Storage Options

- **YAML (default)** – Zero setup, perfect for small/medium servers.
- **MySQL** – Enable in `config.yml` for asynchronous read/write through the Bukkit scheduler.

## Optional Integrations

- **FastAsyncWorldEdit** – Speeds up and enhances regeneration when present. Without FAWE, ArenaLite uses its built-in snapshot-based regen.
- **PlaceholderAPI** – Registers `%arenalite_*%` placeholders automatically.
- **Vault** – Foundation for upcoming economy rewards (hook loads when Vault is present).

## Installation

1. Drop the plugin into your `plugins/` directory.
2. Start the server once to generate configuration files.
3. Adjust `config.yml`, `messages.yml`, and the data files as needed.
4. Use the `/ffasetup` commands to create arenas and kits.

## Permissions

- `arenalite.use` – Access to player commands (default: everyone).
- `arenalite.admin` – Access to setup/admin commands (default: OP).
- `arenalite.*` – Grants both of the above.

## Useful Links

- [docs/SETUP.md](https://github.com/synkfr/ArenaLite/blob/master/docs/SETUP.md) – Step-by-step arena & kit setup.
- [docs/REGEN.md](https://github.com/synkfr/ArenaLite/blob/master/docs/REGEN.md) – How safe regeneration works and how to configure it.
- [docs/API.md](https://github.com/synkfr/ArenaLite/blob/master/docs/API.md) – Working with ArenaLite in your own plugins.
- [docs/PERFORMANCE.md](https://github.com/synkfr/ArenaLite/blob/master/docs/PERFORMANCE.md) – Tuning advice for larger servers.
- [docs/Wiki.md](https://github.com/synkfr/ArenaLite/blob/master/docs/Wiki.md) – Commands, permissions, placeholders, and usage tips.

## Building From Source

```bash
git clone <repository-url>
cd ArenaLite
mvn clean package
```

The compiled JAR is produced in `target/`.

## License & Support

ArenaLite is released under the MIT License. If you run into issues:

1. Check the documentation.
2. Search existing GitHub issues.
3. Open a new issue with reproduction steps and server logs.

Enjoy the fights!

title: Tooltips DLP8
description: A client-side mod that adds customizable tooltips to items with JSON configuration and color formatting support.
body:
# Tooltips DLP8

A simple client-side mod that adds customizable tooltips to Minecraft items. Uses resource packs for easy distribution and configuration!

## Features

- Customizable tooltips with hex colors (#RRGGBB)
- Line break support (#n)
- **Resource pack only** - Distribute configurations easily
- **Multiple resource pack support** - Load tooltips from multiple packs
- JSONC configuration with comments
- `/tooltips reload` command to reload configuration
- Predefined colors for CivLabs classes
- Automatic resource pack detection and loading
- Resource pack name display in commands

## Configuration

### Resource Pack Method

Create resource packs with tooltip configurations in `assets/tooltips-dlp8/[your-filename].jsonc`:

**Important**: Use different filenames (like `civlabs.jsonc`, `my-server.jsonc`, etc.) instead of `tooltips.jsonc` to avoid conflicts with the mod's built-in tooltips.

```jsonc
{
  // Example tooltips for CivLabs classes: You can add comments with // or /* */
  "minecraft:diamond_sword": "#e03e2dGuardsman's Weapon#n#resetA sharp blade forged by skilled hands",
  "minecraft:golden_apple": "#b96ad9Healer's Blessing#n#resetRestores health and grants temporary effects"
}
```

### Multiple Resource Packs

The mod supports loading tooltips from multiple resource packs simultaneously. Tooltips from later packs will override earlier ones if they have the same item ID.

## Color Codes

- `#RRGGBB` - Hex color (e.g., `#ff0000` for red)
- `#reset` - Reset to default tooltip color
- `#n` - New line

### Specialization Experiment Classes Colors

- `#7e8c8d` - Blacksmith (Gray)
- `#f1c40f` - Builder (Yellow)
- `#2dc26b` - Farmer (Green)
- `#e03e2d` - Guardsman (Red)
- `#b96ad9` - Healer (Purple)
- `#3598db` - Librarian (Blue)
- `#ecf0f1` - Miner (Light Gray)

See this resource pack for an example: [SpEx Resource Pack](https://modrinth.com/project/vvvveYgC)


## Commands

- `/tooltips reload` - Reload configuration from resource packs and show loaded packs
- `/tooltips help` - Show help, current status, and loaded resource packs

The commands will display:
- Number of loaded tooltips
- Number of resource packs with tooltips
- Names of loaded resource packs

Perfect for roleplay servers, custom servers, or adding custom information to your items!

title: Lazy Placing
description: Placing a block now takes some time
body:
# Lazy Placing

[Github](https://github.com/whiteGloom/lazy-placing)

A Minecraft Fabric & Forge mod which changes one of the main mechanics in game - block placement timing.

In vanilla Minecraft, any block will be placed instantly, but now you'll have to wait a bit before a block will be placed.

![Preview](https://github.com/whiteGloom/lazy-placing/raw/main/additional/preview.gif)

## Info

By default, the time needed to place a block will be 0.6 seconds (see "configuration" section).

The mod

*   works in singleplayer, LAN and dedicated server
*   should be compatible with most of the other mods, it should work with all block-items, which do not have custom block placement mechanics
*   affects only survival gamemode

## Dependencies

This mod requires:

### Fabric

*   [Minecraft Java Edition](https://www.minecraft.net/ru-ru/store/minecraft-deluxe-collection-pc) >=1.20.1 <=1.20.4
*   [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) ^0.16.9
*   [Fabric API](https://github.com/FabricMC/fabric) ^0.92.2

(Version resolution from [Fabric Documentation](https://wiki.fabricmc.net/documentation:fabric_mod_json_spec#versionrange))

### Forge

*   [Minecraft Java Edition](https://www.minecraft.net/ru-ru/store/minecraft-deluxe-collection-pc) >=1.20.1 <=1.20.4
*   [Forge](https://github.com/FabricMC/fabric) >47

## Uninstallation

To uninstall the mod, remove it from the `mods` folder.

## Configuration

When the game starts for the first time, the mod will generate a configuration file in `config/lazyplacing.json` (in root folder of Minecraft, not `mods` folder).

The file will have the following content:

```
{
  "stablePlacingDuration": 12,
  "maxRandomAdditionDuration": 0
}
```

You can create this file by hand if you want to change the default without starting the game.

If the configuration file was deleted, mod will generate a new one with default values.

### Properties:

*   `stablePlacingDuration` - default value is `12` ticks (0.6 seconds). The minimum time needed to place a block
*   `maxRandomAdditionDuration` - default value is `0` ticks (0 seconds). The maximum clamp for random time, which may to the `stablePlacingDuration`

title: Nebula: Parasites
description: Adds parasitic monsters, infection spread, and infestation mechanics.
body:
This mod introduces dangerous parasites that seek to consume all living things. It all begins with a meteor crash - soon after, the infection starts spreading around the impact zone. Creatures near the site become twisted, horrifying parasite variants. As time passes, the parasites grow stronger, increase in number, and gradually take over the world.



**In the current version of the mod, the following early parasites are available:**

- Crudeform Medium
- Crudeform Small – appears when the transformed entity is a child or has 10 or less max health
- Infected Cow
- Infected Pig
- Infected Sheep
- Infected Zombie
- Simulated Player – a test model (planned to inherit the player's skin in future versions)

**Mechanics:**

- A custom infection system has been added, which takes into account the infection effect level (the higher the level, the greater the chance to transform into a parasite). Infection is spread through world "Warnings" like colonies and meteorite crash sites.
- An airborne infection transfer system: when a parasite is near an uninfected entity, there is a chance to infect it without direct contact.
- Save Zone system: special Purge Fields prevent infection from affecting entities within their radius (without considering direct contact when a parasite attacks the entity)
- **Starting from the first day, there is a chance that a meteor shower event will begin (Overworld only). After the event, three meteor impact sites will appear in the world, and within a small radius around each one, entities will begin to become infected with a parasitic infection.**

**Evolution Phases. There are 9 evolution phases for parasites:**

-2: Parasites do not exist in the world.
-1: Parasites can exist and spawn naturally, but only in places with no sunlight.
0 - 4: Phases when parasites receive a huge bonus (meteorite crash, available only in the Overworld) to their evolution and begin taking over the world.
5 - 6: Phases when parasites can spawn naturally at any time of the day.

**Custom Phase Spawn:**

- A custom spawn system is designed to spawn different parasite lists for each world, making travel to other dimensions more unpredictable. When a certain number of parasite points are reached, parasites will begin to spawn naturally, with increasing difficulty. The mob lists can be customized in the configuration file.

**Future Plans:**

- Add parasitic versions of all existing vanilla mobs.
- Add advanced custom mobs that will result from merging lower-level parasites.
- Introduce parasites from other planets and solar systems.
- Add compatibility between mods (parasitic versions for other mods).
- Plan to add parasites similar to the Necromorphs from the Dead Space series, along with their abilities and locations. (Nebula: Necromorphs)
- Add a city generator that can be customized using config and structure files. (Nebula: City)
- Develop a standalone mod focused on technology and the industrial revolution. (Nebula: Tech)
- Create a mod that allows interplanetary travel, enabling players to visit various planets inhabited by parasites that have invaded Earth. (Nebula: Space)

**This mod is in early development. It can be customized via configuration files to better suit your gameplay.**


**Feel free to include it in your modpack.
Thank you!**



**Help/Support/Suggestions:**

[Join the discord](https://discord.gg/peU9jS8rhA)

# WaypointHomes Adds Waypoints and Waypoint Transporters, a more immersive and balanced alternative to the common /home system many servers use. Players can place down Waypoints, then teleport to them later using a Waypoint Transporter. ## Crafting To craft a Waypoint, you use 3 glass, an eye of ender and 1 obsidian in this pattern. To use it, you right click with it in your hand. This places down the waypoint in your current position.






To make a Waypoint Transporter, you need 2 Breeze Rods and 1 Nether Star in this pattern. To use it, right click with it in your hand. This opens up the Waypoint Transporter's GUI. In this GUI, you can teleport to and remove waypoints, as well as right click on them with an item to set it as an icon.



## The GUI

The Waypoint Transporter GUI has arrows you can use to navigate to different pages, and you can click on waypoints to teleport to them. Right clicking with an item sets that item as the Waypoint's icon, and shift-right clicking will delete the waypoint, placing it back into your inventory.

title: DeathSentence
description: A very versatile death message plugin with sensible fallbacks. From adding your own custom death messages to reformatting the vanilla ones, this plugin has got you covered!
body:
# Death Sentence

## Introduction

DeathSentence is a plugin that allows you to customize death messages. The configuration provides extensive freedom to specify death messages for very specific circumstances. For example you could create a death message that you only get if a snowman kills you by throwing a snowball at an end crystal, which you explode from. Additionally, you could specify that this message should only appear for players with a certain permission, for players in a certain type of world as well as several other options!

The default configuration comes with a wide range of death messages for all of the circumstances in which a player regularly dies in the vanilla game. It also contains a lot of comments that explain how to configure the plugin.

## Feature overview

- Specify death messages for both very broad and very specific circumstances
- Support for custom text formatting (MiniMessage)
- PlaceholderAPI support
- Customize DeathMessage formatting (this includes vanilla messages)
- Configurable cooldown between death messages for a player
- Advanced fallback logic - if none of the specific death messages apply a more generic one is used (you will always get a death message)
- Allows for keeping the vanilla death messages and only expanding/reformatting them

## Installation

To install the plugin, simply Download the ``.jar``-File and drop it into your ``plugins`` Folder. Once you restart the server, a plugin folder (``plugins/DeathSentence``) will appear, in which you can find the default ``config.yml``. In there you can find detailed instructions on how to configure the plugin.

## Support

If you encounter any issues with this plugin, you can either submit a bug report via [GitHub](https://github.com/SlimeNexus/deathsentence/issues/) or if you have general questions you can write in ``#support`` on our [Discord Server](https://slime.nexus/discord/).

title: ChestSee - Chestlogger
description: ChestSee is a lightweight Fabric mod that automatically logs all player interactions with chests and other containers.
body:
ChestSee logs player interactions with chests, barrels and shulker boxes on your server. Drop it in, no config needed.

**How it works**

The mod runs server-side and tracks every time a player opens a container and changes its contents. It also logs when someone breaks a container or places a hopper underneath one.

All logs are saved as `.txt` files in your world folder under `ChestLog/`, sorted by dimension. Each container gets its own file, named after the block type and coordinates.

**Folder structure**
```
world/
└── ChestLog/
    ├── Overworld/
    │   ├── Chest 120 64 -340.txt
    │   └── Barrel 80 70 200.txt
    ├── The Nether/
    └── The End/
```

**Example log entry** (`Chest 120 64 -340.txt`)
```
[06.05.26  19:31:37] Steve
Items Added: [3 diamond]
Items Removed: [1 iron_ingot]

[06.05.26  19:45:02] Alex
Items Added: []
Items Removed: [3 diamond]

[06.05.26  20:10:14] Steve
Broke Chest
```

Inspired by [Aguga2201's Chest Logs](https://github.com/Aguga2201/ChestLog).

title: ModernOnlinePack
description: MinecraftOnlinePack for modern versions!
body:
### Introduction This is a fork of the official server resource pack for [MinecraftOnline](https://minecraftonline.com/), containing extensive changes to achieve compatibility with modern Minecraft versions and mods. It is particularly useful for those who prefer to play on the server using [ViaFabricPlus](https://modrinth.com/mod/viafabricplus), or those who are interested in experimenting with the pack's features on their own modern servers and worlds. ### Requirements This pack targets resource pack formats `15` and above (Minecraft `1.20` and up), as this is the range of versions for which multi-version support can be properly implemented. An effort is also being made to maintain compatibility with [OptiFine](https://optifine.net/downloads), its Fabric alternatives, and any vanilla features in the newest versions that are capable of replacing these in some capacity. However, each of these has historically come with its own limitations, be they in the form of bugs or missing features. For this reason, the setup that is best to use (in terms of maximizing the number of pack features that are properly functional) varies depending on your target Minecraft version and use case. The table below outlines each major scenario and its recommended setup: ||`1.20` - `1.21.1`|`1.21.2` - `1.21.3`|`1.21.4` and up| |:-:|:-:|:-:|:-:| |Playing on `minecraftonline.com`
or an equivalent `1.12.2` server
using ViaFabricPlus|`Fabric` + `CIT Resewn`|Unsupported (custom items will not work)|`Fabric` + `Variants-CIT`| |Playing on a modern server or world|`OptiFine`|`OptiFine`|`Fabric` + `Variants-CIT`| In this table, `Fabric` refers to a setup that includes [Continuity](https://modrinth.com/mod/continuity), [Entity Texture Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures), [Entity Model Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features), and their dependencies. Since [CIT Resewn](https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn) stopped being developed beyond `1.21.1`, higher versions have its features replaced by either [Variants-CIT](https://modrinth.com/mod/variants-cit) alone, or a combination of it and vanilla's [item state](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Items_model_definition) system (the latter case means that all CITs except for renamables and equipment will work on `1.21.5` and above without any mods installed). Please note also that it is generally recommended to always use either Minecraft `1.21.1` or the latest version of the game that is compatible with this pack. While there is an intention to preserve compatibility with all of the stated versions as much as possible, older versions of the mods above sometimes have a larger amount of bugs that may never be fixed. Additionally, if you choose to use this pack with [OptiFabric](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/optifabric) on versions where this is possible (`1.20` to `1.20.4`), please be sure to never install any of the mods mentioned above alongside it. Similarly, CIT Resewn and Variants-CIT should never be installed at the same time on versions where they are both available (`1.21` and `1.21.1`). ### Limitations Even on the latest versions, a handful of features are yet to be implemented, mostly because of issues relating to the mechanics on which this pack relies. They are as follows: * **Block-related**: * Custom blocks with coloured names (`Fireplace` and `Spooky Pumpkin`) will not render in most circumstances because Continuity does not currently support usage of the `raw:` prefix in the `name` property of CTM modules, which is crucial for selecting text components that specify a colour. * When using this pack with [Better Block Entities](https://modrinth.com/project/ONZm0H7Y) or [Enhanced Block Entities](https://modrinth.com/project/OVuFYfre) installed and fully enabled, custom chests, shulker boxes, and trapped chests will often not render correctly; the mod can optionally be disabled for these specific container types to prevent this from occurring, but this will of course disable their optimizations and long-distance visibility. * **Entity-related**: * Custom dragon explosions, dragon fireballs, end crystal beams, guardian beams, and minecarts do not render because they are not currently supported by Entity Texture Features. * Custom shot arrows are currently omitted from the pack because when included, looking at a player that has been shot by any arrow (custom or not) causes Entity Texture Features to repeatedly crash and tank the game's FPS. * Custom rabbits and baby rabbits (`Easter Bunny`) have strange or missing animations. * Custom baby villagers (`Sam`) have two separate arms that are not animated or linked to each other. * **GUI-related**: * The custom GUI for trash cans is currently omitted because it was incorrectly appearing for all containers ([OptiGUI](https://modrinth.com/mod/optigui) will become a dependency of the pack once this is resolved). * **Item-related**: * Custom armours do not render on baby mobs. ### Acknowledgments Special thanks to `Anna_28`, `LordOfTheShadows`, `ScarClaw72`, `Teaacup`, and the countless other staff and players of MinecraftOnline that have contributed their models, textures, and technical expertise to the base pack. Your amazing work is what inspired me to bring this project to modern versions in the first place. Thank you also to `BuffaloBom`, `eevee_27`, `eleanorsilly`, `Koi_Pond`, `Marmo_D`, and various others for tagging along with me in the wonderful, wacky, cutting-edge world of playing MinecraftOnline from modern versions, and staying patient with me as I worked on this project and perpetually underestimated how complex and time-consuming it would truly be. Your continued interest in my efforts is a big part of what kept me motivated to see this through despite the frequent moments of bewilderment and frustration that I encountered along the way.

title: ArcanaConcept
description: Forget items. Command the world itself using pure conceptual magic, and decipher the broken memory of the one who came before you.
body:
🌌 ArcanaConcept: The Weight of Knowing

"The world is not made of blocks. It is made of concepts."
ArcanaConcept redefines magic in Minecraft. Forget wands, physical spellbooks, or powder-based rituals. Here, magic is a science of the mind. You carry nothing, you craft nothing: you are the catalyst.

🧠 Awakening of the Mind
Your progression is no longer measured in materials, but in cognitive evolution.
Zero Items, Zero Blocks: True power occupies no space in your inventory. It resides entirely within your perception of reality.
Mindset Parameters: Shape how your consciousness interacts with the weave. Whether through Intuitive Resonance (hover) or Volitional Anchoring (click), the interface flows with your mental rhythm.
The Ethereal Grimoire: A living manifestation of your awareness. It no longer offers recipes, but fragments of a journey left behind by Alaric. As your Mental Capacity (MC) grows, the Grimoire evolves, revealing new sequences, and each entry unfolds across three layers of understanding — what is taught, what is doubted, and what remains once both have burned away.

📜 The Wheel of Concepts
Concepts are not read; they are experienced. To learn Gravity, you must fall. To learn Fire, you must burn.
Once learned, a Concept can be arranged. Magic here is an equation, not a button: the order of the Runes you assemble is the spell itself. Get it right, and reality answers. Get it wrong, and reality says nothing at all — no punishment, no explosion, just silence. Only a mind that holds the sequence and the strength to carry it gets an answer.

⚖️ Rank and the Weight of Knowing
Every spell carries a rank, from 1 to 20 — not a measure of danger, but of how much your mind must hold at once to keep it from collapsing. The higher the rank, the heavier the equation; understanding a spell has never been the same as being able to cast it.
Mana, meanwhile, answers to no such scale. It is simply the price of the world bending, paid the same whether you shape it by hand or let a rank hold it steady for you.

🕯️ A Sample of What Waits
Command the sky itself, and watch the clouds rearrange to a will other than their own. Raise a wall from realms better left unnamed, standing exactly as long as it is meant to and not a second more. Call back an echo of every foe you've laid low, and lead them as a silent, borrowed army. Anchor a shelter outside the layers you know — leave it, and it will still be waiting, exactly as you left it, when nobody was there to see.

🪐 The Arcana Alignment
Every 30 days, the sky changes, and the laws governing your reserves briefly loosen. Those who reach the world's furthest edge that night walk away carrying more than they did before.

🌑 The Unseen Path
Limits exist only to be questioned. Delve into the deepest layers of the Grimoire, follow the trail of Alaric's notes, and read closely — some pages don't say what they mean the first time.
The world is alive, and so, it seems, is its memory of you.

Become the Concept.

"It is simply reality remembering that it is nothing but a dream." — Alaric

title: PvPIndex Factions
description: Modern Factions refactor, old-school factions but with modern QOL features
body: PvPIndex Factions is a long-term modernization of the classic Factions experience for modern Paper servers. The goal is simple: revive Factions with a timeless architecture, reliable persistence, clean gameplay UX, and API-connectable systems that can integrate with modern server ecosystems for years to come. If you love classic Factions gameplay but need something maintainable, scalable, and integration-ready, PvPIndex Factions is built for exactly that. > **TeamsAPI integration available** - PvPIndex Factions connects natively with TeamsAPI to expose faction data to other compatible plugins and services. Requires TeamsAPI 2.4.0+. [Download TeamsAPI on Modrinth →](https://modrinth.com/plugin/teams-api) ## Supported platforms | Platform | Version | Notes | |---|---|---| | Paper | 1.21.x, 1.26.x | Recommended | | Folia | 1.21.x, 1.26.x | Native Folia scheduler support | | Spigot | 1.21.x, 1.26.x | Legacy compatibility mode | | Java | 21+ | | ## Vision: timeless Factions, modern backend PvPIndex Factions is not a quick port. It is an active refactor effort to make Factions: - Easier to operate in production - Easier to integrate with APIs and external systems - Easier to maintain across future Minecraft/Paper updates - More consistent for players and staff This project keeps the recognizable Factions identity while replacing legacy internals with a modern service/repository model and optional integration adapters. ## What is modernized vs legacy Factions Compared to older Factions-era plugins, PvPIndex Factions focuses on: - Modern command ergonomics and guided help UX - Persistent invite lifecycle with login notifications - Better map readability and interaction flow - More complete claim/unclaim modes - Configurable GUI-driven navigation - Optional tax/economy control for faction banks - Cleaner permissions and admin workflows - Soft-dependency integrations that fail gracefully - Documentation and operational runbooks for real server owners You keep the Factions gameplay loop, but gain a modern operational foundation. ## Why server owners choose PvPIndex Factions - Modernized `/f` command experience with familiar muscle memory - Persistent faction invites with login-time invite notifications - Advanced land control: `claim`/`unclaim` modes (`one`, `square`, `circle`, `fill`, `auto`) - Interactive `/f map` with clearer territory context - Faction bank with deposit/withdraw/transfer/history and optional tax engine - Configurable `/f` GUI via `gui.yml` - Scales from standalone setup to larger integrated networks ## Feature overview ### Faction lifecycle - Create, rename, describe, and disband factions - Member administration with invite/revoke/accept/decline flows - Leadership transfer and rank movement (promote/demote) - Fully manageable custom roles (`/f role ...`) with configurable priorities and prefixes - Clear onboarding through `/f help` ### Land and map - Claim/unclaim behavior designed for both casual and advanced use - `square`, `circle`, and `fill` modes for territory management - Auto claim/unclaim modes for movement-driven workflows - Modernized `/f map` display and improved territorial context messaging ### Economy and bank - Faction bank deposit, withdraw, transfer, and history - Optional periodic tax engine with configurable rates/intervals - Works with Vault-based economy stacks ### Homes and warps - Faction home and warp management - Warp listing/set/delete flows - Compatibility-oriented command structure for player familiarity ### Faction chests - Shared faction storage with `/f chest` for fast default chest access - Named chest management: `/f chest list`, `/f chest open `, `/f chest create `, `/f chest delete ` - Officers can create/delete chests; all faction members can open/list based on permission nodes - Default chest name is configurable via `factions.team-chest.default-name` - Per-faction chest count is configurable via `factions.max-team-chests` (default `1`) ### Faction flags - Per-faction boolean toggles: `pvp`, `friendly-fire`, `explosions`, `fire-spread`, `open` - Officers manage flags in-game with `/f flag set`; defaults and editability configurable per-flag - Admins override any flag via `/fa flag` regardless of the player-editable setting ### Audit log - Officers and above can page through their faction's action history with `/f audit [page] [--action=]` - Staff can view any faction's history with `/fa audit [page] [--action=]` - Tracks claims, unclaims, relation changes, kicks, promotions, demotions, bank transactions, and merge events - Page size configurable via `factions.audit.page-size` in `config.yml` ### Faction merges - `/f merge send ` — officers can propose dissolving their faction into another - `/f merge accept ` — officers of the target faction accept the request - All claims, warps, bank balance, and members are transferred atomically; the sender faction is then disbanded - Online target members are notified immediately when a request arrives ### Internationalization - Eight built-in locale bundles: `en`, `es`, `de`, `fr`, `pt-BR`, `ja`, `zh`, `ru` - Players choose their language with `/f language [code|reset]` - Server default locale configurable via `factions.language.default` in `config.yml` - All command output, GUI item text, and map display respect the resolved locale - Message lookup order: player locale → server default → English → inline fallback - Community locale contributions welcomed — see the [i18n guide](https://pvp-index.github.io/pvpindex-factions/i18n) ### Power and war mechanics - Configurable power model with per-player max, regen rate, loss on death, and grace period - title: Simpel add
description: just a simpel add mod, feels like vanilla but with just a hint of tech
body:
![Logo](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/901/324/logosimpeladd.png)

## SimpelAdd Mod Info

just a simple mod that add a vanilla feeling tech aspect to minecraft. useful crafts and doubling or 6X ore production with an ability to automate it all.

This mod does not use FE on any of its automation blocks, this was done to hold true to vanilla and make things feel more advanced without changing the way the game plays.

A key aspect of this mod is the grinder head, this will let you double your raw Iron, Copper, Gold 6X them if you get the Ore Blocks. you can 3X Coal, Diamond, Emerald Ore Blocks.

### Ore's

this mod adds a few new ores. Netherite Shard ore(Deepslate/nether/end), Diamond Shard ore(nether/end), Emerald Shard ore(nether/end) these are like nugget ores.

Unobtanium ore(end), this is the end game ore for this mod this is used to make armmor better then netherite.

Vanilla ores for the Nether and End, that way you get more places to get some meaterals.

### Items

Grind Head: this is used to double your meaterals by turning them into dust. this has 3 teirs, flint/netherite/unobtanium.

Fuel Chuncks: this is inspaired by Tinny coal. you get 8 of these per coal or charcoal, You can also place them any where a button can be placed to place Tinny Toucrches.

Sandwiches: just some bread and one pice of cocked meat or some veggies will give you a sandwich that is extremly filling.

Wing parts: using some slime string and wool you can make yourslef some wings.

Flesh: turn that zombie flesh into something to eat, or even leather.

Dusts: all raw ores now have a dust this is used to double your ores.

Upgrads: these are speed upgrade 1-4, efficiency upgrade, and xp boost upgrade.

Blank smithing table upgrade: just some clay and you can make any smithing template you want.

Wood Fiber: this can make string, just have to grind some wood.

Home Wand: this is something you can make to take you back to a set location.

### Tool Teirs

Obsidian class tools: these are a touch worse than netherite but slightly better then diamonds.

Obsidirite class tools: these are a touch Better then netherite.

Unobtainrite class tools: these are a touch Better then netherite.

Unobtainobsidirite class tools: this are better then all other armmor and tools.

### Blocks

Tinny Torches: this block is like a button in the way it can be placed it gives off slightly less light then a torch.

Simpel Farmland: this block increase the grow speed of cops but randomly will turn back into farmland. you need to use the Grow Staff to change the farmland into the Simpel Farmland.

### The Block Entities

The Grinder Block will Let you get dust for your raw/ores. this removes the manual crafting using the grind head and ticks to get the job done automated. (This block is able to have upgrades in it with the Speed and efficiency upgrades)

The Netherite Grinder is like the Grinder block but you get 4 input slots and 4 output slots, this block runs a touch faster by default. (This block is able to have upgrades in it with the Speed and efficiency upgrades)

The Netherite Crafter Block, It will turn one Scrap one gold ingot into a Netherite Ingot, this takes heat so use blaze rods(4 uses per rod). This Block can have the Speed upgrades to make it work faster.(This block is able to have upgrades in it with the Speed upgrades)

The Tick Acceleration block, this by default will tick bocks faster in a 1 block raidus. you can increase the size up to 6 using 5 efficiency upgrades. This Block Uses Copper as a fuel source.(This block is able to have upgrades in it with the Speed, and efficiency upgrades)

Tool Repair Block, this uses Copper to  Repair your tools really cool right?

Crop Harvester Block, This Block will Auto Harvest Your crops. if a chest is above it they will go in there if not they will drop on the ground.

Crop Growth Block, this uses a soil and seeds to grow your crops.(kind of like Botany pots)

### Craftable items

you can craft slime balls, obsidian blocks, elytra's and manually craft cobblestone to gravel, gravel to sand. All Smithing Templates are craftable using the blank upgrade. Blaze Rods with Gold Nuggets and Lava Bucket.

### Tools

Repair tool that will recharge 4 damage per 100 ticks. it will take damage per item repaired. A tag is called for items that can not be repaired.

Feeding Tool this will give you food when your health is less than max. it works every 500 ticks.

Fireproof Tool this will keep you from dieing in lava or in the flams, it will try its best to keep you alive.

Grow Staff Bone Meal on crazy, also is used to make Better and Faster Farm land.

title: The Blood Forest
description: There is a mess of flesh growing in the new forest, explore it to find out where its coming from, why it happened, who was responsible, and what you can do... if anything...
body:
The Blood Forest drags Minecraft somewhere it was never supposed to go.

This mod adds two new biomes, each twisted in its own way. One is alive in all the worst ways. The other is dead, flat, silent, and wrong. Between them, new materials, structures, and things that should not exist begin creeping into your world.

What this mod adds

The Blood Forest

A biome of flesh, bone, blood, and things that still seem to breathe when they shouldn’t. The ground is covered in blood grass and rotting tissue. Trees grow like skeletons wrapped in meat. Strange obelisks rise from the landscape, and something violent moves through the bogs. It is not a place made for you, but it wants you there anyway.

The Liminal Flats

A vast concrete wasteland where nature has been buried under something cold and artificial. The land is open, empty, and unnervingly safe. Floating spheres hang over the plains. Abandoned ruins sit in silence. Nothing here feels natural, but that is exactly what makes it inviting.

The Black ore

A strange ore found deep in the world, warm to the touch and wrong in a way stone should never be. It feels less like metal and more like something that grew there. Mine it and forge a full set of tools and armor from it.

Why install it?

If you want your world to feel unfamiliar again, this mod is built for that.

Explore biomes that feel hostile, unnatural, and deeply off in completely different ways.
Find new resources and turn The Black into weapons, tools, and armor.
Wander through landscapes that feel more like nightmares than places.
Build in places that are beautiful, empty, corrupted, or all three at once.
Development note

The Blood Forest is still in active development, so things will keep changing, growing, and getting worse. Feedback, bug reports, and suggestions are welcome.

Step into it.
There is nothing waiting for you there worth having.
That has never stopped anyone before.


Server side is not offically supported as of right now, but it can work.

title: MaxGL
description: Forces Minecraft 26.1 to use OpenGL 4.6 instead of the default 3.3 cap.
body:
# MaxGL

Forces Minecraft to use **OpenGL 4.6** instead of the default 3.3 cap.

---

## Why This Exists

Minecraft 26.1 caps OpenGL at 3.3 by default. [ThreatenGL](https://github.com/Richy-Z/ThreatenGL) was the go-to fix for this — but it silently stopped working on 26.1 because Mojang moved the OpenGL hint calls from `Window` to `GlBackend.setWindowHints()` internally. This fork fixes that.

## Use This If

- You need OpenGL 4.x features (compute shaders, persistent mapped buffers, etc.)
- ThreatenGL isn't working on 26.1

## Requirements

- **Minecraft:** 26.1 only
- **Loader:** Fabric 0.18.4 and above
- **Java:** 21 and above
- **Side:** Client only

## Notes

- Does absolutely nothing on dedicated servers
- Only tested on Minecraft 26.1 — do not expect it to work on older versions
- If 26.1 support is added to the original ThreatenGL, use that instead

---

*Fork of [ThreatenGL](https://github.com/Richy-Z/ThreatenGL) by Richy Z. — LGPL-3.0*

title: EasyKits+
description: AdvancedKits is an advanced, easy-to-use, and performance-oriented kit management plugin for your Minecraft server.
body:
### EasyKits+
**EasyKits+** is an advanced, easy-to-use, and performance-oriented kit management plugin for your Minecraft server. Specially designed for Paper 1.21x, it allows you to manage all kit configuration processes effortlessly from within the game. You no longer have to deal with long and complex YAML files!

![kitmenu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fbf9b11195efdc997b56999d3062dd404596b33a.png)

## ✨ Features
- In-Game Kit Creation: Saves all items in your inventory (including armor and off-hand) by copying them exactly with their enchantments, NBT data, custom models, and names.

- Advanced GUI Menu: Offers a user-friendly and stylish menu that players can access with the /kits command.
 
- Kit Preview System: Before claiming any kit, you can Right-Click on the kit in the menu to transparently see exactly what kind of items are inside.
  
- Visual "Locked" States: Kits for which the player does not have the necessary permission appear as locked (Gray Glass) in the menu. Information on how to obtain the kit is included in the description along with the permission info.
  
- Dynamic Permission System: The moment you create a new kit (e.g., vip), the permission required for players to claim that kit is automatically defined (easykits.kit.vip).
  
- One-Time Use Kits: You can create special starter or reward kits that can only be claimed once.
  
- Independent Cooldowns: Special waiting/cooldown periods can be set individually for each kit in seconds.
  
- PlaceholderAPI Support: You can display kit-specific cooldowns instantly in Tablists, Scoreboards, or other menu plugins.
  
- Flawless Data Logging: Custom Model Data, colored leather armor, custom heads (skulls), and advanced enchantments added to your items are kept on the server without any loss using Base64 encoding.

## 🛡️ Automatic Kit Permissions:
For example, when you type /kit create player in-game;
It creates an automatic permission for this kit. For instance, if you name the kit "Starter", it will automatically create the permission as easykits.kit.starter.

## 📖 Usage Guide
How to Create a Kit?

Arrange your own inventory in-game with the items you want to give. (Armor slots and off-hand are also included in the kit.)

- Enter the /kit create <name> command via chat. Example: /kit create starter
  
- Kit created successfully! You can now give the easykits.kit.starter permission to your players.
  
### - How to Claim or Preview a Kit?
- A player types the /kits command.
  
- Kits for which they have permission appear in the menu with their normal item icons.
  
- Left-Click to instantly claim the kit and transfer it to the inventory.
  
- Right-Click (Preview) to see the items inside the kit in full size and inspect them.

### Commands and Permissions
- /kits the main kit menuNone (Everyone can use)
- /kit create <name> Saves your inventory as a kit with that name easykits.admin
- /kit delete <name> Completely deletes an existing kit from the system easykits.admin
- /kit setcooldown <name> <seconds> Sets the in-game cooldown for the specified kit easykits.admin

## 📊 PlaceholderAPI Usage

```
If PlaceholderAPI is installed on your server, you can use the following variables:

%easykits_cooldown_<kitname>% - Shows the remaining cooldown of the specified kit, whether it is ready for use, or if the right has ended for one-time use kits.

%easykits_has_<kitname>% - Returns true or false indicating whether the player has access to that kit.
```

title: Primal Lib
description: Primal Lib is a library mod that all my other Minecraft mods require in order to run. It has some basic items and functionality that provide a foundation for other mods to build on.
body:
Primal Lib is not meant to be used on its own. Primal Lib is a library mod that all my other Minecraft mods will require in order to run. It has some basic items and functionality that provide a foundation for other mods to build on.

Currently, Primal Lib is used by [Basket Case](https://modrinth.com/mod/basket-case/) and [Darkest Before Dawn](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/darkest-before-dawn).

Primal Lib includes:

*   **Basic items that are used in multiple mods**. For example, twine is a basic material that's used in crafting recipes in both Basket Case and Darkest Before Dawn. Other items include plant fibers, bark, bark strips, branches, twigs, and wooden shafts.
*   **Basic behaviors related to its items**. For example, you can configure vines and sugar cane to count as cordage.
*   **Common utility code that all my mods rely on**. For example, code that registers blocks and textures, functions that spawn entities and particles, and code that adds drops when breaking a block.

For more details, please visit the [Primal Lib home page](https://www.benjaminrose.com/pages/primal-lib.html).
