title: ZealousChat
description: A powerful, mini-message plugin for chat formatting and beyond.
body:
# ZealousChat
*A modern, MiniMessage-powered chat formatter for Paper & Spigot servers*

<details>
<summary>Technical introduction</summary>

ZealousChat replaces Vanilla chat with a fully configurable system built on the Paper's high performance **AsyncChatEvent** and **MiniMessage** components.  It ships with rank/world specific formats, private messaging, inventory placeholders and a granular permission model – all while remaining light-weight and production ready.

---

## Features
- **MiniMessage everywhere** – gradients, hex colours, hover/click events
- **Rank, world & permission based formats** with priority system
- **Private messaging** (`/msg`, `/reply`) with social-spy & cooldowns
- **Cross-server private messaging** (optional, **MySQL required**) for networks running multiple servers
- **Chat / Message toggles** per-player or server-wide (with staff bypass)
- **Inventory placeholders** `[inv]`, `[ender]`, `[armor]`, `[hand]`, `[pos]`, `[health]`
- **URL auto-linking** & **@mentions** (configurable)
- **Advanced swear filter** with regex and fuzzy matching, with a tiered punishment system.
- **Database-backed infraction tracking** with caching for performance
- **PlaceholderAPI bridge** (optional soft-depend)
- **Hot-reloadable** plugin configurations (`/zchat reload`)
- **Customizable Messages** for all messages used within the plugin.

</details>

ZealousChat is a high performance, 1.20.4+ chat formatting plugin that uses configurable MiniMessage-based chat formats to format chat messages. ZealousChat includes many extra features other plugins leave out, like the ability to send a read-only view of your inventory/hand/armor/enderchest in chat, formatted /msg and /reply commands, click/hover messages on messages, @mentions and more.
ZealousChat also has special features for server networks, such as cross-server private messaging, and cross server chat channels (for staffchat and similar).

ZealousChat implements all of its features using the Paper API, and is designed to be as efficient as possible.

[Showcase Images](https://modrinth.com/plugin/zealouschat/gallery)

## Commands

### Plugin Core
- `/zealouschat` (`/chatplugin`, `/zchat`) — Base command for ZealousChat
  - Permission: `zchat.admin`
  - This command is not an actual command, but rather the base for all sub-commands.

### Configuration Commands
- `/zealouschat reload` — Reload plugin configurations
  - Permission: `zchat.admin.reload`
- `/zealouschat info` — Display current plugin settings and enabled features
  - Permission: `zchat.admin.info`
- `/zealouschat test <message>` — Preview chat formatting
  - Permission: `zchat.admin.test`
  - Parameters:
    - `<message>`: Text to format and display

### Format Management
- `/zealouschat format set default <format>` — Set default chat format
  - Permission: `zchat.admin.format`
  - Parameters:
    - `<format>`: MiniMessage format string
- `/zealouschat format set group <group> <format>` — Define group-specific format
  - Permission: `zchat.admin.format`
  - Parameters:
    - `<group>`: Permission group name
    - `<format>`: MiniMessage format string
- `/zealouschat format set world <world> <format>` — Define world-specific format
  - Permission: `zchat.admin.format`
  - Parameters:
    - `<world>`: World name
    - `<format>`: MiniMessage format string
- `/zealouschat format list` — List all current chat formats
  - Permission: `zchat.admin.format`

### Feature Toggles
- `/zealouschat toggle colors` — Enable/disable color codes in chat
  - Permission: `zchat.admin.toggle`
- `/zealouschat toggle formatting` — Enable/disable text formatting
  - Permission: `zchat.admin.toggle`
- `/zealouschat toggle mentions` — Enable/disable player @mentions
  - Permission: `zchat.admin.toggle`
- `/zealouschat toggle cooldown` — Enable/disable chat cooldown
  - Permission: `zchat.admin.toggle`

### Private Messaging
- `/msg <player> <message>` — Send a private message (aliases: `/message`, `/tell`, `/whisper`, `/w`)
  - Permission: `zchat.message`
  - Parameters:
    - `<player>`: Recipient player name
    - `<message>`: Message text
- `/reply <message>` — Reply to the last private message sender (aliases: `/r`, `/respond`)
  - Permission: `zchat.message`
  - Parameters:
    - `<message>`: Reply text

#### Cross-server private messages

When you enable cross-server messaging in storage.conf (requires a MySQL or Redis database), ZealousChat can deliver private messages across multiple Paper servers on the same network.

- `/msg` will attempt cross-server delivery when the target is online on another server
- `/reply` also supports cross-server targets
- Recipients that have private messages toggled off will not receive cross-server messages

### Chat & Social Spy Toggles
- `/zealouschat toggle chat` — Toggle your public chat on/off
  - Permission: `zchat.toggle.chat`
- `/zealouschat toggle messages` — Toggle your private messages on/off
  - Permission: `zchat.toggle.messages`
- `/zealouschat toggle socialspy` — Enable/disable social spy for private messages
  - Permission: `zchat.socialspy`
- `/zealouschat alerts` — Toggle alerts on/off
  - Permission: `zchat.alerts.toggle`
- `/zealouschat toggle status` — View your current chat & private message status
  - Permission: `zchat.status`

### Channel Commands
- `/channel list` — List all available channels
  - Permission: `zchat.channel.use.list`
- `/channel join <channel>` — Join a channel
  - Permission: `zchat.channel.use.join`
  - Parameters:
    - `<channel>`: Channel name
- `/channel leave <channel>` — Leave a channel
  - Permission: `zchat.channel.use.leave`
  - Parameters:
    - `<channel>`: Channel name
- `/channel focus <channel>` — Set a channel as the active channel (where your messages go by default)
  - Permission: `zchat.channel.use.focus`
  - Parameters:
    - `<channel>`: Channel name
- `/channel who <channel>` — List members in a channel
  - Permission: `zchat.channel.use.who`
  - Parameters:
    - `<channel>`: Channel name

## Swear Filter System

The swear filter provides advanced profanity detection with configurable punishment tiers, database persistence, and bypass permissions for trusted staff.
*This system is currently experimental. There will be (mostly small) issues here. Please report any bugs you find.*

### Filter Types

**Regex Matching**
- Uses regular expressions for precise pattern matching
- Case-insensitive by default (e.g., `(?i)badword`)
- Supports complex patterns and word boundaries
- Automatically caches compiled patterns for performance

**Levenshtein Distance Matching**
- Fuzzy matching based on character distance between words
- Configurable distance threshold (default: 2-3 characters)
- Detects misspellings and variations of filtered words
- Splits messages into individual words for comparison

### Punishment System

- **Infraction Tracking**: Each filter group tracks infractions independently
- **Tiered Punishments**: Map infraction counts to command lists
- **Command Placeholders**: Use `{player}` for the offending player's name
- **Console Execution**: All punishment commands run as console
- **Database Persistence**: Infraction counts persist across server restarts

### Performance Features

- **Caching**: Online player infractions cached in memory for instant access
- **Async Processing**: Infraction handling runs asynchronously to prevent chat delays
- **Database Optimization**: Efficient queries with proper indexing
- **Regex Caching**: Compiled patterns cached to avoid recompilation

### Administrator Controls
- `/zealouschat admin clear <type>` — Clear various chat-related data
  - Permission: `zchat.admin.clear`
  - Parameters:
    - `<type>`: One of: `toggles` (resets all chat toggles), `socialspy` (resets all social spy states), `cooldowns` (clears message cooldowns), `blocks` (clears all block lists), `alerts` (clears all alert states), or `all` (clears all data)
- `/zealouschat admin gtoggle <type>` — Toggle global chat features (aliases: `/gtoggle`, `/chatplugin admin gtoggle`, `/zealouschat admin gtoggle`, `/zchat admin gtoggle`)
  - Permission: `zchat.admin.gtoggle`
  - Parameters:
    - `<type>`: One of: `chat`, `privatemessages`, `both`, `all`
- `/zealouschat admin toggle chat <player> <true|false>` — Force toggle public chat for a player
  - Permission: `zchat.admin.toggle.chat`
  - Parameters:
    - `<player>`: Target player name
    - `<true|false>`: Enable or disable chat
- `/zealouschat admin toggle messages <player> <true|false>` — Force toggle private messages for a player
  - Permission: `zchat.admin.toggle.messages`
  - Parameters:
    - `<player>`: Target player name
    - `<true|false>`: Enable or disable private messages
- `/zealouschat admin toggle all <player> <true|false>` — Force toggle both chat & private messages
  - Permission: `zchat.admin.toggle.all`
  - Parameters:
    - `<player>`: Target player name
    - `<true|false>`: Enable or disable both
- `/zealouschat admin socialspy <player> <true|false>` — Force toggle social spy for a player
  - Permission: `zchat.admin.socialspy`
  - Parameters:
    - `<player>`: Target player name
    - `<true|false>`: Enable or disable social spy
- `/zealouschat admin stats` — Display server-wide chat and private message toggle statistics
  - Permission: `zchat.admin.stats`
- `/zealouschat admin alerts <player> <true|false>` — Force toggle alerts for a player
  - Permission: `zchat.admin.alerts`
  - Parameters:
    - `<player>`: Target player name
    - `<true|false>`: Enable or disable alerts
- `/zealouschat admin block <player> <target>` — Force a player to block another player
  - Permission: `zchat.admin.block`
  - Parameters:
    - `<player>`: Player who will do the blocking
    - `<target>`: Player to be blocked
- `/zealouschat admin unblock <player> <target>` — Force a player to unblock another player
  - Permission: `zchat.admin.block`
  - Parameters:
    - `<player>`: Player who will do the unblocking
    - `<target>`: Player to be unblocked
- `/zealouschat admin clearblocks <player>` — Clear all blocks for a player
  - Permission: `zchat.admin.block`
  - Parameters:
    - `<player>`: Player whose block list will be cleared

## Quick Start
1. Drop the built jar into `plugins/` and restart.
2. Edit `plugins/ZealousChat/config.conf` – changes can be reloaded with `/zealouschat reload`.
3. (Optional) Configure database settings in `plugins/ZealousChat/database.conf` and messages in `plugins/ZealousChat/messages.conf`.
4. Grant players a format permission such as `zchat.format.vip` or allow colours with `zchat.color`.
5. Send `[inv]`, `[hand]`, `[ender]`, `[health]` and `[pos]` in chat messages to display inventory information.

## Placeholders
All Chat, PM and config strings support MiniMessage plus any PlaceholderAPI tags when the plugin is present.

## Supported Versions / Dependencies
- PaperMC / Spigot **1.20+** (may work on older versions, untested)
- Java 17+
- (Optional) PlaceholderAPI for external placeholders

## Permissions
<details>
<summary>Click to view permission nodes</summary>

| Node                                | Default | Description                         |
|-------------------------------------|---------|-------------------------------------|
| `zchat.*`                      | op      | Grant everything                    |
| `zchat.admin`                  | op      | Access root/admin commands          |
| `zchat.admin.reload`           | op      | Reload configuration                |
| `zchat.admin.info`             | op      | View plugin info                    |

| `zchat.color`                  | true    | Use colour codes in chat            |
| `zchat.formatting`             | true    | Use text formatting codes           |
| `zchat.url`                    | true    | Send clickable URLs                 |
| `zchat.mention`                | true    | Use @mentions                       |
| `zchat.bypass.cooldown`        | op      | Bypass chat/message cooldowns       |
| `zchat.bypass.swearfilter`     | op      | Bypass swear filter restrictions    |
| `zchat.format.admin`           | op      | Use **Admin** chat format           |
| `zchat.format.moderator`       | false   | Use **Moderator** chat format       |
| `zchat.format.vip`             | false   | Use **VIP** chat format             |
| `zchat.message`                | true    | Send & receive private messages     |
| `zchat.channel.use.list`       | true    | Use the `/channel list` command     |

title: MoreRealisticSurvival999
description: MoreRealisticSurvival999 brings immersive realism to Minecraft survival by dynamically managing temperature, thirst, crop rot, torch burnout, and natural plant growth for a truly challenging and engaging experience.
body:
# MoreRealisticSurvival999

MoreRealisticSurvival999 is a Minecraft plugin that adds a variety of new survival mechanics to the game, making it more challenging and immersive. This plugin introduces temperature and thirst systems, as well as other features that require players to be more mindful of their environment.

## Features

### Temperature System

*   **Player Temperature:** Each player has a temperature that is influenced by their surroundings. The temperature is displayed on a boss bar, which changes color based on how hot or cold the player is.
*   **Biome Effects:** Different biomes have different effects on the player's temperature. Hot biomes like deserts will cause the player's temperature to rise, while cold biomes like snowy plains will cause it to fall.
*   **Water and Heat Sources:** Being in water will rapidly cool the player down, while standing near heat sources like fire, lava, or furnaces will warm them up.
*   **Armor Insulation:** Armor provides insulation, which can help protect the player from extreme temperatures. Different armor materials provide different levels of insulation, and armor can be upgraded with wool to increase its insulation value.
*   **Temperature Damage:** If a player's temperature gets too high or too low, they will start to take damage.

### Thirst System

*   **Water Level:** Each player has a water level that depletes over time. The water level is displayed in the action bar.
*   **Biome-Based Water Loss:** The rate at which the water level depletes is affected by the biome the player is in. Hot biomes will cause the water level to deplete faster.
*   **Dehydration Effects:** When a player's water level gets low, they will receive a "low water" warning and a slowness effect. If the water level reaches zero, the player will start to take damage.

### Water Collection and Purification

*   **Collecting Water:** Players can collect water in glass bottles by right-clicking on a water source. There is an 80% chance of collecting "Dirty Water" and a 20% chance of collecting "Clean Water".
*   **Dirty Water:** Drinking "Dirty Water" will restore a small amount of water but will also give the player a poison effect.
*   **Clean Water:** "Clean Water" can be safely consumed to restore a larger amount of water.
*   **Purifying Water:** "Dirty Water" can be purified by smelting it in a furnace or on a campfire.

### Waterskins

*   **Craftable Water Storage:** Players can craft waterskins to store multiple charges of water. Waterskins are crafted from leather, string, and a glass bottle.
*   **Filling and Purifying:** Waterskins can be filled from water sources, which will result in a "Dirty Waterskin". "Dirty Waterskins" can be purified in a furnace or on a campfire.

### Other Features

*   **Torch Burnout:** Torches placed by players will burn out after a configurable amount of time, dropping a "Burnt Torch" item.
*   **Crop Rot:** Crops that are not harvested will rot after a configurable amount of time, turning into a dead bush.
*   **Wild Growth:** Grass, tall grass, and flowers will slowly spread in the wild, creating a more natural-looking environment.
*   **Rainwater Cauldrons:** Cauldrons placed outdoors will slowly fill with water when it is raining.

## Commands

*   `/mrs help`: Displays the plugin's help message.
*   `/mrs config reload`: Reloads the plugin's configuration file (requires admin permissions).
*   `/mrs water check`: Checks your current water level.
*   `/mrs water give <clean|dirty|waterskin> [player]`: Gives the specified water item to a player (requires admin permissions).

title: MCBackwards
description: This Plugin Will Make Your Minecraft Progression Reverse, Start From END, Then Nether, And Then Overworld
body:
**MinecraftBackwards**

**Flip Minecraft progression on its head!**

MinecraftBackwards is a unique plugin that completely changes the order of the game. Instead of starting in the Overworld, your journey begins directly in The End, forcing you to fight, survive, and progress in reverse.

**How it Works**

Start in The End: On a fresh world, players spawn inside the End dimension. Defeat the Dragon First: Gather loot and prepare to take on the Ender Dragon as your first major challenge. Enter the Nether: After leaving the End, your next step is to build a Nether portal and continue the reversed progression. Reach the Overworld Last: Finally, instead of being your starting point, the Overworld becomes the endgame.

**Features**

Reverses the standard Minecraft progression order. Works on fresh worlds (recommended for proper gameplay). Keeps vanilla mechanics intact but reorders the journey. Perfect for challenge runs, SMP events, or unique survival experiences.

**Why Use MinecraftBackwards?**

If you’re tired of the same old survival grind, this plugin offers a fresh twist on the game you already know. It challenges players to think differently, adapt strategies, and survive in an environment that was never meant to be the “beginning.”

**Use on a new/fresh world to avoid progression conflicts**

For support or custom plugin requests, contact: hotfootgamesindia@gmail.com

title: Perma Death
description: Create a hardcore-like experience to survival servers by adding a configurable ban duration upon player death.
body:
PermaDeath
==============
PermaDeath is the NeoForged 1.21.x update of the [DeathBan mod](https://github.com/graacelin/DeathBan) which is not maintained anymore.

It's a server-side mod for Minecraft, meant to create a hardcore-like experience to survival servers by adding a configurable ban duration upon player death.  

The mod only needs to be added to the NeoForged server, so pure vanilla clients can also join a NeoForged server with PermaDeath installed (given the server **only** has server-only mods).

If you want this mod to be updated on next minecraft release, please consider to [donate](https://www.paypal.com/donate/?business=FA6Q8NVSX555G&no_recurring=0&item_name=OSS+Developer%2C+Modder.+++Thanks+for+your+donation%21&currency_code=EUR) !


Configuration
-----------
You can change the death duration in `config/permadeath-server.toml`. Note that the server does not need to be restarted for the changes to go through, but previous bans will not have their duration changed.

```
#The week duration of the death
Weeks = 0
#The day duration of the death
Days = 0
#The hour duration of the death
Hours = 0
#The minute duration of the death
Minutes = 0
```

Command
-----------
Operator can change the death expiration:

```
/pd add <DeadPlayer> <days>
/pd sub <DeadPlayer> <days>
```


Screenshots
-----------

title: The Real Time
description: This mod makes Minecraft's daily time equal to real time.
body:
_Have you ever thought that a day in Minecraft is too short? This mod will change it._

### - What did this mod do?
____________________________________________________________________________________________________
This mod makes Minecraft's day time equal to real time, but it does not extend Minecraft's daily time, it equalizes the ratio of real time in a day and the ratio of Minecraft's time to Minecraft's day.

It disabled the daylight cycle of Minecraft, and then obtained the time of the real world for each world tick, which was then converted into Minecraft's tick. So if you delete this mod, you need to use 
```
/gamerule doDaylightCycle true
```
to enable the daylight cycle.

### - What impact does this mod have on the game?
____________________________________________________________________________________________________
It's interesting that if you use this mod in the evening, You may have to survive under the attack of a large number of monsters, and you can not modify the time by any ways except by deleting this mod. It will make the survival quite difficult.

This mod is very simple, so it won't have a significant impact on performance.

title: Structure Effects
description: Adventure mode in structures, positive or negative effects in structures, decreasing or increasing attributes in structures.
body:
The Structural Effects mod introduces unique features that change the dynamics of Minecraft. When players find themselves inside certain structures, they enter adventure mode. This opens up a new level of difficulty for players, as they must figure out how to overcome these limitations.

Once out of these structures, players can continue the game using their normal abilities. This makes the game more interesting and dynamic as players have to adapt to changing conditions.

In addition, the Structural Effects mod allows you to add various effects and attributes when entering certain structures. These can be either positive or negative. The list of structures where players will receive effects and attributes is customizable through the data pack, and the list of effects and attributes is customizable through the mod settings. This adds even more depth and complexity to the game, as players should take this into account when planning their actions.

## AddEmAll

[![](https://img.shields.io/curseforge/dt/935081?logo=curseforge&label=Downloads&color=f16436&labelColor=2d2d2d)](https://legacy.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/addemall)

[![](https://cf.way2muchnoise.eu/versions/935081.svg)](https://legacy.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/addemall)


## What does this mod do?

This mod adds an assortment of blocks and items.
Mainly blocks inspired by the aesthetic of Half Life 2's Citadel, as well as other things good for decorative purposes.

Nothing big. Nothing fancy. Nothing complicated.

All blocks / items in this mod are currently only available via creative mode.

![showcase](https://media.griefed.de/images/2024/04/21/20231110225915-d8509788.png)

## Other Information:

- Report Bugs at https://github.com/Griefed/AddEmAll/issues
- You can include this mod in your modpack as long as you don't claim the mod as your own.

## Future

In the future I would like to add:
- custom fluids to resemble the radioactive water in Half-Life (2), with the sound and toxicity.
- Either recipes to acquire the blocks in survival, or an item which consumes the material defined in the block to place said block in the world

Help with either of these would be greatly appreciated! I would love to keep these features in the [Common](Common/src/main/java/de/griefed/addemall)-package as much as possible.

Currently, no other Minecraft, Forge or Fabric version support is planned. I mainly want to use the blocks in this mod in a modpack I enjoy.
If you want support for other versions, feel free to fork this project, implement your changes, and submit a pull request!

title: Rollback
description: This mod improves the backup system. (Automatic backups, GUI, etc.)
body:
# Rollback
This Minecraft mod improves the backup system. (Automatic backups, GUI, etc.)
- Rolling back to a backup using in-game GUI
- Creating backups using commands
- Automated backups

![Rollback Screen](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MehradN/Rollback/master/screenshots/RollbackScreen.png)

### Command
#### /rollback list
Shows a list of the automated backups available for this world.
#### /rollback create [\<name\>]
Creates an automated backup. You can provide a name for the said backup. The name must be wrapped in quotations `"` if it consists of multiple worlds. It can be at most 32 characters long.
#### /rollback delete ("latest"/"oldest"/\<index\>)
Deletes the corresponding backup. If "latest" or "oldest" is provided, the latest/oldest backup gets deleted. If an index is provided, the backup with that index gets deleted.
#### /rollback config (\<option\>) (\<value\>)
Changes the configuration, similar to the `/gamerule` command.

title: Custom Better Beacon
description: Fully configurable beacon pyramids, add new pyramid types and adjust strength.  Place carpets on beacons to hide beam.
body:
# Better Beacons

**A powerful, flexible overhaul for Minecraft beacons.**

Better Beacons makes beacons more useful by giving them massive, chunk based ranges and letting you use almost any block as a base. Effects stick with you even if the beacon unloads, making it the perfect tool for large bases and survival projects.

## Features

- **Configurable Ranges**: Define custom chunk-based radius for any block type.
- **Absurd Range Support**: Beacons can affect players across massive distances, persisting even when the beacon's chunk is unloaded.
- **Carpet Hiding**: Place a wool carpet directly on top of a beacon to hide its beam while maintaining its effects.
- **Server-Sided**: Works with vanilla clients; no mod installation required for players.
- **Dynamic Updates**: Changes to the configuration are applied immediately, including visual synchronization update messages.

***

## Player Guide

### How Ranges Work

Instead of blocks, this mod counts Chunks (16x16 areas).

*   **Iron/Gold**: Covers a 3x3 chunk area.
*   **Emerald**: Covers a 5x5 chunk area.
*   **Diamond**: Covers a 7x7 chunk area.
*   **Netherite**: Covers a massive 9x9 chunk area.

### Building Your Beacon

You build the pyramid just like in vanilla Minecraft. Thanks to our dynamic tag engine, any block you configure as a beacon base will automatically show a beam and work perfectly for all players, even those on vanilla clients.

***

## Admin Commands

Level 2 OP permission required.

Manage your beacon settings directly in-game:

*   `/betterbeacons set <block> [radius]` - Add or change a block's range (example: `/betterbeacons set minecraft:dirt 3`).
*   `/betterbeacons remove <block>` - Stop a specific block from working as a custom beacon base.
*   `/betterbeacons list` - See every block that currently has a custom range.
*   `/betterbeacons reload` - Refresh settings if you manually edited the config file.

***

## Advanced Customization

Server owners can find the configuration file at `config/betterbeacons.json`. You can add any block ID here and set its chunk diameter. Size 3 means a radius of 1 chunk around the center.

```
{
  "enable_custom_beacons": true,
  "beacon_blocks": {
    "minecraft:iron_block": 3,
    "minecraft:diamond_block": 7,
    "minecraft:netherite_block": 9
  }
}
```

***

title: Death Chest
description: Safely store your inventory in a death barrel with precise coordinate logging.
body:
![Chest Death - Banner](https://i.postimg.cc/cJf2NHj4/death-chest-banner-2.png) --- ![Blank Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2e98111b05a2ecc7a51024d1a66189b937f7c952_0.webp) ![Death Chest - About 18px](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/549e4dd28a1be267ef870b493d159b5d98bcbf22_0.webp) Death Chest is a lightweight, ultra-performance-optimized system that securely preserves your inventory inside a localized barrel container upon death. It instantly captures your exact coordinates and handles data dynamically to prevent clashing or server strain. Built for seamless multiplayer scaling, it provides clear chat logging to guide you right back to your lost gear. ![Blank Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2e98111b05a2ecc7a51024d1a66189b937f7c952_0.webp) ![Death Chest - Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/64dcc9aff4ec5cc25fca6ecf3d668e5e0359ab04_0.webp) 1. **Fast, stable, and secure item storage** Automatically stores your items inside a barrel when you die, keeping your inventory safe. 1. **Barrel-based storage system** Uses barrels instead of chests for easier access and reduced server lag. 1. **Blacklist system** Prevent abuse by blocking specific players from using the death chest system `/tag add death_chest_blacklisted`. 1. **Death chest tracking compass** Easily locate your death chest using a compass. 1. **Death location notification** Sends your death coordinates directly to you in chat. 1. **Collectible death items** Stores the player's head on death inside the hotbar barrel. 1. **Smart overflow handling** Automatically separates stored items across multiple barrels: * One barrel stores your hotbar and crafting inventory. * Another barrel stores the rest of your inventory. ![Blank Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2e98111b05a2ecc7a51024d1a66189b937f7c952_0.webp) ![Death Chest - Video Demo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9b2fcbbe756f518f08865bb48498644b3401ff97_0.webp) ![Blank Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2e98111b05a2ecc7a51024d1a66189b937f7c952_0.webp) ![Death Chest - Question and Answer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3a67bf2c759b72661fd0e3a7bf654ce2021d11fc_0.webp)
What does Death Chest do? Death Chest automatically saves your items when you die by storing them safely inside barrels, preventing you from losing your inventory.
Why does it use barrels instead of chests? Barrels provide easier access and help keep the system lightweight by avoiding unnecessary chest usage.
What happens if my inventory is full? The system automatically handles overflow by splitting your items between multiple barrels. Hotbar + crafting inventory are stored in one barrel. Remaining inventory items are stored in another barrel.
How do I find my Death Chest? After dying, you will receive your death coordinates in chat and can use the tracking compass to locate your Death Chest.
Can players abuse the Death Chest system? No. The built-in blacklist system allows server owners to block specific players from using Death Chest if they abuse the system.
Does it support multiplayer servers? Yes. Death Chest is designed for multiplayer environments and supports multiple players at the same time.
Will this create server lag? The datapack is optimized to be lightweight and uses barrels instead of large chest systems to reduce unnecessary lag and more.
Are my armor and offhand items saved? Yes. Your equipment and inventory items are safely stored when the Death Chest is created.
What happens to the player's head? The player's head is stored as a collectible item inside the hotbar barrel after death.
Does it support modded inventories? Partially. It supports modded items inside the standard inventory. Entirely new slots (like Curios API) are unrecognized by vanilla commands. This means those items won't be saved to the block, but they are completely safe from being cleared and will stay with the player.
Are experience levels saved? No, unfortunately. The mod/datapack is designed to stay as close to vanilla Minecraft as possible, keeping the original death system while preventing the frustration of permanently losing your items.

We have paired MTR with a curated selection of decoration mods to help you build immersive stations, bustling terminals, and detailed cityscapes around your railway network. title: No Hitbox Eye Line
description: Removes the eye direction arrow from F3+B entity hitboxes.
body:
# No Eye Line

Clean up your hitboxes.

**No Eye Line** is a lightweight client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft that removes the annoying eye direction line rendered inside entity hitboxes.

Perfect for PvP, practice servers, testing, content creation, and general gameplay where cleaner hitbox rendering matters.

---

## ✨ Features

### 🧹 Removes eye direction lines

Minecraft normally renders a line from the entity’s eyes while hitboxes are enabled (`F3 + B`).

This mod completely removes that line while keeping the rest of the hitbox rendering untouched.

---

## 🎯 Why use it?

The vanilla eye line can:

* clutter the screen
* make hitboxes harder to read
* interfere during PvP
* look distracting in recordings/screenshots
* reduce visual clarity during testing

No Eye Line keeps hitboxes clean and minimal.

---

## ⚡ Client-side

* Works entirely on the client
* Does not require server installation
* Safe to use on servers
* No gameplay changes

---

## 📦 Requirements

* Minecraft
* Fabric Loader

---

## 🖼 Comparison

### Vanilla

```text
Hitbox + eye direction line
```

### With No Eye Line

```text
Clean hitbox without eye line
```

---

## 🚀 Lightweight

* No configuration
* No dependencies
* Minimal performance impact
* Simple and focused functionality

---

title: Heart Container
description: adds heart containers to the game that increases your health
body:
This mod introduces two new health-related items that expand your maximum health


## Heart Container

![Heart Container](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/30aa7a1b12a91158f788d7e2fd37426028826c62.png)

- Crafted from 4 Heart Pieces
- Permanently grants +1 heart (2 HP)
- increases health until the configured max cap is reached

## Heart Piece

![Heart Piece](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/deb5f85d963277938fb6e89da2f93eeacb66cb17.png)

### Found in naturally generated structures:

- Structures include:
- Shipwrecks
- Jungle Temples
- Dungeons
- Ruined Portals
- …and more!

Collect **4 Heart Pieces** to craft a Heart Container and upgrade your health.

## Heartstone

![heartstone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f7e82087113cff1d941a53dbbd20a805549ac842.png)

- Can be activated using a Heart Container
- Saves one nearby player from death
- Can be temporarily disabled with a redstone signal


## Configuration


```
{
  "startingHearts": 3,
  "maxHearts": 20,
  "enableDeathPenalty": false,
  "deathPenaltyAmount": 1,
  "enableHardcoreDeathPenalty": true
}
```

### Config explained:


- startingHearts — how many hearts players start with
  
- maxHearts — maximum number of hearts a player can reach
  
- enableDeathPenalty — lose hearts when dying
  
- deathPenaltyAmount — how many hearts are removed per death
  
- enableHardcoreDeathPenalty — puts the player in Spectator mode when on 1 heart

title: Xenogenesis
description: A biomechanical horror mod inspired by Alien and Prometheus. Discover sealed underground structures, parasitic life cycles, facehuggers, and xenomorph-like organisms waiting to be unleashed.
body:
![Xenogenesis](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4f59815f939e6f05e843758eb179d86fec43609e.png)
[![Fabric](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/unsupported/fabric_vector.svg)](https://fabricmc.net) [![NeoForge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hyperbole-Devs/vectors/8494ec1ac495cfb481dc7e458356325510933eb0/assets/cozy/supported/neoforge_vector.svg)](https://neoforged.net/) [![CurseForge](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/available/curseforge_vector.svg)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/xenogenesis) [![Modrinth](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/available/modrinth_vector.svg)](https://modrinth.com/mod/xenogenesis) [![Discord](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/social/discord-plural_vector.svg)](https://dc.gg/devvyyxyz) **Xenogenesis** is a biomechanical horror mod inspired by **Alien (1979)**, **Prometheus**, and the disturbing art of **H. R. Giger**. Beneath the world, something waits.
--- ![Overview](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/devvyyxyz/abc-site@main/assets/images/titles/Overview.png) Xenogenesis transforms the underground into a place of **ancient design and living machinery**. Hidden far below the surface are sealed structures—black stone, organic shapes, and chambers that breathe softly in the dark. These places were not built to be found. Within them lies a parasitic life cycle engineered with purpose. Eggs remain dormant until disturbed. Creatures do not roam freely—they are released. Once awakened, the infection spreads through hosts, reshaping flesh into something violent, efficient, and unmistakably alien. The mod avoids surface-level chaos and instead focuses on **slow discovery**, **biological horror**, and **irreversible consequences**. --- ![Features](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/devvyyxyz/abc-site@main/assets/images/titles/Features.png) - Deep underground biomechanical structures - Organic egg chambers containing parasitic organisms - Facehugger-style creatures that seek living hosts - Host-based incubation and violent emergence - Adult organisms capable of converting biomass into new eggs - Emphasis on tension, atmosphere, and rarity - No random surface spawning or arcade-style encounters --- ![Screenshots](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/devvyyxyz/abc-site@main/assets/images/titles/Screenshots.png) Screenshots, GIFs, and videos showcasing structures, creatures, and encounters will appear here. --- ![Compatibility](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/devvyyxyz/abc-site@main/assets/images/titles/Compatibility.png) - **Minecraft versions:** Latest supported version only - **Mod loaders:** Fabric, NeoForge - **Multiplayer:** Supported - **Modpacks:** Compatible with most packs unless otherwise stated --- ![Q&A](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/devvyyxyz/abc-site@main/assets/images/titles/Q&A.png)
What Minecraft versions does this mod support? Xenogenesis is developed for the latest Minecraft version. Older versions are not and will not be maintained.
Will this be ported to older versions or other loaders? No. The mod is intentionally focused on its supported platforms only; however, this may change post-release.
Can I include this mod in a modpack? Yes. Modpacks hosted on CurseForge or Modrinth are allowed.
Can I make videos or showcases? Yes. Showcases, streams, and videos are welcome.
Will you add guns, queens, tameable creatures, or sci-fi tech? Yes. Xenogenesis deliberately is made to have firearms, advanced technology, hive mechanics, and tameable organisms added to preserve its horror-focused identity but also allow player to have their own individual experience.
How do I encounter the creatures? By exploring deep underground and disturbing structures that were never meant to be opened.
What happens if I get infected? Some infections can be treated if discovered early. Others are permanent and lethal.
--- ![Installation](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/devvyyxyz/abc-site@main/assets/images/titles/Installation.png) - Download the correct loader version - Install required dependencies if listed - Place the mod file in your `mods` folder - Launch Minecraft --- ![Configuration](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/devvyyxyz/abc-site@main/assets/images/titles/Configuration.png) Configuration options are intentionally limited. Balance and behaviour are designed to maintain unpredictability and tension rather than player control. --- ![Translations](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/devvyyxyz/abc-site@main/assets/images/titles/Translations.png) Currently available in English. Community translations may be supported in the future. --- ![Roadmap](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/devvyyxyz/abc-site@main/assets/images/titles/Roadmap.png) > ⚠️ **Development Disclaimer** > This mod is developed iteratively over a long period of time. > Early releases are experimental and intentionally limited in scope. > Features, mechanics, balance, creatures, and timelines may change, be delayed, split, or reworked as development continues. > Not all listed features are guaranteed for a specific version. --- ## Roadmap Overview | Phase | Focus | |------|------| | Phase 0 | Visual foundation | | Phase I | Structures & atmosphere | | Phase II | Biology & organisms | | Phase III | Infection & interaction | | Phase IV | Life cycle systems | | Phase V | Core survival gameplay | | Phase VI | World integration | | Phase VII | Species divergence | | Phase VIII | Environmental pressure | | Phase IX | Player response | | Phase X | Lore & creators | | Phase XI | Heavy equipment | | Phase XII | Control & ethics | | Phase XIII | Refinement | | Phase XIV | Evolution | --- ## Detailed Roadmap

title: Hintful Audio Cues
description: Sound effects to guide players into learning obscure structure mechanics.
body:
# 💡 Hintful Audio Cues

## ❓ Description

This data+resource pack adds a few sound effects to guide players into discovering the proper placements of blocks in certain multi-block structures—namely enchantment libraries and conduit frames.

**Remember to install/activate both the data pack and the resource pack.** (Click on a version title in the [versions list](https://modrinth.com/datapack/hintful-audio-cues/versions) to see the resource pack download link.)

Supports all <cite>Minecraft: Java Edition</cite> versions from `1.20` snapshot `23w18a` through `26.1-snapshot-1`.

See [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/datapack/hintful-audio-cues) or [GitLab](https://gitlab.com/ZebulanStanphill/hintful-audio-cues/-/releases) for downloads and changelog.

If you like this pack, you may also enjoy [Hintful Advancements](https://modrinth.com/datapack/hintful-advancements).

## 🧩 Mod Compatibility

This pack is designed with mods in mind; tags are used rather than hardcoded block/item/entity lists in most places. The [standardized common tags](https://wiki.fabricmc.net/community:common_tags) are used whenever possible; and for things not covered by those, tags in my own `zeb` namespace are used for anything not specific to this data pack.

Built-in support is provided for the following mods:

- [Colourful Enchanting Tables](https://modrinth.com/mod/colourful-enchanting-tables)
- [More Enchanting Tables (met)](https://modrinth.com/mod/more-enchanting-tables-(met))

If you spot any places where compatibility with another mod or pack could be improved, let me know on [GitLab](https://gitlab.com/ZebulanStanphill/hintful-audio-cues/-/issues).

## 💬 Bugs, Suggestions, and Feedback

Found a bug? Have an idea to improve the pack? Let me know by opening an issue on the [GitLab](https://gitlab.com/ZebulanStanphill/hintful-audio-cues/-/issues).

## 🏅 Credits

Special thanks to everyone listed in the credits of [Hintful Advancements](https://modrinth.com/datapack/hintful-advancements)—the development of which led to this pack being created along the way.

Graphics in the pack icon derived from UI icons in the Bedrock vanilla resource pack. Sounds currently just referenced from the vanilla game files.

And of course, a very special thanks to the Lord God, without whom none of this would have been possible.

## 👨‍⚖️ License

I'm not even sure if the contents of this data pack are copyrightable, but insofar as they are, see [`LICENSE.txt`](https://gitlab.com/ZebulanStanphill/hintful-audio-cues/-/blob/master/LICENSE.txt).

title: Vanilla-V3
description: Official alternative to Nanumpf's Vanilla-V2 Modpack
body:
# quick rundown
**I highly encourage you to customize this modpack yourself. No modpack is perfect, and the custom touches of other players give them a truly perfect look**
This was originally supposed to be a continuation of [Vanilla-V2](https://modrinth.com/modpack/vanilla_v2), made by nanumpf. As a big fan of the Vanilla-V2 modpack I asked nanumpf for permission to create an alternative to this awesome project, I can't guarantee it's as good as the original, but it's definitely something fresher.
nanumpf and I also  discussed what the distinction between our two modpacks should be, so we decided that V3 will be a heavier modded version of V2 in my style. So from now on these two modpacks will split paths but still faintly be connected

## Shader support
just like Vanilla-V2, this modpack also supports shaders thanks to [Iris shaders](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris)

## Support
As of now, the only way of contacting me is through my [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/Q9KbeMEFNX) or privately.
Every new member or message I get will probably be good for the modpack too, since it keeps my ADHD in check by telling me that actual people are enjoying the modpack.
So thank you to everyone that joins.

## Features
This modpack features a wide array of mods to improve your experience on minecraft

- Hunt with a new weapon: the spear
- Don't worry about joining modded servers, as long as it's on the right mod loader and version auto modpack will install missing mods automatically.
- Cook your heart out with several new recipes thanks to the Farmer's delight mod.
- Customize to your heart's content with shaders and resource packs (entity model features and entity texture features are preinstalled) 
- Explore a new but nostalgic world with terralith (you will have to disable this mod for superflat)

**See the Changelog for new additions, I will probably not update this list until there's enough changes**

Also, we're entering the waiting stage for this modpack, so these updates may not be as regularly released as usual.

# **CREDITS**
Foremost, I'd like to thank the original creator nanumpf for letting me create this awesome project. While I don't have that high hopes for it, I do still hope we can at least one day be comparable to the original modpack.

Of course, I also want to thank all my friends for motivating me to do this project.
I honestly couldn't make it without anyone on this list.

And I'd also like to thank my main motivators: Horimiya season 1 and 2 (watch it, it's peak)
and any kind of music.

```
maven { url 'https://maven.uuid.gg/releases' }
```

```
modApi("com.redpxnda.nucleus:nucleus-editor-fabric:${rootProject.minecraft_version}+${rootProject.nucleus_editor_version}")
```

title: Arcane - Data Driven Enchanting Power Overhaul
description: Adding more data-driven customizability to enchanting power sources.
body:
# Arcane

This mod exposes more of Minecraft's enchanting power system to users by making elements of it more data driven.  It is geared towards data pack and mod pack developers alike, though mod developers may also find it useful.

In vanilla Minecraft, you can add entries to the `enchantment_power_provider` tag to make them provide power to enchanting tables like bookshelves do (in fact, bookshelves themselves are part of this tag by default).  However, this power boost is hard coded to 1 (the same as bookshelves), and it doesn't respect block states, making it inconvenient for certain block types (like candles, which can contain multiple candles in one block space). This can sometimes be - to put it rather bluntly - frustrating.

Arcane offers a solution by adding **data driven enchanting power providers**, which can be much more flexible in their parameters.

![One of the example possible setups that can be made with the mod's default configuration.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/rKA97ckp/images/9426df2a29a402ef452204e9c2b82be69f10be1f.png)

**!! You can find more information for developers on [the mod's README page](https://github.com/RandomMcSomethin/arcane/blob/1.21/README.md). !!**

## Compatibility:
### Server Vs. Client:
Arcane is entirely server-side, so vanilla clients can connect to modded servers with nearly everything functioning as expected.  However, enchanting particles from modded power providers will not display on vanilla clients unless they also install the mod.
### With Other Mods:
Arcane does not interact in any way with vanilla nor modded enchanting power providers.  This decision was made to maintain mod compatibility first and foremost.  In addition, the additions to base code are simple and minimal.  However, there are a few areas where Arcane may run into compatibility issues, in particular with:
- Mods that affect the enchanting table's detection radius.  Arcane mainly relies on vanilla functionality for this, so it may place nicely depending on how responsibly this change was implemented.  However, an increased radius may result in some funny business concerning obstruction detection due to how it is calculated (a copy of vanilla's detection system).
- Mods that completely throw out the vanilla enchanting system.  It should be obvious why compatibility issues would arise here.
## Default Configuration:
By default, Arcane includes a few examples of providers you can play around with both in-game and outside the game to see how they work.  These include:
- Blocks that give 0.2 power - soul fire, soul torch, soul lantern
- Blocks that give 1 power - sea lantern, crying obsidian
- Blocks that give 3 power - all vanilla mob heads
- Blocks that give 0.2 power when lit - soul campfire
- Blocks that give 0.25 power for each candle when lit (1 power with 4 candles in 1 block) - candles
- Blocks that give 0.5 power for each book stored (1.5 power for 6 books) - chiseled bookshelf

If you wish to override these, you can overwrite their respective file inside the `arcane_test` data space.

title: Real Time
description: A mod that syncs your game time to IRL time, and matches the sunrise and sunset times correctly.
body:
# Real Time
A mod that syncs your game time to IRL time.

The mod uses [ipify](https://ipify.org) and [ipapi](https://ipapi.com) to get an approximate geolocation, required for getting sunrise and sunset times. It then uses [SunriseSunset.io](https://sunrisesunset.io)'s API to get your local sunrise and sunset times, allowing the mod to have an acurrate time representation in-game.

This mod is server-side only, meaning that if you run a server you don't need to get your players to install this mod. (Don't worry, **you can still use it in singleplayer**!) On servers it uses the server's approximate geolocation and system time.

title: CSF-Bungee
description: ConsoleSpamFix for BungeeCord!
body:
A bungeecord utility plugin that allows you to hide desired messages or errors that appear on server console and logs. The messages or errors are only hidden and not fixed! Useful if you want to hide errors or messages that spam the server console and get huge sized server logs. This plugin was made to stop console spam when you can't have the issue fixed, to prevent other issues because of intense console spam and unreadable console logs. It's very useful on modded servers where some mods can cause a lot of console spam. <font color="#FF0000">This does not hide all errors! Only the ones you configure to be hidden!</font>

**Please do not go and ask brunyman to support this. This plugin has no affiliation with brunyman.**

*I have looking for a console spam block plugin to block the spam logs in bungeecord caused by bot scanner but there no one actually works plugin, so I made this.*

## Features

* Hides configured messages from appearing on server console and logs.
* Easy to configure. Check the plugin config file.
* Reload command to apply the config changes without a server restart.
* **<font color="#FF0000">This plugin cannot fix the errors like magic, just hide them.</font>**

## Install instructions

Place the plugin in the server plugins folder.
Start the server and the config file will be generated on the first run.
Change the config settings anytime and run the command /csfreload (no space) to apply the changes.
Done, enjoy.

## Permissions

**csfbungee.reload** - Allow the use of config reload command.

## Commands

**/csfreload** - Reload the plugin config.

## Configuration

```yaml
#Add here the messages you want to hide from your console and logs.
#Each line represents a new message.
#NOTE! You don't need to add the full message!
#The plugin will hide all messages that contain the text added below.
# EXAMPLE:
#
# Messages-To-Hide-Filter:
# - 'WARNING: unlocalizedName'
#
# To use regex, add "@" prefix in that line
#
# All messages that will appear in the server console that contain these words 'WARNING: unlocalizedName' will be hidden and they will not appear on logs or console.
# If you have large errors you don'tt have to type the full error. But the more words you add the more accurate will be and will not hide other messages that may contain the words added in the filter.

Messages-To-Hide-Filter:
  - 'WARNING: unlocalizedName'
  - 'look up profile properties for'
  - 'InitialHandler - NativeIoException: readAddress(..) failed: Connection reset by peer'
```

title: Easier Netherite
description: Make gathering Netherite a bit easier for yourself!
body:
# Easier Netherite
Easier Netherite reworks Netherite progression a bit to make obtaining Netherite less tedious while keeping it balanced and rewarding.

### Ancient Debris drops Raw Netherite
Ancient Debris no longer drops itself when mined normally. Instead, it drops Raw Netherite - unless a Silk Touch pickaxe is used.

### Fortune works on Ancient Debris
Fortune can also increase the amount of Raw Netherite dropped from Ancient Debris, giving you a reason to enchant your pickaxe before mining it.

![fortune on ancient debris](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f92bcdb1e4dd73e10886e0f1991b781826aaad63.png)

### New Netherite progression
Netherite Ingots can no longer be crafted using the vanilla recipe. Instead, you'll need to:
1. Mine Ancient Debris to obtain Raw Netherite
2. Craft 4 Raw Netherite into Netherite Scrap
3. Smelt Netherite Scrap into a Netherite Ingot

You can also obtain Netherite Nuggets from piglin bartering and craft Raw Netherite from them!

![raw netherite can be also crafted from 9 netherite nuggets](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ffb65eada0e3cae39e3bcff06bad8c26e8b9af39.png)
![netherite scraps are crafted from raw netherite](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e7daef3b7109cae6bbfbad9062cc92c7bd175125.png)

### Supported versions
This mod is available for **Fabric, Forge and Neoforge - 1.20.1, 1.21.1, 26.1.2 and above**

Will be updated to new stable releases of course!

#

If you find any issues, report them on our [Github issues page](https://github.com/JustErikSK/EasierNetherite-Mod/issues) for this mod.

![Server header](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bristn/minecraft-interactive-enchanted-books/refs/heads/main/doc/headers/server_header.png) ![Placeable Enchanted Books in lecterns](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bristn/minecraft-interactive-enchanted-books/refs/heads/main/doc/headers/placeable_header.png) Enchanted Books can be placed in lecterns. Intentions/Reasoning - Allows an easy way of spawning a variety of particle effects. - The other redstone related features enabling a dynamic way of changing particle textures and lifetime.
![Hopper integration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bristn/minecraft-interactive-enchanted-books/refs/heads/main/doc/headers/hopper_header.png) Disable with: `/gamerule interactive_enchanted_books:hopper_interacts_with_lectern false` Hoppers are able to place written or Enchanted Books in lecterns. Intentions/Reasoning - Parity with other block entities and behaviour. Not being able to place books in lecterns using hoppers seems like an oversight in vanilla - Allows for greater control over the enchantment particles of this mod
![Signal changing page](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bristn/minecraft-interactive-enchanted-books/refs/heads/main/doc/headers/signal_header.png) Disable with: `/gamerule interactive_enchanted_books:signal_changes_lectern_page false` Sending a redstone signal to the lectern increments the shown page. If the last page is reached, the lectern will loop back to the first page. **This disables the default behaviour of page changes emitting a redstone signal. Observers will still detect the page change** ![Signal changing page preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bristn/minecraft-interactive-enchanted-books/refs/heads/main/doc/game/signal_preview.gif)
Intentions/Reasoning - As lecterns with Enchanted Books emit particles based on the current page, changing the page with a redstone signal allows dynamic control over which particle is currently shown - In combination with the chiseled bookshelves, this allows for flexible particle effects
![Echo header](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bristn/minecraft-interactive-enchanted-books/refs/heads/main/doc/headers/echo_header.png) Disable with: `/gamerule interactive_enchanted_books:craftable_enchantment_echo false` The Enchantment Echo clones the enchantments of the original item **without** destroying it and can be interacted with just as a regular Enchanted Book (see previous features). Combining the Enchantment Echo with an Echo Shard converts it into an Enchanted Book. | | | | --------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | | | ![Echo crafting in game](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bristn/minecraft-interactive-enchanted-books/refs/heads/main/doc/game/echo_crafting_preview.gif)
Intentions/Reasoning - The Enchantment Echos allow easier usage of the other mod features, such as comparator signal and particles, without having to combine multiple Enchanted Books - The ability to create an Enchantment Echo from an already enchanted item enables easier insight into the enchantment details. When playing a modpack it's easy to find items with tons of enchantments without knowing most of them. Enchantment Echos provide an easy way to preview the details in game - The conversion to a real Enchanted Book is intended to reduce the need for villagers while not being too overpowered, as Echo Shards are a finite end game resource.
![Integration header](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bristn/minecraft-interactive-enchanted-books/refs/heads/main/doc/headers//integration_header.png) See the [example repository](https://github.com/Bristn/minecraft-interactive-enchanted-books-example) for more details on how to integrate custom enchantments.

title: Butterfly API
description: An API to simplify Math and Registries.
body:
# **Butterfly API**

**Butterfly API** is a simple helper **API** for my Fabric 1.20.1 mods.

It mostly exists to keep shared code in one place, instead of rewriting the same registry helpers, item group setup, client setup, math utilities, and **plush** systems for every mod I make.

---

## **What It Adds**

**Butterfly API** adds helper systems for common modding tasks like registering items, blocks, sounds, entities, particles, enchantments, recipes, status effects, and other basic content.

It also includes helper code for creative tabs, client setup, simple gameplay math, and reusable **plush** blocks.

---

## **Plushes**

**Butterfly API** includes a shared **plush** system used by some of my mods.

This makes it easier to add small placeable **plush** blocks with things like direction, waterlogging, honk sounds, squish behavior, and optional GeckoLib Animations.

---

## **Built-In Content**

**Butterfly API** also adds a few small in-game things, including **plushes**, the Matchstick, the Big Red Button, and the Connection enchantment.

These are mostly here because I use **Butterfly API** for my own mods, and I wanted it to have some of the extra things instead of making a super tiny side-project with them.

---

## **For Developers**

**Butterfly API** can be used by other Fabric mod developers who want access to the same helper systems I use in my own mods.

The GitHub page includes more information about the **API**, setup, usage, and examples for using it in your own project.

GitHub: https://github.com/SyntaxyBoi/Butterfly-API

---

## **Extra's**

**Butterfly API** is not meant to be a huge library. It is just a small **API** made to support my mods, make repeated code cleaner, and give other developers access to some of the same tools I use.

Use this mod if another mod requires it, or if you want to use its helper systems in your own Fabric mod.

title: IAxPresencefootsteps
description: A plugin that allows to add stepping-sounds for the Presence Footsteps mod to custom ItemsAdder Blocks.
body:
# IAxPresenceFootsteps

IAxPresenceFootsteps is a simple plugin that allows you to quickly and easily create a `blockmap.json` file for the `PresenceFootsteps` mod, to support stepping sounds for ItemsAdder's Custom Blocks.

## How it works

All you have to do, is add a `pf_sound` option to the `specific_properties.block` section of your custom item:
```yaml
info:
  namespace: example

items:
  example_block:
    display_name: "Example"
    graphics:
      texture: block/example
    specific_properties:
      block:
        placed_model:
          type: REAL_NOTE
        pf_sound: hardmetal # Add this!
```

After that, execute `/iaxpf create` to automatically create a new `blockmap.json` file.  
This blockmap file will contain all the custom ItemsAdder Blocks, which contain the `pf_sound` option and store it in `/plugins/ItemsAdder/contents/presencefootsteps/resourcepack/presencefootsteps/config/blockmap.json`

All that is left to do, is executing `/iazip` and the blockmap will be included in the resource pack.

## Commands

### `/iaxpf create [--verbose]`

Creates the blockmap.json file. If one already exists will it be overridden.  
Adding the `--verbose` flag will make the plugin provide a lot more info, such as what sounds it adds for what custom block (And vanilla blockstate), or what blocks got skipped and why.

## Known Issues/Limitations

### Blocks created from `directional_mode` aren't included

This issue is limited to versions before 4.0.17 of ItemsAdder.  
Due to a lack of API in older versions can the plugin not obtain the actual config used for blocks generated from the `directional_mode` option.  
Your best option is to update ItemsAdder to 4.0.17 or newer.

title: VoteBan Players
description: Allows verified players to start votes to ban/kick/mute players without having mod permissions.
body:
# VoteBan

VoteBan gives your regular players a way to deal with rule-breakers when staff aren't around. Instead of just waiting for an admin to show up, players can start a vote to kick, mute, or ban someone. It uses your existing punishment commands, so it will work with any setup you already have.

## ⭐ Key Features
- Universal Compatibility: Uses your existing server commands, ensuring it works with any punishment plugin (LiteBans, AdvancedBan, EssentialsX, etc.).
- Flexible Voting: Choose between fixed vote counts or a server percentage threshold to ensure votes scale with your player base.
- Anti-Spam & Abuse Protection: Built-in "already-voted" cooldowns and VOTEBAN.BYPASS permissions prevent players from abusing the system.
- Rich Text Support: Full support for MiniMessage, allowing for clean, clickable chat interactions.
- Automated Moderation: Optional chat locking and automatic vote starting make moderation smooth and efficient.


## ✏️ Commands
### /votemute <player> [reason]
- Description: Start a vote to mute a specific player.
- Permission: VOTEBAN.STARTMUTE

### /voteban <player> [reason]
- Description: Start a vote to ban a specific player.
- Permission: VOTEBAN.STARTBAN

### /votekick <player> [reason]
- Description: Start a vote to kick a specific player.
- Permission: VOTEBAN.STARTKICK

### /addvote
- Description: Cast your vote for an active session.
- Permission: VOTEBAN.VOTE

### /votereload
- Description: Reloads the plugin configuration.
- Permission: VOTEBAN.RELOAD


## ✏️ Permissions

- VOTEBAN.*: Grants access to all plugin commands and features.
- VOTEBAN.RELOAD: Allows the user to reload the configuration file.
- VOTEBAN.BYPASS: Prevents a player from being targeted by any punishment votes.
- VOTEBAN.STARTBAN: Allows the player to initiate a vote to ban others.
- VOTEBAN.STARTKICK: Allows the player to initiate a vote to kick others.
- VOTEBAN.STARTMUTE: Allows the player to initiate a vote to mute others.
- VOTEBAN.VOTE: Allows the player to participate in active votes using /addvote.
- VOTEBAN.STOPCHAT: (Required if stop-chat is enabled in config) Allows the user to trigger a chat lockdown during a vote.

## ⚡ Screenshots

![Vote Start](https://i.gyazo.com/515cb8d4a2ac657210367bc0c31c940e.png)

![Added Vote](https://i.gyazo.com/4f8f84858a9188947f7486dd8786200d.png)

![Vote Success](https://i.gyazo.com/fecf5a11dcef8e445822bfbd3538905a.png)

## Features

### config.yml

```yml
# DON'T TOUCH Config-Version OR THINGS WILL BREAK

  # Options: impactor:{currency}, pebbles, ITEMS:{item id}.

    - wish
  # Pokemon that should not be able to use the General Tutor

    - pikachu
# Which types of moves should appear in the Tutor GUI

  tutorMoves: true
  eggMoves: false
  tmMoves: false
  evolutionMoves: false
  levelUpMoves: false
  formChangeMoves: false
```

### Permissions
- `tutormoves.reload` is for `/tutormoves reload`
- `tutormoves.menu` is for `/tutormoves menu`
- `tutormoves.menuothers` is for `/tutormoves menu <tutor> <player>`
- `tutormoves.npc` is for `/tutormoves npc <npc name>`

Be aware: If a permission node does not register for you, deop yourself and relog/restart the server. In order for LuckPerms to cache the permission node, it needs to acknowledge that it exists, and this doesn't end up being the case if only an Opped Player is online when LuckPerms checks for permissions!

title: MIDGARD REWILD
description: A modern NeoForge port of Midgard that restores and enhances its biome and tree world generation.
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6be4d84054a98c99c88a397629ace2aaba086ca7.png)

# WHAT IS THIS MOD ABOUT?                                                  

Midgard is a world generation overhaul created by Sbeev designed to create a more natural and cohesive overworld. Biomes are reorganized based on realistic temperature zones and geographical logic, resulting in smoother transitions and more immersive landscapes.

Most forest biomes have been completely redesigned with large, custom tree structures inspired by real-world ecosystems. These trees introduce two new structural blocks, Trunk and Branch, which work alongside standard Minecraft logs to create more organic and varied shapes.

This Unofficial mod port introduces the 13 new biomes, while several vanilla biomes have been condensed, removed, or fully reworked. These changes aim to reduce redundancy and improve biome identity across the world.

Additionally, three new wood types have been added: Pine, Aspen, and Maple, each integrated into both new and existing biomes.

                                                                                                                                                                        

## Midgard requires the following mods:

Oh The Trees You'll Find 5.3.0+
Tectonic 3.0.22+

Tectonic provides the base terrain shaping, though this may change in future updates.

                                                                                                                                                                             

## WARNING: This mod is currently in beta. Significant changes and additions are expected.

Known Issues:

The advancement "Adventuring Time" does not account for modified or newly added biomes
Leaves do not decay properly after wood blocks are removed

## Planned Features:

Fixes for the issues listed above
Custom tree designs for Cherry, Mangrove, Acacia, and Jungle trees
Boats and signs for the three new wood types
Vanilla Biomes Removed or Reworked                                                                                   


The following vanilla biomes do not generate:

Old Growth Spruce Taiga
Windswept Gravelly Hills
Windswept Savanna
Old Growth Birch Forest
Birch Forest

Some of these may return in future updates, though most have been replaced or made redundant by Midgard’s biome system.



## CREDITS                                                                                                                                                              

Original Mod by Sbeev

Port, Maintenance & Updates: HarlockDev

Midgard was originally created by Sbeev. This project is a continuation and port of the original work to newer Minecraft versions. Huge thanks to Sbeev, the original creator of Midgard.

This version is distributed under the terms of the MIT License. All original credit for the concept, design, and implementation belongs to the original author.

title: BridgeHelper
description: A 1.8.9 Forge mod that gives you live feedback while you're fast-bridging.
body:
BridgeHelper is a Forge 1.8.9 mod that shows you your speed-bridging timing in real time — while you're actually bridging, not after you've already fallen.

![menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2cc47b715ff5c9b226a9e60ae8cd162d990631fe.png)

Configuration GUI Keybind: **_M_**

It reads your raw keyboard input to calculate exactly when you're hitting your placement window, with sub-tick accuracy. 
That means the feedback you see is based on your real movement, not just what the game has processed yet. You can view the raw millisecond data or switch to simple plain-English messages depending on what you prefer.
If your bridging feels inconsistent but you can't figure out why, this mod is what you're missing. Silent trial-and-error is a slow way to build muscle memory - instant feedback isn't.
A few things to know before downloading:

**Requires** Minecraft Forge 1.8.9. Support for modern versions will be coming in the future.
Press **M** in-game to open settings and position your HUD
The mod only activates while you're actively bridging, so it won't clutter your screen otherwise

title: Ultra Hardcore UHC
description: A lightweight UHC modpack designed for fast and competitive matches.
body:
![image 1.1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3bec5fb212e8cb1c653b59e6736c98cf9427c7c3.png)

This modpack delivers a streamlined and competitive Ultra Hardcore (UHC) experience designed for quick setup and smooth gameplay. Instead of dealing with complex commands or external servers, you can start a match in seconds: just open your world to LAN and type /game open to instantly launch the UHC session for everyone connected.

Players begin with no natural health regeneration, encouraging strategic combat, careful resource gathering, and smart survival decisions. Mines, caves, and structures become dangerous battlegrounds where every heart lost is permanent. As the border tightens, players must prepare, fight, and outsmart each other to become the final survivor.

To ensure stable performance during fights, world generation, and border movement, this modpack includes several optimized performance mods. These enhancements reduce lag spikes, improve FPS, speed up chunk loading, and make PvP smoother—ideal for both casual matches and competitive play.

Whether you’re hosting quick UHC rounds with friends, practicing PvP, or running small tournaments, this modpack offers a polished, fast, and reliable UHC experience with simple controls, clean mechanics, and easy LAN setup. Every match is intense, strategic, and adrenaline-filled—exactly what UHC should be.

title: TurulPowerX
description: TurulPlugin is helping for admins to have fun, and keep the server clean
body:
**TurulPowerX** is a Minecraft Spigot plugin that allows players to use various commands, such as striking other players with lightning or even killing a player with a simple command. The plugin aims to provide an engaging and interactive experience for servers, especially for players who want to customize events and commands.

![strike](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7bc3b6fa798ca576c47acf99d3149c22c474aba4.png)
![The Gui](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/78ed7bce4eac12c462ccaab6cfc7903b982b88a8.png)

**Features:**

Lightning Strike Command (/tpx strike): Players can strike another player with lightning by using the command /tpx strike <player>.
Kill Player Command (/tpx kill): Players can kill another player using the command /tpx kill <player>. This is a quick and simple way to influence the game.
Multilingual Support: The plugin allows the use of different languages, so players can enjoy the commands in their preferred language.
Command Permissions: The plugin assigns permissions to each command, ensuring that only authorized users can execute them.
Custom gui: The plugin has a custom gui and erasy to use.
Custom tools: The plugin has a custom tools to use.
![turulpowerx plugin v1.0.134--main.png](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9b4e77a688cd1d9b681cf1499fc3d2cb22b8e73f.png)
![Tools Gui](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/306db93b575d907fe971c7eb30daaafe4801b00c_0.webp)

**Commands:**
1. /tpx strike: Strikes the specified player with lightning.
2. /tpx kill: Kills the specified player.
3. /tpx help: Provides information about the plugin's commands.
4. /tpx up: The player will suddenly look up.
5. /tpx reload: Reloads the config.yml changes.
6. /tpx boom: Explodes the specified player.
7. /tpx hunger: Starves the specified player.
8. /tpx chili: The player receives the Nausea effect for 20 seconds.
9. /tpx fall: The player will be teleported 50 blocks higher into the air.
10. /tpx warden: Spawns a warden at the specified player's location.
11. /tpx lagg: Teleports the specified player to their position from 5 seconds ago.
12. /tpx sparta: A shower of arrows will fall on the specified player.
13. /tpx anvil: An anvil will fall on the specified player.
14. /tpx fakecrash: The specified player will be kicked with the reason 'Server crashed'.
15. /tpx creeper: Summons a specified number of creepers on the given player.
16. /tpx zombie: Summons a specified number of zombies on the given player.
17. /tpx invisible: Toggles the visibility of the given player.
18. /tpx drop: The item held by the given player will be dropped.
19. /tpx down: The given player will be teleported 3 blocks down.
20. /tpx down: The given player will be teleported 3 blocks down.
21. /tpx cobweb: The specified player will be surrounded by cobwebs for 10 seconds.
22. /tpx box: The specified player will be trapped in a box for 10 seconds.
23. /tpx justrun: The specified player must run for 1 minute, or they will die if they stop.
24. /tpx spin: The specified player will spin for 10 seconds.
25. /tpx headswap: Two specified players will swap heads for 10 seconds.
26. /tpx fakeop: The specified player will receive a fake message: 'You are now an Operator.'
27. /tpx confused: The specified player will have reversed movement controls for 10 seconds.
28. /tpx gui: The TurulPowerX menu is open

**Tools:**
1. /tpxt float_stick
2. /tpxt freeze_stick
3. /tpxt knockback_stick
4. /tpxt slip_stick
5. /tpxt strike_stick

**Settings:**
Languages:
- English (en)
- Hungarian (hu)
- German (de)
- French (fr)
- Spanish (es)
- Italian (it)

**Permissions:** ![all permission](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b75e8960e52b937a9f46d61b35857fecdcf53678.png)

TurulPowerX is an easy-to-use and customizable plugin that enhances the gaming experience and allows servers to offer fun commands and events to players.

title: Musicplayer
description: Adds a music selection gui for Minecraft music discs and Minecraft Music
body:
# 🎶 **Music Player** 🎶

## 🌟 **Overview**

This plugin brings a **dynamic and personalized auditory experience** to your Minecraft server! It introduces an easy-to-use **GUI** allowing players to select and play any available **music disc** or **background music** directly for themselves.

## ✨ **Key Features**

* **In-Game GUI:** Players can select songs through a simple and intuitive GUI.
* **Custom Sound Selection:** Choose from a wide array of in-game music discs and other in game music.
* **Colorful Confetti Generator:** Only appears if you imagine it really hard.
* **Player-Specific Audio:** Sounds and music only play for the selecting player, ensuring no disruption to others.
* **Cross-Version Compatibility:** Thanks to **ViaVersion support**, this plugin can even play sounds that don't officially exist in the server's native version!
    * **Example:** On a **Minecraft 1.20 server** with ViaVersion, a player with a **1.21.8 client** can still select and listen to the **"Lava Check Disc"**, even though it wasn't added until 1.21.
* **Lightweight & Efficient:** Designed to run smoothly without significant impact on server performance.

## 🛠️ **Installation**

1.  Stop your Minecraft server.
2.  Place the plugin JAR file into your server's **`plugins`** folder.
3.  Start your server.

## **Developer Notes**
* Code is written in a combination of Java, ancient runes, and caffeine-induced hallucinations.

---

Plugin made by LOLYAY and LAPDK66
