title: LokelPack
description: LokelPack is a modpack to enhance Minecraft in the most cinematic and optimized way.
body:
# Introduction
LokelPack serves a number of different functions, but most of them fall into either performance, QOL, visual, or audio enchancements. 

**The main goal of this modpack is to make Minecraft as cinematic as possible for the ultimate vanilla+ experience.** This is why there will not be any server-side mods nor terrain generation mods. Too Cheap and Chunky are the only exceptions, as they can be removed from a world without corruption.

LokelPack has been made and designed to run on 1.21.5 perfectly, however 1.21.6+ are updated purely to be compatiable with future Minecraft editions. I highly recommend playing this modpack on 1.21.5.

There are plans to backport to all versions of 1.21, and a 1.21.1 version is being looked at.

# API Mods
- **Cloth Config API**
- **CICADA**
- **Creative Core**
- **MRU**
- **TCDCommons API**
- **Fabric API**
- **Fabric Language Kotlin**
- **YetAnotherConfigLib**
- **Kirin** 
- **OWOLib**

# Quality Of Life Mods
- **Mod Menu** - Visualizes Mods.
- **Too Cheap!** - Able to edit the unfairness of anvils and disabling the xp limit
- **Client Sort** - Able to sort chests and inventories by middle clicking.
- **Mouse Tweaks** - Makes storage life easier, hold an item with the mouse, drag, and put all of those same items into your chest or inventory. many other features too!
- **Cubes Without Borders** - Borderless Fullscreen mod, quite useful.
- **Reacharound** - Improved block placement.
- **Notes** - Useful notepad that can be used for marking coords, biomes, creating todo lists, or planing materials.
- **ElytraKey** - Quick swapping of elytra and chestplate with one single press of a key.
- **Xaero's World Map** - A huge map of your world updating, can see chunks you explored.
- **Reese's Sodium Options** - Sleek modern design of the Sodium design.
- **Better Statistics Screen** - Sleek modern design of the Stats screen and adds a search feature.
- **Sodium Extra** - Adds more options to sodium, like the disabling of particles.
- **Do a Barrel Roll** - Cinematic elytra flying sequences and a complete rework of the flight system.
- **ClickThrough Plus** - Allows the player to click through chests that have item frames or signs on them. To interact with the labels, shift.
- **Zoomify** - A zoom mod that has smooth ease in, and can shift to a cinematic mode by pressing F6.

# Performance Mods
- **Fast IP Ping** - makes the Ping lookup faster.
- **Chunky** - A chunky pregenerator. 
  - **Do not use this with the Distant Horizons distant LOD generator, else you will see generation issues. Turn off the generator in DH and use this, then when Chunky is completed, turn DH back on.**
- **Sodium** - Improves minecraft greatly in general.
- **Distant Horizons** - allows for one to see huge render distances without blowing up your computer. Is optional.
- **Dynamic FPS** - Reduces minecraft resource usage when idle.
- **Immediately Fast** - Improves the immediate mode rendering performance of the client.
- **BadOptimizations** - General optimization mod.
- **Entity Culling** - Culls entities.
- **Lithium** - General minecraft optimization in the same footsteps as Sodium.
- **More Culling** - Allows culling of more minecraft items and blocks.
- **Noisium** - Minecraft optimization of chunk generation.
- **FerriteCore** - Minecraft optimization of memory.
- **Concurrent Chunk Management Engine** - Minecraft optimization of chunk generation.
  
# Visual Improvements
- **Not Enough Animations** - Great mod to see new animations of your player model.
- **Iris Shaders** - Adds support for shaders.
- **Xaero's Minimap** - I added the mod for waypoints, but I keep the actual minimap off due to me not wanting to edit the UI too much.
- **Camera Overhaul** - This mod adds realistic camera sway when idling and turning swiftly for that cinematic look.
- **Euphoria Patches** - Addon for Complementary Unbound to make the game look great.
- **Female Gender Mod** - Adds breasts to your player model if the gender is selected. There is a option to turn it off (Male), and it's smooth and able to be adjusted real well.
- **Blur+** - blurs the screen behind the GUI. (eg. opening inventory, title screen)
- **Complementary Shaders - Unbound** - The shader for LokelPack, it gives a realistic viewport.
  - My main settings are High, a world outline to 3, and IntegratedPBR for materials, with coated textures.
- **SPBR** - Optional resourcepack that adds PBR ingame, I recommmend using this with Bliss and not Complementary. 
- **3D Skin Layers** - Adds voxels to minecraft skin, makes things like hair so much better.
- **Continuity** - A resource pack that adds connected glass textures and others.
- **Bobby** - An alternative to Distant Horizons, keeps chunks loaded, improves render distance to multiplayer servers. 
  - **Do not enable both mods at the same time.**
- **Dynamic Elytra FOV** - Changes your FOV by a certain amount based on your speed, and it is a great indicator of how fast you're going.
- **LambDynamicLights** - Adds dynamic lights for handheld items like torches and lanterns.
- **Jerm's Better Leaves** - Optional, I keep it off, adds bushiness to the leaves.
- **Chat Animation** - Adds smooth ease when opening the chat.
- [Bliss (Distant Horizons Version)](https://github.com/X0nk/Bliss-Shader?tab=readme-ov-file) - An alternative but popular shader with Distant Horizons, adds that sense of nostalgia and essence that complementary doesn't have. 
  - I recommend using SPBR with this one.
- **First-Person Model** - Adds a feature to see your body and skin in first person. 
  - I recommend dynamic mode set to always. Pairs great with Female Gender Mod and Not Enough Animations + Fresh Moves.
- **Fresh Moves (1.21.7+ only)**  - A resource pack that adds bounce to your player. Is great with multiplayer and adds life to your gameplay.

# Audio Improvements
- **Sound Physics Remastered** - Adds reverb to caves and makes everything so much more immersive.
- **AmbientSounds** - Adds enviromental sounds to make minecraft feel more alive and inhabited.
- **Sounds** - Adds sounds for the UI and others.
- **Presence Footsteps** - Adds a lot of new sounds for stepping on blocks.

title: localcape
description: Displays arbitrary capes locally
body:
# Localcape

localcape is a simple mod that allows you to define custom capes that will be displayed on your client only.

Capes are added inside the config directory, under the `localcape` folder, where you must put the cape texture with the username of the player you would like to show that cape on.

### Where do I find capes?
The [Minecraft Wiki](https://minecraft.wiki/) has a [page](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Cape) on all the official minecraft capes. From there you can click on one you like and download the texture.
If you do not want any of these, you can create your own.
Tools like [Autocape](https://autocape.app/) exist, however I have not personally used them.

I recommend searching up a cape template and making your own inside a program like [Paint.NET](https://getpaint.net).

### Troubleshooting
My cape isn't showing up! What do I do?


If your cape isn't showing up, there are a few steps you can take.
1. Make sure that your cape follows the proper 64x32 minecraft format, not some other one.
2. Make sure that your cape is named the right filename, e.g. `MyUsername.png` and is inside the right directory, `localcape`.
3. Finally, if none of those work, check the logs. You  might see an error message with more detail on why it failed.

description: A Minecraft Fabric mod that integrates Google Gemini AI directly into the in-game chat.
body:
# AskGemini

![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-21-orange)
![Fabric](https://img.shields.io/badge/Loader-Fabric-box)
![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-GPLv3-blue)
![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.x-brightgreen)

**AskGemini** is a client-side Minecraft Fabric mod that integrates Google's Gemini AI directly into the in-game chat.

It allows players to ask questions, get crafting recipes, building tips, or just chat with the AI without ever leaving the game world. The mod is designed to be lightweight, fast, and unobtrusive.

## 🔑 Configuration

**Prerequisites:**

- Make sure you have [Minecraft Java Edition](https://www.minecraft.net/) installed.
- Install the [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) for Minecraft **1.21.11**.
- Download the [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) mod (required).

To use AskGemini mod, you need to create a Google Gemini API Key.

1.  Go to [Google AI Studio](https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey) and create a new API Key.
2.  Launch Minecraft with the mod installed.
3.  In the game, run the following command (only needed once):
    ```
    /gemini config <YOUR_API_KEY_HERE>
    ```
    *Example: `/gemini config AIzaSyD...`*
4.  The key will be saved locally in `config/askgemini.json`.

## 🎮 Usage

Simply open the chat and type `@Gemini` or `@gemini` followed by your prompt:

**General Questions:**
```text
@Gemini How do I build a redstone clock?
```
**Creative Writing:**
```text
@gemini Tell me a story about a creeper who is afraid of exploding.
```
**Coding Helper:**
```text
@gemini How does the /fill command work?
```
The AI response will appear in your local chat (visible only to you).

title: Weather Tweaks
description: A client-side Minecraft mod that gives you complete control over weather rendering. Override weather conditions, customize precipitation types, adjust intensity, and create the perfect atmosphere for your gameplay!
body:
# Weather Tweaks

A client-side Minecraft mod that gives you complete control over weather rendering. Override weather conditions, customize precipitation types, adjust intensity, and create the perfect atmosphere for your gameplay!

## Features

- **Complete Weather Control**: Override weather rendering with multiple modes
- **Flexible Precipitation**: Choose between rain and snow, or use biome defaults
- **Customizable Intensity**: Fine-tune precipitation and thunder effects
- **Thunderstorm Mode**: Create dramatic storms with configurable sky darkness and thunder frequency
- **Precipitation Radius**: Limit weather effects to a specific area around you
- **Client-Side Only**: Works on any server without requiring server-side installation
- **Real-Time Updates**: All settings apply instantly with no restart needed!

## Configuration

Access the configuration menu through **Mod Menu** (requires the Mod Menu mod to be installed).

### Configuration Options

#### Weather Override
Choose how weather is rendered in your world:

- **No Override** (Default): Use the world's natural weather
  - When active, you can also set **Precipitation Type** to override rain/snow rendering
- **Always Clear**: Force clear skies with no precipitation or thunder
- **Always Rain**: Continuous rainfall with customizable intensity
- **Always Snow**: Continuous snowfall with customizable intensity
- **Thunderstorm**: Create a dramatic storm with rain or snow, thunder, and dark skies

#### Precipitation Type
*Available when Weather Override is set to "No Override" or "Thunderstorm"*

Choose what type of precipitation to render:
- **Default**: Use the biome's natural precipitation type
- **Rain**: Force rain particles
- **Snow**: Force snow particles

#### Precipitation Intensity
*Available when Weather Override is set to "Always Rain", "Always Snow", or "Thunderstorm"*

- Adjust the intensity of precipitation from 1% to 100%
- Default: 100%

#### Sky Darkness
*Available when Weather Override is set to "Thunderstorm"*

- Control how dark the sky becomes during thunderstorms
- Range: 1% to 100%
- Default: 100%

#### Thunder Frequency
*Available when Weather Override is set to "Thunderstorm"*

- Adjust how often thunder and lightning occur
- Range: 0 (Never) to 100 (Maximum)
- Default: 50 (Vanilla frequency)

#### Precipitation Radius
*Available when Weather Override is set to "Always Rain", "Always Snow", or "Thunderstorm"*

- Limit precipitation to a specific radius around your player
- Range: 0 (Everywhere) to 500 blocks
- Default: 0 (precipitation appears everywhere)

## Requirements

- **Minecraft**: 1.21.9 or higher
- **Fabric Loader**: 0.14.21 or higher
- **Fabric API**: Required
- **MaliLib**: Required (dependency for configuration)
- **Mod Menu**: Recommended (for easy access to configuration)

title: Biomentry
description: Immersive and dynamic Titles when enter a new Biome
body:
# 📌 About Biomentry **Biomentry** is not just a biome notifier – it’s a full **immersion system** for Minecraft. It makes each biome feel **alive, unique, and reactive**. From **animated titles** and **ambient sounds** to **advanced conditional rules**, Biomentry connects the environment to the player’s journey — whether they’re crossing deserts, exploring lush caves, or wandering in modded dimensions. Perfect for **RPG, adventure, survival, and storytelling servers**, Biomentry turns exploration into an experience. --- ## ✨ Core Features ### 📍 Intelligent Biome Detection - Real-time detection **above ground and underground**. - Enhanced with **custom logic** for accurate cave recognition (light levels, block density, sky access, Y-level, structures). - Supports **special cave biomes**: `lush_caves`, `deep_dark`, `dripstone_caves`. --- ## 🕳️ Advanced Cave Detection A multi-criteria scoring system determines whether a player is truly in a cave, factoring in: - ambient light level, - block density around the player, - sky access, - Y-level and natural structure context. This allows accurate detection even in artificial caves or open ravines. --- ### 🖥️ Immersive Visual Notifications - Animated **titles & subtitles** (fade, typewriter, etc.) on biome entry. - **Customizable styles** per biome or biome group. - **Biome grouping** to reduce message spam (e.g., forests, oceans). --- ### 🔊 Ambient Sounds - Unique looping sounds per biome: - Desert camels - Jungle parrots - Swamp frogs - Mountain winds - **Goodbye repetitive rain noise → hello immersion**. --- ### ⚙️ Player Customization - `/biomentry toggle` → Enable/disable notifications. - `/biomentry language ` → Change language. - **Preferences saved per player** for full control. --- ### 🛡️ Region & Server Integration - **WorldGuard support** → disable notifications in spawn, arenas, safe zones, or custom areas. - **Multi-language ready** → English & French included; templates for German, Russian, Spanish. - **Optimized performance** → smart caching reduces redundant calculations. --- ## 🔥 New in v0.3 – Sappling Update ### 1️⃣ Advanced Condition System - Brand-new **`conditions.yml`** unlocks deep customization: - **Triggers** → biome entry, surface vs cave, time of day, player stats - **Logic gates** → combine `and`, `or`, `not` for complex rules - **Conditions** → permissions, health, armor, potion effects, world time - **Actions** → run commands, apply effects, grant temporary permissions, heal, give saturation --- ### 2️⃣ Custom Biome & Cave Support - Full support for **modded and datapack biomes** (Terralith, Biomes O’ Plenty, etc.). - **Custom caves recognized** automatically using `in_cave: true/false`. - **Full biome ID usage** (`terralith:skylands`) ensures conditions, sounds, and notifications apply to **any biome**, vanilla or modded. --- ### 3️⃣ Enhanced Immersion & Stability - Ambient sounds fully overhauled. - Smarter cave detection. - Reliable Boss Bars & notifications. - Bug fixes → condition actions now always execute correctly. --- ## 🚀 Why Biomentry? Biomes in Minecraft are **stories, atmospheres, and identities**. **Biomentry gives them a voice.** Ideal for servers that want: - **Immersion** → RPG, semi-RP, adventure worlds - **Storytelling tools** → triggers when entering zones - **Atmosphere** → ambient sounds & visuals - **Customization** → advanced configs & player preferences With Biomentry, **every step into a new biome — surface or cave, vanilla or modded — feels like a new chapter**. ## Config files

AND ..." condition (AND) --- # The player receives speed in the desert, but only if it's daytime AND they have the permission. desert_speed_day: trigger: type: 'ENTER_BIOME' biome: 'minecraft:desert' conditions: and: # "and" is a list of conditions that must ALL be true - type: 'WORLD_TIME' operator: 'LESS_THAN' value: 12500 # Before sunset - type: 'HAS_PERMISSION' permission: 'biomentry.condition.desert_speed' actions: - type: 'APPLY_EFFECT' effect: 'SPEED' duration: 600 # in ticks (30 seconds) amplifier: 0 # --- EXAMPLE 2: "IF IN CAVE" condition --- # The player receives a torch if they enter any cave and have the permission. generic_cave_torch: trigger: type: 'ENTER_BIOME' in_cave: true # This rule only applies when the player is in a cave. conditions: or: # AT LEAST ONE condition must be true - type: 'HAS_PERMISSION' permission: 'biomentry.condition.torch_giver' - type: 'HAS_EFFECT' effect: 'NIGHT_VISION' actions: - type: 'RUN_COMMAND' command: 'give %player_name% minecraft:torch 4' - type: 'SEND_MESSAGE' message: 'You feel like an explorer in these caves.' # --- EXAMPLE 3: "IF NOT ..." condition (NOT) --- # The player receives a warning if they enter the Nether WITHOUT full diamond armor. nether_warning: trigger: type: 'ENTER_BIOME' biome: 'minecraft:nether_wastes' in_cave: false # Only applies on the "surface" of the Nether conditions: not: # "not" inverts the condition it contains type: 'HAS_ARMOR' material: 'DIAMOND' pieces: 4 # 4 pieces for full armor actions: - type: 'SEND_MESSAGE' message: '<#FF6347>Warning! The Nether is dangerous without proper equipment.' # --- EXAMPLE 4: "IF NEITHER ... NOR ..." condition (NOT + OR) --- # The player takes damage in the Deep Dark if they have NEITHER the Regeneration effect, NOR the Resistance effect. deep_dark_danger: trigger: type: 'ENTER_BIOME' biome: 'minecraft:deep_dark' conditions: # The logic is: NOT (A OR B) not: or: - type: 'HAS_EFFECT' effect: 'REGENERATION' - type: 'HAS_EFFECT' effect: 'RESISTANCE' actions: - type: 'APPLY_EFFECT' effect: 'WITHER' # Applies the Wither effect duration: 100 amplifier: 0 - type: 'SEND_MESSAGE' message: '<#8B0000>You feel a malevolent presence draining your life...' # --- EXAMPLE 5: Requested Actions --- # Gives a temporary permission and health/saturation upon entering a specific biome. ancient_forest_bonus: trigger: type: 'ENTER_BIOME' biome: 'minecraft:old_growth_pine_taiga' conditions: # No conditions, triggers for everyone and: [] actions: - type: 'ADD_PERMISSION' permission: 'essentials.fly' duration: 300 # in seconds (5 minutes) - type: 'HEAL' amount: 4.0 # in half-hearts (here, 2 hearts) - type: 'GIVE_SATURATION' amount: 5.0 - type: 'SEND_MESSAGE' message: '<#2E8B57>The strength of the ancient forest flows through you.' ```

title: VoiceAttackAPI
description: A Minecraft mod to integrate VoiceAttack with specific aspects of the game.
body:
# Minecraft VoiceAttack Integration Mod

**Important!** This mod will not work without the companion plugin for VoiceAttack, which can be found [here](https://github.com/TooterTutor/MinecraftVA-Plugin).


## Overview

The Minecraft VoiceAttack Integration Mod is a client-side utility designed to enhance accessibility and gameplay experience by allowing VoiceAttack to communicate directly with Minecraft. This mod enables players to execute keybind actions using voice commands, making it easier to navigate the game without relying solely on traditional input methods. It is particularly beneficial for players using controller mods, as it eliminates the need to remember complex button combinations to access various mods and UIs.

## Features

- **Seamless Integration**: Works out of the box with controller mods, allowing for easy access to game functions without the need for complicated button combinations.
- **Voice Command Execution**: Use VoiceAttack to trigger keybind actions in Minecraft, enhancing accessibility for players with different needs.
- **Automatic Port Configuration**: The mod automatically establishes a connection to VoiceAttack on a specific static port, generating a unique port for communication during the handshake process.

## How It Works

1. **Connection Establishment**: Upon launching Minecraft with the mod, it attempts to connect to VoiceAttack on a predefined static port.
2. **Handshake Process**: The mod sends a handshake request to VoiceAttack, along with a randomly generated port number for future communication.
3. **Key Command Execution**: Once the handshake is successful, VoiceAttack will use the provided port to send key commands to the mod, allowing for real-time execution of keybind actions.

4. Keybinds for Socket Management:
- Restart Socket Server: A keybind to restart the socket server, ensuring a stable connection with VoiceAttack. Default key is `R`.
 - Update Mappings: A keybind to export a `voiceattack_translation_keys.json` file to the configs folder, which contains the translation keys for any bound key at the time of export. Default key is `U`.

## Setup Instructions

### Minecraft Mod

- **No Setup Required**: Simply install the mod in your Minecraft client, and it will automatically handle the connection to VoiceAttack.

### VoiceAttack Configuration

To set up VoiceAttack for use with this mod, you need to configure each command with the following parameters:

1. **Translation Key**: Create a text variable named `keybind` that corresponds to the action you want to trigger in Minecraft. This variable should hold the translation key for the desired keybind.
   
2. **Execute Command**: Use the Minecraft plugin for VoiceAttack to execute the command. Pass the context `execute_keybind` along with the `keybind` variable you created earlier.

### Example Command Setup

1. Create a new command in VoiceAttack.
2. Add a text variable named `keybind` with the value of the desired Minecraft action (e.g., `key.inventory`).
3. Add an action to execute the Minecraft plugin with the context `execute_keybind` and reference the `keybind` variable.

### Exporting Translation Keys
To export the translation keys for any bound key:

1. Use the designated keybind to export the `voiceattack_translation_keys.json` file.
2. Locate the exported file in the configs folder.
3. Reference this file to accurately send data to Minecraft via VoiceAttack.

## Use Cases

- **Accessibility**: Ideal for players with mobility challenges who may find traditional controls difficult to use.
- **Hands-Free Gameplay**: Allows players to execute commands without needing to use their hands, making it easier to multitask or play in a more relaxed position.
- **Enhanced Gameplay**: Streamlines the process of accessing various mods and UIs, improving overall gameplay efficiency.

## Limitations

- The mod does not support all keybind methods, including:
  - Player movement controls (e.g., walking, running).
  - Mouse look functionality.
  - Keybinds that require holding down a key (e.g., zooming into a world map).

VoiceAttack logo used with permission from owner.

Unethical "fixes" to random crash issues.

Datapack Filter Fix

`LifecycledResourceManagerImplMixin=false` in the config to disable. Fixes Mojang's fucked up pack.mcmeta filtering system, since they somehow forgot to make the namespace filter actually do anything.

Force Attribute
---------------
`DefaultAttributeContainerMixin=false` in the config to disable. Will prevent any crashes due to entities not having attributes set.

Packet Fucker
-------------
`DecoderHandlerMixin=true` in the config to enable. Will prevent any crashes due to invalid server-sent packets. NOT GOOD FOR GENERAL USE. This was implemented as a temporary flag to go into broken worlds to manually remove broken blocks or items.

Player Backup x7

# Spiders Improve Over time
Spiders get stronger the longer you play. difficulty is calculated for each player separately. The improvements are gradual, taking place every 20 minutes.

## NOTICE: This datapack is discontinued, instead use the Hostile Mobs Improve Over Time datapack: https://modrinth.com/datapack/hostile-mobs-improve-over-time 

### Stat increase
Stats that change include:
 - Health
 - Movement speed
 - Knockback resistance
 - Damage
 - Armor
 - Follow range
 - Potion effects (for example, fire res., regeneration, speed, etc.)
 - Spiders now destroy crops
### Timers
Timer for difficulty is per player, and increases every minecraft day (20 minutes). sleeping does NOT forward this timer. Max difficulty is day 100+ and difficulty does not increase after that.
### Commands
To test out how hard the spiders are, use functions spid:day25, spid:day50, spid:day75, spid:day100 or use command: /scoreboard players set <player> Spiddif <number>. To reset your score use spid:reset, to reset all of players difficulty, use spid:resetall.
### Installing
Like your ordinary datapack, put zip file in datapacks folder of your world.
### Unistalling
Run function skel:uninstall and remove the datapack from datapacks folder
### Other
I am planning on making a version of this datapack for each common mob, then making a datapack consisting of all of them (This is the fifth mob improvement datapack I made). 
### Farms
Because mobs only receive improvement when 32 blocks away or closer to a player, automatic mob farms will still work fine, and you dont need to adjust the falling height or killing chambers.

## 🌟 What is EloTiers?
EloTiers is a complete competitive **Minecraft PvP leaderboard** ecosystem. It tracks real-time player ratings, hosts detailed leaderboards, and lets you compare stats side-by-side on the website or via our interactive Discord Bot. 
This client mod links your Minecraft game directly to the EloTiers network, giving you instant stats, and matchmaking features right inside your client. It serves as the ultimate **Minecraft tiertagger** and rank viewer.
---
## ⚔️ Key Features
### 📊 In-Game Tiertagger (Tiers & Elo Stats)
Never get surprised by a pro player again. See the exact rating and tier of everyone around you:
*   **Nametag Tiertagger:** Displays active tiers and Elo rating numbers floating directly above players' heads.
*   **Tablist Tiertagger:** Checks the player list (Tab) to show ratings and rankings next to usernames.
*   **Multi Integration:** Pulls data from major PvP directories and leaderboards, including:
    *   **mctiers.com** / **mctiers**
    *   **FlowPvP** / **FlowPvP.GG**
    *   **mcpvp** / **mcpvp.com**
    *   **pvptiers** / PvP Tiers
    *   **SubTiers**
    *   The official **EloTiers** leaderboard
### 🎒 Smart Kit Detection (Auto-Kit)
The mod is smart enough to know what you are playing. 
*   It looks at your inventory items in real-time and automatically switches the displayed rankings to match your current gamemode.
*   Supports all major kits for **mctiers**, **mcpvp**, and **FlowPvP.GG**: *UHC, Pot PvP, Netherite Pot, Crystal, Axe, Mace, Bow, SMP, Vanilla, and Sword*.
### 🛡️ Clan Tags & Glowing Player Outlines
Coordinate with your clan and spot threats instantly on any **Minecraft leaderboard** server:
*   **Clan Tags:** Shows clan names and tags next to player nametags.
*   **Glowing Outlines:** Highlights players with customized glow colors depending on whether they are your Clanmates, Allies, or Enemies.
*   **Custom Colors:** Personalize the colors of your team and enemies using simple color settings.
### 🎮 In-Game Matchmaking
Ready to fight? Join matchmaking queues directly from your game:
*   Find opponents for Ranked or Unranked matches without navigating website lobbies.
*   The mod automatically finds you a match and connects you straight to the duel server.

► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.

You can change your title Mr. Deeds calls you (male or female) if you use the command /changepronouncs.

SCP-662 can spawn anywhere in the overworld like a normal monster. However, there can only be one instance of SCP-662.

When right clicked, a menu will open where you can select a variety of tasks: Healing the player when they are below 15 health, bringing a variety of food when their hunger drops below 15 points, repairing the item held in the main hand, lighting dark areas below light level 9, extinguishing the player if they are burning, playing music, or answering the question “Who are you?”. title: Iron's Spells: Incantation
description: Voice-cast Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks through Simple Voice Chat. Offline speech recognition, grammar dynamically restricted to spells you actually own, no voice training.
body:
# Iron's Spells: Incantation

**Say a spell's name. Cast it.**

Incantation listens to your Simple Voice Chat mic, runs the audio through an offline speech recognizer (Vosk), and casts whichever Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks spell you just said. No voice training, no extra keybind, no setup beyond unzipping a model into the config folder.

---

## How it works

When Simple Voice Chat is transmitting your audio, Incantation feeds the frames to a Vosk recognizer whose grammar is restricted to the names of spells you actually have equipped (spellbook in your Curios slot, spellbook in hand, or an imbued weapon you're holding). That means the recognizer literally cannot mis-hear you and accidentally fire a spell you don't have - background chatter just doesn't match anything in the grammar.

The whole pipeline runs locally. No network calls. No accounts. Your voice never leaves your PC.

## Features

- **Speak any indexed spell** - works with Iron's Spells, all its addons, and any mod that registers spells through Iron's API.
- **Owned-spell restriction** *(default ON)* - Vosk's grammar dynamically narrows to the spells in your Curios slot, hands, and hotbar.
- **Imbued weapons supported** - hold an imbued sword or staff, say the spell it carries, it casts via the same mechanism as right-clicking.
- **HUD chip** showing last cast, queued spells, miss toast, alias suggestions, and a live audio meter.
- **Themes** - accent presets (Arcane, Blossom, Ocean, Mint, Gold, plus Phoenix / Frost / Verdant / Necrotic unlocked by cast milestones) and base palettes (Dark, Midnight, Slate).
- **Vanilla advancements** for voice-cast milestones and combo casts.
- **Spell List screen** browsing every indexed spell with its exact phrase.
- **Voice Codex** - personal stats (top-cast spell, daily streak, median latency).
- **Test Arena** - safe practice mode.
- **Welcome wizard** on first launch.
- **Aliases & custom phrases** - bind words the model can pronounce to any spell id.
- **Loadout shortcuts** - say one word, cast the first castable spell from a list.
- **Macros** - record a cast sequence, replay with one keybind.
- **Voice commands** - spell one through spell nine for slot select; yes/no for queue control.
- **Server-side controls** - whitelist, blocklist, rate limit, broadcast-nearby, cast logging.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- NeoForge 21.1.x
- Simple Voice Chat (henkelmax, 2.5.x+)
- Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks (iron431, 3.x+)
- A small Vosk English model (~40 MB)
- Curios API recommended

## Setup

1. Drop incantation-0.9.0.jar in your mods/ folder alongside SVC and Iron's Spells.
2. Grab a Vosk model from https://alphacephei.com/vosk/models - vosk-model-small-en-us-0.15.zip is enough for vanilla spell names.
3. Unzip and copy the contents into config/voicespells/model/ so the layout is config/voicespells/model/am/, config/voicespells/model/conf/, etc.
4. Launch the game, join a world, trigger SVC, and say a spell you have equipped.

For tricky spell names, either switch to the medium model (vosk-model-en-us-0.22-lgraph, ~128 MB) or map an alias in config/voicespells-client.toml.

## License

MIT.

## Credits

- Vosk - Alpha Cephei (Apache 2.0)
- Simple Voice Chat API - Maximilian Henkel (MIT)
- Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks - iron431

wyświetlanie waypointów przesyłanych z serwera za pomocą prywatnego pluginu,

zmianę tła w menu głównym,

usunięcie przycisku „Minecraft Realms”,

wbudowany system antycheat.

[EN]

Igrzyska Mod is a Fabric client-side mod created for custom Minecraft games.

The mod allows:

displaying custom text on the player's screen,

displaying a countdown at the top of the screen and as a title,

playing a totem animation using red dye (CustomModelData: 1),

displaying waypoints sent from the server via a private server-side plugin,

adding a logo above the pause menu,

changing the main menu background,

removing the “Minecraft Realms” button,

replacing the “Multiplayer” button with a “Dołącz!” button and adding a separate “Join” button in the multiplayer menu that automatically connects the player to the games server,

retrieving the server IP from a link,

a built-in anti-cheat system.

The mod works client-side only and is intended for use on a specific server.

title: Smart Survival
description: Smart Survival is a Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 that adds campfire comfort, sleep quality effects and nutritional food buffs to enhance survival.
body:
![Title banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ab808adcf442d4a6043e01be22a2a50efe073577.png)

# Smart Survival (Fabric)

Smart Survival is a Fabric mod that adds realistic survival mechanics to Minecraft by extending the way players manage food, temperature, sleep and conditions.

The mod aims to make survival immersive without making it any more complex.

## Features

### Advanced Nutrition System

![Custom UI for Diet](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/45de2b2564225c6a6fb5345097f686d14b06f59d.png)

Smart Survival introduces a **food system** where food is organized into food groups.

- A pattern of eating the same type of food repeatedly loses its effectiveness.
- Promotes and rewards a _healthy diet._
- Tracks food groups _per player_.
- Nutrition data is exchanged between server and client.
- Contains **custom nutrition UI in game.**

### Temperature & Environment Effects

![Standing near campfires increases warmth](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e31edb785d56d49b8a436da3acec7b63914a4e0d.png)

Neither the environment nor the actions of the player contribute to player temperature.

- Server-side temperature logic is run for consistency.
- Standing near campfires causes increased body heat.
- Extreme temperatures increase the risk of a coldness penalty.
- Sustaining too long near campfires raises the risk of being in danger.
- Extreme temperatures create survival penalties.

### Improved Sleep Mechanics

![Sleeping Mechanic](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/90b48c455939bd9229697ca3c0bcbf43f91d5aaf_0.webp)

Sleep is no longer a way to escape the dark.

---

Installation

1. Make sure Fabric Loader and Fabric API installed.
2. The latest version of Smart Survival is available from Modrinth for download.
3. Lad the .jar file into your mods folder.
4. Launch Minecraft using the Fabric profile.
5. Enjoy a better survivor experience

---

Custom nutrition screen
Configurable keybind to open the nutrition UI
Client-side data caching for smooth display
Customstatus effecticons

title: Suspended Railways/Monorail
description: Ride the skies! This mod adds a fully standalone suspended railway to minecraft - (no create addon, or vanilla rails needed). It comes with special rails, supportive blocks and crafting recipes.
body:
# **Suspended Railway Mod**

**Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kJPJxqEpO8g**

Bring futuristic transportation to your world with the Suspended Railway Mod! This mod adds a fully independent suspended railway system that works completely on its own — it is no Create Mod addon, and no vanilla minecarts or rails are needed to build it.

Designed to be fully survival-friendly, every block and item comes with crafting recipes.

This mod is inspired by Germanys Suspended Railway System (Wuppertaler Schwebebahn).
Features:

    ✅ **Custom Rail Classes**
    Specially designed rail types that only work with the suspended railway system.

    ✅ **Exclusive Railcar**
    A unique suspended railcar, which hangs under its rail construction. It can only operate on the mod’s custom rails.

    ✅ **Structural Blocks**
    Includes steel beams and rail construction blocks to build realistic and independent suspended track systems.

    ✅ Perfect for Cities & Futuristic Builds
    Ideal for building skylines, industrial areas, metros, and elevated transport systems.

## **Blocks & Items:**

 

_Suspended Rail_ - New rail type, based of a powered rail. It works only with the Suspended Railcar and is specifically designed for it.

_Curved Rails_: as the name suggest: to build curves you need to craft curved rails seperately!

_Railconstruction_: A block specifically designed for the new rail types. Suspended and Curved Rails can only be placed on the Railconstruction block. No additional redstone needed, the block powers the rails automatically.

_Steelbeam_: A decorative block that can be used to support the rail construction, but only optionally.

_Wheelset_: special Item which is needed to craft a suspended railcar.

_Suspended Railcar_: new entity, based of a minecart, but hangs underneath its rails. It has to be placed on a suspended rail, then automatically adjusts underneath it. IMPORTANT: To enter it you need to click near its roof, hitbox is relatively high up.

_________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

### Dependencies (in order for the mod to work):

- u-team-core (by HyCraftHD)

(https://modrinth.com/mod/u-team-core)

 

This mod is forge-only (currently only 1.20.1 as well) 

Right now, i am not planning to port this mod to fabric or higher mc-versions.

title: SnowReports
description: Lightweight, customizable player reporting plugin.
body:
# SnowReports

Lightweight, customizable player reporting plugin.

[![Paper](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/supported/paper_vector.svg)](https://papermc.io/)
[![Modrinth](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/available/modrinth_vector.svg)](https://modrinth.com/plugin/snowreports)

## Features

- **Report Reason Presets** with auto-completion
- **Multiple Storage Methods** MySQL, SQLite, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, H2
- **Intuitive GUI** for viewing and managing reports
- **Discord Integration** via webhooks
- **Automatic Update Checking**
- **Highly Customizable** settings and messages
- **Cross-server support** while using a remote storage method with the velocity plugin
- **Chat History** stored for each report

## Usage

### Commands

| Command                                    | Description                                 | Permission                                 |
|--------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------|
| `/snowreports`                             | Main command                                | `snowreports.command.snowreports`          |
| `/deleteallreports [confirm]`              | Delete all reports                          | `snowreports.command.deleteallreports`     |
| `/deleteallreportsfrom <player> [confirm]` | Delete all reports made by a player         | `snowreports.command.deleteallreportsfrom` |
| `/deletereport <id> [confirm]`             | Delete a specific report                    | `snowreports.command.deletereport`         |
| `/myreports [page]`                        | View reports you've made                    | `snowreports.command.myreports`            |
| `/report <player> [reason]`                | Report a player                             | `snowreports.command.report`               |
| `/reports [player/page]`                   | View all reports or player-specific reports | `snowreports.command.reports`              |
| `/setstatus <id> <status> [confirm]`       | Set the status of a report                  | `snowreports.command.setstatus`            |

### Permissions

| Permission                                   | Description                                         |
|----------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| `snowreports.command.<command>`              | Give permission to a certain command                |
| `snowreports.command.<command>.<subcommand>` | Give permission to a certain subcommand             |
| `snowreports.alerts`                         | Receive an alert when a player is reported          |
| `snowreports.bypass.cooldown`                | Bypass the report cooldown                          |
| `snowreports.bypass.report`                  | Makes a player immune to reports                    |
| `snowreports.update`                         | Get notified if an update is available when joining |

### Placeholders

Requires [PlaceholderAPI](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/placeholderapi.6245/)

| Placeholder                        | Description                         |
|------------------------------------|-------------------------------------|
| `%snowreports_reports_total%`      | Total number of reports             |
| `%snowreports_reports_open%`       | Total number of open reports        |
| `%snowreports_reports_inprogress%` | Total number of in progress reports |
| `%snowreports_reports_resolved%`   | Total number of resolved reports    |

## License

SnowReports is licensed under the [GPL-3.0 license](LICENSE).

title: TristanEhm's Modpack
description: The personal, vanilla compatible modpack of TristanEhm! Gorgeous, optimized and tweaked to (near) perfection.
body:
## TristanEhm’s Modpack

### Version Summary

There are four versions of TristanEhm's Modpack. More detailed information on each modpack can be found on their specific Modrinth page.

1. TristanEhm's Modpack 1: Extreme (TEMP Extreme)
    - A nice blend of audio and visual mods which improve game feel with informational HUD mods and mods which improve inventory management and other quality of life mods. TEMP Extreme also includes live stream related mods since this is the modpack I use while streaming.
2. TristanEhm's Modpack 2: High (TEMP High)
    - TEMP High is identical to TEMP Extreme except that the stream related mods have been removed and the default settings are lower than those in TEMP Extreme. 
3. TristanEhm's Modpack 3: Medium (TEMP Medium)
    - TEMP Medium takes a step down from 1 & 2 in game feel, while taking a step up in performance and retaining all of the quality of life features that make this modpack its own.
4. TristanEhm's Modpack 4: Low (TEMP Low)
    - This modpack is for the best possible performance while maintaining the essential core features of the modpack.

## Content

This modpack contains a few categories of mods.

### 1. Optimization Mods

This modpack includes all of the best performance enhancing mods. This helps counteract all of the beautifying mods in TEMP Extreme and helps the game run on lower end systems in TEMP Low. These mods can be found in all of my modpacks from TEMP Extreme to TEMP Low.

### 2. Quality of Life Mods

Inventory management in vanilla minecraft has always left a bit to be desired. Moving items around and sorting what you’ve collected is a slow and tedious process. That is why there are so many modders changing this aspect of the game. This modpack includes a nicely curated collection of these quality of life mods to improve the game in little ways, while staying true to vanilla. These mods can be found in all of my modpacks from TEMP Extreme to TEMP Low.

### 3. Game Feel Improvement Mods

There are a variety of audio and visual mods included in this pack to improve the ambience and feel of the game. The majority of the visual mods focus on small textural and particle additions and the majority of the audio mods add little sounds throughout the game from actions in the inventory to to footsteps on different blocks. Since these mods impact performance, their quantity decreases from TEMP Extreme to TEMP Low.

### 4. Informational Mods

Technical minecrafters and casual minecrafters alike will love these mods. Information is valuable to anyone who plays the game and the informational mods included in this modpack hit all the right spots, further improving quality of life. 

## Purpose

The purpose of this modpack is to provide a combination of performance enhancing mods with light weight informational and audio/visual mods to enhance the feel, ambience and quality of life of the game, all while remaining vanilla compatible. 

### Vanilla Compatibility

The modpack can be used on vanilla servers without causing any problems, however for some mods to function to their full potential, some server side mods are required. All of these mods are included in the server version of TristanEhm’s Modpack.

## TristanEhm’s Modpack 1: Extreme

TEMP Extreme is beautiful in all regards. This modpack is mainly intended for personal use, however, if you have a computer that can run it and are interested in content creation, this is the modpack for you. Otherwise, TEMP High offers everything you could want.
This modpack also includes all of the basics included in the other packs. In other words; you wont find anything in another TristanEhm Modpack which isn’t included in this one.

title: Eternal Potions
description: Reusable potions with powerful vanilla effects.
body: _Inspired by the [Second Wind](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/second-wind) mod by Lordepos._ **Eternal Potions** introduces a collection of reusable potions that grant vanilla buffs to enhance exploration, combat, and survival, while fitting seamlessly into vanilla gameplay and modpacks. These potions aren’t meant to make you invincible, but they’ll give you the edge when you need it most. Each potion draws its name and theme from **Greek mythology**. ## Potions & Effects | Potion |Effects |Cooldown |Recipe Unlock Requirement | | ----------------- |--------------------------------------------------------------- |-------- |----------------------------- | | Hermes’ Grace |Haste II (2:30) |10 min |Travel 1000 blocks on foot | | Atalanta’s Dash |Speed II (2:30) + Jump Boost (2:30) |6 min |Jump 100 times | | Demeter’s Bounty |Regeneration I (30s) + Saturation (30s) |10 min |Craft a Golden Apple | | Ares’ Bulwark |Resistance I (2:00) + Absorption II (2:00) |12 min |Block an attack with a Shield | | Poseidon’s Gift |Water Breathing (2:30) + Speed I (2:30) |8 min |Catch 25 fish | | Artemis’ Veil |Night Vision (2:30) + Resistance I (2:30) + Invisibility (2:30) |10 min |Kill 5 mobs with a Bow | | Hephaestus’ Ember |Fire Resistance (3:00) + Haste I (3:00) |15 min |Enter the Nether | | Heracles’ Wrath |Strength II (2:00) + Resistance I (2:00) |12 min |Kill an Iron Golem | | Tyche’s Gamble |Luck III (2:00) |15 min |Trade 5 times with a villager | | Hygieia’s Draught |Instant Health I + Health Boost I (2:00) |12 min |Eat a Glistering Melon | ## Features * **Reusable** — Use them over and over (they’re not consumed)   * **Vanilla-friendly** — Only standard Minecraft effects * Works in singleplayer & multiplayer (cooldowns are player-based) * Recipes themed after Greek gods using fitting ingredients   * **Unlock crafting recipes by completing custom advancements** * Custom bottle-like items with unique colors and designs   * Balanced to fit modded or vanilla-style play — from Skyblock to Adventure packs ## FAQ > **How do I craft the potions?**   > Complete the matching advancement to unlock each recipe. The potions are crafted using a vanilla crafting table. > **Are the potions strong?**   > They give meaningful boosts like Speed II, Strength II, or Haste II — but for short durations and with a reasonable cooldown to keep things a little balanced. (Balancing WIP) > **Can I spam or stack them?**   > No — each potion has its cooldown, and using more copies doesn’t bypass it. > **Do I lose the potion when I use it?**   > Nope — you keep the potion forever. Just wait for the cooldown before using it again. ## Perfect for players who want: * **A smoother early game** (get mining & exploring faster)   * **Useful utility boosts** without breaking the game   * **A fun mythological theme** that fits into any modpack

title: Pls Don't Kill Me
description: Mod that allows you to be peaceful around maniacs
body:
## Pls Don't Kill Me
Simple Fabric mod that allows you to be peaceful around maniacs.

### What does the mod do?
Allows you to turn friendly fire on or off for you individually (on by default).\
When turned off for a player, said player :
- Can't damage any player
- Can't take damage from a player
- ANY damage source that has been inflicted by another player will be blocked

### How to use?
Just use the `/plsdontkillme` command to toggle friendly fire on or off.
> Note: To see if you have friendly fire turned on or off, use the `status` subcommand

### Installation
Drop the jar file into your server's/client's mod folder.
> Note: Clients don't need to install the mod to join a server with this mod

title: Proxy Portals
description: A minecraft proxy plugin that allows players to transport between servers with nether portals.
body:
# Proxy-Portals
A minecraft proxy plugin that allows players to transport between servers with nether portals.

## Installation
This plugin works on the backend. No need for a proxy plugin. Simply place the jar file in the plugins folder of any server you want to use portals in, and restart your server. (Note, this plugin does not need to be on the server the player is teleporting to! If you have one central lobby server that has all of the portals, that is the only server that needs the plugin.)

## Usage
To register an ordinary into a server switching portal, use the command `/register-server *server*`, in which you replace `*server*` with the name of the server you want the portal to transport you to. The `*server*` parameter must be the exact same that it appears in your `velocity.toml` (you can find a list of available servers and their exact names with the `/server` command). You will be promped to walk into the portal you want to register. After you do so, the entire portal (size and shape doesn't matter) will be registered to redirect the player to that server.
**Multiple portals can be registered to one server**!

To remove a registration from a portal without deleting your entire configuration, use the command `/deregister-server *server*` in which you replace `*server*` with the name of ther server you want to deregister. After running this command, all portals registered under `*server*` will return to regular portals. 

#### Disclaimer:
I use a recursive function to register the entirety of any portal the player steps into. With very large portals, the registration will not be immediate, and the server will throw a thread dump. This is normal, the plugin will still work perfectly fine.

### NOTE:
I highly highly recommend going into the `config.yml` and changing `lobby-mode` to `true` on any server that you configure portals on. This will prevent players from being locked out of a server because they spawn in a portal. It is `false` by default because this option sends everyone who joins the server to the server spawn when they join, no matter where the are in the world.

There is also a `no-player-die` configuration option. When `true`, this will prevent the player from dying of damage, drowning, or starving. This should be used for lobby-type worlds.

title: Textile
description: small changes to leather armor as well as new paper recipes (rotten flesh to leather recipe integrated)
body:
This small mod makes leather armor a bit more survival-friendly and lets you create paper out of bamboo, seagrass and leather.

**Leather Armor Changes**  
Theres never been a real use of leather armor because it's usually such a short time period between spawning into the world and getting iron armor, that it's better just to spare up for bookshelves
until you got yourself a enchanting table.

But now you can invest (with some luck) only around 4 leather for 28% armor reduction 
(iron armor is 60%) as you get the rest of the invested leather back!
This both encourages using leather armor until it breaks and actually investing the time to even make it in the first place.

[Actual Recycling Values]                     
Helmet = 1-3 returned                       
Chestplate = 3-6 returned                    
Leggings = 2-5 returned             
Boots = 1-2 returned                                

**Paper Recipe Additions**  
It's quite unrealistic how you can only make paper from sugar cane although there are many other things here that you could make it out of just as well.

I know theres alot of sugarcane lying around, but that stuff sometimes takes quite the time to grow if you're busy doing other things. So this mod eases things and lets that seagrass rotting in the chest or the uncollected bamboo sitting there for weeks have a use (also cow farms get more use ig)!

[Recipes]                                 
3 Bamboo = 1 Paper                                 
3 Seagrass = 1 Paper                  
1 Leather = 2 Paper               

*Final Note:* This mod adds rotten flesh to leather smelting recipe as well so thats neat.

*made with MCreator*

description: Server-side mod adding vaults, ender-chest-style inventories.
body:
# GVault

![gunpowder required](https://img.shields.io/badge/Gunpowder-Required-important?style=for-the-badge)

A Gunpowder add-on which adds *vaults*, per-player end-chest-style inventories which can be accessed via commands.

## Commands

| Command                           | Permission node    | Action                                   |
|-----------------------------------|--------------------|------------------------------------------|
| `/vault <number>`                 | `gvault.viewVault` | Shows vault `#number` to yourself.       |
| `/vault showto <target> <number>` | `gvault.showTo`    | Shows `target` their own vault `#number` |
| `/vault spy <target> <number>`    | `gvault.spy`       | Shows you `target`'s vault `#number`     |

## Config

```yaml
vaultCount: 3 # How many vaults does each player have access to?
isDoubleChest: no # Are vaults double-size?
configGroups: [] # A list of Config Groups
```

## Config Groups

A config group looks like:
```yaml
name: special
vaultCount: 5
doubleChest: yes
```

Then, if a player has the permission node `gvault.group.special`, they will have 5 double-size vaults.

title: LotTweaks
description: A Minecraft mod that adds quality-of-life tools for Creative-mode builders.
body:
# LotTweaks

LotTweaks is a Minecraft mod that adds quality-of-life tools for Creative-mode builders. Reach across an entire build with one keystroke, cycle between related blocks (stone → granite → diorite) with the scroll wheel, replace blocks in place, and pick distant blocks at a glance.

## Features

### Reach Extension

Break, place, and pick blocks up to 100+ blocks away. Hold the key (default: **U**) and scroll the mouse wheel to adjust the range on the fly.

> Both client and server need this mod installed.

![A player places and breaks blocks from over 16 blocks away using Reach Extension.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0e5e6fae0a1d87f469894bc494ab821d94ab4430.gif)

### Palette

Hold the key (default: **R**) and scroll to swap the held item for the next one in the same item group — for example, stone → granite → diorite, or oak planks → birch planks. Double-tap to switch between palette groups.

Item groups are defined in `LotTweaks-ItemGroups.json` and can be edited freely. Items with components such as enchantments or custom names are supported, so an enchanted bow or a renamed item can be registered as its own palette entry.

> Client-side only.

![A player uses the Palette to quickly cycle through related block variants in the hotbar.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0c0178b97db65fccdf3bbb8a7dffc9ab3d116b3d.gif)

### Replace Block

Press the key (default: **G**) while looking at a block to replace it with the item in your main hand.

> Both client and server need this mod installed.

### Smart Pick

Press the key (default: **V**) to pick the block you are looking at, even when it is well beyond the vanilla pick range. Long-press the key and scroll to pick from your recent pick-block history instead.

> Client-side only.

## Default Keybindings

| Key | Action | Required side |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **V** | Smart Pick | Client |
| **R** | Palette | Client |
| **G** | Replace Block | Client + Server |
| **U** | Reach Extension | Client + Server |

All keys can be rebound from the standard Minecraft Controls screen.

## Commands

All commands are client-side.

- `/lottweaks add` — Register the items in your hotbar as a new entry in the **primary** palette group.
- `/lottweaks add 2` — Register the items in your hotbar as a new entry in the **secondary** palette group.
- `/lottweaks reload` — Reload item groups from `LotTweaks-ItemGroups.json`.

## Configuration

Item groups are stored in `LotTweaks-ItemGroups.json` inside your `config/` directory. The file is created with sensible defaults the first time you launch the game.

**To customize:**

1. Edit `LotTweaks-ItemGroups.json` directly, or use `/lottweaks add`.
2. Run `/lottweaks reload` to apply the changes.
3. If the file contains errors, the offending lines are reported in chat and in the log.

**To reset to defaults:**

1. Delete `LotTweaks-ItemGroups.json`.
2. Restart Minecraft. A fresh default config will be regenerated.

**Migrating from older versions:**

Older text-based configs (`LotTweaks-BlockGroups.txt` and `LotTweaks-BlockGroups2.txt`) are automatically migrated to the new JSON format on first launch.

## FAQ

**Reach Extension or Replace Block isn't working.**
Make sure the same version of LotTweaks is installed on the server. These two features require both sides.

**Does this mod work with blocks added by other mods?**
Probably yes for standard blocks, but blocks from other mods are not officially supported.

**Can I share a customized item-groups config with others?**
Yes — feel free to distribute your `LotTweaks-ItemGroups.json`.

## Recent Changes

- **2.4.x** — Items with components (enchantments, custom names, etc.) can now be registered as distinct palette entries. Configs are stored as `LotTweaks-ItemGroups.json` (legacy `.txt` configs are auto-migrated).
- **2.3.7** — Internal rename to clearer feature names: `ExPick` → **Smart Pick**, `Rotate` → **Palette**, `AdjustRange` → **Reach Extension**, `Replace` → **Replace Block**. No functional changes.

> Powered by [Beet]


This datapack adds the **Botany Pot**, a compact and decorative farming block that allows you to grow crops in a single space while automatically replanting them after harvest.

Perfect for aesthetic builds, **compact farms** (_try the Hopper Botany Pot_), or simplified crop setups.

![More than 29 crops](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4df1b2e046adac851307c0ea53a7f372786c1029.png)
---

## 📦 Crafting

Craft the **Botany Pot** using the same recipe as the original mod version.
Put a hopper in the center in order to get the **Hopper Botany Pot**
**_Or check the image gallery._**

Once crafted, place it like any normal block.

---

## 🌾 How to Use

Using the Botany Pot is simple:

### 1️⃣ Insert Soil
Right-click the placed Botany Pot with a valid soil block.

Different crops require different soils. For example:
- Wheat → Farmland
- Nether Wart → Soul Sand

Make sure you use the correct soil for the crop you want to grow.

### 2️⃣ Plant the Crop
Right-click the Botany Pot with the seed or crop item.

The crop will begin growing immediately.

![Sapling in a Botany Pot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d9aa25ebcfc864c0a46ee7c808f0078637816ff7.png)

---

## 🌿 Growth & Fertilizer

- Crops grow automatically over time. (remember the light conditions)
- You can speed up growth by right-clicking with Bone Meal.
- You can block growth using honeycomb / restore it using a axe

---

## 🌻 Harvesting

- Right-click a fully grown crop to harvest it.
- The crop will automatically replant itself.
- Left-click with an empty hand to remove contents.
- The Hopper Botany Pot will automatically harvest the crop when ready. Remember to put a hopper below it, or your resources will go lost.

---

## ⚙️ Customization
New crops and soils can be configured easily from in-game or via other datapacks.
Check [Official Custom Crop Generator](https://iconikoulg.github.io/generators/botanypots/customcrops.html)

```
/data modify storage ulg:botanypots custom_plants append value {plant_id:"example",block_id:"minecraft:lantern",item_id:"minecraft:lantern",block_size:"small",growth_time:[3,6],ready_block_size:"big",soils:[{soil_id:"dirt"}],loot:{...}}
```

This datapack is an independent recreation inspired by Darkhax’s original idea. It is not an official port of the mod, and some features may behave differently.

title: UnShade
description: Unshade is a lightweight vanilla lighting overhaul inspired by OptiFine internal shaders visual tweak that removes ambient occlusion (AO) from blocks, resulting in a smoother, evenly lit, and more uniform appearance.
body:
# **UnShade**

UnShade is a lightweight Minecraft resource pack that removes ambient occlusion (AO) from blocks, creating a cleaner, smoother, and evenly lit visual style inspired by the look of OptiFine internal shaders.

It gives Minecraft brighter vanilla visuals with smooth lighting and a flatter appearance similar to the clean Minecraft gameplay often seen in videos from creators like Grian and Mumbo Jumbo.

Unlike traditional Minecraft shaders, UnShade works entirely through a resource pack, allowing you to get a shader-like vanilla Minecraft look without needing Iris, OptiFine shaders, Sodium shaders, or other heavy shader packs.

The result is a lightweight and FPS friendly visual overhaul that keeps the vanilla Minecraft style while reducing dark block shading and visual noise caused by ambient occlusion.

Perfect for players looking for:

* OptiFine internal shader style visuals
* vanilla shader-like lighting
* cleaner Minecraft textures
* brighter Minecraft lighting
* smooth lighting without shaders
* a lightweight Minecraft resource pack
* better visibility for building and survival
* vanilla friendly visuals for screenshots and videos

## Features

* Removes ambient occlusion (AO) shading
* Inspired by OptiFine internal shaders
* Smooth and evenly lit Minecraft visuals
* Lightweight and performance friendly
* No shaders required
* Vanilla Minecraft friendly
* Great for building, survival, PvP, and content creation
* Compatible with modern Minecraft versions

## Why Use UnShade?

Minecraft’s default ambient occlusion adds soft shadows between blocks to simulate depth, but it can also make builds look darker and noisier. UnShade removes those shadows to create a flatter, cleaner, and brighter visual experience.

The result feels similar to OptiFine internal shaders while remaining lightweight and simple to use.

This helps with:

* Better block visibility
* Cleaner aesthetics
* Less visual noise
* More consistent lighting
* Smoother-looking builds
* A classic-style Minecraft feel

## Comparison

body:
# ADMIN ABUSE 🎛️⚡
### Chaos Event Control Panel for Admins (EN/RO + Tiny Text)

ADMIN ABUSE is a server event plugin where admins can trigger timed chaos events from a clean in-game panel.  
Fast to use, fun for players, and perfect for event nights.

---

## 🔥 Main Concept

Open panel ➜ pick event ➜ choose duration (5 / 10 / 15 min) ➜ let the chaos begin.

Everything is designed for quick control and high visibility:
- tiny-text styled branding
- bilingual server messaging (English + Romanian)
- global screen announcements
- event timer feedback

---

## 🧭 Admin Panel

Command: `/adminabuse`

Inside the GUI:
- **Left Click** = 5 minutes
- **Right Click** = 10 minutes
- **Shift Click** = 15 minutes
- **Barrier button** = stop active event

---

## 🌧️ Event: Lucky Rain

A global loot rain event where OP items fall from the sky in player regions.

Possible drops include:
- Diamonds
- Emeralds
- Netherite Ingots
- Enchanted Golden Apples
- Totems of Undying
- Diamond Blocks

This turns normal gameplay into instant high-energy loot chaos.

---

## 🌕 Event: Blood Moon (Vault Economy)

During Blood Moon:
- Night + storm atmosphere is forced
- Hostile mobs are heavily buffed (stronger, faster, tankier)
- Killing Blood Moon mobs rewards money via Vault economy

Great for PvE pressure and high-risk/high-reward gameplay.

---

## ✨ Event: Enchant Frenzy

While active:
- players periodically receive random enchant boosts on valid held gear
- creates temporary power spikes and unpredictable fights

---

## ⛏️ Event: Double Drops

While active:
- mined blocks duplicate their drops
- strong economy/resource acceleration event for all players

---

## 📢 Fullscreen Announce System

Command: `/chat <message>`

Sends:
- global chat broadcast
- fullscreen title message on all players’ screens

Perfect for server alerts, event transitions, or emergency staff messages.

---

## 🎲 Random Enchant Command

Command: `/randenchant`

Applies random enchant to held valid item:
- tools
- weapons
- armor
- bow / crossbow / trident

---

## ℹ️ Member Info Command

Command: `/eventinfo`

Shows:
- active event name
- remaining duration

Useful for regular players to understand what’s currently happening.

---

## 🌍 Language Support

Core messages are bilingual:
- **EN** English
- **RO** Romanian

Built to be readable and clear for mixed communities.

---

## 🔐 Permissions

- `adminabuse.admin`  
  Full access to panel and admin commands.

- `adminabuse.use`  
  Access to basic event info command.

---

## ✅ Compatibility

- Minecraft: `1.16.5` ➜ `1.21.11`
- Platforms: `Bukkit`, `Spigot`, `Paper`, `Purpur`, `Folia`
- Vault support for Blood Moon rewards

---

## 🚀 Quick Setup

1. Put `admin-abuse-1.0.0.jar` in `plugins/`
2. Install Vault + an economy plugin (EssentialsX Economy, CMI, etc.) for Blood Moon payouts
3. Restart server
4. Use `/adminabuse` to open panel
5. Configure rewards in `config.yml` if needed

---

## ❤️ Final Note

ADMIN ABUSE is built for controlled chaos:
- fast admin control
- fun global events
- high-visibility announcements
- simple setup

If you want event-driven gameplay with minimal command friction, this plugin is made for that.

title: Afar
description: A faster, lighter minecraft chunk caching solution
body:
# Afar

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)

**Afar** is a faster, lighter chunk caching solution for minecraft, allowing you to see far beyond the server's view distance.

## How It Works

Instead of modifying the complex rendering engine, Afar operates at lower level. It works directly on the client's network connection.

1.  **Cache (Save):** It silently listens to and saves all the chunk data packets the server sends to your client into a local database.
2.  **Load (Read):** When you move around and need chunks that are within your *client's* view distance but beyond the *server's*, Afar seamlessly loads that previously saved data from your cache instead of waiting for the server to send it.

## Key Features

### 🚀 **Performance**
-   Utilizes **SQLite** as the storage backend, offering significantly faster read/write speeds and smaller file sizes compared to serializing NBT data to files.

### 🔧 **Compatibility**
-   Works **purely at the network connection level**, intercepting and forging packets. It makes **zero changes** to the game's rendering code.
-   This makes it **theoretically 100% compatible** with any rendering optimization mods like **Optifine**, **Sodium**, **Iris**, and any mod that affects chunk rendering or visual aesthetics.

## Dependence      
- Minecraft SQLite JDBC [(modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/plugin/minecraft-sqlite-jdbc/version/3.49.1.0+2025-07-12)
- World ID Provider such as VoxelMap and JourneyMap ( Xaero's Map compatibility is still in production.)

## Usage
- You can find Afar config button in the settings menu or the mod list menu. All configuration items have corresponding explanations.
- Here are some client-side command you can use

```
/afar dataInfo    //Show database infomation
/afar runVacuum   //Run database vacuum, which will optimize the size and read/write speed of the database
/afar doDrop      //Delete all chunk data
/afar deleteOld <float:hours>  // Delete all records before the specified database running time. You can check the running time using /afar dataInfo
```


## Disclaimer 
- This mod simply re-uses data the server has already sent you. It **does not hack the server to get more data**. Your client's performance when rendering a larger view distance is dependent on your own PC's capabilities.

# 📦 SyncInventory - Inventory Synchronization Plugin  

This plugin enables real-time synchronization of player inventory items, supporting shared inventory contents among players within the same custom group.

Independent player backpacks and shared backpacks, players can automatically restore their backpacks after leaving the synchronized group.

Compatible with Folia, Paper, Bukkit, Purpur, Spigot, and other server cores.

## 📌 Features  

- **Multi-player Inventory Sync**  
  Create sync groups where all members' inventories stay automatically synchronized  
- **Multi-language Support**  
  Built-in English (`en`) and Chinese (`zh`) language support  

---

## 🛠 Commands  

All commands use `/syncinv` prefix  

| Command | Description | Permission |  
|---------|-------------|------------|  
| `create <group>` | Create new sync group | `syncinv.manage` |  
| `delete <group>` | Delete existing group | `syncinv.manage` |  
| `join <group>` | Join a sync group | `syncinv.join` |  
| `leave` | Leave current group | `syncinv.leave` |  
| `list` | List all groups | `syncinv.use` |

title: Simple Origin Changer
description: A simple way to give players the chance to change their origin within a certain time limit after joining
body:
![An image of the origin changer command. The game tells the player that they can change their origin a total of 1 time, that they have not yet changed their origin, and that they must change their origin within the next 29 minutes and 33 seconds, if at all. It then provides a button to change their origin.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4d9f7a48d72e4bbe0616aa9774f10e01564e6254.png)
![A chat message telling the player that the Origin Selection Gui has just been opened for them. It informs the player that this is their 1st origin change, out of a total of 1 origin changes.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/250c733f595bf4054fe7ff9b5cd20dd39a79ba05.png)
![An image of the origin changer command. The game tells the player that they have changed their origin 1 time, out of a total of 1 time. It also tells the player they have passed the playtime deadline, and they cannot change their origin any further.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/85804a0ee6a819c589a146f2d904f2165a8f2ff5.png)

A very simple datapack to allow players to change their origin a configurable amount of times (default 1) within a certain period of time since joining (default 30 minutes).

To access their origin change, players must run `/trigger origin-change`.

Time players spend in the origin selection gui is not counted towards the time limit for changing their origin.

The time limit and maximum number of origin changes a player can have can be easily adjusted by changing the following scores:

```
# 36000 is 30 minutes in ticks (30 * 60 * 20)
/scoreboard players set #maxTime origin-change-timer 36000
# 1 max change per person
/scoreboard players set #maxChanges origin-change-used 1
```

For example, if you wanted to change the time limit to 45 minutes, and the maximum number of changes to 2, you'd run the following commands:

```
/scoreboard players set #maxTime origin-change-timer 54000
/scoreboard players set #maxChanges origin-change-used 2
```

Feel free to use in all modpacks and servers, as long as you don't remove the credit!

# BlocksPrint 🖨️

**Mod that lets you save, edit, and load structures extremely fast! ⚡**

BlocksPrint is a powerful structure management tool that allows you to select, save, preview, move, rotate, and load structures using commands — all with blazing performance and smooth previews. Designed to handle even millions of blocks, it's optimized to load structures with minimal FPS impact, thanks to multi-threading and smart compression.

## Features 🧱

Select structures using a tool and two position points

Save structures instantly to a custom .blocksprint format (/blocksprint save <name>)

Load and preview structures with full control:

Move with mouse scroll

Rotate with R

Cancel with Backspace, confirm with Enter

Blazing fast structure loading using multi-threading

Configurable loading speed (/blocksprint config chunks-per-tick, default: 4, max: 64)

Supports structure preview, rotation, and movement before confirming placement

Lightweight and extremely optimized for performance

Client & Server Mod

title: VS2 Utilities
description: Datapack interaction with Valkyrien Skies 2. Utilities for greater control & fun!
body:
___ ### Datapack interaction with Valkyrien Skies 2. Utilities for greater control & fun! ![Mod Loader](https://img.shields.io/badge/mod_loader-forge_|_fabric-ffe8e9?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=ffced2) ![Environment](https://img.shields.io/badge/environment-client_|_server-ffe8e9?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=ffced2) [![Bug Reports](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/kawaiicakes/VSUtil?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&labelColor=ffe8e9&color=ffced2)](https://github.com/kawaiicakes/VSUtil/issues) [![CurseForge](https://img.shields.io/curseforge/dt/1265645?style=for-the-badge&logo=curseforge&labelColor=ffceea&color=ffe8f5)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/vsutil) [![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/sZpOgG7s?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&labelColor=ffceea&color=ffe8f5)](https://modrinth.com/project/vsutil) ___ ![VSUtil Header](https://github.com/kawaiicakes/VSUtil/blob/1.19.2/main/VSUtilHeader.gif?raw=true)
This simple mod adds various commands and items that improve your ship QoL, and I'm not talking about fanfiction. I also threw in some miscellaneous compatibility bug fixes. The ultimate idea behind making this mod was to allow me to use command blocks and datapacks to interact with ships. This included stuff like spawning entire warships, but can easily be used for much more creative things. The ship position, rotation, velocity, and angular velocity data blends almost seamlessly with vanilla in the "ship" subcommand addition to the /data command. It also includes other useful things that other VS addons have added for 1.18.2 and 1.20.1, but not for 1.19.2. --- # 📖 Information This mod adds more than just commands! ## 📑 Commands Commands are accessed through `/vsutil`! A full breakdown of the commands is on the [mod's wiki.](https://github.com/kawaiicakes/VSUtil/wiki/Commands) - `shipify`: create a new ship at a position, including its name/slug, whether it's static, whether it has collisions with other ships, and its scale - `resize`: changes the scale of a ship - `getid`: Get a ship's numeric ID from its slug - `getslug`: Get a ship's slug from its numeric ID - `disableCollisions`: Disable ALL ship-to-ship collisions for a ship if no other arguments are given, otherwise disables collisions between two ships. - `enableCollisions`: Enable all ship-to-ship collisions for a ship if no other arguments are given, otherwise enables collisions between two ships. - `interact`: Does nothing if [Clockwork](https://wiki.valkyrienskies.org/wiki/Clockwork) is not installed. Activate a phys/flap/propeller bearing at a position remotely. - `renameCurrent`: renames the ship the command is executed on. For command blocks, the position is the command block itself. For players, the position of the block underneath. This mod has also changed the vanilla `/data` command! - `/data ship` now exists, allowing deep interplay between vanilla functions & datapacks and VS2. Check the [mod's wiki](https://github.com/kawaiicakes/VSUtil/wiki/Commands) for NBT data info. ## 🌳 Blocks & Items - No Collision Wand for those who want to toggle collisions between two ships by hand. - Big/Small Propeller - Modified from their VS: Tournament counterparts; right-clicking them now allows configuration of the propeller's stats - Further changes to a propeller can be locked from the menu. - Includes a config for setting the maximum allowable stats for each propeller ## 🔧 Fixes - Misc. compatibility fixes (Credit to [Endal!](https://www.curseforge.com/members/endal/projects)) - Fixed sounds of Create: Big Cannons autocannons (and its siblings) not working on ships. - Fixed Create: Big Cannons projectile physics and damage ___ # 📝 In-Development Features - Antigravity wands + commands - Custom wand models + sounds --- # 💗 Credits & Thanks This project uses slightly modified code rewritten from Kotlin into Java from [VS: Tournament](https://wiki.valkyrienskies.org/wiki/Tournament) for the propeller block. All code taken from Tournament is in the package `vsutil.tournament` and used under the Apache-2.0 license. Artistic assets are likewise used under the same license and are located under the `vs_tournament` namespace in the mod's resource pack. The original license may be found [here,](https://github.com/alex-s168/VS_tournament_continued?tab=Apache-2.0-1-ov-file#readme) and a copy included in this software may be found [here.](https://github.com/kawaiicakes/VSUtil/blob/1.19.2/main/LICENSE-Apache-2.0) Other copyrighted work includes Create: Big Cannons compatibility bug fixes and collision save data by [Endal](https://www.curseforge.com/members/endal/projects) from the [Tank Tussle](https://www.patreon.com/TankTussle) community. Also, shoutout to [Kaupenjoe](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCbzPhyLcO8VP25dZ7kaUyAw) for his tutorials lol (wouldn't be here now if not for the start he gave me)

title: Extra Tooltips
description: Add Tooltips to items via a config file.
body:
You can add tooltips to any item (including other items from other mods) via a config file located at: config/extra_tooltips/tooltip.json

 

## Default file is structured:

![Default File Without Extra Tooltips](https://joshepstein.co.uk/fabricTooltips/before_added.png)


Adding a tooltip looks like:

![Adding extra tooltips to config](https://joshepstein.co.uk/fabricTooltips/after_added.png)


You can reload config files (When you make a change) by doing /reloadtooltips - Only in singleplayer though. If you would like to reload in multiplayer, you need to join singleplayer world and run the command, then go back to multiplayer, or, in a simpler way, relaunch your game.

The mod is only required on CLIENT.


Mod can be used in any modpacks.
