description: The Eggcat Mod is a simple Minecraft mod that adds a new decorative block to the game: the Eggcat. This block serves as a light source that can be turned on and off by clicking it.
body:
# Eggcat Mod

The Eggcat Mod is a simple Minecraft mod that adds a new decorative block to the game: the Eggcat. This block serves as
a light source that can be turned on and off by clicking it.

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

To use the Eggcat Mod, you will need the following:

- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API

### Installing

1. Download and install Fabric Loader following the instructions on the [Fabric website](https://fabricmc.net/use/).
2. Download the Eggcat Mod JAR file from the [releases page](https://modrinth.com/mod/eggcat/versions).
3. Move the JAR file to the `mods` folder in your Minecraft installation directory.
4. Launch Minecraft with the Fabric profile.

### Crafting the Eggcat Block

Once you have installed the mod, you can find the Eggcat block in the creative inventory or craft it in a crafting table
like the pattern specified below:

```
   | |O| |
   |O|i|O|
   |O|O|O|
   
   O = Egg
   i = Redstone Torch
```

To turn the light on or off, simply right-click the block.

## Source Code

The source code can be found on [GitHub](https://github.com/WinterWolfSV/eggcat) under
the [CC-BY-NC 4.0 License](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/). More information about the license can be
found under the [License](#license) section.

## License

The Eggcat Mod is released under the [CC-BY-NC 4.0 License](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/). This
license allows you to use, modify, and distribute the mod for non-commercial purposes, as long as you credit the
original author and include a copy of the license in any redistributed versions.

## Bugs and Feedback

Bug reports can be submitted either through the [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/WinterWolfSV/eggcat/issues) page of
the Eggcat Mod repository or by contacting me
personally over Discord (WinterWolfSV#9577). Please provide as much information as possible, including steps to
reproduce the
issue, error
messages, and any relevant screenshots or log files. Your feedback is greatly appreciated and will help improve the mod
for all users.

title: Eggs in a Blanket
description: A modpack for anyone.
body:
## A modpack for anyone. **Eggs in a Blanket** (EGGS for short) is the premium version of *"a pack for me and my friends,"* a classy kitchen sink pack for Quilt that combines simple and accessible mod settings with server support for a smooth and comforting experience like a poached egg on toast. EGGS is tested on a GTX 1070 and a terrible out-of-date processor to ensure your performance is good on even the most mediocre of computers, and default keybinds are provided to ensure that you get the best experience out of the box. The design philosophy for EGGS is... - ...to create a comfortable mid-sized modpack that runs on a wide range of hardware. - ...to emphasize compatibility and ease of use for a wide variety of playstyles. - ...to expand on the unique movement options Minecraft has to offer. - ...to provide natural mod interactions without forcing them on players. - ...to reward players for experimenting with mechanics instead of punishing them. - ...to allow players to express themselves thoroughly and completely. EGGS is designed to be used with "soft" gamerules enabled like "keepInventory": true and "fallDamage": false to keep the experience casual and comfortable. This is a pack designed for smaller servers and mid-line computers, so anti-griefing tools aren't included on the client level and graphical improvements such as shaders are supported but not built-in. An official public server was maintained, but has since shut down.
Frequently Asked Questions:

> Do you have a recommended server host for EGGS? I do not recommend server hosts at all. EGGS Official is personally hosted on a little computer that sits on my desk. I got it for free because it was being thrown away. Remember that the best server host is **you** and no privately-owned server host can compare to the convenience and stability of your own computer. > What do you mean by "simple and accessible mod settings"? EGGS is primarily designed to present mods as they are, without very many changes. Modern modpack design often revolves around tweaking and editing mods to create a seamless "mod soup" sort of vibe. EGGS does not do this. Most mods run with the default settings, or some approximation of those settings, in order for players to better understand the mods themselves and how they interact with each other instead of, say, forcing players to memorize unique recipes and progression that can't be replicated in any other modpack. > What do you mean by "reward[ing] players for experimenting with mechanics instead of punishing them"? Mods are a bit of a fickle business when it comes to cross-mod compatibility. Certain mechanics (such as Uncrafting Tables) are infamous for creating exploits between modded recipes and are usually forcefully removed from modpacks as a result. I'm of the opinion that the modern modding scene for Minecraft is actually pretty watertight when it comes to this stuff, and that we shouldn't put mod developers under quite that much scrutiny when it comes to balance. Obviously I can't stop developers from patching bugs, but I'm not going to manually patch exploits that exist in the interactions between different mods. If you can use some wacky combination of Malum, Lil' Wings, and Modern Industrialization to generate infinite resources, then to be honest I think you've earned that reward. > I'm having trouble getting a stable framerate, despite all the optimization mods. EGGS features Sodium, which has extensive options for improving performance. However, the nature of default options means that you will have to configure Sodium yourself for the best results. I recommend unlocking the framerate, playing in windowed mode, and reducing particles as much as possible without removing them entirely. With those settings on a GTX 1070 I get framerates between 150 and 250 fps during normal gameplay, which I believe is more than adequate for the amount of mods featured in EGGS. > Why choose Quilt? After years of playing Forge modpacks made by other people, I wanted a change. Fabric was tempting but I felt that there was a brewing "us versus them" mentality surrounding it and I was tired of that sort of community. Ultimately I chose Quilt because as a queer person the Quilt community was giving me good vibes, and the extensive Fabric mod support sealed the deal. > Why choose Modrinth? I have a vendetta against CurseForge and its subsidiaries/parent companies for treating mods and modders like little sponsored exclusivity deals. I think their API is terrible, especially when it comes to community support, and I think that their corporate policies are extremely destructive to the community as a whole. Modrinth is an excellent alternative that takes community support and licensing seriously without trying to hoard mods on an increasingly exclusive platform. > Sometimes EGGS updates seem a little wishy-washy about which mods they add and remove. Some updates even remove mods that were included in the previous update. Why is that? The nature of playtesting on a server with a very small team of players is that any mod that I add to EGGS can only be tested for compatibility by adding that mod to the modlist, publishing an update, and then testing it. This means that early versions had a lot of "here's a cool mod! oops, it's broken!" incidents that needed to be sorted out in a messier fashion than I desired. As I've worked on this modpack, I've developed methods for screening mods as a form of pre-testing, and so newer versions are much more strict about which mods get added and which need to be removed. > Why are there no chunkloaders? I believe that mod-based chunkloaders are "overhyped" by a lot of users in the sense that they think they need a chunkloader in order for their builds to be optimal or even usable. This often goes hand-in-hand with mods that allow for sending resources across long distances, even across dimensions. I've done my best with designing EGGS in a way where players don't need to rely on elaborate long-distance resource grinds in order to succeed. For players that absolutely need chunkloading functionality, Fabrication has options for loading chunks using furnace minecarts, and vanilla mechanics can be used to achieve similar effects. > Why is there no way to claim chunks or form teams in multiplayer? This is a licensing issue. EGGS features MapFrontiers, which relies on Journeymap. Journeymap does have support for FTB Chunks and FTB Teams, but those mods are hosted exclusively on CurseForge without a license (all rights reserved). I've tried including Open Chunks & Claims before, but that mod only hooks into Xaero's Minimap, which is... also all rights reserved on CurseForge. The reality is that there just isn't a good way to include that functionality. You, as a player, are welcome to download FTB Chunks and use it in your own instance of the modpack; I just can't provide it for you without, you know, breaking the law.

A full list of gamerules used on the official server:

/gamerule keepInventory true /gamerule disableElytraMovementCheck true /gamerule fallDamage false /gamerule doFireTick false /gamerule commandBlockOutput false /gamerule playersSleepingPercentage 50 /gamerule spawnRadius 0 /gamerule chargedCreeperDestructionType DAMAGE_ONLY /gamerule creeperDestructionType DAMAGE_ONLY /gamerule ghastFireballDestructionType DAMAGE_ONLY /gamerule witherSkullDestructionType DAMAGE_ONLY /gamerule witherSpawnDestructionType DAMAGE_ONLY

Instructions for setting up a server of your own:

1. Install EGGS through a supported launcher (Prism Launcher is recommended) and create a fresh instance if you already have one installed. Do not run the instance. 2. Open the instance's .minecraft folder. There should be a config folder, a mods folder, and nothing else. Copy these folders for later. 3. Download the QuiltMC installer (https://quiltmc.org/en/install/server/). 4. In the installer, select the server tab. Choose Minecraft Version 1.19.2. Choose the place you want your server folder to be. Click "Install." 5. Paste the config folder and mods folder from earlier into the server folder. 6. Create a .txt file with the text "java -jar quilt-server-launch.jar nogui". Convert that .txt file into a .bat file; you will need file extensions enabled on Windows to do this. 7. Launch the server by running the .bat file. 8. The server will close (this is normal). Open the new eula.txt file and change "eula=false" to "eula=true". 9. Open the new server.properties file (you will have to specify a text editor) and change minecraft's server settings to your desire. Make sure to set "allow-flight=true" and "enable-command-block=true" for your convenience later. 10. You will need to port forward your router and allow connections to that port through your server computer's firewall. Instructions are router-specific. I can't help you with this part, I'm sorry. 11. Launch the server by running the .bat file. 12. Connect to your server using a client instance *of the same EGGS version*, such as the one you downloaded at the beginning. 13. Give your minecraft account op access using the server console. 14. Use commands in-game to change the gamerules as desired. 15. Use Chunky commands (https://github.com/pop4959/Chunky/wiki) to pregenerate chunks. I would recommend a radius of 2500 in the overworld to start with. Optionally, set a world border at that radius to prevent players from generating a ton of new chunks. Your server should now be set up!

Instructions for updating your server between EGGS versions:

As a general rule, you should create a fresh Quilt server each time you update, rather than trying to "hotswap" the update's changes with your current server. This is also convenient for keeping previous versions of the modpack around in case something goes horribly horribly wrong. 1. Install the new version of EGGS (Prism Launcher is recommended), **creating a fresh instance**. Do not run the instance. 2. Create a fresh Quilt server with the QuiltMC installer (see the instructions above). 3. Copy the following folders and files from your old server into the new one: > Your world's folder (mine is called Sandwich) > The previous server's .bat file > journeymap > mapfrontiers > banned-ips.json > banned-players.json > eula.txt > ops.json > server.properties > server-icon.png (if you want to keep your server icon) > usercache.json > whitelist.json 4. Copy the config folder and mods folder from the new EGGS instance's .minecraft folder and paste them in the new server folder. 5. Run the server using the .bat file. Your server should now be ready to accept players from the newest EGGS version!

- EGGS features Bewitchment (https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/bewitchment), which needs to be sourced in this description as per its license. This mod may be de-bundled from the modpack in the future at the mod creator's request, but it will always be made compatible so that players can include it themselves if they so wish. - Starting in 3.0.0, EGGS also features Rat's Mischief (https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/rats-mischief), which also needs to be sourced in this description as per its license. Have fun.

title: Flash Carts
description: Faster Minecarts, speedometers, and rail building tools without breaking your Redstone machines or needing client mods!
body:
![A player in a minecart going very fast](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aa5139a381dfdf9e1ec2797f88542852935573f1.webp)
Minecarts are arguably the best transport in Minecraft, but they can be better

## About The primary goal of this mod is to make minecarts better without breaking your Redstone. ### New Minecart Physics To make Minecarts faster, Flash Carts uses Minecrafts experimental physics.
These experimental physics allow for a lot higher speeds, but do often break redstone contraptions. Because of this, the mod only applies the new physics where you would benefit from the higher speeds. By default, the new physics are applied to normal and TNT minecarts, but not to chest, furnace, or hopper minecarts. ![A normal minecraft using a different physics system than a chest minecart](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a6e3345ce1fde6c5247d474b99ef5c1601e25499.webp) ### Building tools To make building of minecart tracks easier, Flash Carts adds selection placing inspired by the Create mod. To start, right-click a rail block with a rail in your hand, and a preview of the rail will appear in front of you. You can then place the rail by right-clicking again. > For people who want a more vanilla experience, Flash Carts also adds an 'extend' build mode which can be enabled in the config. ![A rail being built across a bridge using selections](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a895d7390749274bf1d5e64760d2802531848b98.webp) ### Speed HUD To make sure you use the new maximum speeds to their full potential, a speedometer and speedbar show up when you are in a minecart. ![Speedometer showing the current speed of a minecart in the action bar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cbda492ba396d3d4478fd3770f91b36dfe4857df_0.webp) ### Station Titles To make Minecarts more convenient to create transport networks, a station can show its name when you are standing still on top of it. To set a station's name, place a sign under the block where a Minecart stands still, and write the station name on the first line of the sign. Any extra lines on the sign will be combined into the subtitle under the station name. ![The title of a station and the sign making it possible](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5d2e65d81feb46b33a9353666fa8cbd58d773066_0.webp) ### Minecart 'Crashes' To deal with people leaving minecarts hanging around, a minecart with a passenger will cause colliding empty minecarts to break without affecting its own speed. ![A minecart with a player in it crashing through a still standing cart](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/85e0f26b6f6961d62f10626db0c169a489a84f76.webp) ### Rail recipes To make building railways a bit more do-able early game, Flash Carts adds some alternative recipes for rails like being able to use Copper instead of Gold for Powered Rails. ![A custom recipe for Powered Rail with Copper instead of Gold.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b1afca4f1db77be4f53b8fc22f26bfe78730bc3b.webp)
## Configuration On its own, the mod will not create a config file. To change settings, you can install [Fzzy Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/fzzy-config). To load changes to the config file, you can use the vanilla ``/reload`` command. ```toml cheaperRecipes = true # Whether to show the speedometer when in minecart (current speed in blocks per second), vanilla: false showSpeedometer = true # Whether to show the speed bar when in minecart (bars up to max speed), vanilla: false showSpeedBar = true # Whether to show the station title (title when standing still at a block with a sign under it), vanilla: false showStationTitle = true # Percentage of boost a powered rail should give, vanilla: 0.06 (6%) poweredRailBoostPercentage = 0.06 # How slow a minecart has to be, to be considered halted, vanilla: 0.03 haltSpeedThreshold = 0.03 # Multiplier applied to speed when minecart is considered halted, vanilla: 0.5 haltSpeedMultiplier = 0.5 ... ```

title: SmartClicker
description: 🇬🇧 ​A highly customizable, client-side auto clicker with an in-game GUI. Features Infinite Hold mode, custom keybinds, and native English/Russian localization!
body:
## 🇬🇧 English Description

**Name:** SmartClicker (Forge)
**Summary:** A highly customizable, client-side auto clicker with an intuitive in-game GUI. Perfect for AFK farms, combat, and mining! Fully localized in English and Russian.

### Description
**SmartClicker** is a powerful, fully customizable client-side auto clicker designed to make your Minecraft experience easier and save your mouse from breaking. Whether you are building an AFK cobble generator, grinding mobs, or just need to spam-click, this mod has you covered!

Everything is configured directly in-game through a clean and intuitive GUI. No more digging through config files! The mod also automatically adapts to your game's language (English and Russian are natively supported).

### ✨ Features:
* **In-Game GUI:** Press `M` (by default) to open the settings menu anywhere.
* **Multilingual:** Fully translates to English and Russian automatically based on your game settings.
* **Custom Keybinds Setup:** Bind your toggle and menu keys directly inside the mod's GUI! It even supports mouse side-buttons.
* **Left & Right Click Support:** Choose whether you want to attack/mine (LMB) or use/place items (RMB).
* **Hold vs. Single Click:** Choose between spamming single clicks (great for combat) or holding the button down (perfect for mining).
* **Infinite Hold Mode:** A dedicated infinite-hold mode for AFK farms (fishing, cobble generators).
* **Precise Timing:** Set your delay and hold durations in either Milliseconds or Seconds.
* **HUD Overlay:** A customizable on-screen indicator shows if the clicker is currently Active or Inactive (can be hidden in the settings).

### ⚙️ How to use:
1. Press `M` to open the configuration screen.
2. Set your desired delay/interval and choose the mouse button.
3. Save and close the menu.
4. Press your Toggle Key (can be bound in the menu) to start/stop the auto clicker.

### ⚠️ Important Server Notice:
*This is a client-side only mod, meaning you can use it on any server without installing it on the server itself. However, please respect server rules! Using auto clickers on public multiplayer servers might be considered an unfair advantage (cheating) and could result in a ban. Use it responsibly in single-player or on private servers with your friends.*

---

## 🇷🇺 Описание на русском

**SmartClicker** — это мощный и удобный клиентский автокликер, созданный для того, чтобы упростить выживание и сберечь вашу мышку. Строите ли вы АФК-генератор булыжника, сражаетесь с мобами или просто хотите быстро строиться — этот мод справится с любой задачей!

Все настройки производятся прямо в игре через интуитивно понятное меню. Никакого копания в конфигах! Мод автоматически переводится на русский язык, если он выбран в настройках вашего Minecraft.

### ✨ Главные функции:
* **Меню в игре:** Нажмите `M` (по умолчанию), чтобы открыть настройки прямо во время игры.
* **Локализация:** Полная встроенная поддержка русского и английского языков.
* **Настройка кнопок:** Назначайте клавиши активации и меню прямо внутри интерфейса мода (поддерживаются даже боковые кнопки мыши!).
* **Поддержка ЛКМ и ПКМ:** Выбирайте, что вам нужно — бить/копать (ЛКМ) или строить/использовать (ПКМ).
* **Режимы клика:** Выбирайте между быстрыми одиночными кликами (для сражений) или зажатием кнопки (для копания блоков).
* **Бесконечное Зажатие:** Специальный режим бесконечного удержания кнопки для АФК-ферм.
* **Точное время:** Настраивайте интервалы и время зажатия в миллисекундах или секундах.
* **HUD-индикатор:** Аккуратная надпись на экране покажет, работает ли кликер в данный момент (ее можно скрыть в настройках).

### ⚙️ Как использовать:
1. Нажмите `M`, чтобы открыть меню настроек.
2. Установите нужный интервал и выберите кнопку мыши.
3. Сохраните и закройте меню.
4. Нажмите кнопку активации (настраивается в меню), чтобы запустить кликер.

### ⚠️ Важно (Для игры на серверах):
*Этот мод работает только на клиенте. Вы можете заходить с ним на любые серверы, но помните о правилах! На многих публичных серверах использование автокликеров запрещено и может привести к бану. Используйте мод с умом в одиночной игре или на приватных серверах с друзьями.*

title: Damage = Border
description: Spawns all players in a world border that expands whenever someone takes damage.
body:
# DamageBorder

A Minecraft plugin where the world border expands every time a player takes damage.  
Inspired by Bastighg<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/30bbyHLdevs" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

> **The border is synced across all dimensions** – same size, configurable per-world center, active in Overworld, Nether, and End.

---

## Features

- **Damage-based expansion** – Every time a player takes damage, the world border grows by a configurable amount
- **Multi-dimension sync** – Border size is the same in every dimension; per-world centers are auto-set when a player first enters that world
- **Full protection** – Players cannot walk or break blocks outside the border; if they try to move further out, they get teleported back to the center
- **Statistics** – Track damage per player and total border expansions
- **Reloadable config** – All settings can be changed ingame and reloaded without a server restart

---

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/damageborder` or `/db` | Show help menu |
| `/damageborder reset` | Reset border to starting size |
| `/damageborder size <value>` | Set border to a specific size |
| `/damageborder info` | Show current border size, center, and maximum |
| `/damageborder center` | Teleport to the border center of your current dimension |
| `/damageborder damage` | Show your damage statistics |
| `/damageborder totaldamage` | Show total damage from all players |
| `/damageborder togglemessages` | Toggle border expansion broadcast messages |
| `/damageborder reload` | Reload configuration from disk |

**Permission:** `damageborder.admin` (default: op)

---

## Config

```yaml
# Starting border size in blocks
startSize: 1

# Current border size (persists across server restarts)
currentSize: 1

# How much the border grows per damage point
growthPerDamage: 1

# Maximum border size (-1 = infinite)
maxSize: -1

# Default border center (for worlds without specific center)
center:
  world: world
  x: 0
  z: 0

# Per-world centers are auto-set when a player first enters that world
world_centers:

# Message settings
messageSettings:
  showExpansionMessages: true
  showJoinMessages: true
```

World centers (like the End spawn platform) are automatically detected and saved the first time a player enters that world. You can also set them manually in `world_centers`.

---

title: Leashed Teleport
description: Allow users to teleport around with leashed entities!
body:
![Leashed Teleport](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/371e85a9cb7fabe4a1b7e53839636c939b08d6d0_0.webp)
# **Leashed Teleport**

A Fabric mod for Minecraft that brings your leashed entities along when you teleport via `/tp`.

---

## ✨ Features

- **Leash-based teleportation** — any mob leashed directly to you and within the configured radius can follow your `/tp`, ender pearl, and chorus fruit teleports.
- **Intelligent safety checks** — the mod automatically detects unsafe destinations (lava, fire, void, suffocation hazards) and finds a nearby safe location within a 5-block radius. If no safe spot is found, the teleport is cancelled to prevent mob death.
- **Fall damage protection** — teleported entities receive Damage Resistance V and Slow Falling for a configurable duration to survive the landing.
- **Tame ownership check** — tamed animals (dogs, cats, horses, etc.) only teleport if they are owned by the teleporting player. Animals tamed by other players are left behind.
- **Sitting entities supported** — sitting tamed animals teleport as long as they are leashed to and owned by the teleporting player.
- **Cross-dimension support** — entities can optionally follow you across dimensions (Overworld ↔ Nether ↔ End). Enabled by default; toggleable in config.
- **Optional LuckPerms integration** — enable permission nodes for general use, cross-dimension teleports, ender pearls, and chorus fruit when LuckPerms is installed.
- **Optional Open Parties and Claims integration** — when OPAC is installed, leashed mobs respect claim access plus OPAC's teleport, ender pearl, and chorus fruit protection rules.
- **World border aware** — if the destination is outside the world border, leashed entities are not teleported.
- **Configurable blacklist** — define entity types that should never teleport, even if leashed to you.
- **Optional Mod Menu integration** — when Mod Menu and Cloth Config are present on the client, you can edit the same config through an in-game screen.
- **In-game commands** — `/leashedteleport info` and `/leashedteleport reload` (operator level 2 required).

---

## 🔄 Commands

| Command                      | Description                                        |
|------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------|
| `/leashedteleport info`      | OP only. Display the current config values and LuckPerms status |
| `/leashedteleport reload`    | OP only. Reload the config from disk without restart |

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

Config file: `.minecraft/config/leashedteleport.json`

A default config is created automatically on first launch, with inline comments that explain each option.

If Mod Menu is installed on the client, Leashed Teleport exposes a config screen there too. Cloth Config is optional: without it, the mod still works normally, but no config GUI is shown.

| Field                              | Type    | Default | Description                                                                                   |
|------------------------------------|---------|---------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `leash_radius`                     | double  | `10.0`  | Maximum distance in blocks from the player. Mobs further away are not teleported.            |
| `useLuckPerms`                     | boolean | `false` | When `true`, Leashed Teleport checks LuckPerms permission nodes if LuckPerms is installed.   |
| `cross_dimension_teleport`         | boolean | `true`  | Allow mobs to follow across dimensions. Set to `false` to restrict to the current dimension. |
| `ender_pearl_teleport`             | boolean | `true`  | Allow leashed mobs to follow ender pearl teleports. Set to `false` for vanilla pearl behaviour. |
| `chorus_fruit_teleport`            | boolean | `true`  | Allow leashed mobs to follow chorus fruit teleports. Set to `false` for vanilla chorus fruit behaviour. |
| `respectOpenPartiesAndClaims`      | boolean | `true`  | Respect OPAC claim protections when Open Parties and Claims is installed. |
| `damage_resistance_duration_ticks` | int     | `100`   | Duration of Damage Resistance V + Slow Falling after teleport (20 ticks = 1 second).         |
| `entity_blacklist`                 | list    | `[]`    | Entity type IDs that will never teleport. See example below.                                  |

### Blacklist Example

Use the blacklist to exclude specific mobs — for example animals that are too large or too dangerous to bring along:

```json
{
  "leash_radius": 15.0,
  "useLuckPerms": true,
  "cross_dimension_teleport": true,
  "ender_pearl_teleport": true,
  "chorus_fruit_teleport": true,
  "respectOpenPartiesAndClaims": true,
  "damage_resistance_duration_ticks": 100,
  "entity_blacklist": [
    "minecraft:cow",
    "minecraft:pig",
    "minecraft:bee",
    "minecraft:horse",
    "minecraft:llama"
  ]
}
```

> **Note:** Only mobs that can actually be leashed will ever teleport. You don't need to blacklist mobs that cannot be leashed in vanilla Minecraft (such as most hostile mobs, villagers, etc.).

## 🛡️ Open Parties and Claims

Open Parties and Claims is optional. Leashed Teleport does not depend on it directly, but when OPAC is installed and `respectOpenPartiesAndClaims` is `true`, leashed mobs will not be carried into claims that block the matching action.

- `/tp` and other general player teleports require normal claim access.
- Ender pearl mob-follow checks OPAC's Ender Pearls entity barrier group when that dynamic option exists.
- Chorus fruit mob-follow respects OPAC's chorus fruit claim exception/protection option.

Set `respectOpenPartiesAndClaims` to `false` if you want Leashed Teleport to ignore OPAC claim rules.

## 🔐 LuckPerms

Leashed Teleport only uses LuckPerms when both conditions are true:

1. `useLuckPerms` is set to `true` in `config/leashedteleport.json`
2. The `luckperms` mod is actually installed on the server

If either condition is false, everyone can use Leashed Teleport and no permission plugin is required.
If LuckPerms is active, missing permission nodes default to `false`.

### Permission nodes

| Permission | Description |
|---|---|
| `leashedteleport.use` | Allow a player to bring leashed mobs along during teleports |
| `leashedteleport.crossdimensionteleport` | Allow a player to bring leashed mobs across dimensions |
| `leashedteleport.enderpearlteleport` | Allow a player to bring leashed mobs along with ender pearl teleports |
| `leashedteleport.chorusfruitteleport` | Allow a player to bring leashed mobs along with chorus fruit teleports |

### Example groups

```yaml
group.default:
  permissions:
    - leashedteleport.use

group.vip:
  permissions:
    - leashedteleport.use
    - leashedteleport.crossdimensionteleport
    - leashedteleport.enderpearlteleport
    - leashedteleport.chorusfruitteleport
    - leashedteleport.crossdimensionteleport
```

### LuckPerms quick start

```bash
/lp group default permission set leashedteleport.use true
/lp group default permission set leashedteleport.crossdimensionteleport false
/lp group default permission set leashedteleport.enderpearlteleport false
/lp group default permission set leashedteleport.chorusfruitteleport false

/lp group vip permission set leashedteleport.use true
/lp group vip permission set leashedteleport.crossdimensionteleport true
/lp group vip permission set leashedteleport.enderpearlteleport true
/lp group vip permission set leashedteleport.chorusfruitteleport true
```

Official LuckPerms docs:

- [LuckPerms Wiki](https://luckperms.net/wiki/Home)
- [LuckPerms Command Usage](https://luckperms.net/wiki/Command-Usage)

---

## 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Compatibility

| Mod | Status |
|-----|--------|
| [Essential Commands](https://modrinth.com/mod/essential-commands) | ✅ Compatible |
| [Fabric Essentials](https://modrinth.com/mod/melius-essentials) | ✅ Compatible |
| [TpWithMe](https://github.com/SwordfishBE/TpWithMe) | ✅ Compatible |

---

## 🧾 Notes

- Only `/tp`-based teleportation is supported. Portals do not trigger leash teleportation.
- Supported player teleport types are `/tp`, ender pearls, and chorus fruit. Portals do not trigger leash teleportation.
- For cross-dimension teleports, the leash is re-attached as soon as the entity is loaded in the new dimension.
- Protection effects are applied silently.
- The safety system checks for hazards like lava, fire, void, and suffocation. If the exact teleport destination is unsafe, the mod searches within a 5-block radius for a safe alternative. This prevents accidental mob deaths from teleporting into dangerous locations.
- The mod must be installed server-side. Players do not need to install the mod on their client. This mod does work in single-player.
- Mod Menu and Cloth Config are purely optional client-side extras. A dedicated server does not need them.
- `/leashedteleport info` is operator-only and shows whether LuckPerms is `disabled`, `configured, but mod not installed`, or `active`, plus whether OPAC checks are enabled.

---

## 📦 Installation

1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) for Minecraft.
2. Download [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) and place it in `mods/`.
3. Download `leashedteleport-<version>.jar` and place it in `mods/`.
4. Launch Minecraft. The config is created automatically on first run.

---

## 🏜️ Test Server 
Feel free to join my Minecraft server to test my mods: `play.swordfishbe.eu`

title: Quick Craft
description: This mod allows you to craft items from nearby chests without having to collect the items from them.
body:
## Craft the exact amount you want — new in 1.3.1

You decide how much QuickCraft makes:

- **Click a recipe** in the recipe book to load enough for **one** craft. Click again for **two**,
  again for **three** — each click adds one more, so you can stage the exact batch you want
  without counting items by hand.
- **Shift-click a recipe** to load everything available at once (up to a full stack).
- **Shift-click the crafted result** to make the whole batch in one go. It uses **only what's in
  the grid** — it won't keep draining your chests or inventory.
- **Normal-click the result** to craft one at a time, topping up from your chests as you go.

Works at the crafting table and your inventory's 2×2 grid.

---

Available options:

- **Search Distance** (slider): choose how far QuickCraft searches for containers (up to 64 blocks).
- **Chain Mode** (toggle): if enabled, QuickCraft follows touching/connected chests from any chest already in range.
- This example here one of the marked chests contains 64 birch planks and the other 64 oak planks
![One of the marked chests contains 64 birch planks and the other 64 oak planks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/722dd31a931157a08c7fb98055dfe07ea9fb32e0_0.webp)!
- Resulting in the ability to create oak stairs (or birch) from those linked chests
 ![Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/33b6f3bc37d076043d91f3cdaefcee7add0f180c.png)
- 

---

## What's new

- **The recipe book now uses your chests.** Recipes you can make with items in nearby
  storage light up as craftable — not just the stuff in your backpack. Works at the
  crafting table, your inventory grid, and furnaces.
- **Recipes show up automatically.** If the materials are nearby, the recipe appears in
  your book — even for things you've never personally held. So if you've got oak planks
  in a chest, oak stairs are right there ready to make.
- **Furnaces, smokers, and blast furnaces.** Click a recipe in the furnace's recipe book
  and QuickCraft loads the item to smelt from your chests and adds fuel for you — using
  **coal and charcoal first** so it won't burn your wood unless it has to.
- **Tell QuickCraft to leave a chest alone.** Rename a chest to include **`[ignore]`** and
  it'll be skipped (great for decoration or off-limits storage). See below.
- **Locked chests stay locked.** Containers sealed with a lock are left untouched unless
  you're holding the key.
- **Smarter material matching.** Interchangeable materials (like any kind of planks) are
  treated as equal when filling a recipe.
- **Optional ender chest support**, if you want your ender chest counted too.

## Fixes

- **The big one: no more freezing.** Opening the recipe book, crafting table, or even your
  inventory could drop the game to a near-frozen crawl for several seconds. That's gone.
- **No more furnace lock-up.** Using the furnace recipe book could hang the game so badly
  you couldn't even close it. Fixed.
- **No more recipe-book crash.** Opening the recipe book could crash the game in certain
  cases. Fixed.
- **No more false "can't craft" recipes.** Items in your chests were sometimes shown in
  red as if you couldn't use them. Now they're correctly shown as available.
- **"Show All" shows all again** — including recipes you can't currently craft.
- **Smoother with big bases.** Large connected storage rooms no longer cause lag spikes.

---

## Leaving a chest out

By default QuickCraft uses every chest in range. To skip one, rename the chest in an
anvil so its name includes **`[ignore]`** (for example `Decorations [ignore]`) before you
place it. Want it back in? Just rename it without the tag.

## Works with most storage mods

Modded chests and barrels work as long as they act like normal storage. Big network-style
systems (like Applied Energistics 2 or Refined Storage) aren't supported automatically yet
— that's on the to-do list.

---

Most of these options can be adjusted in QuickCraft's config file if you want to fine-tune
things. Found a bug or have an idea? Let me know your loader and Minecraft version.

Thanks for using QuickCraft 💛

title: Create: Relics plus
description: An engineering expansion for the Relics mod. Harness the kinetic power of Create to evolve unique artifacts, unlock powerful synergies, automated logistics, and crushing combat abilities! Powered by NeoForge.
body:
⚙️ Create: Relics+

Create: Relics+ is an engineering expansion for the popular RPG mod Relics (by SSKirillSS), seamlessly integrating its progression mechanics with the mechanical universe of Create on the NeoForge 1.21.1 platform.

This addon transforms rotational kinetic energy into a powerful tool for character progression. Discover unique artifacts, earn relic experience by performing engineering tasks, unlock beautifully designed custom constellations, and trigger devastating item synergies!



🛠️ The Engineer's Arsenal

- Cogwheel Heart

Slot: charm
Core Function: The core of your mechanical progression. It generates and stores kinetic energy, serving as the fundamental trigger to activate resonance and synergies for all other relics in the addon.

- Crushing Gauntlets

Slot: Hands
Core Function: A heavy accessory built for raw power. It passively grants permanent Strength and Haste effects, with their amplification levels scaling directly with the artifact's generated Item Quality (up to Strength IV and Haste VI for perfect 5.0/5 quality!).
Kinetic Resonance (Synergy): When equipped alongside the Cogwheel Heart, your hands mimic functional Crushing Wheels. Mining any ore blocks is intercepted: vanilla drops are canceled, replaced by Create's Crushed Raw Ores scaled by a custom stat multiplier, with a 40% chance to spawn Create Experience Nuggets.
Compatibility: Features full dynamic ID parsing to support custom ores from third-party mods (Thermal, Mekanism, etc.) and naturally respects the Silk Touch enchantment.

- Warping Belt

Slot: Belt
Core Function: A high-tech accessory designed for space manipulation and automated logistics. Controls movement velocity, conveyor belt logic, and instant resource translocation.

- Sailcloth cape

Slot: Back
Passive ability: Accumulates air energy when moving quickly
Active ability: slows down the fall by using up stored energy

- Chief goggles:
Improved Engineer Goggles from Create that show rotation direction, speed, power consumption, and maximum available power

- Induction heating core:
accumulates thermal energy near a heat source and uses it to smelt ores in the inventory

- Gearshift Torque Boots:
   An innovative engineering artifact for the footwear slot (Boots) that merges the advanced kinetic system mechanics of the Create mod with the deep progression and constellation system of the Relics API. ⚙️ 1. Mechanical Gearbox (Transmission) Added the "Torque Transmission" ability featuring 4 switchable movement modes via the radial menu: 1st Gear: Protective: Reduces the engineer's movement speed by 30%. In return, it grants constant protection (dynamically distributing incoming damage into armor durability) and resiliently knocks back attacking enemies. Puffs of smoke escape from under the soles during sprints. 2nd Gear: Standard: The default operating mode. Player physics and movement speed remain completely vanilla. 3rd Gear: High-Speed: Extreme acceleration that scales directly with the Torque Efficiency statistic. Recoil Mechanics: Crashing into a wall (or any full block at eye or leg level) while sprinting interrupts movement and inflicts impact damage on the player. 4th Gear: Reverse: A unique, fun mode. Completely inverts client-side WASD movement inputs. 🛑 2. Mechanical Handbrake System Added the "Mechanical Handbrake" utility ability with switchable Enabled (On) / Disabled (Off) states: Absolute Anchor: When enabled, sneaking (Shift) completely wipes out movement impulses on both the client and server. The player becomes entirely unmovable by external forces (such as explosions, moving Create conveyor belts, or water currents). Hydraulic Exhaust: Slamming the brakes at high velocity (while sprinting on 3rd gear) unleashes critical sparks and generates a powerful kinetic shockwave that repels all nearby mobs within a 4-block radius. Fortified Buff: While holding the handbrake, the player receives a hidden gradual healing effect (Regeneration I) and 40% absorption against any incoming damage at the cost of armor durability.

📈 Progression & RPG Mechanics

Dynamic Item Quality: Every discovered relic rolls an individual quality stat (0.0 to 5.0). This metric permanently defines the baseline power of your passive potion effects.
Custom Constellations: Unlock full research trees matching Create's aesthetic (e.g., the beautiful 12-star interlocking crushing wheel node design for the gauntlets).
True Leveling Experience: Earn direct relic experience by interacting with the world using logic-based sources, such as mining matching ore tags.



📦 Requirements & Dependencies

Platform: NeoForge
Game Version: Minecraft 1.21.1
Required Mods:
Relics (by SSKirillSS)
Create
Curios API



🔒 Modpack Policy

You are completely free to include this mod in any public or private modpacks hosted on CurseForge. Giving credit to the author is highly appreciated!

title: Redstone Witch [Lite]
description: Redstone Witch is a modpack focused on preserving the gameloop of survival Redstone/technical minecraft, while still adding lots of modded content

**Redstone Witch is a modpack focused on preserving the gameloop of survival Redstone/technical minecraft, while still adding a plethora of content like any other modpack.**

**!!! MODPACK REQUIRES JAVA 21 & LATEST FABRIC !!!** vvv

**Modrinth will default the profile to JAVA 17, you will need to manually change it to get the modpack to work**

**!!! MODPACK REQUIRES JAVA 21 & LATEST FABRIC !!!** ^^^

![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/63fb326355bf5bfb29685db8aee3d679c8cafdfc_0.webp)

Many 'Vanilla+' modpacks out there add too much to the game that usually result in Redstone becoming redundant due to additions like Create or AE2, or seedmaps being unusable due to mods like Terralith. While there is good gameplay to be found within those mods, this modpack aims to be the alternative. 
- **No Quest Book**
- **No Insane World Generation** (seedmaps/cubiomes are mostly usable [wont show modded features])
- **No Crazy Amount of Structures** 
- **Minimal Storage Changes** (nether chests, inmis backpacks, scout)
- **No Durability** - Mending and Unbreaking 3 are no longer a crutch!
- **Keep Some Inventory** - keep tools/weapons/food on death; lose resources on death
- **1.8 Combat** - with Golden Age Combat mod [remove it if you want post-1.9 combat]

Mods have been chosen to only add fluff to the game. No major mechanic changes or shortcuts for farming. Some little mechanic changes are present however, Birch trees can generate with 'branches' so something like Cubicmetre's omnifarm would instead use the Acacia option while farming birch trees, as the branches would break the block stream. !! title: Chaos Mod - Beatable
description: A beatable Minecraft Chaos Mod datapack with 30+ unique effects, where a new random chaos event triggers every 30 seconds to keep gameplay fun, unpredictable, and fair.
body:
# Minecraft Chaos Mod - Beatable
Chaos Mod transforms Minecraft into a constantly changing challenge by triggering a new random chaos effect every 30 seconds. With over 30 unique effects, no two playthroughs are ever the same. You might be struck by lightning, have your hotbar shuffled, lose hunger, get launched into the air with low gravity, face a sudden mob ambush, or watch random blocks around you change unexpectedly.

### TO START - /trigger chaos_start
### TO STOP - /trigger chaos_stop

Despite the chaos, the mod is designed to remain fully beatable and balanced. Effects are meant to create fun and unpredictable moments without making survival impossible. Whether you're playing solo or with friends, Chaos Mod adds nonstop variety and excitement to every Minecraft world.

### Features
- A new random chaos effect triggers every 30 seconds.
- 30+ chaos effects are available, including Lightning, Hotbar Shuffle, Mob Ambush, Hunger Drain, and Random Blocks.
- Multiplayer support, with all players affected at the same time.
- Beatable and balanced gameplay designed to stay fun, unpredictable, and fair.

![Complete the Parkour](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/77233c0570edc38e86019a8e7a9453c12e8a886f.png)

### 📦 Installation
This is a Datapack - no mods required.

1. Download the .zip file
2. Open Minecraft and navigate to your world's folder
   - %appdata%\.minecraft\saves\<YourWorldName>\ on Windows
   - ~/Library/Application Support/minecraft/saves/<YourWorldName>/ on macOS
3. Drop the .zip directly into the datapacks folder (do not unzip it)
4. Launch your world and run /reload if the world is already open
5. Watch for the Bebu load message in chat, you're live!

### ❓ FAQ
Q: Does this work with Fabric or Forge mods?

A: Yes. It's a vanilla datapack and runs alongside any mods without conflict.


Q: Can I use this on a server?

A: Absolutely. It's designed with multiplayer in mind.


Q: Does it work on existing worlds?

A: Yes. Simply add the datapack to an existing world and reload.

title: Botania Slots
description: A Quality-of-Life mod that adds dedicated Curios slots for your Mana Tablets and Rings, decluttering your inventory and reducing server lag.
body:
**Botania Slot** is a Quality-of-Life (QoL) and utility mod for Minecraft Forge that changes how you carry your mana. Instead of keeping Mana Tablets and Mana Rings taking up space in your main inventory, you can now equip them in dedicated curios slots!

---

## Overview

If you play with Botania, you know the struggle of keeping Mana Tablets, Bands of Aura, or Mana Rings in your inventory at all times just to keep your tools working.

This mod integrates directly with the **Curios API** to give you specific slots meant *only* for your mana items. It declutters your inventory, keeps your mana sources organized, and as a great bonus, makes the game run smoother.

---

## Features

* **Dedicated Mana Slots**: Adds two exclusive "Botania Mana" accessory slots to your Curios menu (identified by the Charm icon).
* **Equip Your Tablets**: You can now safely equip your **Mana Tablets** and **Mana Rings** directly into these new slots, freeing up your main inventory for loot and blocks.
* **Smart Filtering**: The custom slots are strictly filtered. Only valid mana-bearing items can be placed inside them, preventing you from accidentally storing the wrong items.
* **Performance Bonus**: Normally, Botania scans all 36 slots of your inventory every tick to find mana. By forcing the game to only check these two specific Curios slots, it drastically reduces CPU usage and server lag, making it a must-have for large modpacks.

---

## Technical Specifications

* **Minecraft Version**: 1.20.1
* **Mod Loader**: Forge 47.4.10+
* **Required Dependency**: [Curios API 5.4.1+](https://modrinth.com/mod/curios) and [Botania](https://modrinth.com/mod/botania)
* **Environment**: Client and Server

title: CleanerX
description: A filtering plugin that censors offensive language, with options to block links and automatically punish offenders.
body:
# CleanerX

CleanerX is an advanced plugin designed to filter and replace inappropriate language with censored alternatives or remove it entirely, ensuring a clean and respectful gaming environment. It allows you to configure automatic execution of commands, for example, to punish players who repeatedly use offensive language after a specified number of infractions. The plugin also blocks the ability to send links in chat, and if needed, you can clear the chat with a simple command.


## 🔹 Features

- ✅ Partial or complete word censorship depending on configuration
- ✅ Ability to block unwanted links
- ✅ Add custom words to the blacklist via command without needing to restart the server
- ✅ Add custom words to the whitelist via command without needing to restart the server
- ✅ Automatic execution of commands based on configuration – recommended integration with PunisherX
- ✅ Ability to clear chat using a command
- ✅ Plugin update notifications with an option to enable automatic updates
- ✅ Extensive configuration file for flexible settings. Check the default settings [here](https://github.com/SyntaxDevTeam/CleanerX/blob/main/src/main/resources/config.yml)
- ✅ Multi-language support via `messages_xx.yml` files

## ⚙️ Technical Information

- 🟢 **Designed for the latest Minecraft versions 1.20.6–1.21.4+**
- 🟢 **Optimized for Paper and its forks (Pufferfish, Purpur, Leaves)**
- 🟢 **Requires Java 21 or newer**
- 🟢 **Written in Kotlin – a modern, expressive, and safer alternative to Java**

If you have any questions, you might find answers on our [Discord](https://discord.gg/Q343kjA2YP).

## 🛠️ Commands and Permissions
| Command                               | Permission               | Description                                        |
|---------------------------------------|--------------------------|----------------------------------------------------|
| `/whitelistx <add/remove/list>`        | `cleanerx.cmd.whitelist` | Adds, removes or displays words from the whitelist |
| `/blacklistx <add/remove/list>`        | `cleanerx.cmd.blacklist` | Adds, removes or displays words from the blacklist |
| `/cleanx`                              | `cleanerx.cmd.clean`     | Clears the in-game chat                            |
| `/cleanerx reset <player>` or `/crx reset <player>`        | `cleanerx.cmd.crx`       | Resets swear counter for player
| `/cleanerx help` or `/crx help`       | `cleanerx.cmd.crx`       | Displays a list of available commands              |
| `/cleanerx reload` or `/crx reload`   | `cleanerx.cmd.crx`    | Reloads the configuration file.                    |
| `/cleanerx version` or `/crx version` | `cleanerx.cmd.crx`   | Shows plugin info                                  |

## 📥 Download

- **The latest stable version is available on Hangar:**  [![Available on Hangar](https://img.shields.io/hangar/dt/CleanerX)](https://hangar.papermc.io/SyntaxDevTeam/CleanerX)
- **You can also build the latest development version from:**  [![Available on GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub.com-CleanerX-green)](https://github.com/SyntaxDevTeam/CleanerX)

## 🚀 Installation

1. Download the latest version of the plugin from the release section.
2. Place the JAR file into the `plugins` folder on your server.
3. Start your Minecraft server.
4. **Configuration:**  
   Open the `config.yml` file to customize settings such as the list of banned words or full censorship mode.

## 📞 Contact

If you have any questions or need support, feel free to reach out on our [Discord](https://discord.gg/Q343kjA2YP) or send us a direct message.

## 📜 License

This plugin is available under the **MIT License**. You can find the details in the LICENSE file.

---

**Thank you for using CleanerX! I hope it meets your expectations. 😊**

title: Bedrock Ore-UI JE
description: Why has the Java Edition interface remained unchanged for over ten years? If you find it boring, why not try Bedrock Ore-UI JE! It makes the interface similar to the Bedrock Edition while making no major changes to the original.
body:
# Bedrock Ore-UI JE Resource Pack - Full Introduction

## I. Core Overview
If you've grown tired of the native interface of Minecraft: Java Edition, which has remained largely unchanged with no core overhauls for over a decade, and are fed up with the fragmented gameplay experience brought by its outdated, cramped, and visually rigid GUI design, then **Bedrock Ore-UI JE** is the GUI optimization resource pack built specifically for you.

Developed exclusively for Minecraft: Java Edition players, this resource pack takes the modern interface design of Bedrock Edition as its core reference. While 100% preserving the native operation logic of Java Edition and without altering players' long-established gameplay habits, it has carried out meticulous remastering, optimization, and style unification for the full-scene UI interface in the game.

We uphold the core principles of minimalist style and vanilla compatibility, rejecting redundant and flashy invalid designs. We only focus on the visual comfort, information readability, and operational convenience of the interface, allowing Java Edition players to experience a fresh, modern, and non-fragmented new interface without switching game versions. At the same time, it does not damage the immersion of the vanilla game at all, and has zero impact on game performance.

## II. Core Design Philosophy
### 1. Vanilla-First Design, Zero Learning Curve for Onboarding
We always adhere to the core principle of "optimization without overwriting". All interface optimizations only upgrade the visual style, and fully retain the functional layout, operation logic, and interactive habits of the native Java Edition interface.

Whether you are a veteran player who has been playing for years, or a new player who has just been exposed to Java Edition, you can get started directly with zero learning cost. There will be no operational errors or inability to find functions due to interface changes, and the visual renewal of the interface is completed without changing your gameplay habits.

### 2. Modern Bedrock Edition Style Porting, Say Goodbye to Outdated Interfaces
Aiming at the pain point of the long-term solidified style of the native Java Edition interface, we have deeply referred to the well-received flat and modern UI design system of Bedrock Edition. We fully port the rounded design, fresh color matching logic, and orderly typography layout of the Bedrock Edition interface to Java Edition, and at the same time carry out exclusive optimization combined with the interface characteristics of Java Edition.

This allows the interface experience of the two editions to achieve a seamless connection, bringing a brand-new visual experience to Java Edition players.

### 3. Minimalist Style, Focus on the Gameplay Itself
This resource pack focuses on the integration of minimalist style and vanilla style, rejecting over-design and gaudy decorative elements. All visual optimizations are carried out around "reducing visual fatigue and improving information acquisition efficiency".

We have optimized the contrast, size ratio, and white space layout of interface elements, eliminated redundant visual interference in the native interface, so that players can focus more on the game content itself. Even if you play continuously for a long time, you will not experience eye fatigue due to the cluttered interface vision.

### 4. Lightweight with No Burden, Full Scenario Compatibility
As a pure GUI interface resource pack, Bedrock Ore-UI JE only modifies the interface-related material content in the game, and does not change any non-UI game content such as blocks, entities, shaders, sound effects, etc. The file size is extremely small, with zero impact on game frame rate and loading speed, and it can run perfectly and smoothly even on low-configuration computers.

At the same time, the extremely lightweight design also gives it extremely strong compatibility. It can be freely matched with the vast majority of resource packs, shaders, and mods without content conflicts.

## III. Full-Scene UI Optimization Coverage, A Seamless All-Round Refreshed Experience
Bedrock Ore-UI JE has carried out comprehensive and full-coverage remastering and optimization of the UI interface of Minecraft: Java Edition, covering every interactive scene in the player's gameplay process, truly achieving "optimization and refreshment everywhere".

### 1. Full Overhaul of the Main Menu & Core Entry Interfaces
We have completed a complete style unification and optimization of the full-process main interface after the game is launched, including:
- The main menu interface after game launch, with optimized button styles, font typography and background adaptation, making the main interface cleaner and more orderly;
- Singleplayer & Multiplayer selection interfaces, world creation and management interfaces, with optimized list layout, button spacing and information display, making it easier and faster to browse and manage your game worlds;
- Settings interface series, including video settings, audio settings, control settings, language settings and other sub-interfaces, we have re-adjusted the option layout, slider style and toggle button design, making the parameter adjustment process more intuitive and efficient, and reducing the probability of misoperation;
- Resource pack & shader pack management interfaces, optimized preview window layout and list sorting, making it easier to sort and manage your installed resource packs.

### 2. In-Game HUD & Core Gameplay Interface Optimization
We have carried out targeted optimization for the core in-game interfaces that players are exposed to the most during gameplay, including:
![The interface closely replicates the Bedrock Edition UI and uses a dark mode, giving it a very sleek appearance.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/793217175f0f5fd9a3ac2eaddae0e3971f619627_0.webp)health bar, hunger bar, experience bar, armor bar, hotbar, and crosshair, with optimized size ratio, color contrast and display logic, ensuring that the core information is clear at a glance while reducing visual occlusion of the game screen;
- Inventory interface, including player survival inventory, creative inventory, recipe book interface, with optimized item grid layout, tooltip style, and category tab design, restoring the clean and tidy item management experience of Bedrock Edition;
- All interactive container interfaces, including chests, double chests, ender chests, shulker boxes, furnaces, blast furnaces, smokers, brewing stands, enchanting tables, anvils, crafting tables, looms, cartography tables, and all other functional block interfaces, with unified rounded style, optimized slot layout and background contrast, making the item interaction process more comfortable;
- Player combat & interaction related interfaces, including the trading interface with villagers, the horse riding interface, the boat control interface, the spectator mode menu, and the advancement/achievement interface, all of which have been fully remastered to maintain a unified modern style.

### 3. Prompt & Status Interface Unification
We have also optimized all the prompt and status pop-up interfaces in the game to eliminate the visual fragmentation of the native interface, including:
- Game over/respawn interface, with optimized text layout and button design, reducing the sense of abruptness of the native interface;
- Loading screen & chunk generation progress interface, with optimized progress bar style and text display;
- Chat & command input interface, including chat box style, message display format, and command prompt window, optimized for better readability in both singleplayer and multiplayer scenarios;
- System prompt pop-ups, disconnect prompts, pack loading failure prompts, and other system notification interfaces, all unified into the modern rounded style, maintaining visual consistency throughout the game.

## IV. Compatibility & Usage Instructions
### 1. Supported Game Versions
This resource pack officially supports the following Minecraft: Java Edition versions:
- Full support for 1.21.x full series official releases
- Compatibility support for 26.1 snapshot versions

We will continue to update and adapt to the latest official releases and snapshot versions of Minecraft: Java Edition to ensure long-term availability.

### 2. Installation & Usage Guide
1. Download the latest version of the Bedrock Ore-UI JE resource pack file from this page;
2. Open Minecraft: Java Edition, enter the main menu, and click `Options` > `Resource Packs`;
3. Click `Open Pack Folder`, and drag the downloaded resource pack .zip file into the opened folder (do not unzip the file);
4. After the resource pack appears in the "Available" list, click the arrow to add it to the "Selected" list;
5. Move this resource pack to the top of the "Selected" list to ensure that its GUI style takes effect first;

title: Pet Compass
description: Never lose your pets again! Track and find your animals easily.
body:
# 🐾 Pet Compass

Never lose your beloved pets again!

**Pet Compass** is a simple yet powerful utility mod that introduces a new item to help you track and locate your tamed animals across the world. Whether it's a dog left sitting in a forest or a cat exploring a village, the Pet Compass will guide you straight to them.

## ✨ Features

*   **Pet List GUI**: Right-click the compass to see a list of all your tamed pets, including their name, type, distance, and coordinates.
*   **Tracking Mode**: Select a pet to track, and the compass needle will point towards it (just like a vanilla compass points to spawn).
*   **Visual Indicators**: A glowing outline highlights your tracked pet when you get close and hold the compass, making them easy to spot even through blocks or in the dark.
*   **Cross-Dimensional**: Works across dimensions! The compass will tell you if your pet is in the Nether or End.
*   **HUD Display**: Shows the distance and target name on your screen while holding the compass.
*   **Mod Compatibility**: Works with modded pets from other mods (like Alex's Mobs, etc.) as long as they are tameable!

## 🛠️ Recipe

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_372de527-46fd-4f98-ac67-a7a608db7302.png)![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_fd9cb536-eb9a-43ff-995e-dc38f02f75e1.png)

## 🎮 How to use

1.  **Craft** the Pet Compass.
2.  **Right-click** to open the selection menu.
3.  **Click** on the pet you want to find.
4.  **Follow the compass!** The needle points to your pet.
5.  **Shift + Right-click** to reset the tracking.

## 🏆 Achievements

*   **Where Is My Pet?**: Find a lost pet that was over 100 blocks away!

**Craftable Trident** is a lightweight, no-nonsense Fabric mod designed to bring back something Minecraft should’ve had years ago:

Stop waiting for drowned to drop it like you’re begging for loot charity.

Everything integrates into a dedicated **Craftable Trident Item Group**, clean and intuitive.

This mod keeps the game balanced:

* You earn the real trident through effort, not RNG.
* Recipe difficulty aligns with mid-game progression.
* Works in any Fabric-based pack as a drop-in solution.

body: The Black Knife is a multi‑mode legendary blade — press R/G to cycle moves (the active move is shown in the tooltip) and right‑click to perform the selected ability; hold Shift and right‑click to begin charging Swoon Attack. While held in your main hand it raises your max HP to 40, continuously refreshes Regeneration III, Speed II and Haste V, and grants +10 extra weapon damage; there’s also a 30% reactive slash chance that spawns a retaliatory blade when you’re hit. Available moves: Black Swords summons five swords that sequentially lunge and actively follow the target; Board Rend fires five timed forward shots over ~2 seconds that explode into left/right shard sprays (with a ~30% chance of a full 360° burst); Knife Hallway fires five quick bursts; Circling Knives are very fast orbiting blades that slash rapidly on touch; Sanguine Slash shoots one arrow then a series of slashes that accelerate; Final STARS spawns stars in a 7–10 block ring that slowly pull inward, then briefly push outward and explode into non‑homing shards (touching stars hurts). The new Parry move is selectable—right‑click to activate a 1‑second reflect window that negates damage and turns incoming projectiles into homing counter shards; note Swoon charging is interrupted if you’re hit while charging.

# Description
**Start Making** is unique mod-pack created to simplify the process of developing maps and datapacks in Minecraft, as well as partially resource packs. It includes a number of powerful tools and mods to help you focus on your creativity and quickly create interesting content.
#### Why Start Making is worth downloading.
This mod pack offers unique tools that greatly simplify content creation in Minecraft. If you want to focus on creativity and quickly develop maps and datapacks, “Start Making” is the perfect solution for you.
## Main Functions:

1. There is a menu with web generators and one built-in one
2. In the inventory there are Advanced World Settings, there you can prescribe Waypoint, Script from commands, Import scorbords and game rules.
3. Notes in which you can write your plans for the day or tips as notes appear in pause and many other menus (selected randomly).
4. In the worlds menu there is a button to select the folder where the worlds are saved.
5. Textures of the game you can change in the game itself!
6. There is an error display datapacks
7. There is a template datapack and resource-pack
8. There is a menu where you can write your nickname (From Modrinth,CurseForge,PlanetMinecraft) or insert a link click on the button to open the site.
9. In Axiom added different blueprints,brush scripts,schematics.
10. Mod-pack is well optimized.

it features:

title: MCPF
description: A mod adding new items and a unique leveling system
body:
**MCPF Mod**

This mod is designed for players looking for longer gaming experiences. I’m one of those players, and after defeating the dragon, I don’t have much to do, so I stop playing on that save. My mod offers gameplay that lasts at least a dozen hours of acquiring new weapons, tools, and other items to enhance the gameplay. It also introduces new challenges, such as battling new enemies and bosses


The mod is a fusion of my favorite universes from games and movies. It’s also a combination of all the mods I’ve released so far because it was created before them. All the mods I’ve released to date have borrowed solutions from it

[**Attention! This mod requires the installation of another modification called AttributeFix[link]**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/attributefix)


## [**I credit all the creators whose work I used in my mod under this link. Thank you all once again!**](https://amibartek.com/mcpf-main-paige/mcpf-creators/)


### What exactly does the mod offer?
## Special leveling system
By pressing the G key, you can open the menu where your current level is displayed. To increase your level, defeat more enemies

![Main menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1de7e3b2bef9c5685b6708205366f9bce6e26f44.webp)


## 25 different melee weapons with a new damage mechanic
The mod offers 6 sets of melee weapons, each set unlocking at a specific level

![Sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2896094a85a6d6c81a4ea6022463e3dfe91ba695.webp)
![Sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2a0eba4780f0759061c1cd55c6d9ecc7ade27ca9.webp)
![Sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/56891808684f1f9884a0d4c4fe6d0e7b52e80e76.webp)

## 20 different firearms and other thrown weapons
In the mod, the higher your level, the greater terror you can unleash with firearms. Starting from classic pistols and rifles, and ending with miniguns, flamethrowers, and homing rocket launchers

![Rifle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5c8b8a44b7078ef51bec5125004e06bdb2c02b51.webp)
![Minigun](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/40cedb2e61b84ad2b8ad5b1bb1260ea5029a1835.webp)
![Shotgun](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ff674ce595e515029c622cd63f04504656e824e4.webp)
![Javelin](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d6ee3da37747402f3b703041e3110cc94a3bfde0.webp)

## 10 different elixirs
At some point, you are able to learn how to brew potions and drink them without killing yourself. They provide powerful bonuses to the player, making it easier to defeat enemies

## Many new vehicles
In the mod, you can create tanks, agricultural machinery, tractors, or cars. Everyone will find something for themselves; you can cultivate wheat, drive a car, or destroy enemies using tanks

![Car](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e4bd0a9cbc255c68f6efd34c89a782bfd2d8e646.webp)
![Tks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/751d971e62792a55e6f4e5dd650a040181012a1c.webp)
![Tractor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1ec4b103d93ea94882b2cc0a2b8b8ab60e2f9ac0.webp)


![Vehicles](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fac6f79c064a8f049544c3f0ab6b3abb3a827914.webp)

## 14 types of new ores
In the mod, there is a variety of ores found in different parts of the world. Additionally, there is a smelting furnace where you can mix these ores to obtain further metal derivatives

![Ores](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/133feef4e0c0b0a255e487838de1f759e72a738f.webp)

## 16 different types of functional machines/blocks
In the mod, there are various machines available, such as an air compressor for filling air tanks, a refinery for producing various products from oil, a generator for generating electricity, and a whole bunch of other machines

## Dragon coins
In the mod, there is a special currency called Dragon Coins that you can use to buy new weapons, construction schematics, armor, materials, vehicles, and many other things. You can earn Dragon Coins by selling heads of defeated enemies, selling grain, selling materials, or looting safes of defeated enemies

## A huge variety of new enemies
The higher your level, the more challenging enemies you can encounter. The enemies available in the mod are truly diverse; you can encounter knights, bandits, hussars, soldiers, mages, paladins, assassins, cursed beings, and so on

![Enemies](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1d0e8be665a7c0c1fbf033de23aaf665905de881.webp)

## 16 different types of manual tools, plus 3 electric tools
Besides the 6 sets of weapons available at specific levels, the same applies to tools. In the mod, you can craft a whole variety of picks, shovels, axes, and hoes. Additionally, at higher levels, you'll be able to make chainsaws or mining drills

![Chainsaw](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/33969cf6011c571ea8909128c6c0daef27eaa596.webp)


## New armor repair system
In my mod, no weapon is completely destroyed. If the durability of a tool/weapon/armor part drops to 0, you can repair it where it was created

## 9 new types of armor
In addition to having better tools and weapons, you gain the ability to create increasingly effective armor

![Armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2b465d98db8a4056b71f32e35c1875fec9335e40.webp)

## Many new structures filled with enemies
You'll find here knights' castles, military bases, magical fortresses, castles, desert cities, towers, and much more

![Castle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e6450054c0ef63d3625bd9126454107688b9a640.webp)
![Castle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c67caa4e041d8aa820998b5a096448a691385b17.webp)


## And a whole bunch of other things!


[Minecraft MCPF mod - All weapones showcase](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3o3JsZRujA4&ab_channel=Bartek)

[MCPF mod - Vehicles guide](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6_1qKyqnPP4&t=138s&ab_channel=Bartek)

[Minecraft - MCPF Mod - All workstations showcase](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zPyqgvEIqOY&t=44s&ab_channel=Bartek)

[MCPF Minigun Guide](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Rc8JCokAUzg&t=13s&ab_channel=Bartek)

[MCPF Mod - Harvesting Wheat](https://youtu.be/MbRVcdaV5F4?si=iQB-BQb0UuiB86-i)

[MCPF Mod - Javelin guide](https://youtu.be/nxKKK9KzUiM?si=kGnFuC8-6AFfLA2g)


In the mod, there’s a special leveling system that increases as you defeat progressively tougher enemies. With each unlocked level, you gain access to more powerful and gameplay-enhancing items, weapons, vehicles, tools, machines, armor, and much more. The complete list of items you unlock as you progress in the game is available[​here]



The mod is really extensive, so to make it easier to find information, I’m providing links to useful resources that will help you navigate the world of MCPF
If you don’t find a topic below that addresses your concern, feel free to ask me a question at rojdanbw@gmail.com

title: CustomClientBlocker
description: A simple plugin that kicks player using specific client brand
body:
# CustomClientBlocker

A simple plugin that kicks player using specific client brand

## Usage

### Configuration

You can configure this plugin by editing `plugins/CustomClientBlocker/config.yml`

```yaml
# The list of clients to block
blacklist:
  - forge
# Kick message
kickMessage: Using %client% is not allowed!
```

### Commands

The base command is `/clientblocker` or `/ccb`

And base permission is `customclientblocker.command`

| Command | Description                                      | Permission                                                                     |
|---------|--------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| players | Lists players, but the connected client is shown | `customclientblocker.command.players`                                          |
| list    | Lists which clients are blocked                  | `customclientblocker.command.list`                                             |
| block   | Adds an entry to client blacklist                | `customclientblocker.command.block` or `customclientblocker.command.modify`    |
| unblock | Removes an entry to client blacklist             | `customclientblocker.command.unblock`  or `customclientblocker.command.modify` |
| reload  | Reloads the setting from config file             | `customclientblocker.command.reload`                                           |

### Bypassing specific players

You can add an except by adding permission `customclientblocker.bypass` to a player

title: Makkit
description: An intuitive world editor for creative mode!
body:
# Makkit

### An in-world editor for Minecraft.

Makkit (pronounced Make-it) is a lightweight creative mod world
editing tool, made for Fabric on Minecraft v1.16+. It's meant to make
a lot of simple operations quicker, while being easy to use!

#### You can read the **[User Guide Here](https://github.com/ejektaflex/Makkit/blob/master/docs/USERGUIDE.md)**!


### Features

* In world editing, with realtime selection boxes
* You can view each other's selections in Multiplayer, too!
* The ability to **move** and **resize** selections with a mouse, no commands or keybinds needed!
* Simple transformations, like **filling** entire selections with 
blocks (or just the walls!)
* The ability to **copy** and **paste** selections, even along a different
axis to **rotate** them
* The ability to mirror your selections over an axis, allowing you
to easily create roofing and other symmetric structures
* A pattern tool, which lets you **tile** blocks or **repeat** them 
in a certain direction
* Edit history, letting you **undo** and **redo** at will!

### Installation

This mod requires [Fabric API](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fabric-api) and [Fabric Language Kotlin](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fabric-language-kotlin). If you want to customize your experience, add in [Mod Menu](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/modmenu)!

### Beta

Makkit is still in Beta, so there might be some niche bugs. I try to test
everything extensively before each release, so releases should be quite
stable. Even if something does go wrong, you can always press undo!


### What about Feature "X"?

While Makkit intends to make creative mode editing easier, it can't do
everything. It tries to do most common world editing features in a very
intuitive way, but it isn't a replacement for other creative mods like 
[WorldEdit](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/worldedit).
Rather, you should use them both together!

In the future, I plan on adding some compatibility with WorldEdit (e.g. 
letting your selection box act as a WorldEdit selection box). Stay tuned!


### Fabric?

Yes, this mod is for Fabric & Fabric API. I don't intend or have
time to maintain a version for both Forge and Fabric. This mod
also does some things that would be hard to do with Forge. 
However, if someone
would like to do a pull request with their own implementation
(written in Kotlin) in a separate branch, I'd be willing
to release a Forge version!
