body:
# Survival Campfire

With this **Fabric** mod you'll need to feed your campfire if you want it to keep burning. 

Here is a small bushcraft introduction for beginners :
- Build a campfire as usual
- Put some fuel in the campfire. Any kind of fuel that can be used in a furnace can be used to maintain your campfire. 
- Ignite it with a flint & steel
- Add fuel to your heart's content to keep the darkness away
- Contemplate life with your friends as you bathe in the sweet warmth of a welcoming hearth

The campfire's light level and model changes depending on the amount of fuel left, to provide you with some visual feedback. Resource packs that change the model of the campfire are probably not compatible, but textures should work fine. This mod does not affect soul campfires.

You can configure the max amount of fuel that can be stored in a campfire and the factor by which vanilla fuel furnace values are multiplied when applied to a campfire. Config is available in-game through [YACL](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl) and [ModMenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu).  

Meant to be used with mods such as [Healing Campfire](https://modrinth.com/mod/healing-campfire/version/1.19.2-4.0-fabric) and [No Hostiles Around Campfire](https://modrinth.com/mod/no-hostiles-around-campfire).

- [Fabric Language Kotlin](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin/version/1.8.1%2Bkotlin.1.7.0)

But I'm using it in my own worlds for what it's worth. This mod will never be ported to Forge as [alternatives](https://github.com/cech12/UnlitCampfire) already exist.

Special thanks to the **Fabric Discord Server**, especially @LlamaLad7 and @justanothercorpusguy, for helping me. Thanks to [Serilium](https://modrinth.com/user/Serilum) for involuntary prompting the making of this mod. - Glass -> Tempered Glass

- Tempered Glass -> 2x Tempered Glass Slab, 4x Tempered Glass Pane, or 6x Tempered Glass Dowel

body:
# RustedIron

## by FireNH

A Minecraft Mod built on the Fabric Toolchain for Minecraft 1.18.1 to add in the ability for iron blocks placed in the world to rust. Also adds in new slabs and stair variants for iron! Pretty simple mod overall.

Iron rusts in four stages just like copper, with the stages being known internally as Unaffected (normal), Exposed, Weathered, and Rusted (similar to Oxidized for copper). Axes can scrape layers of rust or wax away, and it can be waxed to prevent further rusting. 

Iron also has new slab and stair variants which can also rust, be waxed, and be scraped by axes.

All iron blocks (waxed and not) can also be converted back into nine iron ingots through crafting.

*Requires Fabric API*

## Contributions

Thank you to Toilet-Man on GitHub (https://github.com/Toilet-Man) for providing shader support! This change adds appropriate shininess to the rusted iron textures in shaders such as SEUS PTGI.

title: Zeo's Click Bot
description: Play click and keyboard sounds ingame! The most realistic clickbot mod for Minecraft.
body:
# ZCB Live for Minecraft

ZCB Live had a long history of being a [Geometry Dash only mod](https://geode-sdk.org/mods/zeozeozeo.zcblive). Today we are expanding the horizons of what's possible with Minecraft modding, and bringing the untamed power of ZCB Live to Minecraft!

ZCB Live is a next-generation Minecraft clickbot. What it does is replicate the sound of a mouse and keyboard in the most realistic manner possible. Whether you're recording intense PvP matches, filming Bedwars highlights, or just playing casually, ZCB is designed to deliver an unforgettable Minecraft experience.

## Features

*   Incredibly easy to use
*   [ClickpackDB](https://zeozeozeo.github.io/clickpack-db) integration: download more than 800 clickpacks without ever leaving the game. We owe the Geometry Dash community for this one.
*   Realistic click sound algorithm: pitch variation, volume changes, softclick/microclick/hardclick timings
*   Keyboard timing can be tracked per row or per hand, with per-row as the default

## Minecraft clickpacks

ZCB Live supports the GD `player1` / `player2` / `*clicks` / `*releases` layout and an optional new Minecraft format:

```
pack/
  player1/ # can also be `clicks`, `softclicks`, ... for mouse only
  player2/ # can also be `releases`, `softreleases`, ... for mouse only
  keyboard/
    row1/
    row2/
    row3/
    row4/
    special/
      spacebar/
      backspace/
      enter/
      tab/
      modifiers/
      navigation/
      function/
      numpad/
      other/ # fallback for special keys if the corresponding folder above is not present
  mouse/
    side/ # fallback for side keys if the corresponding folder below is not present
    side4/
    side5/
```

Each of the new Minecraft folders use the same softclicks/microclicks/clicks folder structure under the hood, except hardclicks/hardreleases are ignored. You don't have to fill all the folders, for missing folders inside the `mouse` and `keyboard/special` folders the clickbot will first choose fallback sounds from `mouse/side` or `keyboard/special/other` -> if that is also missing fallback sounds are for regular mouse clicks or keyboard

## Screenshots

![The ClickpackDB menu](https://github.com/zeozeozeo/zcblive-mc/blob/main/media/db.png?raw=true) ![Configurable clicks volume](https://github.com/zeozeozeo/zcblive-mc/blob/main/media/sound.png?raw=true)

## Discord

Join the Discord server for support on ZCB and a way to create and submit your own clickpacks: [https://discord.gg/BRVVVzxESu](https://discord.gg/BRVVVzxESu)

title: Hide Names
description: 🏷️ HideTag is a lightweight plugin that lets players hide or show their own nametag, while admins can instantly toggle nametags for the entire server.
body:
![HideTag](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/db4b06ce661590a9e7a46b6bcbff566ca3ced079.png)

**HideTag** gives your server a simple way to control player nametags: players can hide or show their own name, and staff can run hide-all or show-all for everyone who is online at that moment. Those staff commands are not a lock — after a bulk, anyone can still use `/hidename` or `/showname` as they like. ![Before and after image of hidden playernames!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ff8bbed9de387c625c5a43e862522e720578e34a.png) ## 🚀 Features - ⚡ Lightweight & fast - 🧩 No config needed - 👤 Personal nametag toggle for all players - 🛡️ Bulk hide/show for staff (all online players; not a permanent lock) - ✅ One jar, Java 8 bytecode — runs on Bukkit / Spigot / Paper / Purpur / Folia --- ## 💬 Commands - `/hidetag help` → Show command help - `/hidename` → Hide your own nametag - `/showname` → Show your own nametag - `/hideallnames` *(OP / permission)* → Hide every online player’s nametag (bulk) - `/showallnames` *(OP / permission)* → Show every online player’s nametag (bulk) --- ## 🔐 Permissions - `hidetag.help` *(default: true)* - `hidename.use` *(default: true)* - `showname.use` *(default: true)* - `hideallnames.use` *(default: op)* - `showallnames.use` *(default: op)* --- ## 📊 Metrics & privacy ![bStats chart](https://bstats.org/signatures/bukkit/HideName.svg) --- ## 🛠️ Compatibility - Minecraft: Java Edition, 1.8 - 26.1.2 - Platforms: Bukkit, Spigot, Paper, Purpur, Folia - Java: 8+ --- ### 💙 Perfect for: Survival • SMP • Events • Roleplay • Streamer-friendly servers

title: Heartless Horizon Plugin
description: Inspired By Heartless Horizon!
body:
> Disclaimer: This is an unofficial remake of the Heartless Horizon plugin concept. I am not affiliated with the original Heartless Horizon server or team. This plugin is a fan-made recreation and I do not claim any credit for the original gameplay concept.

💛 **Quexo's Heartless Horizon Recreation!**

**❓How HH Works:**
Each time you die, you lose 2 Permanent hearts, and the hearts next to your user change color too based on how many hearts you have.

**🔖 Have Hearts Next To Your User!**

- 20 hearts → 💜 Purple
- 10 hearts → 💚 Green
- 8-9 hearts → 💛 Yellow-Green
- 6-7 hearts → 💛 Yellow
- 4-5 hearts → 🧡 Orange
- 1-3 hearts → ❤️ Red
- 0 hearts → 🖤 Black [Immortal But Can Take Damage, Only Obtainable Via Command!]
- infinite hearts → 🤍 White [Immortal, Can't Take Damage, Only Obtainable Via Command!]

🎟️ **HH - Commands:**

- /sethearts [User] [Amount] Set that player's amount of Hearts [0-20]
- /last [User] Just like in the official series, it will replace the player's heart next to his user with a "⚠️" of the same color of his heart amount, if they have this, no matter how many hearts they have, next time they die they get automatically banned.
- /heartless [User] make the player's hearts Black, making him immortal but capable of taking damage.
- /immortal [User] Make the player's hearts White, making it so that he's immortal and can't take damage, even if in survival.

🎫 **Other Features:**
- Wither Death Sound
- Hearts Visible Both in Chat, Above User, And In TAB List!

Minecraft Shader Translator Mod
一个用于自动翻译Minecraft光影包语言文件的Fabric模组。

功能特性
🔍 自动扫描: 自动扫描指定目录中的光影包ZIP文件
🌐 智能翻译: 使用Google翻译API将英文翻译为中文
⚡ 批量处理: 支持批量翻译，提高处理效率
🔄 并发处理: 多线程并发翻译，显著提升处理速度
📝 本地备份: 自动保存翻译后的语言文件
🛡️ 容错机制: 翻译失败时使用本地词典作为备选方案
安装说明
将编译好的JAR文件放入Minecraft的mods文件夹
启动游戏，模组会自动开始工作
配置选项
扫描设置
scan_enabled: 是否启用自动扫描（默认: true）
scan_directory: 光影包扫描目录（默认: shaderpacks）
output_directory: 翻译文件输出目录（默认: translated-shaders）
翻译设置
api_url: 翻译API地址（可选，默认使用Google翻译）
batch_size: 批量翻译大小（默认: 50）
max_threads: 最大线程数（默认: 8）
使用方法
自动翻译
将光影包ZIP文件放入配置的扫描目录
启动游戏或重新加载资源包
模组会自动扫描并翻译光影包中的语言文件
翻译完成后，文件会保存到输出目录
手动触发
在游戏中使用以下命令：

/shadertranslator scan - 手动触发扫描
/shadertranslator reload - 重新加载配置
输出文件
翻译后的文件会保存为：[原文件名]_zh_CN.lang

例如：

BSL_v10.1.1.zip → BSL_v10.1.1_zh_CN.lang
支持的光影包
支持任何包含shaders/lang/en_US.lang文件的光影包，包括但不限于：

SEUS (Sonic Ether's Unbelievable Shaders)
BSL (BSL Shaders)
Sildur's Vibrant Shaders
Continuum Shaders
Chocapic13's Shaders
技术特性
性能优化
使用线程池管理并发翻译任务
批量处理减少API调用次数
智能错误重试机制
翻译质量
优先使用Google翻译API
内置常用光影术语词典
保留原始格式和注释

title: FurnaceEnhanced
description: Adjustable furnace cooking speed for faster smelting.
body:
# ⚡ Furnace Enhanced ⚡

FurnaceEnhanced is a Bukkit/Spigot plugin that allows configurable furnace cook time reduction based on player permissions.

### Features
- **Cook Time Reduction:** Reduce furnace smelting times based on permissions (e.g., `furnaceenhanced.10` for 10% reduction).  
- **Update Checker:** Automatically notifies ops of new versions (configurable interval).  

### Permissions
- `furnaceenhanced.<number>` — Reduces smelting time by `<number>` percent. Higher numbers override lower numbers.

### Configuration
- Update checker can be enabled/disabled in the plugin config.  
- Check interval is configurable (default 12 hours).  
- Real and virtual furnaces are supported; virtual furnaces require an inventory holder for metadata tracking.

### Authors
- Original Author: `mvez73`  
- Continued by: `BitByLogic`

### Notes
- Cook time reduction only applies if permissions are properly set.
- Works for both real and virtual furnaces.

title: Sword Storm
description: The Sword Storm Enchantment for Minecraft 1.21 Fabric Mod adds wind-element abilities to all types of swords (Diamond Sword, Netherite Sword, etc.) with levels ranging from I to V. In Survival Mode, it can be obtained via Enchanting Table (consuming 50% mo
body:
Sword Storm Enchantment (1.21 Fabric Mod)
When the power of steel merges with that of wind, it gives birth to this experience-redefining sword enchantment – Sword Storm. Tailored for all types of swords (Diamond Sword, Netherite Sword, etc.), it unlocks five core wind-manipulating abilities as you progress from Level I to V, turning every sword swing into a wild rhapsody of wind.
**

![Sword Storm Enchantment Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a2b5ac6953256a9225517347eed572e8babc6907_0.webp)  


Basic Info
Applicable Weapons: All types of swords
Level Range: Level I to V; the higher the level, the more violent the wind power
Acquisition Methods:
Survival Mode: Obtain via Enchanting Table (costs 50% more XP than "Sharpness" of the same level) or villager trading.
Creative Mode: Directly take from the "Enchanted Books" category, or acquire via commands.
Five Wind Abilities
1. Wind Projectile Barrage
Lightly right-click with the enchanted sword equipped, and a translucent white wind projectile will howl forward (speed: 0.8 blocks per tick). It deals 3 base damage, increasing with each level (up to 5 damage at Level V), and inflicts an additional 20% damage to undead mobs. The projectile can also pierce 1 entity.
As the level rises, the firing interval shortens significantly – from 1.2 seconds (24 ticks) at Level I to 0.1 seconds (2 ticks) at Level V. This near-machine-gun-like wind pressure suppression leaves enemies nowhere to hide.
**

![Wind Projectile Barrage Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e8c3aaacb95eb0d73866d1ef92129ba459b27a76.png)  


2. Area Charged Burst
Hold the right mouse button to enter the charging state: the player is forced to crouch (unable to move or turn), and circular wind particles spawn around the sword (particle density and rotation speed increase with charging, featuring 3 levels of visual effects). A gradually intensifying wind sound plays every 0.3 seconds.
The charging duration extends with the level (from 1.5 seconds at Level I to 3.5 seconds at Level V). You can release the burst early by letting go of the right-click, or it will trigger automatically when fully charged.
Upon burst, the area of effect, damage, and knockback surge with the level and charge phase: At Level V + Full Charge (Level 3), it covers a 4-block radius, deals 24 damage, and knocks enemies back 3 blocks. Non-solid blocks (leaves, glass, etc.) will be blown away by the wind, creating a spectacular "wind sweeping away the clouds" visual.
**

![Area Charged Burst Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/34c58ba8d3c73a2065d0c387641f870b83bfc7bf.png)  

3. Aerial Multi-Jump
When in the air (before landing), right-click on empty space to trigger an extra jump using wind power (white wind particles spawn under your feet, accompanied by a wind sound). Level I allows double jumps, while Level V unlocks up to six jumps – letting you move as freely in the sky as on the ground.
After each extra jump, you need to wait 0.2 seconds (4 ticks) to trigger another. The jump count resets when you land, enabling flexible movement across terrain.
** 

![Aerial Multi-Jump Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ab99f8b184fc0ef392d122acf253f86541f24b46_0.webp)  


4. Charged Sword Qi
Hold Left Ctrl + Right-Click to enter the charging state, during which you can move slowly. The charging duration increases from 1.0 second (20 ticks) at Level I to 3.0 seconds (60 ticks) at Level V. Damage is linked to the charge progress – at Level V with full charge, it deals 20 base damage.
It also features an 11-block range (with an extra 20% range at full charge) and a 3×3 cone-shaped area of effect. Wherever the wind blade passes, enemies will be knocked back up to 5.4 blocks, showcasing the overwhelming power of cutting wind pressure. After release, it only has a 0.5-second (10-tick) cooldown, which is independent of the wind projectile’s cooldown.
** 

![Charged Sword Qi Attack Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9462255ba11ef96263da98926ff322d87cee1427.png)  

5. Projectile Immunity & Reflection
When holding the enchanted sword in your main hand or offhand, you automatically gain projectile immunity (arrows, snowballs, fire charges, tridents, etc., have no effect) and can reflect projectiles: When a projectile touches your hitbox, it will bounce back at a random angle within ±30° of your line of sight. The reflected projectile retains its original properties (e.g., a fire arrow still ignites targets) and travels at 70% of its original speed. This combines offense and defense, nullifying long-range threats entirely.
From precise wind projectile suppression to large-area storm bursts, from aerial mobility to long-range sword qi, and even perfect defense against projectiles – the Sword Storm enchantment uses wind as its brush, painting diverse combat possibilities for your sword. With each level up, the power of wind becomes purer. Now, it’s time to unleash your very own Sword Storm in the blocky world of Minecraft.

title: Personal Borders
description: Mod that adds player-specific borders
body:
## Personal Borders  
Fabric mod that adds player-specific world borders using LuckPerms permissions.  
![Two players with different borders](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1532e556b69ec55d08cca56a66a8d5c626efcfd6.png)

### Features
- Separate world borders for each player and each dimension
- Prevent players, players' projectiles, and players' pets from crossing the border
- Updated in real-time when permissions are changed

### Configuration
Personal Borders looks for next four permission nodes in LuckPerms:
- `personal-borders`: default world border, if dimension-specific border is not set
- `personal-borders.overworld`: overworld border
- `personal-borders.the_nether`: nether border
- `personal-borders.the_end`: end border

Parameters of the border are stored in the permission node as context values that are similar to [Vanilla world border command](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Commands/worldborder):
- `center.x`, `center.z`: coordinates of the border center
- `distance`: size of the border (diameter)
- `warning.distance`: distance from the border at which the player's screen starts to tint red
- `damage.amount`: damage dealt to the player per second per block when outside the border
- `damage.buffer`: distance from the border at which the player starts taking damage

title: The Invasion Apocalypse
description: Survive the chaos of a post-apocalyptic invasion with challenging mobs, new mechanics, and a world on the brink of destruction.
body:
# The Invasion Apocalypse

It began in the cold silence of the Arctic.
As global temperatures rose, the ice began to melt — and something ancient awoke beneath it.
A microscopic organism, frozen for thousands of years, emerged from the permafrost.
At first, it was harmless. But then… it began to change.

This organism quickly adapted to its new environment, infecting the weak — animals, humans, anything alive. It consumed and replicated, reshaping its hosts into twisted, nightmarish forms.
Governments tried to contain it. They failed.
The infection spread across continents, devouring everything in its path.

Now the world is collapsing.
Nature is corrupted, cities are abandoned, and only a few survivors remain. You are one of them.

**About the Modpack**
The Invasion Apocalypse is a realistic and terrifying survival experience inspired by biological horror and parasitic evolution.
Built around Scape and Run: Parasites, the infection grows stronger the longer you survive — until no place is safe anymore.

**Features**
- Dynamic infection system — parasites evolve and adapt to your actions.
- Realistic survival — limited resources, harsh environments, and constant danger.
- Atmospheric visuals and sound — every night feels colder, every shadow more alive.
- Progressive difficulty — the world changes the longer you live.
- Supports singleplayer and multiplayer survival.


## Lore – The Beginning of the End

It all started in the Arctic, far away from civilization.
When the ice began to melt, scientists uncovered something buried deep within the frozen wastelands — an organism unlike anything known to man. At first, they believed it to be a harmless microbe, a remnant of a time long before humanity. They brought it to their laboratories, eager to study it, unaware that they had just awoken something ancient… something alive.

The organism began to move. Slowly. Silently. It adapted to the new world with terrifying speed.
It fed on oxygen, heat, and organic matter — and soon it found its first host.
A single researcher became infected. Within hours, the parasite had rewritten his body, reshaping flesh into something grotesque and unrecognizable. His screams echoed through the frozen base… and then there was silence.

Days later, the outpost stopped responding.
Rescue teams were sent — but none returned.
Satellites later captured images of the base, now covered in a strange, pulsating growth spreading across the snow. Then it vanished under a blizzard, as if nature itself was trying to hide what had been unleashed.

Months passed.
And then reports began to surface — strange creatures in remote villages, whole populations disappearing overnight, animals behaving unnaturally. The infection had found its way south. It learned, adapted, and multiplied. It no longer needed the cold — it could live anywhere.

Now, humanity is on the brink of extinction.
Cities burn, forests rot, and the sky turns gray with ash and spores. The world has become a battlefield between the last survivors and the ever-evolving parasite. It cannot be reasoned with, it cannot be stopped — it only spreads.

You are among the few still alive.
But survival has a cost — trust no one, for even the closest ally could already be infected.
The invasion has begun.
And the world as you knew it… is gone forever.

title: Arrow Magnet
description: Curio accessory that makes every landed arrow (on blocks) safely return to sender in one piece!
body:
Ever tired of different arrow variants (e.g spectral or tipped), vanilla or modded, being incompatible with the infinity enchantment (or, well, simply just not having the infinity enchantment in the first place. That or you're a mending > infinity kind of person)? Well that's what this mod aims to solve, or at least, partially alleviate the hassle thereof. The mod adds a curio accessory to the game that magnetizes all arrows that have landed on blocks **from just about any distance** back to the player for collection. This only pertains to arrows that are fired by their respective players and do not originate from bows with the infinity enchantment. The accessory ensures that no arrow of any cost goes to waste as a consequence of missed shots or whatnot.
This mod pairs especially well with mods that add arrows with the ability to remain intact even after colliding with an entity.

**Note that the item does NOT carry out its function right away when equipping it in your charm slot. You have to activate it with a right-click while holding it before it works.** Aside from equipping it as a curio, holding it in your main/off-hand will also allow it to carry out its magnetization function.


### Mod Recommendations
- [Simple Magnets](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-magnets) or any other mod that adds item magnets.
- [Fabulous Fletching,](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fabulous-fletching) the primary catalyst to this mod's conception.


## Item Recipes

Prior to crafting the main accessory, the player must also craft its core ingredient beforehand, that being its catalyst.

### Catalyst of Arrow Magnetism

title: Iridium Exporter
description: Export item data and icons for the program Iridium.
body:
# Iridium


## The Program - Iridium

The program Iridium (currently in beta) is a visual editor for minecraft recipes. The "Holy Grail" of minecraft recipe editors, this program allows you to drag and drop items to build new recipes or remove preexisting ones.

If you wish to use it, you can either find it under the same organization the source code for this mod is in or you can go to the link here: https://github.com/Iridium-Visual-Recipe-Editor/Iridium

## This Mod - The Exporter

This mod acts as a data collector for the program Iridium. It will collect item data and item images from in your game to use with Iridium.

### How to Use

Use the command `/iridium exporter` and one of its three parameters:

*   `all`: Runs all data collection methods.
*   `itemdata`: Only generates the itemdata.txt file.
*   `itemimages`: Only generates the item images.

All data generated will be put inside the Minecraft directory under the folder "exporteddata".

### FAQ
Q: Will you update to version 1.XX.X?\
A: In the future, I plan to update to every version that CraftTweaker and KubeJS is on, that's also supported by Architectury.\
Q: I noticed that between versions (specifically after 1.20.2 and 1.20.5) when creating the images, the background is different. Is that normal?\
A: From what I've tested, it shouldn't affect anything. The only minor problem is that on 1.20.5+ the blur makes it harder to see how many images have been generated, but that's not a big problem by any means.

### Credits
I'd like to thank the mods [IconExporter](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/iconexporter) and [TellMe](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/tellme) for taking a fair amount of inspiration from their code.

# Vinland Enhanced
A modpack designed to **improve your gaming experience** on the Vinland server, as well as for enjoyable play on **other servers or in the local Minecraft world**. This modpack is made with four main features (**Optimization, Visual and gameplay enhancements, Improved RP Experience, Tools for Content Makers**) in mind that will greatly improve your gaming experience. **Everything** is already set up to make your game as **comfortable** as possible. **You just need to install this build and enjoy the game!**

## Main Features:

### Optimization
**Modpack "Vinland Enhanced"** includes a number of optimizations that guarantee **stable and smooth game play** even on servers with high load. The modpack also supports almost **all OptiFine features**, **including shaders**, **capes**, **zoom**, and **support for resourcepacks that require OptiFine**. We pay special attention to performance optimization to ensure **the most comfortable gaming environment**.

title: AiServerAssistant
description: Use OpenAI integration to help players understand your server and navigate its features.
body:
## About

This is a plugin that allows you to integrate ChatGPT into your server as a form of player assistant. You can configure a personality and your basic server features and players can ask it all sorts of questions. 
## Dependencies
AiCore is REQUIRED!
[https://modrinth.com/plugin/aicore](https://modrinth.com/plugin/aicore)

## Commands

> `/aisa reload` reloads the plugin and defaults
`aisa.admin` permission required
> 

> `/aisa force_encrypt` forces the plugin to update the encryption manually. only use this if you have to update your API Key. This can technically be done by setting the API Key in config and setting Encrypted to false. Its actually never recommended to use this command because its likely you'll get something wrong. 
`aisa.admin` permission required
> 

> `/ask <question>` This the main command! The plugin will attempt to answer any question that follows and should hopefully ignore anything that isn’t minecraft or server related.

> `aisa.chat` permission is required for players to use the in-chat feature! To speak to the bot, use "hey botname" at the start of a message. 

## Intial Setup

STEP 1: If you do not have an OpenAI account, create one. 
https://platform.openai.com/docs/quickstart/account-setup

STEP 2: Create an API Key https://platform.openai.com/account/api-keys

STEP 3: Update the "keys.yml" file with your API Key and set "encrypted" to "false"

STEP 4: Start the server! It will AUTOMATICALLY ENCRYPT THE API KEY!

STEP 5: Verify your prompt.txt file. It should work well enough, but tweak it to your liking.

You only need to follow these steps if you need to change your api key.

## API KEY SECURITY NOTICE

By default, the plugin is designed to use an encryption algorithm to mask your tokens and orgs. Its not entirely fool proof, and you should monitor your usage closely. If you see that your usage includes models you normally aren’t using - change keys immediately and remove the old one. 

I do not include an encryption class for self compiling users. You will need to implement your own logic here. I would recommend hosting your own webservice and making authenticated calls to that instead of storing them anywhere staff/players might have access to them.

## Support or Suggestions?
Please use "Issues" on Github or My [Support Discord](https://discord.com/invite/xErSpeWa8d)!

title: LovelyHeads
description: A mod that improves some things related to players' heads and adds new functionalities
body:
LovelyHeads is a mod that fixes the head stack picking with a middle mouse click (you will now get an exact copy of the head, not the standard one), makes heads more useful by adding a few blocks for late game stages that interact with them and adds a little more opportunity to decorate your home with trophies from slain enemies.

List of the additions:

### 1. Stack picking
When you middle-click in creative on a head placed in the world, you will get an exact replica of the head.

### 2. Command for Obtaining Heads by Username
Use /getHead <name> to get a player head with the matching nbt. Just a small command, instead of having to write novels to get one single head

### 3. Polymorph head
A block found in ancient city chests that takes on the shape of the player who placed it.

### 4. Head Constructor
The new block allows you to create player and mob heads, as well as turn player heads into schemes for further multiple reproduction of them

### 5. Beheading Enchantment
Striking a weapon with this enchantment has a small chance of casting a Beheading Mark. Death of a creature with this effect will cause its head to fall off. By modifying the game rules, you can determine whether only player heads will fall out or also the heads of mobs (default is true), and whether the effect will apply to Wither Skeletons (default is false).

### 6. Player Teleport, Item Transmitter and Head Pedestals
Two new blocks that interact with the heads on the head pedestals: Player Teleport teleports the player to the head's owner, and Item Transmitter transfers items to his inventory. Both have their own cooldowns, which can be accelerated by echo shards

### 7. Trophy Plaque
Decorative plaque for placing heads with the owner's name if it is a player's head.

The mod will continue to evolve and in the future I hope to add more features, and, of course, fix bugs and other annoyances that are already surely there but were not noticed by me

title: MenuKit
description: UI library for Fabric mods — HUD panels, widgets, layouts, region anchoring, modal overlays. Client-only.
body:
# MenuKit

MenuKit is a client-side UI library for Fabric mods. It provides reusable interface components and the systems that place them on screen, so mods can build menus, HUD overlays, and in-game UI without writing Minecraft interface code from scratch.

Components: buttons, toggles, checkboxes, radio buttons, sliders, dropdowns (single and multi-select), text fields, labels, tooltips, icons, item displays, progress bars, dividers, and scroll containers.

What it does:
- Places UI in four contexts with one set of components: the HUD, vanilla menu screens, named slot groups, and standalone screens.
- Groups components into panels, each a bounded region that renders, takes input, and shows or hides as a unit.
- Positions panels by screen region and resizes them to fit automatically, wrapping and scrolling as needed, at any GUI scale.
- Lets several mods add UI to the same screens without conflicting: components from different mods register cleanly and coexist (panels sharing a region stack in order instead of overlapping), so mods built on MenuKit stay compatible with each other.
- Exposes slots created through MenuKit: Containers to every MenuKit consumer, so a mod can read and address another mod's custom slots, not only its own.
- Handles modal overlays, click-through prohibition, recipe-book awareness, and cursor stability across screen changes.

MenuKit is client-only and ships primitives rather than taking over Minecraft's UI. Its types are vanilla types (a MenuKit slot is a real `Slot`), so it coexists with other mods. Requires Fabric. For custom container menus and slots with server-synced state, add MenuKit: Containers.

## Install

```gradle
repositories {
    maven { url 'https://api.modrinth.com/maven' }
}
dependencies {
    modImplementation 'maven.modrinth:menukit:2.0.0'
}
```

Declare it in `fabric.mod.json`:

```json
"depends": { "menukit": "*" }
```

## Working examples

MenuKit's validator mod is the honest reference consumer, with real, compiling usage of every primitive. The full surface is documented in the javadoc.

## License

MIT. See `LICENSE`.

## Issues

[github.com/trevorschoeny/menukit/issues](https://github.com/trevorschoeny/menukit/issues).

The TRTA/Tokyo Metro 05 series (営団・東京メトロ05系, Eidan/Tōkyō Metoro 05-kei) is an electric multiple unit (EMU) train type operated on the Tokyo Metro Tozai Line and Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line Ayase Branch in Japan by the subway operator Tokyo Metro. Some sets have also been shipped to Indonesia, where they operated on the KRL Commuterline system in Jakarta between 2011 and 2025.

A total of 43 ten-car trainsets were built from 1988 to 2004, with a number of variants. Sets 05-125 onward have a redesigned front end, and are called "05N series". Sets 05-114 to 05-118 have wide doors. A further four sets were due to be built, but the plan was changed to use 07 series trains transferred from the Yurakucho Line, so no further 05 series trains were built.

body:
![FancyNpcsModel Banner](https://fancyinnovations.com/logos-and-banners/fancynpcsmodel-banner.png)
With this plugin, you can assign custom 3D models (from [BetterModel](https://modrinth.com/plugin/bettermodel)) to npcs.
## How to use Requirements: - [FancyNpcs 2.10.1](https://modrinth.com/plugin/fancynpcs) or newer - [BetterModel 3.1.0](https://modrinth.com/plugin/bettermodel) or newer - FancyNpcsModel (this plugin) How to apply a custom model to an npc: 1. Install the required plugins 2. Import models to BetterModel (see [BetterModel's documentation](https://github.com/toxicity188/BetterModel/wiki) for that) 3. Make sure your npc is a player npc (`/npc type (npc) player`) 4. Set the custom model: `/npc custom_model (npc) (model name)` 5. Done! Your npc should now have the model you assigned to it Setting the custom model to `@none` will remove the model. Commands that won't work, when the npcs has a custom model: - `/npc displayname` - `/npc equipment` - `/npc glowing` - `/npc skin` - `/npc turn_to_player` (depends on model) ## Animations This plugin also adds two new actions (for npcs with custom models only) to play animations. Actions: - `play_animation_once`: plays the specified animation once - `play_animation_loop`: plays the specified animation in a loop How to add the action: `/npc action (npc) (trigger) add play_animation_once (animation name)` There is also a command to play an animation: `/npc play_animation (npc) (animation name) [--loop]` ## Data collection This plugin collects anonymous usage data to help us understand how the plugin is being used and to improve it. All collected data by all servers is aggregated, we don't store any IP addresses, server names, or any other information that could be used to identify a specific server or user. Read more about that topic (used platforms, how to opt-out, list of metrics ...) in the [documentation](https://fancyinnovations.com/docs/minecraft-plugins/data-collection).

title: Aeronautics: Cogs and Clouds
description: A 1.21.1 powerhouse featuring Create: Aeronautics, nuclear engineering, airship combat, and massive dungeons—optimized for everyone.
body:
A 1.21.1 experience predicated on the seamless integration of physics-based flight, heavy industry, and dimensional exploration within an active multiplayer environment.

In this project, the core focus is placed upon Create: Aeronautics, which provides the foundation for players to construct fully functioning airships, trains, and land vehicles. To provide justification for these massive builds, the pack pairs this technology with completely overhauled world generation, ensuring that long-distance travel and exploration are not merely late-game luxuries, but absolutely necessary components of the gameplay loop.
## 
## 🛠️ Industry and Engineering

To establish a truly substantive industrial experience, the base Create ecosystem is heavily expanded. Through the implementation of Steam 'n' Rails, Diesel Generators, and Create: Nuclear, players are granted the prerequisites needed to manage high-tier power and logistics. Furthermore, because the Overworld is entirely overhauled by Terralith and Tectonic, the environments are vast and extraordinarily difficult to traverse on foot. Distant Horizons is utilized so players can view these massive landscapes directly from the decks of their airships. Consequently, to navigate and survive these environments safely, players must leverage Create: Big Cannons to arm their vessels and defend their infrastructure.
## 
## ⚔️ Combat and Dimensional Exploration

While the pack provides a strong foundation for technological progression, it also challenges the player through overhauled dimensions and combat mechanics. The Aether is fully integrated alongside comprehensive transformations of the Nether and End using Incendium and Nullscape. Within these dimensions, as well as the Overworld, players will encounter massive raid targets generated by the YUNG's Better series and When Dungeons Arise. To combat these threats, the melee system is completely replaced by Better Combat, and Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks introduces a functional, progression-based magic alternative for those who prefer staves over wrenches. Ultimately, these systems culminate in thrilling, strategy-heavy encounters governed by Bosses of Mass Destruction.

## 🌾 Community and Agriculture

From a community-based standpoint, the pack is inherently designed to foster a highly engaging server environment. To prevent the exhaustion of resources in multiplayer, Lootr is implemented to provide instanced chests, ensuring that exploration remains rewarding for all users regardless of when they join. Beyond exploration, the pack nourishes a living world through a massive culinary and agricultural ecosystem. The entire Farmer's Delight collection, alongside the comprehensive Let's Do series, allows players to establish functional bakeries, breweries, and vineyards, promoting cooperation and a vibrant shared social life within the server.

## ⚡ Optimization and Performance

Finally, the entire experience is contingent on the absolute effectiveness and reliability of its performance. By incorporating a heavy optimization suite—including Sodium, Iris, ModernFix, FerriteCore, and Lithium—the pack ensures lightning-fast load times and remarkably stable framerates, even when managing complex physics entities. It is highly recommended that users allocate between 5GB and 8GB of RAM, and rely upon the integrated EMI systems for lightweight recipe lookups. Through these careful optimizations, Aeronautics: Cogs and Clouds provides a definitive, highly stable multiplayer experience.

## 📜 Credits & Attributions

This project relies upon the incredible work of the following creators:

    The Simulated Team (Create: Aeronautics)

    satisfy & The Let's Do Team (The Let's Do series)

    vectorwing & community (The Farmer's Delight ecosystem)

    YUNGNICKYOUNG (The YUNG's series)

    The Aether Team (The Aether)

    James Seibel & Team (Distant Horizons)

    All other included modifications are distributed under their respective MIT, LGPL, or Open Source licenses.

title: Notebook
description: Notebook is a client-side Fabric mod that lets you create, manage, and share draggable To-Do lists and item collection quotas directly from your screen.
body:
![Notebook Mod](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dev-jcwd/Notebook/main/BANNER.gif)

![Fabric Only](https://img.shields.io/badge/Loader-Fabric-blue?logo=fabricmc&logoColor=white)
![Client Side](https://img.shields.io/badge/Environment-Client--Side-green)
![MC Versions](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21%20→%201.21.11-yellow)

[![Join Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Join%20Community-5865F2?logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/TubuNkwPam)  
[![NeoCity SMP](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-NeoCity%20SMP-5865F2?logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/YYkVVZwCaX)

---

**Notebook** is a highly customizable, lightweight **client-side** utility mod that brings interactive, draggable To-Do lists and Item Gathering trackers directly to your HUD. 

Perfect for keeping track of your grinding quotas, daily server tasks, or building materials without needing external apps or constantly alt-tabbing!  

---

# 📸 Previews
### Draggable UI
![Draggable UI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dev-jcwd/GUI/main/Draggable%20UI.gif)

### Adding & Managing Lists
![Adding list](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dev-jcwd/GUI/main/Adding%20list%20on%20notebook.gif)

### Pinning to HUD
![Pinning](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dev-jcwd/GUI/main/Pinning%20on%20notebook.gif)

---

# ✅ Features
- 📌 **Draggable UI** → Easily move your item and task lists around your screen using the Edit HUD menu.  
- 📋 **To-Do Lists** → Track your daily goals. Check off completed tasks dynamically to cross them out.  
- 📦 **Item Gathering Tracker** → Set a target amount for an item and track your inventory in real-time.  
- 🚦 **Smart Quota Colors** → Item text turns **Green** when you hit your exact target, and **Red** when you exceed it!  
- 🛡️ **Typo Protection** → Prevents you from accidentally adding invalid or misspelled items to your tracker.  
- 💬 **List Sharing** → Share your active item list straight to the server chat for team collaboration.  
- 📖 **Pagination** → Got a long list? Easily flip through pages using commands or customizable keybinds.  
- 💻 **100% Client-Side** → Works perfectly on vanilla servers or modded SMPs.  

---

# ⌨️ Commands

### 🎒 Item Lists (Aliases: `/il`)
- **/itemlists** → Shows all the item lists you have created.  
- **/il create <name>** → Creates and displays a new item list.  
- **/il delete <name>** → Deletes the specified list.  
- **/il display <name>** → Switches your HUD to show this list.  
- **/il add <listName> <item> <quantity>** → Adds an item quota to your list *(example: `/il add base dirt 64`)*.  
- **/il remove <listName> <item> <quantity>** → Removes an item from the list.  
- **/il share <name>** → Shares the item list to the server chat.  
- **/il next** or **/il n** → Flips to the next page of your item list.  
- **/il previous** or **/il p** → Flips to the previous page.  

### 📝 To-Do Lists (Command: `/todo`)
- **/todo** → Shows all your created To-Do lists.
- **/todo create <name>** → Creates a new To-Do list.
- **/todo delete <name>** → Deletes the specified To-Do list.
- **/todo display <name>** → Switches your HUD to show this To-Do list.
- **/todo add <listName> <task>** → Adds a new task to your list.
- **/todo check <listName> <task>** → Marks a task as completed.
- **/todo uncheck <listName> <task>** → Unmarks a task.
- **/todo next** or **/todo n** → Flips to the next page of tasks.

### ⛏️ Gathering Lists (Aliases: `/gl`)
- **/gatheringlists** → Shows all the gathering lists you have created.
- **/gl create <name>** → Creates and displays a new gathering list.
- **/gl delete <name>** → Deletes the specified list.
- **/gl display <name>** → Switches your HUD to show this list.
- **/gl add <listName> <item> <quantity>** → Adds an item to your gathering list.
- **/gl remove <listName> <item> <quantity>** → Removes an item from the gathering list.
- **/gl share <name>** → Shares the gathering list to the server chat.
- **/gl next** or **/gl n** → Flips to the next page of your gathering list.
- **/gl previous** or **/gl p** → Flips to the previous page.
- **/gl import** → Imports list data.
- **/gl help** → Displays general help instructions for gathering lists.

title: SpawnHunt
description: Spawn. Hunt. A new Minecraft item and block scavenger hunt mod.
body:
**SpawnHunt** is a Fabric mod that turns Minecraft into a speedrun scavenger hunt. You're given a random survival-obtainable item — collect it as fast as you can. Play solo in a fresh world or compete with friends on a server.

## How It Works

### Singleplayer

1. Click **SpawnHunt** on the title screen
2. You're shown a random target item — **Reroll** for a new one, or pick from the full **List**
3. Hit **Start** and a new Survival world is created automatically
4. Find and collect the target item as fast as possible
5. Your time is tracked, and your best runs are saved per item

### Multiplayer

1. Install SpawnHunt on your Fabric server (players don't need the mod installed)
2. An OP runs `/spawnhunt start random` or `/spawnhunt start <item>`
3. All players race to find the target item first
4. Players with the mod see a rich HUD; players without see action bar messages
5. The first player to collect the item wins

## Features

- **400+ target items** — every survival-obtainable item in the game
- **Singleplayer** — built-in timer with pause awareness, run history, hardcore mode
- **Multiplayer** — server commands, automatic inventory scanning, works with vanilla clients
- **Zero setup** — singleplayer worlds created with a single click; multiplayer via one command

## Requirements

- Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.11
- [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/) 0.18.4+
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) 0.141.3+

## Installation

### Client (singleplayer + enhanced multiplayer HUD)
1. Install Fabric Loader and Fabric API for Minecraft 1.21.11
2. Drop the `spawnhunt` jar into your `mods` folder
3. Launch the game — the **SpawnHunt** button appears on the title screen

### Server (multiplayer)
1. Install Fabric Loader and Fabric API on your server
2. Drop the `spawnhunt` jar into the server's `mods` folder
3. Start the server — `/spawnhunt` commands are available to OPs

Players **do not** need the mod installed to participate. They'll see the hunt via action bar messages and chat. Players with the mod get a richer HUD experience.

## Commands

| Command | Permission | Description |
|---------|-----------|-------------|
| `/spawnhunt start random` | OP | Start a hunt with a random item |
| `/spawnhunt start <item>` | OP | Start a hunt with a specific item (tab-completable) |
| `/spawnhunt stop` | OP | Cancel the current hunt |
| `/spawnhunt restart [item]` | OP | Stop and start a new hunt |
| `/spawnhunt status` | Everyone | Show current hunt info |

## Community & Support

title: PrismProtect
description:
Adds protect functionality for servers(like coreprotect). 
Has rollback, lookup + lookup client highlight, etc.
body:
# PrismProtect — protect your modded Minecraft server

## Requires Architectury API

**PrismProtect is a server-side(and client for hightlighting) Architectury mod for Minecraft 1.20.1–1.20.4 that brings CoreProtect-like logging and rollback to modded servers — no plugins required, built for performance.**

---

## Features

- Logs block break/place/replace with full BlockEntity NBT support
- Tracks explosions (TNT, creepers, vanilla explosion pipeline)  
  **Note:** some mods with fully custom explosion logic may bypass vanilla hooks and not be logged
- Logs entity deaths with full NBT snapshots for accurate restoration
- Records container and inventory changes with menu open/close diff tracking
- Logs item drops from broken blocks and crafting outputs for item rollback
- Supports blocks/entities from **any mod** (namespaced IDs are stored as-is)
- Uses optimized SQLite storage with WAL journaling and thread-safe writes
- Includes inspect mode to view block history in-game

---

## Commands

```bash
/pp inspect
```
Toggle inspect mode and click blocks to view history.

```bash
/pp lookup [u:<name>] [t:<time>] [r:<radius>] [a:block|entity|container]
```
Search logged actions using filters (`a:block` by default).

```bash
/pp rollback [u:<name>] [t:<time>] [r:<radius>] [a:entity]
```
Rollback changes in the selected scope.  
Without `a:entity`, rolls back block/container/item changes.

```bash
/pp highlight [off] [u:<name>] [t:<time>] [r:<radius>] [w:<world>] [d:<sec>] [l:<limit>] [p:<page>]
```
Highlights matched block changes with in-world colored outlines for visual investigation.  
Use `off` to clear active highlights immediately.  
Running `/pp highlight ...` again replaces the previous highlight set for that player.

```bash
/pp restore [u:<name>] [t:<time>] [r:<radius>]
```
Restore previously rolled-back block/container/item changes.

```bash
/pp purge t:<time>
```
Delete old log data (requires OP level 4).

```bash
/pp status
```
Show database counters and runtime status.

---

## Time Format

Supports `s`, `m`, `h`, `d`, `w`  
Examples: `30m`, `1h30m`, `2d`, `1w`

---

## Highlight Mode

Use `/pp highlight` to render outline markers for matched block changes in-world.  
Colors indicate action type, and `/pp highlight off` clears active highlights immediately.

## Entity Rollback

Entity rollback is a separate scope: add `a:entity` to rollback commands.  
PrismProtect respawns entities at original coordinates using full NBT snapshots captured at death.

---

## Item Rollback

PrismProtect logs:
- item drops from broken blocks
- crafting outputs taken from result slots

During `/pp rollback`, it restores affected blocks and tries to remove logged items from the original player inventory.  
If items are missing there, it also checks nearby ground drops around the original position.

---

## Storage

PrismProtect uses bundled **SQLite** (no external DB required).  
Database path: `config/prismprotect/prismprotect.db`  
WAL journaling provides safe concurrent access under active server load.

---

## Version Support

| Minecraft | Loader | Status |
|-----------|--------|--------|
| 1.20.1–1.20.4 | Forge 47.2.0+ | ✅ Supported |
| 1.20.1–1.20.4 | Fabric Loader 0.14.25+ + Fabric API 0.92.2+1.20.1 | ✅ Supported |
| 1.20.5+ / 1.21.x | Other builds | ⚠️ Not working(Will be added soon) |

> Server-side and optional client side. Clients do **not** need PrismProtect installed to join.
```

title: PlayerControl
description: Swap bodies with other players, or control Carpet fake players
body:
# What

Control Player is a **server-side** mod that allows players to swap control with another player or take control of Carpet fake players.

When a swap is active, the two players effectively control each other's bodies.The mod also works well with Carpet mod fake players, allowing real players to temporarily control them.

# Why

This mod makes it possible to observe gameplay from another perspective useful when test mechanics using fake players.

# How

## Main command:

```
/controlPlayer
```

### Swap control

Swap control with another player.

```
/controlPlayer swap <player>
```
Permission level: **2**

---

### Release control

Release your current control state.
```
/controlPlayer release
```
If an admin wants to forcibly release another player:
```
/controlPlayer release <player>
```
Permission level for forced release: **2**

---

### List active swaps

Display all currently active control pairs.

```
/controlPlayer list
```

Permission level: **2**

---

### Check control status

Show whether you are currently controlling another player.

```
/controlPlayer status
```
---
---
## Gamerules

### `showControllerPrefix`

Default: `false`

When enabled, the name of the player currently controlling someone will be displayed ​**after the player's name**​.

This helps identify control relationships more easily, especially when multiple swaps are active.

---

### `permissionSwapsToo`

Default: `false`

When enabled, ​**player permissions will also be swapped together with the bodies**​.

Normally, only the **player control / body** is swapped.
With this rule enabled, the **permission level (such as OP level)** will also be exchanged between the two players.

> **Warning:**
> This can be dangerous on servers, as it may temporarily grant elevated 
> permissions to another player.

title: ChatSolver
description: Your chat, but supercharged. Adds prefixes, suffixes, chat colors, HEX support, emoji placeholders, and custom color codes. Solves the boringness of vanilla chat. Features styles even beyond chat, tablist as example.
body:
**Your chat, but supercharged.**

ChatSolver transforms vanilla Minecraft chat with HEX colors, custom prefixes/suffixes, emoji placeholders, and advanced formatting. Say goodbye to boring default chat.

---

## ✨ Features

### Design Features
- 🎨 **HEX color support** - Use `&#RRGGBB` format in chat, prefixes, and suffixes
- 👤 **Custom prefixes & suffixes** - Per-player customization for chat and TabList
- 🌈 **Automatic message coloring** - Set default chat colors for players
- 🔧 **Custom color codes** - Replace default `&x` colors with your own HEX values
- ⭐ **Pretty Tablist** _(Currently Fabric's special)_ - Adds Header and Footer to Tablist 

### Enhanced Chat
- 😊 **Emoji placeholders** - Type `:heart:` → get ❤️ _(currently works only on Paper\Purpur verison)_
- 📊 **Ping display** - Show player ping in TabList
- 🌍 **Multi-language** - English, Russian, Ukrainian (add your own!)

---

## 📋 Commands

### `/prefix <set/clear> <player> [prefix]`
Sets or clears player's chat/TabList prefix. Supports HEX colors.

**Examples:**
```
/prefix set N0rM1x &#ffBB00Friend &e
/prefix clear N0rM1x
```

### `/suffix <set/clear> <player> [suffix]`
Sets or clears player's chat/TabList suffix. Supports HEX colors.

**Examples:**
```
/suffix set N0rM1x &#ffBB00 cool
/suffix clear N0rM1x
```

### `/chatcolor <set/clear> <player> [chat color]`
Sets or clears player's default chat message color. Supports HEX.

**Examples:**
```
/chatcolor set N0rM1x &#ffBB00
/chatcolor clear N0rM1x
```


## ⚙️ Configuration

### Emoji Placeholders (`emojis.yml`)
Create custom emoji shortcuts:
```yaml
heart: "❤️"
star: "⭐"
fire: "🔥"
```
Type `:heart:` in chat → displays ❤️
_(currently works only on Paper\Purpur verison)_

### Custom Color Codes (`colors_config.yml`)
Replace default Minecraft color codes with HEX:
```yaml
d: "<#ff0000>"  # Makes &d show red instead of light purple
```

### Language (`config.yml`)
Change command feedback language:
```yaml
lang: en-US  # Options: en-US, ru-RU, ua-UA
```
You can add your own language files in `ChatSolver/message_lang/` directory.

### Tablist _(Currently Fabric's special)_ (`tablist.yml`)
Enchance your tablist with cool footer and header features:
```yaml
header:
  enabled: true
  text:
    - ""
    - "&eWelcome, %player%"
    - "&7Your ping: &f%ping% &7TPS: &f%tps%"
    - ""
```
Supports multiple placeholders for most of needed information.
---

## 📦 Installation

1. Download `ChatSolver.jar` from [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/plugin/chatsolver)
2. Place in your server's `plugins/` or `mods` folder
3. Restart server
4. Configure in `plugins/ChatSolver/` or `config/ChatSolver/`

**Requirements:**
- Paper/Purpur 1.21–1.21.4 server *(Currently working on Spigot/Folia support. Doesnt work on those now. Currently updating and optimising for newest versions.)*
- Fabric 1.21–1.21.11 server *(Not sure about every exact version support. Currently works perfect on 1.21.4 and 1.21.11.)*

---

## 📝 License

Licensed under GPL-3.0 - see LICENSE file for details.

---

## 🐛 Issues & Support

Found a bug? Have a suggestion? Open an issue on [GitHub](https://github.com/N0rM1x/ChatSolver/issues).

---

## 💡 Why ChatSolver?

Vanilla chat is functional but boring. ChatSolver gives server owners and players the tools to make chat truly theirs - with modern HEX colors, emojis, and flexible formatting that actually works.

**Made by [N0rM1x](https://github.com/N0rM1x/ChatSolver)**

title: Deaths Accounted For (DAF)
description: A lightweight mod focused on tracking kills, deaths, and enforcing a configurable death limit for competitive or hardcore servers.
body:
Tired of your friends claiming they’re the “_best PvPer on the server_” with nothing to back it up? Or maybe you just want to know who really gets wrecked in fair fights (spoiler: still probably you).

**Deaths Accounted For** keeps track of every glorious victory and every not-so-glorious defeat — but only when another player is involved. Creepers don’t count here. No more excuses, no more “_lag got me_” — the stats don’t lie.

Whether you’re running a hardcore challenge, a PvP tournament, or just want to roast your friends with cold, hard numbers, this mod’s got you covered.

 

### **✨ Features**
- **Kills & Deaths Tracking** – Records only player-caused kills and deaths, complete with player names and timestamps.
- **Player Stats Command** – Run /stats to check your own stats. Admins can peek at everyone else’s, but normal players only see their own.
- **Leaderboard Command** – Shows the top players ranked by kills only. Simple, clean, and ruthless.
- **Configurable Death Limit** – Want hardcore mode with a twist? Set a death cap — when players reach it, they’re automatically banned. (Don’t worry, you can tweak or disable it in the config.)
- **Reloadable Config and Stats** – Change settings without restarting the server. Because who has time for restarts?
- **Death and Ban Logs** - Keep track of every kill and bans with timestamps available in the Log file.



### **🎮 Server Use Cases**
- **PvP Arenas** – Track who’s truly the champion.
- **Hardcore SMPs** – Add accountability and spice with a configurable death cap.
- **Events & Tournaments** – Make competitions fair with a visible leaderboard.
- **Friendly Chaos** – Or just keep it around to remind your friends who the real “PvP god” is.

  

If you have any questions, sugestions or just wanna have a good time. feel free to join my [Mike's Land](https://discord.gg/S5EESWTtMe)

title: Random Item Generator
description: The Random generator plugin adds a fun twist to your Minecraft server by randomly giving items to selected players. You can control how, when, and what items drop-perfect for events, challenges, or just some extra chaos.
body:
# 🧨 RandomDrops

**Bring chaos or fun challenges to your server with random item drops!**

**RandomDrops is a lightweight Minecraft plugin that periodically gives random items to selected players. It's fully configurable — control the frequency, quantity, item types, and even how the items are delivered.**

## ✨ Features

- **🎯 Target specific players** – Only drop items for chosen players.
- **⏱️ Customizable drop intervals** – Set how often drops happen.
- **📦 Three drop modes** – Choose between normal, full stacks, or line mode (9-slot layout).
- **🧍 Everyone gets the same items** – Or not. Up to you.
- **🥚 Control whether spawn eggs drop.**
- **💬 Optional feedback messages** – Let players know what they got.
- **🎲 Luck Dupe System** – Chance-based item duplication.
- **🔧 Easy-to-use command system.**

## 🛠 Commands

```
/rd start                                      → Start the item drops.
/rd stop                                       → Stop the item drops.
/rd add <player>                               → Add a player to the drop list.
/rd remove <player>                            → Remove a player from the list.
/rd playerlist                                 → Show all players currently added.
/rd setting DropsInterval <t>                  → Set drop frequency (in ticks).
/rd setting Drops <n>                          → How many items are dropped per interval.
/rd setting DoEggsDrop <true/false>            → Toggle dropping of spawn eggs.
/rd setting DropMode <...>                     → Choose how items are delivered.
/rd setting SendItemFeedback <true/false>      → Enable/disable feedback.
/rd setting EveryoneSame <true/false>          → Give same items to all players.
/rd setting LuckDupe <true/false>              → Enable the duplication system.
/rd setting SendLuckDupeFeedback <true/false>  → Dupe message toggle.
/rd setting LuckDupeChance <...>               → Set dupe probability level.
/rd setting LuckDupeChances                    → Show dupe probabilities.
/rd reset                                      → Reset all settings to default.
/rd help                                       → Show help.
```

title: ChatsPlus
description: The solution for custom chats with a lot of features.
body:
![](https://imgur.com/AxH5bBJ.png) **
If you're looking for a plugin that allows you to make multiple different chats, then this one is for you!
** ![](https://imgur.com/6YiD8Q2.png)
ChatsPlus allows you to create chats that only certain players and ranks can join and chat in, assign those chats to a certain world and much more! This plugin also has EssentialsDiscord support. If you have chats, that should not be shown in a Discord server, then you can have them ignored using a sub-configuration inside the config file. (More about that in the config section of this description)
![](https://imgur.com/zFGXKHn.png) It is recommended to use a permissions plugin like [LuckPerms](https://modrinth.com/mod/luckperms) for the best experience. ![](https://imgur.com/P9fywH0.png) This plugin supports Placeholder API! |Placeholder|Description| |:------|:------| |%chatsplus_chat%|returns the chat name the player is in.| ![](https://imgur.com/YcFq0pF.png)
This plugin mainly uses the main command /chat in-game, however it comes with subcommands.

|Command Sender|Command|Description|Permission| |:---|:---|:---|:---| |Player|/chat |Assigns you to a chat|chatsplus.command.chat.| |Player|/chat off|Unassigns you from a chat|chatsplus.command.off| |Player|/chat mute |Mutes a chat for the player.|chatsplus.command.mute| |Player|/chat unmute |Unmutes a chat for the player.|chatsplus.command.unmute| |Player|/chat help|Shows the list of commands.|chatsplus.command.help| ||||| |Admin|/chat assign |Assigns player to a chat.|chatsplus.command.assign| |Admin|/chat kick |Kicks player from chat they're assigned to.|chatsplus.command.kick| |Admin|/chat reload|Reloads the configs of this plugin.|chatsplus.command.reload| ||||| |Console|chatsystem listChats|Lists up all chats.|-/-| |Console|chatsystem listWorldChats|Lists up all worlds with chat assigned.|-/-| |Console|chatsystem getPlayerChats|Lists up all players who are assigned to a chat.|-/-| |Console|chatsystem reload|Reloads the configs of this plugin.|-/-| ![](https://imgur.com/HbqF5hy.png) |Permission|Default| |:--|:--| |chatsplus.command.*|true| |chatsplus.command.help|true| |chatsplus.command.chat.|true| |chatsplus.command.off|true| |chatsplus.command.mute|true| |chatsplus.command.unmute|true| |chatsplus.command.assign|op| |chatsplus.command.reload|op| |chatsplus.command.kick|op| ||| |chatsplus.admin.*|op| |chatsplus.admin.join|true| |chatsplus.admin.bypass|true| |chatsplus.chat.read.|op| ![](https://imgur.com/2qhgCi4.png)
config.yml ```YAML ############################# # CHATSPLUS by Niestrat99 # ############################# ########### # DEBUG # ########### # Allows the developer to try and find out any possible bugs. debug-mode: false # []>-----------------------------------------------------------------------------<[] ########### # CHATS # ########### # This option allows you to make new chats. Simply add them to the list below. # Each chat, that you create, will automatically have a permission named 'chatsplus.chat.'. # The chats must have sub-settings set up as well, or else it uses default values which may look ugly. # - title = The text that appears in the very front of the message. # - nameTag = The way the player name is displayed. You can make it look like "xXPlayerNameXx" for example. # - messageColor = The color of what the actual message shall appear in. # - ignoreDiscord = This prevents the EssentialsX Discord plugin from sending a message out of this chat into the Discord server, if set to "true". # EXAMPLE: # chats: # vip: # title: '&8[&6VIP&8]' # nameTag: '&8<&6name&8>' # messageColor: '&6' # ignoreDiscord: true # # NOTE: # - The color codes (e.g. &6) are optional, but allow you to make your chats look fancier. # - You MUST have the text "name" included in your nameTag section, or else the player name won't be displayed. chats: staff: title: '&b[&fStaffChat&b]' nameTag: '&b<&fname&b>' messageColor: '&r' ignoreDiscord: true vip: title: '&8[&6VIP&8]' nameTag: '&8<&6name&8>' messageColor: '&6' ignoreDiscord: true # []>-----------------------------------------------------------------------------<[] #################### # PER WORLD CHAT # #################### # In this section, you can assign a chat to a certain world. # If a player joins that world, they'll automatically be assigned to that specific chat. # Just like the chats section, this section also comes with sub configurations: # - chat = The chat that shall be assigned to the world # - isGlobal = Whether the chat shall appear in all worlds or not # - offStandard = If the player shall be put into the assigned that when using /chat off/kick # To assign a chat to a world you do the following: # per-world-chat: # world: # chat: vip # isGlobal: true # offStandard: false # # NOTE: # - The world must match the world's actual name. # - All three sub configurations MUST be included! If not, then the plugin will set default values to it. # - Make sure you're setting a valid chat created in the chats section above, or else the plugin will remove that setting. per-world-chat: world: chat: vip isGlobal: true offStandard: true # []>-----------------------------------------------------------------------------<[] ######################### # ASSIGN CHAT ON JOIN # ######################### # Assigns the joining player to the specified chat, if they have the permission 'chatsplus.admin.join'. # This can be ideal, if you want staff members to be automatically assigned to a staff chat. # It bypasses the Per-World-Chat settings. assign-chat-on-join: "" ```
![](https://imgur.com/y7N568D.png) If you found any issues, got questions or need help with this plugin, then feel free to reach out to me here: - [Discord](https://discord.gg/Jrr6veTNGF) - [Github Issue Tracker](https://github.com/Niestrat99/ChatsPlus/issues)

body:
**Cobblemon is an alternate Unofficial Fork of the Cobblemon Fabric Pack that's slightly more user friendly, including additions like Wraith's Waystones and Traveller's Backpack.**

# 

![Time To Explore!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/VqzM1npM/images/252aac46b4a0d6ba2f081265d41af54dfebda0b2.jpeg)


This alternate Cobblemon modpack is designed to be an even more immersive Minecraft experience than the official Cobblemon pack, with extra quality of life mods such as [Traveler's Backpack](https://modrinth.com/mod/travelersbackpack), and [Wraith Waystones](https://modrinth.com/mod/fwaystones) to make your gameplay less stressful and easier. Also included (but disabled by default) are 2 shaderpacks, [Shrimple](https://modrinth.com/shader/shrimple), and [BSL Shaders](https://modrinth.com/shader/bsl-shaders), which can really make your world come alive (with the expense of being taxing on your system). This pack is also designed to be no more straining on your system than the standard pack, so it can be enjoyed by everyone.

# What Cobblemon Includes:
- Capture Pokémon to expand your team, battle wild Pokémon to gain experience, level up to unlock new moves, and evolve your Pokémon. There are over 600 Pokémon to catch!
- Battles using the [Pokémon Showdown!](https://pokemonshowdown.com) engine for accurate competitive battle mechanics.
- Some Legends Arceus-style mechanics, such as move relearning, physically running from battle, and evolving your Pokémon when you decide.
- Toggle free-movement during battles. You can build, mine, or fight mobs while in Pokémon battles!
- You can trade and battle with your friends in multiplayer.
- Let your Pokémon roam free wherever you want using pastures! You can finally enjoy having your Pokémon out with you in the world.
- Apricorn trees in 7 colors. Harvest apricorns by right-clicking them, and each harvest has a chance to also drop a seed that can grow a new tree. You can use bone meal on apricorns too!
- Berries which can be found in the wild, grown on farmland, and cross-bred to mutate new berries. You can also use mulches to affect how berries grow.
- Some new crops that can be grown to craft healing items and foods. They're found in many different places and grow in many different ways.
- Medicine items can be created by putting crops and berries into a brewing stand. Brewed potions heal more!
- Ancient structures in the world to discover. Some of these structures have gilded chests, which may contain valuable loot or other surprises!
- Fossils can be found by excavating suspicious gravel or sand at certain locations, which can then be revived using a ressurection machine.
- All Pokémon from generations 1 to 9 can be spawned and battled with, but if they don't have a model yet then they will display as a substitute doll.
- Support for many biome mods, including [Terralith](https://modrinth.com/mod/terralith), [Oh The Biomes You'll Go](https://modrinth.com/mod/biomesyougo), and [William Wythers' Overhauled Overworld](https://modrinth.com/mod/wwoo). There's a growing list of others with support too!
- Full support for custom variations and fakemon using data packs and resource packs. You can find out how to do it using [cobblemons' guide](https://cobblemon.com/guides/custompokemon.html)!

***... and many more to come!***

- [Accurate Block Placement Reborn](https://modrinth.com/mod/accurate-block-placement-reborn) - Allows for smooth bedrock-like placement mechanics

title: The Helminth
description: reworks enchanting in minecraft
body:
#### Core Features:

- **Unlock to Craft:**
  - Enchantments are locked by default and can only be crafted once they have been unlocked through gameplay.

- **Grimoire Tracking:**
  - Unlocked enchantments are stored in a special Grimoire, which provides essential details such as crafting recipes and effects.
  - Grimoires automatically update per player. When shared, a Grimoire instantly syncs with the recipient’s current unlocks.

- **Tiered Enchanting System:**
  - Enchantments are divided into tiers, each requiring specific conditions to craft, using the **Helminth**—a specialized crafting station.

- **Soul Swapping System:**
  - Players can use "souls" to modify the enchantments on their items:
    - **Removing Enchantments:** Unwanted enchantments can be removed.
    - **Swapping Enchantments:** Existing enchantments can be swapped with others the player has unlocked.
    - **Applying Enchantments:** Apply specific enchantments using the Helminth with fixed recipes, ensuring precise customization rather than random outcomes.

- **Multiplayer Compatibility:**
  - Player progress, including unlocked enchantments and customizations, is stored using UUID-based storage, ensuring smooth gameplay across multiplayer servers.

---

#### Additional Features:

- **New Custom Particle Effects:**
  - **Bleeding Edge Particle:** A unique bleeding slash effect triggered by specific enchantments, like Bleeding Edge.

- **New Enchantments:**
  - **Shadow Step:** Grants invisibility while sprinting.
  - **Golden Skin:** Replaces the last two hearts with golden ones that never perish and instantly regenerate.
  - **Resonance:** Links hit entities together, causing chain damage when any linked entity is struck.
  - **Seismic Wave:** Creates a destructive wave upon smash-hitting an entity, lifting blocks and dealing dismantling damage to any entity within it.
  - **Potion Master:** Randomly applies either a positive or negative potion effect when attacking.
  - **Witherborn:** Applies the Wither effect when sneaking, triggers an explosion near the nearest entity affected by Wither, clears all Wither effects from nearby entities, and also applies Wither to the player.
  - **Flashlight:** Grants night vision and darkness effects when entering a dark area.
  - **Bleeding Edge:** An enchantment exclusive to netherite hoes that significantly damages the user but deals increased area-of-effect damage to victims.
  - **Auto-Scaffold:** Automatically places scaffolding blocks when sneak-jumping.

- **Essences & Cosmetic Effects:**
  - **Essence Collection:** Collect various essences, like those from the Void, Cherry Trees, Dragon, Gold, Amethyst, Water, Lava, End, Emerald, and Netherite. These can be used to unlock cosmetic enhancements, such as unique arrow trails and particle effects when walking or hitting entities.

---

#### Configuration Options:

- **Villager Trades for Enchantments (Default: Off):**
  - Toggle villager trading for enchantments.
  - **Command:** `scoreboard players set #villager_trades_enchants helminth 1`

- **Enchanting Table Functionality (Default: Off):**
  - Toggle the functionality of the enchanting table.
  - **Command:** `scoreboard players set #ench_table_works helminth 1`

- **Item Breakage During Soul Swapping (Default: On):**
  - Toggle the possibility of items breaking while using the Soul Swapping system.
  - **Command:** `scoreboard players set #item_can_break helminth 0`

- **Mending Removal:**
  - Removes the functionality of the Mending enchantment from the game, making it impossible to use for repairing items.

title: No Zombie Villagers
description: Replace Zombie Villager Spawns with Zombies 1% to 100% of the time.   Separate Spawner Cage and Natural Spawn percentages.
body:
This mod lets you control the rate zombie villagers spawn in the world.  The Spawner Cage in the banner was configured with a zombie villager egg.   This can be used to make it harder for players to get Zombie villagers in your modpack.

## Configuration Options

s oddsSpawnerJustZombie

This is the percentage a spawnercage spawned zombie villager will spawn as a zombie instead.  

s oddsNaturalJustZombie

This is the percentage a naturally spawned zombie villager will spawn as a zombie instead. 



This is a *server*/Modpack utility.  It's only needed on the server.  In a modpack, it needs to be on the client side for single player and Lan games.  



Why I wrote it.   Our Patron, Averse Thule, The creator of Avese Thule Homebrew wanted zombie villagers to be rare.  However several of the new structures from cool structure mods had pure zombie villager spawners... creating a dozen villagers per minute.  Averse tried to handle it manually and removed some structures but things kept popping up with villager spawners.



So we are running this at 96% to replace spawner zombie villagers that spawn with zombies on our live server.   And replacement of natural zombie villagers at 0%.  



Next up is a mod to stop boat cheese (HarderMonsterBoats) by letting you control which hostile mobs get into boats, if they get out of boats when hit, and even if some will break boats.

title: Munchables
description: A simple, light-weight, and data-driven API for adjusting eat times in Minecraft!
body:
Deprecated due to item components having this feature in 1.20.5+


A simple, light-weight, and data-driven API for adjusting eat times in Minecraft!



## FAQ ### Is this compatible with X mod? Most likely yes! This mod is fully compatible with most food mods. Note that a specific food item would not be compatible if it adds a custom eat time WITHOUT using this API. ## How To Use 1. create a data pack 2. create the folder `namespace/munchables` 3. In the new folder, create a json file named `item_id.json` 4. Have the json file follow the following schema: ``` { "replace": boolean // if set to true, will override the entry item if it already exists "eatTime": int // the time in ticks it takes to eat the item } ``` This example would change the eat time for the item: `namespace:item_id` Still not sure how to use it? See the Wiki for a more detailed walk through or contact us via the contact options on our github page. ## License This project is under an MIT license

title: Relative XP
description: Relativizes the costs of enchanting and anvil combining.
body:
Relativizes the costs of enchanting and anvil combining.

- Enchanting tables consume the points cost between the minimum required level and the subtraction of the level cost
  - For example, a level 30 enchant requiring 3 levels will cost 306 points (points between level 27 and 30)
- Anvils consume the  points cost between level 0 and the level cost
  - For example, an 8 level operation will cost 112 points (points between level 0 and 8)

title: Ultimate Reports
description: A simple yet complete Player Reports plugin for Minecraft, with cross-server and Discord support.
body:
# UltimateReports - Advanced Player Reporting System UltimateReports is a light-weight, high-performance **player report plugin** for Minecraft servers. It offers seamless cross-server synchronization and full **Discord integration**. Developed with optimization in mind, all database operations are **asynchronous** to ensure zero lag for your players.

![Discord Integration and Logs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/163f5d441b2112c81ce92f2c288cec7bf049a8ac.png)
[Check the Images Gallery for more previews!](https://modrinth.com/plugin/ultimate-reports/gallery) ## 🚀 Key Features ### 🌐 Cross-Server Synchronization (Bungee/Velocity) The plugin synchronizes data in real-time between proxied servers. Using **MySQL/MariaDB** and a message broker, your moderation team can handle reports from any server in the network.
### 💬 Advanced Discord Integration Bring your moderation to Discord. You can configure UltimateReports to: * Send simple **Webhooks** for new reports. * Run a full **Discord Bot** to manage and update reports directly from your Discord server.
### ⚡ Optimized Performance Written from scratch to be lightweight. It supports extensive database options with async connections: * **H2** (Default, preferred over SQLite) * **MariaDB** (Recommended for performance) * MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQLite.
## 🛠️ Moderation Tools * **Interactive GUIs:** View, manage, and resolve reports entirely in-game via a clean inventory interface. * **Minecraft Dialogs:** Utilizes the new dialogs feature for supported versions. * **Reward System:** Encourage community reporting by configuring rewards for players who submit valid reports. * **Punishment System:** Prevent spam by putting players on cooldown if they abuse the report command. * **PlaceholderAPI Support:** Integrated placeholders available out of the box. * **Full Customization:** Every message and setting is configurable.

## 📜 Commands & Permissions ### Player Commands * `/report [reason]` - Submit a new report against a player. ### Admin Commands (`/reports`) Manage the moderation queue efficiently: * `/reports check ` - Open the **GUI manager** for a specific report. * `/reports comment [comment]` - Add staff notes to a report. * `/reports notify` - Toggle staff notifications on/off. * `/reports cooldown ` - Manage cooldowns for specific players. --- **Thank you for choosing UltimateReports!** *Need help? Check the [Documentation](https://ultimatereports.gitbook.io/ultimatereports-docs/) or open an issue on [GitHub](https://github.com/xF3d33/UltimateReports/issues).*
