title: Voice Bridge
description: Bridges Plasmo Voice and Simple Voice Chat on the server side
body:
# Voice Bridge

A server-side [Paper](https://papermc.io/) plugin that bridges proximity voice chat
between [Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat)
and [Plasmo Voice](https://modrinth.com/plugin/plasmo-voice), allowing players using different voice mods to hear each
other.

## How it works

Both Simple Voice Chat (SVC) and Plasmo Voice (PV) encode audio with Opus at 48 kHz, mono, 20 ms frames. Voice Bridge
intercepts audio packets from each mod's API and relays them to the other — no transcoding required. The result is
low-latency, cross-mod proximity voice chat with minimal CPU overhead.

```
SVC Player ──► SVC API ──► Voice Bridge ──► PV API ──► PV Player
PV Player  ──► PV API  ──► Voice Bridge ──► SVC API ──► SVC Player
```

## Requirements

- Paper 1.21.4+ (or Folia)
- Java 21+
- [Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat) (server-side plugin)
- [Plasmo Voice](https://modrinth.com/plugin/plasmo-voice) (server-side plugin)

## Installation

1. Install both Simple Voice Chat and Plasmo Voice on your Paper server
2. Download `voice-bridge-<version>.jar`
3. Place it in your server's `plugins/` directory
4. Restart the server

## Building from source

```shell
./gradlew build
```

The plugin jar will be in `build/libs/`.

### Running a dev server

```shell
# With Mojang mappings (for debugging)
./gradlew runDevBundleServer

# With obfuscation (production-like)
./gradlew runServer
```

## Configuration

A `config.yml` is generated on first run in `plugins/voice-bridge/`:

```yaml
bridge:
  enabled: true       # Enable/disable the bridge
  debug: false        # Enable debug logging

proximity:
  default-distance: 48.0      # Default voice range in blocks
  whisper-multiplier: 0.33    # Whisper range = distance * multiplier
  max-distance: 128.0         # Maximum allowed voice distance

audio:
  passthrough: true            # Opus passthrough (recommended)
  force-transcode: false       # Force transcoding (not yet implemented)
```

### Per-world distance overrides

You can override the default voice distance for specific worlds:

```yaml
proximity:
  world-overrides:
    world_nether: 24.0
    world_the_end: 64.0
```

## Commands

| Command                        | Description                             |
|--------------------------------|-----------------------------------------|
| `/voicebridge status`          | Show bridge status, metrics, and config |
| `/voicebridge players`         | List active bridged sessions            |
| `/voicebridge reload`          | Reload configuration                    |
| `/voicebridge debug [on\|off]` | Toggle debug logging                    |

Alias: `/vb`

Permission: `voicebridge.admin` (default: op)

## Architecture

```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              VoiceBridgePlugin                 │
├───────────┬───────────┬────────────┬───────────┤
│ SvcAdapter│ PvAdapter │ AudioRelay │  Session  │
│           │           │            │  Manager  │
├───────────┴───────────┴────────────┴───────────┤
│  SpatialMapper │ BridgeConfig │ BridgeMetrics  │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

- **SvcAdapter** — integrates with Simple Voice Chat via `VoicechatPlugin`
- **PvAdapter** — integrates with Plasmo Voice via `@Addon` / `AddonInitializer`
- **AudioRelay** — central router that forwards audio frames between adapters
- **SessionManager** — tracks which mod each player is using
- **SpatialMapper** — converts between SVC float distances and PV short distances

## Known limitations

- Group/channel bridging is not supported (proximity chat only)
- Transcoding mode is not yet implemented (passthrough only)
- SVC-only players may not receive audio from PV players in some edge cases

title: Skill Tree
description: This mod allows players to unlock new abilities and perks by progressing through a visually interactive skill tree.
body:
# Skill Tree (Fabric)

[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache%202.0-blue.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/Apache-2.0)
[![Fabric](https://img.shields.io/badge/Loader-Fabric-beige)](https://fabricmc.net/)
[![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.20-green)](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_1.20)
[![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/dnC6tCcs?color=00AF5C&logo=modrinth&label=Downloads)](https://modrinth.com/mod/skill-tree-(fabric))
[![CurseForge Downloads](https://img.shields.io/curseforge/dt/1397099?logo=curseforge&label=Downloads)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/skill-tree-fabric)

Turn your Experience into Permanent Power.

Skill Tree (by JammingDino) completely overhauls how you view Experience Points in Minecraft. Instead of hoarding levels only to lose them in a lava pit, use them to unlock permanent passive abilities, stat boosts, and unique game-changing mechanics.

To get started, simply craft and place a **Skill Altar**, then right-click it to open the radial skill menu. From there, you can spend your collected Experience Points to unlock permanent passive abilities that persist even after death. These upgrades range from basic stat boosts and faster mining speed to unique mechanics like moving swiftly through lava or pulling enemies towards you with every hit. To access more powerful, higher-tier skills, you will simply need to upgrade your Altar to better materials like Iron, Diamond, or Obsidian.

---

![JammingDino on BisectHosting – Banner](https://www.bisecthosting.com/partners/custom-banners/3d19e63b-6b0c-4929-bf81-479d7e23e5c2.webp)

---

[Bisect Hosting - JammingDino](https://www.bisecthosting.com/JammingDino)

## Key Features

- **Radial Skill System:** A beautiful, easy-to-navigate circular skill tree interface.  
- **Skill Altars:** Craft tiered Altars (Iron, Diamond, Emerald, Obsidian) to access the skill tree. Higher tiers unlock more advanced skills.  
- **Permanent Progression:** Unlocked skills remain with you even after death.  
- **XP Points System:** Costs are calculated in raw XP points, allowing for fine-tuned balancing.

---

## Abilities & Effects

This isn’t just about adding +1 Heart. The mod supports a wide range of dynamic effects (more to come...):

### Passive Skills

- **Attribute Modifiers:** Boost Max Health, Movement Speed, Attack Damage, and more.  
- **Mining Speed:** Break blocks faster.  
- **Movement Mastery:** Swim faster in water or walk quickly through Lava.  
- **Combat Mechanics:** Modify your Knockback. Push enemies further away, or use negative knockback to pull enemies toward you!  
- **Enchantment Mastery:** Add permanent enchantment levels to your gear (even breaking vanilla limits).  
- **XP Multipliers:** Permanently boost the amount of experience you gain from all sources.

### Actions

- **Command Execution:** Run any vanilla or modded Minecraft command automatically. Supports placeholders like `@p` (player name) and `%x% %y% %z%` (event coordinates).

#### Action Types

- **On Block Break:** Fire an action immediately when you mine a block.  
- **On Block Place:** Fire an action immediately when you place a block or interact with a surface.

#### Conditions

*   **Conditional Skills:** Create complex passive or active skills that only work when specific criteria are met.
*   **Item Requirements:** Restrict effects based on what the player is holding in their **Mainhand** or **Offhand** (e.g., "Gain +50% Mining Speed, but only when holding a Golden Pickaxe"). With support for Count and NBT data.
*   **Equipped Armor:** Requires wearing specific armor pieces (with NBT support).
*   **Health:** Check if health is Greater/Less/Equal to a specific amount.
*   **Hunger:** Check food level.
*   **Armor Value:** Check total armor points.
*   **Dimension:** Restrict skills to the Overworld, Nether, End, or modded dimensions.
*   **Y-Level:** Activate skills only at specific heights (e.g., "Mining Speed only below Y=0").
*   **Walking On Block:** Requires standing on a specific block type.
*   **Time of Day:** Activate effects only during the day or night.
*   **Fluid State:** Check if the player is **Wet** or **In Lava**.
  
---

## For Mod Developers: Built-in Editor

Skill Tree is 100% data-driven. This means if you want to create your own skills, you don’t even need to use JSON — you can simply use the built-in Developer Skill Altar block in-game to start building custom skills in real time.

1. Place a **Developer Skill Altar**.  
2. Open the GUI to access the In-Game Skill Editor.  
3. Design your skill (Name, Icon, Cost, Prerequisites, Effects).  
4. Click **Export**.  
5. The mod handles the rest — generating the JSON files needed for your modpack or datapack.

> _Note: `"jd_skill_tree"` is the internal ID for JammingDino’s Skill Tree mod._  
> If you plan to use this mod in a modpack/datapack, make sure to correctly mark Skill Tree (Fabric) as an optional or required dependency in your config files.

---

## Links & Source

- **Source Code & Issue Tracker:** GitHub Repository (check this for more info on datapack/mod creation)  
- **Report Bugs:** Please report any issues on the GitHub Issues page.

> The mod is still in active development — expect features to be completely reworked or changed without warning. If you have ideas for new features, feel free to open an issue labelled “enhancement” or leave a comment on the GitHub page.  
> At the moment, the mod is geared toward use in modpacks or specialized projects, but I plan to gradually expand the set of default skills to be more generic and useful across a wide variety of modpacks.

---

## Installation

Requires `Fabric API` and `owo-lib`.  
Simply drop the `.jar` file into your `mods` folder.

title: The Witch Hut
description: Adds a witch hut randomly generating in the world, could contain loot !!!
body:
Description: Witch Huts Expanded is a structure and atmosphere enhancement mod that adds fully handcrafted witch huts to the Minecraft world. These huts generate naturally in swamp biomes, dark forests, and other locations associated with magic or eerie ambience. Each hut features custom interiors filled with detailed furniture, potion-crafting equipment, magical decorations, and environmental storytelling elements that help make each location feel unique and lived-in.

The mod introduces several types of witches, each with their own personality and behavior. Some witches are hostile and protect their territory fiercely, others remain neutral unless provoked, and rare special witches act as magical traders who offer unique potions, rare ingredients, and enchanted items not found in standard village trades. These interactions give players more reasons to explore and revisit these structures.

Every witch hut contains a randomized loot table that may include potion ingredients, enchanted books, spell components, ritual items, alchemy materials, and other magic-related valuables. Some huts may also include hidden compartments or secret chests containing rarer treasures.

Beyond the structures themselves, the mod aims to enrich world exploration by adding lore, environmental hints, and subtle worldbuilding touches that make the witch huts feel naturally integrated into their biomes. The design goal is to expand Minecraft’s magical atmosphere without breaking the game's vanilla style.

The mod is compatible with a wide range of Minecraft versions and can be used with NeoForge, Forge, or Fabric mod loaders. It is lightweight, performance-friendly, and designed to work well alongside biome, magic, and world-generation mods.




### ⭐ Features (text-first, accessible) - **Spawns:** Witch huts generate in **Swamps** and other **magic-touched biomes**. - **Witches:** Each hut includes a witch NPC. Behaviors vary — some are **hostile**, some **neutral**, and rare witches may act as **magical traders**. - **Loot:** Huts contain **randomized magical loot** such as spell books, enchanted potions, and potion ingredients.

### 📥 Installation (plain text) **Supported Minecraft versions:** 1.16.5, 1.17.1, 1.18.2, 1.19.2, 1.19.4, 1.20.1, 1.20.4, 1.20.6, 1.21.1, 1.21.4, 1.21.5, 1.21.8 **Works with:** NeoForge • Forge • Fabric

title: Resource Generator
description: A server side resource generator mod
body:
# Resource Generator

This is a server side mod to place resource generators. Suitable for minigames, skyblock and so on.

## Configuration

This mod use command `/resgen` to control, need permission 0 in local game and permission 2 on dedicated server.

`/resgen <pos> add|remove|info|list|highlight`

- `...add <interval> (item <item> <count>|itemTag <tag>|block <block state>|blockTag <tag>|lootTable <loot table>`

Place a resource generator.

Note: For block & block tag, interval is count after broken the block.

- `...remove`

Remove a resource generator.

- `...info`

Get all info of a specific generator.

- `...list (chunk|range <distance>`

List generators in specific range.

- `...highlight (chunk|range <distance>`

Highlight generators with particles in specific range.

title: Scoreboard pay
description: Pay by scoreboard 1.18+ Paper Spigot Bukkit
body:
# 💰 PayCommand

![Paper](https://img.shields.io/badge/API-Paper%2FSpigot%2FBukkit-blue)
![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.18--1.21.5-green)
![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow)
![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Version-1.0-lightgrey)

---

## 🌍 English Description

**PayCommand** — a lightweight plugin that adds a `/pay` command using the **Minecraft scoreboard** as a currency system.

When launched for the first time, the plugin automatically creates:

plugins/PayCommand/config.yml

You can edit all text messages and the scoreboard name inside this file.

✅ Works on **Paper**, **Spigot**, and **Bukkit** servers  
✅ Supports **Minecraft 1.18+**

### 💸 Command:
/pay <nickname> <amount>

---

## 🇷🇺 Описание на русском

**PayCommand** — лёгкий плагин, добавляющий команду `/pay`,  
которая использует **scoreboard** в качестве системы перевода денег между игроками.

При первом запуске плагин автоматически создаёт:

plugins/PayCommand/config.yml

Ты можешь менять любые тексты и имя scoreboard в этом файле.

✅ Работает на **Paper**, **Spigot**, и **Bukkit**  
✅ Поддержка **Minecraft 1.18+**

### 💸 Команда:
/pay <ник> <число>

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

```yaml
# Example config.yml

# Scoreboard objective name
scoreboard-name: Money

# Messages
messages:
  only-player: "&cThis command is available only to players!"
  no-permission: "&cYou do not have permission to use this command!"
  usage: "&eUsage: /pay <player> <amount>"
  player-not-found: "&cPlayer not found!"
  self-pay: "&cYou cannot transfer money to yourself!"
  valid-number: "&cEnter a valid number!"
  valid-amount: "&cAmount must be greater than 0!"
  not-enough: "&cInsufficient funds!"
  send: "&aYou transferred &e%amount% &acoins to player &e%target%!"
  received: "&6You received &e%amount% &6coins from &e%player%!"
```
## 🔑 Permissions
Permission	                Description
paycommand.use	Allows the player to use the /pay command

If you use LuckPerms, give access with:


```
/lp user <player> permission set paycommand.use true
```


🧩 Compatibility
Minecraft Version	Paper	Spigot	Bukkit
1.18 – 1.21.5	     ✅	      ✅	  ✅

## 🧱 Installation
- Download the latest PayCommand.jar
  
- Place it into your server’s plugins folder
  
- Start the server — a config file will be generated
  
- Edit config.yml to customize messages and scoreboard

## 🧠 Notes
The plugin uses the Minecraft scoreboard system to store player balances

Make sure you have a scoreboard objective created (Money by default)

Compatible with most scoreboard-based economy setups

## 🧾 License
This project is licensed under the MIT License.
You can freely use, modify, and include it in your server packs.

![Banner 1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a9200b5654b9dbd94dfd289a894f5bc5aba48da9_0.webp)
## About This Modpack
This modpack is designed to give you an immersive Minecraft and Cobblemon experience with improved visuals, audio, and environmental sceneries using Shaders, Tectonic, and Seasons. This pack also adds several building, exploration, equipment, QOL, and perfomance improving mods to give you the best experience. The primary focus of this pack is Cobblemon, with many addons to get the most out of the Cobblemon mod, using addons for 200+ pokemon, legendary structures, trainer battles, and a progressive gym leader battle system using Radical Cobblemon Trainers. Designed to give you that nostalgic Pokemon feeling with Vanilla+ features. Designed by the BlazeCraft server.

**This pack's goal is to stay as up to date as possible with the Official Cobblemon Mod. The current version is Cobblemon 1.6. Some mods may end up being removed depending on how up to date those mods are or if they become archived.**

## Features
Cobblemon with many addons that include missing features from the base mod.

Tom's Simple Storage.

Thousands of new building and decoration items with variations for slabs, stairs, walls and vertical slabs :D

Several of YUNG's better structure/ dimension mods.

Several mods to help with stability and performance.

Several mods to add immersive sounds, visuals, and biomes.

Before we begin, it is mandatory you increase your RAM allocation:

- 2GB - No, just No - This WILL crash your game, don't bother.

- 6GB - Recommended - This is the optimum amount of RAM for running medium sized modpacks(~100 mods) to large sized modpacks(200+ mods).

title: TumiTranslator
description: Displays different messages depending on the language of each player
body:
# TumiTranslator

Add rich translations to you Minecraft Server or Proxy

## Installation
- Install [MiniPlaceholders](https://modrinth.com/plugin/miniplaceholders)
- Drag and drop on your plugins folder
- Start the server

## Features
- Add the translations you want, and use them anywhere on your server.
- Support for MiniPlaceholders placeholders. (Full support anywhere for global placeholders; 
for player placeholders, requires plugins compatible with MiniMessage using the latest version)

## Placeholders

In addition to providing translations that can be used anywhere on your server,
TumiTranslator also provides placeholders for using your translations.
This is the recommended way to use translations, usable in plugins compatible with MiniPlaceholders.

- `<tumi_translation:"tumi.welcome">`

Returns a translation in the language of the target/executor.
If the translation does not exist in the specified language,
it will attempt to use the translation in the configured default language.

![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/SpH1UuKm/images/6dc93e5f95816b0963159d37f1466ef058367c3d.png)

- `<tumi_translation_by_locale:"tumi.welcome":ES>`

Returns a translation in the specified language.
If the translation does not exist in the specified language,
it will attempt to use the translation in the default language configured.

![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/SpH1UuKm/images/3c39bfb4a252aca38ac87559e4394df1d0aa7ea1.png)

## Usage in General Translations

The recommended use of TumiTranslator is through its MiniPlaceholders placeholders.
But if you want to use them anywhere else, it is possible. Here are some examples.

Please note that player placeholders are not yet supported in this way of displaying placeholders.
[This feature will be applied to MiniMessage in future versions.](https://github.com/KyoriPowered/adventure/pull/1300)

### Lang Tag

- `<lang:"tumi.welcome":ES>`

![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/SpH1UuKm/images/b8b08bdee11d9b2d46518eaf6ef15255fb24970c.png)

## Videos

#### TumiTranslator with Velocitab

[![Watch the video](https://img.youtube.com/vi/YSyx6R2_hK0/maxresdefault.jpg)](https://youtu.be/YSyx6R2_hK0)

#### TumiTranslator with VCustomBrand

[![Watch the video](https://img.youtube.com/vi/1Me2Cw_1hHI/maxresdefault.jpg)](https://youtu.be/1Me2Cw_1hHI)

Support is exclusively for those who have purchased the plugin from BuiltByBit or Polymart. You will be given a role on my Discord server with access to an exclusive channel.

The days as Halloween draws closer, it weakens down even further. ![eyes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JackOfNoneTrades/EyesInTheShadows/master/images/eyes.gif) [![hub](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JackOfNoneTrades/EyesInTheShadows/master/images/badges/github.png)](https://github.com/JackOfNoneTrades/EyesInTheShadows/releases) [![modrinth](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JackOfNoneTrades/EyesInTheShadows/master/images/badges/modrinth.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/eyes-in-the-shadows) [![curse](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JackOfNoneTrades/EyesInTheShadows/master/images/badges/curse.png)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/eyes-in-the-shadows) [![maven](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JackOfNoneTrades/EyesInTheShadows/master/images/badges/maven.png)](https://maven.fentanylsolutions.org/#/releases/org/fentanylsolutions/eyesintheshadows/EyesInTheShadows) ![forge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JackOfNoneTrades/EyesInTheShadows/master/images/badges/forge.png) [![cord](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JackOfNoneTrades/EyesInTheShadows/master/images/badges/cord.png)](https://discord.gg/xAWCqGrguG) If you see the eyes, don't turn away from them.

Or do, at your own risk.
You have been warned. ![caves](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JackOfNoneTrades/EyesInTheShadows/master/images/screenshots/cave.png) ## Dependencies * [UniMixins](https://modrinth.com/mod/unimixins) [![curse](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JackOfNoneTrades/EyesInTheShadows/master/images/icons/curse.png)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/unimixins) [![modrinth](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JackOfNoneTrades/EyesInTheShadows/master/images/icons/modrinth.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/unimixins/versions) [![git](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JackOfNoneTrades/EyesInTheShadows/master/images/icons/git.png)](https://github.com/LegacyModdingMC/UniMixins/releases) ## FAQ ### What is this? It is a backport of the [Eyes in the Darkness](https://github.com/gigaherz/EyesInTheDarkness/blob/master/LICENSE.txt) mod, originally created by [gigaherz](https://github.com/gigaherz). [Support him on Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/gigaherz). Please DO NOT report any issues or send any requests concerning this port to gigaherz, open an issue here instead.
Original mod showcase by Mischief of Mice:
[![Original mod showcase by Mischief of Mice](https://img.youtube.com/vi/JxcLQwxwgyw/0.jpg)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JxcLQwxwgyw)

description: A post-processing shader that applies a low exposure effect to your game. (completely customizable!)

# Low Exposure

Transform your Minecraft world with a moody, cinematic aesthetic inspired by underexposed photography.

## What it does

This shader mod applies real-time color grading to create that classic **underexposed look** - darker tones, enhanced contrast, and desaturated colors for a more dramatic and atmospheric visual experience.

The shader adjusts:
- **Brightness** - Subtle darkening for richer shadows
- **Contrast** - Boosted contrast for more dramatic lighting
- **Saturation** - Muted colors using proper perceptual luminance calculations

Perfect for players who want a more cinematic, moody atmosphere without the performance impact of complex lighting shaders.

## Features

- ⚡ Lightweight post-processing shader
- 🔧 Configurable settings for fine-tuning (down to the luminance perception value [RGB only])

## Requirements

- **NeoForge 1.21.1**
- **Veil 1.2.0** or higher (get the veil-bundled version if you don't want to install Veil)
- **Fzzy Config 0.6.0** or higher

## Installation

1. Install the required dependencies listed above
2. Download and place the mod file in your `mods` folder
3. Launch the game and enjoy the new atmospheric look!

title: Alternate End
description: A mod that reworks the way you adquire ender eyes
body:
This mod seeks to rework how you arrive to the end, inestead of going to the end by crafting up ender eyes, these must now be adquired via defeating bosses.

**Note: If when updating this mod you start crashing, try to delete the configuration file. Config file changes can cause crashes if your older file is outdataded!**

**This mod does NOT add any bosses by itself. Its heavily recommended that you install other mods to go along with it to add bosses and register them on the config!
**
Also check this mod out on [Curseforge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/alternate-end)

# **Features**

- This mod will disable the traditional recipe to craft ender eyes
- Bosses will now drop ender eyes upon death

Note: Although this mod adds the ability for bosses to drop ender eyes it does NOT add any bosses by itself, meaning this mod is designed to be installed in a modpack with several bosses

# **Configuration Guide**

Upon launching the game with this mod installed, a file will be created in .minecraft > config called "AlternateEndConfig" which should contain the following


```

[Bosses]
	Bosses = "minecraft:enderdragon, minecraft:wither"
	"Boss Display Name" = "Example, Example"

```


in order to configure which entities are considered "bosses" by the mod you must use either one of these options.


```
	Bosses = "minecraft:enderdragon, minecraft:wither"

```

in this field, you may type the bosses registry name. If you do not know the registry name of the boss you can check it in game via the /summon command.


```
"Boss Display Name" = "Example, Example"

```

In this field, you can type the display name of the boss. **this option is not recommended for usage** as it can cause bugs, but was left in for mods that utilize display names over normal entities to determine which of these are bosses.

# **Special Thanks / Credits / Disclaimers**

This mod was made using [MCreator](https://mcreator.net/), special thanks to the MCreator team for making this all possible.


This is one of my first mods ever done, originally created for a modpack in between me and a friend alongside a few others which i decided to share for the first time. If there are any bugs found contact me and ill attempt to fix them if possible!


If you want to support me, you may donate to my [Buy me a coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/magythemage) page, any kind of support is welcome but not necesary.

title: KeepResourcePackOnProxiedServerSwitch
description: Prevent proxied server switched from reloading resources twice -> not at all
body:
# Dankness

tldr: **Instead of seeing the resource reloading screen _twice_ sometimes when switching a proxied server with a network-wide pack, you _won't see it at all_.**

1.20.2 introduced a new protocol phase, being the configuration phase. In it, you can send the client resource packs
*before* they enter the world and also better communicate server switches. Unfortunately, the 1.20.2 client forcefully
unloads the current resource pack, which means on server networks with network-wide resource packs, the pack will have
to be resent on every server switch, resulting in *two* loading screens.

... This mod hackily "fixes" that by just not reloading the resource manager when re-entering the configuration phase,
as well as ignoring packs that have the same hash as the already loaded one.

## Even less loading
If you want to get rid of the resource pack fade effects and other screens, you might want to check out this as well: https://modrinth.com/mod/forcecloseworldloadingscreen

title: Location Logger
description: Allows the logging of players locations
body:
Location Logger logs the XYZ coordinates and current dimension of all players currently within the server and sends it to console at a set period, the default is 10 minutes. There is also a command to forcibly log everyone or to log a specific person.

If you have a problem or suggestion for the plugin, make sure to check out the [GitHub](https://github.com/1ByteBit/Player-Location-Logger)! (Currently, this plugin only works on paper and its forks)

### Commands:

/loglocations
/locations
/forcelog
- Permission: locationlog.forcelog
- Optional argument: <player>
- Logs all player locations before the set timer

/logadd <player>
- Permission: locationlog.listadd
- Adds specified player to the whitelist/blacklist

/logremove <player>
- Permission: locationlog.listremove
- Removes specified player to the whitelist/blacklist

/setlisttype <whitelist/blacklist>
/changelisttype <whitelist/blacklist>
- Permission: locationlog.setlisttype
- Changes between blacklist/whitelist

### Misc Permissions:

locationlog.viewlog
- People with this permission will be able to see the log of any specific person with /forcelog (This doesn't give them permission to use that command)

locationlog.viewautolog
- Not granted to OPs
- People with this permission will be able to see the automated logs in-game (May lead to spammy messages)

locationlog.exempt
- Not granted to OPs
- People with this permission won't be logged by the automated logger

### Default Config:
```
version: 1
# Don't touch the version number
settings:
  checkhours: 0
  checkminutes: 10
  checkseconds: 0
  # Setting all to zero will disable the automatic logger
  # Default is 10 minutes
  listtype: blacklist
  # Whether to use a blacklist or a whitelist, default is blacklist.
  # Blacklist prevents players from being logged, if whitelist is enabled then only specified people are logged
  shorten-log: false
  # Shortens the sentences of the logs
  bstats: true
specified-players:
```

title: Lost and Fished
description: Recover your lost valuables by fishing!
body:
Named or enchanted items that despawn in the Overworld will wash away and end up in the world's bodies of water, where they can be recovered by fishing. Certain other items are also preserved. By default, items with durability may be recovered with up to have their remaining durability lost.

All aspects of the mod are configurable, including which kinds of items are captured by the system, the chance to recover one with each fishing attempt, and the odds and severity of items being damaged.

Additionally, the mod adds the tag "lost_found:must_save", which flags certain kinds of items as always protected, even if not renamed or enchanted. By default, this includes:

+ The Dragon Egg
+ Nether Stars
+ Elytras
+ Music Disks

There is also a "lost_found:no_save" tag that will prevent items from being protected, even if they are renamed or enchanted (or on the other tag list). By default, this includes only the Name Tag.

The mod also adds a selection of commands to manage this inventory:
```lost-fished peek```, ```lost-fished retrieve```, ```lost-fished discard top```, and ```lost-fished discard all```. Their functions are all self-explanatory.

# Wynnpelago

An [Archipelago](https://archipelago.gg) client for [Wynncraft](https://wynncraft.com), allowing you to play Wynncraft as part of an Archipelago multiworld.

Wynncraft is a MMORPG featuring a completely custom abilities and combat system, and a large world with lots of content for the player to explore.

> Archipelago is a cross-game modification system which randomizes different games, then uses the result to build a single unified multi-player game.
> Items from one game may be present in another, and you will need your fellow players to find items you need in their games to help you complete your own.
>
> \- *The archipelago.gg homepage*

## Setup

This mod is for the Fabric mod loader version 0.19.1+ and Minecraft version 1.21.11.
This mod also requires [Wynntils](https://modrinth.com/mod/wynntils) and [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) as dependencies.

### Connecting to Archipelago

1. Download and install the Wynnpelago mod from [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/wynnpelago) (or [releases](https://github.com/EpicPuppy613/Wynnpelago/releases)). The mod requires Fabric loader 0.19.1+ and Minecraft 1.21.11.
2. Log in to Wynncraft. Wynntils should provide a button to do this from the main menu.
3. Create a new character. Ironman mode is recommended, but not required.
4. The tutorial is optional; run `/skiptutorial` to skip it.
5. Run `/archipelago connect <host> <port> <slot> [password]` to connect to an Archipelago server.

If you are playing in a multiworld, and are not the one hosting, contact whoever's hosting and ask them for instructions.
If you are hosting the multiworld, or playing solo, follow these instructions:

1. Download the [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases/latest) software
2. Download the latest [Wynncraft APWorld](https://github.com/EpicPuppy613/Wynncraft-APWorld/releases)
3. In Archipelago Launcher, import the Wynncraft .apworld
4. Use the 'Options Creator' tool to choose the randomization options
5. Move all of the .yaml files of everyone playing into the `Players` directory of your Archipelago install
6. Use the 'Generate' tool to generate the multiworld
7. Either upload the multiworld to an online host like https://archipelago.gg (recommended) or host the multiworld yourself
8. Connect to the multiworld in-game by using the command `/archipelago connect`

A more detailed setup guide for Archipelago can be found on the [Archipelago website](https://archipelago.gg/tutorial/Archipelago/setup_en).

### Wynncraft Guild

The level cap requires being in a Wynncraft guild to function properly.
The entire randomizer is still 100% playable without being in a guild.
If you want a guild to join for playing Archipelago, see the linked [message](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1492950679638118481/1498542346407776316) on the Archipelago discord.

## Features

This list uses the following definitions of items and checks:
- A check is where a single, random item is rewarded.
- An item is a single additional feature or thing that is unlocked in Wynncraft.

**Region Lock**
- The vast majority of the Wynncraft world starts locked
- To enter a region, it must first be unlocked by getting an item
- __Entering a region before it is unlocked may kill the player, depending on the game settings__

**Level Limit**
- Max combat level starts at 1
- The limit increases with items
- Note: This is done using Wynncraft's guild experience feature. You will need to be in a Wynncraft guild for this feature to function properly.

**Questsanity**
- Completion of a quest gives a check
- Completion of a mini-quest gives a check

**Cavesanity**
- Completion of a cave for the first time gives a check
- You must meet the minimum level requirement of the cave

**Dungeonsanity**
- Completion of a dungeon for the first time gives a check

## Commands

Wynnpelago provides the following commands to manage the mod and Archipelago connection:

- `/wynnpelago version`: prints the version of Wynnpelago installed
- `/wynnpelago territory borders`: show/hide in-world locked territory borders
- `/archipelago connect <host> <port> <slot> [password]`: connect to a running Archipelago server
- `/archipelago disconnect`: disconnect from the currently connected Archipelago server
- `/ap <message>`: send a message or command through Archipelago

## Wynntils Integration

Wynnpelago uses Wynntils to provide a few convenience features while playing Archipelago.
- **World Map**: Holding control overlays regions on the map (M).
Regions in red are not accessible to the player.
- **Territory Map**: The guild map (J) will show all regions and what regions they connect to.
  - The randomizer will ensure the entire game is beatable by staying within territories connected to Ragni.

title: Beacon Overhaul Revived
description: Introduces a tier system and better effect scaling for beacons.
body:
# Beacon Overhaul Revived

(Original mod by ChloeDawn: [Beacon Overhaul](https://modrinth.com/mod/beaconoverhaul))

If the original author updates their own mod, or wants me to remove this mod. Please notify me.

---
**A mod for Minecraft that introduces a tier system and better effect scaling for beacons**

- Adds night vision, fire resistance, *nutrition*, *long reach*, and slow falling as beacon effects
- Adds a tier system for beacons, with diamond and netherite structures providing progressively increased effect potency
- Adds a higher potency of night vision, allowing the player to see everything with midday lighting (full bright) and no fog effects
- Adds 2 new effects to the game, Long Reach, increasing interaction reach, and Nutrition, passively restoring food levels
- Adds a dropping mechanic to slow falling, allowing sneaking to cause a fall at normal velocity whilst still negating damage
- Adds an increased step height to jump boost, allowing the player to step up blocks instantaneously when the effect is applied
    - Note: Auto-jump takes precedence, and will need to be disabled for this to have any effect

title: Grid Easy
description:
A lightweight 3D grid overlay for precise building, alignment, and per-axis spacing control.

정밀한 건축과 축별 간격 조절을 위한 가볍고 최적화된 3D Grid Overlay 모드입니다.
body:
![3D Grid Overlay in Action](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5aa949fca479e59c8d41ef0b4856aca8f0992fd6_0.webp)

# 🧱 Grid Easy

**Grid Easy** is a lightweight and optimized **3D grid overlay mod** designed for builders who want better precision, cleaner alignment, and more control over spacing in Minecraft.

With an origin-based 3D grid system and independent **X / Y / Z spacing controls**, Grid Easy helps you plan structures, align blocks, visualize space, and build with confidence.

Whether you are working on massive builds, technical structures, city layouts, redstone systems, or detailed interiors, Grid Easy gives you a clean visual guide without unnecessary complexity.

---

## ✨ Why Grid Easy?

Minecraft building often comes down to precision.

🔹 A few blocks off-center can break symmetry.  
🔹 Uneven spacing can ruin a large structure.  
🔹 Vertical alignment can be hard to judge by eye.  
🔹 Large projects are easier when you have a clear visual guide.

**Grid Easy** solves this by giving you a customizable 3D alignment grid directly in your world.

Simple to use.  
Easy to configure.  
Built for builders.

---

## 🚀 Key Features

### 🌐 3D Grid Overlay
- Full **X / Y / Z axis** grid rendering
- Visualize space in three dimensions
- Useful for both horizontal and vertical alignment
- Great for large structures and layered builds

### 📏 Independent Axis Spacing
- Configure **X spacing** independently
- Configure **Y spacing** independently
- Configure **Z spacing** independently
- Perfect for advanced layouts, floors, towers, and technical builds

### 🎯 Origin-Based Alignment
- Grid starts from a defined origin point
- Supports relative origin offsets
- Keeps alignment consistent and predictable
- Useful when building from a fixed reference point

### 🎨 Clean Configuration UI
- Modern two-column settings layout
- Quick access to spacing, radius, origin, and color options
- Color presets with live preview
- Config screen automatically disables the grid while editing

### ⚡ Performance Friendly
- Optimized rendering logic
- Built-in render count safety limit
- Designed to reduce unnecessary FPS drops
- Lightweight client-side rendering only

### 🧩 Mod Menu Support
- Optional Mod Menu integration
- Open the config screen directly from Mod Menu
- Works even without Mod Menu installed

---

## 🎮 Default Controls

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `.` | Toggle Grid ON / OFF |
| `,` | Open Config Screen |
| `[` | Decrease Grid Spacing |
| `]` | Increase Grid Spacing |

---

## 🏗️ Recommended For

Grid Easy is especially useful for:

- 🏰 Large-scale building projects
- 🏙️ City planning
- 🧱 Symmetrical structures
- 🔧 Technical builds
- 🔴 Redstone spacing
- 🛋️ Interior alignment
- 🎨 Pixel art layouts
- 🗼 Vertical structure planning
- 📐 Precise block alignment

---

## 📦 Requirements

- Minecraft **1.21.4**
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API

Optional:
- Mod Menu

---

## 📝 Notes

Grid Easy is a **client-side utility mod**.

It does **not** modify:

- World generation
- Blocks
- Entities
- Server-side behavior

It only renders a visual grid overlay on the client, making it safe and convenient for building assistance.

---

# 🇰🇷 한국어 설명

# 🧱 Grid Easy

**Grid Easy**는 마인크래프트에서 건축, 정렬, 간격 조절을 더 쉽고 정확하게 도와주는 가볍고 최적화된 **3D Grid Overlay 모드**입니다.

기준점 기반의 3D Grid 시스템과 **X / Y / Z 축별 개별 간격 설정**을 통해 구조물의 위치, 대칭, 간격을 훨씬 직관적으로 확인할 수 있습니다.

대형 건축, 기술 건축, 도시 설계, 레드스톤 구조, 인테리어 작업 등 정밀한 배치가 필요한 상황에서 깔끔한 시각적 기준선을 제공합니다.

---

## ✨ 왜 Grid Easy인가요?

마인크래프트 건축은 결국 정밀함이 중요합니다.

🔹 몇 블록만 어긋나도 대칭이 깨질 수 있습니다.  
🔹 간격이 일정하지 않으면 대형 구조물이 어색해질 수 있습니다.  
🔹 수직 정렬은 눈으로만 맞추기 어렵습니다.  
🔹 큰 건축물일수록 명확한 기준선이 필요합니다.

**Grid Easy**는 월드 안에 직접 표시되는 3D Grid를 통해 이런 문제를 해결합니다.

간단하게 사용하고,  
쉽게 설정하고,  
정확하게 건축할 수 있도록 설계되었습니다.

---

## 🚀 주요 기능

### 🌐 3D Grid Overlay
- X / Y / Z 축 기반 3D Grid 렌더링
- 수평 정렬뿐만 아니라 수직 정렬까지 지원
- 공간 구조를 직관적으로 확인 가능
- 대형 구조물과 층 구조 설계에 유용

### 📏 축별 개별 간격 설정
- X축 간격 개별 조절
- Y축 간격 개별 조절
- Z축 간격 개별 조절
- 층고, 기둥 간격, 도로 폭, 구조물 배치 등에 활용 가능

### 🎯 Origin 기반 정렬 시스템
- 기준점 기반 Grid 생성
- 상대좌표 Origin Offset 지원
- 일정한 기준점으로 안정적인 정렬 가능
- 특정 위치를 중심으로 건축할 때 유용

### 🎨 깔끔한 설정 UI
- 보기 좋은 2열 설정 화면
- 간격, 범위, Origin, 색상 설정 지원
- 색상 프리셋 및 실시간 색상 미리보기
- Grid ON 상태에서 설정창 진입 시 자동 OFF 처리

### ⚡ 성능 최적화
- 최적화된 렌더링 로직
- 렌더 개수 안전 제한 적용
- FPS 저하를 줄이도록 설계
- 클라이언트 전용 경량 렌더링

### 🧩 Mod Menu 지원
- Mod Menu 연동 지원
- Mod Menu에서 설정창 바로 열기 가능
- Mod Menu 없이도 사용 가능

---

## 🎮 기본 조작 키

| 키 | 기능 |
|-----|------|
| `.` | Grid ON / OFF |
| `,` | 설정창 열기 |
| `[` | Grid 간격 감소 |
| `]` | Grid 간격 증가 |

---

## 🏗️ 추천 사용 환경

Grid Easy는 이런 상황에서 특히 유용합니다.

- 🏰 대형 건축 프로젝트
- 🏙️ 도시 설계
- 🧱 대칭 구조물 제작
- 🔧 기술 건축
- 🔴 레드스톤 간격 조절
- 🛋️ 인테리어 정렬
- 🎨 픽셀 아트 제작
- 🗼 수직 구조 설계
- 📐 정밀한 블록 정렬

---

## 📦 필요 사항

- Minecraft **1.21.4**
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API

선택 사항:
- Mod Menu

---

## 📝 참고 사항

Grid Easy는 **클라이언트 전용 유틸리티 모드**입니다.

다음 요소를 변경하지 않습니다.

- 월드 생성
- 블록
- 엔티티
- 서버 동작

클라이언트 화면에 Grid Overlay만 표시하여 건축을 보조하므로, 서버에 영향을 주지 않고 안전하게 사용할 수 있습니다.

title: Tether
description: The ultimate leashing solution. Leash any mob or player and take full control over leashing across your server.
body:
![Tether Banner](https://i.imgur.com/32kVuw7.png)

## Overview
Tether is the ultimate leashing solution. You can leash any mob or player, and can take full control over leashing across your server with a multitude of configuration options and integrations.

It supports all default leashing mechanics, has a mob whitelist and blacklist, and integrates with your favourite land management plugins.

## Features
- Leash any mob in Minecraft.
- Attach any leashed mob to a fence (right-click the fence).
- Leash any mobs together (sneak + right-click the mob).
- Mob leash blacklist and whitelist.
- Leash players.

## Integrations
Tether integrates with the following plugins (for both mob and player leashing):
- WorldGuard (using the "leash" flag).
  - The "leash" flag respects the default INTERACT flag, which in turn respects the BUILD flag.
  - However, in the \_\_global\_\_ region, only BUILD is checked.
- GriefPrevention
- Towny
- Lands
- GriefDefender
- Residence (using the "leash" flag).
- Citizens - Respects your NPCs' "leashable" setting.

## Commands
- `/tether reload` - Reloads the configuration.


## Permissions
- `tether.leashplayers` - Allows leashing other players. (Make sure to also enable player leashing in the config).
- `tether.reload` - Allows /tether reload

## Images
![Leashing Villager](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e8b4f5636bd2877dd899c48164c53dbc3d0d7476.png)

title: Rotatable Sculk
description: Sculk blocks generate & place in any direction
body:
> **NOTE:** _This mod is packaged as part of [Great Big World](https://modrinth.com/mod/great-big-world) and was made a standalone mod so that players can enjoy it separately. Do not download both with the intent of using them together._
> 
# Rotatable Sculk

title: ModWatch
description: The ultimate all-in-one security suite for total mod control and automated fair play on your server.
body:
ModWatch

The ultimate bridge between Server Administration and Player Integrity.

--- ## What is ModWatch? **ModWatch** is a synchronization system designed to give server owners full visibility into the client-side environment of their players. By pairing a **Bukkit/Spigot/Paper plugin** with a lightweight **Fabric client mod**, you can ensure that your server remains a fair playground for everyone. > [!NOTE] > **For Players:** You only need to install the **Client Mod**. > **For Server Owners:** You need to install the **Server Plugin** on your server. --- ## Why choose ModWatch? - **Instant Insight**: Admins can see a full list of a player's mods and active resource packs with a single command. - **Automated Blacklist**: Instantly punish players using forbidden IDs like `xray`, `wurst`, or `freecam`. - **Periodic Challenges**: Our unique security layer sends hidden verification "challenges" every 30 seconds to ensure players can't bypass the check after joining. - **Global Search**: Want to know who's using a specific mod? Use `/modwatch find ` to scan everyone online. - **Anti-Outdated**: Enforce a minimum version of the mod to keep your security standards high. --- ## Advanced Security ModWatch doesn't just check once on join. It uses a **Challenge-Response** protocol: 1. **Join Handshake**: 2 seconds after joining, the server requests data. 2. **Periodic Pings**: Every 30 seconds, a new random challenge is generated. 3. **Verification**: If a client fails to reply or sends an invalid response, they are immediately kicked. 4. **Resilience**: Optimized networking handles connection spikes and cross-platform communication seamlessly. --- ## Media

Kick message if you have a mod that is blacklisted

--- ## Commands & Permissions | Command | Action | Permission | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `/modwatch ` | Inspect a player's mods/packs | `modwatch.admin` | | `/modwatch find ` | Search all players for a mod | `modwatch.admin` | | `/modwatch reload` | Reload the config & blacklist | `modwatch.admin` | --- ## Installation ### For Players 1. Download the **latest client JAR**. 2. Drop it into your `.minecraft/mods` folder. 3. Requires **Fabric API** & **Minecraft 1.21.1**. ### For Server Admins 1. Download the **latest plugin JAR**. 2. Drop it into your server's `plugins` folder. 3. Configure your blacklist in `plugins/ModWatch/config.yml`. [![Nexeu.zip](https://i.ibb.co/HDJnHpvZ/nexeu-banner-v5.png)](https://nexeu.zip/) ---

Created with precision for the Minecraft community.

Changes to existing content:

  • Manastar: Now displays a wand HUD for its targeted pool, like the Mana Pool HUD, except displaying the overall fullness of all spark-connected pools

Functional Flowers:

  • Snapdresson: Remembers a trinket loadout. When clicked, re-equips you with those trinkets, if you have them in your inventory.
        Including within a Trinket Case or Shulker Box, etc.
  • Groundberry: Turns nearby Sand into Suspicious Sand, and Gravel into Suspicious Gravel, with the associated loot.
        Intended primarily for skyblock.
  • Oxidaisel: Rapidly oxidizes nearby copper blocks.
  • Glory Incarnata: Prevents* and reverses the zombification of Piglins, Hoglins, and Villagers.
        *except for preventing villager zombification, as this happens via death.
  • Witch's Pupil: Allows remote observation of the flower when one of its Eye Berries is plucked and eaten.
  • Dispelagonium: When splashed with a potion effect, clears that effect from nearby entities for the duration of the potion.
        Also added are potions for Wither, Mining Fatigue, and Levitation.
  • Topsy Tulip: Can be placed on any side of a block, and warps gravity to let you walk on walls.
        Requires Forge GravityAPI.

Generating Flowers:

  • Candysnuft: Generates mana when nearby candles are extinguished (consuming a candle), but only in small portion sizes (blocks of at most 3 candles).
  • Queen Anelace: Sits on a square of Grass Blocks and outputs redstone signals pointing to a block in that square; generates mana if that block (and only that block) is broken.

Magical Trees:

  • Chthonic Yew: A tree with dark black wood whose hollow contains a Nether Portal; a growable alternative to manual placement.
  • Alfthorne: A great tree with vibrant green wood whose hollow contains an Alfheim Portal. Requires the same mana infusion to open.
        Intended as options for modpack progression.

Miscellaneous:

  • Bouquet: A decorative item which can bundle up to 3 flowers together.
  • Rod of the Acropolis: A survival-friendly version of the Debug Stick which can force the shape of Stairs, Fences, Walls, and Panes.
  • Rod of the Grasslands: A simple upgrade to the Rod of the Lands which creates Grass Blocks instead of Dirt.

title: No-Enderman-Grief
description: Completely disables enderman block griefing while keeping all other mob behavior vanilla.
body:
# NoEndermanGrief

A lightweight Paper/Spigot plugin that completely disables enderman block griefing while keeping all other mob behavior vanilla.

Endermen can no longer pick up or place blocks, but creepers still explode, villagers still farm, and the `mobGriefing` gamerule remains under your control.

---

## Features

- Prevents **only endermen** from changing blocks (both pickup and placement).
- Does **not** modify the global `mobGriefing` gamerule.
- Per-world enable/disable via `config.yml`.
- Optional console logging with timestamps and coordinates whenever an enderman block change is cancelled.
- Minimal surface area: one admin-only reload command, no changes for regular players.

---

## Requirements

- **Server:** Paper or Spigot (Paper recommended)
- **Minecraft:** 1.21+
- **Java:** 21

This plugin is developed against the Paper 1.21 API with Mojang mappings.

---

## Configuration

`plugins/NoEndermanGrief/config.yml`:

```yaml
# If a world is not listed under "worlds", this value decides
# whether the plugin is enabled there by default.
default-enabled: true

# Per-world overrides.
# Add world names and set them to true/false as needed.
# Example:
# worlds:
#   world: true
#   world_nether: false
#   world_the_end: true
worlds: {}

logging:
  # If true, log whenever the plugin cancels an enderman block change.
  enabled: false

  # If true, include a timestamp inside the message itself
  # (on top of the normal server log timestamp).
  include-timestamp: true
```

## Per-world control

 - If a world is not listed under `worlds`, `default-enabled` determines whether the plugin is active there.
 - If a world is listed under `worlds`, that value overrides `default-enabled`:

```yaml
worlds:
  world: true
  world_nether: false
  world_the_end: true
```

In this example, the plugin is:

 - Enabled in `world` and `world_the_end`.
 - Disabled in `world_nether`.

## Logging

 - `logging.enabled: true` – log a line each time an enderman block change is cancelled.
 - `logging.include-timestamp: true` – include an ISO-8601 timestamp in the log message.

Example log entry:

```text
[NoEndermanGrief] [EndermanBlocked] 2025-01-01T12:34:56 - Cancelled enderman block change in world 'world' at (10, 64, -30)
```

## Commands

Reloads `config.yml` from disk (without restarting the world / server).

 - `/negreload`

## Permission
Allows use of `/negreload`.

 - `noendermangrief.reload`
   - Default: `op`

## Building from source

This project uses Maven.
```bash
git clone https://github.com/<your-username>/NoEndermanGrief.git
cd NoEndermanGrief
mvn package
```

The compiled plugin JAR will be located in the target/ directory:
```text
target/no-enderman-grief-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT.jar
```

Copy this JAR into your server’s plugins/ folder.

## How it works (technical overview)

 - The plugin registers a listener for EntityChangeBlockEvent.
 - If the event’s entity type is ENDERMAN and the plugin is enabled in that world:
    - The event is cancelled so the block change does not occur.
    - If logging is enabled, a timestamped message with world and coordinates is written to the console.
 - No other entity types are modified, so creepers, villagers, and other mobs behave as in vanilla.

This makes the plugin safe to drop into existing survival worlds where you want to preserve terrain from enderman griefing without affecting any other mechanics.

body:
# TrueShot
is a client-side aiming assistant that visualizes projectile trajectories and predicts whether your shot is likely to hit a target.
The mod does not aim for you or modify accuracy — it only displays helpful visual information.

TrueShot is useful for PvP, PvE, bow duels, crystal PvP, and for players who want to understand Minecraft’s projectile physics more clearly.

## Features
• Predicts hits with bow, crossbow, and trident
• Works even when the crossbow is fully charged
• Displays a clean and accurate trajectory line
• Supports players, mobs, and end crystals
• Three crosshair states:
– White — miss
– Orange — near hit (grazes extended hitbox)
– Red — direct hit prediction
• Fully client-side
• Lightweight and compatible with any server
• Perfectly centered custom crosshair

**How it Works**

TrueShot simulates the flight of arrows, bolts, and tridents on the client side.
It predicts their motion over time and checks whether the path intersects with entity hitboxes.
This allows the crosshair to show accurate feedback about potential hits without altering gameplay mechanics.

**Usage**

Just aim with one of the following:
• Bow (while pulling)
• Crossbow (while pulling or fully charged)
• Trident (while charging a throw)

The mod automatically shows the trajectory and changes the crosshair color based on hit prediction.

### Installation

1. Download the mod file

2. Place it into your mods folder

3. Launch Minecraft with Fabric

4. Install [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)

description: A plugin that automatically spawns loot drops with random loot. With title announcements. (Everything adjustable in a single Config.yml)
body:
# LootDrops (Paper 1.21.4)

Automatische Lootdrops für dein Minecraft-Netzwerk: zufällige Drops in der Overworld, coole Effekte & Titel, konfigurierbarer Loot, Admin-Commands – und optional eigene **WorldEdit-Schematics** als Drop-Modell.

> **Kurz:** Das Plugin kann auf **öffentlichen Servern frei genutzt** werden.  
> **ABER:** Wenn durch das Plugin **Geld eingenommen** wird (Shop, Ränge, Spenden, In-Game-Käufe etc.), **bitte vorab Kontakt aufnehmen**, um die weitere Nutzung zu besprechen (siehe *Nutzung & Monetarisierung*).

---

## Features

- ⏱️ **Auto-Drops**: Standardmäßig alle 30 Minuten (Timer startet neu, wenn ein Drop verschwindet).
- 🗺️ **Fairer Spawn**: Zufällige Position innerhalb ±2000 Blöcken ab Welt-Spawn, Mindestabstand, **kein Ozean**, **kein Wasser**, **nicht im Baum**, Luft-Schutzzone (keine Blätter/Logs/Decken direkt über der Kiste).
- 📦 **Schematic-Support (optional)**: Wenn **WorldEdit/FAWE** installiert ist und `plugins/LootDrops/Ballon.schem` existiert, wird **deine Schematic** gespawned (Chest-Position wird automatisch erkannt).  
  Ohne WorldEdit nutzt das Plugin einen hübschen **Fallback-Drop** aus Code.
- 🎆 **Effekte & Sounds**: Beim Spawn und beim Entfernen (inkl. Broadcast-Nachricht & Titel).
- 🧰 **Loot**: Zufallsliste für PVP-Items; Limits für Iron/Diamond-Armor/Weapons; random Slots in der Kiste; optional Haltbarkeits-Variationen.
- 🧹 **Despawn**: **Sobald die Kiste einmal geöffnet und wieder geschlossen wird**, verschwindet der Drop mit Effekten – unabhängig vom Restinhalt.
- 🔧 **Saubere Struktur**: Manager, Listener, Tasks, Utils, Loot-Konfiguration, klare Trennung.

---

## Kompatibilität

- **Server:** Paper **1.21.4**
- **Java:** **21**
- **Optional:** WorldEdit **oder** FastAsyncWorldEdit (für `.schem`)

---

## Installation

1. Jar in den `plugins/`-Ordner legen.
2. (Optional) **WorldEdit/FAWE** installieren, wenn du `.schem` nutzen willst.
3. Server starten (erzeugt `plugins/LootDrops/`).
4. (Optional) **Eigene Schematic** als  
   `plugins/LootDrops/Ballon.schem`  
   ablegen (Dateiname **muss exakt** so heißen).  
   > Die Schematic sollte **genau eine Chest** enthalten. Diese wird als Loot-Kiste verwendet.
5. Server neu starten oder Plugin reloaden.

---

## Commands & Permissions

### Commands
- `/lootadmin reload` – Konfiguration & Schematic neu laden  
- `/lootadmin force here` – Drop **hier** sofort spawnen  
- `/lootadmin remove` – aktiven Drop entfernen  
- `/lootadmin status` – Status/Koordinaten anzeigen  
- `/lootdrop` – Spielerinfo (z. B. Koordinaten/Status)

### Permissions
```text
lootdrops.admin  (default: op)
lootdrops.use    (default: true)
````

---

## Konfiguration (Auszug)

Datei: `plugins/LootDrops/config.yml`

```yaml
settings:
  world: "world"
  spawn-radius: 2000
  min-distance-from-spawn: 100

# Limits pro Drop (Caps)
loot:
  limits:
    iron-armor-max: 2
    diamond-armor-max: 1
    weapons-max: 1

  # Anzahl Loot-Rolls pro Drop (Range)
  rolls:
    min: 4
    max: 8

  # Optionale Haltbarkeits-Variation bei damageable Items
  allow-durability-variance: true
  max-damage-fraction: 0.35

  # Beispiel-Pool (du kannst beliebig erweitern/kürzen)
  pool:
    - material: DIAMOND
      min: 1
      max: 3
      weight: 3
      damageable: false

    - material: IRON_HELMET
      min: 1
      max: 1
      weight: 4
      damageable: true

    - material: IRON_CHESTPLATE
      min: 1
      max: 1
      weight: 4
      damageable: true

    - material: IRON_LEGGINGS
      min: 1
      max: 1
      weight: 4
      damageable: true

    - material: IRON_BOOTS
      min: 1
      max: 1
      weight: 4
      damageable: true

    - material: IRON_SWORD
      min: 1
      max: 1
      weight: 6
      damageable: true

    - material: BOW
      min: 1
      max: 1
      weight: 5
      damageable: true

    - material: ARROW
      min: 16
      max: 48
      weight: 8
      damageable: false

    - material: COBWEB
      min: 8
      max: 24
      weight: 10
      damageable: false

    - material: ENDER_PEARL
      min: 2
      max: 6
      weight: 6
      damageable: false

    - material: GOLDEN_APPLE
      min: 1
      max: 3
      weight: 5
      damageable: false

    - material: COOKED_BEEF
      min: 16
      max: 32
      weight: 10
      damageable: false
```

---

## Schematic-Hinweise

* Datei: `plugins/LootDrops/Ballon.schem`
* Unterstützt WorldEdit & FAWE-`.schem` (neuere Formate).
* Der Drop wird so gepastet, dass **die Chest exakt auf dem berechneten Boden** steht.
* **Luft wird ignoriert** → Terrain bleibt.
* Typische Markerblöcke (z. B. rotes Wool/Concrete, `LIGHT`, `BARRIER`, `STRUCTURE_VOID`) werden **automatisch entfernt**.
* Beim Entfernen des Drops werden **alle gesetzten Blöcke** auf ihren **Originalzustand** zurückgesetzt (kein kaputtes Terrain).

---

## Roadmap (Ideen)

* Mehrere Schematics zufällig aus `/schematics/` wählen
* Coords-Hint im Chat klickbar machen (Kompass/Waypoint)
* BossBar während aktiver Drops
* Per-World Einstellungen & Blacklist-Biomes

---

## Support

* **Bugs/Feature-Requests:** GitHub Issues
* **Kontakt:** Emiliosrz@gmx.de / Discord: emioo01

## Nutzung & Monetarisierung

* Die Nutzung ist **kostenlos**, auch auf **öffentlichen Servern**.

title: ChatHighliter
description: A mod to highlight forbidden words in chat.
body:
# ChatHighliter

## Описание (Description)

### Русский (ru)

**ChatHighliter** — это клиентский мод для Minecraft, который помогает выделять запрещённые слова в чате, чтобы вы могли легко их заметить. Настройте список слов, выберите цвет выделения и добавьте звуковые уведомления — всё это через удобный конфигурационный файл!

#### Возможности
- **Выделение слов**: Автоматически выделяет запрещённые слова в чате с настраиваемым цветом, жирным и курсивным форматированием.
- **Настройка**:
  - Изменяйте цвет выделения (16 вариантов: красный, синий, золотой и т.д.).
  - Включайте/выключайте жирный и курсивный текст.
  - Настройте громкость звуковых уведомлений.
- **Звуковые уведомления**: Проигрывает звук арфы при обнаружении запрещённого слова (можно отключить).
- **Команды**:
  - `/chath add <слово>`: Добавить слово в список запрещённых.
  - `/chath remove <слово>`: Удалить слово из списка.
  - `/chath list`: Показать текущий список запрещённых слов.
- **Локализация**: Поддержка русского (`ru_ru`) и английского (`en_us`) языков.

#### Поддерживаемые версии
- Minecraft 1.20.x
- Minecraft 1.21.x

⚠️ **Требуемая Java**: 21

Спасибо за использование ChatHighliter! 🚀

---

### English (en)

**ChatHighliter** is a client-side mod for Minecraft that highlights forbidden words in chat, making it easy to spot specific keywords. Customize your word list, choose highlight colors, and enable sound notifications—all through a simple config file!

#### Features
- **Word Highlighting**: Automatically highlights forbidden words in chat with customizable colors, bold, and italic formatting.
- **Configuration**:
  - Change the highlight color (16 options: red, blue, gold, etc.).
  - Enable/disable bold and italic text.
  - Adjust the volume of sound notifications.
- **Sound Alerts**: Plays a harp sound when a forbidden word is detected (can be disabled).
- **Commands**:
  - `/chath add <word>`: Add a word to the forbidden list.
  - `/chath remove <word>`: Remove a word from the list.
  - `/chath list`: Display the current list of forbidden words.
- **Localization**: Supports English (`en_us`) and Russian (`ru_ru`) languages.

#### Supported Versions
- Minecraft 1.20.x
- Minecraft 1.21.x

⚠️ **Required Java version**: 21

Thank you for using ChatHighliter! 🚀

---

title: Echoes of the Void
description: A very large dimensional mod that adds the void, a black expanse with scattered islands.
body:
Echoes of the Void is a mod project I have been hobbying over since the advent of MC 1.14, though only recently have my dreams proven any real fruit. It is, in a way, a world building project of mine.

# Reasons for and against this mod:
For the builders and explorers, the Void has vast expanses of building space, both horizontally and vertically, and many building blocks to go with it and secrets to find.

For the casual survivalists, however, resources are sparse, it's always dark, and travel is not easy.

# Features in this mod:
Adds a totally new dimension to Minecraft - The Void.

The Void is a large dark expanse with no skylight, and has sparse floating islands with rare vegetation.

The Void has a building limit of ±1280, two and a half kilometers from top to bottom.

There are 7 biomes, seperated into regions: 4 stone-type regions, and 2 forests for each region.

Adds has a full suite of tools and armor, with 10 new ores that spawn in the Void, and 3 new ores that spawn in the nether, and 3 new ores that spawn in the overworld.

title: Clean HUD
description: Only shows health/hunger/armor when they change, fades out otherwise
body:
# CleanHUD

CleanHUD keeps your screen clean without taking useful information away. Core HUD elements can fade out when they are not needed, and optional Info HUD lines can stay visible exactly where you want them.

Built for **Fabric**, **Forge**, and **NeoForge**.

## What CleanHUD Can Do

### Fade the vanilla HUD

You can configure these HUD elements individually:

- `health`
- `hunger`
- `armor`
- `air`
- `experience`
- `mount_health`
- `hotbar`
- `crosshair`
- `held_item`
- `status_effects`
- `boss_bar`

Each supported HUD element can be configured with:

- **Fade enabled** on/off
- **Fade if not full** on/off where it makes sense
- **Hold ticks**
- **Fade ticks**
- **Reset to global/default behavior**

### Show an optional Info HUD

CleanHUD also includes an Info HUD with individually toggleable items:

- `coords` — player coordinates
- `fps` — FPS counter
- `chunk` — chunk coordinates
- `facing` — facing direction
- `light` — light level
- `biome` — current biome
- `memory` — memory usage
- `looking` — what you are looking at, with coordinates
- `speed` — movement speed
- `ping` — player ping

Each Info HUD item can be:

- Enabled or disabled individually
- Placed in any corner:
	- `top_left`
	- `top_right`
	- `bottom_right`
	- `bottom_left`

The Info HUD also has a single **global text size** setting shared by all info items.

Available text sizes currently include:

- `0.25x`
- `0.50x`
- `0.75x`
- `1.00x`
- `1.25x`
- `1.50x`
- `1.75x`
- `2.00x`

## In-Game Configuration

Open the menu with:

- `/cleanhud`
- `/ch`

From the main config screen you can:

- Configure fading behavior for vanilla HUD elements
- Open the dedicated **Info HUD** screen
- Toggle each info item on/off
- Change each info item corner
- Change Info HUD text size
- Use **All ON** and **All OFF** for the Info HUD

## Commands

### Open the menu

- `/cleanhud`
- `/cleanhud menu`
- `/ch`
- `/ch menu`

### HUD fade commands

```text
/cleanhud status [element]
/cleanhud fade <element|all> <true|false>
/cleanhud hold <element|all> <ticks>
/cleanhud fadeTicks <element|all> <ticks>
/cleanhud reset <element|all>
```

### Info HUD commands

```text
/cleanhud info status [item]
/cleanhud info toggle <item|all> <true|false>
/cleanhud info corner <item|all> <top_left|top_right|bottom_right|bottom_left>
/cleanhud info allOn
/cleanhud info allOff
```

The same commands are also available through `/ch`.

## Why Use CleanHUD?

CleanHUD is made for players who want less clutter without losing useful information. You can keep the screen minimal during normal gameplay, while still showing the exact HUD and player info you care about.

title: RedStone AntiLag and Blocker
description: Redstone AntiLag is a powerful Paper plugin designed to prevent redstone-based lag by intelligently monitoring and limiting redstone activity per chunk. It allows administrators to automatically or manually block redstone in problematic areas
body:
# ✨ RedstoneAntiLag ✨ [![Paper 1.21+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Paper-1.21+-blue.svg)](https://papermc.io/) [![Paper 1.20+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Paper-1.20+-blue.svg)](https://papermc.io/) [![Java 21+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-21+-orange.svg)](https://www.oracle.com/java/) > **The most complete redstone lag prevention toolkit for Paper servers.** > Stop server meltdowns before they happen — with zero compromise on player experience.
--- ## Why RedstoneAntiLag? Most "anti-lag" plugins are reactive: they kick in *after* your TPS is already destroyed. **RedstoneAntiLag** is proactive. It monitors your server's redstone activity at the chunk level in real time, giving you surgical precision to restrict exactly what's causing lag — without a blanket ban on all redstone. Got a mega-farm that's totally fine? **Whitelist that chunk.** Got a grief machine spinning up in a hidden basement? **Auto-detect it, teleport there, and shut it down — all from chat.** --- ## Features ### Global Redstone Toggle - Enable/disable all redstone server-wide via command - Instant effect, no restart required - Optional broadcast to all players ### TPS-Based Auto Disable - Monitors server TPS every few seconds - Auto-disables redstone when TPS drops below your threshold - Auto-re-enables when TPS recovers - Hysteresis thresholds prevent on/off flapping - Fully configurable broadcasts ### Per-Chunk Piston Limiter - Cap piston activations per chunk per second - Silently cancels excess activations — no explosions, no errors ### Redstone Signal Rate Limiter - Cap redstone updates per chunk per second - If exceeded: chunk redstone is **frozen** for a configurable time - Players inside frozen chunks are informed why their redstone stopped ### Entity Limits Per Chunk - Max armor stands per chunk - Max minecarts per chunk — counting **all 6 types**: - Normal, Chest, Hopper, TNT, Furnace, Command Block ### Manual Chunk Block - Block redstone in any chunk with one command - Supports temporary blocks (e.g., `/ra block 3600` = 1 hour) - Or permanent blocks ### Suspicious Chunk Detection - Automatically flags chunks that exceed activity thresholds - Two notification modes: **instant** or **interval** (e.g., every 800 seconds) - Each detection is numbered and actionable from chat: - Clickable **[TP]** button to teleport safely to chunk surface - Clickable **[BLOCK]** to block redstone immediately - Clickable **[IGNORE]** to dismiss the detection - Auto-expires after a configured time if no action is taken ### Permanent Chunk Ignore - Mark important chunks as permanently exempt from **all** restrictions - These chunks work normally even when global redstone is disabled - Perfect for vital farms you never want restricted ### Restricted Chunk List - One command to see all blocked, frozen, and ignored chunks - Shows world, coordinates, type, and expiry timestamp ### Player Status Command - `/ra status` — any player can check the redstone status of their chunk - Shows current TPS, freeze state, block state, or global disable state --- ## Configuration Preview ```yaml tps-auto-disable: enabled: true threshold: 15.0 restore-threshold: 18.0 broadcast: true signal-limit: enabled: true max-updates-per-second: 150 freeze-duration: 15 suspicious-detection: enabled: true updates-threshold: 200 notification-mode: "instant" auto-expire: 3600 ``` --- ## Commands | Command | Description | |---------|-------------| | `/ra status` | Check redstone status in your current chunk | | `/ra toggle` | Toggle global redstone on/off | | `/ra block [seconds]` | Block redstone in current chunk | | `/ra unblock` | Unblock current chunk | | `/ra ignore` | Permanently ignore current chunk | | `/ra list` | List all restricted chunks | | `/ra suspicious` | View suspicious chunk detections | | `/ras block ` | Block a suspicious chunk | | `/ras ignore ` | Ignore a suspicious detection | | `/ras tp ` | Teleport to suspicious chunk | | `/ra reload` | Reload configuration | | `/ra help` | Show all commands | --- ## Permissions | Permission | Description | |-----------|-------------| | `redstonelag.use` | Use `/ra status` (default: everyone) | | `redstonelag.admin` | All admin commands | | `redstonelag.bypass` | Bypass all restrictions | --- ## Performance RedstoneAntiLag is engineered for minimal footprint: - **No per-tick loops** — all processing is event-driven or uses scheduled tasks at long intervals - **O(1) chunk lookups** using ConcurrentHashMap - **Lazy expiry** — expired entries are cleaned on access, with a periodic sweep every 5 minutes - **No database** — everything lives in memory, instant response - **No reflection** — uses stable Paper API only --- ## Compatibility | Version | Status | |---------|--------| | Paper 1.21.x | Fully Supported | | Paper 1.20.x | Compatible | | Spigot | Not Supported | | Folia | Not Supported | **Java 21+ required.** --- ## Support - on [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/sD4HvQh8P4) --- ## 📜 License - The source code is not publicly available, contact me on discord server if you want something ---
**Made with ❤️ for the Minecraft community**

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.

**InvHud** — Inventory Status HUD for Minecraft 1.20.1
InvHud is a lightweight Fabric mod that adds a clean, unobtrusive HUD overlay to your Minecraft game screen. At a glance — hence the name — you can instantly see the condition of your equipped armor and the food you're carrying, without ever opening your inventory.
The overlay displays each piece of armor (helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots) alongside its remaining durability, color-coded for urgency: white when healthy, orange when below 50%, and red when critically low at under 25%. Food items from your inventory are shown with their stack count, so you always know when it's time to restock before heading into a fight.
The HUD is fully configurable through Mod Menu. You can anchor it to any corner of the screen, switch between horizontal and vertical layout, adjust padding from the screen edges, and toggle armor or food display independently.
Glance is built with Fabric API, integrates seamlessly with Mod Menu and Cloth Config, and is designed to stay out of your way — it automatically hides when the debug screen is open and scales correctly with any GUI scale setting.
No bloat, no performance impact. Just the information you need, exactly where you want it.

title: Real Life Time
description: Syncs Minecraft's day/night cycle with your real-world clock. It's night outside? It's night in-game.
body:
![Titel](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1f1a06bb669b69168507730337a46c8db8db09a3.png)

---

[![Discord](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/17e5d47afb1ec97eaf67b51e3922abe80f00bf06.png)](https://discord.gg/r5u6jwpHJY) [![curseforge](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/85767d619d6e19ce7285fa1798c07c196575a0ea_0.webp)](https://www.curseforge.com/members/victorwinner/projects)

---

> **Your world. Your clock. Your time.**

Real Life Time is a Fabric mod that **syncs Minecraft's in-game time with your computer's real-world clock** — automatically and in real time. If the sun has set outside your window, it sets in your world too.

---

**📷 Media**

![Mod Configs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/FPbq6YT8/images/93911d4b92f00102142b3cb20bc6153b0b73094c.png)

![Day Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/FPbq6YT8/images/c7ce4823d1fff975ec237572dcd95322845e036e.png)

---

<details>
<summary>⚙️ How does it work?</summary>

🌅 **Real-Time Sync**  
The mod reads your system clock every second and converts it directly into Minecraft ticks. No commands, no setup — it just works.

🕐 **Time Mapping**  
| Real Time | Minecraft |
|-----------|-----------|
| 06:00 | Sunrise |
| 12:00 | Noon |
| 18:00 | Sunset |
| 00:00 | Midnight |

🔄 **Automatic Cycle Control**  
The `doDaylightCycle` gamerule is automatically disabled so the mod has full control over the time. No more day skipping.

⚙️ **Cloth Config Integration**  
All settings are adjustable in-game via a clean config screen — no file editing needed.

</details>

<details>
<summary>🛠️ Configuration</summary>

All options are available via **Mod Menu → Real Life Time → Config** or in `config/reallifetime.json`.

| Option | Default | Description |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| ✅ **Enable Mod** | `true` | Toggle the sync on or off without removing the mod |
| 🌍 **Time Zone Offset** | `0` | Shift the clock ±12 hours — useful for servers in a different time zone |
| 🌅 **Sunrise Hour** | `6` | The real-world hour that maps to Minecraft sunrise (tick 0) |
| ⏱️ **Sync Interval** | `20` | How often the time is synced in ticks (20 = once per second) |
| 🔥 **Sync Nether** | `false` | Apply real-world time to the Nether dimension |
| 🌑 **Sync End** | `false` | Apply real-world time to The End dimension |

</details>

<details>
<summary>🎯 Who is this for?</summary>

This mod is perfect for players who:

- Want a more **immersive survival experience** tied to the real world  
- Play on **servers with friends** across time zones and want a shared day/night cycle  
- Love **roleplay or realism** modpacks where immersion matters  
- Want to add a **unique challenge** — no more sleeping through the night  
- Run **events or streams** where the real time of day adds atmosphere  

Whether you're playing at noon with the sun high in the sky or grinding at midnight under the stars — Real Life Time makes your world feel alive.

</details>

<details>
<summary>💡 Note</summary>

- **Server-side only** — clients do NOT need to install the mod  
- Requires **Fabric API** and **Cloth Config API**  
- Only the **Overworld** is synced by default — Nether and End are optional  
- Syncs every **20 ticks** (once per second) for smooth and efficient performance  
- Compatible with **Minecraft 1.21.1 + Fabric Loader 0.16.10+**  
- Config changes take effect on the **next sync tick** — no restart needed  

</details>

title: zombies-eat-animals
