title: Beecraft
description: A lightweight modpack incorporating simple industrial expansion, spooky exploration, shader support, and client performance optimizations. Updates to paper-supported stable MC releases.
body:
## Getting Started
Beecraft is a Fabric-based modpack intended to incorporate several simple gameplay expansion mods with straightforward optimization and shader support out-of-the-box.

### Client Installation
To simply play the modpack, search for it in the Modrinth launcher application or another supported launcher. You may download a .mrpack file from [the Versions page](https://modrinth.com/modpack/beehive-beescraft/versions) if that is more helpful for you.
 
### Server Installation
As with any client-side modpack, it is easy to run a local server by simply [opening your game to your LAN](https://help.minecraft.net/hc/en-us/articles/4410317081741-How-to-Play-Minecraft-Java-Edition-Multiplayer#h_01FGSNQW64PVTP6P03M9GJXWE2). 

Running a dedicated server is more involved and requires background understanding of how to install and operate a Fabric server. If you want to run a dedicated server, you are strongly advised to load a .mrpack file [available in the Versions page](https://modrinth.com/modpack/beehive-beescraft/versions) in a launcher capable of creating a working server directory for you. If you want or need to populate the server mods directory by hand, the following are necessary to provide a feature-complete experience for Beecraft clients. Be advised that, in the course of manual installation, you would need to figure out cross-compatibility yourself:
<details>
<summary>Click to show serverside mods</summary>

- Dawn API by Hugman
- Fabric API by modmuss50
- Geckolib by Gecko
- Grappling Hook Mod: Restitched by CloudG360
- Lithium by jellysquid3
- Memory Leak Fix by fxmorin
- oωo (owo-lib) by glisco
- The Graveyard (FABRIC) by finallion
- Universal Ores by Hugman
- Fabric Waystones by LordDeatHunter
- Xaero's Minimap by thexaero
- Ping Wheel by Luken
- Inventory Profiles Next by blackd
- Another Furniture by crispytwig

</details>

## Design Principles
Before all other considerations, a desire for simplicity and easy-to-grasp mechanics steers this modpack.

Over many years, we have observed that  casual players seeking to ease themselves into the modded Minecraft experience are often overwhelmed by modpacks with half a thousand mods, a dozen new dimensions, and five copies of the same machines. We seek to avoid confusing, overloading, and burning out prospective modded Minecraft players.

### Gameplay Expansion
A game with well-considered design language invites the player to learn deeper mechanics simply by playing; while it is fine to need to look up the details of a game's mechanics in a wiki, it is far preferable that the design of items and gameplay interactions steer the player to figure things out without needing to read a reference guide. We identify Create, The Graveyard, Fabric Waystones, and Grappling Hook Mod: Restitched as four (often-underappreciated) mods that facilitate this style of in vivo learning.

### Shader Support
It is hoped that anyone -- whether preferring Iris- or Optifine-format shaders -- may use this modpack out of the box. Iris Shaders is included alongside with a slew of mods providing Fabric-stack support for features of the Optifine shader/texture format.

### Optimization
A variety of bugfix, optimization, and menu improvement mods are included. This modpack's optimization mods were included with older or less-powerful systems in mind; it is anticipated that players on low-end systems will enjoy stable framerates and stability improvements while high-end system users may crank settings to the max.

## Mods Included
In order to simplify licensing for and permission for redistribution, all mods come from modrinth.com. We extend our sincerest thanks to [the modders referenced in the Changelog](https://modrinth.com/modpack/beehive-beescraft/changelog) for making their work available on this platform.

## Additional Thanks
Icon by AriArtistryAffairs. Used with permission (Thanks Ari!)

# OpenBucket

- Bucket can hold a **configurable** amount of water:

- Bucket can hold a **configurable** amount of lava:

"Witcher Medalions" to modyfikacja która wprowadza do gry medaliony związane z każdą szkołą wiedźmińską z uniwersum Wiedźmina. Gracz ma możliwość stworzenia medalionów za pomocą rytualnego kamienia, na którym wiedźmini zakończają swoje próby medalionu.

Aby stworzyć rytualny kamień, potrzebne są następujące składniki: 3 bloki bruku, 4 pochodnie, miseczka z wodą (miska + butelka/wiadro z wodą) oraz blok ziemi oraz stół rzemieślniczy na którym należy owe bloki ułożyć zgodnie z instrukcją przedstawioną na załączonym obrazku:

 

Aby stworzyć medalion potrzebna jest bryłka srebra:

Ten cenny surowiec można wytopić z rudy srebra, którą można odnaleźć razem z innymi minerałami kopiąc w kopalni. Gdy srebro zostanie wytopione należy udać się z nim do kamienia rytualnego by nasycić medalion energią czterech żywiołów. Po rytuale jako pełnoprawny wiedźmin możesz już przemierzać szlak!

Translated:

 

"Silence! Hear me now adepts!

Here is the final test before you. The ultimate trial. Medallion Trial!

Whoever returns with the medallion will prove that he is worthy and can join the trail.

 

"Witcher Medallions" is a modification that adds medallions to the game related to each witcher school from the Witcher universe. The player has the option to create medallions using a ritual stone on which witchers end their medallion trials.

 

(Ritual Stone)

 

To create a ritual stone, you need the following ingredients: 3 cobblestone blocks, 4 torches, a bowl of water (bowl + water bottle/bucket) and a block of earth and a crafting table on which to place these blocks according to the instructions presented in the attached picture:

 

 

 

 

To create a medallion, you need a silver nugget:

 

This precious resource can be smelted from silver ore, which can be found along with other minerals by digging in the mine. When the silver is smelted, go with it to the ritual stone to imbue the medallion with the energy of the four elements. After the ritual, as a full-fledged witcher, you can now travel the trail!

title: Dimension Update Fixer
description: Unyeets the Nether and End when a world is loaded without a dimension or is upgraded between Minecraft versions with dimension mods installed
body:
# Dimension Update Fixer
A simple mod that unyeets the Nether and End when a world is loaded without a dimension or is upgraded between 
Minecraft versions with dimension mods installed.

This mod does now fix the issue where removing a dimension from a world deletes all other dimensions.

## Jank
The way this mod fixes the dimension-removal issue is by mixing in and overriding the `decode` method in 
`UnboundedMapCodec`. This is somewhat of a janky fix and may break other mods that expect a certain load order for 
DFU classes or that also attempt to fix the dimension-removal issue in the same way.

## Known to Work With
This mod is known to work with:

* [Heart of the Machine](https://heart-of-the-machine.github.io/) 
  [(Github)](https://github.com/Heart-of-the-Machine/heart-of-the-machine)
  [(Modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/mod/heart-of-the-machine)
  [(CurseForge)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/heart-of-the-machine)
* [Applied Energistics 2](https://ae-mod.info/) 
  [(Github)](https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2)
  [(CurseForge)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/applied-energistics-2)
  (Fabric Build)
* Likely others.

## Thanks to

* `alcatrazEscapee` for providing the [dimension-removal fix](https://github.com/Mojang/DataFixerUpper/pull/55) in 
  the first place.
* `Kneelawk` for packaging the fix into a mixin-based fabric mod.

- Player count information

DonutHoppers is a high-performance Minecraft plugin designed to completely upgrade the default hopper system for modern SMP servers.

DonutHoppers solves this problem by dramatically increasing hopper transfer speed while reducing server strain and maintaining full vanilla compatibility.


Built specifically for Paper 1.21.1 – 1.21.11, DonutHoppers is lightweight, plug-and-play, and requires zero configuration to get started.


Whether you're running a small survival server or a large-scale SMP network, DonutHoppers helps keep automation fast, smooth, and optimized.

Faster item transportation

Smoother automation performance

### Features * **Infinite vaults** per player * **Per-vault permissions:** `playervaults.quantity.` * **Admin commands** to see other players vaults​ * **MiniMessage formatting** (gradients, hex colors, rainbows) * Every message and vault title is **fully configurable** * **Automatic saving** on close and server shutdown * **Zero** server-side dependencies --- ### Commands & Permissions #### Commands * `/pv ` - Open a personal vault. * `/pv ` - Opens other player vault. #### Permissions * `playervaults.quantity.` - Access to vaults up to the number specified. * `playervaults.quantity.*` - Access to all vaults. * `playervaults.admin.view` - Access to other players vaults **only view**. * `playervaults.admin.edit` - Lets you edit other player vaults. --- ### Requirements * **Software:** Spigot, Paper, or any fork * **Minecraft Version:** 1.8 to 26.1 * **Java:** Java 8 or higher --- ### Configuration ```yaml messages: opening: "Opening vault #{number}" no-permission: "You don't have any vaults available" usage: "Usage: /pv {number}" invalid-number: "Please enter a valid number" vault-title: "Vault #{number}" ```

[![JOIN OUR DISCORD](https://img.shields.io/badge/JOIN%20OUR%20DISCORD-5865F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/HTkn94BXmA)

Lightweight client-side utility mod that hides the shield model in first-person view. It simply removes the shield rendering from your own view, ensuring that bulky shields no longer block your screen and field of vision.

Client-side only (no server installation required). Fully compatible with singleplayer and multiplayer.

**What it does:**
- Hides the shield model from your first-person perspective when you hold it.
- Frees up valuable screen space for much better visibility during combat and exploration.
- Leaves all vanilla shield mechanics, blocking behavior, and hitboxes completely untouched.
- Does not affect how your shield looks to other players or how it renders in third-person view.

**Configuration:**
This mod works straight out of the box with zero configuration required. Simply drop it into your mods folder and enjoy a clear screen!

**Details:**
- Client-side only.
- Completely safe to use on any vanilla or modded server.
- Absolutely no server-side logic or gameplay changes.

Please report any bugs, errors, or feature suggestions on Discord: https://discord.gg/4XUPywnEyE

title: Classic Bar Unofficial
description: Classic Bar Unofficial — A community-maintained fork of the original Classic Bar. Adds extended mod support including thirst overlay (Thirst Was Taken), Vampirism blood bar, Forbidden Curse hunger bar, and full Chinese localization.
body:
# Classic Bar Unofficial

A **NeoForge 1.21.1** community port of Tfarcenim's Classic Bar. Clean, readable progress bars replace Minecraft's default icon HUD — hearts, armor, food, air, and more.

---

## What It Does

Classic Bar replaces the traditional icon rows on your HUD — hearts, armor pieces, food drumsticks, air bubbles, and other status symbols — with **continuous progress bars**. The health bar scales dynamically with your maximum health instead of locking at 20 points, giving you a cleaner, more information-dense HUD at a single glance.

Originally created by Tfarcenim for Minecraft Forge, this community fork updates the mod to **NeoForge 1.21.1**, adds new mod integrations, and provides ongoing maintenance.

---

## Why Download

- **Dynamic health scaling** — the health bar adjusts to your actual max HP, not a fixed 20
- **Deep customization** — every bar can be positioned left, right, or hidden; colors, number display modes, icon toggles, and overlay effects are all configurable through an in-game GUI
- **Extended mod support** — five additional mods now have dedicated bar integrations (see below)
- **Better readability** — continuous bars are easier to parse at a glance than scattered icon rows
- **Cleaner look** — reduces visual clutter while keeping all information accessible

---

## Features

### Native Status Bars (8)

- **Health** — Scales dynamically with max health; poison/wither/frozen overlay effects
- **Armor** — Configurable number of armor layers
- **Food** — Hunger icon variant; food preview when holding edible items
- **Saturation** — Sub-bar below the food bar
- **Air** — Underwater breath indicator with flashing warning
- **Armor Toughness** — Secondary damage reduction stat
- **Mount Health** — Health of horses, striders, llamas, and other mounts
- **Absorption** — Absorption hearts shown as a progress bar

### Mod Compatibility

- [**Thirst Was Taken**](https://modrinth.com/mod/thirst-was-taken) — thirst bar + hydration sub-bar + drink preview
- [**Vampirism**](https://modrinth.com/mod/vampirism) — blood level bar (replaces the food bar when in vampire form)
- [**Farmer's Delight**](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight) — golden nourishment overlay on the food bar
- [**Kaleidoscope Cookery**](https://modrinth.com/mod/kaleidoscope-cookery) — red satiation-compensation overlay on the food bar
- [**Enigmatic Legacy+**](https://modrinth.com/mod/enigmatic-legacy-plus) — Forbidden Curse hunger overlay (mutually exclusive with blood/food)

### Multi-Effect Icon Stacking

Poison, Wither, and Freezing icons automatically stack side-by-side on the health bar. Similarly, Hunger, Nourishment, and Satiation-Compensation icons arrange themselves on the food bar — no overlapping mess.

### Food & Drink Preview

Hold a food item in your hand to see exactly how much hunger and saturation it will restore, shown as a preview overlay on the bars (similar to AppleSkin).

### Custom Pixel Number Fonts

Choose between **3x5** and **3x5_tiny** bitmap fonts for a compact, retro-looking numeric display on the HUD.

### Full Chinese Translation

Complete **zh_CN** localization of the entire UI and configuration menu.

### Debug Toggles (8)

Developer-only switches for testing bar behavior and HUD rendering — available only in a development environment.

### Code Quality Improvements

Compared to the original Forge version, this fork brings:
- Centralized registration system (ModOverlays, ModIcons, ModConfigs)
- Spotless automated code formatting
- Gradle version catalog for unified dependency management
- Access Transformer infrastructure
- Data generation framework

---

## Configuration Highlights

- Every status bar: **LEFT** / **RIGHT** / **HIDDEN**
- Custom color picker for each bar
- Number display modes: **Current value only** / **Current + Max** / **Percentage**
- Per-bar icon toggle
- Per-bar overlay effect toggle
- Full configuration GUI — no manual file editing required

---

## Requirements

- **Minecraft:** 1.21.1
- **NeoForge:** 21.1.228+
- **Side:** Client-side only (no server installation needed)

---

## Credits

- **Original author:** [Tfarcenim](https://github.com/Tfarcenim)
- **Original project:** [Classic Bar (Forge)](https://github.com/Tfarcenim/ClassicBar)

## License

**GPL-3.0-only** — This fork is released under the GNU General Public License v3.0. Includes 3x5 bitmap fonts from [Reliable-Recount](https://github.com/evanbones/Reliable-Recount) by catboybinary, also GPL-3.0.

title: ProAuthMeLogin
description: Help your Anthme with an Dialog or AnvilGui
body:
# ProAuthMeLogin

A plugin allowing your players to login without typing password by entering commands. 
Now we have supported Folia, Paper, Purpur and Leaf.

## Dependencies

| Dependency | Type |
|------|-----------|
| Paper 1.21+ / Folia | ✅Required |
| Java 21 | ✅Required |
| AuthMe 5.6.1+ | ✅Required |
| Floodgate + Geyser | ⚠️Optional (Bedrock Edition Support) |
| ItemsAdder | ⚠️Optional (Custom Items) |
| FastLogin | ⚠️Optional (Automatic Login for Genuine Players) |
| PlaceholderAPI | ⚠️Optional |
## Features

- **Dual GUI Mode**: Clients 1.21.5+ automatically use the native Dialog window; other clients revert to the Anvil GUI.

- **User Agreement Pop-up**: Displays the agreement after login/registration; rejection results in being kicked from the server.

- **Bedrock Edition Support**: Automatically identifies and routes to the Bedrock Edition GUI via Floodgate.

- **Security Protection**: Login failure lockout, IP address protection. Rate limiting, security audit logs

- **Password policy:** Configurable length limit, uppercase letter requirement

- **Folia compatibility:** All scheduling operations are adapted to Folia multi-threading
## 配置

```yaml
max-attempts: 3           # 最大登录尝试次数
lockout-duration: 300     # 锁定时长（秒）

config:
  isRequestUpper: true    # 密码须含大写字母
  checkLowestPassword: true
  checkLongestPassword: true
  enableAgreement: true   # 启用用户协议弹窗
  useDialogGui: true      # 启用 Dialog GUI（1.21.5+ 客户端）
  close-kick: true        # 强制无法关闭登录界面

materials:
  login:
    left: "PAPER"
    right: "REDSTONE"
    output: "ARROW"
  register:
    left: "DIAMOND"
    right: "IRON_INGOT"
    output: "ARROW"

messages:
  login-title: "Login"
  reg-title: "Register"
  # ... 其余见默认 config.yml

agreement:
  - "1. 禁止作弊"
  - "2. 遵守服务器规则"
  # ... 自定义协议内容
```

> Items support the ItemsAdder format：`namespace:item_id`

## 命令

| 命令             | 说明       | 权限                     |
|----------------|----------|------------------------|
| `/al reload`   | reload config     | `authanvillogin.admin` |
| `/al list`     | Check player authentication status | `authanvillogin.admin` |
| `/al login`    | Manually open the login GUI | 所有人                    |
| `/al register` | Manually open the register GUI | 所有人                    |

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Login screen cannot be opened:** Check if the item names in the `materials` configuration are valid.

**Authentic players still need to enter a password:** Ensure FastLogin and AuthMe are both running correctly. The plugin will delay for 2 seconds to wait for automatic login to complete.

**Folia error UnsupportedOperationException:** Upgrade to the latest version. The issue with BukkitScheduler in older versions has been fixed.

**getClientBrandName() NullPointerException:** Upgrade to the latest version. Null value protection has been added.

## License

GPL-3.0 license ©

title: Create Recycling V2
description: Recycling mod for reverse recipe generation! Generates crushing wheel recipes to recycle your Create items!
body:
## Introduction (do /reload when you first add it)
Straight to the point- someone made a Fabric create recycling mod which adds crushing wheel recipes to turn crafted items back into their original form. it was terrible and had a ton of bugs so I made this version, this time for NEOFORGE!

I had ported their Fabric version just to update it to Create 6 but it was still terrible so that is now private.

Let me know on Github by reporting issues if you want a less buggy Fabric version!

## Now onto the mod description:


Do you ever end up with chests completely full of random leftover items and blocks that you can't really do anything with. I wanted a way to actually break them down, so I made Create Recycling (code is completely diff from the original made by someone else for Fabric)!

Basically, this mod dynamically generates Crushing Wheel recipes for almost every crafted item in the game. You just throw your unwanted stuff into the wheels, and it automatically calculates the base materials and spits them back out for you.

## How It Works:

**Smart Yields**: Full blocks (like iron blocks, slime blocks, or Create alloys) give you 100% of your stuff back. Regular items give you a guaranteed base amount, plus a percentage chance for the rest, so it stays balanced and isn't too overpowered.

**Auto-Generation**: You don't need to manually configure hundreds of JSON files. The mod scans your recipe registry right when the server starts and builds a virtual datapack in your config folder automatically.

**Skips The Weird Stuff**: It's smart enough to ignore things that shouldn't be crushed (like wood planks, glass panes, or waxed blocks) so your JEI doesn't get cluttered with broken or useless recipes.


### Read this:
_(**Note**: Because of how 1.21 loads, if the recycling recipes don't show up the very first time you boot up a new world, just type /reload in chat so the game can read the generated files, and you're good to go!)_

Hope this helps you guys clean up your factories and save some resources. Let me know if you run into any bugs!

--- ## ⚔️ About OutCombatLog **OutCombatLog** is not just another combat logger — it's a **complete combat logging prevention system** for your Minecraft server. Unlike standard plugins that simply punish players, OutCombatLog delivers a professional experience with beautiful BossBar timers, stunning visual feedback, and unparalleled customization options. Whether you're running a small PvP server with friends or a large factions network with hundreds of players, OutCombatLog adapts to your needs with its flexible configuration system, item cooldowns, and comprehensive combat protection. --- ## ✨ Feature Showcase ### ⚔️ Core PvP Features | Feature | Description | |---------|-------------| | **PvP Timer** | Configurable duration (default: 30 seconds) that resets with each hit | | **BossBar Display** | Beautiful BossBar on top with real-time timer and custom text | | **Combat on Death** | Configurable - killer remains in PvP after kill to prevent instant logout | | **Logout Punishment** | Players who log out during PvP are killed with item drops like normal death | | **Login Notification** | Players are notified when they log in if they left during PvP | ### 🛡️ Protection & Safety | Feature | Description | |---------|-------------| | **Command Blocking** | Block all commands during PvP except allowed ones (msg, tell, help, etc.) | | **Ender Chest Block** | Prevent players from opening Ender Chests during combat | | **Logout Broadcast** | Alert players in radius (configurable) when someone combat logs | | **Item Cooldowns** | Custom cooldowns for specific items during PvP only | ### ⏱️ Item Cooldowns (EXAMPLE) | Item | Default Cooldown | |------|------------------| | **ENDER_PEARL** | 15 seconds | | **ENCHANTED_GOLDEN_APPLE** | 60 seconds | | **GOLDEN_APPLE** | 30 seconds | | **CHORUS_FRUIT** | 10 seconds | | **FIREWORK_ROCKET** | 10 seconds | | **ENDER_CHEST** | 30 seconds | > **Note:** All cooldowns are fully configurable and only apply during PvP mode! ### 🔊 Audio & Visual | Feature | Description | |---------|-------------| | **Combat Start Sound** | Configurable sound when entering PvP | | **Combat Tick Sound** | Ticking sound 3 seconds before PvP ends | | **Combat End Sound** | Victory sound when PvP timer expires | | **BossBar Customization** | Full RGB color support, custom text, and timer display | | **BossBar Styles** | Multiple styles: PROGRESS, NOTCHED_6, NOTCHED_10, NOTCHED_12, NOTCHED_20 | ### 👑 Admin Features | Feature | Description | |---------|-------------| | **Config Reload** | `/ocl reload` - Reload configuration without restart | | **Item List** | `/ocl list` - View all items with cooldowns | | **Combat Status** | `/ocl check` - Check current PvP status | | **Plugin Info** | `/ocl info` - View plugin information and statistics | | **Update Checker** | Automatic notification when new version is available | --- ## 📥 Installation Guide | Step | Action | |------|--------| | 1️⃣ | **Download** — Get the latest `.jar` from [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/plugin/outcombatlog) | | 2️⃣ | **Install** — Place the JAR into your server's `plugins/` folder | | 3️⃣ | **Restart** — Restart your server (or use `/reload` if you must) | | 4️⃣ | **Configure** — Edit `plugins/OutCombatLog/config.yml` to your liking | | 5️⃣ | **Enjoy!** — Players are now protected from combat loggers | > **⚠️ Important:** A full server restart is strongly recommended over `/reload` for optimal performance and to avoid any plugin conflicts. ## 📊 bStats Metrics OutCombatLog uses bStats to collect anonymous usage statistics. title: DeathSwap by DFWS
description: A powerful but reliable plugin that add Death Swap Death Shuffle and Block Shuffle to Minecraft.
body:
# 🎮 DeathSwap

**A professional DeathSwap minigame plugin** for Paper 1.21.11 with 3 game modes, multi-arenas, admin dashboard, and full customization.

> ⚠️ **Paper 1.21.11 required** (or compatible forks like Purpur). Not compatible with Spigot/Bukkit.

---

## ✨ Features

- 🕹️ **3 Game Modes** — DeathSwap, DeathShuffle, BlockShuffle
- 🏟️ **Multi-Arenas** — Independent instances with their own worlds, configs, and players
- 🎛️ **Admin Dashboard** — Full GUI to manage arenas, players, gamerules, and settings
- 📊 **Statistics** — Kills, deaths, wins, play time with leaderboards
- 🗳️ **Seed Voting** — Players vote for predefined seeds before each game
- 🎯 **Challenges** — Craft, mine, and kill objectives with potion effect rewards
- 🔊 **Custom Sounds** — Every event sound is fully configurable
- 🤝 **Team System** — Play all modes cooperatively with auto-balanced color teams
- 🎨 **Two UI Modes** — RICH (BossBar + ActionBar) or CLEAN (chat only)
- ⚙️ **In-Game Config** — Modify everything via GUI or commands, no file editing needed
- 🛠️ **Custom GameMode API** — Developers can register their own modes using the DeathSwapAPI
- 🌐 **Bilingual** — French and English support
- ⚡ **Lightning Fast Start** — Bypass wait times for instant gameplay!
- 🌍 **Custom Dimensions** — Configurable Nether & End worlds per arena with dedicated gamerules
- 🛡️ **World-Ready Polling** — Intelligent loading checks ensuring CWR and Multiverse worlds are securely loaded

---

## 🕹️ Game Modes

| Mode | How it works |
|------|-------------|
| **DeathSwap** | Players trappers are randomly swapped — trap your area and survive your opponent's trap! |
| **DeathShuffle** | Each round assigns a death type. Die the right way to survive! Configurable causes via in-game GUI, includes "Death Run". |
| **BlockShuffle** | Find and stand on the target block before time runs out! Configurable blocks via in-game GUI, includes "Item Race". |

---

## 📋 Quick Start

1. Drop the JAR in `plugins/`
2. Create worlds (Multiverse recommended): `mv create DS_Game normal` + `mv create DS_Lobby normal`
3. Copy `arenas/example.yml` → `arenas/default.yml`, edit your world names
4. `/ds reload` then `/ds join`

title: Alloy
description: The Alloy mod is an expansion for Minecraft that adds new materials, tools, armor, and unique resource processing mechanics to the game.
body:
# ⚒️ Alloy

**Alloy** is a mod that significantly expands the possibilities of the game by introducing new metals, tools, armor and production units. The mod is aimed at players who want to diversify the process of mining, processing and using resources, as well as gain new experiences from crafting and progression.

---

## ✨ What does the mod add?

### 🔩 New metals and alloys

Unique materials such as **Azurite**, **Bronze**, **Aurum**, **Aquitaine**, **Amethyst**, **Hell Metal** and others are added to the game. Each metal has its own properties, appearance and production methods.

### 🛠️ Tools and weapons

For each new material, a complete set of tools (pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe, sword) with unique characteristics of strength, speed and damage are implemented.

### 🛡️ Armor

Each metal allows you to create a complete set of armor, featuring protection and additional effects:

- **Amethyst Armor** — grants Night Vision effect
- **Azurite Armor** — grants Speed effect
- **Aquitaine Armor** — grants Jump Boost effect
- **Hell Armor** — grants Fire Resistance effect
- **Aurum Armor** — grants Regeneration effect

### 🏭 New production units

The mod features a unique block — **Mega Smelter**, which allows you to melt ores and materials more efficiently and quickly, and also has its own interface and animation.

### 📜 Crafting Recipes

Balanced recipes are implemented for all new items and blocks, integrated into the standard Minecraft crafting system.

### 🎨 Unique textures and models

All items, blocks and armor have their own high-quality textures and 3D models that harmoniously fit into the style of the game.

### 🏆 Achievements System

The mod includes a comprehensive achievement system to track your progress:

- **🔥 Embodiment of Fire** — Craft a Mega Smelter
- **⚡ Spark of Progress!** — Create your first alloy in the Mega Smelter
- **🌙 Master of Night** — Craft a full set of amethyst armor
- **💎 First Blood of Earth** — Mine any ore from the mod

---

## 🎯 Key Features

- ⚔️ **Expansion of endgame content** through new materials and improved tools
- 🔗 **Production chains** using new blocks and recipes
- 🎭 **Visual and gameplay variety** due to unique textures and effects
- ⚖️ **Balanced gameplay** — all items are carefully balanced and don't overpower vanilla content
- 🌍 **Rare ore generation** — ores spawn less frequently than diamonds, making them valuable
- 🎮 **Seamless integration** with vanilla Minecraft mechanics

---

## 💡 Why should you download Alloy?

- 🆕 **New impressions:** The mod adds a fresh look at the familiar Minecraft mechanics, making the process of mining and processing resources more interesting

- ⚖️ **Balance and integration:** All items and blocks are balanced and seamlessly blend into the vanilla gameplay

- ✨ **High-quality implementation:** The mod is characterized by high quality of execution, thoughtful textures and stable operation

- 🔄 **Support and development:** The project is actively developing, updates with new features are regularly released

- 🏆 **Progression system:** Achievements provide additional goals and rewards for your journey

---

**Alloy** is the perfect choice for players who want to expand the possibilities of Minecraft, get new challenges and make the gameplay even more exciting!

---

## 📋 Requirements

- **Minecraft:** 1.20.1
- **Fabric Loader:** ≥0.16.13
- **Fabric API:** Required
- **Java:** ≥17

---

## 🔧 Installation

1. Install **Fabric Loader** for Minecraft 1.20.1
2. Download and install **Fabric API**
3. Place the **Alloy** mod file in your `mods` folder
4. Launch Minecraft and enjoy!

---

title: Tensura-BYG
description: This is a simple, lightweight compatibility patch that fixes a common world-generation crash between the Tensura: Reincarnated mod and Oh The Biomes You'll Go (BYG)
body:
This is a full compatibility patch that allows the "Tensura: Reincarnated" and "Oh The Biomes You'll Go" (BYG) mods to work together seamlessly without crashes or lost content.
 
The Problem:
Without this patch, using Tensura and BYG together results in a critical Feature order cycle error during world generation. This happens because both mods try to add their unique features (like trees) to the same biome spaces, creating an infinite dependency loop that crashes the game.

 
The Solution & Integration

 

This patch doesn't just disable the problematic tensura:sakura_forest biome to prevent the crash. Instead, it integrates its key content into the equivalent biome from BYG, creating a full and logical compatibility experience.

Now, in BYG's cherry_blossom_forest biome, you will find:

    🌸 Sakura Trees from the Tensura mod, generating naturally.

    🐝 Army Wasps from the Tensura mod, which now spawn in this biome to restore its intended fauna.

![Create: Masterwork title image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1acb2ee23526cf83f3695e6ee8319ce15e33fc53.png)

## Intro
*Create: Masterwork* is a carefully designed modpack built around the Create mod and its addons, always striving to be one of the best ways to play the latest version of Create—now updated to Create v6.0: *Post Production*. A medium-sized pack made to appeal to both new modded Minecraft players and seasoned veterans.

Instead of a chaotic mix of disconnected mods, Create: Masterwork offers a thoughtfully curated modlist where all the content is cohesively integrated and made compatible to prioritize fun and discovery. A custom, carefully designed advancement tab can help guide you through the pack’s diverse content and give you goals to work towards, encouraging creativity without the rigid structure of a traditional quest system.

## Features

- **Built Around Create And Its Best Addons** - Featuring a carefully selected range of complementary mods, configs, and integrations.
  
- **Long-term Depth** - Includes mods for building, creativity, and lasting replayability. 
  
- **Improved World Generation** - Stunning landscapes across all three vanilla dimensions.  
  
- **Enhanced Visuals** - Full support for both **shaders** and **Distant Horizons**.  
  
- **Multiple Ways to Play** - Enjoy singleplayer, host a dedicated server, or use the included e4mc mod to open your LAN world to friends over the internet with a single click.

## Technical Stuff
### Performance
- Memory (RAM) Requirements: For smooth gameplay, at least 6-8 GB of RAM is recommended.
- Disabling Distant Horizons, tweaking or turning off shaders, or playing on a dedicated server can significantly reduce memory usage and improve performance—especially on lower-end systems.
- If you experience visual stuttering, try these adjustments or ensure at least 6-8 GB of RAM is allocated to your Minecraft instance if possible.

### Installation (Client)
1. Just download the modpack through the Modrinth launcher!
2. Run with a minimum of 6 GB of allocated memory (RAM), with 8 GB being ideal. Make sure to leave at least 2-3 GB free for your computer to ensure system stability.
### Installation (Dedicated Server)
1. Download The modpack client through your preferred launcher.
2. Copy the /config folder from the pack's files to the /config folder on your forge server.
3. Copy the /kubejs folder from the pack's files to the /kubejs folder on your forge server.
4. Copy the /mods folder from the pack's files to the /mods folder on your forge server.
5. **IMPORTANT** Remove the following mods from your server's /mods folder (Not doing this will result in your server not being able to start):
- blur-forge-x.x.x.jar
- oculus-mc1.20.1-x.x.x.jar

title: Origins: Verdant Crown
description: A symbiotic peacekeeper left to rust away in the ruins of the Verdant Kingdom. It excels at mitigating conflict with powerful crowd control abilities and a 'safety cannon'.
body:
_"...…we remain, and they do not. My first brother, the Verdant crown, was designed to be necessarily capable of enforcing peace and compliance, in line with the values Verdancy had come to symbolise post-standardization. It was publicly beloved by Verdant citizens, due to its competence in imposing such positive outlooks. However…"_

🟢 Restraint: Targets restrained by the Verdant crown would be significantly slowed, with both their damage dealt and damage taken halved. In this state, targets would spread their restraint to nearby entities, but would be completely freed if the crown was not in close proximity.

🟩 HLSC: The hard light safety cannon implanted in the Verdant crown's body allowed it to restrain threats at a distance. The cannon had to be charged for a considerable amount of time before it could fire, a process that would rapidly drain the crown's internal charge.

🟩 Sanction: In order to selectively restrain threats, the Verdant crown was able to sanction unrestrained entities. Sanctioned entities could not be restrained by any source other than a direct HLSC shot, which was the only way to lift a sanction.

🟩 Restraint Drone: The crown was capable of projecting drones that, while energized, would act as conduits to keep entities restrained even while the crown was out of their range. When first created, a drone would be automatically sanctioned. To remove this sanction and energize the drone, the crown had to shoot them with the HLSC and provide 160 post-standard experience units (PSX).

🟢 Symbiotic Sustainability: The hard light projectors that powered the Verdant crown could only be recharged by siphoning energy from nearby restrained entities. When at maximum energy, the crown's 'safety inhibitors' would reduce its damage output by 25%. When below maximum charge, these inhibitors would deactivate, but the crown would be completely unable to heal.

🟢 Verdant Roots: After its termination, the Verdant crown was left to rust in the buried ruins of an ancient village, awaiting the day it could awaken once more.

🟢 Pearlescent Archives: All three crowns possessed the ability to interface with the Pearlescent Archives from anywhere within the Pearlescent realm, provided they had a suitable antenna.

Being the first project in my new "Miniature Modpacks" series, the cloudy skylands are brought to life with only 10 primary mods (as well as a bunch of performance/QoL mods but those don't count). The world generates in clusters of floating, towering islands, capable of generating all vanilla terrain and natural features. Peppered throughout this world are additional floating structures, giving players locations to find and explore. The pack also comes with 3 mods that add unique ways to traverse get around! And bridges! The entire pack is also thoughtfully tweaked and modified to add some visual flare, tying together the idea that this truly is a world in the clouds! Check out the video below showing the creation process!

# IMPORTANT

I have abandoned this as the code got a little messy and I can't fix it.

# Intro

This mod aims to shake up the PvP game, and make it a bit more exciting as well as interactive. This mod will be updated as time permits with:

Currently
  - New Weapons
  - New Totems

Possibly

  - New Enchantments
  - New Effects
  - New Potions

# Overview

This mod currently adds two weapons to the game, as well as two new Totems. 

The current Weapons:
- The Scythe is a faster but weaker weapon than the Vanilla Sword
- The Buster Sword is a slower but more powerful weapon than the Vanilla Axe
- The Masamune is even faster than the scythe at the cost of less damage

The current Materials:
- The Rotting Soul and a Netherite Template upgrades your Diamond tools or weapons into Rotting items.

The current Totems:
- The Totem of Silence adds another 20 hearts to your health for a minute and instantly heals you for around 16 hearts. The drawback is you get the Darkness effect for a minute as well
- The Totem of Fear makes you nearly invincible, as well as faster and stronger
- The Rotting Soul makes you nearly invincible as the Totem of Fear does, but also allows for you to see inn the dark and the mending of flesh and bones.

title: RealRegions
description: GUI based World and Region management plugin
body:
# RealRegions Plugin

Welcome to the **RealRegions** plugin page!  
RealRegions is a brand-new GUI-based World and Region management plugin.  
**Note:** To use this plugin, you will need **FAWE** or **WorldEdit**.

## Statistics  
[Plugin Statistics on bStats](https://bstats.org/plugin/bukkit/RealRegions/19311)

## Found an Issue?  
Report it [here](https://github.com/joserodpt/RealRegions/issues) or message me on Discord.  

**Discord:** [Join the Discord Server](https://discord.gg/SK7M7f2YkV)

## Features  
- **Integration with RealMines**: Automatically creates a region for a mine.  
- **Integration with RealPermissions**: Sync up permissions easily.  
- **YAML Configuration** for easy customization.  
- **Simple and Performant GUI Interface** for seamless management.  
- **Flag Toggling by GUI** for easy control.  
- **Console Commands** supported for advanced usage.  
- **Permission Bypass** for region flags.  
- **World Management**: Create, import, unload, and manage worlds using commands or GUI.

## Commands & Permissions

### 1. Default Command
- **Command:** `/realregions` or `/rr`  
- **Function:** Displays plugin information, such as the plugin name and version.

### 2. Reload Command
- **Command:** `/realregions reload` or `/rr reload`  
- **Permission:** `realregions.admin`  
- **Function:** Reloads the configuration files and updates the plugin settings.

### 3. Worlds Command
- **Command:** `/realregions worlds` or `/rr worlds`  
- **Permission:** `realregions.admin`  
- **Function:** Lists all registered worlds and their load status. Opens a GUI for players.

### 4. Create Command
- **Command:** `/realregions create <name>`  
- **Permission:** `realregions.admin`  
- **Function:** Creates a region by selecting a WorldEdit region and associates it with the specified name.

### 5. Create World Command
- **Command:** `/realregions createw <name> <worldtype>`  
- **Permission:** `realregions.admin`  
- **Function:** Creates a new world with the specified name and world type.

### 6. Region Command
- **Command:** `/realregions region <name>` or `/rr reg <name>`  
- **Permission:** `realregions.admin`  
- **Function:** Displays detailed information about the specified region and opens a GUI for management.

### 7. World Command
- **Command:** `/realregions world <name>` or `/rr w <name>`  
- **Permission:** `realregions.admin`  
- **Function:** Displays detailed information about the specified world and opens a GUI for management.

### 8. Teleport World Command
- **Command:** `/realregions tp <name>`  
- **Permission:** `realregions.admin`  
- **Function:** Teleports the player to the specified world.

### 9. Teleport Region Command
- **Command:** `/realregions tpr <name>`  
- **Permission:** `realregions.admin`  
- **Function:** Teleports the player to the specified region.

### 10. View Command
- **Command:** `/realregions view <name>`  
- **Permission:** `realregions.admin`  
- **Function:** Toggles the visibility of region boundaries for the specified region.

### 11. Unload Command
- **Command:** `/realregions unload <name>`  
- **Permission:** `realregions.admin`  
- **Function:** Unloads the specified world.

### 12. Load Command
- **Command:** `/realregions load <name>`  
- **Permission:** `realregions.admin`  
- **Function:** Loads the specified world.

### 13. Unregister Command
- **Command:** `/realregions unregister <name>`  
- **Permission:** `realregions.admin`  
- **Function:** Unregisters the specified world from the plugin.

### 14. Import Command
- **Command:** `/realregions import <name> <worldtype>`  
- **Permission:** `realregions.admin`  
- **Function:** Imports a world with the specified name and world type.

### 15. Delete Region Command
- **Command:** `/realregions delete <name>` or `/rr del <name>`  
- **Permission:** `realregions.admin`  
- **Function:** Deletes the specified region.

### 16. Entities Command
- **Command:** `/realregions entities <name>` or `/rr ents <name>`  
- **Permission:** `realregions.admin`  
- **Function:** Displays a GUI showing entities present in the specified world.

### 17. Delete World Command
- **Command:** `/realregions deleteworld <name>` or `/rr delw <name>`  
- **Permission:** `realregions.admin`  
- **Function:** Deletes the specified world.

### 18. Players Command
- **Command:** `/realregions players <name>` or `/rr plrs <name>`  
- **Permission:** `realregions.admin`  
- **Function:** Displays a GUI showing players present in the specified world.

## Support  
If you have any issues with the plugin, contact me via DM on Here or join the Discord server.

## Like the Plugin?  
Don't forget to give it a **heart**!

title: Plugin See For Op
description: Blocks /plugins command for non-OPs.
body:
## **Plugin See for OP**

**Minecraft Compatibility:** 1.21, 1.21.1

**Overview:**  
Plugin See for OP is a straightforward Minecraft plugin designed to enhance your server's security by restricting access to the `/plugins` command. With this plugin, only server operators (OPs) can use the `/plugins` command to view the list of installed plugins, while non-OP players are entirely blocked from accessing this information.

### **Key Feature:**

- **OP-Only Access to `/plugins`:** Plugin See for OP automatically disables the `/plugins` command for non-OP players. If a non-OP player attempts to use the command, they will receive a message indicating that the command is not available to them.

### **Installation and Setup:**

- Download the Plugin See for OP .jar file.
- Place it in your server’s `plugins` folder.
- Restart your server.

### **Future Plans:**

- **Custom Configs:** Future updates will introduce the ability for non-OP players to receive a customizable message or no response at all when attempting to use the `/plugins` command, making it appear as though the command does not exist.

- **Customizable Responses:** We plan to add functionality for server administrators to easily customize the message displayed to non-OP players when they try to access the `/plugins` command. This will allow for personalized server messages that match your server's theme or rules.

- **Complete Alias Protection:** Future versions will include comprehensive protection for all common aliases of the `/plugins` command, ensuring consistent security across the server.

- **Optional Logging:** We aim to implement optional logging to track unauthorized attempts to use the `/plugins` command. This feature will help server admins monitor potential security threats or players trying to explore restricted commands.

- **Enhanced Performance:** Updates will focus on ensuring the plugin has minimal impact on server performance, maintaining its efficiency for servers of all sizes without causing lag or delays.

- **Advanced Configuration:** Future releases will offer an enhanced configuration file (`config.yml`) that allows more extensive customization of the plugin’s behavior to fit your server's needs, including changes to response messages and logging options.

- **Seamless Integration:** Planned updates will ensure the plugin remains fully compatible with other plugins and server configurations, integrating smoothly into any existing setup without causing conflicts.

- **Future-Proof Updates:** We will continue to provide regular updates to ensure Plugin See for OP remains compatible with future versions of Minecraft, guaranteeing long-term reliability and security.

Take control of your server's plugin visibility with Plugin See for OP, ensuring only trusted server operators can access this critical information.

title: AdminWhitelist
description: Allows players who are not on the whitelist to join the server when an admin is online
body:
# AdminWhitelist - Allows players who are not on the whitelist to join the server when an admin is online

![Version](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/LakyLuc/AdminWhitelist?style=flat-square)
![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-AGPL%20v3-yellow?style=flat-square)

## Description
AdminWhitelist is a plugin that allows players who are not whitelisted to join the server, but only if an admin is online.
Players that are not whitelisted will be kicked if no admins are online.
This is useful for servers that want to be open to the public, but don't want to be overrun by griefers.

## Installation
- Put the plugin in the `plugins` folder of your server
- Start the server
- Add players to the admin list with `/adminwhitelist add <UUID>`
- Turn on the whitelist with `/whitelist on`
- Add players to the whitelist with `/whitelist add <player>`
- Reload the whitelist with `/whitelist reload` after making changes

## Commands
`/adminwhitelist add <UUID>` (`/awl add <UUID>`) - Adds a player to the admin list

`/adminwhitelist remove <UUID>` (`/awl remove <UUID>`) - Removes a player from the admin list

`/adminwhitelist list` (`/awl list`) - Lists all players on the admin list

The commands must be run in the server console.

## Permissions

`adminwhitelist.update` - Receive a notification when a new version is available

title: hAntiLagMachines
description: Targeted lag-machine protection with modular detection, automatic cleanup, quarantine, logs, protected signs and fully configurable thresholds.
body:
# hAntiLagMachines

**hAntiLagMachines** is a targeted lag-machine protection plugin for Minecraft servers.

Instead of working as a generic anti-lag cleaner, the plugin focuses on specific dangerous construction patterns that are commonly used to overload servers: dense redstone grids, gravity block traps, minecart rail clusters, piston machines with armor stands, large slime or honey piston walls, and sculk sensor activity zones.

The plugin detects suspicious structures, temporarily quarantines dangerous areas, removes selected blocks or entities when needed, writes detailed logs, and places protected signs with a detection ID.

---

## Overview

hAntiLagMachines is built around separate protection modules.

Each module has its own settings, scan radius, trigger thresholds, cleanup limits, cooldowns and quarantine rules. You can enable or disable modules independently and adjust the plugin to your server's gameplay style.

The plugin is designed for servers where players can build freely, but destructive lag-machine patterns must be detected and blocked automatically before they cause serious TPS drops.

---

## Features

- Modular lag-machine detection
- Automatic cleanup of dangerous structures
- Temporary quarantine for active areas
- Detailed logs with coordinates and nearby players
- Protected sign placement after cleanup
- Configurable materials
- Configurable scan radius and thresholds
- Cleanup cooldowns to avoid repeated heavy work
- Expiring internal caches
- Version-safe sculk sensor support
- No external dependencies
- No commands required

---

## Modules

### Redstone

Detects dense redstone grids made from redstone wire, repeaters and comparators.

The module can react to:

- Suspicious redstone construction
- Active redstone event spam
- Dense multi-layer redstone structures
- High repeater or comparator density

When a dangerous redstone grid is detected, the plugin can cancel the placement, quarantine the affected region, remove redstone parts and write a detailed log entry.

---

### Gravity

Detects gravity-block and cobweb lag machines.

The module checks patterns involving:

- Sand
- Red sand
- Gravel
- Concrete powder
- Cobwebs
- FallingBlock entity bursts

It can react both when a support block is broken and when many falling blocks are spawned in a short time. The cleanup can remove gravity blocks, cobwebs and nearby falling block entities.

---

### Minecarts

Detects dense minecart and rail lag machines.

The module checks:

- Minecart placement
- Vehicle creation
- Active vehicle update spam
- Rail clusters near minecarts
- High minecart density

When the configured pattern is detected, the plugin can quarantine the region, remove minecarts, remove rails and log the action.

---

### Armor Stands

Detects piston machines that use armor stands.

The module watches:

- Armor stand spawning
- Piston machine construction
- Piston extension and retraction
- Frequent piston activity near armor stands

Cleanup can remove armor stands and machine parts such as pistons, observers, redstone blocks, piston heads and moving pistons.

---

### Slime Walls

Detects large slime or honey piston walls.

The module checks structures made from:

- Slime blocks
- Honey blocks
- Pistons
- Sticky pistons
- Observers
- Redstone blocks
- Piston heads
- Moving pistons

It can detect dangerous patterns during construction, piston movement and repeated active movement.

---

### Sculk Sensors

Detects sculk sensor lag-machine zones on versions where sculk sensor materials are available.

The module can watch:

- Sculk sensor construction
- Redstone activity from sensors
- Physics activity near sensors
- Repeated activity in remembered sensor regions

Sculk sensor zones are quarantined first. After repeated quarantine strikes, the plugin can remove sculk sensors from the configured cleanup radius.

On older server versions where sculk sensor materials are not available, this module is automatically unavailable.

---

## Logs

hAntiLagMachines writes detailed logs to a configurable log file.

By default, logs are stored in:

```text
plugins/hAntiLagMachines/logs.txt
```

Log entries can include:

- Detection ID
- Detection type
- World name
- Coordinates
- Nearby players
- Removed block count
- Removed entity count
- Pattern details
- Quarantine status
- Sculk sensor strike count

Log text and formatting are configurable in:

```text
plugins/hAntiLagMachines/logs.yml
```

---

## Signs

After a cleanup, the plugin can place a protected sign near the detected location.

The sign can display:

- Plugin name
- Protection message
- Date
- Log ID

The sign is marked through persistent data and cannot be broken by regular players. Only players with the configured admin permission can break protected signs.

---

## Config

The plugin creates three main configuration files:

```text
plugins/hAntiLagMachines/config.yml
plugins/hAntiLagMachines/materials.yml
plugins/hAntiLagMachines/logs.yml
```

`config.yml` controls modules, thresholds, scan radius, cleanup radius, cooldowns and quarantine settings.

`materials.yml` controls which materials are counted as redstone parts, gravity blocks, rails, minecart items, piston parts, sticky blocks and sculk sensor blocks.

`logs.yml` controls log messages, sign text, titles, reasons and detail formats.

---

## Commands

This plugin does not register player commands.

Protection works automatically through event listeners and configuration files.

---

## Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `hantilagmachines.admin` | Allows breaking protected hAntiLagMachines signs | OP |

The permission string can also be changed in the configuration:

```yaml
settings:
  permissions:
    admin: "hantilagmachines.admin"
```

---

## Requirements

| Requirement | Status |
|---|---|
| Java 17 or newer | Required |
| Spigot/Paper/Purpur 1.16 or newer | Required |
| External plugins | Not required |

Paper or Purpur is recommended for production servers.

---

## Install

1. Place `hAntiLagMachines.jar` into the server's `plugins` folder.
2. Restart the server.
3. Open the plugin folder:

```text
plugins/hAntiLagMachines/
```

4. Configure enabled modules and thresholds in `config.yml`.
5. Configure checked materials in `materials.yml` if needed.
6. Configure log and sign text in `logs.yml` if needed.
7. Give staff the admin permission if they should be able to remove protected signs.

---

## Use Cases

hAntiLagMachines is useful for:

- Survival servers with free building
- Anarchy or semi-anarchy servers
- Servers with redstone enabled
- Technical survival servers
- Public servers with grief protection
- Servers where lag machines are a common problem
- Projects that need automatic logging for staff review

---

## Notes

The plugin removes blocks and entities when a configured pattern is detected. Before using it on a live server, review the default thresholds and test the plugin with your own gameplay rules.

For strict servers, lower the thresholds.

For technical survival servers, increase the thresholds to avoid blocking legitimate farms or complex redstone builds.

title: Prevent Enderman Block Pickup
description: Prevents Endermen from picking up (& placing) blocks and destroying your carefully crafted world!
body:
# Prevent Enderman Block Pickup

Prevent Enderman Block Pickup, as it says on the tin, prevents Endermen from picking up blocks (and technically also placing down). This mod only has to be installed on the server side (which is the client when playing single player) in order for it to work. You can remove this mod at any time (or use the config in v2.0.0 and up) to allow Endermen to pick up blocks again; This mod does not permanently change your world(s). 

I know that there are quite a few other mods out there that do the same, but I can't seem to find one that does exactly what I want and/or is available in the version(s) I want. For example, some still allow Endermen to pick up pumpkins and melons, some create an entry in the Advancements tab, and some are not open source. This doesn't mean they are bad mods; I just wanted a version of anti-Enderman griefing that I personally have no issues with.

## Version Support

I intend to support all __release__ versions from 1.21.1 onward. I might release this mod for older versions like 1.20.x, but I'll see about that.

## Why? (Rant)

I don't mind most forms of mob griefing, such as sheep eating grass (grass grows back and passive mobs can be controlled very easily) or creepers exploding (technically you could prevent this by staying alert all the time), but there is one form I truly hate: Enderman griefing. Why? Because you cannot reasonably control it.

Unless you light up everything around you in simulation distance, you can't prevent them from spawning (why does Minecraft assume I _want_ everything to be lit up around near/in a completed base?), and you cannot control when they pick up or place which block where, which is incredibly frustrating if, like me, you want everything to stay exactly where you put it.

title: Tellurium's Random Stuff
description: Soul powered item crafting, decorative blocks, a grappling hook and other additions to make your life easier
body:
This mod is a collection of mostly non-thematic additions that tries to make your life easier. ## Features This list refers to the 1.7.0 version, in previous version this features may differ or be absent.
Soul Sand and Magma Block with Grate -Similar to its vanilla counterparts except that it doesn't have the various effect that entities get when walking on it
-Still make bubble columns underwater
![image](https://i.imgur.com/u4cH4Bk.png) ![image](https://i.imgur.com/smojRKl.png)
Hydrodynamic Rails -New type of rail that work similar to powered rails except its activated by being waterlogged
-If not waterlogged slows down the cart
-When powered it can go faster than powered rails ![image](https://i.imgur.com/J7v1QiZ.png) ![image](https://i.imgur.com/DAel0Dx.png)
Opal -A shiny rock that comes with different colors
-You can find it in large clusters underground
![image](https://i.imgur.com/C9Jpd4P.png)
Infused Soul Sand -A soul powered soul sand block
-Requires a small soul fragment to craft (see the soul fragment section)
-Used to make soul lava (see below)
![image](https://i.imgur.com/F2omvhO.png)
Soul Lava -A new type of fluid made by filtering lava with infused soul sand
-Has similar properties to lava but it doesn't do damage to skeletons
-Put an empty cauldron underneath the soul sand to collect it
-When the cauldron is filled the lava is consumed, the infused soul sand also has a chance to convert to regular soul sand
![image](https://i.imgur.com/vuqhXO6.png) ![image](https://i.imgur.com/z7gBbxu.png)
Soul Magma Blocks -Crafted by throwing a magma block inside a cauldron filled with soul lava, or with soul infusion (see the soul infuser section)
-Only skeleton-type mobs can spawn on it
-Skeletons that walk on it don't take fire damage
-It activates the soul speed enchantment
-Also has a variant with grate and generates bubble columns underwater
![image](https://i.imgur.com/QAHJPvY.png) ![image](https://i.imgur.com/7ZPp5w8.png)
Soul Magma Bricks -Decorative blocks crafted with soul magma blocks
-Allow only skeleton-type mob to spawn on it
-Unlike soul magma blocks doesn't damage entities that walk on it
-Has a slab variant ![image](https://i.imgur.com/PFRHAKQ.png)
Soul Furnace -A special furnace that use soul lava as fuel
-Can smelt four items at a time and is faster than the vanilla furnace
-Unlike vanilla furnaces, it stores soul lava in its tank and ignites only if there's a valid item to smelt in one of the input slot
-If a soul furnace gets broken the soul lava stored inside is lost so remember to use it all before breaking it
![image](https://i.imgur.com/oNPiOMd.png) ![image](https://i.imgur.com/hlt1Met.png)
Soul Fragments -Dropped by killing mobs with a sword enchanted with Soul Harvesting
-Soul Harvesting is a new treasure enchantment with max 3 levels, each level increase the drop chance of soul fragments (also stacks with Looting)
-Hostile mob and bosses drop more fragments
Soul Infuser -A block used to transmute items into other items using soul power
-Has lots of usefull recipes
-Each recipes has its own soul lava cost, use Jei to check
-Like the soul furnace the soul lava inside is lost if it gets broken
![image](https://i.imgur.com/ltnMYyb.png) ![image](https://i.imgur.com/45Vy6OQ.png)
Soul Compactor -Compact items with soul power
-Has lots of usefull recipes
-Each recipes has its own soul lava cost, use Jei to check
-Like the soul furnace the soul lava inside is lost if it gets broken
![image](https://i.imgur.com/GcCJZ61.png) ![image](https://i.imgur.com/v0vRWBc.png)
Soul Anchor -A block that allows the player to recover their inventory upon death
-Activated by right-clicking it with a Totem of Binding (the totem is consumed)
-When a player who has activated a Soul Anchor dies, their inventory is not dropped but instead 'saved'. To recover it, open the anchor's GUI, and the anchor will lose its charge.
-The saved inventory can be lost if the player dies again before recovering the previous inventory or if the anchor is broken while charged
-Charged state can be read with a comparator
![image](https://i.imgur.com/JyZq3c5.png) ![image](https://i.imgur.com/2OgkGBd.png)
Alchemixer -Mix potions using soul lava
-Mixing two potions of the same type upgrade its level or increase its durability
-Allows to obtain stronger potions than vanilla like regeneration 3 or potions longer than 8 minutes
-Mixing two potions with different effects combines them in a single potions
-Mixing cost increases the more powerful potions are mixed
![image](https://i.imgur.com/zKFpBxi.png) ![image](https://i.imgur.com/gNFSH0b.png)
Extractor -A dipenser like block that extracts items from a connected inventory behind it and drops them in front of itself
-It functions exactly like a dropper, activated by a redstone signal
-It has three slots in its inventory that act as filters where items can be placed, the extractor will only take items that match those present in its inventory
![image](https://i.imgur.com/ruH2VFr.png) ![image](https://i.imgur.com/GQz4AvD.png) ![image](https://i.imgur.com/nrVM4px.png)
Item Pedestal -Block used to display items
-Right-click to insert and retrieve items (similar to item frames)
-Use a name tag on it to make it display the item name
![image](https://i.imgur.com/uBsKHVl.png) ![image](https://i.imgur.com/6AOCmiu.png)
Bright and Soul Torchflower -Variants of the torchflower plant
-Emits light unlike its vanilla counterpart
-Can be placed in pots
![image](https://i.imgur.com/JGNw0m0.png)
Lava Googles -Allows to see inside lava more clearly
-Can be colored by crafting it with dyes like with leather armor
-It does not offer any fire protection by itself, use fire resistance potions!
![image](https://i.imgur.com/NOiryq3.png) ![image](https://i.imgur.com/C7FiP39.png) ![image](https://i.imgur.com/pfN79BU.png)
Spirited Iron -Upgraded iron ingot crafted by soul infusing iron
-Used to make tools and armor
![image](https://i.imgur.com/NIDrUya.png)
Grappling Hook -Used to jump around and climb heights faster
-Charge it by holding right-click and throw it at a block
-Once it hits a block press right-click to get pulled towards it, or shift + right-click to retrieve it without being pulled
-Press right-click again while being pulled to retrieve it
-Can be enchanted with the Aerodynamics enchantment (up to level 3) to be able to launch it further
-Careful about fall damage! Boots with feather falling recommended
![image](https://i.imgur.com/rc1kjMj.png) ![image](https://i.imgur.com/OhpnW40.png)
Floating Walkway -Walkable block that can be placed on water source blocks, even without a support block (similar to lily pads)
-Sinks slightly in water when stepped on by a living entity
-Available in all wood types
![image](https://i.imgur.com/BEdH9Id.png) ![image](https://i.imgur.com/LeCETBf.png)
Blue Glowstone -New variant of glowstone
-Only found in soul sand valleys
![image](https://i.imgur.com/cjU7h7n.png)
Blue Redstone Lamp and Soul Jack o'Lantern -Decorative blocks that emits light
![image](https://i.imgur.com/rxTBu6z.png) ![image](https://i.imgur.com/qSq8f16.png)
Awakened Sculk Shrieker -A variant of the sculk shrieker
-Allows to summon a Warden anywhere even if placed by a player
-To spawn a Warden right-click it with a soul cluster (crafted with soul fragments), the cluster is consumed
-After a succesfull spawn it goes dormant for a while before awakening again (the dormant time can be changed in the config)
![image](https://i.imgur.com/rgqfUGM.png) ![image](https://i.imgur.com/7uSbqRa.png)
Ancient City -A new structure that spawn in the deep dark, similar to ancient cities
-It contains some interesting loot
![image](https://i.imgur.com/Qo6yVMM.png) ![image](https://i.imgur.com/G25gWiC.png)
Dispenser can interact with cauldrons -Added an interaction where dispensers can fill and empty cauldrons in front of them using buckets
-Allows to automate lava and soul lava production
-Can be disabled in the config file
Zombie Horse Rider -During village zombie sieges, there is a chance for a zombie rider to spawn
-This allows players to obtain a zombie horse in survival mode
-The spawn chance can be adjusted using configs (default is 25%)
![image](https://i.imgur.com/JAy1SwL.png)
Riptide from water cauldrons -Trident enchanted with riptide can be used to launch when standing inside a water cauldrons
-Useful to use riptide inside the nether

Allays duplication with echo shards -Items present in the new allay_duplication_items tag can be used to duplicate allays similar to amethyst shards
-Echo shards are present in the tag by default
-Can be disabled in the config
This are all the features currently present in the mod, I'm probably gonna add or change some stuff in the future. If you find problems or bugs please report them on the issue tracker on GitHub.

The clear, customizable cooldown notifications ensure players always know exactly how long they need to wait, reducing frustration and confusion.

🔹 Reward Your Supporters

With the tiered permission system, you can offer faster message rates as a perk for donors or long-time members, creating an additional incentive for supporting your server.

🔹 Perfect for All Server Types

Whether you're running a survival, creative, minigame, or roleplay server, MessageCooldownPRO adapts perfectly to your needs. It's especially valuable on high-population servers where chat can quickly become overwhelming.
Commands

/msgcooldown reload - Reload the plugin configuration
/msgcooldown reset <player> - Reset cooldown for a specific player
/msgcooldown reset all - Reset cooldowns for all players

Permissions

msgcooldown.default - Access to default cooldown (5 seconds)
msgcooldown.premium - Access to premium cooldown (3 seconds)
msgcooldown.vip - Access to VIP cooldown (1 second)
msgcooldown.bypass - Bypass cooldown completely
msgcooldown.admin - Access to administrative commands

Installation

Download MessageCooldownPRO.jar

Place it in your server's plugins folder

Restart your server or use a plugin loader

Configure settings in the config.yml file (optional)

Assign permissions to your players ( for example for vip just put whatever type of cooldown u want )

Support and Feedback

We're dedicated to making MessageCooldownPRO the best chat cooldown plugin available. If you have suggestions, encounter any issues, or just want to share your experience, please reach out through our support channels.

title: LockDrop
description: Allows you to lock an item to prevent accidental dropping.
body:
This mod allows you to lock an item to prevent it from being dropped from your inventory.
Sometimes you accidentally press “Q” and throw an important item into the void, lava, a cactus, or someone’s farm on the server.

Just press the “L” key while hovering over an item in your inventory, and you won’t be able to drop it without confirmation.

You can also hold an item in your hand and lock it by using the command /lockdrop

body:
# How it works
Allows for you to use the Axe/Sword you put in on your off-hand slot by right clicking. This allows for interesting combos with the following:

Axe & Sword - Axe & Axe - Sword & Sword - Axe & Trident - Sword & Shield - More!

# Configuration
The default cooldown for off-hand swinging is higher than the weapon's attack speed for balance purposes, however this can be modified with the following gamerules:
`/gamerule duelWieldSwordCooldown <value>`
`/gamerule duelWieldAxeCooldown <value>`
The default value for Axe is 100 and for Sword it is 30, lowering the value will speed up the attack speed, and increasing the value will slow down the attack speed.

- **Kits** - Timed kits with cooldowns and permissions (includes 3 default kits)
- **Crates** - Reward crate system with animations (includes 3 default crates)
- **Claims** - Land protection system with trust management

### 👑 **VIP Features**

### 🛡️ **Moderation Tools**

### 📊 **Server Management**
- **Scoreboard** - Dynamic sidebar with live player stats
- **Tab List** - Customizable player list formatting
- **Performance Tools** - Anti-lag features and resource monitoring
- **Module System** - Toggle features on/off as needed
- **World Manager** - Multi-world support and management

### 🔧 **Utility Commands**
- `/workbench` - Open crafting table anywhere
- `/anvil` - Open anvil interface
- `/enderchest` - Access your ender chest
- `/hat` - Wear any item as a hat
- `/trash` - Disposable trash GUI
- `/heal` - Heal yourself or others
- `/feed` - Restore hunger
- And 30+ more utility commands!

---

## 🎯 What Makes AwesomeNeeded Different?

### **All-in-One Solution**
Stop juggling multiple plugins! AwesomeNeeded combines 40+ essential features into one optimized package.

### **GUI-First Design**
Every feature has an intuitive in-game GUI - no need to memorize complex commands or edit config files in-game.

- Efficient database handling with HikariCP connection pooling
- Async operations where possible
- Minimal server impact with optimized code

### **Modern & Maintained**

### **Crates (3 Pre-configured)**

- **Rare Crate** - Diamond blocks, netherite scraps, totems
- **Epic Crate** - Netherite ingots, elytra, beacons

---

## 🔌 Integration Support

### **Optional Dependencies (Soft Dependencies)**
- **Vault** - Economy integration (has built-in fallback)
- **PlaceholderAPI** - Dynamic placeholder support
- **LuckPerms** - Advanced permission integration

All integrations are optional - AwesomeNeeded works perfectly standalone!

---

1. Download `AwesomeNeeded-1.0.0.0.jar`
2. Place in your server's `plugins/` folder
3. Start/restart your server

All permissions follow the format: `awesome.<feature>`

## ⚡ Performance

AwesomeNeeded is designed with performance in mind:

- Optimized database queries with prepared statements
- Async operations for I/O-heavy tasks

- Smart caching to reduce redundant operations
- Resource monitoring and anti-lag features included

Suitable for servers of all sizes - from small community servers to large networks!

title: Civilizations999
description: Civilizations is a robust Minecraft faction management system that enables players to form organized groups, set territories, and collaborate with team-based features.
body:
The Civilizations plugin is designed to enhance multiplayer gameplay in Minecraft by allowing players to create and manage their own civilizations. This plugin introduces a structured system for players to form factions, manage members, and engage in cooperative gameplay. With features like customizable civilization names, spawn points, and exclusive commands, players can enjoy a rich and immersive experience.

Features
Civilization Creation: Players can create their own civilizations with unique names and descriptions.
Member Management: Leaders can invite players, kick members, and manage ranks within their civilization.
Spawn Points: Each civilization can set a designated spawn point for its members.
Private Chat: Toggle chat visibility so that only civilization members can see messages.
GUI Interface: A user-friendly graphical interface to view civilization information and members.
Friendly Fire Prevention: Automatically prevents damage between members of the same civilization.
Configurable Limits: Set maximum members per civilization and default spawn locations.
Persistent Data Storage: All civilization data is saved in a YAML configuration file.
Commands
/civilizations create <name> [description]: Create a new civilization with an optional description.
/civilizations invite <player>: Invite a player to join your civilization.
/civilizations join: Accept a pending invitation to join a civilization.
/civilizations leave: Leave your current civilization.
/civilizations setspawn <civilization>: Set the spawn point for your civilization (Leader only).
/civilizations info [civilization]: View information about a specific civilization or all civilizations.
/civilizations myciv: View your civilization's members and leader.
/civilizations rename <newname>: Rename your civilization (Leader only).
/civilizations kick <player>: Kick a player from your civilization (Leader only).
/civilizations chat: Toggle chat visibility for your civilization.
/civilizations disband: Disband your civilization (Leader only).
/civilizations config reload: Reload the configuration file (OP only).
Permissions
civilizations.create: Allows players to create civilizations.
civilizations.invite: Allows players to invite others to their civilization.
civilizations.join: Allows players to join a civilization.
civilizations.leave: Allows players to leave their civilization.
civilizations.setspawn: Allows leaders to set the spawn point for their civilization.
civilizations.info: Allows players to view civilization information.
civilizations.myciv: Allows players to view their own civilization's details.
civilizations.rename: Allows leaders to rename their civilization.
civilizations.kick: Allows leaders to kick members from their civilization.
civilizations.chat: Allows players to toggle private chat for their civilization.
civilizations.disband: Allows leaders to disband their civilization.
civilizations.config: Allows OPs to reload the configuration file.
Conclusion
The Civilizations plugin is perfect for Minecraft servers looking to enhance community interaction and teamwork. With its robust features and easy-to-use commands, players can immerse themselves in a world of collaboration and strategy, making every gameplay session unique and engaging.

body:
![CmbMinigamesBanner.png](https://github.com/29cmb/CmbMinigames/blob/master/docs/images/CmbMinigamesBanner.png?raw=true)

# Cmb Minigames
An open source minecraft plugin for playing a variety of minigames with your friends

A video demo can be found [here](https://youtu.be/MwLLYsCOvPg)

## Minigames
- Manhunt
    - Players pick if they want to be a runner or a hunter using the `/runner` and `/hunter` commands
    - Once the game starts after 30 seconds, runners will be placed into survival and put at the world spawn
    - After another 15 seconds, hunters are also put into survival and put at world spawn
    - Hunters win if they kill all the runners
    - Runners win if they kill the ender dragon
    - Hunters have unlimited lives, and runners will be ELIMINATED if they die
- Block Shuffle
    - Players are assigned a block every 5 minutes
    - Everyone must obtain and stand on their assigned block before the timer runs out
    - If you do not find your block in time you will be ELIMINATED
- Death Swap
    - Every 7 minutes, players will be swapped with one another
    - The goal of the game is to kill the other players and be the last man standing
    - If you die, you will be ELIMINATED
- Death Shuffle
    - This minigame is very similar to block shuffle
    - Every 5 minutes you will be assigned a source of death
    - Everyone must die to that source before the timer runs out
    - If you do not die by the proper source, you will be ELIMINATED

![1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fedba216992bf67f95c81339458f4230455737f7.png)


# How to create custom Steps in the plugin?

**1. Create a standard resource pack. In the assets/minecraft folder, create two folders:**
   font
   textures

**2. In the /assets/minecraft/font folder, create a default.json file**

An example of the contents of the default.json file:


```
{
    { “providers”: [
        {
            { “type”: { “bitmap”,
            { “file”: “minecraft:{your file name in the '/assets/minecraft/textures/yourfile'} folder”,
            “ascent": 9, 
            “height": 11,
            “chars": [
                “ٸ” // The character to which the image will be applied
            ]
        }
    ]
}
```


    Note: The ascent parameter should not be greater than the height value

**3. In the /assets/minecraft/textures folder, add your picture**

**4. Pack the contents of your resource pack into a .zip archive.**
    Upload the archive to DropBox.
